explanation_mandarin: 表示用來裝物品的容器（通常為編織或有框的容器），也常作構詞成分出現在籃球等詞語中。
explanation_english: A container, usually woven or framed, used to hold items. Also appears as a morpheme in compounds like 'basketball'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲水果擺喺籃入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 seoi2 gwo2 baai2 hai6 laam4 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把水果放在篮子里面。
examples.english_sentence: Put the fruit in the basket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買個籃嚟裝啲菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 go3 laam4 lei4 zong1 di1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买个篮子来装菜。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a basket to hold some vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鐘意打籃球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 daa2 laam4 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢打篮球。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to play basketball.

mandarin_meaning: 篮子 (lánzi)
english_meaning: basket
explanation_mandarin: 指由柳條、竹、塑料或其他材料編織或製成的容器，用來盛放物品。也可泛指類似用途的容器。
explanation_english: A container made from woven materials (e.g. wicker, bamboo) or plastic used to hold items; can also refer generally to similar containers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個新籃子去街市買菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 laam4 zi2 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个新篮子去菜市场买菜。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new basket to go to the market to buy vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲衫放喺個籃子入面，記得攞返去洗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saam1 fong3 hai2 go3 laam4 zi2 jap6 min6, gei3 dak1 lo2 faan1 heoi3 sai2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服放在篮子里，记得拿去洗。
examples.english_sentence: The clothes are in the basket; remember to take them to wash.

mandarin_meaning: 篮底；（篮球）篮筐/得分；（口语）商店中的打折/清仓篮
english_meaning: bottom of a basket; (in basketball) the hoop/net or a made basket; (colloquial) a clearance basket in shops
explanation_mandarin: “籃底”字面意思是籃子的底部。在籃球語境下可指籃筐或進球（入籃）。在日常口語中，也常用於商店指放減價或清倉貨品的籃子（如“籃底貨”）。
explanation_english: Literally the bottom of a basket. In basketball contexts it can refer to the hoop/net area or a made basket (a scored shot). Colloquially in shops it may refer to a clearance basket holding discounted items (as in '籃底貨').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條籃底爛咗，要換一個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 laam4 dai2 laan6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 篮底坏了，要换一个。
examples.english_sentence: The bottom of the basket is broken; we need to replace it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今場入咗三個籃底，幫球隊贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 coeng4 jap6 zo2 saam1 go3 laam4 dai2, bong1 kau4 deoi2 jeng4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这场投进了三个篮，帮球队赢了。
examples.english_sentence: He scored three baskets in this game, helping the team win.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市入面有個籃底，啲貨係減價品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 laam4 dai2, di1 fo3 hai6 gaam2 gaa3 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市里面有个篮底，货品是减价品。
examples.english_sentence: There's a clearance basket in the supermarket; the items are discounted.

mandarin_meaning: 篮板（指篮球框后方的支撑板；或指抢到的篮板/篮板数）
english_meaning: backboard (the board behind the basket); rebound (the act or statistic of retrieving the ball after a missed shot)
explanation_mandarin: 在篮球运动中，指篮筐后面的支撑板（即“篮板”本体）；在赛事统计或口语中也常指抢到的篮板球或篮板数量。
explanation_english: In basketball, refers to the backboard behind the hoop; in stats or casual speech it can also mean a rebound (the retrieval of the ball after a missed shot) or the number of rebounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場佢攞咗十個籃板，表現好出色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 keoi5 lo2 zo2 sap6 go3 laam4 baan2, biu2 jin2 hou2 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛他抢了十个篮板，表现很出色。
examples.english_sentence: He grabbed ten rebounds in this game; his performance was outstanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個籃板有啲鬆，投籃時彈得唔穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 laam4 baan2 jau5 di1 sung1, tau4 laam5 si4 daan6 dak1 m4 wan6 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个篮板有点松，投篮时弹得不稳定。
examples.english_sentence: That backboard is a bit loose; shots rebound unpredictably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練叫我哋要爭籃板，唔好放棄第二次機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zang1 laam4 baan2, m4 hou2 fong3 hei3 dai6 ji6 ci3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练叫我们要争抢篮板，不要放弃第二次机会。
examples.english_sentence: The coach told us to fight for rebounds and not give up on second-chance opportunities.

mandarin_meaning: 篮板球：指篮球比赛中从篮筐或篮板反弹出的球，或指抢篮板的动作/相关统计（篮板数）。
english_meaning: Rebound (in basketball): the ball that bounces off the rim or backboard, or the action/statistic of gaining rebounds.
explanation_mandarin: 籃板球主要用於籃球比賽，指球從籃筐或籃板反彈後可被爭取得到的球，也常用來表示個人或球隊的籃板數據或搶籃板的動作。
explanation_english: Used in basketball: refers to the ball that rebounds off the rim or backboard and can be contested, and also refers to the act/statistic of collecting rebounds by a player or team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今場攞咗十個籃板球，防守好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 coeng4 lo2 zo2 sap6 go3 laam4 baan2 kau4, fong4 sau2 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這場搶了十個籃板，防守很厲害。
examples.english_sentence: He grabbed ten rebounds in this game; his defense was great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練叫我哋多爭籃板球，唔好畀對手爭走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 do1 zang1 laam4 baan2 kau4, m4 hou2 bei2 deoi3 sau2 zang1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练叫我们多争篮板球，不要让对手抢走。
examples.english_sentence: The coach told us to fight more for rebounds and not let the opponents take them.

mandarin_meaning: 篮框
english_meaning: basketball hoop; rim (and sometimes the backboard) - the target for scoring
explanation_mandarin: 指籃球場上的籃圈或籃框結構（有時包含籃板），是投籃得分的目標。
explanation_english: Refers to the basketball hoop or rim (sometimes including the backboard); the structure that serves as the target for scoring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個籃框好高，好難投中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 laam4 kwaang1 hou2 gou1, hou2 naan4 tau4 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 篮框很高，很难投中。
examples.english_sentence: The basketball hoop is very high; it's hard to make a shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個籃框壞咗，要換一個先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 laam4 kwaang1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 篮框坏了，要换一个才行。
examples.english_sentence: The hoop is broken; we need to replace it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練叫我哋把球打向籃框邊緣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 giu3 ngo5 dei6 baa2 kau4 daa2 hoeng3 laam4 kwaang1 bin1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练叫我们把球打向篮框边缘。
examples.english_sentence: The coach told us to aim the ball toward the rim's edge.

mandarin_meaning: 篮球
english_meaning: basketball (the sport or a basketball game)
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語中，籃波是籃球的口語說法，指籃球運動、籃球比賽或籃球這個球類。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 籃波 (laam4 bo1) is the colloquial term for 'basketball', referring to the sport, a basketball game, or the ball itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意打籃波，每個星期同朋友去球場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 daa2 laam4 bo1, mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 tung4 pang4 jau5 heoi3 kau4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢打篮球，每个星期和朋友去球场。
examples.english_sentence: I like playing basketball; I go to the court with friends every week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場籃波比賽好精彩，兩隊打到最後先分勝負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 laam4 bo1 bei2 coi3 hou2 zing1 coi2, loeng5 deoi6 daa2 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 sin1 fan1 sing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場篮球比赛很精彩，兩隊打到最後才分勝負。
examples.english_sentence: This basketball game was exciting; the two teams played until the end before deciding the winner.

mandarin_meaning: 篮球 (lánqiú)
english_meaning: basketball
explanation_mandarin: 一種球類運動，由兩隊在有籃筐的場地上比賽得分，也可指比賽所用的球。
explanation_english: A ball sport played between two teams who score by shooting a ball through the opponent's hoop; also refers to the ball used in the sport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鐘意打籃球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 daa2 laam4 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢打篮球。
examples.english_sentence: I like playing basketball.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺學校籃球隊做隊長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hok6 haau6 laam4 kau4 deoi6 zou6 deoi6 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在学校篮球队做队长。
examples.english_sentence: He is the captain of the school's basketball team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個星期六有籃球比賽，你去唔去？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing1 kei4 luk6 jau5 laam4 kau4 bei2 coi3, nei5 heoi3 m4 heoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个星期六有篮球比赛，你去不去？
examples.english_sentence: There's a basketball game this Saturday — are you going?

mandarin_meaning: 篮球场
english_meaning: basketball court
explanation_mandarin: 供打篮球的场地，通常有球场标线、篮框和观众区域，既可室外亦可室内。
explanation_english: A playing area marked for basketball, usually with court lines, hoops, and sometimes spectator areas; can be indoor or outdoor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去籃球場打波啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 laam4 kau4 coeng4 daa2 bo1 laa1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去篮球场打球吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the basketball court to play basketball tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個社區嘅籃球場好乾淨，幾多人都喺度練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 se5 keoi1 ge3 laam4 kau4 coeng4 hou2 gon1 zeng6, gei2 do1 jan4 dou1 hai2 dou6 lin6 zaap6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个社区的篮球场很干净，很多人在那里练习。
examples.english_sentence: The basketball court in this neighborhood is very clean; many people practice there.

mandarin_meaning: 筹（籌）：筹划、筹集（资金）；也指筹码、代币
english_meaning: to plan; to raise funds; (noun) a token or chip (e.g., gambling chip) or a bargaining chip
explanation_mandarin: 「籌」常用於表示籌劃、籌集資金（如籌款、籌集）或指實體的籌碼、代幣（如籌碼、籌碼作為談判籌碼）。在粵語中常見於複合詞如「籌款」「籌劃」「籌碼」。
explanation_english: The character 籌 is used for planning or raising funds (e.g., 籌款), and as a noun it denotes a token/chip or bargaining chip. In Cantonese it commonly appears in compounds like 籌款, 籌劃, 籌碼.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要籌集資金先可以展開呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 cau4 zaap6 zi1 gam1 sin1 ho2 ji5 zin2 hoi1 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要籌集資金才能展開這個項目。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to raise funds before it can start this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺賭場，你見到張枱上有好多籌碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 dou2 coeng4, nei5 gin3 dou3 zoeng1 toi2 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 cau4 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在賭場，你看到桌子上有很多籌碼。
examples.english_sentence: At the casino, you can see many chips on the table.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋仲喺籌劃下個季度嘅市場策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zung6 hai2 cau4 waak6 haa6 go3 gwai3 dou6 ge3 si5 coeng4 caak3 loek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們還在籌劃下個季度的市場策略。
examples.english_sentence: They are still planning next quarter's market strategy.

mandarin_meaning: 筹备；准备、筹划、安排
english_meaning: to prepare; to make arrangements; to organize
explanation_mandarin: 表示为某项活动、计划或事务进行准备、筹划和安排的过程或动作。
explanation_english: Refers to the process or action of preparing, planning, and arranging for an event, plan, or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要籌備周年晚會，大家分工合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 cau4 bei6 zau1 nin4 maan5 wui6, daai6 gaa1 fan1 gung1 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要筹备周年晚会，大家分工合作。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to prepare for the anniversary party; everyone will divide the work and cooperate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲未開始籌備搬屋，要快啲計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 mei6 hoi1 ci2 cau4 bei6 bun1 uk1, jiu3 faai3 di1 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我还没开始筹备搬家，需要尽快计划。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't started preparing for the move yet; I need to plan quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府正籌備疫苗接種計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zing3 cau4 bei6 jik6 miu4 zip3 zung3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府正在筹备疫苗接种计划。
examples.english_sentence: The government is preparing a vaccination plan.

mandarin_meaning: 筹划（筹划、策划、制定计划或安排）
english_meaning: to plan; to devise; to scheme; to make arrangements
explanation_mandarin: 表示筹划、策划、制定计划或安排，常用于正式或书面语境，强调提前安排与布局。
explanation_english: To plan or devise a scheme; to draw up plans and make arrangements, often used in formal contexts to emphasize organizing and strategizing in advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司需要好好籌劃明年的市場策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 hou2 hou2 cau4 waak6 ming4 nin4 ge3 si5 coeng4 caak3 loek6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司需要好好筹划明年的市场策略。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to carefully plan its marketing strategy for next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要籌劃一次社區活動，吸引更多居民參與。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cau4 waak6 jat1 ci3 se5 keoi1 wut6 dung6, kap1 jan5 gang1 do1 geoi1 man4 caam1 jyu5。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要筹划一次社区活动，吸引更多居民参与。
examples.english_sentence: We need to plan a community event to attract more residents to participate.

mandarin_meaning: 籌募 / 筹募 (chóumù)，募集資金或捐款
english_meaning: to raise funds; to solicit donations
explanation_mandarin: 指為某個項目或目的募集資金或捐款，常用於慈善、項目啟動或基金成立等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to collecting funds or soliciting donations for a project or purpose, commonly used for charity, project launches, or establishing a fund.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家要為呢個慈善項目籌募資金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 wai6 ni1 go3 ci4 sin6 hong6 muk6 cau4 mou6 zi1 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們現在要為這個慈善項目籌募資金。
examples.english_sentence: We now need to raise funds for this charity project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會公開籌募新基金，邀請市民捐款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 gung1 hoi1 cau4 mou6 san1 gei1 gam1, jiu1 cing2 si5 man4 gyun1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府會公開籌募新基金，邀請市民捐款。
examples.english_sentence: The government will publicly raise a new fund and invite citizens to donate.

mandarin_meaning: 筹措（筹集、安排資金或資源）
english_meaning: to raise or arrange funds/resources; to make provisions
explanation_mandarin: 指籌集或安排資金、物資或其他資源，通常用於為項目、救援或計劃提供所需的經費或資源。
explanation_english: To collect or arrange funds, supplies, or other resources—commonly used when securing money or resources for projects, relief efforts, or planned activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要籌措資金，準備擴展業務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 cau4 co3 zi1 gam1, zeon2 bei6 kwaa3 zin2 jip6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要筹措资金，准备扩展业务。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to raise funds to prepare for business expansion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要籌措緊急救援經費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 cau4 co3 gan2 gap1 gau3 wun6 ging1 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要筹措紧急救援经费。
examples.english_sentence: The government must mobilize funds for emergency relief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋小組要諗辦法籌措活動經費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 siu2 zou2 jiu3 lam2 baan6 faat3 cau4 co3 wut6 dung6 ging1 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们小组要想办法筹措活动经费。
examples.english_sentence: Our team needs to find ways to raise funds for the event.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）籌款；募捐
english_meaning: to raise funds; to run a fundraising drive (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，指為某項目或機構籌集資金、舉辦募捐活動。此詞較非正式，主要在香港地區口語中出現。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term used to mean raising money or holding a fundraising drive. Informal usage primarily found in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋呢個禮拜要籌旗，幫學校籌款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ni1 go3 lai5 baai3 jiu3 cau4 kei4, bong1 hok6 haau6 cau4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們這個禮拜要做籌旗，幫學校籌款。
examples.english_sentence: This week we're doing a fundraising drive to raise money for the school.

mandarin_meaning: 筹款；筹集资金
english_meaning: to raise funds; fundraising
explanation_mandarin: 指為某個目的（如慈善、救援或社區項目）募集金錢的行為或活動。可作動詞（籌款）或名詞（籌款活動）使用。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or event of soliciting or collecting money for a specific purpose (e.g., charity, relief, community projects). Can be used as a verb or a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月要搞一個籌款活動，幫助有需要嘅家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 gaau2 jat1 go3 cau4 kwan2 wut6 dung6, bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月要举办一个筹款活动，帮助有需要的家庭。
examples.english_sentence: We're organizing a fundraising event next month to help families in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要籌款唔容易，需要好好計劃同埋宣傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 cau4 kwan2 m4 jung4 ji6, seoi1 jiu3 hou2 hou2 gai3 waak6 tung4 maai4 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要筹款不容易，需要好好计划和宣传。
examples.english_sentence: Raising funds isn't easy; it requires careful planning and publicity.

mandarin_meaning: 筹码（談判或賭局中用作籌注或交換的東西）
english_meaning: bargaining chip; (poker/casino) chips; leverage
explanation_mandarin: 指談判、交易或博弈中用來交換、威脅或下注的籌注或優勢；也可引申為可用來交換利益或影響結果的資源或籌碼。
explanation_english: Refers to chips used for betting or the leverage/items used in negotiations and transactions; can also mean resources or advantages that can be traded to gain benefits or influence outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺談判入面冇籌碼，難以爭取好條件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 taam4pun3 jap6min6 mou5 cau4 maa5, naan4 ji5 zang1 ceoi2 hou2 tiu4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在談判中沒有籌碼，難以爭取好條件。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't have any bargaining chips in the negotiation, so it's hard for him to secure good terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賭場入面啲籌碼係用嚟下注嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou2 coeng4 jap6 min6 di1 cau4 maa5 hai6 jung6 lei4 haa6 zyu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 賭場裡的籌碼是用來下注的。
examples.english_sentence: The chips in the casino are used for placing bets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府用資源作為籌碼，換取其他國家嘅支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jung6 zi1 jyun4 zok3 wai6 cau4 maa5, wun6 ceoi2 kei4 taa1 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 zi1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府用資源作為籌碼，換取其他國家的支持。
examples.english_sentence: The government uses resources as bargaining chips to gain support from other countries.

mandarin_meaning: 筹划并组成（组织、团体）；组建
english_meaning: to organize; to form or set up (a group, team, organization)
explanation_mandarin: 指策劃、籌備並組成一個組織、團隊或機構，通常用於成立新團體或準備參與活動（例如選舉、義工隊等）。
explanation_english: Refers to planning, preparing and forming a group, team, or organization; commonly used when establishing a new unit or preparing for an activity (e.g., an election team, volunteer group).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算籌組一個義工隊，去幫社區嘅長者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 cau4 zou2 jat1 go3 ji6 gung1 deoi6, heoi3 bong1 se5 keoi1 ge3 zoeng2 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們打算籌組一個義工隊，去幫助社區的長者。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to organize a volunteer team to help the elderly in the community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政黨開始籌組候選人嘅團隊，準備參選。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 dong2 hoi1 ci2 cau4 zou2 hau6 syun2 jan4 ge3 tyun4 deoi2, zeon2 bei6 caam1 syun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政黨開始籌組候選人的團隊，準備參選。
examples.english_sentence: The party has begun assembling the candidate's team to prepare for the election.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家籌組緊一個新部門，負責研發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 cau4 zou2 gan2 jat1 go3 san1 bou6 mun4, fu6 zaak3 jin4 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司正在籌組一個新部門，負責研發。
examples.english_sentence: The company is currently forming a new department responsible for R&D.

mandarin_meaning: 筹办
english_meaning: to organize; to make arrangements; to prepare
explanation_mandarin: 表示籌劃並處理各項事務或活動的安排與準備。
explanation_english: To plan, organize, and make arrangements or preparations for events, activities, or affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要籌辦下星期嘅年會，仲有好多嘢未安排好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 cau4 baan6 haa6 sing1 kei4 ge3 nin4 wui6, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 mei6 on1 paai4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要籌辦下星期的年會，還有很多事情還沒安排好。
examples.english_sentence: We're organizing next week's annual meeting; there are still many things not yet arranged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司由佢負責籌辦新產品嘅發佈會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau4 keoi5 fu6 zaak3 cau4 baan6 san1 caan2 ban2 ge3 faat3 bou3 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司由他負責籌辦新產品的發佈會。
examples.english_sentence: The company put him in charge of organizing the launch event for the new product.

mandarin_meaning: 筹钱（為某個目的募集或籌措資金）
english_meaning: to raise money; to collect funds
explanation_mandarin: 指為某個目的或活動籌措資金，例如為醫療費、項目或慈善活動募集金錢。
explanation_english: To gather or raise money for a purpose or activity, such as paying medical bills, funding a project, or supporting a charity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要為阿媽醫藥費籌錢，你可以借我啲錢嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai6 aa3 maa1 ji1 joek6 fai3 cau4 cin2, nei5 ho2 ji5 ze3 ngo5 di1 cin2 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要為媽媽的醫藥費籌錢，你可以借給我一些錢嗎？
examples.english_sentence: We need to raise money for Mom's medical bills. Can you lend me some money?

mandarin_meaning: 籌集 / 筹集 (chóu jí) — 籌措或收集資金、物資等
english_meaning: to raise; to collect (funds, resources)
explanation_mandarin: 表示為達成某個目的而籌措或收集資金、物資或其他資源，常用於募款或組織資源的語境。
explanation_english: Means to obtain or gather funds, supplies, or other resources for a particular purpose; commonly used in contexts like fundraising or resource mobilization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司計劃籌集資金去擴展業務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gai3 waak6 cau4 zaap6 zi1 gam1 heoi3 kwaa3 zin2 jip6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司計劃籌集資金來擴展業務。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to raise funds to expand its business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想透過網上眾籌嚟籌集所需嘅資金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 tau3 gwo3 mong5 soeng6 zung3 cau2 lai4 cau4 zaap6 so2 seoi1 ge3 zi1 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們打算透過網路眾籌來籌集所需的資金。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to use online crowdfunding to raise the funds they need.

mandarin_meaning: 籍 (jí)：書籍；登記、名冊或身份記錄（如戶籍、國籍）
english_meaning: jid (zik6): book; register; record; used in compounds like 'household registration' (戶籍) and 'nationality' (國籍)
explanation_mandarin: 「籍」常用於合成詞，表示書本或登記、記錄身份的名冊，例如「書籍」、「戶籍」、「國籍」。
explanation_english: The character 籍 is commonly used in compounds to mean books or registers/records of identity, as in 書籍 (books), 戶籍 (household registration), 國籍 (nationality).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅戶籍喺香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 wu6 zik6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的戶籍在香港。
examples.english_sentence: His household registration is in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館有好多古典書籍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 jau5 hou2 do1 gu2 din2 syu1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圖書館有很多古典書籍。
examples.english_sentence: The library has many classical books.

mandarin_meaning: 籍贯 (祖籍、家族的原籍或來源地)
english_meaning: ancestral home; native place of family origin
explanation_mandarin: 指一家人的原籍或祖先出自的地區；常用來表示人的籍屬來源，不一定等於出生地。
explanation_english: Refers to a family's ancestral home or the place where one's ancestors originated; often used to indicate family origin and not necessarily the person's place of birth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你籍貫係邊度？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zik6 gwaan3 hai6 bin1 dou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的籍贯是哪里？
examples.english_sentence: Where is your ancestral home?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我籍貫係廣東台山，但我喺香港出世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zik6 gwaan3 hai6 gwong2 dung1 toi4 saan1, daan6 ngo5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 ceot1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的籍贯是广东台山，但我在香港出生。
examples.english_sentence: My ancestral home is Taishan, Guangdong, but I was born in Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 藤（téng）：攀緣植物或由其製成的材料，如藤製的椅子、籃子等。
english_meaning: rattan; vine; cane (the climbing plant or the material made from it, used for weaving furniture and baskets)
explanation_mandarin: 指一種攀緣植物（藤）或用該植物纖維編織而成的材料，常用來製作家具、籃子等生活用品。
explanation_english: Refers to a climbing plant (rattan) or the material made from its fibers, commonly used to weave furniture, baskets, and other household items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張籐椅幾舒服喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 tang4 ji2 gei2 syu1 fuk6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張藤椅很舒服喔。
examples.english_sentence: This rattan chair is very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用籐條編咗個籃，放水果好啱用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 tang4 tiu4 bin1 zo2 go3 laam4, fong3 seoi2 gwo2 hou2 aam1 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用藤條編了一個籃子，放水果很合適。
examples.english_sentence: He wove a basket from rattan strips; it's great for holding fruit.

mandarin_meaning: 籟（lài）：風聲或竹管、樂器發出的聲音，常用於文言或詩詞中表示自然或樂音。
english_meaning: Laì; the sound of wind or flute-like sounds produced by pipes/bamboo — a literary term for natural or musical sounds.
explanation_mandarin: 「籟」原指竹管或管樂發出的聲音，引申為風聲或自然發出的音響，常見於古文與詩詞中，現代口語較少使用。
explanation_english: Originally refers to sounds from bamboo pipes or wind instruments; extended to mean wind sounds or natural acoustics. It is a literary/classical term and uncommon in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚聽到山林入面嘅籟聲，好寧靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 teng1 dou3 saan1 lam4 jap6 min6 ge3 laai6 seng1, hou2 ning4 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上聽到山林裡的籟聲，很寧靜。
examples.english_sentence: At night I hear the flute-like/wind sounds in the forest; it's very peaceful.

mandarin_meaning: 笼，指用竹、木、金属等编制或构成的容器（如鸟笼、蒸笼）；也可作动词，意为包围、囊括或笼络。
english_meaning: cage; basket; steamer basket; (verb) to enclose, to entrap, to win over
explanation_mandarin: 「籠」常指用來裝東西或關動物的容器（例如鳥籠、蒸籠），在複合詞中也常用來表示包圍或籠絡的意思（如籠絡）。
explanation_english: The character refers to a container made from bamboo, wood, or metal (e.g. birdcage, steamer basket). In compounds it can also convey the idea of enclosing or winning someone over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將隻雀關喺籠入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 zek3 zoek3 gwaan1 hai2 lung4 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把那只鸟关在笼子里。
examples.english_sentence: He put the bird in the cage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個蒸籠，成日用嚟蒸饅頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 zeng1 lung4, sing4 jat6 jung6 lai4 zeng1 maan6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个蒸笼，常用来蒸馒头。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a steamer basket and often use it to steam buns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個籠仔擺喺廳頭，入面放緊雜物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 lung4 zai2 baai2 hai2 teng1 tau4, jap6 min6 fong3 gan2 zaap6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小篮子放在客厅里，里面放着杂物。
examples.english_sentence: The little basket is in the living room with miscellaneous items inside.

jyutping: lung4 liu4 (不確定，疑為非標準拼寫或打字錯誤；請提供原字或上下文以便確認)
mandarin_meaning: 不明（可能為非標準用法或打字錯誤，需提供更多上下文以確認）
english_meaning: Unknown (likely non-standard slang, typo, or romanisation; more context needed to determine meaning)
explanation_mandarin: 「籠liu」並非常見或可確認的粵語詞彙。看起來是以中文字符「籠」配合羅馬拼寫「liu」的混合寫法，可能是打字錯誤、網絡用語或地方性俚語。若可提供原文上下文或對應漢字，才能給出準確解釋與拼音。
explanation_english: “籠liu” is not a recognized standard Cantonese word. It appears to mix the character 籠 with the romanisation “liu” and may be a typo, internet slang, or a local variant. More context or the intended Chinese character(s) is needed to provide an accurate meaning and correct Jyutping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個「籠liu」係咩意思？我唔識，係咪打錯字？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 「lung4 liu4」 hai6 me1 ji3 si1? ngo5 m4 sik1, hai6 m4 da2 co3 zi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個「籠liu」是什麼意思？我不認識，是否打錯字？
examples.english_sentence: What does this “籠liu” mean? I don't recognize it — is it a typo?

mandarin_meaning: 笼子
english_meaning: cage; coop; (figuratively) a confinement or trap
explanation_mandarin: 指用来关住动物或物品的笼状容器；也可比喻限制自由的环境或陷阱。
explanation_english: A cage-like container used to confine animals or objects; can also be used metaphorically for an environment or situation that restricts freedom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個籠子嚟放雀仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 lung4 zi2 lai4 fong3 zoek3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个笼子来养小鸟。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a cage to keep a bird.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份合約就好似個籠子，限制咗佢嘅自由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 zau6 hou2 ci5 go3 lung4 zi2, haan6 zai3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 zi6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同就像一个笼子，限制了他的自由。
examples.english_sentence: This contract is like a cage, restricting his freedom.

mandarin_meaning: 籠屋（lóngwū）：指把居住空間以籠子或鐵絲格劃分的極小居住單位，常見於香港的貧窮住屋情況。
english_meaning: Cage home: a very small subdivided living unit formed by metal cages or wire partitions, typically associated with extreme poverty in Hong Kong.
explanation_mandarin: 籠屋是指把單位劃成多個以鐵籠或格子隔開的居住格間，空間狹窄、設施簡陋，住戶多為低收入或無家可歸者，屬社會住房問題的一種現象。
explanation_english: A cage home refers to living units subdivided into many small metal-caged cubicles or wire partitions. They are extremely cramped with minimal facilities; residents are often low-income or homeless. It is a social housing issue especially associated with Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家住喺籠屋，連張床都冇位擺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zyu6 hai2 lung4 uk1, lin4 zoeng1 cong4 dou1 mou5 wai2 baai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在住在籠屋，連床都沒地方放。
examples.english_sentence: He now lives in a cage home; there's not even room for a bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 籠屋通常由好多個鐵籠組成，住得好擠迫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lung4 uk1 tung1 soeng4 jau4 hou2 do1 go3 tit3 lung4 zou2 sing4, zyu6 dak1 hou2 zai1 bik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 籠屋通常由很多個鐵籠組成，居住非常擠迫。
examples.english_sentence: Cage homes are usually made up of many metal cages; living conditions are very cramped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要改善籠屋居民嘅居住條件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 goi2 sin6 lung4 uk1 geoi1 man4 ge3 geoi1 zyu6 tiu4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要改善籠屋居民的居住條件。
examples.english_sentence: The government should improve the living conditions of cage home residents.

mandarin_meaning: 掩護；包庇（俚語）
english_meaning: to cover for someone; to shield or protect someone (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「籠底」為粵語俚語，常用來表示替人掩護、包庇或在背後幫忙頂住責任。有時用作名詞指被用來包庇或掩護的人或行為。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning to cover for someone, shield or protect them (often by hiding mistakes or taking the blame). It can be used as a verb (to cover for) or as a noun (the act/person that covers).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日做我籠底，自己面對後果啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 zou6 ngo5 lung4 dai2, zi6 gei2 min6 deoi3 hau6 gwo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要老是為我掩護，自己面對後果吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep covering for me; face the consequences yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司畀員工犯錯，老闆做籠底幫佢掩住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bei2 jyun4 gung1 faan6 co3, lou5 baan2 zou6 lung4 dai2 bong1 keoi5 jim2 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司讓員工犯錯，老闆為他掩護。
examples.english_sentence: When an employee makes a mistake, the boss covers for him.

mandarin_meaning: 籠屋居民；住在籠屋（用金屬籠子或鐵網劃分的狹小單位）的人
english_meaning: cage-home residents; people who live in 'cage homes'—very small, often metal-caged sleeping cubicles in subdivided flats
explanation_mandarin: 「籠民」是香港廣東話口語，指居住在籠屋（以金屬籠或類似隔間構成的極狹小居住單位）的人，通常帶有貧窮與社會議題的涵義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used in Hong Kong for people who live in 'cage homes'—tiny, often metal-caged cubicles inside subdivided flats. The term usually carries connotations of poverty and housing problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多籠民住喺冇窗嘅籠屋入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 lung4 man4 zyu6 hai2 mou5 coeng1 ge3 lung4 nguk1 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多籠民住在沒有窗戶的籠屋裡。
examples.english_sentence: There are many cage-home residents in Hong Kong living in windowless cage homes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該改善籠民嘅居住條件，提供更安全同有尊嚴嘅住屋選擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 goi2 sin3 lung4 man4 ge3 geoi1 zyu6 tiu4 gin6, tai4 gung1 gang3 on1 cyun4 tung4 jau5 zyun1 jim4 ge3 zyu6 nguk1 syun2 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該改善籠民的居住條件，提供更安全和有尊嚴的住房選擇。
examples.english_sentence: The government should improve the living conditions of cage-home residents and provide safer, more dignified housing options.

mandarin_meaning: （香港口語）悄悄溜走、偷偷離開
english_meaning: Hong Kong colloquial: to sneak off; to slip away quietly (often implying leaving without informing or shirking responsibility)
explanation_mandarin: 籠溜是香港粵語口語用法，指悄悄地離開某處或在人不注意時溜走，有時含有逃避責任或不願交代的意味。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquialism meaning to quietly slip away or sneak off, often carrying the nuance of leaving without explanation or shirking responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到老闆嚟就籠溜走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 lou5 baan2 lai4 zau6 lung4 lau6 zau2 zo2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到老闆來就悄悄溜走了。
examples.english_sentence: He saw the boss coming and quietly slipped away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再籠溜，出返嚟面對問題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 lung4 lau6, ceot1 faan1 lai4 min6 deoi3 man6 tai4 laa1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別再偷偷溜走，出來面對問題吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't sneak off again — come out and face the problem.

mandarin_meaning: 笼络（人心）；拉拢、收买以取得支持或好感
english_meaning: to win over; to curry favor; to win someone's support (often by flattery, gifts, or manipulation)
explanation_mandarin: 指用各種手段（如奉承、送禮、拉攏）取得他人好感或支持，常含有策略性或不太光明正大的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to using various means (flattery, gifts, courting) to gain someone's favor or support; often implies strategic or somewhat unscrupulous methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日送禮去籠絡啲重要嘅客戶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 sung3 lai5 heoi3 lung4 lok3 di1 zung6 jiu3 ge3 haak3 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常送禮去籠絡重要的客戶。
examples.english_sentence: He often gives gifts to win over important clients.

mandarin_meaning: 笼统
english_meaning: vague; general; not specific
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容說話或表述不具體、不詳細、概括性強、缺乏具體細節。
explanation_english: Describes speech or descriptions that are not specific or detailed; general and lacking concrete details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好籠統，唔講清楚細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 lung4 tung2, m4 gong2 cing1 co2 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話很籠統，沒有講清楚細節。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very vaguely and doesn't explain the details clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 笼罩 (lóngzhào)
english_meaning: to envelop; to shroud; to cover; to cast (a shadow or atmosphere) over
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物或某種氣氛包圍、覆蓋某處或某人的狀態，常用於描述霧、陰影、情緒或局勢等被籠罩的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates that something or some atmosphere envelops or covers a place or person; commonly used for fog, shadows, moods, or situations that 'shroud' or 'hang over' something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成座城市都被濃霧籠罩住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 zo6 sing4 si5 dou1 bei6 nung4 mou6 lung4 ziu6 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整座城市都被濃霧籠罩著。
examples.english_sentence: The whole city was shrouded in thick fog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恐懼感籠罩住整個會場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung2 geoi1 gam2 lung4 ziu6 zyu6 zing2 go3 wui6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恐懼感籠罩著整個會場。
examples.english_sentence: A sense of fear hung over the entire venue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情籠罩住成個世界，大家都好關注情況發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 cing4 lung4 ziu6 zyu6 sing4 go3 sai3 gaai3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 gwaan1 zyu3 qing4 fong3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情籠罩著整個世界，大家都很關注情況發展。
examples.english_sentence: The pandemic has engulfed the whole world; everyone is closely watching how the situation develops.

mandarin_meaning: 被關在籠子裡的雞會反抗；比喻被長期壓抑或限制的人最終起來反抗或製造麻煩
english_meaning: A caged chicken rebels; metaphor for someone who, after being confined or suppressed for a long time, finally rebels or acts out
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容受限制、受壓的人或群體，因為不滿或受壓太久，最終爆發、反抗或製造麻煩。亦可泛指本來被控制的對象突然起來反對。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person or group who, after being constrained or oppressed for a long time, eventually erupts in rebellion or causes trouble. Can be used metaphorically for someone who suddenly turns against their controller.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司成日剝削員工，總有一日會籠裏雞作反。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sing4 jat6 bok3 zoek3 jyun4 gung1, zung2 jau5 jat1 jat6 wui5 lung4 leoi5 gai1 zok3 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司經常剝削員工，遲早會有員工起來反抗。
examples.english_sentence: The company keeps exploiting its staff; sooner or later someone will rebel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日咁控制佢哋，驚佢哋籠裏雞作反，就要小心後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 gam2 hung3 zai3 keoi5 dei6, geng1 keoi5 dei6 lung4 leoi5 gai1 zok3 faan2, zau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你總是這樣控制他們，怕他們被逼得反抗，要小心後果。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep controlling them like that, you're risking them rebelling — be careful about the consequences.

mandarin_meaning: 籠中雞反抗／受困卻反抗（比喻受人照顧或受控制，反而不知感恩或作對）
english_meaning: A caged chicken rebels (idiom) — to rebel or make trouble despite being under someone's care or control; to resist futilely when trapped
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人在被照顧、受保護或處於受控環境下，卻仍然反抗、不知感恩或製造麻煩；也可指在困境中做出徒勞無益的反抗。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person who, despite being cared for or controlled, becomes rebellious or ungrateful and causes trouble; can also refer to a futile or pointless resistance when trapped.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司畀佢住同食，佢仲成日鬧老闆，真係籠裡雞作反。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bei2 keoi5 zyu6 tung4 sik6 , keoi5 zung6 sing4 jat6 naau6 lou5 baan2 , zan1 hai6 lung4 leoi5 gai1 zok3 faan2 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司給他食宿，他還整天罵老闆，真是籠中雞作反。
examples.english_sentence: The company provides him with housing and food, yet he keeps scolding the boss—what a caged chicken rebelling.

mandarin_meaning: 籠中雞反抗 / 受保護或被照顧後反過來反抗或忘恩負義
english_meaning: lit. a caged chicken rebels — to rebel/act up (often after being sheltered or cared for); to be ungrateful or turn against one’s benefactors
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俗語（片語 / 成語性短語）
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，形容本來被照顧、受保護或受約束的人，忽然反抗、頂撞或忘恩負義。用於批評那些對幫助自己的人反過來不識感恩或造反的人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial idiom describing someone who, after being sheltered, protected, or restrained, suddenly rebels, acts up, or is ungrateful toward those who helped them. Often used to criticize people who turn against their benefactors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀屋企人照顧咁耐，點知而家籠裡雞作反，成日頂撞佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 uk1 kei5 jan4 ziu3 gu3 gam2 noi6, dim2 zi1 ji4 gaa1 lung4 leoi5 gai1 zok3 faan2, sing4 jat6 deng2 zong6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被家人照顧這麼久，誰知現在反過來頂撞他們。
examples.english_sentence: He was taken care of by his family for so long, but now he turns around and argues with them all the time.

mandarin_meaning: 籠裡的雞作反（比喻受拘束或被管得緊的人長大後反抗或惹事）
english_meaning: A caged chicken rebels — figuratively, someone who, after being constrained or overly controlled, rebels or causes trouble when given an opportunity.
explanation_mandarin: 用籠中之雞會反抗來比喻被嚴格管束或受限制的人，長大或有機會時會反抗、頂撞或惹事。
explanation_english: Compares a caged chicken rebelling to a person who has been tightly controlled; when given the chance they react by rebelling, talking back, or creating trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日畀屋企人管住，長大咗一有機會就籠裡鷄作反。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 bei2 uk1 kei5 jan4 gun2 zyu6, coeng4 daai6 zo2 jat1 jau5 gei1 wui6 zau6 lung4 leoi5 gai1 zok3 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候常被家里管得很严，长大后一有机会就开始反叛。
examples.english_sentence: Tightly controlled as a child, once grown up he/she rebels at the first chance.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻在被限制或困住的情況下，人變得暴躁、鬧事或作出違逆行為
english_meaning: Literally 'a caged chicken revolts' — describes someone who, when confined or restricted, becomes irritable and causes trouble or rebels
explanation_mandarin: 此俗語形象地比喻人在狹小空間或受束縛時容易發脾氣、惹事或反抗，常用於描述因受限而引發的爭執或不服從行為。
explanation_english: A figurative expression used to describe someone who, when confined or restricted, becomes irritable and stirs up trouble or rebels. Commonly used to refer to disputes or rebellious behavior caused by restriction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家唔畀佢出街，佢就喺屋企籠裹雞作反，搞到成日鬧交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 m4 bei2 keoi5 ceot1 gaai1, keoi5 zau6 hai2 uk1 kei2 lung4 gwo2 gai1 zok3 faan2, gaau2 dou3 sing4 jat6 nau6 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在不讓他出門，他就在家裡鬧事，弄得整天吵架。
examples.english_sentence: Now that he's not allowed out, he makes a fuss at home, causing constant arguments.

mandarin_meaning: 小籠子；用來關禽畜或存放物品的小型籠子（口語常寫作「籠仔」）
english_meaning: a small cage or coop; a little basket-like enclosure used to keep animals or store items (colloquially 'small cage')
explanation_mandarin: 「籠𨋢」是廣東話口語用詞，指用竹、藤、金屬或其他材料做成的小籠子，常用來關小型家禽或暫時存放物品。書寫上常見寫法為「籠仔」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 籠𨋢 (lung4 zai2) refers to a small cage made of bamboo, wire, or other materials, typically used to hold small poultry or temporarily store items. It is commonly written colloquially as '籠仔'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企有隻雞，我擺咗佢入籠𨋢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jau5 zek3 gai1, ngo5 baai2 zo2 keoi5 jap6 lung4 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡有一隻雞，我把它放進小籠子裡。
examples.english_sentence: There is a chicken at home; I put it into the small cage.

mandarin_meaning: 籤；簽；抽籤用的籤條（求籤、籤詩）
english_meaning: a lot/stick or slip used for drawing lots or divination; a fortune slip; (verb) to draw lots
explanation_mandarin: 指用於抽籤或占卜的細長籤條或籤詩；也可作動詞，表示抽取籤占卜或決定事務。
explanation_english: Refers to the stick or slip used for drawing lots or divination (fortune slip); can also be used as a verb meaning to draw a lot for divination or decision-making.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去廟入面抽籤，睇下今年嘅運勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 miu6 jap6 min6 cau1 cim1, tai2 haa5 gam1 nin4 ge3 wan6 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去廟裡求籤，看看今年的運勢。
examples.english_sentence: Go to the temple to draw a lot and see this year's fortune.

mandarin_meaning: 簽文／籤詩（廟宇抽籤得到的文字，用來占卜吉凶）
english_meaning: fortune slip; the text on a divination lot (used in temple divination)
explanation_mandarin: 指廟宇或占卜時抽到的籤上所寫的文字或詩句，常用來解籤、預示吉凶或指引行為。
explanation_english: The written text or verse on a divination slip (lot) drawn at temples or during fortune-telling, used to interpret fortunes, omens, or give guidance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拜完神，我去抽籤，攞到嘅籤文寫住「事事順利」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baai3 jyun4 san4, ngo5 heoi3 cau1 cim1, lo2 dou3 ge3 cim1 man4 se2 zyu6 'si6 si6 seon6 lei6'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拜完神，我去抽籤，抽到的簽文寫著「事事順利」。
examples.english_sentence: After worshipping, I drew a lot; the fortune slip I got said 'everything will go smoothly.'

mandarin_meaning: 籤詩 (廟宇抽籤所得的詩句，用於占卜吉凶)
english_meaning: fortune-telling slip; an oracle poem drawn during divination
explanation_mandarin: 指在廟宇或神壇抽籤時得到的籤文或詩句，用來占卜未來的吉凶或提供指示。通常會配有籤義解說，供信眾參考。
explanation_english: A slip of paper bearing a short poem or verse drawn during divination (often at a temple). It is used to predict luck or offer guidance, usually accompanied by an interpretation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日去廟入面抽籤，攞到張籤詩話我最近會有好運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1jat6 heoi3 miu6 jap6 min6 cau1 cim1, lo2 dou3 zoeng1 cim1 si1 waa6 ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 wui5 jau5 hou2 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天去廟裡抽籤，抽到的籤詩說我最近會有好運。
examples.english_sentence: I went to the temple today to draw a lot; the fortune slip I got says I'll have good luck soon.

mandarin_meaning: 篱；篱笆、围栏
english_meaning: fence; hedge; enclosure
explanation_mandarin: 指用來圍護或隔開空間的柵欄或籬笆，常見於庭院、田地或花園周圍。
explanation_english: Refers to a fence or hedge used to enclose or separate spaces, commonly found around yards, fields, or gardens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企後面條籬笆爛咗，要搵人修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 hau6 min6 tiu4 lei4 baa1 laan6 zo2, jiu3 wan2 jan4 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家後面的籬笆爛了，要找人修理。
examples.english_sentence: The fence at the back of the house is broken and needs to be repaired.

mandarin_meaning: 罕见或方言词，暂无固定现代汉语对应；可能为地名、人名或外来语音译
english_meaning: A rare/obscure Cantonese term with no widely accepted modern meaning; possibly a dialectal or archaic word or a transliteration of a name/place
explanation_mandarin: 「籬士」讀作 lei4 si6，在現代粵語詞典和常用語料中極為罕見，沒有一致的詞義記載。可能出現在方言、古籍或作為人名、地名或外來詞的音譯。使用時應按語境判斷，若無上下文則視作不確定或古語、方言詞。
explanation_english: “籬士” (lei4 si6) is extremely rare in modern Cantonese resources and lacks a consistent documented meaning. It may occur in dialectal speech, older texts, or as a transliteration of a personal/place name or foreign word. Interpretation depends on context; without context it should be treated as obscure or dialectal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺舊書入面見到個詞「籬士」，但唔知佢係咩意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gau6 syu1 jap6 min6 gin3 dou3 go3 ci4 "lei4 si6", daan6 m4 zi1 keoi5 hai6 me1 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在舊書裡看到詞「籬士」，但不知道它是什麼意思。
examples.english_sentence: I saw the term "籬士" in an old book, but I don't know what it means.

mandarin_meaning: 篱笆和竹子；用以描绘乡村景象或质朴生活（方言、罕见用法）
english_meaning: literally 'fence and bamboo'; used to evoke rural scenes or simple, rustic life (dialectal/rare usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「籬更竹」為廣東話中的少見詞語，字面指籬笆與竹子，常用來描繪鄉村、田園或樸實的生活景象。有時亦可作比喻，表示簡單、樸素的氛圍或環境。
explanation_english: “籬更竹” is a rare Cantonese expression literally meaning 'fence and bamboo'. It is used to evoke rural or pastoral scenes and a simple, rustic way of life. It can be used literally or metaphorically to describe a plain, unpretentious environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度仲保留住好多籬更竹嘅農村景象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 zung6 bou2 lau4 zyu6 hou2 do1 lei4 gang1 zuk1 ge3 nung4 cyun1 ging2 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里仍保留着许多篱笆和竹子的农村景象。
examples.english_sentence: This place still preserves many rural scenes of fences and bamboo.

mandarin_meaning: 篱笆，栅栏
english_meaning: fence; barrier (usually a low fence made of wood, bamboo, or metal)
explanation_mandarin: 指用木、竹、鐵等材料搭成，用來圈住或隔開空間的籬笆或柵欄。
explanation_english: A fence or barrier, typically made of wood, bamboo, or metal, used to enclose or separate spaces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋主喺後園搭咗道籬笆，遮住咗街道嘅視線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 zyu2 hai2 hau6 jyun4 daap3 zo2 dou6 lei4baa1, ze1 zyu6 zo2 gaai1 dou6 ge3 si6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 屋主在後院搭起了一道籬笆，遮住了街道的視線。
examples.english_sentence: The homeowner put up a fence in the backyard, blocking the view of the street.

mandarin_meaning: 箩（luó），籃子；一籮（量詞/方言用法，表示許多）
english_meaning: basket (woven bamboo/rattan); a basketful; colloquially 'a lot' (in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 指用竹、藤等編成的盛物器具（籃子），可搭配量詞表示一籮或一籮筐；口語中亦常用作比喻，表示『很多、一大堆』。
explanation_english: Refers to a woven basket (often bamboo or rattan) used to hold items. Can mean 'a basketful' and is also used colloquially/metaphorically to indicate a large quantity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一籮菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 lo4 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一籮菜。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a basket of vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一手拎住個籮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sau2 ling1 zyu6 go3 lo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一手提著籃子。
examples.english_sentence: He was holding the basket with one hand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講咗一籮嘢，講到我頭都大晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 zo2 jat1 lo4 je5, gong2 dou3 ngo5 tau4 dou1 daai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說了一籮子的話，說得我頭都大了。
examples.english_sentence: He said a whole bunch of things — it left me overwhelmed.

mandarin_meaning: 一大堆；很多（口語）
english_meaning: a pile/ton/loads of (Cantonese slang for 'a lot')
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語俚語，表示數量很多或一大堆東西，等同「一籮筐」「一大堆」。多用於非正式口語場合。
explanation_english: Cantonese colloquial slang used to indicate a large quantity or a big pile of something (equivalent to 'a ton', 'loads', or 'a whole lot'). Used mainly in informal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企有籮pat衫，唔知點樣收晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 jau5 lo4 pat1 saam1, m4 zi1 dim2 joeng6 sau1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家有很多衣服，不知道怎麼收好。
examples.english_sentence: I have loads of clothes at home; I don't know how to put them all away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日市場有籮pat菜，平到唔得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 si5 coeng4 jau5 lo4 pat1 coi3, peng4 dou3 m4 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天市場有很多菜，便宜得不得了。
examples.english_sentence: There are tons of vegetables at the market today — they're insanely cheap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家有籮pat嘢要做，忙到飛起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 jau5 lo4 pat1 je5 jiu3 zou6, mong4 dou3 fei1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司現在有很多事情要做，忙得不得了。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a ton of work right now; we're unbelievably busy.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：篮子底下的橙子。引申：比喻被遗弃、剩下或不被看重的东西或人（俗语、俚语用法）。
english_meaning: Literal: oranges at the bottom of a basket. Figurative: something or someone left behind, leftover, unwanted, or considered of low value (slang/idiomatic).
explanation_mandarin: 常用於粵語俚語，原指放在籮底的橙子（可能不新鮮或沒有人挑），引申指被遺棄、剩下或不被重視的人或物。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang/idiom: literally oranges at the bottom of a basket (often undesirable or not fresh). Figuratively used for people or things that are leftover, unwanted, or disregarded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲水果係籮底橙，已經唔係好新鮮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 seoi2 gwo2 hai6 lo4 dai2 caang4, ji5 ging1 m4 hai6 hou2 san1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些水果放在篮子底下，已经不太新鲜了。
examples.english_sentence: These fruits are at the bottom of the basket; they're not very fresh anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日被人取笑，覺得自己好似籮底橙咁冇人要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bei6 jan4 ceoi2 siu3, gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hou2 ci5 lo4 dai2 caang4 gam2 mou5 jan4 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常被人取笑，覺得自己像籮底橙一樣沒有人要。
examples.english_sentence: He's often mocked and feels like a basket-bottom orange — nobody wants him.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語俗語，罕見）把東西裝/撥進籮裡；引申為大量收集或一次性拿很多東西
english_meaning: (Cantonese, colloquial/rare) to scoop or pull things into a basket; figuratively, to make a big haul or collect a lot at once
explanation_mandarin: 詞形由「籮」（盛物的籃子）與「拔」（拔取、撥取）組成。此詞在廣東話口語中屬於地方性的俗語或罕用詞，字面指將物件撥入籮中，延伸用法可表示一次性收集或買入大量物品。現代文獻或詞典收錄較少，使用時帶有口語和地區色彩。
explanation_english: Composed of 籮 (basket) and 拔 (to pull/scoop). This is a regional/colloquial Cantonese expression, rare in formal references. Literally it means to scoop or pull items into a basket; figuratively it can mean to collect or buy a large amount (to make a big haul). The term is informal and regionally marked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市集上今日有特價，阿姐一下子買到籮拔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zaap6 soeng6 gam1 jat6 jau5 dak6 gaa3, aa3 ze2 jat1 haa6 zi2 maai5 dou3 lo4 bat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天市集有特價，阿姐一下子買了很多（籮拔）。
examples.english_sentence: There were bargains at the market today—Sister bought a whole lot at once.

mandarin_meaning: 篮子里的柚子；（口语）很多、一大堆
english_meaning: a basketful of pomelos; (colloquial) a lot / a whole pile
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（可作量词短语/口语用法）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can be used figuratively as a quantifier/colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 字面为“篮子里的柚子”，可指实际的一篮柚子。在粤语口语中，有时会引申用作表示数量多或一大堆的说法，属于口语化表达。
explanation_english: Literally 'a basket of pomelos'. It can mean an actual basketful of pomelos. In Cantonese colloquial speech it is sometimes extended figuratively to mean 'a lot' or 'a whole pile' and is informal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市場賣緊一籮柚，好多人買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 coeng4 maai6 gan2 jat1 lo4 jau4, hou2 do1 jan4 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市场上正在卖一篮柚子，很多人买。
examples.english_sentence: They're selling a basket of pomelos at the market; many people are buying them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家有一籮柚嘢要做，忙到冇時間食晏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 jat1 lo4 jau4 je5 jiu3 zou6, mong4 dou3 mou5 si4 gaan3 sik6 ngaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在有一大堆事情要做，忙到没时间吃午饭。
examples.english_sentence: He has a whole pile of things to do right now; he's so busy he doesn't have time for lunch.

mandarin_meaning: 愛霸佔或霸道的人；喜歡獨佔、搶佔資源或位置的人（廣東話俚語）
english_meaning: A Cantonese slang term for a person who hogs or monopolizes, behaves dominantly or bossily, and takes more than their fair share.
explanation_mandarin: 「籮霸」是廣東話口語／俚語，用來形容喜歡霸佔、獨佔或以強勢壓人、佔盡便宜的人。可用作稱呼或描述行為。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone who hogs, monopolizes, or acts domineeringly — someone who takes more than their share or pushes others aside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食飯嗰陣，佢成日拎最多嘢，真係個籮霸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 faan6 go2 zan6, keoi5 sing4 jat6 ling1 zeoi3 do1 je5, zan1 hai6 go3 lo4 baa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃飯時，他總拿最多東西，真是個愛霸佔的人。
examples.english_sentence: At meals, he always takes the most; he's such a hog.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做籮霸，等其他細路都玩吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 lo4 baa3, dang2 kei4 taa1 sai3 lou6 dou1 waan2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當個霸道的人，讓其他小朋友也玩一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a hog; let the other kids have a turn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺班度成日做籮霸，好少理人意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 baan1 dou6 sing4 jat6 zou6 lo4 baa3, hou2 siu2 lei5 jan4 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在班上總是很霸道，很少聽別人的意見。
examples.english_sentence: He always plays the boss in class and rarely listens to others' opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 呼籲；懇求；號召
english_meaning: to call on; to appeal; to implore; to urge
explanation_mandarin: 籲常用於「呼籲」等詞，表示向他人發出請求、號召或要求採取某種行動或注意事項，偏書面或正式用語。
explanation_english: The character 籲 (jyu3) appears in compounds like '呼籲' and means to call on, appeal, or implore — urging people to take action or pay attention. It is often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府呼籲市民留喺屋企唔好外出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 fu1 jyu3 si5 man4 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei5 m4 hou2 ngoi6 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府呼籲市民留在家裡不要外出。
examples.english_sentence: The government appealed to citizens to stay at home and not go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋呼籲大家支持呢個環保計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 fu1 jyu3 daai6 gaa1 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 waan4 bou2 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們呼籲大家支持這個環保計劃。
examples.english_sentence: We call on everyone to support this environmental protection plan.

mandarin_meaning: 米（mǐ）：稻米、米飯；口語可指公尺（米，mĕtĕr）；粵語俚語指錢
english_meaning: rice (grain or cooked rice); colloquially: metre (meter) and slang for money
explanation_mandarin: 「米」通常指稻米或米飯；口語中也用作度量單位「米」表示公尺；在粵語俚語中可指金錢（如「有米」＝有錢）。
explanation_english: ‘米’ generally means rice (grain or cooked rice). Colloquially it can denote the unit metre (meter). In Cantonese slang it is also used to mean money (e.g. '有米' = have money).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落街買啲白米先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 gaai1 maai5 di1 baak6 mai5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先去街上買點白米。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go out and buy some white rice first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家好有米，買到架新車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 jau5 mai5, maai5 dou3 gaa3 san1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在很有錢，買得起新車。
examples.english_sentence: He's rich now and can afford a new car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條繩有五米長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 sang4 jau5 ng5 mai5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條繩有五米長。
examples.english_sentence: This rope is five meters long.

mandarin_meaning: 米仔兰（粤语地方俗名）——一种小型的兰花（地方名称）
english_meaning: A Cantonese local name for a small orchid (a type of orchid commonly grown in pots or found locally)
explanation_mandarin: 「米仔蘭」是粵語地區的俗稱，通常指體型較小或常見於盆栽／野外的蘭花品種。該名稱屬於地方俗稱，並非嚴格的植物學名，主要在香港及廣東地區使用。
explanation_english: “米仔蘭” is a Cantonese regional/common name usually used for small orchids that are grown in pots or seen locally. It is a vernacular name rather than a strict botanical term and is mainly used in Hong Kong and Guangdong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽鍾意種花，屋企有幾盆米仔蘭，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 zung1 ji3 zung3 faa1, uk1 kei5 jau5 gei2 pun4 mai5 zai2 laan4, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈喜欢种花，家里有几盆米仔兰，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: My mother likes growing flowers; there are a few pots of 米仔蘭 at home — they're very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 花市入面今朝有啲新鮮嘅米仔蘭賣，啱晒入門新手養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa1 si5 jap6 min6 gam1 ziu1 jau5 di1 san1 sin1 ge3 mai5 zai2 laan4 maai6, aam1 saat3 jap6 mun4 san1 sau2 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 花市里面今天有些新鲜的米仔兰出售，适合入门新手养护。
examples.english_sentence: The flower market had some fresh 米仔蘭 this morning — perfect for beginner plant keepers.

mandarin_meaning: 英國國旗（聯合王國國旗），俗稱米字旗
english_meaning: The Union Jack / Union Flag (the national flag of the United Kingdom)
explanation_mandarin: 指英國或聯合王國的國旗，因旗面交叉的紅白藍圖案形似漢字「米」，故俗稱米字旗。
explanation_english: Refers to the national flag of the United Kingdom, commonly known as the Union Jack. The nickname '米字旗' comes from the flag's crossed pattern resembling the Chinese character 米.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰面牆掛住一幅米字旗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 min6 coeng4 gwaa3 zyu6 jat1 fuk1 mai5 zi6 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那面牆掛着一面米字旗。
examples.english_sentence: There's a Union Jack hanging on that wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗一件印有米字旗嘅T恤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 jat1 gin6 jan3 jau5 mai5 zi6 kei4 ge3 T-seot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿了一件印有米字旗的T恤。
examples.english_sentence: He's wearing a T-shirt printed with the Union Jack.

mandarin_meaning: 家境窮困、生活拮据，連飯都不夠或生活困難
english_meaning: Very poor or financially strapped; so short of resources that one can't even afford proper meals
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，形容家庭或個人生活拮据、貧困，常用以強調連米飯或基本生活所需都不足。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing a state of poverty or severe financial shortage — literally 'little rice, meals burnt' — used to emphasize lacking even basic food or resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月開支多，屋企真係米少飯焦燶，連請個醫生都驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 hoi1 zi1 do1, uk1 kei5 zan1 hai6 mai5 siu2 faan6 ziu1 nong4, lin4 cing2 go3 ji1 sang1 dou1 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月开支太多，家里真是拮据得连请医生都怕花不起钱。
examples.english_sentence: We had too many expenses this month; the household is really strapped for cash — we're even afraid we can't afford a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 事情已成定局，無法挽回（相當於「覆水難收」）
english_meaning: What’s done is done; the matter is irreversible
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是米已經成為熟飯，比喻事情已經發生、無法改變或挽回。
explanation_english: Literally 'the rice has already been cooked'; metaphorically used when something has already happened and cannot be changed or undone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家後悔冇用，米已成炊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hau6 fui3 mou5 jung6, mai5 ji5 sing4 ceoi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在后悔也没用，事情已成定局。
examples.english_sentence: It's no use regretting now; what's done is done.

mandarin_meaning: 米每秒（速度單位，符號 m/s）
english_meaning: meters per second (unit of speed, symbol m/s)
explanation_mandarin: 表示速度的單位，等於每秒通過多少米。常見寫法還有「米/秒」或符號「m/s」。在口語或網絡用語中，有時也用來誇張地形容速度很快。
explanation_english: A unit of speed indicating how many meters are covered per second. Commonly written as "米/秒" or the symbol "m/s". Occasionally used colloquially or online to humorously describe something very fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車嘅最高速度係三十米每秒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 ge3 zeoi3 gou1 cuk1 dou6 hai6 saam1 sap6 mai5 mui5 miu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车的最高速度是三十米每秒。
examples.english_sentence: The top speed of this car is 30 meters per second.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢嘅速度好快，簡直係米每秒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 ge3 cuk1 dou6 hou2 faai3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 mai5 mui5 miu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说话的速度很快，简直是米每秒。
examples.english_sentence: You speak so fast, it's literally meters per second.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）有錢或有背景而顯得傲慢、愛炫耀的氣派；也可作字面義指米飯的香味
english_meaning: slang: an air of wealth or snobbishness (showing off money); literally 'smell/air of rice' (rice aroma)
explanation_mandarin: 米氣常用作俚語，形容一個人因為有錢或有靠山而表現出一種傲慢或愛炫耀的氣勢；在字面上也可以指煮飯時散出的米飯香氣。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese term used to describe someone’s showy, wealthy air—acting snobbish or flaunting money. Literally it can also mean the smell/steam of cooking rice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲說話好有米氣，成日喺度炫耀自己有錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 syut3waa6 hou2 jau5 mai5 hei3, sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 hyun3jiu6 zi6 gei2 jau5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話很有米氣，總是在那裡炫耀自己有錢。
examples.english_sentence: He talks with a wealthy, showy air, always bragging about having money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面飄出陣陣米氣，知道係煮緊飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4fong2 jap6 min6 piu1 ceot1 zan6 zan6 mai5 hei3, zi1dou6 hai6 zyu2 gan2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房裡飄出一陣陣米飯的香味，知道在煮飯。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen smells of rice; you can tell someone's cooking.

mandarin_meaning: （1）淘米水；（2）口語：零用錢、生活費
english_meaning: (1) rice-washing water; (2) (colloquial) pocket money / small living expenses
explanation_mandarin: 「米水」一方面可指淘米時留下的水（廚用）；另一方面在香港粵語口語中常用來指零用錢或生活上的小額開支。
explanation_english: Literally the water left from washing rice. In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, it is also used to mean pocket money or small everyday living expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月啲米水唔夠用，要慳啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 di1 mai5 seoi2 m4 gau3 jung6, jiu3 haan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月的生活费不够，要省一点。
examples.english_sentence: My living expenses for this month aren't enough; I need to save a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會用淘米水澆花，唔浪費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 jung6 tou4 mai5 seoi2 giu1 faa1, m4 long6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我會用淘米水浇花，不浪费。
examples.english_sentence: I'll use the rice-washing water to water the plants — not wasting it.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）指「美牛」，即美國牛肉（美國進口的牛肉）的非正式稱呼
english_meaning: Colloquial/slang term for "American beef" (beef imported from the United States)
explanation_mandarin: 「米牛」是口語或網路用法，常用米代替「美」來指美國，合起來即指美國牛肉（美牛）。多見於討論進口政策、食物來源或價格時的非正式語境。
explanation_english: "米牛" is an informal/internet slang abbreviation substituting 米 for 美 (America), thus referring to American beef. It is used in casual contexts when discussing imports, food sources, or pricing around U.S. beef.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近街市有啲米牛，價錢平咗啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gaai1 si5 jau5 di1 mai5 ngau4, gaa3 cin4 ping4 zo2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近菜市場有一些美國牛肉，價格便宜了一些。
examples.english_sentence: Lately the market has had some American beef, and the price has gotten a bit cheaper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府開會討論放寬米牛進口嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hoi1 wui2 tou2 leon6 fong3 fun1 mai5 ngau4 zeon3 hau2 ge3 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府正在討論放寬美國牛肉進口的政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government is discussing a policy to relax restrictions on American beef imports.

mandarin_meaning: 米商／米業大亨（俗稱）
english_meaning: rice king; a major rice/grain merchant (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「米王」原指掌握大量糧米買賣的米商或米業大亨。在口語中也可用來戲稱在某段時間內大量囤積或掌握糧食的人，屬俗稱或通俗用法，帶有比喻意味。
explanation_english: Literally 'rice king'. Historically refers to a prominent rice/grain merchant who controls large quantities of staple grain. Colloquially it can also jokingly refer to someone who hoards rice or dominates the rice/food market. It is a colloquial/figurative term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺舊時，佢哋家族係一個米王，掌握好多糧食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gau6 si4, keoi5 dei6 gaa1 zuk6 hai6 jat1 go3 mai5 wong4, zoeng2 ngok6 hou2 do1 loeng4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在過去，他們家族是個米王，掌握很多糧食。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, their family was a rice king, controlling a large amount of grain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情初期有人囤米，大家笑佢係「米王」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 cing4 co1 kei4 jau5 jan4 tyun5 mai5, daai6 gaa1 siu3 keoi5 hai6 'mai5 wong4'.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情初期有人囤米，大家笑他是「米王」。
examples.english_sentence: At the start of the pandemic some people stockpiled rice; people joked that they were 'rice kings'.

mandarin_meaning: （粗口）相當於「操你媽／屌你老母」的委婉說法，用來表示憤怒或驚訝
english_meaning: a Cantonese slang expletive used as a euphemism for profanities like "fuck your mother"; expresses anger, frustration, or surprise
explanation_mandarin: 「米田共」是香港粤語網絡與口語中的俚語，用作替代或迴避直接說出更粗的罵語。通常在生氣、驚訝或不滿時使用，語氣粗俗但較常見粗口委婉化的形式。
explanation_english: “米田共” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang often used online and in speech as a minced oath to avoid saying stronger curse words. It expresses anger, frustration, or surprise and functions as a vulgar interjection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 米田共，我啲報告又被打回頭改咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 tin4 gung6, ngo5 dik1 bou3 gou3 jau6 bei6 daa2 wui4 tau4 goi2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 該死，我的報告又被打回來修改了。
examples.english_sentence: Damn it, my report got sent back for revisions again.

mandarin_meaning: 零钱；小额钱；微不足道的钱
english_meaning: small change; spare change; a paltry/small amount of money
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语/俚语，指零散的小额钱或零钱，也可用来形容数额很少、微不足道的金钱。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term referring to small or spare change, or a very small amount of money—often used to indicate a trivial or insufficient sum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇啲米碎借我？我想買杯嘢飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 di1 mai5 seoi3 ze3 ngo5? ngo5 soeng2 maai5 bui1 je5 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有一些零錢借我？我想買杯飲料。
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any spare change to lend me? I want to buy a drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做咁多嘢淨係攞到啲米碎，真係唔抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 gam2 do1 je5 zing6 hai6 lo2 dou3 di1 mai5 seoi3, zan1 hai6 m4 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做這麼多事只拿到一點小錢，真的不划算。
examples.english_sentence: After doing so much work you only get a tiny amount—it's really not worth it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆淨係畀啲米碎，點留住好員工？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 zing6 hai6 bei2 di1 mai5 seoi3, dim2 lau4 zyu6 hou2 jyun4 gung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板只給一點小錢，怎麼留住好員工？
examples.english_sentence: The boss only pays paltry sums—how can he keep good employees?

mandarin_meaning: 盛米的碟子 / 一碟米（口語、方言用法，少見）
english_meaning: a plate/small dish of rice (literal; a rare/colloquial usage)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是盛米飯的碟子或一碟米。屬於較口語或地區性用法，並不常見，常用於講述一小份米飯或飯碟。
explanation_english: Literally 'rice plate' — a plate or small dish of rice. A colloquial or regionally used expression for a portion of rice; not a widely standard term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽盛咗一碟米畀細路食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 zo2 jat1 dip6 mai5 bei2 sai3 lou6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽盛了一碟米給小孩吃。
examples.english_sentence: Mom scooped a plate of rice for the child.

mandarin_meaning: 米粉 (mǐfěn)：用米製成的粉條或米製麵食（如米線、米粉）；另在網絡語境可指小米（Xiaomi）品牌的粉絲（俚語）。
english_meaning: rice vermicelli (rice noodles); (slang) fans of Xiaomi (the 'Mi' brand).
explanation_mandarin: 通常指以大米為原料製成的細長粉條，常用於湯粉、炒粉等菜式。在現代網絡語境下，『米粉』亦可作為對小米公司產品愛好者的暱稱（俚語）。
explanation_english: Refers to thin noodles made from rice used in soups or stir-fries. In internet slang, 'Mi fan' (米粉) can also mean devotees or fans of the Xiaomi ('Mi') brand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋食炒米粉好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 sik6 caau2 mai5 fan2 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我們吃炒米粉好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we have stir-fried rice vermicelli tonight?

mandarin_meaning: 糧食；口糧；生活所需的食物或供給
english_meaning: provisions; food supplies; grains/rations
explanation_mandarin: 指米、糧食或作為口糧的食物，亦可泛指供應生活的物資或薪資所得（口語用法）。
explanation_english: Refers to rice, grain, or food provisions used as rations; can broadly mean sustenance or supplies for daily living. Also used colloquially to mean earnings to support a household.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風嚟緊，我哋要買定啲米糧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 lai4 gan2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 maai5 ding6 di1 mai5 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 颱風快要來了，我們要提前買一些糧食。
examples.english_sentence: A typhoon is coming; we should buy some provisions in advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠呢份工攞米糧養家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 ni1 fan6 gung1 lo2 mai5 loeng4 joeng5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠這份工作賺錢養家。
examples.english_sentence: He relies on this job to earn money to support his family.

mandarin_meaning: 米线 (mǐ xiàn)
english_meaning: rice noodles; rice vermicelli
explanation_mandarin: 一种以大米制成的细长或扁平面条，常用于汤粉、干拌或炒制，不同地区有不同做法。
explanation_english: A type of noodle made from rice, typically thin or flat; used in soups, stir-fries, or dry dishes. Preparation varies by region.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食唔食米線呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1maan5 sik6 m4 sik6 mai5 sin3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃不吃米线？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to eat rice noodles tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意加辣椒同檸檬喺米線度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1ji3 gaa1 laat6ziu1 tung4 ning4mung1 hai2 mai5 sin3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢在米线里加辣椒和柠檬。
examples.english_sentence: I like adding chili and lemon to my rice noodles.

mandarin_meaning: 米缸（家中的米缸）；引申為家用、積蓄或維持生計的資金來源
english_meaning: literally 'rice jar'; figuratively the household's food supply or family finances/savings—funds that sustain a family or livelihood
explanation_mandarin: 原指存放米的缸，常用作比喻指家裡的生活基金、積蓄或主要經濟來源，有時也指養家的人或收入來源。
explanation_english: Originally the container for rice; commonly used metaphorically for household funds, savings, or the main source of income—sometimes referring to the breadwinner or livelihood source.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂用屋企個米缸，要儲啲錢應付未來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 jung6 uk1 kei2 go3 mai5 gong1, jiu3 co5 di1 cin2 jing3 fu6 mei6 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要亂花家裡的米缸，要存點錢應付未來。
examples.english_sentence: Don't recklessly spend the family's savings; save some money for the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係屋企嘅米缸，靠佢一個人養活成個家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 uk1 kei2 ge3 mai5 gong1, kaau3 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 joeng5 wut6 sing4 go3 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是家裡的米缸，靠他一個人養活整個家庭。
examples.english_sentence: He is the family's breadwinner; the whole household depends on him alone to provide.

mandarin_meaning: 米铺 / 卖米的店
english_meaning: rice shop; a store that sells rice
explanation_mandarin: 指專門售賣大米的店鋪，是廣東話中的傳統稱呼，常見於菜市或街市附近的商店。
explanation_english: A shop that specializes in selling rice. This is a traditional Cantonese term for a rice store, commonly found near markets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隔離有間老字號嘅米舖，啲米好出名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaak3 lei4 jau5 gaan1 lou5 zi6 hou6 ge3 mai5 pou3, di1 mai5 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隔壁有一家老字號的米铺，米很有名。
examples.english_sentence: There's a long-established rice shop next door; their rice is very famous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺街市買米，冇去米舖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 mai5, mou5 heoi3 mai5 pou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在菜市场买米，没有去米铺。
examples.english_sentence: We bought rice at the market and didn't go to the rice shop.

mandarin_meaning: 米色（mǐsè），指介於白色與黃色之間的淺色，像米飯的顏色
english_meaning: beige, off-white; a light color between white and yellow (like the color of rice)
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述一種淺淡的米白或奶油色調，常用於服裝、傢俱和室內設計的顏色描述。
explanation_english: Describes a light, off-white or creamy color (beige). Commonly used for clothing, furniture, and interior design.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗件米色大褸，好易襯衫褲同鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gin6 mai5 sik1 daai6 lou2, hou2 ji6 can3 saam1 fu3 tung4 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一件米色的大衣，很容易搭配衣服和鞋子。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a beige coat — it's easy to match with clothes and shoes.

mandarin_meaning: 米其林（指米其林公司、米其林指南或米其林星級）
english_meaning: Michelin (the Michelin company; the Michelin Guide; Michelin-starred restaurants)
explanation_mandarin: 「米芝蓮」是米其林在粵語的音譯，常用來指米其林指南或獲米其林星級的餐廳，也可泛指米其林品牌。
explanation_english: “米芝蓮” is the Cantonese transliteration of Michelin, commonly used to refer to the Michelin Guide, restaurants awarded Michelin stars, or the Michelin brand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間米芝蓮餐廳好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 mai5 zi1 lin4 caan1 teng1 hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家米其林餐廳很多人排隊。
examples.english_sentence: That Michelin restaurant has a long queue.

mandarin_meaning: 米兰（意大利北部城市）
english_meaning: Milan (city in northern Italy)
explanation_mandarin: 意大利北部的大城市，著名的时尚、設計與金融中心，也以教堂和歷史建築聞名。
explanation_english: A major city in northern Italy, known as a fashion, design and financial center, also noted for its cathedrals and historic architecture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去米蘭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 mai5 laan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去米兰。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Milan next month.

mandarin_meaning: 米豆（字面意思：小顆粒的豆子或米形的小豆；也可作暱稱用）
english_meaning: rice bean (literally: small beans the size/shape of rice); occasionally used as a nickname
explanation_mandarin: 「米豆」字面上指像米粒般細小的豆子。該詞為較口語或方言性用法，日常中較少見；在口語中有時也會用作暱稱，形容個子細或可愛的人。
explanation_english: Literally 'rice bean' — beans that are small or rice-shaped. This is a relatively rare or regional colloquial term. It may also be used informally as a nickname for someone small or cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗啲米豆，打算煮嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 di1 mai5 dau6, daa2 syun3 zyu2 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一些米豆，打算煮來吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some rice beans and plan to cook them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細細粒，朋友叫佢「米豆」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 sai3 lik6, pang4 jau5 giu3 keoi5 「mai5 dau6」。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他個子小，朋友叫他「米豆」。
examples.english_sentence: He's small, and his friends call him 'Maidou'.

mandarin_meaning: 出路；机会；前途（粤语俚语）
english_meaning: prospects; a way out; an opportunity (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「米路」是香港粵語的俗語，指事情或人的前途、出路或成功的機會。常見用法有「有米路」「冇米路」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning someone's prospects, a way out, or the chance of success. Commonly used in phrases like 'have prospects' or 'no prospects'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做緊嗰份工冇乜米路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gan2 go2 fan6 gung1 mou5 mat1 mai5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在做的那份工作沒有什麼前途。
examples.english_sentence: The job he's doing doesn't have much prospect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果公司唔轉型，啲舊員工可能冇米路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gung1 si1 m4 zyun2 jing4, di1 gau6 jyun4 gung1 ho2 nang4 mou5 mai5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司不轉型，這些老員工可能沒出路。
examples.english_sentence: If the company doesn't transform, those older employees might have no prospects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好太擔心，等多陣，可能會有米路嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 taai3 daam1 sam1, dang2 do1 zan6, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 mai5 lou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別太擔心，再等等，可能會有機會/出路的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry too much; wait a bit, there's likely to be an opportunity.

mandarin_meaning: 米通（mǐtōng）：一種以米製成的膨化或油炸脆零食
english_meaning: mǐtōng (puffed rice snack) — a crunchy rice-based snack, often sugar-coated
explanation_mandarin: 米通是一種以米或糯米製成的零食，通常經過膨化或油炸，口感酥脆，常見於香港和廣東地區，經常作為甜味或糖衣小食。
explanation_english: Mǐtōng is a rice-based snack made by puffing or frying rice; it has a crunchy texture and is common in Hong Kong and Guangdong, often served sweet or with a sugar coating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個我成日食米通，仲記得嗰啲味道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ngo5 sing4 jat6 sik6 mai5 tung1, zung6 gei3 dak1 go2 di1 mei6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小時候我常常吃米通，還記得那些味道。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid I often ate mǐtōng; I still remember the taste.

mandarin_meaning: 米酒；用米發酵製成的酒
english_meaning: rice wine; an alcoholic beverage fermented from rice
explanation_mandarin: 用米發酵製成的酒，常見於東亞和東南亞地區。米酒可直接飲用、用於烹調或作為節慶食品，有時為甜味且未蒸餾（如酒釀）。
explanation_english: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting rice. Common in East and Southeast Asia, rice wine can be consumed as a drink, used in cooking, or served during festivals. It is often sweet and undistilled (e.g., jiuniang).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年嘅時候，一家人會飲米酒慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, jat1 gaa1 jan4 wui5 jam2 mai5 zau2 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年的时候，全家人会喝米酒庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: During the Lunar New Year, the whole family drinks rice wine to celebrate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢樽米酒係我阿婆自家釀嘅，好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zeon1 mai5 zau2 hai6 ngo5 aa3 po4 zi6 gaa1 joeng6 ge3, hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这瓶米酒是我奶奶自家酿的，很香。
examples.english_sentence: This bottle of rice wine was homemade by my grandmother; it smells/tastes fragrant.

mandarin_meaning: 米铺（卖米或粮食的店铺）
english_meaning: rice shop; a shop that sells rice and often other grains or staples
explanation_mandarin: 指专门出售大米或其他粮食的店铺，传统街市常见的一种商铺。
explanation_english: A shop that sells rice and often other grains or staple foods; a traditional type of grocery/store found in markets and neighborhoods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隔離間米鋪今朝開門未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaak3 lei4 gaan1 mai5 pou3 gam1 ziu1 hoi1 mun4 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隔壁的米铺今天开门了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Did the rice shop next door open this morning?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺米鋪買咗一袋白米，夠我哋食幾個禮拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 mai5 pou3 maai5 zo2 jat1 doi2 baak6 mai5, gau3 ngo5 dei6 sik6 gei2 go3 lai5 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在米铺买了一袋白米，够我们吃几个礼拜。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a bag of white rice at the rice shop; it will last us a few weeks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時每條街都有間米鋪，依家多數被超市取代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 mui5 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 jau5 gaan1 mai5 pou3, ji1 gaa1 do1 sou3 bei6 ciu1 si5 ceoi2 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过去每条街都有一家米铺，现在多数被超市取代。
examples.english_sentence: There used to be a rice shop on every street; nowadays most have been replaced by supermarkets.

mandarin_meaning: 米青（顏色名）
english_meaning: rice-green (a pale, muted green with a beige/tan undertone)
explanation_mandarin: 米青指一種帶有米色或淡褐調的淺綠色，常用來形容布料、服飾或室內擺設的顏色，給人柔和、低調的感覺。
explanation_english: "Rice-green" denotes a pale, muted green with a slight beige/tan undertone. It is used to describe colors of fabrics, clothing, or interior items, conveying a soft, understated look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗件米青色外套，好襯膚色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 gin6 mai5 ceng1 sik1 ngoi6 tou3, hou2 can3 fu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一件米青色外套，很襯膚色。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a rice-green coat; it suits my skin tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企啲枕頭換咗米青色，個客廳睇落柔和咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 di1 zam2 tau4 wun6 zo2 mai5 ceng1 sik1, go3 haak3 teng1 tai2 lok6 jau4 wo4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的枕頭換成米青色，客廳看起來柔和多了。
examples.english_sentence: We changed the pillows to rice green; the living room looks softer.

mandarin_meaning: 米饭
english_meaning: cooked rice (plain boiled rice)
explanation_mandarin: 指煮熟的白米，作為主食之一，常與菜一起食用。
explanation_english: Refers to cooked rice (white rice) used as a staple food, typically eaten with other dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日唔想食米飯，想食麵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 soeng2 sik6 mai5 faan6, soeng2 sik6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天不想吃米饭，想吃面条。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to eat rice today; I want noodles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碗米飯好熱，等一陣先食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wun2 mai5 faan6 hou2 jit6, dang2 jat1 zan6 sin1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这碗米饭很热，等一会儿再吃。
examples.english_sentence: This bowl of rice is very hot; wait a bit before eating.

mandarin_meaning: 養家的人；家庭的主要經濟來源
english_meaning: breadwinner; the main earner who supports the household
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語的口語俚語，半開玩笑或直接用來指家庭或團體中負責賺錢養家、提供經濟來源的人。語氣不正式，常見於日常會話。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang term used jokingly or directly to refer to the person who earns the household's living — the main provider or breadwinner. Informal and commonly used in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋屋企嘅米飯班主，日日返工養家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ge3 mai5 faan6 baan1 zyu2, jat6 jat6 faan1 gung1 joeng5 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們家的飯票，每天上班養家。
examples.english_sentence: He is the breadwinner of our family; he goes to work every day to support us.

mandarin_meaning: 飯錢；用來買飯或作日常開銷的錢，也可泛指微薄的生活費或報酬
english_meaning: meal money; money for food or small daily expenses; can also refer to a modest income or allowance
explanation_mandarin: 指用來買飯或支付日常生活開支的錢；口語中也常用來形容微薄的收入或僅夠維持生計的錢。
explanation_english: Refers to money used to buy food or cover everyday living expenses. Colloquially, it can describe a meager income or just enough money to get by.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以借我五十蚊做米飯錢？
