examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 m4 soeng2 zing6 hai6 zi2 soeng6 taam4 bing1, jiu3 ngo5 dei6 gaau1 sat6 zai3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆不想只是紙上談兵，要我們提交實際的方案。
examples.english_sentence: The boss doesn't want us to just do paper planning; he wants us to submit practical plans.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇實際經驗嘅理論喺工作入面往往只係紙上談兵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 sat6 zai3 ging1 jim6 ge3 lei5 leon6 hai2 gung1 zok3 jap6 min6 wong5 wong5 zi2 hai6 zi2 soeng6 taam4 bing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沒有實際經驗的理論在工作中往往只是紙上談兵。
examples.english_sentence: Theory without hands-on experience often remains just paper talk at work.

mandarin_meaning: 纸包（用纸包裹的东西；亦见于成语“纸包不住火/纸包唔住火”）
english_meaning: paper wrapper; something wrapped in paper; (used in idiom) cannot hide the truth
explanation_mandarin: “紙包”字面意思是用纸包着的包装或包裹，例如纸包鸡。引申用在成语“紙包唔住火”（纸包不住火），表示事实终会被揭露，无法长期掩盖真相。
explanation_english: Literally a paper wrapper or a thing wrapped in paper (e.g. paper‑wrapped chicken). Figuratively appears in the idiom “紙包唔住火” meaning that the truth cannot be hidden or covered up for long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想食紙包雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 sik6 zi2 baau1 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚想吃纸包鸡。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat paper‑wrapped chicken tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲謠言遲早會畀揭穿，紙包唔住火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jiu4 jan4 ci4 zou2 wui5 bei2 kit3 cyun1, zi2 baau1 m4 zyu6 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些谣言迟早会被揭穿，纸包不住火。
examples.english_sentence: Those rumors will be exposed sooner or later; you can't hide the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 纸包不住火
english_meaning: You can't hide the truth/Secrets won't stay hidden
explanation_mandarin: 比喻真相或秘密終會被揭穿，無法長久隱瞞。
explanation_english: A metaphorical saying meaning the truth or a secret cannot be concealed forever; it will eventually be revealed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嗰啲嘢終於俾人發現，紙包唔住火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 go2 di1 je5 zung1 jyu1 bei2 jan4 faat3 jin6, zi2 baau1 m4 zyu6 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做的那些事終於被人發現，紙包不住火。
examples.english_sentence: What he did was eventually found out — you can't hide the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講大話畀人搵到證據，紙包唔住火，遲早要負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 daai6 waa6 bei2 jan4 wan2 dou3 zing3 geoi3, zi2 baau1 m4 zyu6 fo2, ci4 zou2 jiu3 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他撒的謊被人找到證據，紙包不住火，遲早要負責。
examples.english_sentence: His lies were exposed by evidence; you can't hide the truth — sooner or later he'll be held accountable.

mandarin_meaning: 纸包饮品 / 纸盒饮料（盒装饮料）
english_meaning: paper-packaged drinks; carton/boxed beverages
explanation_mandarin: 指用紙或紙盒包裝的飲品，例如紙盒果汁、盒裝牛奶或紙包飲料，通常為一次性包裝，部分可回收或需分類處理。
explanation_english: Refers to drinks packaged in paper or paperboard cartons/boxes (e.g., juice boxes, boxed milk, Tetra Pak-style beverages). Typically single-use packaging; some types are recyclable but may require separation for recycling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市入面有好多唔同口味嘅紙包飲品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 hau2 mei6 ge3 zi2_baau1_jam2_ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市里面有很多不同口味的纸包饮品。
examples.english_sentence: There are many paper-packaged drinks in different flavors in the supermarket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔成日帶紙包飲品去學校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 seng4 jat6 daai3 zi2_baau1_jam2_ban2 heoi3 hok6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友经常带纸包饮品去学校。
examples.english_sentence: Kids often bring carton drinks to school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款紙包飲品可以回收，但要分開處理先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 zi2_baau1_jam2_ban2 ho2 ji5 wui4 sau1, daan6 jiu3 fan1 hoi1 cyu3 lei5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种纸包饮品可以回收，但要分类处理才行。
examples.english_sentence: This type of paper-packaged drink can be recycled, but it needs to be separated for proper disposal.

mandarin_meaning: 纸媒（指以纸张为载体的传统媒体，如报纸、杂志等）
english_meaning: print media; paper-based media (newspapers, magazines, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指以紙張為載體的傳統媒體，如報紙、雜誌等，常與數位／新媒體相對。近年因互聯網普及而影響力下降或轉型為網上版。
explanation_english: Refers to traditional media that use paper as their medium, such as newspapers and magazines. Often contrasted with digital/new media; in recent years many print outlets have declined or shifted to online editions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多紙媒都改做網上版。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 zi2 mui4 dou1 goi2 zou6 mong5 soeng5 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多纸媒都改成了网上版。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many print media have switched to online editions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳統紙媒嘅廣告收入大跌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 tung2 zi2 mui4 ge3 gwong2 gou3 sau1 jap6 daai6 dit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 传统纸媒的广告收入大幅下滑。
examples.english_sentence: Advertising revenue for traditional print media has fallen dramatically.

mandarin_meaning: 纸屑
english_meaning: paper scraps; paper waste
explanation_mandarin: 指小塊的紙或紙的碎屑，通常指可被丟棄的紙片或廢紙。
explanation_english: Refers to small pieces or scraps of paper, usually discarded or waste paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地上有啲紙屑，掃一掃啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 soeng6 jau5 di1 zi2 sit3, sou3 jat1 sou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地上有些纸屑，掃一掃吧。
examples.english_sentence: There are some paper scraps on the floor; sweep them up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將信撕爛成紙屑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 seon3 si1 laan6 sing4 zi2 sit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把信撕成了纸屑。
examples.english_sentence: He tore the letter into pieces (paper scraps).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂拋紙屑，要分開回收。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 paau1 zi2 sit3, jiu3 fan1 hoi1 wui4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱丢纸屑，要分类回收。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw paper scraps around; separate them for recycling.

mandarin_meaning: 纸巾
english_meaning: tissue; paper towel; napkin
explanation_mandarin: 指用來擦拭、吸鼻涕或擦手等的一次性紙製品，常見於家居、餐廳或隨身攜帶。
explanation_english: A disposable paper product used for wiping, blowing one's nose, or drying hands; commonly found at home, restaurants, or carried for personal use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以借張紙巾畀我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 zoeng1 zi2 gan1 bei2 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以借我一張紙巾嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can I borrow a tissue?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鼻水流緊，要拎張紙巾擦下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei6 seoi2 lau4 gan2, jiu3 ling1 zoeng1 zi2 gan1 caat3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的鼻涕在流，要拿張紙巾擦一下。
examples.english_sentence: My nose is running; I need to grab a tissue to wipe it.

mandarin_meaning: 纸币
english_meaning: banknote; paper money
explanation_mandarin: 指以紙張製作、用作流通的貨幣單位，即紙鈔或鈔票。
explanation_english: Paper money issued as banknotes used as legal tender for transactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我冇現金，淨係有紙幣同硬幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mou5 jin6 gam1, zing6 hai6 jau5 zi2bai3 tung4 ngaang6bai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我沒現金，只有紙幣和硬幣。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have cash; I only have banknotes and coins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張紙幣係假嘅，唔好用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 zi2bai3 hai6 gaa2 ge3, m4 hou2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張紙幣是假的，別用。
examples.english_sentence: This banknote is counterfeit; don't use it.

mandarin_meaning: 纸张
english_meaning: paper; sheets of paper
explanation_mandarin: 指用於書寫、印刷或包裝的紙片或紙張的總稱，常用來表示紙的張數或整體材料。
explanation_english: Refers to sheets of paper used for writing, printing, or packaging; often used to refer to the paper material or number of sheets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇多啲紙張？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 do1 di1 zi2 zoeng1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有多一些纸张吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have more sheets of paper?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 辦公室入面冇足夠嘅紙張，打印機停咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan6 gung1 sat1 jap6 min6 mou5 zuk1 gau3 ge3 zi2 zoeng1, daat6 jan3 gei1 ting4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 办公室里没有足够的纸张，打印机停了。
examples.english_sentence: There isn't enough paper in the office; the printer has stopped.

mandarin_meaning: 抽纸 / 面巾纸 / 纸巾
english_meaning: facial tissues (pull-out tissues) / box of tissues
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，通常指抽取式的紙巾或裝在盒/包中的面巾紙。可指整盒/包的紙巾或單張的紙巾，與「抽紙」「紙巾」「面巾紙」意思相近。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for pull-out facial tissues or a box/pack of tissues. It can refer to the box/pack itself or individual tissue sheets; similar in meaning to '抽紙' or 'tissue'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企冇紙抽啦，我落街買返盒紙抽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 mou5 zi2 cau1 laa1, ngo5 lok6 gaai1 maai5 faan1 hap6 zi2 cau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡沒有紙抽了，我去街上買一盒紙抽。
examples.english_sentence: We're out of tissues at home — I'll go buy a box of tissues.

mandarin_meaning: 纸本
english_meaning: paper copy; paper version
explanation_mandarin: 指以紙張為載體的版本或文件，與電子檔相對，常用來區分紙質文件與電子文件。
explanation_english: Refers to a version or document in paper form (a physical paper copy), as opposed to an electronic file.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要紙本定電子檔？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 zi2 bun2 ding6 din6 zi2 dong2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要纸本还是电子档？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want a paper copy or an electronic file?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要保留紙本合約三年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 bou2 lau4 zi2 bun2 hap6 joek3 saam1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要保留纸质合同三年。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to keep paper contracts for three years.

mandarin_meaning: 纸杯
english_meaning: paper cup (disposable cup made of paper)
explanation_mandarin: 用紙製成的杯子，通常為一次性或拋棄式，用來盛放飲料。
explanation_english: A cup made of paper, typically disposable, used to hold beverages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚派對我負責買紙杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 paai3 deoi3 ngo5 fu6 zaak3 maai5 zi2 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚派对我负责买纸杯。
examples.english_sentence: I'm responsible for buying paper cups for tonight's party.

mandarin_meaning: 纸板；用來製作盒子或包裝的硬紙
english_meaning: cardboard; a sheet of thick paperboard used for boxes and packaging
explanation_mandarin: 指厚紙或硬紙板，常用於包裝、製盒或作為保護墊，也可泛指一張紙板。
explanation_english: Refers to thick paper or paperboard commonly used for packaging, making boxes, or as protective sheets; can mean a piece of cardboard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個盒係紙板做嘅，要小心唔好畀水濕咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hap6 hai6 zi2 baan2 zou6 ge3, jiu3 siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 bei2 seoi2 sap1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个盒子是纸板做的，注意不要弄湿了。
examples.english_sentence: This box is made of cardboard; be careful not to get it wet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我攞張紙板墊喺地下，唔想弄髒張椅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lo2 zoeng1 zi2 baan2 din3 hai2 dei6 haa6, m4 soeng2 nung6 zong1 zoeng1 ji2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我拿张纸板垫在地上，不想弄脏椅子。
examples.english_sentence: I put a piece of cardboard on the floor because I don't want to dirty the chair.

mandarin_meaning: 指那些沒有實權、只在言語或網上道德譴責別人、表面上扮演維護秩序角色但實際上虛有其表或偽善的人（相當於「紙上談兵」式的執法者/道德警察）。
english_meaning: A slang term for people who act like enforcers or 'moral police' without real authority — performative, hypocritical, or armchair enforcers who loudly police others (often online) but have no real power or responsibility.
explanation_mandarin: 帶貶義的俗語，用來形容那些喜歡在生活或網絡上以高姿態挑剔、指責他人，卻沒有實際權力或承擔，行為表面化、虛偽。
explanation_english: Derogatory Cantonese slang for someone who adopts a self-righteous, policing attitude (often online) without actual authority or responsibility — essentially a performative or hypocritical 'moral cop'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺社交網站度扮正義，真係紙板警察。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 se5 gaau1 mong5 zaam6 dou6 bun6 zing3 ji6, zan1 hai6 zi2 baan2 ging2 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常在社交網站上裝出正義者的樣子，真是個紙板警察。
examples.english_sentence: He’s always playing the righteous defender on social media — truly a 'paper policeman'.

mandarin_meaning: 紙條 (zhǐtiáo)，指用來寫簡短訊息或提醒的小紙片
english_meaning: slip of paper; note; a small written message
explanation_mandarin: 短小的紙片，用來寫簡短的訊息、提醒或留言，常放在桌上、門口或私下傳遞。
explanation_english: A small piece of paper used for writing brief messages, reminders, or notes; commonly left on desks or doors or passed privately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢放咗張紙條喺我枱上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fong3 zo2 zoeng1 zi2 tiu4 hai2 ngo5 toi2 seong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把一張紙條放在我的桌上。
examples.english_sentence: He left a note on my desk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺門口貼咗張紙條，寫住幾點返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 mun4 hau2 tit3 zo2 zoeng1 zi2 tiu4, se2 zyu6 gei2 dim2 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在門口貼了一張紙條，寫著幾點回來。
examples.english_sentence: I stuck a note on the door saying what time I'll be back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用紙條傳咗個秘密俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zi2 tiu4 cyun4 zo2 go3 bei3 mat6 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用紙條傳給我一個秘密。
examples.english_sentence: He passed me a secret on a note.

mandarin_meaning: 纸样；样板；（引申）仅停留在纸面上的想法或表面样子
english_meaning: paper pattern; template; something that exists only on paper; superficial appearance
explanation_mandarin: 1) 传统用法：裁缝或製作時用來裁剪或作樣板的紙樣。2) 引申用法：比喻僅存在於書面上或只是表面、未落實的事物或計劃。
explanation_english: 1) Literal: a paper pattern or template used in tailoring or making items. 2) Figurative: something that exists only on paper or superficially, e.g. a plan that hasn't been implemented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 裁縫師喺張紙樣上剪布，然後縫返件衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coi4 fung4 si1 hai2 zoeng1 zi2 joeng6 soeng6 zin2 bou3, jin4 hau6 fung4 faan1 gin6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裁缝师在纸样上剪布，然后缝成一件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: The tailor cuts fabric using the paper pattern, then sews it into a garment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃而家淨係得張紙樣，仲未落實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ji4 gaa1 zing6 hai6 dak1 zoeng1 zi2 joeng6, zung6 mei6 lok6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划现在只是纸面上的样子，还没有落实。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is currently only on paper and hasn't been put into action yet.

mandarin_meaning: 欠條 / 借據（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: IOU / informal promissory note (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「紙水」是廣東話的口語/俚語，通常指非正式的書面承諾或欠條，帶有不太可靠或只是表面/口頭承諾的含義。
explanation_english: In Cantonese slang, "紙水" refers to an informal written promise or IOU — a makeshift promissory note. It often implies the document or promise may be informal and not fully reliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾咗張紙水話下個月會還我錢，但係我唔太信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 zoeng1 zi2 seoi2 waa6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 waan4 ngo5 cin2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 taai3 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他給了我一張欠條，說下個月會還我錢，但我不太相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me an IOU saying he'll pay me back next month, but I don't really trust him.

mandarin_meaning: 紙牌（如撲克牌、遊戲用卡片）
english_meaning: paper cards (e.g. playing cards, game cards)
explanation_mandarin: 指以紙製成的牌子，常用於撲克牌或各類遊戲卡片，也可泛指紙做的牌子。
explanation_english: Refers to cards made of paper, commonly used for playing cards or various game cards; can also refer generally to paper-made cards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚一齊打紙牌，唔好遲到啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 jat1 cai4 daa2 zi2 paai4, m4 hou2 ci4 dou3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚一起打紙牌，別遲到。
examples.english_sentence: We're playing cards together tonight; don't be late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽收埋啲舊紙牌做紀念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sau1 maai4 di1 gau6 zi2 paai4 zou6 gei2 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽把一些舊紙牌收藏起來作紀念。
examples.english_sentence: Mom kept some old cards as keepsakes.

mandarin_meaning: 纸板；废纸板；（口语）指薄弱、没用的东西或人；（粤语）指拾荒捡纸板的人（纸皮佬）
english_meaning: cardboard; scrap cardboard; (colloquial) something or someone flimsy/useless; (in HK) a person who collects cardboard
explanation_mandarin: 原指用作包裝或墊層的厚紙板，也指廢棄的紙板。在口語中可用來形容人或物軟弱、沒用；在香港語境下，『紙皮佬』指收集紙皮賣錢的拾荒者。
explanation_english: Literally refers to cardboard or thick paper used for packaging or padding, and to discarded cardboard. Colloquially it can describe a person or thing as flimsy or worthless. In Hong Kong context, '紙皮佬' refers to someone who collects cardboard to sell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係舊紙皮，唔好要啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 gau6 zi2 pei4, m4 hou2 jiu3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是旧纸板，不要了。
examples.english_sentence: These are old pieces of cardboard; don't want them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲傢俬都係紙皮造，成日壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 gaa1 si1 dou1 hai6 zi2 pei4 zou6, sing4 jat6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些家具都是用纸板做的，经常坏。
examples.english_sentence: Those pieces of furniture are made of cardboard and break often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街對面有個紙皮佬，成日嚟執紙皮賣錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 deoi3 min6 jau5 go3 zi2 pei4 lou2, sing4 jat6 lai4 zap1 zi2 pei4 maai6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街对面有个捡纸皮的人，经常来捡纸板卖钱。
examples.english_sentence: There's a cardboard collector across the street who often comes to collect cardboard to sell.

mandarin_meaning: 頁岩/板岩（能剝成薄片、容易風化或碎裂的岩石）
english_meaning: shale/slate — a rock that splits into thin, paper-like layers and is prone to weathering or crumbling
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗稱，用來指那些能剝成薄片、結構較鬆散、易風化或剝落的岩石，例如頁岩或某些板岩類型。在香港地區的口語中常用以描述岸邊或地基較脆弱的岩石層。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for rocks that can be peeled into thin, paper-like layers and tend to be loose, easily weathered or flake off—e.g., shale or certain slates. Commonly used in Hong Kong speech to describe fragile rock layers on shorelines or foundations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰度成條岸邊都係紙皮石，好易風化同剝落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dou6 seng4 tiu4 ngon6 bin1 dou1 hai6 zi2 pei4 sek6, hou2 ji6 fung1 faa3 tung4 bok3 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那裡整條岸邊都是紙皮石，很容易風化和剝落。
examples.english_sentence: The whole shoreline there is made of paper-rock (shale); it weathers and flakes off easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起樓嘅時候要小心，地基如果係紙皮石，承托力可能唔夠穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 lau4 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, dei6 gei1 jyu4 gwo2 hai6 zi2 pei4 sek6, sing4 tok3 lik6 ho2 nang4 m4 gau3 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 建造房屋時要小心，如果地基是紙皮石，承載力可能不夠穩定。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when building; if the foundation is paper-rock (shale), its bearing capacity may not be stable.

mandarin_meaning: 纸箱 / 硬纸箱
english_meaning: cardboard box / corrugated box
explanation_mandarin: 指用牛皮纸或瓦楞纸製成的箱子，常用于打包、存放或搬家时装东西。
explanation_english: A box made from cardboard or corrugated paper, commonly used for packing, storing, or moving items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要啲紙皮箱嚟裝嘢搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 di1 zi2 pei4 soeng1 lai4 zong1 je5 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要一些纸皮箱来装东西搬家。
examples.english_sentence: We need some cardboard boxes to pack things for moving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲紙皮箱已經濕咗，唔可以再用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zi2 pei4 soeng1 ji5 ging1 sap1 zo2, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些纸皮箱已经湿了，不能再用了。
examples.english_sentence: The cardboard boxes are already wet and can't be used anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 紙屑；廢紙；（口語）比喻無價值或瑣碎的東西／廢話
english_meaning: scrap(s) of paper; scrap paper; (colloquial) something worthless, trivial, or rubbish (e.g., speech)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思為紙的碎片或紙屑。在廣東話口語中，也可用來比喻無價值、瑣碎或毫無意義的事物或話語（類似「廢話」「垃圾」）。
explanation_english: Literally a scrap or piece of paper. In colloquial Cantonese it can also be used metaphorically to refer to something worthless, trivial, or nonsense (e.g., someone's words).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張係紙碎，唔使留。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 hai6 zi2 seoi3, m4 sai2 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這只是廢紙，不用留著。
examples.english_sentence: This is just scrap paper; no need to keep it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅全部都係紙碎，唔好理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 zi2 seoi3, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說的全都是廢話，別理他。
examples.english_sentence: Everything he says is rubbish; don't pay attention to him.

mandarin_meaning: 纸碟；一次性纸盘
english_meaning: paper plate (disposable paper dish)
explanation_mandarin: 用紙製作的一次性或可丟棄的盤子，用來盛放食物，常見於聚會、野餐或外賣時使用。
explanation_english: A plate made of paper (often disposable) used to hold food; commonly used at parties, picnics, or for takeout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗一包紙碟去野餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 jat1 baau1 zi2 dip6 heoi3 je5 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们买了一包纸碟去野餐。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a pack of paper plates for the picnic.

mandarin_meaning: 纸扎（祭祀用的纸制人形或器物，作为焚烧的冥器）
english_meaning: paper effigies / paper offerings (paper models burned as funerary/ancestral offerings)
explanation_mandarin: 指用紙紮成的人形、房屋或日用品等，作為祭祀或送給亡者焚燒的冥器，是華人喪俗及祭祀活動中的常見習俗。
explanation_english: Items crafted from paper (human figures, houses, goods) made to be burned as offerings for the deceased; a common practice in Chinese funerary and ancestral rituals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企人買咗啲紙紮，準備喺清明燒畀阿公。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jan4 maai5 zo2 di1 zi2 zaat3, zeon2 bei6 hai2 cing1 ming4 siu1 bei2 aa3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡人買了些紙紮，準備在清明燒給阿公。
examples.english_sentence: My family bought some paper effigies to burn for my grandfather at Qingming.

mandarin_meaning: 紙下巴／弱下巴（口語）
english_meaning: paper chin; someone who is easily knocked out or easily beaten (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，字面上指像紙紮一樣脆弱的下巴，主要用來形容人在肉體上容易被打倒（例如拳擊中一拳就倒）；也可引申指缺乏抗擊打或抗壓能力、脆弱。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term literally meaning 'paper chin.' It describes someone whose chin is weak—easily knocked out by a punch—or more broadly someone who is fragile or lacks resilience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係有紙紮下巴，喺拳擊場一拳就倒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jau5 zi2 zaat3 haa6 baa1, hai2 kyun4 gik1 coeng4 jat1 kyun4 zau6 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的有紙下巴，在拳擊場一拳就倒。
examples.english_sentence: He really has a paper chin — at the boxing ring one punch and he's down.

jyutping: zi2 zaat3 haa6 baa1 —— hau2 hing1 hing1
mandarin_meaning: 说话轻浮、不负责任或不可信
english_meaning: to speak flippantly or insincerely; words are flimsy and not to be trusted
explanation_mandarin: 俚語，比喻說話像紙紮般虛浮、輕率，言語不可靠或不負責任。
explanation_english: A colloquial slang phrase describing someone who talks lightly or insincerely — their words are flimsy and not trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好理佢，佢淨係紙紮下巴——口輕輕，根本唔可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5, keoi5 zing6 hai6 zi2 zaat3 haa6 baa1 —— hau2 hing1 hing1, gan1 bun2 m4 ho2 seon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別理他，他只是紙紮下巴——口輕輕，根本不可信。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pay attention to him; he's all talk — speaks lightly and isn't trustworthy.

mandarin_meaning: 紙扎公仔；用於祭祀或喪葬的紙製人形或其他紙製品
english_meaning: paper effigies (paper dolls/figures) used as offerings in funerary and ancestral rituals
explanation_mandarin: 傳統民間在祭祀、喪禮或中元節等場合使用的紙製人形或物品，通常焚燒作為供品或替代品給亡者或祖先。
explanation_english: Paper figures or objects made for traditional Chinese funerary and ancestral rites; they are typically burned as offerings or substitutes for the deceased or ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺喪禮嗰日，佢哋燒咗啲紙紮公仔畀亡者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 song3 lai5 go2 jat6, keoi5 dei6 siu1 zo2 di1 zi2 zaat3 gung1 zai2 bei2 mong4 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在喪禮那天，他們燒了紙紮公仔給亡者。
examples.english_sentence: At the funeral, they burned paper effigies for the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 附近有間店專賣紙紮公仔，仲有紙屋同紙車可以買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 gan6 jau5 gaan1 dim3 zyun1 maai6 zi2 zaat3 gung1 zai2, zung6 jau5 zi2 uk1 tung4 zi2 ce1 ho2 ji5 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 附近有一家專賣紙紮公仔的店，還有紙屋和紙車可以買。
examples.english_sentence: There's a shop nearby that sells paper effigies; you can also buy paper houses and paper cars there.

mandarin_meaning: 纸扎铺（纸扎店）
english_meaning: paper-offerings shop (a shop that makes and sells paper offerings for funerals and ancestral rites)
explanation_mandarin: 指專門製作和販售祭祀用的紙紮用品（如紙紮屋、紙紮金銀、紙紮家俱等）的店舖。這些紙紮品常在喪葬、清明、中元等傳統儀式中焚燒，作為供奉亡者或先人的用品。
explanation_english: A shop that specializes in making and selling paper offerings (such as paper houses, paper money, and paper furniture) used in Chinese funerary and ancestral rituals. These paper items are commonly burned during funerals, Qingming, and the Ghost Festival as offerings to the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明嗰陣，我哋去紙紮舖買紙紮屋畀已故阿爺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 go2 zan6, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zi2 zaat3 pou3 maai5 zi2 zaat3 uk1 bei2 ji5 gu3 aa3 je4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明節那時，我們去紙紮舖買紙紮屋給已故的爺爺。
examples.english_sentence: During Qingming, we went to the paper-offerings shop to buy a paper house for our late grandfather.

mandarin_meaning: 纸的角；小張纸、纸屑（口语）
english_meaning: corner of a piece of paper; scrap/small piece of paper (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「紙角」可以指纸张的角落，也常用作口语，指小张的纸或纸屑、不起眼的纸片。
explanation_english: “紙角” can mean the corner of a sheet of paper. Colloquially it is also used for a small scrap or piece of paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂拋紙角，地上已經好污糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 paau1 zi2 gok3, dei6 soeng6 ji5 ging1 hou2 wu1 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱扔纸片，地上已经很脏。
examples.english_sentence: Don't throw paper scraps around; the floor is already dirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張試卷嘅紙角摺咗，可能會影響評分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 si3 jyun4 ge3 zi2 gok3 zit3 zo2, ho2 nang4 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 ping4 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 试卷的纸角折了，可能会影响评分。
examples.english_sentence: The corner of the test paper is folded; it might affect grading.

mandarin_meaning: 擅長處理文書／文件的人；善於辦理行政或書面手續的人（有時帶輕微貶義，指只會處理文件而不擅長實際執行）
english_meaning: a person skilled at handling paperwork/documentation; an administrative or clerical expert (sometimes mildly pejorative, implying someone focused on paperwork rather than practical action)
explanation_mandarin: 「紙通」通常指在公司或機構內擅長處理文件、表格、手續與文書工作的人。用法可中性，也可帶有輕微貶義，指只擅長書面程序而不重實際執行。
explanation_english: “紙通” refers to someone in an organization who is good at handling documents, forms, and administrative paperwork. The term can be neutral or slightly derogatory, implying a focus on paper procedures rather than practical implementation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司做咗幾年，已經係一個紙通，所有表格同申請手續都交俾佢處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1si1 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4, ji5ging1 hai6 jat1 go3 zi2 tung1, so2 jau5 biu2 gok3 tung4 san1 cing2 sau2 zuk6 dou1 gaau1 bei2 keoi5 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司做了幾年，已經是一個擅長處理文書的人，所有表格和申請手續都交給他處理。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked at the company for years and is already skilled at handling paperwork; all the forms and applications are handed to him to process.

mandarin_meaning: 沉溺於奢華享樂、迷戀金錢與聲色（紙醉金迷）
english_meaning: to be intoxicated/dazzled by wealth and extravagant pleasures; to lead a life of luxury and dissipation
explanation_mandarin: 形容沉迷於奢華享受和物質享樂，常用來批評追求奢靡生活的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is infatuated with wealth and luxurious pleasures; often used to criticize living a hedonistic, extravagant lifestyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大城市入面過緊紙醉金迷嘅生活，日日都去酒吧同高檔餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 sing4 si5 jap6 min6 gwo3 gan2 zi2 zeoi3 gam1 mai4 ge3 saang1 wut6, jat6 jat6 dou1 heoi3 zau2 baa1 tung4 gou1 dong6 caan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大城市裡過著紙醉金迷的生活，天天去酒吧和高檔餐廳。
examples.english_sentence: He lives a life of luxury and excess in the big city, going to bars and upscale restaurants every day.

mandarin_meaning: 纸钞；钞票；纸币
english_meaning: banknote; paper money; bill
explanation_mandarin: 指用紙製成的貨幣，即鈔票或紙幣，由政府或銀行發行，作為支付手段。
explanation_english: Refers to currency made of paper (banknotes or bills) issued by a government or bank, used as a means of payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部自動櫃員機唔收紙鈔，淨係收硬幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 zi6 dung6 gwai6 jyun4 gei1 m4 sau1 zi2 caau1, zing6 hai6 sau1 ngaang6 bai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台自动柜员机不收纸钞，只收硬币。
examples.english_sentence: This ATM doesn't accept banknotes, only coins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買嘢用紙鈔記得要有零錢找。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 je5 jung6 zi2 caau1 gei3 dak1 jiu3 jau5 ling4 cin2 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买东西用纸钞记得要有零钱找。
examples.english_sentence: When paying with banknotes, remember to have change.

mandarin_meaning: 纸钱；冥币（烧给祖先或神明的纸质祭品）
english_meaning: joss paper; spirit money — paper offerings burned for ancestors and deities
explanation_mandarin: 紙錢是民間祭祀中焚燒給祖先或神明的紙質祭品，象徵供奉金錢或日用品，祈求保佑與供養亡靈。
explanation_english: Paper money used as an offering in Chinese folk religion and ancestor worship. It is burned as joss paper to symbolically provide money and goods to the deceased or deities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明嗰陣，我哋要燒紙錢畀祖先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 go2 zan6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu1 zi2 cin2 bei2 zou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明時，我們要燒紙錢給祖先。
examples.english_sentence: During Qingming, we burn joss paper for our ancestors.

mandarin_meaning: 紙鎮 (zhǐzhèn)
english_meaning: paperweight
explanation_mandarin: 用來壓住紙張或文件，防止被風吹走或散開的小型重物，常放在書桌或工作桌上。
explanation_english: A small heavy object used to hold down papers or documents so they are not blown away or scattered; commonly placed on desks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺書桌上放咗個紙鎭，避免文件畀風吹走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 syu1 zoek3 soeng6 fong3 zo2 go3 zi2 zan3, bei6 min5 man4 gin2 bei2 fung1 ceoi1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在書桌上放了一個紙鎮，避免文件被風吹走。
examples.english_sentence: I put a paperweight on the desk to prevent the papers from being blown away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個紙鎭好靚，係英國買返嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi2 zan3 hou2 leng3, hai6 jing1 gwok3 maai5 faan1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個紙鎮很漂亮，是從英國買回來的。
examples.english_sentence: This paperweight is beautiful; it was bought back from the UK.

mandarin_meaning: 纸镇
english_meaning: paperweight
explanation_mandarin: 用來壓住紙張以防被風吹散或移動的小型重物，常用於辦公或作為裝飾收藏品。
explanation_english: A small heavy object used to hold down papers to prevent them from being blown away or shifted; commonly used in offices or as a decorative/collectible item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用個紙鎮壓住張稿紙，免得風吹走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 go3 zi2 zan3 aat3 zyu6 zoeng1 gou2 zi2, min5 dak1 fung1 ceoi1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用紙鎮把稿紙壓住，免得風吹走。
examples.english_sentence: I used a paperweight to hold down the manuscript paper so the wind wouldn't blow it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個古董紙鎮好靚，好有收藏價值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gu2 dung2 zi2 zan3 hou2 leng3, hou2 jau5 sau1 cong4 gaa3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個古董紙鎮很漂亮，很有收藏價值。
examples.english_sentence: That antique paperweight is beautiful and has collectible value.

mandarin_meaning: 風箏／紙鳶
english_meaning: paper kite; kite (toy)
explanation_mandarin: 指用紙、竹條等材料製成、可在風中飛行的傳統玩具（風箏）。在廣東話中常用來指放風箏的玩具。
explanation_english: A traditional toy made of paper and bamboo (a kite) that flies in the wind. In Cantonese, it commonly refers to the paper kite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔放紙鷂好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 fong3 zi2 jiu6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子放風箏很開心。
examples.english_sentence: The kids are happy flying kites.

mandarin_meaning: 紙黏土 / 紙漿黏土
english_meaning: paper clay (a lightweight, air‑dry modeling material made from paper pulp or paper powder mixed with a binder)
explanation_mandarin: 一種以紙漿或紙粉混合黏合劑製成的可塑材料，常用於手工藝與模型製作，乾後輕且不易開裂，可用於捏塑或貼合表面細節。
explanation_english: A malleable material made from paper pulp or paper powder combined with a binder, commonly used for crafts and model making. It air‑dries into a lightweight, less crack‑prone form suitable for sculpting and surface detailing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺手作班用紙黏土做公仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 sau2 zok3 baan1 jung6 zi2 nim1 tou2 zou6 gung1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在手作班用紙黏土做公仔。
examples.english_sentence: We're using paper clay to make figurines in the craft class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 紙黏土乾咗之後會好輕，唔易裂開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 nim1 tou2 gon1 zo2 zi1 hau6 wui5 hou2 hing1, m4 ji6 lit6 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 紙黏土乾了之後會很輕，不易裂開。
examples.english_sentence: Paper clay becomes very light after drying and does not crack easily.

mandarin_meaning: 級（等級、年級、級別）
english_meaning: level; grade; rank; class
explanation_mandarin: 「級」用來表示等級、層次或年級，常用於學校年級、能力等級或分類，例如初級、中級、高級。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a level, grade, rank, or class. Commonly appears in contexts like school grades, skill levels, and classifications (e.g., beginner, intermediate, advanced).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係三年級學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 saam1 nin4 kap1 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在是三年級學生。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently a third-grade student.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司提供初級、中級同高級嘅培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tai4 gung1 co1 kap1, zung1 kap1 tung4 gou1 kap1 ge3 pui4 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司提供初級、中級和高級的培訓。
examples.english_sentence: The company offers beginner, intermediate, and advanced training.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面係高級職員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 hai6 gou1 kap1 zik1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡是高級職員。
examples.english_sentence: He is a senior staff member in the company.

mandarin_meaning: 级别 (jíbié)
english_meaning: level; rank; grade; classification
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物或人員的等級、層次或身份高低，常用作名詞，用於職位、分類或重要性排序等情境。
explanation_english: Refers to the level, rank, or grade of something or someone; a noun used for positions, classifications, or ordering by status or importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個職位嘅級別好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zik1 wai6 ge3 kap1bit6 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个职位的级别很高。
examples.english_sentence: The rank of this position is very high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 按級別分組，大家各有責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: on3 kap1bit6 fan1 zou2, daai6 gaa1 gok3 jau5 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按级别分组，大家各有责任。
examples.english_sentence: Group them by level; everyone has their own responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告按重要性同級別排序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 on3 zung6 jiu3 sing3 tung4 kap1bit6 paai4 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告按重要性和级别排序。
examples.english_sentence: This report is ordered by importance and level.

mandarin_meaning: 級別、檔次、水平；（口語）指能力或格調的高低
english_meaning: level, grade, class, caliber; (colloquial) someone's class or degree of ability
explanation_mandarin: 「級數」用來表示事物的等級、檔次或人的水平。在口語中常用來稱讚或評價某人有沒有「格調／水準」，如「有級數」。
explanation_english: “級數” refers to a level, rank, or class (degree or quality). Colloquially it’s used to comment on someone's caliber or class (e.g. “has class” or “is impressive”).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校嘅級數好高，入學好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 ge3 kap1 sou3 hou2 gou1, jap6 hok6 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間學校的級數很高，入學很難。
examples.english_sentence: This school's level is very high; it's hard to get admitted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係有級數，做嘢好專業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jau5 kap1 sou3, zou6 je5 hou2 zyun1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很有級數，工作很專業。
examples.english_sentence: He's really of high caliber — very professional in his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個品牌係高級貨，級數唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 baan1 paai4 hai6 gou1 kap1 fo3, kap1 sou3 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個品牌是高級貨，檔次不同。
examples.english_sentence: This brand is high-end; it's in a different class.

mandarin_meaning: 纷（fēn）：表示接連、不斷或紛亂，常見於複合詞如「紛紛」、「紛至沓來」。
english_meaning: Indicates things happening one after another, in profusion, or in a disorderly way (often seen in compounds like '紛紛' or idioms like '紛至沓來').
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞 / 形容詞（常見於複合詞或成語）
partOfSpeech_english: adverb / adjective (often in compounds or idioms)
explanation_mandarin: 「紛」用來表示接連、不斷或紛亂的狀態，常以重疊形式（如「紛紛」）或出現在成語中表示大量、接踵而來的情況。
explanation_english: Used to express succession, multitude, or disorder; frequently appears doubled ('紛紛') or in idioms ('紛至沓來') to mean many things happening one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家紛紛表示反對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 fan1 fan1 biu2 si6 faan2 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家紛紛表示反對。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone expressed their opposition one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消息傳出後，市民紛紛到場查詢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 sik1 cyun4 ceot1 hau6, si5 man4 fan1 fan1 dou3 coeng4 caa4 seon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消息傳出後，市民紛紛到場查詢。
examples.english_sentence: After the news broke, citizens came to the scene to inquire one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 麻煩紛至沓來，忙到冇停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 faan4 fan1 zi3 taap6 loi4, mong4 dou3 mou5 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻煩紛至沓來，忙得停不下來。
examples.english_sentence: Troubles came thick and fast, leaving no time to stop.

mandarin_meaning: 紛紛呈現；接連出現
english_meaning: to appear in profusion; to emerge one after another
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物接連出現、紛紛呈現，常用於書面語或正式語境，例如「新書紛呈」、「活動紛呈」。
explanation_english: Indicates that items or events appear one after another or in great numbers; commonly used in formal or written contexts (e.g., "new books appear in profusion", "events are plentiful").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排新書紛呈，讀者有好多選擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 san1 syu1 fan1 cing4, duk6 ze2 jau5 hou2 do1 syun2 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近來新書紛呈，讀者有很多選擇。
examples.english_sentence: Recently new books have been appearing in large numbers; readers have many choices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 藝術節上本地與外地嘅作品紛呈，吸引唔少觀眾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaat6 seot6 zit3 soeng5 bun2 dei6 jyu5 ngoi6 dei6 ge3 zok3 ban2 fan1 cing4, kap1 jan5 m4 siu2 gun1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在藝術節上，本地與外地的作品紛呈，吸引了不少觀眾。
examples.english_sentence: At the arts festival, works from local and foreign artists appeared in profusion, attracting many viewers.

mandarin_meaning: 纷争 (fēnzhēng)：争端、纠纷
english_meaning: dispute; conflict; contention
explanation_mandarin: 指雙方或多方因利益、權利或意見不同而產生的爭執或爭端。
explanation_english: Refers to disputes or conflicts between two or more parties, often arising from differences in interests, rights, or opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個部門因為資源分配而發生紛爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 bou6 mun4 jan1 wai6 zi1 jyun4 fan1 pui3 ji4 faat3 sang1 fan1 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两个部门因为资源分配而发生纷争。
examples.english_sentence: The two departments had disputes over resource allocation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家庭內嘅財產分配引起咗好大嘅紛爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 ting4 noi6 ge3 coi4 caan2 fan1 pui3 jan5 hei2 zo2 hou2 daai6 ge3 fan1 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家庭内的财产分配引起了很大的纷争。
examples.english_sentence: The distribution of property within the family caused a big dispute.

mandarin_meaning: 紛紛（fēnfēn）表示接連不斷或很多人/事同時出現
english_meaning: one after another; in profusion; happening in succession
explanation_mandarin: 表示多人或多件事接連出現或發生，常用於動詞前作狀態副詞，強調接連性或眾多。
explanation_english: Indicates that many people or events appear or occur one after another; used as an adverb to emphasize succession or multiplicity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民紛紛到場投票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 fan1 fan1 dou3 coeng4 tau4 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民紛紛到場投票。
examples.english_sentence: Citizens went to the polling stations one after another to vote.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會散場，觀眾紛紛離開會場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui6 saan3 coeng4, gun1 zung3 fan1 fan1 lei4 hoi1 wui6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱會散場，觀眾紛紛離開會場。
examples.english_sentence: After the concert ended, the audience left the venue one after another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 問題一出，就有專家紛紛發表意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: man6 tai4 jat1 ceot1, zau6 jau5 zyun1 gaa1 fan1 fan1 faat3 biu2 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 問題一出，就有專家紛紛發表意見。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as the problem arose, experts rushed to express their opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 纷纭；纷繁、杂乱、各式各样的意见或消息
english_meaning: numerous and disorderly; various and conflicting
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容意見、消息等很多且雜亂、各不相同，常用於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: Describes opinions, reports, or matters that are many, varied, and often confused or conflicting; commonly used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市面上對呢個議題嘅意見紛紜，真係好難搵到共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 min6 soeng6 deoi3 ni1 go3 ji5 tai4 ge3 ji3 gin3 fan1 wan4, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 wan2 dou2 gung6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市面上对于这个议题的意见纷纭，真的很难找到共识。
examples.english_sentence: Opinions on this issue in the public sphere are mixed and numerous; it's really hard to reach a consensus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 關於呢條新聞，傳聞紛紜，最好等警方證實先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 jyu1 ni1 tiu4 san1 man4, cyun4 man4 fan1 wan4, zeoi3 hou2 dang2 ging2 fong1 zing3 sat6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 关于这条新闻，传闻纷纭，最好等警方证实后再说。
examples.english_sentence: Regarding this news story, rumors are all over the place; it's best to wait for police confirmation.

mandarin_meaning: 纷飞（fēnfēi）：形容大量细小物体在空中飘舞或飞散
english_meaning: to flutter or fly in large numbers; to fall or scatter in a flurry
explanation_mandarin: “紛飛”常用來形容雪花、花瓣、塵埃等大量細小物體在空中翩翩飄動或散落，也可用於比喻性地形容消息、謠言四處傳播。
explanation_english: “紛飛” describes many small things fluttering or scattering in the air (e.g., snowflakes, petals), and can also be used metaphorically for things like rumors spreading widely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冬天嚟到，雪花紛飛，街道鋪滿咗白雪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung1 tin1 lai4 dou3, syut3 faa1 fan1 fei1, gaai1 dou6 pou1 mun5 zo2 baak6 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冬天到了，雪花纷飞，街道铺满了白雪。
examples.english_sentence: Winter has arrived; snowflakes are fluttering down, covering the streets with white snow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰件事一出，謠言就紛飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gin6 si6 jat1 ceot1, jiu4 jin4 zau6 fan1 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件事一出，谣言就纷飞。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as that matter became public, rumors began to fly.

mandarin_meaning: 纷纭（纷乱、复杂、多而杂）
english_meaning: numerous and confused; varied or disordered (literary)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（書面語，常用於複合詞）
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物繁多且紛亂或眾說紛紜，常見於「紛紜」等複合詞，屬書面語用法。
explanation_english: Indicates that things are many and confused or that opinions are varied; typically appears in compounds such as '紛紜' and is literary in style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 關於件事嘅消息紛紜，真係唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwaan1 jyu1 gin6 si6 ge3 siu1 sik1 fan1 wan4, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 关于这件事的消息纷纭，真的不知道该怎么办。
examples.english_sentence: Reports about this matter are conflicting; I really don't know what to do.

mandarin_meaning: 朴素；清淡；素食（吃素）；本来的、原始的
english_meaning: plain/simple; bland (taste); vegetarian (to eat vegetarian); original/elemental
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 名詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「素」在粵語中常讀作 sou3，可作形容詞表示樸素、簡單或清淡；也可表示素食或吃素；常見於合成詞如「素顏」「素食」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese pronounced sou3. It can be an adjective meaning plain/simple or bland, a noun/verb referring to vegetarianism (to eat vegetarian), and appears in compounds like '素顏' (no makeup) and '素食' (vegetarian food).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚食素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 sik6 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚吃素。
examples.english_sentence: I'm eating vegetarian tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好素，適合上班著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 sou3, sik1 hap6 soeng5 baan1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服很樸素，適合上班穿。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing is very plain, suitable for wearing to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日素顏出門，唔化妝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 sou3 ngaan4 ceot1 mun4, m4 faa3 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天素顏出門，不化妝。
examples.english_sentence: She went out today without makeup.

mandarin_meaning: 素人（非專業人士、業餘或一般人）
english_meaning: a layperson; amateur; non-professional; ordinary person (often used to mean non-celebrity)
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有專業資格或相關經驗的普通人，常用來區別於專業人士或明星，也可指業餘者或非公開人物。
explanation_english: Refers to a person without professional qualifications or specialized experience; an ordinary or amateur person. Often used to distinguish from professionals or celebrities, or to mean non-professional participants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係一個素人，唔係專業歌手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 sou3 jan4, m4 hai6 zyun1 jip6 go1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是一个素人，不是专业歌手。
examples.english_sentence: He's just an amateur, not a professional singer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 節目想搵素人嚟試下新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zit3 muk6 soeng2 wan2 sou3 jan4 lei4 si3 haa5 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 节目想找素人来试试新产品。
examples.english_sentence: The show wants to find ordinary people to try the new product.

mandarin_meaning: 素来 (sùlái)：一向；从来
english_meaning: always; all along; traditionally; from the beginning
explanation_mandarin: 表示从过去到现在一直如此，强调一贯的情况或习惯。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has been the case from the past up to the present; emphasizes a consistent or habitual state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢素來都好準時，未試過遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sou3 loi4 dou1 hou2 zeon2 si4, mei6 si3 gwo3 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他素来很准时，没试过迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been punctual and has never been late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳素來衛生做得唔錯，所以好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sou3 loi4 wai6 sang1 zou6 dak1 m4 co3, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅素来卫生做得不错，所以很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has always kept good hygiene, so many people line up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 素來以嚴格著稱嘅老師今次都放鬆咗啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sou3 loi4 ji5 jim4 gaak3 zoek3 cing1 ge3 lou5 si1 gam1 ci3 dou1 fong3 sung1 zo2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 素来以严格著称的老师这次也放松了一点。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher who is always known for strictness relaxed a bit this time.

mandarin_meaning: 素描（sùmiáo）——指用鉛筆、炭條等對物體進行速寫或描繪其輪廓與明暗，常作為繪畫的基礎練習或草圖。
english_meaning: Sketch; sketching — a quick drawing that captures outlines and tonal values, often used as practice or a preliminary study.
explanation_mandarin: 素描是一種以線條和明暗為主要表現手法的繪畫形式，可指一幅速寫作品或素描這一技法，常用於觀察練習或作為其他繪畫作品的草圖。
explanation_english: A drawing technique focused on lines and tonal values. 'Sketch' can refer to a quick drawing or the practice/technique of sketching, commonly used for study or as a preliminary work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近開始學素描，想練習畫人像。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hoi1 ci2 hok6 sou3 miu4, soeng2 lin6 zaap6 waa6 jan4 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近開始學素描，想練習畫人像。
examples.english_sentence: I've recently started learning sketching; I want to practice drawing portraits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師要求我下星期交一幅素描作業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 haa6 sing1 kei4 gaau1 jat1 fuk1 sou3 miu4 zok3 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師要求我下星期交一幅素描作業。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher asked me to submit a sketch assignment next week.

mandarin_meaning: 素昧平生（sù mèi píng shēng）：彼此從未見過面，互不相識。
english_meaning: To have never met before; to be complete strangers.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 表示雙方從未謀面或互不相識，常用來形容彼此完全陌生的關係或情況。
explanation_english: Indicates that two or more people have never met and are complete strangers; commonly used to describe a situation of total unfamiliarity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢素昧平生，唔知道佢係邊個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 sou3 mut6 ping4 saang1, m4 zi1 keoi5 hai6 bin1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他素昧平生，不知道他是誰。
examples.english_sentence: I have never met him; I don't know who he is.

mandarin_meaning: 素来有；一直有；向来有（表示长久以来具有某种特质或名声）
english_meaning: have long had; have always been; be long reputed
explanation_mandarin: 用于表示某事物自古或长久以来就具有某种特质、名声或状况，通常置于名词或名词短语之前，例如「素有盛名」。多见于书面或较正式的表达。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something has long possessed a certain quality, reputation, or condition; typically placed before a noun or noun phrase (e.g., "long renowned"). Common in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間餐廳素有好評。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sou3 jau5 hou2 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅素来有好评。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant has long received good reviews.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市素有創業氛圍，吸引咗唔少初創公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 sou3 jau5 cong3 jip6 fan1 wai6, kap1 jan5 zo2 m4 siu2 co1 cong3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个城市素来有创业氛围，吸引了不少初创公司。
examples.english_sentence: This city has long had an entrepreneurial atmosphere, attracting many startups.

mandarin_meaning: 素服（sùfú）：朴素、简单的衣着；在丧礼或追悼场合常指丧服（素色衣服）以示哀悼。
english_meaning: Plain/simple clothing; often refers to mourning attire (plain-colored clothes) worn at funerals or memorials to show mourning.
explanation_mandarin: 「素服」一般指朴素、未加修飾的衣著。在習俗上，於喪禮或追悼場合穿戴素服以示哀悼和莊重。
explanation_english: “素服” denotes plain or unadorned clothing. In cultural contexts it commonly refers to mourning clothes worn at funerals or memorials to express grief and solemnity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著住素服去出席喪禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zyu6 sou3 fuk6 heoi3 ceot1 zik1 song3 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿着素服去出席丧礼。
examples.english_sentence: He is wearing plain (mourning) clothes to attend the funeral today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 平時佢鍾意簡單打扮，差唔多都係素服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ping4 si4 keoi5 zung1 ji3 gaan2 daan1 daa2 baan6, caa1 m4 do1 dou1 hai6 sou3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 平时他喜欢简单的打扮，差不多都是素服。
examples.english_sentence: He usually prefers simple outfits and mostly wears plain clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺傳統習俗，親人過身時都會穿素服以示哀悼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 cyun4 tung2 zaap6 zuk6, can1 jan4 gwo3 san1 si4 dou1 wui5 coeng1 sou3 fuk6 ji5 si6 oi1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在传统习俗中，亲人去世时会穿素服以示哀悼。
examples.english_sentence: In traditional customs, relatives wear plain (mourning) clothes when someone dies to show mourning.

mandarin_meaning: 素未謀面（從未見過面；彼此素不相識）
english_meaning: have never met (each other); never met in person; previously unknown to one another
explanation_mandarin: 表示雙方從未見過面、互不相識，常用於書面或較正式的語境，用來說明彼此是陌生人。
explanation_english: Indicates that two parties have never met in person and do not know each other; commonly used in formal or written contexts to state that people are strangers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我哋素未謀面，但我聽過你嘅名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 dei6 sou3 mei6 mau4 min6, daan6 ngo5 teng1 gwo3 nei5 ge3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然我們素未謀面，但我聽過你的名字。
examples.english_sentence: Although we've never met, I've heard of your name.

mandarin_meaning: 素材（sùcái）：原料；製作內容或作品時使用的材料，如圖片、文字、影片等。
english_meaning: materials; raw materials; assets (e.g., images, text, footage) used for producing content or works.
explanation_mandarin: 指用於創作、製作或工程等的原始資料或素材，常指圖片、影音、文字等可供編輯使用的內容。
explanation_english: Refers to source materials used in creation or production (e.g., images, audio, video, text). Often used for assets that are edited or assembled into a final product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇啲可用嘅素材俾我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 di1 ho2 jung6 ge3 sou3 coi4 bei2 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有可用的素材给我？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have any usable materials/assets for me?

mandarin_meaning: 素聞 / 向來聽說、早有耳聞
english_meaning: have long heard of; to be reputed; previously heard
explanation_mandarin: 表示以前聽說過某人或某事，常用於客套或表達對對方名聲的敬意，例如「素聞大名」。屬於文言或書面用語。
explanation_english: Indicates having previously heard of someone or something; often used politely to acknowledge someone's reputation (e.g. "I've long heard of your name"). It is somewhat literary/formal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 素聞你大名，今日終於見到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sou3 man4 nei5 daai6 ming4, gam1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 gin3 dou3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 素闻你的大名，今天终于见到你。
examples.english_sentence: I've long heard of your reputation; it's a pleasure to finally meet you.

mandarin_meaning: 素色（無圖案、單一顏色）
english_meaning: plain/solid color; unpatterned
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有圖案或花紋、以單一顏色為主的色彩，常用來形容衣物、布料或設計風格，強調簡潔與低調。
explanation_english: Refers to a plain or solid color without patterns; commonly used to describe clothing, fabrics, or design aesthetics emphasizing simplicity and understatement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日着素色衫，好有簡約風格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 sou3 sik1 saam1, hou2 jau5 gaan2 joek3 fung1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常穿素色的衣服，很有簡約風格。
examples.english_sentence: He/She often wears plain-colored clothes; it gives a minimalist look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張相嘅背景用咗素色，睇落乾淨啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 ge3 bui3 ging2 jung6 zo2 sou3 sik1, tai2 lok6 gon1 zeng6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张照片的背景用了素色，看起来更干净。
examples.english_sentence: The background of this photo uses a plain color, making it look cleaner.

mandarin_meaning: 素菜（sùcài）：以蔬菜為主、不含或少含肉類的菜肴，指素食的菜式。
english_meaning: vegetarian dish; vegetable-based dish (food without meat)
explanation_mandarin: 指不含肉類或以蔬菜為主的菜餚，可用於餐廳菜單或日常用語，表示素食選擇或清淡的菜式。
explanation_english: Refers to dishes that are vegetable-based or meat-free. Used on menus or in everyday speech to indicate vegetarian options or lighter dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想食素菜，唔食肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 sou3 coi3, m4 sik6 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想吃素菜，不吃肉。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat vegetarian food tonight, not meat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳有好多素菜選擇，對素食者好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 hou2 do1 sou3 coi3 syun2 zaak6, deoi3 sou3 sik6 ze2 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅有很多素菜选择，对素食者很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has many vegetarian options, which is very convenient for vegetarians.

mandarin_meaning: 素质 (sùzhì)
english_meaning: quality; caliber; basic character or upbringing
explanation_mandarin: 指人或事物的基本品質、修養或素養，常用來評價一個人的教養、行為或能力。
explanation_english: Refers to the basic qualities, upbringing, or caliber of a person or thing; often used to judge someone's manners, behavior, or competence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅素質好差，成日唔守時又無禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sou3 zat1 hou2 caa1, sing4 jat6 m4 sau2 si4 jau6 mou4 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的素质很差，经常不守时又没有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: His/her quality (upbringing/character) is poor; often unpunctual and rude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得呢間公司嘅員工素質普遍高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jyun4 gung1 sou3 zat1 pou2 bin6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这间公司的员工素质普遍很高。
examples.english_sentence: I think the employees at this company generally have high quality/caliber.

mandarin_meaning: 素顏（沒有化妝的臉）
english_meaning: bare face; without makeup
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有化妝、裸臉的樣子，強調自然、不施粉黛的面容。
explanation_english: Refers to a face without makeup — a natural, unadorned appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日素顏出街，樣子好自然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 sou3 ngaan4 ceot1 gaai1, joeng6 zi2 hou2 zi6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天素顏出門，樣子很自然。
examples.english_sentence: She went out today without makeup; she looks very natural.

mandarin_meaning: 素食（sùshí）
english_meaning: vegetarian food; vegetarianism; to eat vegetarian
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（亦可用作動詞，如「吃素」）
explanation_mandarin: 指不含肉類的食物或以不吃肉為主的飲食習慣，也可指素食菜餚。
explanation_english: Refers to food that contains no meat or the dietary practice of not eating meat; can also refer to vegetarian dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅素食好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sou3 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间餐厅的素食很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The vegetarian dishes at this restaurant are very tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 纺；纺纱、纺织（制作线或布料）
english_meaning: to spin (yarn); to do spinning/textile work
explanation_mandarin: 表示把纖維加工成紗或線，常見於紡織、紡紗等詞語中。
explanation_english: Refers to processing fibers into yarn or thread; commonly used in words related to spinning and textiles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺工廠入面負責紡紗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 cong2 jap6 min6 fu6 zaak3 fong2 saa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在工廠裡負責紡紗。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for spinning yarn in the factory.

mandarin_meaning: 纺织 / 紡織（紡線與織布；紡織業）
english_meaning: spinning and weaving; textile; textile industry; to spin and weave
explanation_mandarin: 指紡線與織布的工藝或相關產業，也可作為動詞表示從事這些活動。
explanation_english: Refers to the processes of spinning yarn and weaving cloth or the textile industry; can be used as a verb meaning to spin and weave or as a noun for the textile industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺紡織廠做咗幾十年，對呢行好熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fong2 zik1 cong2 zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4, deoi3 ni1 hong4 hou2 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在紡織廠做了幾十年，對這一行很熟。
examples.english_sentence: He worked in a textile factory for decades and is very familiar with this line of work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 紡織業曾經係本地嘅重要行業，但而家好多廠已經轉去內地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong2 zik1 jip6 cang4 ging1 hai6 bun2 dei6 ge3 zung6 jiu3 hong4 jip6, daan6 ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 cong2 ji5 ging1 zyun2 heoi3 noi6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 紡織業曾經是本地的重要行業，但現在很多工廠已經轉到內地。
examples.english_sentence: The textile industry used to be an important local sector, but now many factories have moved to the mainland.

mandarin_meaning: 索 (suǒ)：要求、索取、索要；也有追索、尋找之意
english_meaning: to demand; to request; to claim; to search or seek (in some compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 「索」常用作動詞，表示向他人要求或索取某物（如「索取」「索要」），在某些語境或詞語中也有尋找、追索的意思。
explanation_english: Commonly a verb meaning to demand or request something (e.g. 索取, 索要). In some compounds it can also mean to search for or trace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向我索一千蚊，我唔肯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 ngo5 sok3 jat1 cin1 man1, ngo5 m4 hang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向我要一千块，我不肯。
examples.english_sentence: He demanded 1,000 dollars from me; I refused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司索取咗全部嘅合約副本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sok3 ceoi2 zo2 cyun4 bou6 ge3 hap6 joek3 fu6 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司索取了全部的合约副本。
examples.english_sentence: The company requested copies of all the contracts.

mandarin_meaning: 在KTV等場所搭訕／勾搭異性（俗語）
english_meaning: To pick up or hit on someone (often at KTV); slang for flirting/trying to hook up
explanation_mandarin: 香港口語俚語，通常指到KTV或相關娛樂場所主動搭訕或勾搭異性，常帶有追求約會或發展短暫關係的含義。
explanation_english: Hong Kong slang for actively hitting on or trying to pick up someone, typically in KTV or similar entertainment venues; implies attempting to date or hook up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去K房索K，成晚都有女仔黐埋佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heoi3 kei1 fong2 sok3 kei1, seng4 maan5 dou1 jau5 neoi5 zai2 ci1 maai4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常去KTV搭訕，整晚都有女生黏著他。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to KTV to pick up girls; girls stick to him all night.

mandarin_meaning: 索价；要价（向他人索取价格，常含过高或敲诈之意）
english_meaning: to demand a price; to charge (often implying overcharging or extortion)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“索價”表示向别人索取或开出价格，常用于指出不合理或过高的要价，有时带有勒索或漫天要价的含义。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, “索價” means to demand or quote a price, often used to indicate an unreasonably high charge or extortionate demand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁索價啦，公平啲得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 sok3 gaa3 laa1, gung1 ping4 di1 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样要价，能不能公平一点？
examples.english_sentence: Don't charge like that — can you be a bit fair?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲士多成日索價，仲唔俾折扣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 si6 do1 sing4 jat6 sok3 gaa3, zung6 m4 bei2 zit3 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些便利店经常漫天要价，还不给折扣。
examples.english_sentence: Some convenience stores always overcharge and don't give discounts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭的士，唔好俾司機亂索價，記住睇計程表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 dik1 si2, m4 hou2 bei2 si1 gei1 lyun6 sok3 gaa3, gei3 zyu6 tai2 gai3 cing4 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐出租车不要让司机乱要价，记得看计价器。
examples.english_sentence: When taking a taxi, don't let the driver overcharge — remember to check the meter.

mandarin_meaning: 索赔；要求赔偿
english_meaning: to claim compensation; to seek damages or reimbursement
explanation_mandarin: 向责任方要求赔偿因事故、损害或违约而产生的损失或费用，常用于交通事故、医疗赔偿或保险理赔等情形。
explanation_english: To demand compensation from the party responsible for loss, damage, or breach (e.g., medical bills, repair costs, insurance claims). Commonly used in contexts like traffic accidents, injuries, or contract disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 車禍之後，佢向對方索償醫療費同修車費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1 wo6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 hoeng3 deoi3 fong1 sok3 soeng4 ji1 liu4 fai3 tung4 sau1 ce1 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 交通事故之后，他向对方索赔医疗费和修车费。
examples.english_sentence: After the car accident, he claimed compensation from the other party for medical and repair expenses.

mandarin_meaning: 索取 (要求得到、索要)
english_meaning: to demand; to request; to claim; to ask for
explanation_mandarin: 表示向他人或機構要求得到某物或某種補償，語氣可偏正式或帶有要求、索要的意味。
explanation_english: To request or demand something from someone or an organization, often formally or insistently (e.g., compensation, information, payment).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向公司索取賠償。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 gung1 si1 sok3 ceoi2 pui4 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向公司索取賠償。
examples.english_sentence: He demanded compensation from the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 客戶索取咗太多資料，搞到我哋好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haak3 wu6 sok3 ceoi2 zo2 taai3 do1 zi1 liu2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 客戶索取了太多資料，弄得我們很忙。
examples.english_sentence: The client requested too much information, which made us very busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好隨便向人索取私人資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seoi4 bin6 hoeng3 jan4 sok3 ceoi2 si1 jan4 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要隨便向別人索取私人資料。
examples.english_sentence: Don't casually ask others for personal information.

mandarin_meaning: 索取（东西/利益）；不停向别人要东西，或带有勒索/占便宜的意思
english_meaning: to demand orask for things/favors (often repeatedly); can imply extortion or freeloading
explanation_mandarin: 俚語，指不断向别人索要东西或利益，有时带有敲诈、占便宜或贪求的含义。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang meaning to repeatedly demand or ask others for things or favors; can carry connotations of extortion, freeloading, or taking advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日向人索嘢，大家都覺得佢好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hoeng3 jan4 sok3 je5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常向别人索取东西，大家都觉得他很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He often asks others for things; everyone finds him annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果有人向你索嘢，唔好畀佢得逞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jan4 hoeng3 nei5 sok3 je5, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dak1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果有人向你索要东西，不要让他得逞。
examples.english_sentence: If someone tries to demand things from you, don't let them succeed.

mandarin_meaning: 索回（suǒ huí）——取回、要回、收回（被借走、被取走或欠下的東西或款項）
english_meaning: to reclaim; to get back; to demand the return of (something lost, taken, borrowed, or owed)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把已借出、被取走或被佔用的東西或款項取回或要求對方歸還。常用於金錢、物品或權利的收回，可用於口語或書面語。
explanation_english: Means to take back or demand the return of something that was lent, taken, lost, or owed. Commonly used for money, items, or rights; used in both spoken and written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想索回我借俾佢嗰部電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sok3 wui4 ngo5 zek3 bei2 keoi5 go2 bou6 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把借給他的那部電話要回來。
examples.english_sentence: I want to get back the phone I lent him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢唔還，我就會索回，仲會採取法律行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 m4 waan4, ngo5 zau6 wui5 sok3 wui4, zung6 wui5 coi2 ceoi2 faat3 leot6 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他不還，我就會索回，並採取法律行動。
examples.english_sentence: If he doesn't return it, I'll demand it back and take legal action.

mandarin_meaning: 绳子；抽绳
english_meaning: cord; drawstring
explanation_mandarin: 指用於衣物、袋口或其他物件上，用來收緊或束緊的繩子或帶子，常見於褲腰、袋口等位置，也可泛指小繩子。
explanation_english: A cord or drawstring used on clothing, bag openings, or other items to tighten or secure—commonly found on waistbands or bag openings; can also refer generally to a small rope or string.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條褲有條索子，拉緊啲就唔會跌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 fu3 jau5 tiu4 sok3 zi2, laai1 gan2 di1 zau6 m4 wui5 dat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條褲子有一根抽繩，拉緊一點就不會掉了。
examples.english_sentence: The pants have a drawstring; pull it tighter and it won't fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個袋口有條索子，拉開就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 doi6 hau2 jau5 tiu4 sok3 zi2, laai1 hoi1 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 袋口有一根繩子，拉開就行了。
examples.english_sentence: The bag's opening has a cord; just pull it open.

mandarin_meaning: 用來固定、綁紮或拖拉物件的帶子或繩索（如拖車帶、綁貨的帶子或攀岩用的繩索套）
english_meaning: a strap or rope used for fastening, lashing or towing objects (e.g. a tow strap, lashing strap or climbing sling)
explanation_mandarin: 指用作固定、綑綁或牽引物件的帶子或繩索，可指拖車用的拖帶、綁貨用的捆綁帶，或攀登時的索具（如吊帶、繩套）。
explanation_english: Refers to a strap or cord used to secure, tie down, or pull objects — for example a tow strap for vehicles, lashing straps for cargo, or slings used in climbing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗條索帶，用嚟拖車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 tiu4 sok3 daai3, jung6 lai4 to1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一條索帶，用來拖車。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a tow strap to use for towing the car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貨唔穩，要用索帶綁好先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fo3 m4 wan6, jiu3 jung6 sok3 daai3 bong2 hou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 貨物不穩，需要用索帶綁好才行。
examples.english_sentence: The cargo is unstable; we need to secure it with straps first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去攀山記得帶埋索帶同安全繩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 paan1 saan1 gei3 dak1 daai3 maai4 sok3 daai3 tung4 on1 cyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去攀岩/爬山時記得帶上索帶和安全繩。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring slings and safety ropes when rock climbing.

mandarin_meaning: 索引（書籍或資料的索引；或指將資料編入索引以便檢索）
english_meaning: index (an index in a book or database; also the action of indexing for retrieval)
explanation_mandarin: 指書本、文件或資料庫中按主題、關鍵詞等編排以便查找的索引條目；作動詞時則指將資料編入索引以方便檢索。
explanation_english: Refers to an index in a book, document, or database organized for lookup; as a verb, to index materials so they can be retrieved easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺書尾可以搵到詳細嘅索引，方便查找。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 syu1 mei5 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou3 coeng4 sai3 ge3 sok3 jan5, fong1 bin6 caa4 zaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在書的末尾可以找到詳細的索引，方便查找。
examples.english_sentence: You can find a detailed index at the back of the book, which makes it easy to look things up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館會將新書索引入系統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 wui5 zoeng1 san1 syu1 sok3 jan5 jap6 hai6 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圖書館會把新書索引到系統中。
examples.english_sentence: The library will index the new books into the system.

mandarin_meaning: 索性 (suǒxìng)：乾脆、倒不如、索性就這樣做
english_meaning: might as well; simply; might as well just do (something decisively)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在權衡或猶豫之後，乾脆採取一個直接或果斷的行動，有“乾脆……、不如就……”的意思。
explanation_english: Used to indicate taking a direct or decisive action after some consideration or hesitation; similar to 'might as well' or 'simply (do it)'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要裁員，索性辭職啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 coi4 jyun4, sok3 sing3 ci4 zik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要裁員，索性辭職吧。
examples.english_sentence: The company is laying people off; might as well resign.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日停電，索性出街食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ting4 din6, sok3 sing3 ceot1 gaai1 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天停電，索性出去吃飯吧。
examples.english_sentence: The power's out today; we might as well go out to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢題太難，索性跳過唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tai4 taai3 naan4, sok3 sing3 tiu3 gwo3 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這題太難，索性跳過不做。
examples.english_sentence: This question is too hard; I'll just skip it.

mandarin_meaning: 索书号（图书馆用于标示、定位书籍的编号）
english_meaning: call number (library identifier used to locate a book or item)
explanation_mandarin: 圖書館用來標示與定位書籍或館藏資料的編號，通常包含分類號、著者號（或切碼）等元素，方便查找與管理。
explanation_english: A library call number used to identify and locate an item within a library's collection. It usually consists of a classification number and additional elements (e.g., author cutter) to help shelve and retrieve materials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以用索書號喺書架上搵到嗰本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 sok3 syu1 hou6 hai2 syu1 gaa3 seong6 wan2 dou3 go2 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以用索书号在书架上找到那本书。
examples.english_sentence: You can use the call number to find that book on the shelf.

mandarin_meaning: 喘气；歇口气
english_meaning: to gasp for breath; to catch one's breath; to take a breather
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，表示因運動或勞累而需要喘一口氣或短暫休息，也可用於形容正在喘氣的狀態。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to gasp or catch one's breath after exertion, or to take a short rest; can describe the state of being out of breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我跑咗幾條街，依家好攰，要索氣一下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 paau2 zo2 gei2 tiu4 gaai1, ji4 gaa1 hou2 gui6, jiu3 sok3 hei3 jat1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我跑了好幾條街，現在很累，要喘口氣一下。
examples.english_sentence: I ran several blocks and now I'm tired; I need to catch my breath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱行上樓梯，仲係索氣，休息一陣先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 haang4 soeng5 lau4 tai1, zung6 hai6 sok3 hei3, jau1 sik1 jat1 zan6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛爬完樓梯，還在喘氣，先休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: He just climbed the stairs and is still out of breath; he'll rest for a moment first.

mandarin_meaning: 索取回扣 / 索要好处费
english_meaning: to demand a cut/kickback; to ask for illicit gains
explanation_mandarin: 俗語或俚語，指向他人索取不正當利益、回扣或好處費，常見於貪污或不透明的商業交易中。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term meaning to demand illicit benefits, kickbacks, or a cut; commonly used in contexts of corruption or under-the-table deals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲承辦商話被政府官員索油，結果唔敢再接新工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sing4 baan6 soeng1 waa6 bei6 zing3 fu2 gun1 jyun4 sok3 jau4, git3 gwo2 m4 gam2 zoi3 zip3 san1 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 承包商說被政府官員索要油水，結果不敢再接新工程。
examples.english_sentence: The contractors said they were asked for kickbacks by government officials, so they didn't dare take on new projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度索油啦，大家講公道啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 sok3 jau4 laa1, daai6 gaa1 gong2 gung1 dou3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別在這裡索要油水，大家講話公平一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to get a cut here; let's be fair.

mandarin_meaning: 抽绳袋 / 束口袋
english_meaning: drawstring bag; pouch with a cord for closing
explanation_mandarin: 一种带有抽绳或束口装置的小袋子，用于装小件物品，便于收口和携带。
explanation_english: A small bag with a drawstring or cord closure, used to hold small items and easily close and carry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用個索繩袋裝咗啲雜物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 go3 sok3 sing4 doi6 zong1 zo2 di1 zaap6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用抽绳袋装了一些杂物。
examples.english_sentence: I used a drawstring bag to hold some miscellaneous items.

mandarin_meaning: 索钩（连着绳索的钩子，类似抓钩/挂钩）
english_meaning: grappling hook; a hook attached to a rope used to catch, pull, or secure objects
explanation_mandarin: 指连着绳索或绳索可系住的钩子，常用来勾住、拉拽或固定物体，在救援、攀爬或牵引场景中可见。
explanation_english: A hook attached to (or used with) a rope — a grappling hook — used to catch, pull, secure, or anchor objects; commonly used in rescue, climbing, or hauling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 消防員用索鈎救走被困樓層嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu1 fong4 jyun4 jung6 sok3 gau1 gau3 zau2 bei6 kwan3 lau4 cang4 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 消防员用索钩救走被困楼层的人。
examples.english_sentence: The firefighters used a grappling hook to rescue people trapped on a floor.

mandarin_meaning: 搭讪；勾搭（俗語）
english_meaning: to hit on someone; to flirt with or try to hook up
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，通常指在社交場合主動接近他人、搭話或勾搭以求發展感情或性關係，語氣口語且帶俗俚色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang verb meaning to approach someone with the intention of flirting or trying to hook up. Used informally and often in casual speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺酒吧度索鉤啲女仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 zau2 baa1 dou6 sok3 gau1 di1 neoi5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在酒吧搭讪女生。
examples.english_sentence: He often hits on girls at the bar.

mandarin_meaning: 索马里（國家名稱，位於東非）
english_meaning: Somalia (a country in the Horn of Africa)
explanation_mandarin: 索馬里是位於非洲東部的一個國家，位於非洲之角，首都是摩加迪休。近年因內戰與海盜問題常被國際新聞提及。
explanation_english: Somalia is a country in eastern Africa (the Horn of Africa), with its capital at Mogadishu. It has frequently appeared in international news due to civil conflict and piracy issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 索馬里係一個位於東非嘅國家，首都係摩加迪休。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sok3 maa5 lei5 hai6 jat1 go3 wai6 jyu1 dung1 fei1 ge3 gwok3 gaa1, sau2 dou1 hai6 mo1 gaa1 dik6 jau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 索马里是一个位于东非的国家，首都是摩加迪休。
examples.english_sentence: Somalia is a country in East Africa; its capital is Mogadishu.

mandarin_meaning: 索马里兰（自稱獨立的地區，位於索馬里北部）
english_meaning: Somaliland (a self-declared state/region in the northwest of Somalia)
explanation_mandarin: 索馬里蘭是位於非洲索馬里北部的一個自稱獨立地區，1991年宣稱獨立並建立了事實上的政府，但在國際上尚未被廣泛承認。
explanation_english: Somaliland is a self-declared independent region in northwestern Somalia. It declared independence in 1991 and has its own functioning government in practice, but it is not widely recognized internationally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 索馬里蘭係非洲北部一個自稱獨立嘅地區，1991年開始有自己嘅政府，但喺國際上未被普遍承認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sok3 maa5 lei5 laan4 hai6 fei1 zau1 bak1 bou6 jat1 go3 zi6 cing1 duk6 lap6 ge3 dei6 keoi1, jat1 gau2 gau2 jat1 nin4 hoi1 ci2 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 zing3 fu2, daan6 hai2 gwok3 zai3 soeng6 mei6 bei6 pou2 bin3 sing4 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 索马里兰是非洲北部一个自称独立的地区，1991年开始有自己的政府，但在国际上尚未被普遍承认。
examples.english_sentence: Somaliland is a self-declared independent region in northern Somalia; it has had its own government since 1991 but is not widely recognized internationally.

mandarin_meaning: 抠鼻子；挖鼻孔（口語／俗語）
english_meaning: to pick one's nose (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「索鼻」是廣東話口語用法，通常指用手指抠鼻子或挖鼻孔。屬於俗語、非正式用語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression referring to picking or digging one's nose with a finger. Informal/slang usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺公共場合索鼻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 gung1 gung6 coeng4 hap6 sok3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在公共場合抠鼻子。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pick your nose in public.

mandarin_meaning: 扎（zhā / zhá）：扎、綁、刺入，亦用於扎針、扎頭髮等
english_meaning: to prick/stab; to tie or bind; to give an injection; to tie up hair (e.g. braid or bun)
explanation_mandarin: 「紥」（同字形亦寫作紮/扎）在廣東話常用作動詞，可表示用尖物刺入（如紮針）、把物件綁緊或把頭髮紮起來等。
explanation_english: The Cantonese verb 紥 (also written 紮/扎) means to prick or stab (e.g. acupuncture/injection), to tie or bind something securely, or to tie up hair (braid, bun).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 護士幫我紮針，唔使驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu6 si1 bong1 ngo5 zaa1 zam1, m4 sai2 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 護士給我扎針，不用怕。
examples.english_sentence: The nurse gave me an injection; don't be afraid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將垃圾袋紮好先拎走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 laap6 saap3 doi2 zaa1 hou2 sin1 ling1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把垃圾袋扎好才拿走。
examples.english_sentence: He tied up the garbage bag before taking it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢媽媽幫佢紮辮，望落好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maa4 maa1 bong1 keoi5 zaa1 bin3, mong6 lok6 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他媽媽幫他扎辮子，看起來很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: His mother braided his hair; it looked very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: （表示动作正在进行）在/正在；紧（贴身、紧密）；紧要/重要
english_meaning: progressive/aspect marker 'be ...-ing'; tight/close; important/urgent
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 助词（表示进行时）/ 形容词
explanation_mandarin: 「緊」一方面作為粵語的進行時助詞，置於動詞之後表示動作正在進行；另一方面作為形容詞表示緊、貼身或表示重要、緊要。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '緊' is used as a progressive aspect particle placed after verbs to mark ongoing actions. It is also an adjective meaning tight/close or indicating importance/urgency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家喺屋企等緊你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 uk1 kei5 dang2 gan2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在在家等你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm waiting for you at home right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫太緊，著唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 taai3 gan2 zoek3 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服太紧，穿不上。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is too tight; I can't put it on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好緊要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 gan2 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很重要。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very important.

mandarin_meaning: 紫；紫色
english_meaning: purple; violet
explanation_mandarin: 表示一種顏色（紫色），可作顏色名詞或用作形容詞，亦常見於許多複合詞中，如紫外線、紫羅蘭等。
explanation_english: Denotes the color purple (violet). Used as a noun or adjective and appears in many compounds (e.g., ultraviolet, violet).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係紫色，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 zi2 sik1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是紫色的，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is purple and very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 紫外線 / 紫外光 (zǐwàixiàn)
english_meaning: ultraviolet light (UV light / ultraviolet radiation)
explanation_mandarin: 指波長比可見光中紫色更短的電磁輻射，常稱為紫外線，能引起曬黑、皮膚損傷並具有殺菌作用。
explanation_english: Electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths shorter than visible violet light (ultraviolet, UV). It can cause tanning and skin damage, and is used for sterilization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出面太陽好猛，要戴太陽眼鏡同搽防曬霜，先可以擋住啲紫外光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 min6 taai3 joeng4 hou2 maang5, jiu3 daai3 taai3 joeng4 ngaan5 geng3 tung4 caat3 fong4 saai3 soeng1, sin1 ho2 ji5 dong2 zyu6 di1 zi2 ngoi6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外面太陽很烈，要戴太陽眼鏡和擦防曬霜，這樣才能擋住紫外光。
examples.english_sentence: The sun is very strong outside; you should wear sunglasses and apply sunscreen to block ultraviolet light.

mandarin_meaning: 紫外线 (zǐwàixiàn)
english_meaning: ultraviolet rays / ultraviolet radiation
explanation_mandarin: 指波长短于可见光的电磁辐射，能导致晒伤，对皮肤和眼睛有害。
explanation_english: Electromagnetic radiation with wavelengths shorter than visible light; can cause sunburn and is harmful to skin and eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日紫外線好強，小心曬傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 zi2 ngoi6 sin3 hou2 koeng4, siu2 sam1 saai3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天紫外线很强，小心晒伤。
examples.english_sentence: The ultraviolet radiation is strong today; be careful of sunburn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢副太陽眼鏡可以阻隔紫外線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fu6 taai3 joeng4 ngaan5 geng2 ho2 ji5 zo2 gaak3 zi2 ngoi6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这副太阳眼镜可以阻隔紫外线。
examples.english_sentence: These sunglasses can block ultraviolet rays.

mandarin_meaning: 紫微斗数 (zǐwēi dǒushù)，一種中國傳統的命理占星術
english_meaning: Zi Wei Dou Shu (Purple Star Astrology), a traditional Chinese astrological divination system
explanation_mandarin: 紫微斗數是一種中國傳統的占星與命理系統，通過排命盤、觀察紫微星及其他星曜在宮位的分布，推算個人的性格、運勢、婚姻、事業和財運等，常用於算命與命理解讀。
explanation_english: Zi Wei Dou Shu is a traditional Chinese astrological/divination system that charts the positions of the Purple Star and other celestial 'stars' across a natal chart to interpret a person's character, fortune, relationships, career, and wealth. It is commonly used for fortune-telling and fate analysis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日搵人幫我算命，用紫微斗數排命盤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 wan2 jan4 bong1 ngo5 syun3 ming6, jung6 zi2 mei4 dau2 sou3 paai4 ming6 pun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天找人幫我算命，用紫微斗數排命盤。
