examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 min4 seoi3, teng1 lok6 hou2 naan4 zaap6 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話很綿絮，聽起來很難集中注意力。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks in a rambling, wordy way that's hard to concentrate on.

mandarin_meaning: 绵羊 (miányáng)
english_meaning: sheep (a domesticated ruminant raised for wool, meat, and milk)
explanation_mandarin: 指一種家畜，長有羊毛，常用於取得羊毛、羊肉和羊奶；也可比喻性格溫順、被動的人。
explanation_english: A domesticated wool-bearing ruminant (Ovis aries) commonly raised for wool, meat, and milk; can also be used metaphorically for someone who is meek or docile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場入面有幾隻綿羊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 gei2 zek3 min4 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农场里面有几只绵羊。
examples.english_sentence: There are several sheep on the farm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢性格好溫馴，好似綿羊咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 gaak3 hou2 wan1 seon4, hou2 ci5 min4 joeng4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他性格很温顺，像绵羊一样。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is very gentle, like a sheep.

mandarin_meaning: 綿羊；（比喻）性格溫順、容易被帶動或缺乏主見的人；也可作暱稱
english_meaning: lamb; (figurative) a meek, docile person or someone easily led; can be used as a pet name
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是小綿羊（羔羊）。在廣東話中常用來形容人溫順、乖巧或容易受人影響，有時用作親暱稱呼，也可帶輕微貶義。
explanation_english: Literally a young sheep (lamb). In Cantonese it is often used to describe someone gentle, meek, or easily influenced; it can be a term of endearment or, sometimes, mildly derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日畀人話係綿羊仔，成日冇主見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bei2 jan4 waa6 hai6 min4 joeng4 zai2, sing4 jat6 mou5 zyu2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常被人說是綿羊仔，總是沒有主見。
examples.english_sentence: He's often called a 'lamb'—always a pushover and has no opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你細個時真係好似綿羊仔咁可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sai3 go3 si4 zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 min4 joeng4 zai2 gam2 ho2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你小時候真的像綿羊仔一樣可愛。
examples.english_sentence: You were really cute like a little lamb when you were a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做綿羊仔，學識為自己發聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 min4 joeng4 zai2, hok6 sik1 wai6 zi6 gei2 faat3 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要當綿羊仔，學會為自己發聲。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a pushover—learn to speak up for yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 棉花（棉的纖維；在口語中也出現在「綿花糖」即棉花糖）
english_meaning: cotton (cotton fiber); also appears in cotton candy (as part of 綿花糖)
explanation_mandarin: 指從棉植物取得的纖維材料，可用作填充物或製作布料；在口語中常與「綿花糖」連用表示棉花糖。
explanation_english: Refers to the fibrous material obtained from the cotton plant, used as stuffing or to make textiles; colloquially appears in the term for cotton candy (綿花糖).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 枕頭入面係綿花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zam2 tau4 jap6 min6 hai6 min4 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 枕头里面是棉花。
examples.english_sentence: There's cotton inside the pillow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食綿花糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 min4 faa1 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃棉花糖。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat cotton candy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係用綿花做嘅，幾舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 jung6 min4 faa1 zou6 ge3, gei2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是用棉花做的，很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is made of cotton; it's quite comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 縱（緃）：放縱；（作連詞）即使、縱然
english_meaning: Variant of 縱 (to let loose, to indulge); (as conjunction) even if / although
explanation_mandarin: 「緃」為「縱」的異體字。作動詞時有放縱、縱容的意思；作連詞或副詞時可表示讓步關係，如「縱使、縱然」，相當於「即使」。
explanation_english: “緃” is a variant of 縱. As a verb it means to indulge or let loose; as a conjunction/adverb it expresses concession — 'even if' or 'though'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 緃使你唔鍾意，我都要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 si2 nei5 m4 zung1 ji3, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 縱使你不喜歡，我也得做。
examples.english_sentence: Even if you don't like it, I still have to do it.

mandarin_meaning: 缎带、带子；用带子绑（古或方言用法）
english_meaning: ribbon, sash, band; (verb) to bind/tie with a ribbon (archaic/dialectal)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 动词（古或方言）
explanation_mandarin: 緄为较少见或古老用字，常指丝带、绶带、缎带等，也可指用带子把东西绑好。现代汉语中多见于古文或方言中。
explanation_english: A rare or archaic character meaning a ribbon, sash, or band. It can also be used as a verb meaning to tie or bind with such a band. Mostly seen in literary or dialectal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用條緄綁住禮盒，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 tiu4 gwaan1 bong2 zyu6 lai5 hap6, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她用緄把礼盒绑好，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She tied the gift box with a ribbon; it looks very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 靠邊/走開（口語、粗俗）
english_meaning: get out of the way; shove off (colloquial, rude)
explanation_mandarin: 「緄邊」是香港粵語的口語用法，常用於要別人讓開、走開或表達不耐煩，有時帶有粗魯或不禮貌的語氣。語意接近「閃邊」或「走開」。
explanation_english: “緄邊” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang used to tell someone to move aside or get lost; it’s colloquial and can be rude or impatient. It is similar in meaning to “saan2 bin1” (閃邊) or “zou2 hoi1” (走開).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好企喺度，緄邊畀我過吓路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kei5 hai2 dou6, gwan1 bin1 bei2 ngo5 gwo3 haa5 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要站在這裡，靠邊讓我過一下路。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stand there — get out of the way so I can pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日阻住人，真係要緄邊啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seng4 jat6 zo2 zyu6 jan4, zan1 hai6 jiu3 gwan1 bin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老是妨礙別人，真的要走開了。
examples.english_sentence: You always get in people's way — seriously, move aside.

mandarin_meaning: 把絲、紗等繞成團或捻成股（古字）
english_meaning: to wind or twist silk/yarn into a skein (archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 指把絲、紗等繞成團或捻成股的動作，為古字，現代少用，常見於古文或專業紡織用語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the action of winding thread or silk into a skein or twisting it into strands. It is an archaic character, rarely used in modern everyday language and mainly found in classical texts or textile contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用紗線緅成一團，準備下次織衫用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 saa1 sin3 zau1 sing4 jat1 tyun4, zeon2 bei6 haa6 ci3 zik1 saam1 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把紗線緅成一團，準備下次織毛衣用。
examples.english_sentence: He wound the yarn into a skein, preparing it for the next knitting session.

mandarin_meaning: （助词）表示进行；（形容词）紧、紧急、重要
english_meaning: (particle) progressive/continuous marker; (adjective) tight / urgent / important
explanation_mandarin: 「緊」在廣東話有幾個常見用法：1) 作助詞表示動作或狀態正在進行，相當於普通話的「正在」；2) 作形容詞表示緊、緊密，如衣物緊；3) 表示緊急或重要（如「緊要」）。另外在口語中與其他字連用（如「緊係」）可作強調用法。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 「緊」 has several common uses: 1) as an aspect particle marking progressive/continuous action (equivalent to Mandarin "正在"); 2) as an adjective meaning tight (physically tight); 3) indicating urgency or importance (as in "緊要"). It also appears in colloquial compounds (e.g. "緊係") for emphasis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家做緊嘢，遲啲先傾啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 je5, ci4 di1 sin1 king1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在正在做事，等一下再談吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm doing something right now; let's talk later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條褲有啲緊，換條大啲嘅啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 fu3 jau5 di1 gan2, wun6 tiu4 daai6 di1 ge3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條褲子有點緊，換一條大一點的吧。
examples.english_sentence: These pants are a bit tight; get a slightly bigger pair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事好緊要，要快啲處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 hou2 gan2 jiu3, jiu3 faai3 di1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事很緊要，要快點處理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very important/urgent; handle it quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 緊急的事情；要緊的事
english_meaning: urgent matter; important business
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用法，指需要立即處理或很重要的事情，可理解為「緊急的事」或「要緊的事」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning an urgent or important matter that needs immediate attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣先，我有緊事要搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6 sin1, ngo5 jau5 gan2 si6 jiu3 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下，我有緊急的事情要處理。
examples.english_sentence: Wait a moment; I have an urgent matter to deal with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話有緊事，唔可以同我傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jau5 gan2 si6, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 ngo5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說有緊急的事，不能和我聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He said he had urgent business and couldn't chat with me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件係緊事，唔可以再拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 hai6 gan2 si6, m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事很緊急，不能再拖延。
examples.english_sentence: This is an urgent matter; it can't be delayed any longer.

mandarin_meaning: 紧密
english_meaning: close; tight; intimate; closely connected
explanation_mandarin: 表示關係、聯繫或安排非常接近、牢固或緊密不鬆散，常用於形容合作、關係或聯繫。
explanation_english: Describes relationships, connections, or arrangements that are very close, tight, or firmly knit; commonly used to describe cooperation, ties, or coordination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩間公司嘅關係好緊密，經常合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 gan2 mat6, ging1 soeng4 hop6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两家公司关系很紧密，经常合作。
examples.english_sentence: The two companies have very close ties and often collaborate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅合作好緊密，大家互相信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 hop6 zok3 hou2 gan2 mat6, daai6 gaa1 wu6 soeng1 seon3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的合作很紧密，大家互相信任。
examples.english_sentence: Our cooperation is very close; everyone trusts each other.

mandarin_meaning: 密切接觸
english_meaning: close contact (physical proximity or frequent physical contact)
explanation_mandarin: 指兩人或多人在空間上非常接近或經常有身體接觸，可用於描述傳染病接觸或關係親密等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to people being in very close physical proximity or having frequent physical contact; used to describe situations such as disease transmission or close personal relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排疫情嚴重，大家要盡量避免緊密接觸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 jik6 cing4 jim4 zung6, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 zeon6 loeng6 bei6 min5 gan2 mat6 zip3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近疫情嚴重，大家要盡量避免緊密接觸。
examples.english_sentence: The epidemic has been serious recently; everyone should try to avoid close contact.

mandarin_meaning: 密切接觸者；與確診或疑似病例有密切接觸的人
english_meaning: close contact (a person who has had close contact with a confirmed or suspected case)
explanation_mandarin: 指與確診或疑似病例有密切接觸（例如近距離或長時間接觸）的人，通常需要接受檢疫、檢測或隔離監測以防止疫情傳播。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has had close contact with a confirmed or suspected case (e.g., prolonged or close-distance contact). Such persons usually need to undergo quarantine, testing, or isolation for public health monitoring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你被列為緊密接觸者，需要檢疫十四日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 bei6 lit6 wai4 gan2 mat6 zip3 zuk1 ze2, seoi1 jiu3 gim2 jik6 sap6 sei3 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你被列為密切接觸者，需要檢疫十四天。
examples.english_sentence: If you are classified as a close contact, you need to quarantine for 14 days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府會通知緊密接觸者接受檢測並隔離觀察。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 wui5 tung1 zi1 gan2 mat6 zip3 zuk1 ze2 zip3 sau6 gim2 cak1 bing6 gaak3 lei4 gun1 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府會通知密切接觸者接受檢測並隔離觀察。
examples.english_sentence: The government will notify close contacts to get tested and undergo quarantine/observation.

mandarin_meaning: 紧张 (jǐnzhāng)
english_meaning: nervous; tense; anxious; strained
explanation_mandarin: 表示情緒焦慮、不安或形容氣氛、狀態緊繃、緊張。
explanation_english: Indicates feeling anxious or nervous; can also describe a tense or strained atmosphere or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我考試前好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haau2si3 cin4 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我考試前很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very nervous before the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣氣氛好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 go2 zan6 hei3 fan1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试的时候气氛很紧张。
examples.english_sentence: The atmosphere during the interview was very tense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使緊張，慢慢嚟就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gan2 zoeng1, maan6 maan6 lai4 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用紧张，慢慢来就行。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be nervous; take your time and it'll be fine.

mandarin_meaning: 總是很緊張或製造緊張氣氛的人（口語、戲稱）
english_meaning: a person who is always nervous or who creates tension; slang for someone who's a 'master' at being nervous
explanation_mandarin: 「緊張大師」是粵語俚語，戲稱總是容易緊張、在重要場合緊張或常常製造緊張氣氛的人。
explanation_english: "緊張大師" is a Cantonese slang term used jokingly to describe someone who is chronically nervous or who tends to create a tense atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做報告嗰陣成日好緊張，真係緊張大師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 bou3 gou3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, zan1 hai6 gan2 zoeng1 daai6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做報告的時候總是很緊張，真是緊張大師。
examples.english_sentence: He always gets nervous when giving presentations; he's a real 'master of nerves'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試前阿明整晚都唔訓，做嗰陣又好緊張，大家都笑佢係緊張大師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 cin4 aa3 ming4 zing2 maan5 dou1 m4 fan3, zou6 go2 zan6 jau6 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 siu3 keoi5 hai6 gan2 zoeng1 daai6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試前阿明整晚沒睡，做面試時又很緊張，大家都笑他是緊張大師。
examples.english_sentence: Before the interview, Ah Ming didn't sleep all night; during the interview he was very nervous—everyone joked he was a 'master of nerves'.

mandarin_meaning: 紧张感（jǐnzhāng gǎn）：紧张、不安或悬念的感觉，常用来形容气氛或个人的心理状态。
english_meaning: a sense of tension; a feeling of nervousness, stress, or suspense, often describing an atmosphere or someone's psychological state.
explanation_mandarin: 表示緊張或不安的感覺，既可指個人情緒（如焦慮、緊張），也可指環境或情節帶來的緊張氣氛或懸念。
explanation_english: Denotes a feeling of tension or nervousness; can refer to an individual's anxious state or the tense/suspenseful atmosphere created by a situation or event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影入面嗰段打鬥好有緊張感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 jap6 min6 go2 dyun6 daa2 dau3 hou2 jau5 gan2 zoeng1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影里面那段打斗很有紧张感。
examples.english_sentence: That fight scene in the movie is very tense / has a strong sense of tension.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前我總係會有緊張感，心口慌慌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 ngo5 zung2 hai6 wui5 jau5 gan2 zoeng1 gam2, sam1 hau2 fong1 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试前我总是会有紧张感，心里很慌。
examples.english_sentence: I always feel nervous before exams; my heart feels unsettled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 整個房間冇聲，反而令到人有緊張感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing2 go3 fong4 gaan1 mou5 seng1, faan2 ji5 ling6 dou3 jan4 jau5 gan2 zoeng1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整个房间没有声音，反而让人感到紧张。
examples.english_sentence: The silence in the room instead creates a sense of tension.

mandarin_meaning: 緊急 (jǐn jí)
english_meaning: urgent; emergency
explanation_mandarin: 表示情況需要立即處理或引起高度注意，常用於描述危險、突發或需要迅速應對的狀況。
explanation_english: Indicates that a situation requires immediate attention or action; used to describe danger, urgency, or events that need rapid response.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個情況好緊急，我哋要即刻處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing4 fong3 hou2 gan2 gap1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zik1 hak1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個情況很緊急，我們要立刻處理。
examples.english_sentence: This situation is very urgent; we need to deal with it immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果天氣惡化，可能會有緊急撤離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 tin1 hei3 ok3 faa3, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 gan2 gap1 cit3 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果天氣惡化，可能會有緊急撤離。
examples.english_sentence: If the weather worsens, there may be emergency evacuations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇緊急聯絡人？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 gan2 gap1 lyun4 lok3 jan4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有緊急聯絡人？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have an emergency contact?

mandarin_meaning: 緊張、坐立不安、心神不寧
english_meaning: nervous, fidgety, restless
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俗語，形容一個人因為緊張或焦慮而坐立不安、搓弄或顫抖的狀態。常用於口語，帶有擬態語的感覺。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression describing someone who is nervous, anxious, or restless — often fidgeting or trembling. It's an onomatopoeic, spoken phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試前成日緊捋捋，手震到攞唔穩支筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2si3 cin4 seng4 jat6 gan2 leot6 leot6, sau2 zan3 dou3 lo2 m4 wan2 zi1 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考試前總是坐立不安，手抖到拿不穩筆。
examples.english_sentence: He is always fidgety before exams; his hands shake so much he can't hold the pen steady.

mandarin_meaning: 紧接（紧接着，紧接发生）
english_meaning: immediately following; right after; to follow closely; to connect directly
explanation_mandarin: 表示緊接著、緊接發生，常用來形容事情或動作在時間或順序上緊鄰、馬上跟著發生；也可作動詞，表示接上、連接。
explanation_english: Indicates that something immediately follows or occurs right after; used to describe events or actions that are directly consecutive in time or sequence. Can also be used as a verb meaning to connect or attach immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 緊接之後，我哋會介紹下一位講者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan2 zip3 zi1 hau6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 gaai3 siu6 haa6 jat1 wai2 gong2 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 緊接之後，我們會介紹下一位講者。
examples.english_sentence: Immediately afterward, we'll introduce the next speaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩個動作係緊接發生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 go3 dung6 zok3 hai6 gan2 zip3 faat3 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這兩個動作是緊接發生的。
examples.english_sentence: These two actions occur consecutively.

mandarin_meaning: 紧握
english_meaning: to hold tightly; to grip firmly
explanation_mandarin: 表示用手用力抓住或握住某物或某人，強調力度或不放手。
explanation_english: To grasp or hold something/someone firmly with the hand, emphasizing tightness or not letting go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢緊握住我嘅手，唔肯放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan2 ngok3 zyu6 ngo5 ge3 sau2, m4 hang2 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他紧握着我的手，不肯放开。
examples.english_sentence: He held my hand tightly and refused to let go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下雨路滑，我緊握住方向盤小心駕駛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 jyu5 lou6 waat6, ngo5 gan2 ngok3 zyu6 fong1 hoeng3 pun4 siu2 sam1 gaa3 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨路滑，我紧握着方向盘小心驾驶。
examples.english_sentence: The road was slippery from rain, so I gripped the steering wheel tightly and drove carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 紧凑
english_meaning: compact; tight; well-paced
explanation_mandarin: 表示布局或时间安排紧密，没有多余的空档或空间；也可指节奏紧密、连贯、没有冗长部分。
explanation_english: Indicates something arranged closely with little extra space or time; can describe a tight schedule, compact layout, or a well-paced, concise structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個行程排得好緊湊，我哋冇乜時間休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hang4 cing4 paai4 dak1 hou2 gan2 cau3, ngo5 dei6 mou5 mat1 si4 gaan3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个行程安排得很紧凑，我们没有多少休息时间。
examples.english_sentence: This itinerary is scheduled very tightly; we don't have much time to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 劇情節奏好緊湊，完全冇悶場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kek6 cing4 zit3 zau6 hou2 gan2 cau3, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 mun6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 剧情节奏非常紧凑，完全没有沉闷的段落。
examples.english_sentence: The plot's pacing is very tight; there's no dull parts at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次會議時間好緊湊，開會要控制好討論時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 wui6 ji5 si4 gaan3 hou2 gan2 cau3, hoi1 wui6 jiu3 hung3 zai3 hou2 tou2 leon6 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次会议时间很紧凑，开会要控制好讨论时间。
examples.english_sentence: This meeting's schedule is tight, so we must control discussion time during the meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 把火調小；轉小火
english_meaning: to turn down the heat / lower the flame (when cooking)
explanation_mandarin: 烹饪用語，表示在烹調時把火力調小或改為小火慢煮，以免沸騰過猛或煮焦。
explanation_english: A cooking instruction meaning to reduce the stove's heat or lower the flame (to simmer or prevent burning).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲湯滾得太厲害，緊火慢慢煲幾分鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 tong1 gwan2 dak1 taai3 lai6hoi6, gan2 fo2 maan6 maan6 bou2 gei2 fan1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 湯沸騰得太厲害，把火轉小慢慢燉幾分鐘。
examples.english_sentence: The soup is boiling too hard; turn down the heat and simmer for a few minutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你煎緊嗰塊牛扒，記得緊火唔好煎燶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zin1 gan2 go2 faai3 ngau4 paa4, gei3 dak1 gan2 fo2 m4 hou2 zin1 long4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你煎的那塊牛排，記得把火調小，不要煎焦。
examples.english_sentence: You're frying that steak—remember to turn down the heat so it doesn't burn.

mandarin_meaning: 緊缺；短缺；不足
english_meaning: short of; scarce; in short supply (e.g., staff, money, time)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某種資源（如人手、資金、時間）不足、緊缺，常用於口語和書面語中。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a resource (such as staff, funds, or time) is insufficient or in short supply; commonly used in everyday and formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家公司人手好緊絀，冇時間培訓新人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gung1 si1 jan4 sau2 hou2 gan2 keot1, mou5 si4 gaan3 pui4 fan3 san1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在公司人手很緊缺，沒有時間培訓新人。
examples.english_sentence: The company is currently short-staffed and doesn't have time to train new hires.

mandarin_meaning: 紧缩（收紧、减少开支或规模；经济收缩）
english_meaning: to tighten; to reduce or cut back (e.g. spending); contraction (economic)
explanation_mandarin: 表示收紧或减少（如开支、规模、政策等），也可指经济上的收缩或紧缩政策。
explanation_english: Indicates tightening or reducing (e.g. spending, scale, policies); can also refer to economic contraction or austerity measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要緊縮開支，可能會裁員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 gan2 suk1 hoi1 zi1, ho2 nang4 wui5 coi4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要紧缩开支，可能会裁员。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to tighten its spending and may lay off staff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府推行緊縮政策，削減公共支出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 teoi1 hang4 gan2 suk1 zing3 caak3, soek3 gaam2 gung1 gung6 zi1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府推行紧缩政策，削减公共支出。
examples.english_sentence: The government is implementing austerity measures, cutting public expenditures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要緊縮生活開支，節省啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gan2 suk1 sang1 wut6 hoi1 zi1, zit3 saang2 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要紧缩生活开支，节省点钱。
examples.english_sentence: We need to tighten our household expenses and save some money.

mandarin_meaning: 重要 / 要紧
english_meaning: important; crucial; critical
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事或情況很重要或關鍵，常用於粵語口語中。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is important or crucial; commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好緊要，唔可以拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 gan2 jiu3, m4 ho2 ji5 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很重要，不能拖延。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is very important; it can't be put off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 安全最緊要，其他嘢可以慢慢再傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: on1 cyun4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3, kei4 taa1 je5 ho2 ji5 maan6 maan6 zoi3 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 安全最重要，其他事情可以慢慢再谈。
examples.english_sentence: Safety is the most important; other things can be discussed later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我病情唔係好緊要，但係要定期檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 beng6 cing4 m4 hai6 hou2 gan2 jiu3, daan6 hai6 jiu3 ding6 kei4 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的病情不严重，但要定期检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said my condition isn't serious, but I need regular check-ups.

mandarin_meaning: 重要的事／要緊的事情
english_meaning: important matter; urgent matter
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事很重要或緊急，既可用於書面語，也可用於口語。
explanation_english: Refers to a matter that is important or urgent; usable in both formal and colloquial contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件緊要事我哋要盡快處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 gan2 jiu3 si6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件重要的事我們要盡快處理。
examples.english_sentence: We need to deal with this important matter as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你有緊要事，記得打電話畀我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jau5 gan2 jiu3 si6, gei3 dak1 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有重要的事，記得打電話給我。
examples.english_sentence: If you have any important matters, remember to call me.

mandarin_meaning: 记得；务必记住；切记
english_meaning: remember; be sure to remember; make sure
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示提醒對方記住某事或務必不忘。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to remind someone to remember something or to be sure not to forget.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你緊記帶把遮，今日可能會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gan2 gei3 daai3 baa2 ze1, gam1 jat6 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你記得帶傘，今天可能會下雨。
examples.english_sentence: Make sure you bring an umbrella; it might rain today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 緊記要喺截止日前交功課，唔好遲交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan2 gei3 jiu3 hai2 git3 zai3 jat6 cin4 gaau1 gung1 fo3, m4 hou2 ci4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記得要在截止日期前交作業，不要遲交。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to submit your homework before the deadline; don't turn it in late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門前緊記鎖門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 cin4 gan2 gei3 so2 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門前記得把門鎖上。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to lock the door before you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 紧贴；紧密跟随或关注（可指物理上贴近，或比喻上紧跟最新情况）
english_meaning: to stick closely to; to follow closely; to keep up-to-date or stay close to
explanation_mandarin: 表示靠得很近或密切跟随、关注。既可用于物理上贴紧某物，也常用于比喻，指紧跟信息、潮流或事态发展。
explanation_english: Indicates staying closely attached or closely following/monitoring. Can be used physically (stuck close to something) or figuratively (keeping up with news, trends, or developments).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要緊貼市場變化，先可以做出啱嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gan2 tip3 si5 coeng4 bin3 faa3, sin1 ho2 ji5 zou6 ceot1 aam1 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要紧贴市场变化，才能做出正确的决定。
examples.english_sentence: We need to keep close to market changes so we can make the right decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家網上資訊咁快，要緊貼先唔會落後。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 mong5 soeng6 zi1 seon3 gam2 faai3, jiu3 gan2 tip3 sin1 m4 wui5 lok6 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在网上信息更新很快，要紧贴才不会落后。
examples.english_sentence: Online information moves so fast now; you must stay up-to-date to avoid falling behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張海報緊貼牆，唔易畀風吹走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 hoi2 pou3 gan2 tip3 coeng4, m4 ji6 bei2 fung1 ceoi1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海报紧贴在墙上，不容易被风吹走。
examples.english_sentence: The poster is stuck to the wall and won't be blown away easily.

mandarin_meaning: 紧身
english_meaning: tight; tight-fitting; form-fitting
explanation_mandarin: 表示衣物貼身、貼合身體形狀；也可用來形容某物緊繃、不寬鬆。
explanation_english: Describes clothing (or similar items) that fit closely to the body; tight or snug rather than loose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好緊身，我唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 gan2 san1, ngo5 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很紧身，我不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is very tight; I'm uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意著緊身牛仔褲，顯得腿好直。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 zoek3 gan2 san1 ngau4 zai2 fu3, hin2 dak1 teoi2 hou2 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她喜欢穿紧身牛仔裤，显得腿很直。
examples.english_sentence: He/she likes wearing tight jeans; it makes their legs look very straight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲鞋太緊身，壓到我隻腳好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 haai4 taai3 gan2 san1, aat3 dou3 ngo5 zek3 goek3 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些鞋太紧，把我的脚压得很痛。
examples.english_sentence: The shoes are too tight and are pressing on my foot so it hurts.

mandarin_meaning: 緊身褲 (jǐnshēnkù)
english_meaning: tight-fitting pants; leggings; tights
explanation_mandarin: 指緊貼身體、較修身的褲子，常見如打底褲、緊身運動褲或緊身長褲。
explanation_english: Refers to pants that fit closely to the body, such as leggings, tights, or other tight-fitting trousers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗條新嘅緊身褲，好舒服，好適合跑步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 tiu4 san1 ge3 gan2 san1 fu3, hou2 syu1 fuk6, hou2 sik1 hap6 paau2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一條新的緊身褲，很舒服，很適合跑步。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new pair of tight pants; they're very comfortable and great for running.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲緊身褲太貼身啦，我唔太鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gan2 san1 fu3 taai3 tip3 san1 laa1, ngo5 m4 taai3 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條緊身褲太貼身了，我不太喜歡。
examples.english_sentence: These tights are too tight; I don't really like them.

mandarin_meaning: 紧迫（jǐnpò），紧急、迫切
english_meaning: urgent; pressing; imminent; under pressure
explanation_mandarin: 表示情況急迫或迫切，需要立即處理或採取行動。
explanation_english: Indicates that a situation is urgent or pressing and requires immediate attention or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家情況好緊迫，我哋要趕快完成呢份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 cing4 fong3 hou2 gan2 bik1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gon2 faai3 jyun4 sing4 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司現在情況很緊迫，我們要趕快完成這份報告。
examples.english_sentence: The company is in a very urgent situation right now; we need to finish this report quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 局勢愈來愈緊迫，政府要盡快採取措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: guk6 sai3 jyu6 loi4 jyu6 gan2 bik1, zing3 fu2 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 coi2 ceoi2 co3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 局勢越來越緊迫，政府要盡快採取措施。
examples.english_sentence: The situation is becoming increasingly urgent; the government should take measures as soon as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家時間好緊迫，冇得慢慢傾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 si4 gaan3 hou2 gan2 bik1, mou5 dak1 maan6 maan6 king1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在時間很緊迫，不能慢慢商量。
examples.english_sentence: I'm under tight time pressure right now; we can't discuss this slowly.

mandarin_meaning: 紧逼；逼迫；紧紧逼近
english_meaning: to press/pressure someone; to pursue/close in closely
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示緊緊追逼、施加壓力或逼迫別人做某事，也可指靠得很近、逼近。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to press or pressure someone, to pursue closely, or to close in on something/someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直緊逼我交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 gan2 bik1 ngo5 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直紧逼我交作业。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps pressuring me to hand in the homework.

mandarin_meaning: 紧锣密鼓（jǐn luó mì gǔ）：形容准备或进行某项活动时，步调紧凑、频密而有序，进展迅速。
english_meaning: in full swing; proceeding rapidly and intensively with well-organized preparations
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容籌備或開展活動時，工作紧密且有序地迅速進行，常帶有緊張但有條理的意味。
explanation_english: Used to describe preparations or events that are being carried out quickly, intensively, and in an organized manner; implies busy, tightly scheduled activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司依家緊鑼密鼓準備推出新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji1 gaa1 gan2 lo4 mat6 gu2 zeon2 bei6 teoi1 ceot1 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司现在紧锣密鼓准备推出新产品。
examples.english_sentence: The company is currently making intensive, well-organized preparations to launch a new product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗應付考試，佢哋而家緊鑼密鼓溫習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jing3 fu6 haau2 si3, keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 gan2 lo4 mat6 gu2 wan1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了应付考试，他们现在紧锣密鼓地复习。
examples.english_sentence: They're studying intensively right now to prepare for the exams.

mandarin_meaning: 紧闭（紧紧关闭、封闭）
english_meaning: tightly closed; shut tightly; sealed
explanation_mandarin: 表示緊緊地關上或封閉，強調不能打開或進入。可用作動詞（將…緊閉）或形容詞（處於緊閉狀態）。
explanation_english: Indicates something is tightly closed or sealed, emphasizing that it cannot be opened or entered. Can function as a verb (to close tightly) or an adjective (in a tightly closed state).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大門緊閉，冇人入得去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 mun4 gan2 bai3, mou5 jan4 jap6 dak1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大门紧闭，没有人能进去。
examples.english_sentence: The main door is tightly closed; no one can get in.

mandarin_meaning: 深紅色；鮮紅（常作顏色詞或用於合成詞，如「緋紅」「緋聞」）
english_meaning: crimson; scarlet (a deep red color; often appears in compounds such as 'scarlet' or 'scandal')
explanation_mandarin: 表示深紅、鮮紅的顏色，常見於合成詞中（如「緋紅」指鮮豔的紅色），在某些詞如「緋聞」中則引申為與緋色相關的社會語義（緋聞＝醜聞、緋聞）。
explanation_english: Indicates a deep, crimson red. Commonly used in compounds (e.g. 緋紅 = scarlet). In compounds like 緋聞 it takes on social meanings related to scandals or affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着咗一件緋紅色嘅裙，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 jat1 gin6 fei1 hung4 sik1 ge3 kwan4, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿了一條緋紅色的裙子，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a scarlet dress; it's very beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 绯红（fēihóng），深红色或猩红色
english_meaning: crimson; scarlet; deep red
explanation_mandarin: 緋紅指偏鮮豔、帶有一點橙或紫調的深紅色，常用於描寫顏色或具有詩意、文學性的描寫。
explanation_english: 緋紅 denotes a vivid deep red—crimson or scarlet—often used for color description and in poetic or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夕陽把天邊染成緋紅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik6 joeng4 baa2 tin1 bin1 jim5 sing4 fei1 hung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夕阳把天边染成绯红。
examples.english_sentence: The setting sun dyed the horizon crimson.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着咗件緋紅色嘅衣服，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 gin6 fei1 hung4 sik1 ge3 ji1 fuk6, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿了一件绯红色的衣服，很抢眼。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a crimson-colored outfit that was very eye-catching.

mandarin_meaning: 绯闻 (fēiwén)
english_meaning: scandal; gossip, especially about romantic affairs or alleged relationships involving public figures or celebrities
explanation_mandarin: 指与名人或公众人物有关的绯闻、恋情或丑闻报道，通常带有未经证实或夸大的成分，常出现在娱乐新闻中。
explanation_english: Refers to rumors or scandalous reports—often about romantic relationships—concerning celebrities or public figures. Typically implies unverified or sensational gossip, commonly found in entertainment media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個歌手最近有好多緋聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 go1 sau2 zeoi3 gan6 jau5 hou2 do1 fei1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个歌手最近有很多绯闻。
examples.english_sentence: This singer has had a lot of gossip lately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司對傳出嚟嘅緋聞保持沉默。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 deoi3 cyun4 ceot1 lai4 ge3 fei1 man4 bou2 ci4 cam4 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司对传出来的绯闻保持沉默。
examples.english_sentence: The company remained silent about the circulated scandal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅緋聞其實根本就係誤會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 fei1 man4 kei4 sat6 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 ng6 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的绯闻其实根本就是误会。
examples.english_sentence: Their scandal was actually just a misunderstanding.

mandarin_meaning: 綠（颜色），拼音：lǜ，表示绿色；也可引申为青涩、经验不足；在文化语境中与“戴绿帽”（被戴绿帽）相关。
english_meaning: green (color); can also mean inexperienced/naive; culturally associated with being cuckolded (as in 'wearing a green hat').
explanation_mandarin: 表示一種顏色，介於藍色與黃色之間。日常用於描述植物、衣物、標識等的顏色；在口語或比喻中可用來表示生疏、未熟或指涉被戴綠帽的狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to the color green, between blue and yellow. Commonly used to describe plants, clothing, signs, etc.; figuratively it can mean inexperienced/naive or, in Chinese cultural context, refer to being cuckolded (e.g., 'wearing a green hat').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係緑色，好啱夏天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 luk6 sik1, hou2 aam1 haa6 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是绿色，很适合夏天。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is green and very suitable for summer.

mandarin_meaning: 绪（xù）：情感、心情；事情的头绪、线索
english_meaning: (seoi) mood/emotion; thread/clue of a matter
explanation_mandarin: 表示情感、心情，或事情的头绪、线索。常见用法有“情绪”“头绪”等，通常与其他字组成词语使用。
explanation_english: Denotes emotion or mood, and also a thread/clue toward the resolution or beginning of something. Commonly appears in compounds such as 情緒 (mood) and 頭緒 (clue).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家情緒唔好，唔想講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 cing4 seoi3 m4 hou2, m4 soeng2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在情绪不好，不想说话。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a bad mood right now and don't want to talk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搵唔到呢件事嘅頭緒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan2 m4 dou3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 tau4 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我找不到这件事的头绪。
examples.english_sentence: I can't find any clue/the thread to this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 序言；前言；引言
english_meaning: preface; introduction; opening remarks
explanation_mandarin: 緒言指文章或演講開頭的引言或序言，用來簡要介紹背景、目的或主要內容，屬於名詞用法。
explanation_english: Refers to the opening remarks or preface of a text or speech that briefly introduces the background, purpose, or main points; used as a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇論文嘅緒言寫得幾清楚，介紹咗研究嘅目的同方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 leon6 man4 ge3 seoi3 jin4 se2 dak1 gei2 cing1 co2, gaai3 siu6 zo2 jin4 gau3 muk6 dik1 tung4 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇論文的緒言寫得很清楚，介紹了研究的目的和方法。
examples.english_sentence: The introduction of this paper is written clearly; it introduces the objectives and methods of the research.

mandarin_meaning: 绪论（书籍或论文开头说明背景、目的和结构的部分）
english_meaning: introduction (the opening section of a book, essay, thesis, or report explaining background, purpose, and structure)
explanation_mandarin: 指書籍、論文或報告開頭用來說明研究背景、目的與章節安排的部分，屬於學術與書面語用法。
explanation_english: The introductory section of a book, paper, thesis, or report that outlines the background, objectives, and organization of the work; commonly used in academic and formal writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋先睇下緒論，了解研究嘅背景同目的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sin1 tai2 haa5 seoi3 leon6, liu5 gaai2 jin4 gau3 ge3 bui3 ging2 tung4 muk6 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們先看緒論，了解研究的背景和目的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's read the introduction first to understand the background and objectives of the research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 緒論部分主要講明研究範圍，方便讀者理解後續章節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi3 leon6 bou6 fan6 zyu2 jiu3 gong2 ming4 jin4 gau3 faan6 wai4, fong1 bin6 duk6 ze2 lei5 gaai2 hau6 zuk6 zoeng1 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 緒論部分主要說明研究範圍，方便讀者理解後續章節。
examples.english_sentence: The introduction section mainly explains the scope of the study to help readers understand the subsequent chapters.

mandarin_meaning: 緒 (xù)，表示頭緒、線索、開端或狀況
english_meaning: (literary/morpheme) thread; clue; beginning; state (used in compounds like '頭緒')
explanation_mandarin: 「緒」常見於合成詞（如「頭緒」、「緒論」），作名詞使用，表示線索、頭緒、事情的開端或狀態。
explanation_english: The character 緒 appears in compounds (e.g. 頭緒, 緒論). As a noun it denotes a thread, clue, the beginning of something, or the state/condition of a matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家冇頭緒，唔知點開始做呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 mou5 tau4 co3, m4 zi1 dim2 hoi1 ci2 zou6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在沒有頭緒，不知道怎麼開始做這個項目。
examples.english_sentence: I have no idea right now; I don't know how to start this project.

mandarin_meaning: 绪言、序言，引言，书籍或文章开头对内容的概述或导引。
english_meaning: preface; introduction; introductory remarks or prologue that outlines or introduces the content of a book or article.
explanation_mandarin: 緖言通常指書籍、論文或報告開頭的部分，用來概述主題、背景或寫作目的，類似序言或前言。
explanation_english: Refers to the introductory section of a book, article, or report that outlines the topic, background, or purpose—similar to a preface or foreword.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰篇報告嘅緒言寫得好清楚，令讀者好快掌握研究目的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 pin1 bou3 gou3 ge3 co3 jin4 se2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2, ling6 duk6 ze2 hou2 faai3 zoeng2 ngok6 jin4 gau3 muk6 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那篇报告的绪言写得很清楚，使读者很快掌握研究目的。
examples.english_sentence: The report's introduction was written very clearly, enabling readers to quickly grasp the research objectives.

mandarin_meaning: 緒論；引言；導論
english_meaning: introduction; preliminary discussion (the opening section of an article, thesis, or book)
explanation_mandarin: 書面語，指文章或論文開頭的章節，對研究主題、背景、目的與範圍做總體說明與鋪陳。
explanation_english: A formal written section at the beginning of a paper, thesis, or book that outlines the topic, background, objectives, and scope; serves as the introduction or preliminary discussion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇論文嘅緒論講咗研究目的同背景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 leon6 man4 ge3 co3 leon6 gong2 zo2 jin4 gau3 muk6 dik1 tung4 bui3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇論文的緒論陳述了研究目的和背景。
examples.english_sentence: The introduction of this paper states the research objectives and background.

mandarin_meaning: 封（信）；封口；保持沉默
english_meaning: to seal (a letter); to keep silent; to close one's mouth
explanation_mandarin: 表示把信封好或閉口不言，常見於書面語或成語中，如「緘口」、「緘默」。
explanation_english: Indicates sealing (e.g., a letter) or keeping silent; commonly used in written/formal contexts or compounds like '緘口' (to keep silent) and '緘默' (silent).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者問佢多次，但佢一直緘口唔答。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 man6 keoi5 do1 ci3, daan6 keoi5 jat1 zik6 gim1 hau2 m4 daap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 記者問他多次，但他一直緘口不答。
examples.english_sentence: Reporters asked him many times, but he remained silent and did not answer.

mandarin_meaning: 缄默；沉默、不发言（书面语）
english_meaning: silent; remaining silent; taciturn (literary/written)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞/動詞短語（書面語）
explanation_mandarin: 表示保持沉默、不发表意见或闭口不谈，常用于书面或正式语境。
explanation_english: Indicates keeping silent or not speaking; a literary/written term used to describe taciturnity or deliberate silence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對記者提問，佢仍然緘默不語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 gei3 ze2 tai4 man6, keoi5 jing4 jin4 gim1 mak6 bat1 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对记者提问，他仍然缄默不语。
examples.english_sentence: Facing reporters' questions, he remained silent.

mandarin_meaning: 缂（kè）：缂丝，一種古代的織錦/切絲織造技藝；也可指用此法織成的絲織品。
english_meaning: kè (kesi): to weave/embroider using the kesi (cut-silk) technique; also refers to the kesi silk fabric produced by that technique.
explanation_mandarin: 緙為文言常見字，常見於「緙絲/缂丝」一詞，指用緙（缂）法織造或繡製精細的絲織品，是一種歷史悠久的工藝技法，常見於古代皇室與高級織物描述中。
explanation_english: An archaic/literary character most often seen in the compound 緙絲 (kesi). It denotes the technique of weaving or embroidering fine silk using the kesi (cut-silk) method, or the fabric produced by that technique. Used as a verb (to weave/embroider in this style) or as a noun (kesi silk).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅緙絲係清朝嘅手工藝，好罕有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 hot3 si1 hai6 cing1 ciu4 ge3 sau2 ngai6, hou2 hon2 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這幅緙絲是清朝的手工藝，很罕見。
examples.english_sentence: This kesi silk piece is a Qing-dynasty handicraft; it's very rare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代匠人緙絲嘅功夫好犀利，圖樣好精細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 zoeng6 jan4 hot3 si1 ge3 gung1 fu1 hou2 sai1 lei6, tou4 joeng6 hou2 zing1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代工匠緙絲的功夫很厲害，圖樣很精細。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient craftsmen's skill in kesi was impressive; the patterns are very intricate.

mandarin_meaning: 线（xiàn）：线状物；线路；线索
english_meaning: line; thread; wire; cable; clue; route
explanation_mandarin: 表示細長的線狀物，例如線、繩、電線或電纜；也可引申指路線、界線或抽象的線索（如破案的線索）。
explanation_english: Refers to a thin elongated filament or cord (thread, string, wire, cable); can also mean a route, boundary, or an abstract clue (e.g., evidence in an investigation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條線好細，唔好扯斷佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sin3 hou2 sai3, m4 hou2 ce2 dyun6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條線很細，不要扯斷它。
examples.english_sentence: This thread is very thin; don't pull it and break it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企嘅網線壞咗，冇得上網。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 ge3 mong5 sin3 waai6 zo2, mou5 dak1 soeng5 mong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡的網線壞了，上不了網。
examples.english_sentence: The home's network cable is broken; we can't get online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方依靠線索破案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 fong1 ji1 kaau3 sin3 sok3 po3 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方依靠線索破案。
examples.english_sentence: The police solved the case based on the clues.

mandarin_meaning: 線上 / 在線上（透過網路）
english_meaning: online (via the internet)
explanation_mandarin: 「線上」指透過網路或虛擬連線進行的活動或狀態，例如線上會議、線上課程或線上預約等。
explanation_english: "線上" means 'online' — referring to activities or states conducted via the internet or a network (e.g., online meetings, courses, appointments).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多公司轉做線上開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 gung1 si1 zyun2 zou6 sin3 soeng6 hoi1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很多公司改成線上開會。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many companies have switched to holding meetings online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢報咗一個線上課程，學緊廣告設計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou3 zo2 jat1 go3 sin3 soeng6 fo3 cing4, hok6 gan2 gwong2 gou3 cit3 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他報名了一個線上課程，正在學習廣告設計。
examples.english_sentence: He signed up for an online course and is studying advertising design.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺線上預約客服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 sin3 soeng6 jyu6 joek3 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在線上預約客服。
examples.english_sentence: You can make an appointment with customer service online.

mandarin_meaning: 线人（向警方、媒體或其他機構提供線索或消息的人）
english_meaning: informant; mole; someone who provides tips or inside information
explanation_mandarin: 指向警方、媒體或其他機構提供內部消息、線索或情報的人，亦可指臥底或內線；通常帶有提供秘密或內部資訊的含義。
explanation_english: A person who provides inside information, tips, or leads to the police, media, or other organizations; can also mean a mole or an undercover source who leaks confidential information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係警方嘅線人，專門提供內部資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ging2 fong1 ge3 sin3 jan4, zyun1 mun4 tai4 gung1 noi6 bou6 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是警方的線人，專門提供內部資料。
examples.english_sentence: He is an informant for the police, specifically providing internal information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司懷疑有人做線人，將商業機密洩露出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 waai4 ji4 jau5 jan4 zou6 sin3 jan4, zoeng1 soeng1 jip6 gei1 mat6 sit3 lou6 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司懷疑有人當線人，把商業機密洩露出去。
examples.english_sentence: The company suspects someone is acting as an informant, leaking trade secrets.

mandarin_meaning: （電線或電子設備的）插口、接口
english_meaning: a port, socket, or jack where a cable/wire is plugged in
explanation_mandarin: 指供電線、訊號線或其他連接線插入的接口或插槽，常用於描述電子設備上的接線位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the socket/port where a cable or wire is connected (power, signal, or other cables); commonly used to describe connection points on electronic devices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視後面嗰個線口插唔到條線，可能壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 hau6 min6 go2 go3 sin3 hau2 caap3 m4 dou3 tiu4 sin3, ho2 nang4 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電視後面的那個線口插不上線，可能壞了。
examples.english_sentence: The port at the back of the TV won't accept the cable; it might be broken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個充電器嘅線口好鬆，成日插唔穩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 cung1 din6 hei3 ge3 sin3 hau2 hou2 sung1, sing4 jat6 caap3 m4 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 充電器的接口很鬆，經常插不牢。
examples.english_sentence: The charger port is loose; the plug often doesn't stay in.

mandarin_meaning: 線圈砲（電磁砲的一種）
english_meaning: coilgun (electromagnetic projectile launcher)
explanation_mandarin: 一種利用脈衝電磁線圈產生磁場，依序激發以加速金屬彈丸的裝置，常稱為線圈砲或線圈槍，與磁軌砲（railgun）原理不同。
explanation_english: A device that uses pulsed electromagnetic coils to generate magnetic fields that sequentially accelerate a projectile; commonly called a coilgun or electromagnetic launcher, distinct in principle from a railgun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話有人研發緊一部線圈砲，聽落好科幻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 jau5 jan4 jin4faat3 gan2 jat1 bou6 sin3 hyun1 paau3, teng1 lok6 hou2 fo1 waan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們說有人在研發一門線圈砲，聽起來很科幻。
examples.english_sentence: They said someone is developing a coilgun; it sounds very sci‑fi.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校嘅實驗室做咗個小型線圈砲，用嚟示範電磁加速。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 ge3 sat6 jim6 sat1 zou6 zo2 go3 siu2 jing4 sin3 hyun1 paau3, jung6 lai4 si6 faan2 din6 ci4 gaa1 cuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校的實驗室做了一個小型線圈砲，用來示範電磁加速。
examples.english_sentence: The school's lab built a small coilgun to demonstrate electromagnetic acceleration.

mandarin_meaning: 線報（線索、內部消息、情报）
english_meaning: tip-off; inside information; a lead or intelligence
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，指收到的線索或內部消息，常用於報案、商業情報或社會新聞中，含未必經確認的意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial term for a tip or piece of inside information—often an unconfirmed lead used in police reports, business intelligence, or gossip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我收到個線報，話嗰間舖今晚會減價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau1 dou3 go3 sin3 bou3, waa6 go2 gaan1 pou3 gam1maan5 wui5 gaam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我收到了一個線報，說那間舖今晚會降價。
examples.english_sentence: I got a tip that that shop will have a sale tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方收到條線報，話有人會喺碼頭走私貨物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 sau1 dou3 tiu4 sin3 bou3, waa6 jau5 jan4 wui5 hai2 maa5 tau4 zau2 si1 fo3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方收到線報，說有人會在碼頭走私貨物。
examples.english_sentence: The police received a tip-off that someone will be smuggling goods at the pier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有線報話佢可能會被公司炒魷魚，但未有證據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 sin3 bou3 waa6 keoi5 ho2 nang4 wui5 bei6 gung1 si1 caau2 jau4 jyu4, daan6 mei6 jau5 zing3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有線報說他可能會被公司解僱，但還沒有證據。
examples.english_sentence: There's a tip that he might be fired by the company, but there's no evidence yet.

mandarin_meaning: 线条
english_meaning: line; lines; contour; stroke; linear quality
explanation_mandarin: 指線或筆觸形成的條狀形態，常用於繪畫、設計或描述輪廓與結構。
explanation_english: Refers to lines or strokes forming linear shapes; commonly used in drawing, design, or to describe contours and structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫嘅線條好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 ge3 sin3 tiu4 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画的线条很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The lines in this painting are very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用簡單嘅線條勾勒人物輪廓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 gaan2 daan1 ge3 sin3 tiu4 gou1 lak6 jan4 mat6 leon4 kok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用简单的线条勾勒人物轮廓。
examples.english_sentence: He sketches the figure's contours with simple lines.

mandarin_meaning: 走鋼絲；處於如履薄冰的危險或微妙狀態（罕見或口語用法）
english_meaning: walking a tightrope; being in a precarious, risky, or delicate situation (rare/colloquial usage)
explanation_mandarin: 「線步」為粵語中較罕見的口語表達，字面上可理解為「在細線上行走」。比喻用法指處於危險、微妙或風險極高的情況，類似「走鋼絲」或「如履薄冰」。日常粵語中有時會以「行緊線步」等形式出現，但並非普遍常用詞。
explanation_english: “線步” is a relatively rare Cantonese colloquial expression; literally "walking on a thread." Metaphorically it refers to being in a precarious, risky, or delicate situation—similar to "walking a tightrope." It may appear in forms like "行緊線步" (be walking a tightrope) but is not widely used in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家做嘢好似行緊線步，成日驚出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 je5 hou2 ci5 hang4 gan2 sin3 bou6, seng4 jat6 geng1 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在做事好像走鋼絲，總是怕出錯。
examples.english_sentence: He's doing things like walking a tightrope right now, always afraid of making mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 漏洞；可被利用的小空隙或後路
english_meaning: a loophole; a small gap or weak point that can be exploited; an escape route or way out
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指合約、規則或安排中的小漏洞、破綻或可供利用的退路，常用於描述可被鑽空子的地方。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang for a loophole or small flaw in rules, contracts, or arrangements that can be exploited; also used to mean an escape route or way out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺條款度留咗線眼，等日後可以反悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 tiu4 fun2 dou6 lau4 zo2 sin3 ngaan5, dang2 jat6 hau6 ho2 ji5 faan2 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在條款裡留下了漏洞，方便日後反悔。
examples.english_sentence: They left a loophole in the terms so they can back out later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 律師幫我檢查合約，冇畀人搵到線眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leot6 si1 bong1 ngo5 gim2 caa4 hap6 joek3, mou5 bei2 jan4 wan2 dou3 sin3 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 律師幫我檢查合約，沒有讓人找到漏洞。
examples.english_sentence: The lawyer checked the contract so no one can find a loophole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆為咗逃稅，喺帳目入面留咗線眼畀自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 wai6 zo2 tou4 seoi3, hai2 zoeng3 muk6 jap6 min6 lau4 zo2 sin3 ngaan5 bei2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆為了逃稅，在帳目中留下了漏洞給自己。
examples.english_sentence: The boss left holes in the accounts to evade taxes for himself.

mandarin_meaning: 线索；头绪（用于侦查、调查、研究中，指可帮助找到真相或解决问题的信息或迹象）
english_meaning: clue; lead; hint — information or signs that help solve a problem, find the truth, or guide an investigation
explanation_mandarin: 指能幫助解開問題或找到真相的信息、跡象或線索，常見於偵查、調查或研究等語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to information, indications, or hints that help resolve a problem or uncover the truth; commonly used in contexts like investigations, research, or problem-solving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺現場搵到一啲可能有用嘅線索，依家正喺跟進。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 jin6 coeng4 wan2 dou2 jat1 di1 ho2 nang4 jau5 jung6 ge3 sin3 sok3, ji1 gaa1 zing3 hai6 gan1 zeon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在现场找到一些可能有用的线索，正在跟进。
examples.english_sentence: The police found some potentially useful clues at the scene and are currently following up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我終於有啲頭緒，搵到一條線索可以解決呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jau5 di1 tau4 seoi3, wan2 dou2 jat1 tiu4 sin3 sok3 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我终于有些头绪，找到一条线索可以解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: I finally have some leads — I found one clue that could solve this problem.

mandarin_meaning: 人脈；關係；聯繫
english_meaning: personal contacts; connections; network (used to get favors, jobs, or information)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指能提供幫助、資源或渠道的人際關係或聯繫，常用於討論找工作、辦事或取得特殊資源時。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term referring to personal contacts or connections that can be leveraged to obtain favors, jobs, information, or access.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你有線絡，搵份工會容易啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jau5 sin3 lok3, wan2 fan6 gung1 wui5 jung4 ji6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有人脈，找工作會容易一點。
examples.english_sentence: If you have connections, it's easier to find a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺政府度有線絡，事情辦得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zing3 fu2 dou6 jau5 sin3 lok3, si6 cing4 baan6 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在政府有人脈，事情辦得很快。
examples.english_sentence: He has contacts in the government; things get handled quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 毛衣；針織衫
english_meaning: sweater; knitted garment; knitwear
explanation_mandarin: 指以毛線或紗線編織成的上衣，用於保暖，常見如毛衣或針織衫。
explanation_english: A garment knitted from wool or yarn (knitwear), worn for warmth — e.g. a sweater or jumper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣轉涼，記得帶件線衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 zyun2 loeng4, gei3 dak1 daai3 gin6 sin3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天氣轉涼，記得帶件毛衣。
examples.english_sentence: The weather's getting cooler; remember to bring/wear a sweater.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗件新線衫，好啱佢著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 gin6 san1 sin3 saam1, hou2 aam1 keoi5 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她買了一件新毛衣，很適合他/她穿。
examples.english_sentence: He/She bought a new sweater; it fits him/her well.

mandarin_meaning: 線裝書（xiànzhuāngshū）
english_meaning: thread-bound book; traditional Chinese stitched-bound book
explanation_mandarin: 傳統的中式裝訂形式，使用線縫將冊頁裝訂在一起，多見於古籍和古典文獻。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese bookbinding method in which folded sheets are stitched together with thread; commonly used for classical texts and antique books.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本線裝書用傳統嘅線裝方法裝訂，好有古樸嘅味道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 sin3 zong1 syu1 jung6 cyun4 tung2 ge3 sin3 zong1 fong1 faat3 zong1 ding6, hou2 jau5 gu2 pok3 ge3 mei6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本線裝書是用傳統的線裝方法裝訂的，很有古樸的味道。
examples.english_sentence: This thread-bound book is bound using the traditional stitch-binding method and has a very antique charm.

mandarin_meaning: 線路；路線；電路；布線
english_meaning: line; route; circuit; wiring (e.g., railway line, electrical circuit)
explanation_mandarin: 「線路」可以指交通或運輸系統的路線（如鐵路線路、地鐵線路），也可以指電力或電子系統中的電路、布線。
explanation_english: “線路” refers to a route or line (such as a railway or subway line) and can also mean an electrical/electronic circuit or wiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 地鐵嗰條線路因故障暫停服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dei6 tit3 go2 tiu4 sin3 lou6 jan1 gu3 zong6 zaam6 ting4 fuk6 mou6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 地铁那条线路因故障暂停服务。
examples.english_sentence: That subway line is suspended due to a fault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電工檢查啲線路，搵出一個短路位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 gung1 gim2 caa4 di1 sin3 lou6 wan2 ceot1 jat1 go3 dyun2 lou6 wai2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电工检查线路，找出一个短路点。
examples.english_sentence: The electrician inspected the wiring and found a short circuit.

mandarin_meaning: 耍弄、欺騙（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: to fool, trick or mess someone around (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指耍弄或欺騙別人，可用於開玩笑或惡意欺騙的情況。主要在香港口語中使用。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to fool, trick or mess someone around. Can be used for playful teasing or malicious deception; primarily used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日線轆人，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 sin3 luk6 jan4, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天耍弄人，不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He always plays tricks on people; don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我俾人線轆咗五百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei2 jan4 sin3 luk6 zo2 ng5 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我被人骗了五百块。
examples.english_sentence: I was cheated out of five hundred dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，唔好俾人線轆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 sin3 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，不要被人耍弄。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful; don't let people fool you.

mandarin_meaning: 麵線（細長的麵條，常見於台灣或華人的湯麵小吃）
english_meaning: mee sua / thin wheat noodles (very fine, vermicelli-like noodles)
explanation_mandarin: 「線面」在廣東話中多為口語、俗稱，用來指細長、類似麵線的麵條（也常寫作「麵線/面線」）。在香港或粵語圈可能作非正式用法出現，實際標準寫法通常為「麵線」或「面線」。
explanation_english: “線面” is a colloquial Cantonese term referring to very thin wheat noodles (mee sua). It is a nonstandard/vernacular way to refer to 麵線 (mee sua), with the standard written forms being 麵線 or 面線.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚食線面定飯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 sik6 sin3 min6 ding6 faan6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚吃麵線還是飯？
examples.english_sentence: Are we having mee sua or rice tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話鍾意食線面配油蔥酥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zung1 ji3 sik6 sin3 min6 pui3 jau4 cung1 sou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常說喜歡吃麵線配油蔥酥。
examples.english_sentence: He often says he likes mee sua with fried shallots.

mandarin_meaning: 线头；（引申）线索、头绪、未了的尾巴
english_meaning: thread end; (figurative) loose end, lead/clue, unresolved detail
explanation_mandarin: 原义指布或线的末端；引申为事情的线索或头绪，或指未处理完、还有余留的问题（未了的尾巴）。
explanation_english: Literally the end of a thread; figuratively a lead or clue, a loose end, or an unresolved detail remaining in a matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫有條線頭，唔好拉出嚟，會散嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 jau5 tiu4 sin3 tau4, m4 hou2 laai1 ceot1 lai4, wui5 saan3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服有条线头，不要拉出来，会散的。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing has a loose thread; don't pull it — it will come apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方搵到個線頭，有機會追到疑犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 wan2 dou3 go3 sin3 tau4, jau5 gei1 wui6 zeoi1 dou3 ji4 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方找到一个线索，有机会追到疑犯。
examples.english_sentence: The police found a lead; they may be able to track down the suspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單案好複雜，暫時未有線頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 on3 hou2 fuk1 zaak6, zam6 si4 mei6 jau5 sin3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这宗案子很复杂，暂时没有线索。
examples.english_sentence: This case is complicated; there are no leads for now.

mandarin_meaning: 线香（烧香用的细长香棒）
english_meaning: incense stick; joss stick
explanation_mandarin: 一种细长的香棒，点燃后产生香烟，常用于宗教祭祀、拜神、祭祖或供奉等场合。
explanation_english: A thin stick of incense that releases fragrant smoke when burned; commonly used in religious offerings, ancestor worship, rituals, or for aromatic purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清明節嗰日，大家會去墳前燒線香，紀念祖先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ming4 zit3 go2 jat6, daai6 gaa1 wui5 heoi3 fan4 cin4 siu1 sin3 hoeng1, gei2 nim6 zou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清明节那天，大家会去墓前烧线香，祭拜祖先。
examples.english_sentence: On Qingming Festival, people go to the graves to burn incense sticks to honor their ancestors.

mandarin_meaning: 缉，逮捕、捉拿（嫌疑人）
english_meaning: to arrest; to apprehend; to capture
explanation_mandarin: “緝”常用於法律或警務語境，表示追捕、逮捕或捉拿犯罪嫌疑人或進行搜捕行動。
explanation_english: Used mainly in legal or police contexts to mean to apprehend, arrest, or capture suspects; often appears in compounds like '緝拿' or '緝捕'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方終於成功將嫌疑人緝拿歸案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 zoeng1 him2 ji4 jan4 zip1 naa4 gwai1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方終於成功將嫌疑人緝拿歸案。
examples.english_sentence: The police finally succeeded in apprehending the suspect and closing the case.

mandarin_meaning: 缉凶（追捕、逮捕兇手）
english_meaning: to hunt down/apprehend a killer; to pursue and capture a culprit
explanation_mandarin: 指追捕犯罪分子，特別是針對兇手或重大案件的嫌疑人以將其逮捕歸案。
explanation_english: Refers to pursuing and arresting criminals, especially killers or suspects in major cases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方正緝兇，呼籲市民提供線索。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zing3 zap1 hung1, fu1 jyu6 si5 man4 tai4 gung1 sin3 sok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方正在缉凶，呼吁市民提供线索。
examples.english_sentence: The police are hunting down the killer and are urging citizens to provide any clues.

mandarin_meaning: 缉拿；逮捕、捉拿（犯罪嫌疑人）
english_meaning: to arrest; to capture; to apprehend (a suspect)
explanation_mandarin: 指公安或执法机关追捕、逮捕犯罪嫌疑人或在逃人员的行动。
explanation_english: Refers to the action by police or law-enforcement authorities to pursue and arrest suspects or fugitives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方展開緝拿行動，拘捕多名疑犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zin2 hoi1 kap1 naa4 hang4 dung6, kau1 bou6 do1 ming4 ji4 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方展开缉拿行动，拘捕多名疑犯。
examples.english_sentence: The police launched an operation to apprehend suspects, arresting several of them.

mandarin_meaning: 缉捕；逮捕、缉拿嫌疑人或逃犯
english_meaning: to apprehend or capture; to hunt down and arrest suspects or fugitives
explanation_mandarin: 指追捕、逮拿犯罪嫌疑人或逃犯，通常用於警方或執法機關的行動。
explanation_english: Refers to pursuing and arresting criminals, suspects, or fugitives; typically used for police or law-enforcement actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方經過長時間調查，終於緝捕到主要嫌疑人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 ging1 gwo3 coeng4 si4 gaan3 diu6 caa4, zung1 jyu1 zap1 bou6 dou3 zyu2 jiu3 jim4 ji4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方经过长时间的调查，终于缉捕到主要嫌疑人。
examples.english_sentence: After a long investigation, the police finally apprehended the main suspect.

mandarin_meaning: 緝毒（缉拿、打擊販毒行為）
english_meaning: to crack down on drugs; to investigate and arrest drug traffickers
explanation_mandarin: 指警方或執法機關進行的打擊販毒、緝拿毒販的行動或工作。
explanation_english: Refers to police or law-enforcement actions aimed at combating drug trafficking and arresting drug dealers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方緝毒，搗破咗一個販毒集團。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 kap1 duk6, dou2 po3 zo2 jat1 go3 faan6 duk6 zaap6 tyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方緝毒，搗破了一個販毒集團。
examples.english_sentence: The police carried out an anti-drug operation and busted a drug trafficking ring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做緝毒警察好多年，經驗好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 kap1 duk6 ging2 caat3 hou2 do1 nin4, ging1 jim6 hou2 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他當了很多年緝毒警察，經驗很豐富。
examples.english_sentence: He has been an anti-narcotics officer for many years and has a lot of experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府加強緝毒行動，重點打擊走私毒品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gaa1 goeng3 kap1 duk6 hang4 dung6, zung6 dim2 daa2 gik1 zau2 si1 duk6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府加強緝毒行動，重點打擊走私毒品。
examples.english_sentence: The government has intensified anti-drug operations, focusing on cracking down on drug smuggling.

mandarin_meaning: 缉毒犬
english_meaning: narcotics detection dog; sniffer dog
explanation_mandarin: 指受過訓練、由警方或執法機構使用，用來嗅探並發現毒品的警犬。
explanation_english: A police or law-enforcement dog trained to detect narcotics by scent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方喺機場用緝毒犬嗅行李，搵出咗一啲可疑嘅毒品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 hai2 gei1 coeng4 jung6 zap1 duk6 hyun2 cau3 hang4 lei5, wan2 ceot1 zo2 jat1 di1 ho2 ji4 ge3 duk6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方在機場用緝毒犬嗅查行李，發現了一些可疑的毒品。
examples.english_sentence: The police used narcotics detection dogs to sniff luggage at the airport and found some suspicious drugs.

mandarin_meaning: 逮捕、繳獲（多用於警方或執法機關）
english_meaning: to apprehend/arrest and seize; to capture
explanation_mandarin: 「緝獲」常用於警方或執法情境，指緝拿、逮捕嫌疑人或查獲違法物品。
explanation_english: Used mainly in law-enforcement contexts; means to apprehend/arrest suspects or to seize contraband/evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察緝獲一名嫌疑人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 zap1 wok6 jat1 ming4 jim4 ji4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察逮捕了一名嫌疑人。
examples.english_sentence: The police apprehended a suspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行動中警方緝獲大量毒品及贓款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 dung6 zung1 ging2 fong4 zap1 wok6 daai6 loeng6 duk6 ban2 kap6 zong1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 行動中警方查獲大量毒品及贓款。
examples.english_sentence: During the operation the police seized a large quantity of drugs and illicit money.

mandarin_meaning: 缉私：查缉走私活动，没收走私货物并逮捕走私者。
english_meaning: to clamp down on smuggling; to investigate and suppress smuggling, seize contraband and arrest smugglers.
explanation_mandarin: 指查办走私活动，没收赃物并逮捕走私者，常用于海关或执法部门的行动描述。
explanation_english: Refers to investigating and suppressing smuggling activities—seizing contraband and apprehending smugglers; commonly used to describe customs or law-enforcement operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府加強緝私行動，查獲大量走私貨物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gaa1 koeng4 zap1 si1 hang4 dung6, caa4 wok6 daai6 loeng6 zau2 si1 fo3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府加強缉私行动，查获大量走私货物。
examples.english_sentence: The government stepped up anti-smuggling operations and seized a large quantity of smuggled goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 海關緝私部隊昨晚在港口截獲一船毒品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi2 gwaan1 zap1 si1 bou6 deoi6 zok6 maan5 zoi6 gong2 hau2 zit3 wok6 jat1 syun4 duk6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 海关缉私队昨晚在港口截获一船毒品。
examples.english_sentence: The customs anti-smuggling unit intercepted a ship carrying drugs at the port last night.

mandarin_meaning: 緞（缎）：一種光滑、有光澤的織物，常用於服裝和裝飾品
english_meaning: satin (a smooth, glossy fabric used for clothing and decorations)
explanation_mandarin: 緞指一種表面光滑、有光澤的織物（常稱為緞子），常用來做禮服、婚紗或裝飾用布料。
explanation_english: Refers to a smooth, glossy fabric (commonly called satin) often used for gowns, wedding dresses, and decorative textiles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件裙係用緞做嘅，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 kwan4 hai6 jung6 dyun6 zou6 ge3, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的裙子是用緞子做的，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Her skirt is made of satin; it's very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 缔（缔结）；建立、形成（常用于正式或书面语）
english_meaning: to conclude; to establish; to forge (formal, often used for agreements or achievements)
explanation_mandarin: 表示締結、建立或形成，常用於正式或書面語，例如「締結協議」「締造業績」。
explanation_english: A formal verb meaning to conclude, establish, or forge something (commonly used in written/formal contexts, e.g. conclude an agreement or create achievements).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經同對方締結咗合作協議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 tung4 deoi3 fong1 dai3 git3 zo2 hop6 zok3 hip3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已經與對方締結了合作協議。
examples.english_sentence: The company has already concluded a cooperation agreement with the other party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成功締造咗一個全新嘅品牌形象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 gung1 dai3 zou6 zo2 jat1 go3 cyun4 san1 ge3 ban1 paai4 jing4 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们成功缔造了一个全新的品牌形象。
examples.english_sentence: They successfully created a brand-new brand image.

mandarin_meaning: 締結同盟；結成盟約
english_meaning: to form or conclude an alliance; to enter into a pact or treaty
explanation_mandarin: 表示締結同盟或盟約，常用於正式或書面語，指兩方或多方建立政治、軍事或組織上的聯盟或合作關係。
explanation_english: Indicates forming or concluding an alliance or pact. It is mainly used in formal or written contexts to describe two or more parties establishing a political, military, or organizational alliance or cooperative relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩國決定締盟，對外共同合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gwok3 kyut3 ding6 dai3 mang4, deoi3 ngoi6 gung6 tung4 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 兩國決定締盟，對外共同合作。
examples.english_sentence: The two countries decided to form an alliance and cooperate externally.

mandarin_meaning: 订约；签订合同或条约
english_meaning: to sign/enter into a contract or treaty; to conclude an agreement
explanation_mandarin: 表示与对方签订合同、协议或条约，达成正式约定的行为或过程。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or process of concluding and signing a contract, agreement, or treaty between parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司同客戶締約咗，合作期係三年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 tung4 haak3 wu6 dai3 joek3 zo2, hap6 zok3 kei4 hai6 saam1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已与客户订约，合作期是三年。
examples.english_sentence: The company has signed a contract with the client; the partnership term is three years.

mandarin_meaning: 締造 (dìzào) — 創造、促成或鑄就某事物的發生或成就
english_meaning: to create; to bring into being; to bring about or forge (an achievement or result)
explanation_mandarin: 表示創造或促成某事物的發生或成就，常用於較正式或書面語，例如描述締造紀錄、締造機會等。
explanation_english: Indicates creating or bringing something into existence or achieving/bringing about a result. Commonly used in formal or written contexts (e.g., creating records, generating opportunities).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋締造咗一個奇蹟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dai3 zou6 zo2 jat1 go3 kei4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們締造了一個奇蹟。
examples.english_sentence: They created a miracle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目成功締造出大量就業機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 sing4 gung1 dai3 zou6 ceot1 daai6 loeng6 zau6 jip6 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個項目成功締造出大量就業機會。
examples.english_sentence: This project successfully created a large number of jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司致力締造卓越的品牌形象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zi3 lik6 dai3 zou6 coek3 jyut6 dik1 ban1 paai4 jing4 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司致力締造卓越的品牌形象。
examples.english_sentence: The company is committed to creating an outstanding brand image.

mandarin_meaning: （古）细丝；丝带（罕用）
english_meaning: a type of fine silk or silk ribbon (archaic/rare)
explanation_mandarin: 罕用漢字，指細緻的絲或絲帶，常見於古文或描述衣飾、裝飾的語境。
explanation_english: A rare/archaic character referring to a fine silk thread or silk ribbon, typically found in classical texts or descriptions of clothing and ornamentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時嘅戲服上面會用緡帶作裝飾，睇落好華麗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 ge3 hei3 fuk6 soeng6 min6 wui5 jung6 man4 daai3 zok3 zong1 sik1, tai2 lok6 hou2 waa4 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧时的戏服上会用緡带作装饰，看起来很华丽。
examples.english_sentence: Old theatrical costumes used to be decorated with '緡' ribbons, which looked very ornate.

mandarin_meaning: 缘；缘分、因缘、缘由或缘故
english_meaning: fate; predestined relationship; reason or cause (also edge/rim in some contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 表示人与人之间的缘分或机缘，也可指事情发生的缘由、缘故；在某些语境下可指事物的边缘。
explanation_english: Refers to fate or a predestined affinity between people; can also mean the reason or cause for something. In some contexts it may refer to an edge or rim.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋有緣再見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau5 jyun4 zoi3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们有缘再见。
examples.english_sentence: We'll meet again if fate allows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段緣份係天注定嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 jyun4 fan6 hai6 tin1 zyu3 ding6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段缘分是天注定的。
examples.english_sentence: This relationship is destined by fate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為啲緣故，佢冇嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 di1 jyun4 gu3, keoi5 mou5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为一些缘故，他没来。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't come because of some reasons.

mandarin_meaning: 缘分（指人与人之间由命运或因缘促成的相遇、关系）
english_meaning: fate; predestined relationship or affinity that brings people together
explanation_mandarin: 指人与人之间因机缘或命运而相遇、相识或结合的关系，常用于形容人与人之间的有缘或注定会相遇、相爱的情形。
explanation_english: Refers to the idea that meetings or relationships between people are caused by fate or destiny; often used to describe a predestined affinity, especially in romantic or meaningful encounters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋能夠相遇真係有緣份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 nang4 gau3 soeng1 jyu6 zan1 hai6 jau5 jyun4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们能够相遇真的是有缘分。
examples.english_sentence: It's really fate that we met.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果係緣份，遲啲可能會再見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 hai6 jyun4 fan6, ci4 di1 ho2 nang4 wui5 zoi3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果是缘分，迟一点可能会再见。
examples.english_sentence: If it's fate, we might meet again later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話係緣份，所以好快就拍咗拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 hai6 jyun4 fan6, so2 ji5 hou2 faai3 zau6 paak3 zo2 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说是缘分，所以很快就开始交往了。
examples.english_sentence: They said it was fate, so they started dating quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 緣分使人錯過見面（未能見上一面）
english_meaning: to miss the chance to meet someone because fate/timing prevented it
explanation_mandarin: 表示因為緣分、時機或種種原因而錯過與人見面的機會，未能見上一面。
explanation_english: Used to describe missing the opportunity to meet someone due to fate, timing, or circumstances — literally 'fate deprives (one of) a meeting'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋原本約好喺茶樓見面，點知最後緣慳一面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jyun4 bun2 joek3 hou2 hai2 caa4 lau4 gin3 min6, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 jyun4 haan1 jat1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們原本約好在茶樓見面，沒想到最後緣慳一面。
examples.english_sentence: We had planned to meet at the teahouse, but in the end we missed each other.

mandarin_meaning: 緣故 / 原因
english_meaning: reason; cause
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情發生的原因、緣由，常用於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the reason or cause of something; often used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由於種種緣故，佢冇辦法出席會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 jyu1 zung2 zung2 jyun4 gu3, keoi5 mou5 baan6 faat3 ceot1 zik1 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 由於種種緣故，他無法出席會議。
examples.english_sentence: Due to various reasons, he couldn't attend the meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 缘于 (yuányú) — 表示由于、起因于
english_meaning: to be due to; to stem from; originating from
explanation_mandarin: “緣於”用于书面语，表示某事的起因或来源，相当于“由於”“因为”。
explanation_english: A formal/written prepositional phrase indicating cause or origin; equivalent to 'due to' or 'owing to'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題緣於政策改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 jyun4 jyu1 zing3 caak3 goi2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题缘于政策改变。
examples.english_sentence: This problem stems from changes in policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成功緣於多年嘅努力同堅持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 gung1 jyun4 jyu1 do1 nin4 ge3 nou5 lik6 tung4 gin1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成功缘于多年的努力和坚持。
examples.english_sentence: His success is due to many years of effort and perseverance.

mandarin_meaning: 緣木求魚：比喻方法或方向不對，不能達到目的，徒勞無益。
english_meaning: To attempt the impossible or pursue a goal by the wrong method — a futile or self-defeating effort (literally: 'climb a tree to catch fish').
explanation_mandarin: 形容用錯誤的方法或走錯方向，無法達成目標，結果徒勞無功。
explanation_english: Describes using the wrong method or going in the wrong direction so that the goal cannot be achieved; a fruitless, ineffective effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做只係緣木求魚，根本唔會有用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zi2 hai6 jyun4 muk6 kau4 jyu4, gan1 bun2 m4 wui5 jau5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做只是緣木求魚，根本沒用。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is just like climbing a tree to catch fish — it's pointless.

mandarin_meaning: 緣由 / 原因
english_meaning: reason; cause
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情發生的原因或來由，較書面或正式用語。
explanation_english: Indicates the cause or origin of something; a somewhat formal or written term for 'reason'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以講下緣由？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 haa5 jyun4 jau4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以說說緣由嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you explain the reason?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 辭職嘅緣由已經寫咗喺信入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 zik1 ge3 jyun4 jau4 ji5 ging1 se2 zo2 hai2 seon3 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 辭職的緣由已經寫在信裡。
examples.english_sentence: The reasons for resigning are already written in the letter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇緣由就咁發脾氣唔係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 jyun4 jau4 zau6 gam2 faat3 pei4 hei3 m4 hai6 gam2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 沒有緣由就這樣發脾氣不好。
examples.english_sentence: It's not good to lose your temper for no reason.

mandarin_meaning: 始作俑者；禍首；挑起事端的人
english_meaning: instigator; ringleader; the person who starts trouble or a conflict
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話口語中，「緣首」常用來指挑起事端或引發衝突的人，即始作俑者或禍首。
explanation_english: '緣首' in Cantonese is commonly used to refer to someone who instigates trouble or provokes conflict — the instigator or ringleader.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做緣首，成日挑起事端。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 jyun4 sau2, sing4 jat6 tiu1 hei2 si6 dyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要當煽動者，總是挑起事端。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be the instigator and keep stirring up trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係今次衝突嘅緣首，大家要小心應付。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gam1 ci3 cung1 dat6 ge3 jyun4 sau2, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 jing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是這次衝突的始作俑者，大家要小心應對。
examples.english_sentence: He's the instigator of this clash; everyone should handle him carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 編（biān）：編輯、編寫、編造、編排、編織等
english_meaning: to compile/edit/assemble; to weave/knit; to make up (a story)
explanation_mandarin: 表示整理、編輯或編寫內容；也可指編造（虛構）或編織、編號等動作。
explanation_english: Used to indicate compiling, editing, or writing content; can also mean to fabricate (make up), to weave/knit, or to assign numbers/arrange.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責編呢本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6zaak3 pin1 ni1 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他負責編這本書。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for compiling/editing this book.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂編故仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 pin1 gu3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要亂編故事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make up stories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識編毛衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 pin1 mou4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我會編毛衣。
examples.english_sentence: I can knit sweaters.

mandarin_meaning: 编制 (biānzhì)：指单位经批准的人员编制、组织结构或名额；也可作动词，表示编排、制订或编撰。
english_meaning: Established staffing; authorized posts or organizational structure; (verb) to compile or draw up.
explanation_mandarin: 通常指單位或機構經批准的編制名額或組織構成；作動詞時則表示編排、制訂或編撰某項資料或表格。
explanation_english: Refers to the authorized number of staff positions or the organizational arrangement of an institution; as a verb, it means to compile, draw up, or organize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司冇多餘嘅編制，無法再請人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 mou5 do1 jyu4 ge3 pin1 zai3, mou4 faat3 zoi3 ceng2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司沒有多餘的編制，無法再聘請人員。
examples.english_sentence: The company doesn't have extra established positions and can't hire more people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於申請到編制，正式成為公務員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 san1 cing2 dou3 pin1 zai3, zing3 sik1 sing4 wai4 gung1 mou6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於申請到編制，正式成為公務員。
