examples.english_sentence: He finally obtained an established post and officially became a civil servant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 編制表顯示呢個部門有十個職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pin1 zai3 biu2 hin2 si6 ni1 go3 bou6 mun4 jau5 sap6 go3 zik1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 編制表顯示這個部門有十個職位。
examples.english_sentence: The staffing table shows this department has ten positions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告係由一個小組編制嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 hai6 jau4 jat1 go3 siu2 zou2 pin1 zai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份報告是由一個小組編制的。
examples.english_sentence: This report was compiled by a small team.

mandarin_meaning: 编剧 (biān jù)
english_meaning: screenwriter; playwright; scriptwriter; to write scripts
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 指負責創作或撰寫劇本的人（如電視劇、電影、舞台劇等），亦可作動詞使用，表示編寫劇本的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who writes scripts (for TV, film, theater, etc.). It can also be used as a verb meaning to write or draft a script.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係專業編劇，寫過好幾套電視劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zyun1 jip6 pin1 kek6, se2 gwo3 hou2 gei2 tou3 din6 si6 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是专业编剧，写过好几部电视剧。
examples.english_sentence: He is a professional screenwriter and has written several TV dramas.

mandarin_meaning: 编印（编辑整理并印刷或出版）
english_meaning: to compile/edit and print; to edit and publish
explanation_mandarin: 指將資料或稿件經過編輯、整理後進行印刷或出版的動作或工作。
explanation_english: Refers to the action or task of editing/compiling material and then printing or publishing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺週末完成呢本手冊嘅編印工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 zau1 mut6 jyun4 sing4 ni1 bun2 sau2 caak3 ge3 bin1 jan3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在周末完成这本手册的编印工作。
examples.english_sentence: We need to finish the compilation and printing of this manual by the weekend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告已經編印好，今日派畀各部門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ji5 ging1 bin1 jan3 hou2, gam1 jat6 paai3 bei2 gok3 bou6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告已经编印好，今天派给各部门。
examples.english_sentence: This report has been compiled and printed and will be distributed to each department today.

mandarin_meaning: 编写 (biānxiě)
english_meaning: to write; to compose; to compile (text, code, documents)
explanation_mandarin: 编写：撰写或编制文字、程序、文档等，常用于书面或技术领域，如编写说明书、编写程式。
explanation_english: To write, compose, or compile texts, code, or documents. Commonly used for formal, technical, or written works (e.g., writing manuals or code).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要編寫一份使用說明書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 bin1 se2 jat1 fan6 si6 jung6 syut3 ming4 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要编写一份使用说明书。
examples.english_sentence: We need to write a user manual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責編寫程式碼，同時要做測試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 bin1 se2 cing4 sik1 maa5, tung4 si4 jiu3 zou6 cak1 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责编写程序代码，同时要做测试。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for writing the program code and also needs to do testing.

mandarin_meaning: 編導（指在影視或舞台領域負責編寫劇本與指導演出的人或動作）
english_meaning: scriptwriter/director; to script and direct (in film, TV, or theatre)
explanation_mandarin: 在影視或舞台領域，指負責編寫劇本與指導演出的工作或擔任此工作的人；也可作動詞，表示從事編寫與導演的行為。
explanation_english: In film, television, or theatre contexts, refers to the role of writing the script and directing the production, or a person who performs that role; can also be used as a verb meaning to script and direct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影嘅編導好有才華。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 ge3 bin1 dou6 hou2 jau5 coi4 waa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電影的編導很有才華。
examples.english_sentence: The film's director/scriptwriter is very talented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責編導呢個舞台劇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 bin1 dou6 ni1 go3 mou5 toi4 kek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他負責編導這齣舞台劇。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for scripting and directing this stage play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學主修編導。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 zyu2 sau1 bin1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大學主修編導。
examples.english_sentence: He majored in directing/scriptwriting at university.

mandarin_meaning: 编年史（按年代顺序记录历史事件的史书或记录）
english_meaning: chronicle; annals (a record of events arranged in chronological order)
explanation_mandarin: 指以年為序，逐年記載歷史事件的書籍或記錄，強調時間順序與事件的連貫性。
explanation_english: A work or record that documents historical events arranged year by year; emphasizes chronological order and continuity of events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係一部詳盡嘅編年史，記載咗嗰段時期嘅重要事件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 jat1 bou6 coeng4 zeon6 ge3 pin1 nin4 si2, gei3 zoi6 zo2 go2 dyun6 si4 kei4 ge3 zung6 jiu3 si6 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书是一部详尽的编年史，记载了那段时期的重要事件。
examples.english_sentence: This book is a detailed chronicle that records the major events of that period.

mandarin_meaning: 編排（biānpái）：對節目、文章、表演等的內容進行安排、組織或排序；也可指為演出等進行設計安排。
english_meaning: to arrange or organize the components of a program, text, performance, etc.; to schedule or stage (a performance); arrangement.
explanation_mandarin: 指把節目、文章、舞台或活動等的各個部分理順、安排成一定的順序或形式，以達到預期效果。
explanation_english: To put the parts of a program, text, performance, or event into order or design their sequence/form; to organize or schedule elements so they work together effectively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電視台會喺下星期編排一個新嘅晚間節目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 si6 toi4 wui5 hai2 haa6 sing1 kei4 bin1 paai4 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 maan5 gaan1 zit3 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電視台會在下星期編排一個新的晚間節目。
examples.english_sentence: The TV station will schedule/arrange a new evening program next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次舞台劇嘅導演負責編排演員嘅走位同燈光效果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 mou5 toi4 kek6 ge3 dou6 jin2 fu6 zaak3 bin1 paai4 jin2 jyun4 ge3 zau2 wai6 tung4 dang1 gwong1 haau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次舞台劇的導演負責編排演員的走位和燈光效果。
examples.english_sentence: The director of this stage play is responsible for arranging the actors' blocking and the lighting effects.

mandarin_meaning: 编撰（编写、撰写、编辑资料或著作）
english_meaning: to compile and write; to compose; to edit and assemble written material
explanation_mandarin: 指整理、編寫或撰寫資料、文章或著作，常用於學術、出版或教材的編輯工作。
explanation_english: Refers to compiling and writing material—assembling, composing or editing texts or documents; commonly used for academic, publishing, or instructional work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係佢親自編撰嘅，內容好詳盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 keoi5 can1 zi6 pin1 zyun2 ge3, noi6 jung4 hou2 coeng4 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書是他親自編撰的，內容很詳盡。
examples.english_sentence: This book was personally compiled by him; the content is very detailed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要搵專家嚟編撰教學材料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 wan2 zyun1 gaa1 lai4 pin1 zyun2 gaau3 hok6 coi4 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們需要找專家來編撰教學材料。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find experts to compile the teaching materials.

mandarin_meaning: 编曲（为歌曲或乐曲设计、安排乐器、和声、节奏等）
english_meaning: arrangement (in music); to arrange music
explanation_mandarin: 在音樂領域中，指為一首歌或樂曲設計並安排各種樂器、和聲、節奏與結構等，使作品達到預期的音樂效果；亦可指已完成的編排作品（編曲）。
explanation_english: In music, the process of designing and organizing instruments, harmonies, rhythms, and structure for a song or piece; can also refer to the finished musical arrangement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅編曲好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 bin1 kuk1 hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的编曲很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: The arrangement of this song is very distinctive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我負責今次專輯嘅編曲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fu6 zaak3 gam1 ci3 zyun1 zap1 ge3 bin1 kuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我负责这次专辑的编曲。
examples.english_sentence: I'm responsible for the arrangements on this album.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫首歌編曲，編得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 sau2 go1 bin1 kuk1, bin1 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为这首歌做了编曲，编得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He arranged the song very well.

mandarin_meaning: 编造 / 分派
english_meaning: to make up (a story/excuse) / to assign or allocate (people/resources)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，常見兩種意思：1) 編造、虛構（如藉口、故事）；2) 編配、分派人員或資源到不同崗位或地方。
explanation_english: A colloquial verb with two common uses: 1) to fabricate or make up (e.g., excuses or stories); 2) to assign or allocate people or resources to posts or places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日編派唔同嘅理由嚟敷衍我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bin1 paai3 m4 tung4 ge3 lei5 jau4 lei4 lai4 fu1 jin5 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是編造不同的理由來敷衍我。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes up different excuses to brush me off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司編派咗幾個新人去分店幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bin1 paai3 zo2 gei2 go3 san1 jan4 heoi3 fan1 dim3 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司把幾個新員工編派到分店幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: The company assigned several new hires to help out at the branch.

mandarin_meaning: 编码 (biān mǎ)：对信息或数据进行编码的过程或表示
english_meaning: encoding; to encode; code
explanation_mandarin: 指按照一定的规则将信息或数据转换为另一种表示形式的过程或结果，例如字符编码或数据编码。
explanation_english: The process or result of transforming information or data into another representation according to a set of rules (e.g., character encoding, data encoding). Can be used as a verb ('to encode') or noun ('an encoding').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個檔案係用 UTF-8 編碼嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dong2 on3 hai6 jung6 UTF-8 pin1 maa5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个文件是用 UTF-8 编码的。
examples.english_sentence: This file is encoded in UTF-8.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以幫我編碼呢個訊息嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 pin1 maa5 ni1 go3 seon3 sik1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以帮我把这个讯息编码吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you encode this message for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要遵守相同嘅編碼標準，先至可以互通資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon1 sau2 soeng1 tung4 ge3 pin1 maa5 biu1 zeon2, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 wu6 tung1 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要遵守相同的编码标准，才能互通资料。
examples.english_sentence: We need to follow the same encoding standards before we can exchange data.

mandarin_meaning: 编程（写计算机程序/程序设计）
english_meaning: programming; to program (computers)
explanation_mandarin: 指编写计算机程序或从事程序设计的行为，也可作为名词表示这一领域或活动（即“编程”）。
explanation_english: The activity of writing computer programs (programming). Can be used as a verb (to program) or as a noun (programming as a field/activity).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近學緊編程，想整一個手機應用程式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hok6 gan2 pin1 cing4, soeng2 zing2 jat1 go3 sau2 gei1 jing3 jung6 cing4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近在学编程，想做一个手机应用程序。
examples.english_sentence: I've been learning programming recently and want to build a mobile app.

mandarin_meaning: 编织
english_meaning: to weave; to knit; to interweave; to fabricate (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用線、布等交織成布料或服飾；也可比喻把事情、情節、關係等縝密地安排或編排，有時也指編造（如編織謊言）。
explanation_english: To weave or knit fibers into fabric or garments; figuratively, to interweave or construct things such as stories, relationships, or circumstances (sometimes meaning to fabricate, as in 'weaving lies').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用毛線編織咗一件毛衣畀個女兒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 mou4 sin3 pin1 zik1 zo2 jat1 gin6 mou4 ji1 bei2 go3 neoi5 ji4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用毛线为女儿织了一件毛衣。
examples.english_sentence: He knitted a sweater for his daughter using yarn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺網上編織謊言好容易傷害到人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 mong5 soeng6 pin1 zik1 fong2 jin4 hou2 jung4 ji6 soeng1 hoi6 dou3 jan4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在网上编造谎言很容易伤害别人。
examples.english_sentence: It's easy to harm others by weaving/fabricating lies online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段經歷將佢哋嘅命運編織埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 ging1 lik6 zoeng1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ming6 wan6 pin1 zik1 maai4 jat1 cai4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這段經歷把他們的命運編織在一起。
examples.english_sentence: This experience wove their destinies together.

mandarin_meaning: 編纂：編輯、整理並彙集文獻或資料，將資料編成書或匯編
english_meaning: to compile; to edit and compile texts or documents into a collection/publication
explanation_mandarin: 指將各種資料、文獻或史料整理、編輯並匯集成書或彙編的行為，常用於學術、史書或資料集的編製。
explanation_english: Refers to organizing, editing, and assembling various materials, documents, or historical records into a book or compilation; commonly used for scholarly works, histories, or collected volumes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責編纂呢本歷史書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 bin1 zyun2 ni1 bun2 lik6 si2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他負責編纂這本歷史書。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for compiling/editing this history book.

mandarin_meaning: 编者（负责编辑或编撰文章、书籍等的人）
english_meaning: editor; the person who edits, compiles, or is responsible for content in a publication
explanation_mandarin: 指负责整理、编辑或审定文章、书籍或出版物内容的人，常用于出版物署名或提示中。
explanation_english: Refers to the person responsible for compiling, editing, or approving articles, books, or other publications; commonly used in bylines or editorial notes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章係由編者寫嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 hai6 jau4 pin1 ze2 se2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章是由编者撰写的。
examples.english_sentence: This article was written by the editor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果對內容有疑問，請聯絡編者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 deoi3 noi6 jung4 jau5 ji4 man6, ceng2 lyun4 lok3 pin1 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果对内容有疑问，请联系编者。
examples.english_sentence: If you have questions about the content, please contact the editor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 編者按：下列資料僅供參考。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pin1 ze2 on3: haa6 lit6 zi1 liu2 gan2 gung1 saam1 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 编者按：下列资料仅供参考。
examples.english_sentence: Editor's note: The following information is for reference only.

mandarin_meaning: 编号
english_meaning: serial number; identification number
explanation_mandarin: 表示用來識別或排序的編號或序號，常用於文件、會員、產品等標示。
explanation_english: A number used for identification or ordering, commonly used to label documents, memberships, products, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請問你嘅會員編號係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 man6 nei5 ge3 wui6 jyun4 bin1 hou6 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问你的会员编号是多少？
examples.english_sentence: May I ask what your membership number is?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份表格要填上你嘅編號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 jiu3 tin4 soeng5 nei5 ge3 bin1 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份表格需要填写你的编号。
examples.english_sentence: This form requires you to fill in your number.

mandarin_meaning: 编制（biānzhì）：编写、制定或设定组织结构与人员名额；也指机构的编制、编制名额
english_meaning: To compile/formulate; to set up an organizational structure or staffing establishment; also the staffing/authorized posts themselves
explanation_mandarin: 指編寫、製作或制訂某些文件、制度或設定組織與人員的配置；在行政或人事上也常用來表示正式的編制名額。
explanation_english: Refers to compiling or formulating documents or procedures, or establishing an organizational structure and allocation of personnel; in administrative contexts it also denotes the official staffing establishment or authorized posts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司依家要按新預算調整員工編制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji1 gaa1 jiu3 on3 san1 jyu6 syun3 tiu4 zing2 yun4 gung1 bin1 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司现在要根据新预算调整员工编制。
examples.english_sentence: The company now needs to adjust the staff establishment according to the new budget.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告係講點樣編製流程文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 hai6 gong2 dim2 joeng6 bin1 zai3 lau4 cing4 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告是讲如何编制流程文件。
examples.english_sentence: This report explains how to compile process documents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府部門嘅編制有限，未必可以即刻加人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 bou6 mun4 ge3 bin1 zai3 jau5 han6, mei6 bat1 ho2 ji5 zik1 hak1 gaa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府部门的编制有限，未必可以立即增加人手。
examples.english_sentence: Government departments have limited staffing establishments, so they may not be able to add personnel immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 編訂（編撰並確定、制定或修訂內容）
english_meaning: to compile and finalize; to edit and set/formulate (a document, plan, regulation, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指把材料整理、編撰或修訂，並確定最終內容或方案，例如編訂計劃、教科書或規章。
explanation_english: Refers to compiling, editing, or revising material and finalizing the content or a plan—for example, compiling a plan, textbook, or regulations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺下星期之前編訂本年度嘅工作計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 haa6 sing1 kei4 zi1 cin4 bin1 ding6 bun2 nin4 dou6 ge3 gung1 zok3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要在下星期之前編訂本年度的工作計劃。
examples.english_sentence: We need to finalize this year's work plan before next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責編訂教科書嘅內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 bin1 ding6 gaau3 fo1 syu1 ge3 noi6 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他負責編訂教科書的內容。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for compiling/editing the textbook content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市政府需要編訂新嘅交通規例。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zing3 fu2 seoi1 jiu3 bin1 ding6 san1 ge3 gaau1 tung1 kwai1 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市政府需要編訂新的交通規例。
examples.english_sentence: The city government needs to draw up new traffic regulations.

mandarin_meaning: 编辑 (biānjí)
english_meaning: edit; editor; compile
explanation_mandarin: 表示整理、修改或編排文字、影像等內容的動作；也可指從事此工作的職位或人員（編輯）。
explanation_english: Refers to the action of organizing, modifying, or arranging text, images, or video; it can also mean the person or role that performs this work (editor).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢本雜誌嘅編輯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 bun2 zaap6 zi2 ge3 pin1 zap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是這本雜誌的編輯。
examples.english_sentence: He is the editor of this magazine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要花多啲時間編輯呢段片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 faa1 do1 di1 si4 gaan3 pin1 zap1 ni1 dyun6 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要花更多時間編輯這段影片。
examples.english_sentence: I need to spend more time editing this video.

mandarin_meaning: 编造（捏造、虚构）
english_meaning: to fabricate; to make up (stories, facts, data)
explanation_mandarin: 編造指憑空捏造或偽造事實、故事、資料或證據，通常帶有欺騙性。
explanation_english: To fabricate or concoct something that is not true—e.g., inventing stories, falsifying data or evidence—usually with intent to deceive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢編造咗個謊話去掩飾罪行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bin1 zou6 zo2 go3 fong2 waa6 heoi3 jim2 sik1 zeoi6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他編造了謊言來掩飾罪行。
examples.english_sentence: He fabricated a lie to cover up the crime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新聞報道唔好隨便編造事實，記者應該求證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 man4 bou3 dou6 m4 hou2 ceoi4 bin6 bin1 zou6 si6 sat6, gei3 ze2 jing1 goi1 kau4 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新聞報導不應隨便編造事實，記者應該求證。
examples.english_sentence: News reports should not fabricate facts; journalists should verify.

mandarin_meaning: 编配（分配、安排人员、任务或资源）
english_meaning: to assign; to allocate; to arrange (personnel, tasks, resources)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把人員、任務或資源按照需要分派或安排到適當位置或用途。
explanation_english: To distribute or assign people, tasks, or resources to appropriate positions or purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司編配咗啲人手去支援個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 pin1 pui3 zo2 di1 jan4 sau2 heoi3 zi1 wun6 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已經編配了人手去支援這個項目。
examples.english_sentence: The company has assigned staff to support this project.

mandarin_meaning: 缓、缓慢；（使）缓和、缓解
english_meaning: slow; to slow down; to ease or alleviate
explanation_mandarin: 表示速度慢、延緩，或使某種狀態變得較為和緩、減輕。
explanation_english: Indicates slowness or delay, or to make a situation less severe / to ease or alleviate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 病情有緩和嘅跡象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: beng6 cing4 jau5 wun6 wo4 ge3 zik1 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 病情有缓和的迹象。
examples.english_sentence: The condition shows signs of easing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程可以暫時緩一緩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 ho2 ji5 zaam6 si4 wun6 jat1 wun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程可以暂时缓一缓。
examples.english_sentence: We can postpone this project temporarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 車速要緩慢行駛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1 cuk1 jiu3 wun6 maan6 hang4 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车速要缓慢行驶。
examples.english_sentence: Drive at a slow speed.

mandarin_meaning: 缓兵之计；拖延战术，用以争取时间或改变不利局面。
english_meaning: A delaying tactic or stratagem used to buy time, stall the opponent, or alter an unfavorable situation.
explanation_mandarin: 指为了争取时间、拖延对方或缓和情势而采用的计策，不直接正面交锋，常用于军事、谈判或战略场合。
explanation_english: Refers to a strategy employed to buy time or delay an opponent instead of engaging directly; commonly used in military, negotiation, or strategic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對對手嘅攻勢，我哋要諗下緩兵之計，唔好即刻硬碰硬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 deoi3 sau2 ge3 gung1 sai3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nam2 haa5 wun6 bing1 zi1 gai3, m4 hou2 zik1 hak1 ngaang6 pung3 ngaang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对对手的攻势，我们要想想缓兵之计，不要立刻硬碰硬。
examples.english_sentence: Facing the opponent's attack, we should think of a delaying tactic instead of confronting them head-on immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 缓刑
english_meaning: suspended sentence / probation
explanation_mandarin: 法院對被告判處刑罰但暫不立即執行，在一定觀察或考驗期間內如遵守法定條件且無再犯，則不實際執行原判刑罰；若再犯則可能啟動執行。
explanation_english: A court-imposed sentence that is not enforced immediately. The offender is released under conditions for a suspension (probation) period; if they comply and do not reoffend, the sentence is not carried out. If they breach conditions or reoffend, the original sentence may be enforced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為犯咗罪，法官判佢緩刑兩年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 faan6 zo2 zeoi6, faat3gwaan1 pun3 keoi5 waan6 heng4 loeng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為犯罪，法官判他緩刑兩年。
examples.english_sentence: He was given a two-year suspended sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果喺緩刑期內再犯法，之前嘅刑罰就會被執行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4gwo2 hai2 waan6 heng4 kei4 noi6 zoi3 faat3faat3, zi1cin4 ge3 jing4faat3 zau6 wui5 bei6 zap1hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果在緩刑期內再犯罪，之前的刑罰就會被執行。
examples.english_sentence: If you commit another crime during the probationary period, the previous sentence will be enforced.

mandarin_meaning: 缓和 (huǎnhé)：使紧张、冲突或情况变得较不严重或缓和；也可指减轻症状
english_meaning: to ease; to soften; to alleviate; to moderate (tensions, conditions, pain, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示使緊張、衝突或不良狀況變得較為溫和或減輕，也可用於描述減輕疼痛或症狀。
explanation_english: Indicates making something less severe, tense, or intense; to ease or alleviate a condition (e.g., tensions, pain, symptoms).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘗試用外交手段緩和兩國之間嘅緊張關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 soeng4 si3 jung6 ngoi6 gaau1 sau2 dyun6 wun6 wo4 loeng5 gwok3 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gan2 zoeng1 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府尝试用外交手段缓和两国之间的紧张关系。
examples.english_sentence: The government tried to use diplomatic means to ease the tense relationship between the two countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種藥可以緩和痛症，但唔可以完全代替治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 joek6 ho2 ji5 wun6 wo4 tung3 zing3, daan6 m4 ho2 ji5 jyun4 cyun4 doi6 tai3 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种药可以缓和疼痛，但不能完全取代治疗。
examples.english_sentence: This medicine can alleviate pain, but cannot completely replace treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 緩急；事情的緊急程度、輕重緩急
english_meaning: urgency; the degree of urgency or priority
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情的緊急程度或輕重緩急，常用來說明處理事情的先後次序與優先性。
explanation_english: Indicates the degree of urgency or the relative priority of matters; often used to describe the order in which things should be handled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要先分清事情嘅緩急，先安排人手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 fan1 cing1 si6 cing4 ge3 wun6 gap1, sin1 ngon1 paai4 jan4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要先分清事情的緩急，才能安排人手。
examples.english_sentence: We need to first determine the urgency of the matters before arranging manpower.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事嘅緩急唔高，唔使咁急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 wun6 gap1 m4 gou1, m4 sai2 gam2 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事的緩急不高，不需要那麼急。
examples.english_sentence: This matter isn't very urgent; there's no need to rush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要識得分清輕重緩急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 sik1 dak1 fan1 cing1 hing1 zung6 wun6 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做事要懂得分清輕重緩急。
examples.english_sentence: When working, you should know how to distinguish what's important and urgent.

mandarin_meaning: 缓慢 (huǎnmàn) — 速度慢、不迅速
english_meaning: slow; sluggish; not rapid
explanation_mandarin: 表示動作、變化或進展的速度很慢、不迅速，常用於書面或正式語境。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action, change, or progress is slow and not rapid; often used in more formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行得好緩慢，趕唔切大家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 dak1 hou2 waan6 maan6, gon2 m4 cit3 daai6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走得很缓慢，追不上大家。
examples.english_sentence: He walks very slowly and can't keep up with everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話反應好緩慢，要重開先快啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 faan2 jing3 hou2 waan6 maan6, jiu3 cung4 hoi1 sin1 faai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手機反應很缓慢，要重啟才會快一點。
examples.english_sentence: The phone's response is very slow; restart it to make it a bit faster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學習語言需要耐性，進步通常比較緩慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 zaap6 jyu5 jin4 seoi1 jiu3 noi6 sing3, zeon3 bou6 tung1 soeng4 bei2 gaau3 waan6 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學習語言需要耐心，進步通常比較緩慢。
examples.english_sentence: Learning a language requires patience; progress is usually relatively slow.

mandarin_meaning: 缓步（慢慢走、缓慢行走）
english_meaning: to walk slowly; a slow, leisurely pace; to stroll
explanation_mandarin: 「緩步」常用於書面或較正式的語境，表示以緩慢、從容的步伐行走，也可指慢速前進的步態。
explanation_english: A somewhat formal or literary term meaning to walk slowly or to proceed at a leisurely, slow pace; used as a verb (or to describe a slow gait).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺海邊緩步而行，望住海景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hoi2 bin1 waan6 bou6 ji4 hang4, mong6 zyu6 hoi2 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在海边缓步而行，望着海景。
examples.english_sentence: He was strolling slowly along the seafront, gazing at the sea view.

mandarin_meaning: 步行代替乘車（用走路代替坐車）
english_meaning: to walk instead of taking a vehicle; to go on foot rather than be driven
explanation_mandarin: 指以步行代替乘坐車輛，常含有謙遜、節儉或順路、享受步行的意味。
explanation_english: Means to walk in place of taking a vehicle. It often implies modesty, frugality, convenience, or simply choosing to enjoy walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣咁好，不如我哋緩步代車，慢慢行去海邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 gam2 hou2, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 waan6 bou6 doi6 ce1, maan6 maan6 haang4 heoi3 hoi2 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天氣這麼好，不如我們緩步代車，慢慢走去海邊。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is so nice today; why don't we walk instead of taking a car and slowly go to the beach?

mandarin_meaning: 緩步當車（huǎnbù dàngchē）
english_meaning: to dawdle; to proceed very slowly
explanation_mandarin: 形容行動遲緩、拖延不快，像把步行當成坐車般慢吞吞。
explanation_english: Describes acting or moving very slowly and leisurely, as if treating walking like riding in a carriage — i.e., dawdling or delaying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次佢做嘢緩步當車，結果錯過咗機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 keoi5 zou6 je5 waan6 bou6 dong3 ce1, git3 gwo2 co3 gwo3 zo2 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次他做事拖拖拉拉，結果錯過了機會。
examples.english_sentence: Last time he dawdled in his work and ended up missing the opportunity.

mandarin_meaning: 缓冲
english_meaning: buffer; cushioning; to buffer
explanation_mandarin: 指用來吸收衝擊或減少影響的緩和措施或裝置；也可指預留以避免影響的時間或空間。
explanation_english: Refers to a buffer or cushioning used to absorb shocks or reduce impact; can also mean reserved time or space to prevent adverse effects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋預留多啲緩衝時間，避免延誤影響行程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jyu6 lau4 do1 di1 waan6 cung1 si4 gaan3, bei6 min5 jin4 ng6 jing2 hoeng2 hang4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们预留更多缓冲时间，避免延误影响行程。
examples.english_sentence: We left extra buffer time to avoid delays affecting the schedule.

mandarin_meaning: 慢跑道；供人慢跑或輕鬆跑步的步道
english_meaning: jogging path; a path designated for jogging or light running
explanation_mandarin: 指公園、社區等地方專為慢跑或健身而設的步道或小跑道，通常鋪有適合跑步的路面或有標示距離。
explanation_english: A path typically in parks or residential areas intended for jogging or light running, often surfaced or marked for runners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鐘意喺公園嘅緩跑徑慢跑，感覺好放鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 gung1 jyun4 ge3 waan6 paau2 ging3 maan6 paau2, gam2 gok3 hou2 fong3 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡在公園的慢跑徑慢跑，感覺很放鬆。
examples.english_sentence: I like to jog on the park's jogging path; it feels very relaxing.

mandarin_meaning: 缅（如：缅甸）；缅怀（怀念、追忆）
english_meaning: Myanmar (short form); to remember/cherish the memory of (in compounds like '緬懷')
explanation_mandarin: 「緬」常用於地名「緬甸」表示國名；在詞語「緬懷」中表示懷念、追憶之意。
explanation_english: The character is used as the short form in the country name 'Myanmar' and appears in compounds like '緬懷' meaning to remember or cherish the memory of someone. It can function as a noun or part of a verbal compound depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 緬甸係一個東南亞嘅國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min5 din1 hai6 jat1 go3 dung1 naam4 aa3 ge3 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 缅甸是一个东南亚的国家。
examples.english_sentence: Myanmar is a Southeast Asian country.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每逢清明，我都會緬懷祖先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 fung4 cing1 ming4, ngo5 dou1 wui5 min5 waai4 zou2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每逢清明，我都会缅怀祖先。
examples.english_sentence: I always remember/commemorate my ancestors during Qingming.

mandarin_meaning: 缅怀 (miǎn huái)：缅怀、怀念、追忆
english_meaning: to cherish the memory of; to recollect fondly; to commemorate
explanation_mandarin: 表示追忆或怀念（逝去的人或过去的事情），多用于书面或正式语境。
explanation_english: Expresses remembering with respect or nostalgia (for deceased people or past events); commonly used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年清明我哋都會去墳場緬懷先人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 nin4 cing1 ming4 ngo5 dei6 dou1 wui5 heoi3 fan4 coeng4 min5 waai4 sin1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年清明我们都会去墓地缅怀先人。
examples.english_sentence: Every year during Qingming we go to the cemetery to commemorate our ancestors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家緬懷佢對社區嘅貢獻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 min5 waai4 keoi5 deoi3 se5 keoi1 ge3 gung3 hin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家缅怀他对社区的贡献。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone commemorates his contributions to the community.

mandarin_meaning: 缅甸（國名）
english_meaning: Myanmar (country name; formerly Burma)
explanation_mandarin: 位於東南亞的國家，官方英文名為 Myanmar（緬甸），曾被稱為「緬甸／緬甸邦」，首都是內比都，與中國、泰國、老撾、孟加拉和印度接壤。
explanation_english: A country in Southeast Asia, officially known in English as Myanmar (formerly Burma). Its capital is Naypyidaw. It borders China, Thailand, Laos, Bangladesh and India.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去緬甸旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 min5 din6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去缅甸旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Myanmar next month.

mandarin_meaning: 緯（wěi）：1) 織物中與經相對的緯線（橫向的線）；2) 指緯度；3) 常用於合成詞如「經緯」，指事情的來龍去脈或細節。
english_meaning: wei: 1) the weft (crosswise threads) in weaving; 2) latitude (geographical); 3) used in compounds (e.g., "經緯") to mean the ins and outs or detailed aspects of something.
explanation_mandarin: 「緯」主要作名詞使用，可指織物的橫向線（緯線）、地理上的緯度，或出現在合成詞中表示事物的細節與來龍去脈。
explanation_english: The character "緯" is primarily a noun meaning the weft threads in weaving, the geographic latitude, and appears in compounds to denote the details or ins-and-outs of a matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊布嘅緯線好密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 bou3 ge3 wai4 sin3 hou2 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊布的緯線很密。
examples.english_sentence: The weft threads of this fabric are very dense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅緯度大約係二十二度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 wai4 dou6 daai6 joek3 hai6 ji6 sap6 ji6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的緯度大約是二十二度。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's latitude is about 22 degrees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔清楚件事嘅經緯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 ge3 ging1 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不清楚這件事的經緯。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not clear about the ins and outs of this matter.

mandarin_meaning: 纬度
english_meaning: latitude
explanation_mandarin: 表示地理上的緯度，指以赤道為基準測量南北位置的角度，通常以度數表示。
explanation_english: The geographic coordinate that measures a location's north–south position relative to the equator, usually expressed in degrees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個城市嘅緯度大約係三十七度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sing4 si5 ge3 wai5 dou6 daai6 joek3 hai6 saam1 sap6 cat1 dou6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个城市的纬度大约是三十七度。
examples.english_sentence: The latitude of this city is about 37 degrees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 緯度會影響一個地方嘅氣候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai5 dou6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 jat1 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 hei3 hau3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 纬度会影响一个地方的气候。
examples.english_sentence: Latitude affects the climate of a place.

mandarin_meaning: （古）渺小、模糊、遙遠；同「缈/渺」
english_meaning: vague; indistinct; distant (literary/classical)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物不清楚、模糊或遙遠，多見於書面語或文言用法。
explanation_english: Denotes something vague, indistinct, or distant; mainly used in literary or classical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對以前嗰段經歷嘅記憶好緲，無咩細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ji5 cin4 go2 dyun6 ging1 lik6 ge3 gei3 jik1 hou2 miu5, mou5 me1 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對以前那段經歷的記憶很模糊，沒有什麼細節。
examples.english_sentence: His memory of that period is very vague and lacks many details.

mandarin_meaning: 练（liàn）：练习、锻炼
english_meaning: to practice; to train; to drill; (archaic) to refine or purify
explanation_mandarin: 表示反覆练习或锻炼，以提高技能或熟练度；在某些文言或特定語境下可作“提炼、纯化”之意。
explanation_english: Indicates practicing or training repeatedly to improve skill or proficiency. In some archaic or special contexts it can mean to refine or purify.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都練吉他半個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 lin6 gat1 taa1 bun3 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都练吉他半个小时。
examples.english_sentence: I practice guitar for half an hour every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺琴行練琴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 kam4 hong4 lin6 kam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在琴行练琴。
examples.english_sentence: He often practices the instrument at the music shop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新人喺度練手，唔好責怪佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jan4 hai2 dou6 lin6 sau2, m4 hou2 zaak3 gwaai3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新手在练手，不要责怪他。
examples.english_sentence: The newcomer is practicing; don't blame him.

mandarin_meaning: 裝清高、裝做高高在上
english_meaning: to act aloof/sanctimonious; to put on an air of superiority
explanation_mandarin: 俚語，指故意擺出高傲、超然或清高的樣子，常帶貶義，用來形容某人在社交場合表現得不接地氣或自以為高人一等。
explanation_english: Slang for deliberately putting on an aloof, superior, or sanctimonious attitude. Often derogatory, used to describe someone acting detached or self-important in social situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日練仙啦，大家一齊講啲真話得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 lin6 sin1 laa3, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 gong2 di1 zan1 waa6 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別老是裝清高了，大家一起說實話可以嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Don't always act aloof — can everyone just speak honestly?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到陌生人就練仙，成日講啲高高在上的說話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 mak6 saang1 jan4 zau6 lin6 sin1, sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 gou1 gou1 zoi6 soeng6 dik1 syut3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到陌生人就裝出高高在上的樣子，總是說些傲慢的話。
examples.english_sentence: He puts on an aloof act around strangers, always saying haughty things.

mandarin_meaning: 练兵 (liàn bīng)：训练士兵；也指组织演练、训练以提升能力或保持战备。
english_meaning: Literally 'train soldiers'; to conduct drills, training exercises, or rehearsals to improve skills or maintain readiness.
explanation_mandarin: 字面上是訓練士兵；引申為對人員或團隊進行訓練、演習或實戰演練，以提升能力或保持準備狀態。
explanation_english: Literally means training soldiers. Figuratively it means organizing drills or practice sessions to train people or teams, improve abilities, or keep forces/teams ready.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司打算喺下個月開始練兵，為新產品嘅推出做準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 hai2 haa6 go3 jyut6 hoi1 ci2 lin6 bing1, wai6 san1 caan2 ban2 ge3 teoi1 ceot1 zou6 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司打算在下个月开始练兵，为新产品的推出做准备。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to start training staff next month to prepare for the launch of the new product.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍隊定期練兵，保持戰備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 deoi2 ding6 kei4 lin6 bing1, bou2 ci4 zin3 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军队定期练兵，保持战备。
examples.english_sentence: The military regularly conducts training exercises to maintain readiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教練安排球隊練兵，提高默契與配合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 lin6 ngon1 paai4 kau4 deoi2 lin6 bing1, tai4 gou1 mak6 kei3 jyu5 pui3 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教练安排球队练兵，提高默契与配合。
examples.english_sentence: The coach scheduled drills for the team to improve coordination and chemistry.

mandarin_meaning: 练功（练习技能或训练，常指武术练习，也可比喻勤加练习或游戏中刷等级）
english_meaning: to practice/train (skills); often used for martial arts practice, training, or metaphorically for practicing/grinding (e.g., in games)
explanation_mandarin: 指進行技能或體能的練習與訓練。可用於字面意義的武術練習，也常用作比喻，表示反覆練習或在遊戲中刷等級、提升角色能力。
explanation_english: Refers to practicing or training a skill or physical ability. It can mean literal martial arts practice or be used metaphorically for repeated practice, training, or grinding (such as leveling up in games).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿華每日朝早去道場練功，想提高功夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 waa4 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 heoi3 dou6 coeng4 lin6 gung1, soeng2 tai4 gou1 gung1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿华每天早上去道场练功，想提高功夫。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Wah goes to the dojo every morning to practice martial arts; he wants to improve his kung fu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打機想快啲升級就要不停練功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 gei1 soeng2 faai3 di1 sing1 kap1 zau6 jiu3 bat1 ting4 lin6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玩游戏想快点升级就要不停练功。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to level up quickly in a game, you have to keep grinding/practicing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我去練功，你要一齊嚟嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 heoi3 lin6 gung1, nei5 jiu3 jat1 cai4 lai4 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我去练功，你要一起来吗？
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to practice/training tonight. Do you want to come along?

mandarin_meaning: （遊戲）用來快速獲得經驗或自動練級的道具或券
english_meaning: An in-game item or coupon that grants experience points or automates leveling; 'training coupon'.
explanation_mandarin: 香港粵語的遊戲用語，指能讓角色快速獲得經驗值或自動練級的道具/券，常見於線上遊戲活動或商城。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese gaming term for an item (a 'training coupon') that gives characters experience points or automates leveling, commonly found in online game events or stores.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱喺活動度攞到一張練功券，快啲用嚟升級啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 wut6 dung6 dou6 lo2 dou3 jat1 zoeng1 lyun6 gung1 kyun3, faai3 di1 jung6 lai4 sing1 kap1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛在活動中拿到一張練功券，趕快用來升級吧。
examples.english_sentence: I just got a training coupon from the event; I'll use it to level up quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 練壯／練成壯碩（體格）
english_meaning: to work out to get bigger or more muscular; to bulk up
explanation_mandarin: 口語、俚語用法，指透過舉重、健身等鍛鍊使身體變壯、變大隻（變得更壯碩）。
explanation_english: Colloquial/slang expression meaning to train (e.g., at the gym) to become bigger or more muscular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢近排成日去健身房，想練大隻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan6 paai4 sing4 jat6 heoi3 gin6 san1 fong4, soeng2 lin6 daai6 zek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近常去健身房，想練壯。
examples.english_sentence: He's been going to the gym a lot lately; he wants to bulk up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係食補，要配埋練大隻先有效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sik6 bou2, jiu3 pui3 maai4 lin6 daai6 zek3 sin1 jau5 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只靠補品，要配合鍛鍊才能有效。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just rely on supplements; you need to combine them with training to see results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬練咗三個月，依家已經大隻咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 lin6 zo2 saam1 go3 jyut6, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 daai6 zek3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟練了三個月，現在已經變壯了。
examples.english_sentence: My younger brother trained for three months and is already bulkier.

mandarin_meaning: 练字 (liàn zì)：练习书写汉字或练习书法
english_meaning: to practice writing (Chinese characters); to practice handwriting or calligraphy
explanation_mandarin: 指練習書寫漢字或練習書法的筆法與字跡，常見於學生或書法愛好者的習慣。
explanation_english: Refers to practicing the writing of Chinese characters or practicing calligraphy—improving handwriting, strokes, and style. Common among students and calligraphy enthusiasts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都會練字半個鐘，想寫得靚啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 wui5 lin6 zi6 bun3 go3 zung1, soeng2 se2 dak1 leng3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都会练字半个小时，想写得更漂亮一点。
examples.english_sentence: I practice writing for half an hour every day because I want to write more nicely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師叫我哋放學之後留喺學校練字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 dei6 fong3 hok6 zi1 hau6 lau4 hai2 hok6 haau6 lin6 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师叫我们放学之后留在学校练字。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher asked us to stay at school after class to practice writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意練字，用毛筆寫書法，好有心機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 lin6 zi6, jung6 mou4 bat1 se2 syu1 faat3, hou2 jau5 sam1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢练字，用毛笔写书法，很用心。
examples.english_sentence: He likes practicing calligraphy; he writes with a brush and is very meticulous.

mandarin_meaning: 练武
english_meaning: to practice martial arts; to train in combat skills
explanation_mandarin: 指练习武术或进行战斗、军事技能方面的训练，也可比喻磨练本领或技艺。
explanation_english: Refers to practicing martial arts or training in combat/military skills; can also be used metaphorically to mean honing one's skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個禮拜都去練武。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 heoi3 lin6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每个礼拜都去练武。
examples.english_sentence: I go practice martial arts every week.

mandarin_meaning: 练习（在水中进行的训练），通常指练习游泳或水上运动
english_meaning: to practice/train in the water (usually swimming or water sports)
explanation_mandarin: 「練水」為廣東話口語用法，字面為「練習水中活動」，多用來指練習游泳或進行水上訓練。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term literally meaning 'practice water'; commonly used to refer to practicing swimming or doing water-based training.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚去游泳池練水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 heoi3 jau4 wing6 ci4 lin6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚去游泳池练习游泳。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the swimming pool tonight to practice swimming.

mandarin_meaning: 练笔（練習寫作或書寫技巧）
english_meaning: to practice writing; to warm up or exercise one's writing skills
explanation_mandarin: 「練筆」指練習寫作或書寫，以提升文筆或作為寫作前的熱身，也可指試寫短文以檢驗技巧。
explanation_english: “練筆” means practicing writing or handwriting—writing short pieces to improve style or to warm up before serious writing; it can also mean trying out one's pen or style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想寫得好，最好每日練筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 se2 dak1 hou2, zeoi3 hou2 mui5 jat6 lin6 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想寫得好，最好每天練筆。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to write well, it's best to practice writing every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作家出新書之前會先練筆寫短篇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 gaa1 ceot1 san1 syu1 zi1 cin4 wui5 sin1 lin6 bat1 se2 dyun2 pin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作家在出新書之前會先練筆寫短篇。
examples.english_sentence: Authors often write short pieces to warm up before publishing a new book.

mandarin_meaning: 熟練後開始偷懶、懈怠
english_meaning: to become so proficient at something that one starts to slack off or cut corners
explanation_mandarin: 用以形容對某項工作或技能已經很熟練，反而開始偷懶或不再認真，帶有負面評價。
explanation_english: Describes someone who, having become skilled or experienced at a task, begins to slack off or be complacent. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗咁耐，練精學懶，連基本檢查都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gam2 noi6, lin6 zing1 hok6 laan5, lin4 gei1 bun2 gim2 caa4 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了這麼久，已經熟練了，開始偷懶，連基本檢查都不做。
examples.english_sentence: He's been doing this for so long that he's gotten complacent and started slacking off; he doesn't even do the basic checks.

mandarin_meaning: 练习
english_meaning: to practice; practice; exercise
explanation_mandarin: 指通过反复练习以提高技能或掌握知识；也可指练习的动作或练习题。
explanation_english: To perform repeated exercises or rehearsals to improve a skill or learn something; can also refer to a practice session or practice exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都要練習廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 jiu3 lin6 zaap6 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都要练习广东话。
examples.english_sentence: I need to practice Cantonese every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊今晩有練習，記得準時到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi2 gam1 maan5 jau5 lin6 zaap6, gei3 dak1 zeon2 si4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队今晚有练习，记得准时到。
examples.english_sentence: The team has practice tonight; remember to arrive on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這份練習題好有用，可以幫我準備考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze5 fan6 lin6 zaap6 tai4 hou2 jau5 jung6, ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zeon2 bei6 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份练习题很有用，可以帮我准备考试。
examples.english_sentence: These practice exercises are very useful; they help me prepare for the exam.

mandarin_meaning: 练习生
english_meaning: trainee; apprentice (often an idol trainee)
explanation_mandarin: 指正在接受培訓、尚未正式出道或上任的人，常用於歌手或藝人的培訓階段，也可泛指實習或見習的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone undergoing training who has not officially debuted or assumed a full role; often used for singers/entertainers in the idol industry, but can also mean a general trainee or apprentice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係練習生，仲未正式出道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 lin6 zaap6 saang1, zung6 mei6 zing3 sik1 ceot1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是练习生，尚未正式出道。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is a trainee and hasn't officially debuted yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司安排咗一個月嘅訓練畀練習生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 on1 paai4 zo2 jat1 go3 jyut6 ge3 fan3 lin6 bei2 lin6 zaap6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司安排了一個月的訓練給練習生。
examples.english_sentence: The company arranged a one-month training for the trainees.

mandarin_meaning: 練馬師（賽馬訓練師／馬匹訓練師）
english_meaning: racehorse trainer (horse trainer for racehorses)
explanation_mandarin: 負責訓練、調教與管理賽馬及馬房，使馬匹達到參加比賽水平的專業人員。
explanation_english: A professional who trains, conditions, and manages racehorses and stables to prepare horses for racing competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位出色嘅練馬師，啲馬喺上季贏咗好多場賽馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 ceot1 sik1 ge3 lin6 maa5 si1, di1 maa5 hai2 soeng6 gwai3 jing4 zo2 hou2 do1 coeng4 coi3 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位出色的練馬師，上季他訓練的馬贏了很多場比賽。
examples.english_sentence: He is an outstanding racehorse trainer; the horses he trained won many races last season.

mandarin_meaning: （缇）一種絲織品，常見於緹花（錦織圖案）；也指暗紅、绛紅色。屬書面或文言用詞。
english_meaning: A type of woven silk cloth (as in brocade/tapestry) or a dark reddish (deep scarlet) color; literary/archaic usage.
explanation_mandarin: 緹原指一種絲織品（如緹花），用於服飾或裝飾；引申可指暗紅或绛紅色，現多見於書面或專業用語中。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a kind of woven silk fabric (e.g. brocade); by extension it can denote a dark reddish/scarlet color. The term is mainly literary or specialized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件緹花布好靚，啱嚟做旗袍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 tai4 faa1 bou3 hou2 leng3, aam1 lai4 zou6 kei4 paau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件緹花布很漂亮，適合用來做旗袍。
examples.english_sentence: This brocade fabric is very beautiful; it's suitable for making a qipao.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代宮廷有時會用緹色作為服飾或帳幔嘅裝飾色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 gung1 ting4 jau5 si4 wui5 jung6 tai4 sik1 zok3 wai6 fuk6 sik1 wo6 zoeng3 maan6 ge3 zong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代宮廷有時會用緹色作為服飾或帳幔的裝飾色。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient courts sometimes used the 'ti' color for clothing or canopy decorations.

mandarin_meaning: 精緻；細緻
english_meaning: delicate; exquisite; fine; meticulous
explanation_mandarin: 表示細緻、精巧，常見於「精緻」「細緻」等詞語，用來形容物品或做工的精細與講究。
explanation_english: Indicates fine detail or exquisite workmanship. Commonly appears in compounds like '精緻' to describe something as delicate, detailed, or carefully crafted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅擺設好精緻，連細節都做得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 baai2 sit3 hou2 zing1 zi3, lin4 sai3 zit3 dou1 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳的擺設很精緻，連細節都做得很好。
examples.english_sentence: The decor of this restaurant is very exquisite; even the details are well done.

mandarin_meaning: 緣／緣分，指人與人或事物之間的因緣、機緣
english_meaning: fate; predestined affinity or connection; chance that brings people together
explanation_mandarin: 「縁」為「緣」的變體，表示人與人或事物之間因緣分、機會或牽連，常用來形容命中注定的相遇或關係（如「有緣」）。
explanation_english: A variant form of 緣 (yuan), meaning the predestined bond, affinity, or chance that links people or events. Commonly used to describe a fated meeting or connection (e.g., "have fate/affinity").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋能夠相遇，真係有緣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 nang4 gau3 soeng1 jyu6, zan1 hai6 jau5 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們能相遇，真是有緣。
examples.english_sentence: It's really fate that we met.

mandarin_meaning: 繩（shéng）
english_meaning: rope; cord; string
explanation_mandarin: 「縄」是表示繩索的漢字形式，日語常用寫法為「縄」。在廣東話裡通常使用字「繩」(讀作 sing4)，「縄」屬於書寫變體或借用字，意思為繩子、索類，作名詞使用。
explanation_english: 「縄」 is a character used to mean rope or cord (commonly written as 繩 in Chinese). The form 縄 is often seen in Japanese. In Cantonese the usual character is 繩 (jyutping: sing4). The word denotes a rope/cord and is used as a noun; 縄 itself is a variant form and not commonly used in everyday Cantonese writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條縄好硬，小心唔好割親手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sing4 hou2 ngaang6, siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 got3 can1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條繩很硬，小心別割到手。
examples.english_sentence: This rope is very stiff; be careful not to cut your hand.

mandarin_meaning: 縈繞；纏繞；盤旋
english_meaning: to entangle; to hover or linger around; to haunt (as a thought)
explanation_mandarin: 表示纏繞、盤旋或在心中揮之不去，常見於詞語「縈繞」。也可用於具體物體的纏繞或抽象思緒的縈繞。
explanation_english: Indicates entangling, circling/hovering, or lingering in the mind; commonly seen in the compound "縈繞". Can describe physical entanglement or persistent thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅笑容一直縈繞喺我心頭，令我無法忘記。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 siu3 jung4 jat1 zik6 jing4 jiu5 hai2 ngo5 sam1 tau4, ling6 ngo5 mou4 faat3 mong4 gei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的笑容一直縈繞在我心頭，讓我無法忘記。
examples.english_sentence: His/her smile keeps lingering in my mind, making it impossible to forget.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊事一直縈繞住佢，佢夜晚都訓唔着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si6 jat1 zik6 jing4 jiu5 zyu6 keoi5, keoi5 je6 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 往事一直縈繞著他/她，他/她晚上睡不著。
examples.english_sentence: Past events keep haunting him/her; he/she can't sleep at night.

mandarin_meaning: 縈繞（yíngrào）：持續盤旋、糾纏不去，常用於情緒、回憶、氣味等在心頭或周圍徘徊。
english_meaning: to linger/haunt; to hover around; to remain persistently in one's mind or surroundings
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容情感、回憶、氣味等長時間在心中或周圍徘徊、不易消散，也可指實際的盤旋或環繞。
explanation_english: Describes an emotion, memory, smell, etc. that persists or hovers around for a long time and is hard to dispel; can also mean to circle or surround physically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅旋律一直縈繞喺我腦海，令我諗唔停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 syun4 leot6 jat1 zik6 jing4 naau6 hai2 ngo5 nou5 hoi2, ling6 ngo5 lam2 m4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這首歌的旋律一直縈繞在我腦海，讓我想個不停。
examples.english_sentence: The melody of this song keeps lingering in my mind, making me unable to stop thinking about it.

mandarin_meaning: 绞死、上吊、勒死（拼音：yì）
english_meaning: to strangle; to hang (to cause death by strangulation or hanging)
explanation_mandarin: 指以繩索、手或其他方式勒頸或上吊使人窒息而死；亦可指處以絞刑或類似的絞殺刑罰。
explanation_english: To cause death by strangulation or hanging (e.g., hanging oneself or executing by strangulation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺房入面縊咗，警方話係自殺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fong4 jap6 min6 jik6 zo2, ging2 fong1 waa6 hai6 zi6 saat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在房间里上吊了，警方说是自杀。
examples.english_sentence: He hanged himself in the room; the police said it was suicide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代有啲地方會用縊刑處死犯人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 jau5 di1 dei6 fong1 wui5 jung6 jik6 hang4 cyu5 sei2 faan6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代有些地方会用绞刑处死犯人。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times some places used hanging as a form of execution for criminals.

mandarin_meaning: 弄皺；起皺紋（如布、紙或臉部表情）
english_meaning: to wrinkle; to crease; (of fabric, paper, or the face) to form wrinkles
explanation_mandarin: 表示使布料、紙張等產生皺褶，或指臉部因表情而出現皺紋；也可用作描述衣物被弄皺的狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates causing fabric, paper, etc. to form creases or wrinkles; can also refer to facial wrinkles from expressions. Also used to describe clothing that has become wrinkled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫縐咗，唔好著出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 zau3 zo2, m4 hou2 zoek3 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服被弄皺了，別穿出門。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is wrinkled; don't wear it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到成績單即刻縐咗眉頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 sing4 zik1 daan1 zik1 hak1 zau3 zo2 mei4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一看到成績單就皺起眉頭。
examples.english_sentence: He frowned as soon as he saw the report card.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：皱巴巴的胶带；引申：粤语俚语，贬义，用来形容人没用、懦弱、做事不能兑现或装腔作势的人（口语、非正式、带冒犯性）
english_meaning: Literal: 'wrinkled adhesive tape'; Colloquial Cantonese slang (derogatory) used to describe someone as pathetic/useless, flaky, or a poser — informal and offensive
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚语 / 名词（口语、贬义）
explanation_mandarin: 『縐皮膠紙』直譯為皺起來的膠紙。作為粵語俚語時，通常以貶義稱呼某人無用、遇事退縮、言行不一或裝模作樣。屬於香港口語、非正式且可能冒犯的用語，使用時需注意場合與對象。
explanation_english: Literally 'wrinkled sticky tape'. As Cantonese slang it is used pejoratively to call someone useless, cowardly, flaky, or a poser who talks big but fails to deliver. It's informal, regionally Hong Kong, and can be offensive — use with caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做縐皮膠紙，講完唔做到，成日扮晒嘢喺度吹水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 zau3 pei4 gaau1 zi2, gong2 jyun4 m4 zou6 dou3, seng4 jat6 baan6 saai3 je5 hai2 dou6 ceoi1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別做縐皮膠紙，說了不做到，整天裝腔作勢在那裡吹牛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a '縐皮膠紙' — you say things but don't follow through, always pretending and bragging.

mandarin_meaning: 把紙弄皺；皺巴巴的紙
english_meaning: to crumple paper; crumpled paper
explanation_mandarin: 「縐紙」指把紙弄得有皺摺，或用作名詞指已經被弄皺的紙張。常見於日常口語描述紙張狀態或動作。
explanation_english: “縐紙” means to crumple or wrinkle paper; as a noun it refers to paper that is crumpled. Commonly used in everyday speech to describe the action or the condition of paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好縐啲紙，放喺度等陣會用到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zau3 di1 zi2, fong3 hai2 dou6 dang2 zan6 wui5 jung6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別把紙弄皺，放在這裡等一下會用到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't crumple the paper; leave it here, we'll need it later.

mandarin_meaning: 綁、束縛（fú）
english_meaning: to bind; to tie up; to restrain; to confine
explanation_mandarin: 表示用繩索或其他方式捆綁，使不能自由活動；也可用作引申義，表示束縛或限制。
explanation_english: Means to bind or tie up with rope or similar so movement is restricted; can also be used figuratively to mean to restrict or confine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雙手畀人縛住，連喊都喊唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng1 sau2 bei2 jan4 fuk1 zyu6, lin4 haam3 dou1 haam3 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他雙手被人縛住，連喊都喊不到。
examples.english_sentence: His hands were tied up; he couldn't even shout.

mandarin_meaning: 手脚被束缚；行动受限
english_meaning: to be tied hand and foot; to be hampered/restricted
explanation_mandarin: 字面上是把手腳縛住，引申指行動或自由受到限制，做事不方便或受束縛，常用來形容制度、規矩或情況讓人無法發揮或行動受阻。
explanation_english: Literally 'to tie the hands and feet'. Figuratively used to describe being restricted or hampered in action or freedom — unable to act freely, often because of rules, procedures, or circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啲規矩太多，令到員工做事縛手縛腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 di1 gwai1 geoi2 taai3 do1, ling6 dou3 jyun4 gung1 zou6 si6 fuk1 sau2 fuk1 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的规矩太多，导致员工做事手脚受限。
examples.english_sentence: The company has too many rules, which ties the employees' hands and feet when they work.

mandarin_meaning: 縝（多見於「縝密」），表示周密、細緻、謹慎
english_meaning: meticulous; careful; thorough (often seen in the compound '縝密')
explanation_mandarin: 表示做事周詳、細緻、謹慎，多用於「縝密」一詞來形容安排或思考周到。
explanation_english: Indicates being meticulous, careful, and thorough. Commonly used in the compound '縝密' to describe careful planning or detailed thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好縝密，冇乜錯漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 zan2 mat6, mou5 mat1 co3 lau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很縝密，幾乎沒有錯漏。
examples.english_sentence: He is very meticulous in his work, with almost no mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 縝密（zhěnmì）— 做事或計劃非常周詳、細緻、嚴密
english_meaning: meticulous; thorough; detailed and careful
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事或計劃非常周詳、考慮周到、細節處理得當，容易避免錯漏。
explanation_english: Describes actions or plans that are careful, thorough, and detailed; well thought out so that errors or omissions are unlikely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好縝密，冇咩遺漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 zan2 mat6, mou5 me1 wai4 lau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很縝密，沒有什麼遺漏。
examples.english_sentence: He does his work very meticulously and hardly misses anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成功就需要一個縝密嘅計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 gung1 zau6 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 go3 zan2 mat6 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要成功就需要一個縝密的計劃。
examples.english_sentence: To succeed, you need a meticulous plan.

mandarin_meaning: 繁多、繁複、錯綜（多見於文言或書面語）
english_meaning: numerous; intricate; complicated; elaborate (literary/formal)
explanation_mandarin: 「縟」多用於書面或文言表達，形容事物繁複、紛亂或錯綜，常與其他字搭配形成複合詞。
explanation_english: A literary/formal term describing something intricate, numerous, or complicated. Often appears in written or classical contexts and in compounds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段文章用詞太縟，普通讀者唔易明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 man4 zoeng1 jung6 ci4 taai3 juk6, pou2 tung1 duk6 ze2 m4 ji5 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段文章用词太縟，普通读者不容易理解。
examples.english_sentence: This passage uses overly intricate wording, making it difficult for general readers to understand.

mandarin_meaning: 縣（xiàn），一級行政區劃，通常位於省或直轄市之下
english_meaning: county (an administrative division below a province/prefecture)
explanation_mandarin: 「縣」是中國等地常見的行政區劃名稱，指省或市下的一級地方行政區，負責當地日常治理與公共事務。
explanation_english: “縣” denotes a county, an administrative division commonly found in China and some other places, usually below a province or prefecture and responsible for local governance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋住喺呢個縣度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 ni1 go3 jyun6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们住在这个县。
examples.english_sentence: We live in this county.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個縣嘅風景好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyun6 ge3 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个县的风景很美。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery in this county is beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做緊縣長，負責管理呢個縣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gan2 jyun6 coeng4, fu6 zaak3 gun2 lei5 ni1 go3 jyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在担任县长，负责管理这个县。
examples.english_sentence: He's serving as the county magistrate, responsible for managing this county.

mandarin_meaning: 縣和市（地方性的行政區劃）
english_meaning: counties and cities (local administrative divisions)
explanation_mandarin: 指縣與市，合稱地方基層的行政區或地方政府，常用於討論行政、統計或公共政策。
explanation_english: Refers to counties and cities, collectively denoting local-level administrative divisions or local governments. Commonly used when discussing administration, statistics, or public policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府喺會議上講到要支援偏遠縣市嘅醫療資源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 gong2 dou3 jiu3 zi1 jyun4 pin1 jyun5 jyun2 si5 ge3 ji1 liu4 zi1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府在會議上提到要支援偏遠縣市的醫療資源。
examples.english_sentence: The government mentioned at the meeting that it needs to support medical resources in remote counties and cities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 各縣市嘅稅率唔一樣，對企業投資有影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gok3 jyun2 si5 ge3 seoi3 leot6 m4 jat1 joeng6, deoi3 kei4 jip6 tau4 zi1 jau5 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 各縣市的稅率不一樣，對企業投資有影響。
examples.english_sentence: Tax rates differ among counties and cities, which affects business investment.

mandarin_meaning: 縫 / 缝 (féng) — 衣物的接合處（縫線）；縫補、縫製的動作；也可指裂縫、縫隙。
english_meaning: seam; stitch; to sew; to mend; a crack or gap.
explanation_mandarin: 「縫」可表示布料或衣物上用線連接的部分（縫、縫線），也可作動詞表示用針線縫補或縫製；有時亦指裂縫或縫隙。
explanation_english: “縫” can mean the seam or stitching on fabric or clothing, the action of sewing or mending with needle and thread, and occasionally a crack or gap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫條縫開咗，要縫返先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 tiu4 fung4 hoi1 zo2, jiu3 fung4 faan1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服的縫開了，要縫回來才行。
examples.english_sentence: The seam on this shirt has come apart; it needs to be sewn back up before it can be worn.

mandarin_meaning: 缝合（用针线缝合伤口或把裂口连接起来；也可比喻修补、弥合分裂）
english_meaning: to stitch/suture (to sew a wound or join pieces together); figuratively, to mend or reconcile a split
explanation_mandarin: 指用针线把伤口或物体的裂口缝起来，使其合拢；在比喻用法中表示修补或弥合分裂、裂痕。
explanation_english: Refers to sewing a wound or joining a split with thread and needle; figuratively, it means to repair or heal divisions or rifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生用線幫我縫合傷口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jung6 sin3 bong1 ngo5 fung4 hap6 soeng1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生用线帮我缝合伤口。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor used thread to stitch my wound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府推出嘅措施未必能即刻縫合社會嘅裂痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 teoi1 ceot1 ge3 cou3 sik1 mei6 bat1 nang4 zik1 hak1 fung4 hap6 se5 wui6 ge3 lit3 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府推出的措施未必能立刻弥合社会的裂痕。
examples.english_sentence: The measures introduced by the government may not immediately mend the fractures in society.

mandarin_meaning: 縫紉 (缝纫, féngrèn)
english_meaning: sewing; to sew; needlework
explanation_mandarin: 指用針線或縫紉機將布料、衣物等縫合、修補或製作成衣的技術或行為。
explanation_english: The act or skill of joining, mending, or making garments and fabrics using needle and thread or a sewing machine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要去學縫紉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 hok6 fung4 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要去學縫紉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to learn sewing today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫要縫紉一下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jiu3 fung4 jam6 jat1 haa6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服要縫紉一下。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing needs a bit of sewing.

mandarin_meaning: 缝制
english_meaning: to sew; to stitch (to make by sewing)
explanation_mandarin: 用針線把布料縫合、製作衣物或其他布製品的動作。
explanation_english: To join fabric by stitching; to make garments or other textile items by sewing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係佢親手縫製嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 keoi5 can1 sau2 fung4 zai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服是他親手缝制的。
examples.english_sentence: This garment was sewn by him personally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司委託工廠縫製新款樣板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai2 tok3 gung1 cong2 fung4 zai3 san1 fun2 joeng6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司委託工廠缝制新款樣板。
examples.english_sentence: The company commissioned the factory to sew the new sample.

mandarin_meaning: 缝补（用针线把衣物等缝好）
english_meaning: to sew; to stitch (to mend cloth or fabric with needle and thread)
explanation_mandarin: 用針和線把衣物或布料的破洞、裂口等縫合或修補的動作。
explanation_english: The action of using a needle and thread to stitch or mend clothes or fabric (to sew up tears or make repairs).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫爛咗，要縫針先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 laan6 zo2, jiu3 fung4 zam1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服破了，要缝起来才行。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing is torn; it needs to be sewn up before it's wearable.

mandarin_meaning: 縫隙 / 缝隙 (fèngxì)
english_meaning: gap; crevice; small opening or seam
explanation_mandarin: 指物體之間的細小裂縫或空隙，常用來形容窗、門、物件接縫處等的狹小空間。
explanation_english: Refers to a small crack, seam, or space between objects; commonly used for gaps around windows, doors, or joints of objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張窗同窗框之間有縫隙，冷風會吹入嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 coeng1 tung4 coeng1 kwaang4 zi1 gaan1 jau5 fung4 sik1, laang5 fung1 wui5 ceoi1 jap6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 窗戶和窗框之間有縫隙，冷風會吹進來。
examples.english_sentence: There is a gap between the window and the frame; cold air will blow in.

mandarin_meaning: 缩（suō）：收缩、变小；退缩、畏缩；（口语）吝啬、缩手缩脚
english_meaning: to shrink/contract; to withdraw or recoil; (colloquial) to be reluctant or stingy
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體尺寸或體積變小（如衣服縮水），也可表示因害怕或不敢而退縮；口語中可指吝嗇或不願意付出。
explanation_english: Indicates that something becomes smaller or contracts (e.g. clothes shrinking); can also mean to withdraw or recoil out of fear or hesitation. Colloquially it may describe reluctance or stinginess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫洗完縮咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 sai2 jyun4 suk1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服洗完缩了。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing shrank after washing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一聽到責罵就縮埋咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 zaak3 maa6 zau6 suk1 maai4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一听到责备就缩了起来。
examples.english_sentence: He withdrew as soon as he heard the scolding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好縮手，唔肯出錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 suk1 sau2, m4 hang2 ceot1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很小气，不肯出钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's stingy and won't pay.

mandarin_meaning: 縮印（將文字或圖像按比例縮小印刷或製成縮印本；亦指製作刪節的簡縮版本）
english_meaning: to print or reproduce at reduced size (photoreduce); an abridged or reduced-size edition
explanation_mandarin: 指把原稿、文件或圖像按比例縮小後印刷或複印，或指製作內容經過刪減的縮印本／簡縮版本。
explanation_english: Refers to reducing the scale of text or images for printing or photocopying (photoreduction), or producing an abridged/reduced version of a document or book.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係縮印本，內容有啲刪減。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 suk1 jan3 bun2, noi6 jung4 jau5 di1 saan1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書是縮印本，內容有些刪減。
examples.english_sentence: This book is an abridged (reduced-size) edition; some content has been cut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫我把文件縮印成一張A4？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 baa2 man4 gin6 suk1 jan3 sing4 jat1 zoeng1 A4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以幫我把文件縮印成一張A4嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me reduce and print the document to A4 size?

mandarin_meaning: 小氣，吝嗇（連一兩角這樣微小的錢都不願意付或分享）
english_meaning: stingy/cheap — unwilling to spend or share even a very small amount
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，形容一個人非常小氣，連一兩角（很小的錢）也不願意付出或分擔。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang phrase describing someone extremely stingy — unwilling to pay or share even a trivial amount (literally 'shrinking one or two jiao').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好縮埋一二角，出街食飯連分錢都唔肯畀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 suk1 maai4 jat1 ji6 gok3, ceot1 gaai1 sik6 faan6 lin4 fan1 cin2 dou1 m4 hang2 bei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很小氣，出門吃飯連分攤的錢都不肯付。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stingy — when we go out to eat he won't even pay his share.

mandarin_meaning: 縮成一團；擠在一起
english_meaning: to huddle together; to crowd/squeeze into one lump
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容人或動物因寒冷、害怕或想靠近而聚在一起，縮成一團或擠在一起。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase describing people or animals drawing close together — literally ‘shrinking into one lump’ — often because of cold, fear, or to stay close.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚凍到，大家縮埋一嚿取暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 dung3 dou3, daai6 gaa1 suk1 maai4 jat1 gau3 ceoi2 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上冷得大家縮成一團取暖。
examples.english_sentence: It was so cold at night that everyone huddled together to keep warm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小狗驚風，縮埋一嚿喺門口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 gau2 geng1 fung1, suk1 maai4 jat1 gau3 hai2 mun4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小狗害怕風，縮成一團躲在門口。
examples.english_sentence: The puppy was scared of the wind and huddled at the doorway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到陌生人就縮埋一嚿，唔肯出嚟講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 mak6 saang1 jan4 zau6 suk1 maai4 jat1 gau3, m4 hang2 ceot1 lai4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到陌生人就縮成一團，不願出來說話。
examples.english_sentence: When he saw strangers, he withdrew into himself and refused to come out and speak.

mandarin_meaning: 缩写 (suōxiě)
english_meaning: abbreviation; to abbreviate
explanation_mandarin: 表示把較長的詞或短語縮短成較短的形式；也可指縮短後的形式。
explanation_english: The act of shortening a word or phrase, or the shortened form itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個詞可以縮寫成三個字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ci4 ho2 ji5 suk1 se2 sing4 saam1 go3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个词可以缩写成三个字。
examples.english_sentence: This word can be abbreviated into three characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司名通常會用縮寫嚟方便書寫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ming4 tung1 soeng4 wui5 jung6 suk1 se2 lai4 fong1 bin6 syu1 se2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司名通常会用缩写来方便书写。
examples.english_sentence: Company names are usually abbreviated to make writing easier.

mandarin_meaning: 缩小 (suōxiǎo)
english_meaning: to reduce; to shrink; to scale down
explanation_mandarin: 表示把尺寸、範圍、規模或程度變小，可用於物件大小、規模縮減或數值降低等情況。
explanation_english: Indicates making something smaller in size, scope, scale, or degree; used for physical size reduction, downsizing, or decreasing values.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫我將相片縮小啲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 soeng1 pin3 suk1 siu2 di1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以幫我把相片縮小一點嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you help me shrink the photo a bit?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為咗節省成本，要縮小規模。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 zit3 saang2 sing4 bun2, jiu3 suk1 siu2 kwai1 mo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司為了節省成本，要縮小規模。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to downsize to save costs.

mandarin_meaning: 缩影（suōyǐng）：原指缩小的影像，引申为能反映整体特征或状态的典型事物或局部表现。
english_meaning: microcosm; epitome; a small representation that reflects the characteristics of the whole
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容能代表整體特徵或情況的事物或現象，像是部分反映整體的縮小模型或典型事例。
explanation_english: Refers to something that represents or reflects the characteristics of a larger whole; a small or typical example that embodies the overall situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個小鎮係香港多元文化嘅縮影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 siu2 zan3 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 do1 jyun4 man4 faa3 ge3 suk1 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小镇是香港多元文化的缩影。
examples.english_sentence: This small town is a microcosm of Hong Kong's multiculturalism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅研發團隊係創新精神嘅縮影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 jin4 faat3 tyun4 deoi6 hai6 cong3 san1 zing1 ge3 suk1 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的研发团队是创新精神的缩影。
examples.english_sentence: The company's R&D team is an epitome of its innovative spirit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生嘅表現係學校教育成果嘅一個縮影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 saang1 ge3 biu2 jin6 hai6 hok6 haau6 gaau3 juk6 sing4 gwo2 ge3 jat1 go3 suk1 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生的表现是学校教育成果的一个缩影。
examples.english_sentence: Students' performance is a microcosm of the school's educational outcomes.

mandarin_meaning: 缩约/食言/违约（口语）
english_meaning: to renege on a promise; to back out; to reduce an agreed number/amount (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指违背原先的承诺、减少原本约定的数量或条件，等于“食言”或“缩减约定”。常用于责备别人没有履行承诺或临时缩减给付。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to break a promise or to reduce the amount/terms previously agreed — i.e., to back out, renege, or short-change someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你答應買十個，點解而家縮數得五個？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daap3 jing3 maai5 sap6 go3, dim2 gaai2 ji4 gaa1 suk1 sou3 dak1 ng5 go3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你答应买十个，为什么现在缩数只买了五个？
examples.english_sentence: You promised to buy ten, why have you now shrunk it to only five?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講好幫手搬屋，但最後又縮數，真係好失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 hou2 bong1 sau2 bun1 uk1, daan6 zeoi6 hau6 jau6 suk1 sou3, zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她说好帮忙搬家，但最后又缩数，真是很失望。
examples.english_sentence: They said they'd help move, but in the end backed out again — really disappointing.

mandarin_meaning: 縮水 (suōshuǐ)，指衣物因洗滌等變小；引申為數量、程度或價值減少
english_meaning: to shrink (e.g. clothes); figuratively, to decrease/reduce (amount, value, size)
explanation_mandarin: 「縮水」可指衣物經洗滌、乾燥後尺寸變小；在口語中亦常用作比喻，表示數量、金額或程度減少（例如利潤縮水、工資縮水）。
explanation_english: Literally, 'to shrink'—used for garments that become smaller after washing/drying. Figuratively, used colloquially to mean a reduction in quantity, amount, or value (e.g., profits shrank, pay was reduced).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫洗完縮水咗，宜家著唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 sai2 jyun4 suk1 seoi2 zo2, ji4 gaa1 zoek3 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服洗完縮水了，現在穿不下。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt shrank after washing; now it doesn't fit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司第二季嘅利潤縮水咗三成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 dai6 ji6 ge3 lei6 jeon6 suk1 seoi2 zo2 saam1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的第二季度利潤縮水了三成。
examples.english_sentence: The company's profits shrank by 30% in the second quarter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人工縮水咗，今個月淨係俾我八千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 gung1 suk1 seoi2 zo2, gam1 go3 jyut6 zing6 hai6 bei2 ngo5 baat3 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工資縮水了，這個月只給我八千塊。
examples.english_sentence: My salary got reduced—this month they only paid me HK$8,000.

mandarin_meaning: 缩水楼
english_meaning: A housing unit or development whose actual usable area or value is much smaller than advertised; literally a 'shrunken' flat/building (slang, property context).
explanation_mandarin: 指實際使用面積或價值比宣傳、廣告或合同標示的少很多的住宅單位或樓盤，常用於描述樓市廣告與實際情況不符的情形，也可引申為規模或利益被縮減的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to a flat or development whose actual usable area or value is much less than what was advertised or stated in the contract. Commonly used in real-estate slang to describe discrepancies between listings/marketing and reality; can also be extended to mean a reduction in scale or benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個樓盤係縮水樓，廣告寫三房，其實實用面積好細，連雙人床都唔夠位放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 lau4 pun4 hai6 suk1 seoi2 lau4, gwong2 gou3 se2 saam1 fong4, kei4 sat6 sat6 jung6 min6 zik1 hou2 sai3, lin4 soeng1 jan4 cong4 dou1 m4 gau3 wai2 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个楼盘是缩水楼，广告写三房，实际上实用面积很小，连双人床都放不下。
examples.english_sentence: That development is a 'shrunken' building — the ad says three bedrooms, but the usable area is very small; there's not even room for a double bed.

mandarin_meaning: 臨陣退縮、膽怯、不敢做
english_meaning: to chicken out; to back out; to shrink back from doing something
explanation_mandarin: 「縮沙」是廣東話俚語，指在面臨困難、責任或挑戰時臨陣退縮、膽怯不敢去做，或畏縮不前。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term meaning to chicken out or shrink back from doing something, especially at the last minute; to act cowardly or be reluctant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好縮沙啦，一齊上台表演啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 suk1 saa1 laa1, jat1 cai4 soeng5 toi4 biu2 jin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別膽怯了，一起上台表演吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't chicken out; let's go on stage and perform together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢答應咗幫手，但到時又縮沙咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daap3 jing6 zo2 bong1 sau2, daan6 dou3 si4 jau6 suk1 saa1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答應了幫忙，但到時又臨陣退縮了。
examples.english_sentence: He promised to help, but he backed out at the last minute.

mandarin_meaning: 缩减 (suōjiǎn)
english_meaning: to reduce; to cut down; to decrease
explanation_mandarin: 表示减少、缩小（数量、规模、程度等）。常用于指削减经费、开支、人员或规模。
explanation_english: Means to reduce or decrease in number, size, or extent. Commonly used for cutting expenses, budgets, staff, or scale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要縮減開支，可能會減人工或者裁員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 suk1 gaam2 hoi1 zi1, ho2 nang4 wui5 gaam2 jan4 gung1 waak6 ze2 coi4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要缩减开支，可能会减薪或者裁员。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to reduce expenses; it may cut wages or lay off staff.

mandarin_meaning: 缩减班级/班次；减少工时或裁员
english_meaning: to reduce the number of classes or work shifts; to cut back operations or downsize staff
explanation_mandarin: 指因生源不足或訂單減少而减少班级、缩减班次、縮短工作時間或裁減人手，常见于学校、工厂或公司等情境。
explanation_english: Refers to cutting the number of classes (in schools), reducing shifts or working hours, or downsizing staff due to low enrollment or fewer orders; commonly used for schools, factories, or companies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校因為生源不足要縮班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 jan1 wai6 saang1 jyun4 bat1 zuk1 jiu3 suk1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校因为生源不足要缩班。
examples.english_sentence: The school has to reduce classes because of low enrollment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廠入面因為冇咁多訂單，老闆話要縮班，唔少工人要放無薪假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong2 jap6 min6 jan1 wai6 mou5 gam2 do1 ding6 daan1, lou5 baan2 waa6 jiu3 suk1 baan1, m4 siu2 gung1 jan4 jiu3 fong3 mou4 jam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工厂因为订单减少，老板说要缩减班次，不少工人要放无薪假。
examples.english_sentence: Because orders declined, the factory owner said they'd cut shifts — many workers will have to take unpaid leave.

mandarin_meaning: 退縮／打退堂鼓／收手
english_meaning: to back down; to withdraw a challenge or stop confronting; to chicken out
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，表示原本張揚或挑釁的人突然退縮、不再爭辯或取消挑戰。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning someone who was boastful or confrontational suddenly backs down, withdraws a challenge, or gives up the fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次你咁叻，依家縮番條槓？
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 nei5 gam2 lek1, ji4 gaa1 suk1 faan1 tiu4 gong3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次你那麼厲害，現在退縮了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: You were so tough last time—now you're backing down?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來佢話要同我一較高下，結果到時又縮番條槓，唔見人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 loi4 keoi5 waa6 jiu3 tung4 ngo5 jat1 gaau3 gou1 haa6, git3 gwo2 dou3 si4 jau6 suk1 faan1 tiu4 gong3, m4 gin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本來他說要和我一較高下，結果到時又退縮不現身。
examples.english_sentence: He originally said he'd compete with me, but when the time came he backed out and didn't show up.

mandarin_meaning: 小氣；吝嗇
english_meaning: stingy; tight-fisted
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語俚語，形容人不願意花錢或分享，態度小氣、吝嗇。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese slang meaning stingy or tight-fisted — unwilling to spend money or share with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好縮皮，成日唔肯請客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 suk1 pei4, sing4 jat6 m4 hang2 ceng2 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很小氣，總是不肯請客。
examples.english_sentence: He's really stingy; he never treats others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁縮皮啦，大家一齊夾錢食飯都可以。
