examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 suk1 pei4 laa1, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 gaap3 cin2 sik6 faan6 dou1 ho2 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別這麼小氣啦，大家可以一起湊錢吃飯。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy — we can all chip in and eat together.

mandarin_meaning: 缩短 (suōduǎn)
english_meaning: to shorten; to reduce (length, duration, distance)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把長度、時間或距離變得更短，減少長度或持續時間。
explanation_english: To make something shorter in length, duration, or distance; to reduce the length or time of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要縮短工作時間，員工會有多啲休息時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 suk1 dyun2 gung1 zok3 si4 gaan3, jyun4 gung1 wui5 jau5 do1 di1 jau1 sik1 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要缩短工作时间，员工会有更多休息时间。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to shorten working hours, so employees will have more rest time.

mandarin_meaning: 縮窄 / 變窄
english_meaning: to narrow; to become or make narrower; to shrink (in width)
explanation_mandarin: 表示寬度變小或使某物變窄，常用於道路、衣物等實體的寬度變化。
explanation_english: Indicates that something's width becomes smaller or is made narrower; commonly used for physical narrowing of roads, clothing, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段路開始縮窄，開車要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 lou6 hoi1 ci2 suk1 zaak3, hoi1 ce1 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這段路開始變窄，開車要小心。
examples.english_sentence: This stretch of road is starting to narrow; drive carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件褲洗咗之後縮窄咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 fu3 sai2 zo2 zi1 hau6 suk1 zaak3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條褲子洗過之後縮窄了。
examples.english_sentence: These pants shrank after washing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰條裙洗咗會唔會縮窄？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tiu4 kwan4 sai2 zo2 wui5 m4 wui5 suk1 zaak3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那條裙子洗了會不會縮窄？
examples.english_sentence: Will that skirt shrink after washing?

mandarin_meaning: 縮小；變小
english_meaning: to shrink; to make smaller; to reduce in size
explanation_mandarin: 表示把物件或規模的尺寸變小，也可指程度或影響力減弱。
explanation_english: Means to make something smaller in size or scale; can also refer to a reduction in extent or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫洗咗之後會縮細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 sai2 zo2 zi1 hau6 wui5 suk1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服洗了之後會縮小。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing will shrink after washing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司縮細咗部門，員工要轉工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 suk1 sai3 zo2 bou6 mun4, jyun4 gung1 jiu3 zyun2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司縮小了部門規模，員工需要換工作。
examples.english_sentence: The company downsized departments, so employees need to change jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將字體縮細，我睇唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 zi6 tai2 suk1 sai3, ngo5 tai2 m4 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把字體縮小，我看不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make the font smaller; I can't see clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 退缩；畏缩；推脱责任（也可指身体上缩起肩膀）
english_meaning: to shrink back; to chicken out; to back out or shirk responsibility (also physically to draw up one's shoulders)
explanation_mandarin: 「縮膊」在廣東話常用作口語，表示在面對困難或要求時退縮、不願意承擔或幫忙；也可指因害怕或冷而把肩膀縮起來。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to shrink back, be reluctant, or back out (including shirking responsibility). It can also literally mean drawing one's shoulders up from fear or cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好縮膊，快啲幫手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 suk1 bok3, faai3 di1 bong1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要退缩，快点帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't chicken out; hurry up and help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到有困難就縮膊，從來唔肯負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 jau5 kwan3 naan4 zau6 suk1 bok3, cung4 loi4 m4 hang2 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一遇到困难就退缩，从来不肯负责。
examples.english_sentence: He shrinks back whenever he faces difficulties and never takes responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 讓開、退開、躲開
english_meaning: move aside; step aside; back off
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，意思是往後退或讓開，給他人留出空間；常用於催促別人讓路或避開某物或某人。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to move aside or back off to give space; commonly used to urge someone to make way or to avoid something/someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋縮開啲，俾我過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 suk1 hoi1 di1, bei2 ngo5 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你們讓開一點，讓我過。
examples.english_sentence: Move aside a bit, let me pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人擠住唔走，阿媽叫佢哋縮開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 zai1 zyu6 m4 zau2, aa3 maa1 giu3 keoi5 dei6 suk1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人群擠著不走，媽媽叫他們讓開。
examples.english_sentence: People were crowding and wouldn't move, so mum told them to move aside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路見到陌生人會縮開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou6 gin3 dou3 mak6 sang1 jan4 wui5 suk1 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子看到陌生人會退縮/躲開。
examples.english_sentence: The child backs away when he sees strangers.

mandarin_meaning: 退后/让开一点；往后移动一点
english_meaning: Move back a bit; give some space; step aside
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，用來叫對方往後退或讓開一點，常在擠迫或距離太近時使用。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase used to tell someone to move back or make room; commonly used when someone is standing too close or blocking the way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你企得太近，縮開啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 kei5 dak1 taai3 gan6, suk1 hoi1 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你站得太近，退后一点！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, you're standing too close — move back a bit!

mandarin_meaning: 縮頭烏龜 / 懦夫、膽小鬼（口語、貶義）
english_meaning: coward; someone who shirks responsibility or hides from problems (slang, pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，字面意思為「把頭縮起來的烏龜」，用來形容膽小、退縮、不敢面對困難或逃避責任的人，帶有貶義與口語色彩。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term literally meaning 'a turtle that retracts its head.' It describes a person who is cowardly, shrinks from facing difficulties, or shirks responsibility. Informal and often pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到困難唔好做縮頭烏龜，要勇敢面對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 kwan3 naan6 m4 hou2 zou6 suk1 tau4 wu1 gwai1, jiu3 jung5 gam2 min6 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到困難不要做縮頭烏龜，要勇敢面對。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a coward when facing difficulties; face them bravely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢逃避責任，好似個縮頭烏龜咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tou4 bei6 zaak3 jam6, hou2 ci5 go3 suk1 tau4 wu1 gwai1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他逃避責任，好像一個縮頭烏龜。
examples.english_sentence: He shirks responsibility, like a coward.

mandarin_meaning: 縮頭烏龜（意指膽小、遇事退縮的人）
english_meaning: a coward; someone who shrinks back or avoids responsibility (derogatory slang)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容膽小、遇到困難或責任時退縮、不敢面對的人，屬口語貶義詞。
explanation_english: An informal, derogatory term for a person who is cowardly and withdraws or avoids facing difficulties or responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日縮頭龜，遇到困難就走開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 suk1 tau4 gwai1, jyu6 dou3 kwan3 naan6 zau6 zau2 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是縮頭烏龜，遇到困難就躲開。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts like a coward; he runs away when faced with difficulties.

mandarin_meaning: 畏縮；退縮；膽怯
english_meaning: to cower; to shrink back in fear; to chicken out
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語或口語，形容因為害怕或受驚而身體縮起、退縮不敢面對或行動，也可用來形容遇事膽怯、退縮不前。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang verb meaning to cower or shrink back due to fear; to be too frightened to act or to chicken out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚到縮骨，連句說話都唔敢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng1 dou3 suk1 gwat1, lin4 geoi3 syut3 waa6 dou1 m4 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被嚇得縮起來，連一句話都不敢說。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared he shrank back and didn't even dare to say a word.

mandarin_meaning: 摺疊傘 / 可收縮的雨傘
english_meaning: folding umbrella / collapsible umbrella
explanation_mandarin: 指可以折疊、收縮的雨傘，骨架可摺疊，體積小，便於攜帶和放在包內。
explanation_english: A collapsible umbrella with foldable ribs—compact and portable, designed to fold down for easy carrying and storage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我出門帶咗把縮骨遮，落雨都唔驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceot1 mun4 daai3 zo2 baa2 suk1 gwat1 ze1, lok6 jyu5 dou1 m4 geng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我出門帶了把摺疊傘，下雨也不怕。
examples.english_sentence: I brought a folding umbrella when I went out, so I'm not afraid of the rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢把縮骨遮好輕，放喺袋入面好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baa2 suk1 gwat1 ze1 hou2 heng1, fong3 hai2 doi2 jap6 min6 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這把摺疊傘很輕，放在包裡很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This folding umbrella is very light and convenient to keep in the bag.

mandarin_meaning: 畏縮；膽怯或退縮（廣東話俗語）
english_meaning: to shrink back; to cower or chicken out (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「縮髆」是廣東話俗語，表示因害怕、尷尬或怯場而退縮、不敢出面或說話。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to shrink back — to withdraw, cower, or be too timid to speak or act, often from fear or embarrassment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到老細就縮髆，唔敢講真話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 lou5 sai3 zau6 suk1 ku1 m4 gam2 gong2 zan1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他見到老闆就畏縮，不敢說真話。
examples.english_sentence: He shrinks back when he sees the boss and doesn't dare tell the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 縱；放縱；縱使（表示讓步）
english_meaning: to indulge/let loose; (conjunction) even if; vertical/longitudinal (in compounds)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞；連詞（在「縱使」「縱然」等表讓步時）
explanation_mandarin: 「縱」可作動詞，表示放任、縱容或放任不管；在書面語中亦可作連詞，表示讓步或假設（如「縱使」「縱然」）。在某些複合詞中也有縱向、縱橫等含義。
explanation_english: ‘縱’ can be used as a verb meaning to indulge or let loose; in written usage it also functions as a conjunction expressing concession (e.g. '縱使', '縱然' = 'even if'). In some compounds it can refer to vertical/longitudinal or roaming freely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太放縱自己，成日食好多甜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 fong3 zung3 zi6 gei2, seng4 jat6 sik6 hou2 do1 tim4 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太放縱自己，總是吃很多甜食。
examples.english_sentence: He indulges himself too much and always eats a lot of sweets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 縱使你唔嚟，我都會去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 si2 nei5 m4 lai4, ngo5 dou1 wui5 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 縱使你不來，我也會去。
examples.english_sentence: Even if you don't come, I'll still go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好縱佢，佢會變壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zung3 keoi5, keoi5 wui5 bin3 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要縱容他，他會變壞。
examples.english_sentence: Don't indulge him; he'll turn out badly.

mandarin_meaning: 即使；縱然；即便
english_meaning: even if; even though; despite
explanation_mandarin: 用於引出讓步分句，表示即便某種情況成立，後句的結果仍然不受影響或照常發生（相當於「即使⋯也⋯」）。
explanation_english: A conjunction introducing a concessive clause: 'even if' or 'even though', indicating that the main clause holds true despite the condition in the subordinate clause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 縱使今日落大雨，我都會去你屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 si2 gam1 jat6 lok6 daai6 jyu5, ngo5 dou1 wui5 heoi3 nei5 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使今天下大雨，我也會去你家。
examples.english_sentence: Even if it pours today, I will still go to your place.

mandarin_meaning: 寵壞、縱容（使變壞）
english_meaning: to spoil or indulge (someone), causing them to become spoiled or develop bad habits
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指溺愛或縱容某人（通常指小孩），導致對方變得任性或形成不良習慣。
explanation_english: A colloquial verb meaning to spoil or overly indulge someone (often a child), leading them to become willful or pick up bad habits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好縱壞個細路，佢會變得好任性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zung3 waai6 go3 sai3lou6, keoi5 wui5 bin3 dak1 hou2 jam6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要縱壞那個小孩，他會變得很任性。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spoil that child; he'll become very willful.

mandarin_meaning: 縱容（放任、寬容不加制止）
english_meaning: to indulge; to tolerate or condone (bad behavior); to be permissive
explanation_mandarin: 指對不良行為或錯誤採取寬容或放任的態度，不加嚴格制止或糾正，常含有縱容會導致後果惡化的負面含義。
explanation_english: To take a permissive attitude toward bad behavior or mistakes, failing to stop or correct them; often implies that indulgence will lead to worse outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母唔好縱容細路胡亂發脾氣，否則佢會以為咩都得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 m4 hou2 zung3 jung4 sai3 lou6 wu4 lyun6 faat3 pei4 hei3, fau2 zak1 keoi5 wui5 ji5 wai4 me1 dou1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母不要縱容孩子亂發脾氣，否則他會以為什麼都可以。
examples.english_sentence: Parents should not indulge a child in throwing tantrums; otherwise they may think they can get away with anything.

mandarin_meaning: 縱容成性 / 放縱成習
english_meaning: to indulge someone/something until it becomes entrenched; to pamper so that bad habits form
explanation_mandarin: 表示長期縱容某人或某種行為，導致成為習慣或性格的一部分，通常含有負面警示意味。
explanation_english: Indicates long-term indulgence of a person or behavior that becomes a habit or part of one's character; usually a warning with negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母長期溺愛小朋友，縱慣斯勢，最終會出問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 coeng4 kei4 nik6 ngoi3 siu2 pang4 jau5, zung3 gwaan3 si1 sai3, zeoi3 zung1 wui5 ceot1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母長期溺愛小孩，縱容成性，最終會出問題。
examples.english_sentence: If parents indulge their children for a long time, the indulgence will become entrenched and eventually cause problems.

mandarin_meaning: 縱欲（放縱自己的性慾或感官欲望）
english_meaning: to indulge in sexual or sensual desires; to give free rein to one's desires
explanation_mandarin: 指放縱自己的性慾或其他感官的慾望，常含有不節制、過度的意思，常用於道德或健康的語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to giving free rein to one's sexual or sensual desires, often implying a lack of restraint or excess; commonly used in moral or health-related contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日縱慾無度，最後弄到身體出問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zung3 juk6 mou4 dou6, zeoi3 hau6 lung6 dou3 san1 tai2 ceot1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常縱欲無度，最後弄得身體出問題。
examples.english_sentence: He often indulges in sexual pleasures without restraint and ended up with health problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過度縱慾會影響婚姻關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 dou6 zung3 juk6 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 fan1 jan1 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 過度縱欲會影響婚姻關係。
examples.english_sentence: Excessive indulgence in desires can affect marital relationships.

mandarin_meaning: （書面語/文言）即使、縱然，表示讓步
english_meaning: a literary/formal conjunction meaning 'even if' or 'even though' (expressing concession)
explanation_mandarin: 「縱有」多見於書面或文言，表示即使存在某種情況，通常用來引出讓步或對比的從句。
explanation_english: '縱有' is a literary/formal conjunction meaning 'even if' or 'even though'. It introduces a concessive clause, often contrasting with or limiting the main clause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 縱有困難，我哋都要堅持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 jau5 kwan3 naan6, ngo5 dei6 dou1 jiu3 gin1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 縱有困難，我們也要堅持。
examples.english_sentence: Even if there are difficulties, we must persist.

mandarin_meaning: 纵横（縱橫）
english_meaning: to crisscross; to roam freely; to be dominant or widespread; strategic maneuvering
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副詞／形容詞／動詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示縱向和橫向交錯、自由縱行或在某領域內大範圍活動、影響廣泛或運籌帷幄、策略佈局。常見於成語或書面語，如“縱橫捭闔”、“縱橫交錯”。
explanation_english: Indicates crossing in multiple directions, roaming freely, or operating widely and dominantly; often used to describe freedom of movement, broad influence, or strategic maneuvering. Common in idiomatic or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺商界縱橫多年，認識好多人脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 soeng1 gaai3 zung3 wong4 do1 nin4, jing6 sik1 hou2 do1 jan4 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在商界縱橫多年，認識很多人脈。
examples.english_sentence: He has been active across the business world for many years and has many connections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代將軍縱橫沙場，屢建戰功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 zoeng1 gwan1 zung3 wong4 saa1 coeng4, leoi6 gin3 zin3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代將軍縱橫沙場，屢建戰功。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient generals campaigned across the battlefields and repeatedly won military honors.

mandarin_meaning: 纵横交错（错综复杂、交叉重叠的样子）
english_meaning: crisscrossing; intersecting in many directions; intricately intertwined
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成语（形容词/副词性短语）
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物、线路、关系等互相交叉重叠，错综复杂，不易理清。
explanation_english: Describes lines, routes, relationships, etc., that intersect and overlap in many directions—complex, tangled, and not easy to sort out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 城市嘅道路縱橫交錯，好易迷路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 si5 ge3 dou6 lou6 zung3 waang4 gaau1 co3, hou2 ji6 mai4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 城市的道路纵横交错，很容易迷路。
examples.english_sentence: The city's roads crisscross; it's easy to get lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司內部權力縱橫交錯，難以理清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 noi6 bou6 kyun4 lik6 zung3 waang4 gaau1 co3, naan4 ji5 lei5 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司内部权力纵横交错，难以理清。
examples.english_sentence: The company's internal power structures are intertwined and complex, hard to sort out.

mandarin_meaning: 縱火（纵火），放火
english_meaning: to set fire; arson
explanation_mandarin: 指故意引燃物品或建築，造成火災的行為，通常構成犯罪（縱火罪）。
explanation_english: The act of intentionally igniting property or buildings to cause a fire; typically a criminal act (arson).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方懷疑有人晚上故意縱火焚燒嗰座大廈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 waai4 ji4 jau5 jan4 maan5 soeng6 gu3 ji3 zung3 fo2 fan4 siu1 go2 zo6 daai6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方懷疑有人在晚上故意縱火焚燒那棟大廈。
examples.english_sentence: The police suspect someone deliberately set fire to that building at night.

mandarin_meaning: 即使；縱使；雖然（表示讓步）
english_meaning: even if; although (concessive conjunction)
explanation_mandarin: 用來引出讓步或假設的從句，表示即使發生某情況，主要句子的情況仍然成立或不受影響。
explanation_english: A conjunction introducing a concessive or hypothetical clause, meaning 'even if' or 'although', used to express contrast or concession.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 縱然你唔同意，我都會咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung6 jin4 nei5 m4 tung4 ji3, ngo5 dou1 wui5 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使你不同意，我也會這樣做。
examples.english_sentence: Even if you don't agree, I will still do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 縱然落雨，我哋都會去睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung6 jin4 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 dou1 wui5 heoi3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 即使下雨，我們也會去看電影。
examples.english_sentence: Even if it rains, we'll still go to the movies.

mandarin_meaning: 縱觀 (zòngguān)：從整體或長遠角度來看
english_meaning: viewed as a whole; looking across; from a broad/overall perspective
explanation_mandarin: 表示從整體或長遠角度觀察或回顧，常用於書面語，用來引出總括性的評論或結論。
explanation_english: Indicates observing or reviewing from an overall or long-term perspective; typically used in formal/written contexts to introduce a general summary or evaluation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 縱觀整體，我哋需要改變策略。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 gun1 zing2 tai2, ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 goi2 bin3 caak3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 縱觀整體，我們需要改變策略。
examples.english_sentence: Viewed as a whole, we need to change our strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 縱觀歷史，可以見到社會嘅演變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 gun1 lik6 si2, ho2 ji5 gin3 dou2 se5 wui6 ge3 jin2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 縱觀歷史，可以看到社會的演變。
examples.english_sentence: Looking across history, one can see the changes in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 縱觀各國政策，香港有其獨特之處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung3 gun1 gok3 gwok3 caak3 zik1, hoeng1 gong2 jau5 kei4 duk6 dak6 zi1 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 縱觀各國政策，香港有其獨特之處。
examples.english_sentence: When looking across the policies of various countries, Hong Kong has its own unique characteristics.

mandarin_meaning: 牽、拉（舊義）；（合成詞）縴夫：拉船的人
english_meaning: to pull or tow (archaic); (in compounds) a towman who pulls boats
explanation_mandarin: 「縴」為文言或舊時用字，表示用繩索等拉、牽的動作。在合成詞如「縴夫」中作名詞，指拉船的人。
explanation_english: A literary/archaic character meaning to pull or tow (with a rope). In compounds such as 縴夫 it is a noun meaning a towman who pulls boats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前河邊有好多縴夫拉船上岸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ho4 bin1 jau5 hou2 do1 hin1 fu1 laai1 syun4 soeng5 ngon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前河邊有很多縴夫拉船上岸。
examples.english_sentence: In the past there were many towmen by the river pulling boats ashore.

mandarin_meaning: 綁、捆；系緊（把物品用繩、帶等固定）
english_meaning: to bind; to tie; to fasten securely
explanation_mandarin: 表示用繩、帶等把東西捆綁或系緊，使其固定不動。此字較書面或古雅，口語常用「綁、捆」等詞。
explanation_english: Means to bind or tie something with a rope, cord, or strap to secure it. The character is relatively literary/archaic; in speech people often use words like "tie" or "bind".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用繩將箱縶實先搬走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 sing4 zoeng1 soeng1 zik6 sat6 sin1 bun1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用繩子把箱子綁好才搬走。
examples.english_sentence: He tied the box securely with a rope before moving it.

mandarin_meaning: 縷（缕）：細長如絲的線狀物；亦用作量詞（如一縷陽光、一縷白髮），引申為一絲、一點、縷縷的痕跡或希望。
english_meaning: A thin thread or strand; a wisp or trace (used as a classifier in Chinese for thin, threadlike things, or metaphorically as a slight trace or glimmer).
partOfSpeech_english: noun (in Chinese usage also functions as a classifier)
explanation_mandarin: 表示細長如絲的線狀物（如一縷頭髮、一縷陽光），也常用來比喻一點點、微弱的痕跡或希望。
explanation_english: Denotes a thin, thread-like strand (e.g., a strand of hair, a ray of light). Often used metaphorically for a small trace or glimmer (e.g., a sliver of hope).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 窗外有一縷陽光照進房間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng1 ngoi6 jau5 jat1 leoi5 joeng4 gwong1 ziu3 zeon3 fong4 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 窗外有一缕阳光照进房间。
examples.english_sentence: A ray of sunlight is shining into the room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭髮上有幾縷白髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 faat3 soeng6 jau5 gei2 leoi5 baak6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他头发上有几缕白发。
examples.english_sentence: He has a few strands of white hair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲有一縷希望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 jau5 jat1 leoi5 hei1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我还有一缕希望。
examples.english_sentence: I still have a glimmer of hope.

mandarin_meaning: 縹 (piǎo) — 淺青色、淡藍色；引申為渺遠、模糊（如「縹緲」）
english_meaning: A pale blue or light azure color; by extension, something faint, indistinct, or remote (as in the compound 縹緲)
explanation_mandarin: 本字可指淺青或淡藍的顏色（如「縹色」），在詞語中如「縹緲」則表示朦朧、遙遠、難以捉摸。
explanation_english: The character denotes a pale blue or light azure hue (e.g. 縹色). In compounds such as 縹緲 it conveys a sense of haze, vagueness, or remoteness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 霧氣縹緲，遠處個山影若隱若現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou6 hei3 piu3 miu5, jyun5 cyu3 go3 saan1 jing2 joek6 jan2 joek6 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 霧氣縹緲，遠處山影若隱若現。
examples.english_sentence: The mist is faint and hazy; the distant mountain silhouettes appear only faintly.

mandarin_meaning: （書面語）形容遙遠、模糊、飄渺不清，常用於描寫景象或氛圍的虛幻感
english_meaning: A literary adjective meaning distant, indistinct, vague, or ethereal; often used to describe misty or otherworldly scenes or an elusive atmosphere.
explanation_mandarin: 「縹渺」多用於書面或文學語境，描寫景物或感受時的模糊、遙遠或飄渺不定的狀態。
explanation_english: Used mainly in literary contexts to describe a state that is vague, remote, or ethereal—often applied to landscapes shrouded in mist or to an elusive mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山下嘅城市喺晨霧入面顯得縹渺，好似一幅水墨畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 haa6 ge3 sing4 si5 hai2 san4 mou6 jap6 min6 hin2 dak1 piu3 miu5, hou2 ci5 jat1 fuk1 seoi2 mak6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山下的城市在晨雾中显得縹渺，好像一幅水墨画。
examples.english_sentence: The city below the mountain looked vague in the morning mist, like an ink wash painting.

mandarin_meaning: 縛、束縛；捆綁（古義）
english_meaning: to bind; to tie; to restrain (classical/archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 縻為古漢語詞，原指用繩索等捆綁、綁縛，後引申為束縛、牽連或使依附。
explanation_english: A classical Chinese verb meaning to bind or tie (originally with ropes); extended sense includes to restrain, bind, or make dependent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢段古文入面用到「縻」，意思係束縛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dyun6 gu2 man4 jap6 min6 jung6 dou3 'mai4', ji3 si1 hai6 suk1 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这段古文中使用了“縻”，意思是束缚。
examples.english_sentence: This passage of classical text uses '縻', meaning to bind or restrain.

mandarin_meaning: 總 / zǒng（總是、總共、總經理、總結）
english_meaning: always; in total; general/overall; chief; to sum up
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 / 名词 / 动词
explanation_mandarin: 「總」可作副詞表示「總是、一直」；可作前綴或名詞表示「總的、首要的、總經理」等；也可用作動詞表示「總結、合計」。在粵語日常口語中常見用法如「總係」、「總之」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "總" (zung2) is used as an adverb meaning "always" or "in any case"; as a prefix/noun meaning "general/overall" or "chief" (e.g. general manager); and as a verb meaning "to sum up" or "total." Common colloquial uses include "總係" (always) and "總之" (in short).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你總係遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung2 hai6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你總是遲到。
examples.english_sentence: You are always late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總之，我哋要快啲決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 zi1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 總之，我們要快點決定。
examples.english_sentence: In short, we need to decide quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅總經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 zung2 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是公司的總經理。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is the company's general manager.

mandarin_meaning: 总之
english_meaning: in short; anyway; to sum up
explanation_mandarin: 用來總結、概括或引出結論，有「總而言之」「反正」的意思。
explanation_english: Used to summarize, conclude, or introduce a final point/decision; similar to 'in short' or 'anyway'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總之，呢件事唔好再提。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 zi1, ni1 gin6 si6 m4 hou2 zoi3 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总之，这件事不要再提了。
examples.english_sentence: In short, don't bring up this matter again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家時間唔夠，總之先做呢啲最緊要嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 si4 gaan3 m4 gau3, zung2 zi1 sin1 zou6 ni1 di1 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在时间不够，总之先做这些最重要的。
examples.english_sentence: We don't have enough time now; in short, do the most important things first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總之，你要記住帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 zi1, nei5 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 daai3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总之，你要记得带钥匙。
examples.english_sentence: Anyway, make sure you bring your keys.

mandarin_meaning: 总代理
english_meaning: general agent; exclusive/sole distributor
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一地区或领域代表品牌或公司负责整体代理、分销或授权的主要或唯一代理商。
explanation_english: A principal or exclusive agent appointed to represent a brand/company in a particular territory or market, responsible for distribution, licensing, or overall agency duties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係呢間公司喺香港嘅總代理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 zung2 doi6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是这家公司在香港的总代理。
examples.english_sentence: They are this company's general agent in Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 总是 (经常、老是)
english_meaning: always; keeps on; tends to (habitually)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事经常发生或习惯性地发生，常带有无奈、抱怨或习惯性的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens frequently or habitually; often conveys a tone of annoyance, resignation, or habitual tendency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢總係遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung2 hai6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到。
examples.english_sentence: He always arrives late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你總係諗太多，放輕鬆啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung2 hai6 lam2 taai3 do1, fong3 hing1 sung1 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是想太多，放轻松一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: You always overthink — relax a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次總係我唔啱，唔好再講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zung2 hai6 ngo5 m4 ngaam1, m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次总是我不对，别再说了。
examples.english_sentence: This time it's my fault as usual, don't talk about it anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 总值（总价值、总和）
english_meaning: total value; aggregate value
explanation_mandarin: 表示若干項目或資產加起來的總價值或總和，常用於財務、會計或估價等情境。
explanation_english: Refers to the combined or aggregate value of items or assets; commonly used in finance, accounting, and valuation contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅總值已經超過一百億。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zung2 zik6 ji5 ging1 ciu1 gwo3 jat1 baak3 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间公司的总值已经超过一百亿。
examples.english_sentence: The company's total value has already exceeded 10 billion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你計算咗所有資產嘅總值未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gai3 syun3 zo2 so2 jau5 zi1 caan2 ge3 zung2 zik6 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你算过所有资产的总值了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you calculated the total value of all the assets?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰幅畫嘅總值真係難以估計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 fuk1 waa2 ge3 zung2 zik6 zan1 hai6 naan4 ji5 gu2 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那幅画的总值确实难以估计。
examples.english_sentence: The total value of that painting is indeed hard to estimate.

mandarin_meaning: 总公司
english_meaning: head office; headquarters; parent company
explanation_mandarin: 指企業的總部或負責管理各分支機構的公司，通常為最高管理單位；有時亦可指母公司或控股公司。
explanation_english: Refers to a company's main office or headquarters that oversees and coordinates its branches; can also refer to the parent company or holding company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要向總公司申請批准。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heung3 zung2 gung1 si1 san1 cing2 pei1 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要向总公司申请批准。
examples.english_sentence: We need to apply to the head office for approval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總公司下個月會派人嚟視察我哋嘅分公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 paai3 jan4 lai4 si6 caat3 ngo5 dei6 ge3 fan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总公司下个月会派人来视察我们的分公司。
examples.english_sentence: The head office will send people to inspect our branch next month.

mandarin_meaning: 总共
english_meaning: in total; altogether; overall
explanation_mandarin: 表示把數量或情況合起來計算，指總計或合計的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates the total amount or sum when combining quantities or situations; means in total/altogether.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度總共幾多錢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 zung2 gung6 gei2 do1 cin2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡總共多少錢？
examples.english_sentence: How much is it in total here?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋總共有十個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung2 gung6 jau5 sap6 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們總共有十個人。
examples.english_sentence: There are ten of us in total.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月開支總共超過三千蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 hoi1 zi1 zung2 gung6 ciu1 gwo3 saam1 cin1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個月支出總共超過三千元。
examples.english_sentence: This month's expenses total over $3,000.

mandarin_meaning: 总动员（动员全部人员或资源）
english_meaning: mobilization; all-out mobilization; calling everyone to take part
explanation_mandarin: 表示动员所有人力或资源去完成某项任务，常用于紧急、重要或大规模的行动场合。
explanation_english: Indicates mobilizing all people or resources to carry out a task; often used for urgent, important, or large-scale actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司為咗應付節日高峰，要總動員大家加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 jing3 fu6 zit3 jat6 gou1 fung1, jiu3 zung2 dung6 jyun4 daai6 gaa1 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司为了应对节日高峰，要动员大家加班。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to mobilize everyone to work overtime to handle the holiday peak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府宣布總動員軍隊協助救災。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 zung2 dung6 jyun4 gwan1 deoi2 hip3 zo6 gau3 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府宣布总动员军队协助救灾。
examples.english_sentence: The government announced the mobilization of the military to assist in disaster relief.

mandarin_meaning: 总务 (负责日常事务、后勤或行政工作的部门或职位)
english_meaning: general affairs; general administration (department or duties handling daily affairs, logistics, and administrative tasks)
explanation_mandarin: 指組織中負責日常事務、後勤或行政工作的部門或職位，處理例如設備維修、採購、辦公室管理等事宜。
explanation_english: Refers to a department or position within an organization responsible for daily affairs, logistics, or administrative tasks — e.g., equipment maintenance, procurement, and office management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅總務負責辦公室嘅日常事務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 zung2 mou6 fu6 zaak3 baan6 gung1 sat1 ge3 jat6 soeng4 si6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的总务负责办公室的日常事务。
examples.english_sentence: The general affairs department at our company handles the office's daily tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校總務處喺處理設備維修同採購。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 zung2 mou6 cyu3 hai2 cyu3 lei5 cit3 bei6 wai4 sau1 tung4 coi2 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校总务处在处理设备维修和采购。
examples.english_sentence: The school's general affairs office is handling equipment maintenance and procurement.

mandarin_meaning: 总司令 (zǒng sīlìng)
english_meaning: commander-in-chief; supreme commander
explanation_mandarin: 指军队或组织的最高指挥官；也可作比喻，用来形容在某个团队或事务中掌握最高指挥权的人。
explanation_english: Refers to the highest commanding officer of an army or organization; can also be used figuratively to describe someone who exercises top authority in a team or project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被任命為總司令，負責統領全部部隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jam6 ming6 wai4 zung2 si1 ling6, fu6 zaak3 tung2 ling5 cyun4 bou6 bou6 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被任命为总司令，负责统领全部部队。
examples.english_sentence: He was appointed commander-in-chief, responsible for leading all the troops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個項目入面，佢成日扮總司令，乜都要決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jap6 min6, keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 zung2 si1 ling6, mat1 dou1 jiu3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个项目里面，他总爱摆出总司令的样子，什么都想决定。
examples.english_sentence: In this project, he always acts like the commander-in-chief, wanting to decide everything.

mandarin_meaning: 总和 / zǒnghé
english_meaning: sum; total; aggregate
explanation_mandarin: 表示若干项相加后得到的总数或整体的汇总。
explanation_english: Refers to the total obtained by adding several items together or an overall aggregate/summary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲數字嘅總和係一百二十。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sou3zi6 ge3 zung2 wo4 hai6 jat1 baak3 ji6 sap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些数字的总和是一百二十。
examples.english_sentence: The sum of these numbers is 120.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家我哋要睇下每位學生嘅分數總和。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 haa5 mui5 wai2 hok6saang1 ge3 fan1sou3 zung2 wo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在我们要看看每位学生的分数总和。
examples.english_sentence: Now we need to look at each student's total score.

mandarin_meaning: 總比沒有好／至少還算好
english_meaning: better than nothing; at least it's better than (doing nothing or having none)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，用來表示某事雖然不是最佳，但總比沒有或完全不做要好。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to indicate that something, while not ideal, is preferable to having nothing or doing nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢遲到，但總好過唔嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 ci4 dou3, daan6 zung2 hou2 gwo3 m4 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然他遲到了，但總比不來好。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's late, it's still better than not coming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次只有十個座位，總好過一個都冇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zi2 jau5 sap6 go3 zo6 wai2, zung2 hou2 gwo3 jat1 go3 dou1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次只有十個座位，總比一個都沒有好。
examples.english_sentence: This time there are only ten seats; it's better than having none.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係有啲零用錢，總好過完全冇錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 jau5 di1 ling4 jung6 cin2, zung2 hou2 gwo3 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只有一些零用錢，總比完全沒有錢好。
examples.english_sentence: I only have some pocket money; it's better than having no money at all.

mandarin_meaning: 总局；中央或主管某类事务的机关或部门
english_meaning: central bureau; head office; headquarters; the main agency overseeing a particular set of affairs
explanation_mandarin: 指负责统筹、管理某一类事务的中央机构或部门，常用于政府或大型机构的部门名称。
explanation_english: Refers to a central bureau or office responsible for coordinating and managing a particular area of affairs; commonly used in names of government agencies or major organizations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事要報總局批准。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jiu3 bou3 zung2 guk6 pai1 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事要报总局批准。
examples.english_sentence: This matter needs to be reported to the central bureau for approval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公安總局已發出通知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 on1 zung2 guk6 ji5 faat3 ceot1 tung1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公安总局已发出通知。
examples.english_sentence: The Public Security Bureau has issued a notice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺總局做行政管理工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zung2 guk6 zou6 hang4 zing3 gun2 lei5 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在总局做行政管理工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works in administrative management at the headquarters.

mandarin_meaning: 总店 (zǒngdiàn) — 主要分店或店铺的总部/总公司分支
english_meaning: main branch; head store; flagship store (the main outlet that oversees other branches)
explanation_mandarin: 指連鎖店或多間分店中負責管理、協調其他分店的主要店鋪或總部所在地，通常是最早開或規模較大的分店。
explanation_english: Refers to the main store or head branch of a chain or business that oversees and manages the other branches; often the original or largest outlet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅總店喺銅鑼灣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zung2 dim3 hai2 tung4 lo4 waan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家餐廳的總店在銅鑼灣。
examples.english_sentence: The main branch of this restaurant is in Causeway Bay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總店負責管理所有分店，包含採購同培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 dim3 fu6 zaak3 gun2 lei5 so2 jau5 fan1 dim3, baau1 ham4 coi2 gok3 tung4 pui4 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 總店負責管理所有分店，包含採購和培訓。
examples.english_sentence: The head store is responsible for managing all branches, including purchasing and training.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺總店做經理，之前喺分店工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 zung2 dim3 zou6 ging1 lei5, zi1 cin4 hai2 fan1 dim3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她現在在總店擔任經理，之前在分店工作。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is now a manager at the main branch; previously worked at a branch.

mandarin_meaning: 總得 / 總要 / 必須（至少要）
english_meaning: must; have to; should; at least
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事是必須的、總要發生的或至少應該做的，用來強調必要性或最低要求。
explanation_english: Used to indicate necessity or that something must/should happen; can also convey 'at least' or the minimum requirement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你總得試下先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung2 dak1 si3 haa5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你總得試一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: You should at least give it a try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事總得有人負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 zung2 dak1 jau5 jan4 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事總得有人負責。
examples.english_sentence: Someone has to be responsible for this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論點做，總得搵個方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 dim2 zou6, zung2 dak1 wan2 go3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 無論怎麼做，總得找到一個方法。
examples.english_sentence: No matter what we do, we still have to find a way.

mandarin_meaning: 总括；概括、总结
english_meaning: to summarize; to sum up; to give an overall view
explanation_mandarin: 对若干事物或情况作概括性的归纳或总结，给出总体的评价或概览。
explanation_english: To give a general summary or overview of things or a situation; to sum up the main points.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家總括嚟講，呢個計劃值得投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zung2kwaat3 lai4 gong2, ni1 go3 gai3waak6 zik1dak1 tau4zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在总括来说，这个计划值得投资。
examples.english_sentence: To summarize now, this plan is worth investing in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢總括負責整個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung2kwaat3 fu6zaak3 zing2go3 hong6muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总括负责整个项目。
examples.english_sentence: He is overall responsible for the entire project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總括嚟講，成績有進步，但仍然有改善嘅空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2kwaat3 lai4 gong2, sing4zik1 jau5 zeon3bou6, daan6 jing4jin4 jau5 goi2sin6 ge3 hung1gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总括来说，成绩有进步，但仍然有改进的空间。
examples.english_sentence: In summary, the results have improved, but there is still room for improvement.

mandarin_meaning: 总开关；主要的控制开关；（引申）掌控全局的人或控制权
english_meaning: master switch; main switch; (figurative) the person or control that holds overall power
explanation_mandarin: 指控制整個系統或裝置的主要開關，用於實際設備時也可比喻指掌控全局的人或關鍵控制權。
explanation_english: Refers to the main switch that controls an entire system or device. It can also be used figuratively to mean the person or control that holds overall authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果發生火警，要即刻切斷總掣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 faat3 sang1 fo2 ging2, jiu3 zik1 haak1 cit3 dyun6 zung2 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果发生火警，要立刻切断总开关。
examples.english_sentence: If there's a fire, turn off the master switch immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 总揽 (zǒnglǎn) — 掌握全局；全面负责
english_meaning: to take overall charge; to oversee; to have overall control
explanation_mandarin: 表示對整體事務進行全面掌管或負責，強調對全局的統籌與控制。
explanation_english: Indicates taking overall responsibility or control of something, emphasizing coordination and oversight of the whole picture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面負責總攬大局。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 fu6 zaak3 zung2 laam5 daai6 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡負責總攬大局。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for overseeing the overall situation at the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要一個人總攬成個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 go3 jan4 zung2 laam5 sing4 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們需要一個人來總攬整個項目。
examples.english_sentence: We need one person to take overall charge of the entire project.

mandarin_meaning: 总数 (zǒngshù)
english_meaning: total; total number; sum
explanation_mandarin: 表示某一集合或项目的总和或总数量，通常用来指总数目或总计。
explanation_english: Refers to the total sum or overall count of a set of items or quantities; used to indicate the total number or aggregate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅總數係一百二十。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 zung2 sou3 hai6 jat1 baak3 ji6 sap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的总数是一百二十。
examples.english_sentence: The total number for this project is 120.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你提供全部項目嘅總數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 tai4 gung1 cyun4 bou6 hong6 muk6 ge3 zung2 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你提供全部项目的总数。
examples.english_sentence: Please provide the total number of all items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報告入面寫咗員工總數有五百五十人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 se2 zo2 jyun4 gung1 zung2 sou3 jau5 ng5 baak3 ng5 sap6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报告里面写了员工总数有五百五十人。
examples.english_sentence: The report states that the total number of employees is 550.

mandarin_meaning: 总是（經常、一直）
english_meaning: always; invariably; often
explanation_mandarin: 表示頻率，意思為一直或經常發生。書面語常用「總是」，口語中粵語常用「總係」或「成日」。
explanation_english: An adverb indicating frequency — that something happens always or repeatedly. In Cantonese speech, speakers often use variants like "總係" (zung2 hai6) or "成日" (seng4 jat6).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你總是遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung2 si6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你總是遲到。
examples.english_sentence: You are always late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢總是忘記我講過嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung2 si6 mong4 gei3 ngo5 gong2 gwo3 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是忘記我說過的事。
examples.english_sentence: He always forgets what I said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我總是覺得有啲唔放心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung2 si6 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 m4 fong3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我總是覺得有點不放心。
examples.english_sentence: I always feel a bit uneasy.

mandarin_meaning: 總書記（zǒngshūjì）：通常指政黨或組織的最高領導職務，常用於中國共產黨的最高領導人。
english_meaning: General Secretary: the top leadership position of a political party or organization, commonly used for the highest leader of the Chinese Communist Party.
explanation_mandarin: 指政黨或組織內負責全面領導的書記職務，尤指中國共產黨內的最高領導人或黨中央的最高職務。
explanation_english: Refers to the secretary position responsible for overall leadership in a party or organization; especially the top leader of the Chinese Communist Party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中國嘅總書記通常係黨內最高領導人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 gwok3 ge3 zung2 syu1 gei3 tung1 soeng4 hai6 dong2 noi6 zeoi3 gou1 ling5 dou6 jan4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中国的总书记通常是党内的最高领导人。
examples.english_sentence: The General Secretary in China is usually the highest leader within the party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新任總書記發表咗重要講話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jam6 zung2 syu1 gei3 faat3 biu2 zo2 zung6 joeng6 gong2 waa6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新任总书记发表了重要讲话。
examples.english_sentence: The new General Secretary delivered an important speech.

mandarin_meaning: 总会 (遲早會/肯定會發生)
english_meaning: will eventually / will surely / inevitably
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某件事遲早或必然會發生，常用來安慰或表示肯定的語氣。例如「總會有辦法」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something will happen eventually or is bound to happen; often used to reassure or express certainty (e.g., "there will always be a way").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁灰心，總會有辦法嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 fui1 sam1, zung2 wui5 jau5 baan6 faat3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別那麼灰心，總會有辦法的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so discouraged; there will always be a way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢總會遲到，你唔好等佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung2 wui5 ci4 dou3, nei5 m4 hou2 dang2 keoi5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是會遲到，你別等他了。
examples.english_sentence: He always ends up being late; don't wait for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總會有一日你會明白佢嘅苦心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 wui5 jau5 jat1 jat6 nei5 wui5 ming4 baak6 keoi5 ge3 fu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 總有一天你會明白他的苦心。
examples.english_sentence: Someday you'll understand his good intentions.

mandarin_meaning: 总有 (zǒng yǒu)
english_meaning: always; inevitably; there will be
explanation_mandarin: 表示必然、终究会发生或存在，常用来强调某事迟早会出现或总是存在。
explanation_english: Indicates certainty or inevitability — that something will exist or happen eventually; often used to emphasize that there will always be or that something is bound to occur.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生總有起伏，唔好太灰心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 zung2 jau5 hei2 fuk1, m4 hou2 taai3 fui1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生总有起伏，不要太灰心。
examples.english_sentence: Life always has ups and downs; don't be too discouraged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好擔心，總有辦法解決嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daam1 sam1, zung2 jau5 baan6 faat3 gaai2 kyut3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别担心，总有办法解决的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry; there's always a way to solve it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總有一日我會再返香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 jau5 jat1 jat6 ngo5 wui5 zoi3 faan1 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总有一天我会再回香港。
examples.english_sentence: One day I'll return to Hong Kong.

mandarin_meaning: 总机
english_meaning: switchboard; (telephone) operator; PBX (private branch exchange)
explanation_mandarin: 指電話系統中的總接線裝置（或總機設備），或指負責接聽並轉接電話的接線員/總機人員，也可指公司內的交換機（PBX）。
explanation_english: Refers to the telephone switchboard or the operator who answers and connects phone calls; can also mean the main telephone exchange device (PBX) within an organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有部總機，負責轉接來電。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 bou6 zung2 gei1, fu6 zaak3 zyun2 zip3 loi4 din6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有部总机，负责转接来电。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a switchboard that handles incoming calls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打電話畀總機，搵張小姐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 zung2 gei1, wan2 zoeng1 siu2 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打电话给总机，找张小姐。
examples.english_sentence: I called the operator to ask for Miss Cheung.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果總機壞咗，就打唔到分機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 zung2 gei1 waai6 zo2, zau6 daa2 m4 dou3 fan1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果总机坏了，就打不到分机。
examples.english_sentence: If the main switchboard is down, you cannot reach the extensions.

mandarin_meaning: 总理（国家或政府的首脑）；管理、处理（动词用法）
english_meaning: Prime minister / premier; (verb) to manage or handle
partOfSpeech_english: Noun (primary); can also be used as a verb
explanation_mandarin: 「總理」主要指國家或政府的首腦，相當於「總理」或「首相」。在口語或書面語中，有時也用作動詞，表示管理或處理事務。
explanation_english: "總理" primarily denotes the head of government (prime minister/premier). It can also be used as a verb in contexts meaning to manage or handle affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋國家嘅總理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 zung2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们国家的总理。
examples.english_sentence: He is the prime minister of our country.

mandarin_meaning: 总的来说 / 总体而言
english_meaning: overall; in general; generally speaking
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 / 过渡语（用于引出概括性结论）
explanation_mandarin: 用來概括性地總結或引出結論，表示從整體角度來看情況如何。
explanation_english: Used to summarize or introduce a general conclusion; indicates the overall situation or general view.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總的來說，今次會議係成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 dik1 loi4 syut3, gam1 ci3 wui6 ji5 hai6 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总的来说，这次会议是成功的。
examples.english_sentence: Overall, this meeting was successful.

mandarin_meaning: 總的來說（概括、總結）
english_meaning: overall; in general; to sum up
explanation_mandarin: 用於概括前面說過的內容或引出總結性的觀點，相當於「總的來說」「總之」。
explanation_english: Used to summarize previous points or introduce an overall conclusion; equivalent to 'overall', 'in general', or 'to sum up'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總的來説，今次嘅報告令人滿意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 dik1 loi4 syut3, gam1 ci3 ge3 bou3 gou3 ling6 jan4 mun5 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 總的來說，這次的報告令人滿意。
examples.english_sentence: Overall, this report is satisfactory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總的來説，我哋今次做得唔錯，但仲有改進嘅空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 dik1 loi4 syut3, ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 zou6 dak1 m4 co3, daan6 zung6 jau5 goi2 zeon3 ge3 hung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 總的來說，我們這次做得不錯，但還有改進的空間。
examples.english_sentence: Overall, we did well this time, but there's still room for improvement.

mandarin_meaning: 總監（总监）：負責某一部門或領域的高級主管，負責監督、管理與決策。
english_meaning: Director; a senior executive in charge of a department or area, responsible for supervision, management, and decision-making.
explanation_mandarin: 「總監」通常是公司或機構內的職稱，指負責某一部門或專案的高階管理人員，主要職責包括監督團隊、制定策略及最終決策。
explanation_english: “總監” is a job title in companies or organizations referring to a senior manager in charge of a department or function, whose duties include supervising teams, setting strategy, and making key decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係我哋嘅財務總監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 coi4 mou6 zung2 gaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在是我們的財務總監。
examples.english_sentence: He is now our financial director.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會時總監提出咗一個新方案，大家要評估可行性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 si4 zung2 gaam1 tai4 ceot1 zo2 jat1 go3 san1 fong1 on3, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 ping4 gu1 ho2 hang4 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 會議時總監提出了一個新方案，大家要評估可行性。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting, the director proposed a new plan; everyone needs to assess its feasibility.

mandarin_meaning: 總督（zǒngdū）：地方或殖民地的最高行政長官，例如香港總督。
english_meaning: Governor-general; a high-ranking administrative official (viceroy) in charge of civil, military and fiscal affairs over multiple provinces or a colony.
explanation_mandarin: 總督是歷史上或殖民地時期設置的高級官職，通常負責多個省份或整個殖民地的軍政與財政管理，權限較大，例子包括清朝的總督與英國時期的香港總督。
explanation_english: A historical or colonial-era high-ranking official (governor-general or viceroy) who oversaw military, civil and fiscal administration across several provinces or an entire colony. The position often held broad authority; e.g., Qing-era governor-generals or the Governor of Hong Kong during British rule.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清朝嗰陣，總督要負責管轄幾個省份嘅軍政事務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ciu4 go2 zan6, zung2 duk1 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 gun2 hat6 gei2 go3 saang2 fan6 ge3 gwan1 zing3 si6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清朝時期，總督要負責管轄幾個省份的軍政事務。
examples.english_sentence: During the Qing dynasty, a governor-general was responsible for overseeing military and civil affairs across several provinces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 回歸前，香港由英國任命嘅總督負責管理呢個殖民地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui4 gwai1 cin4, hoeng1 gong2 jau4 jing1 gwok3 jam6 ming6 ge3 zung2 duk1 fu6 zaak3 gun2 lei5 ni1 go3 zik6 man4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 回歸前，香港由英國任命的總督負責管理這個殖民地。
examples.english_sentence: Before the handover, the Governor of Hong Kong appointed by Britain was responsible for administering the colony.

mandarin_meaning: 总称；统称
english_meaning: collective name; to collectively call/refer to
explanation_mandarin: 表示把多種事物歸為一個總的名稱或稱呼。可作動詞（總稱為…）或作名詞（是一個總稱）。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that several items are grouped under one general name. Can function as a verb (to collectively call/refer to) or as a noun (a collective name).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲水果可以總稱為熱帶水果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 seoi2 gwo2 ho2 ji5 zung2 cing1 wai4 jit6 daai3 seoi2 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些水果可以总称为热带水果。
examples.english_sentence: These fruits can be collectively referred to as tropical fruits.

mandarin_meaning: 总站；终点站
english_meaning: terminus; final stop (of a bus/train/route)
explanation_mandarin: 指公交、電車或火車等路線的終點站或主要樞紐站，也可指車輛返回停放或調度的總站/車廠位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the final stop or terminus of a public transport route (bus, tram, train) or a main hub/depot where vehicles finish service or are dispatched.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺總站落車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 zung2 zaam6 lok6 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在总站下车。
examples.english_sentence: We got off at the terminus.

mandarin_meaning: 總算 / 終於（表示經過等待或困難後，事情終於發生或達成）
english_meaning: at last; finally; after all
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示經過等待、努力或困難之後，事情終於發生或達成，帶有鬆一口氣或總算完成的語氣。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that something has finally happened or been accomplished after difficulty, delay, or waiting; often conveys a sense of relief.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我總算到咗，唔使等我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung2 syun3 dou3 zo2, m4 sai2 dang2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我總算到了，不用等我。
examples.english_sentence: I finally arrived; you don't need to wait for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢總算攞到份工，真係好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung2 syun3 lo2 dou3 fan6 gung1, zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總算找到工作，真的很開心。
examples.english_sentence: He finally got the job; he's really happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等咗咁耐，總算有回覆啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zo2 gam2 noi6, zung2 syun3 jau5 wui4 fuk1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等了這麼久，總算有回覆了。
examples.english_sentence: After waiting so long, there's finally a reply.

mandarin_meaning: 总管（負責管理或掌管的人/職位；也可作動詞，表示負責管理）
english_meaning: manager; person in charge; to be in charge of / to manage
explanation_mandarin: 指負責管理或掌管某事的人或職位；也可作動詞，表示掌管、管理。常見於工作、機構或家庭內部的分工稱呼。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is responsible for managing or overseeing something, or the position itself; can also be used as a verb meaning to supervise or manage. Common in workplace, organizational, or household contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅總管係阿明，佢負責調度同埋安排員工嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zung2 gun2 hai6 aa3 ming4, keoi5 fu6 zaak3 diu6 dou6 tung4 maai4 on1 paai4 jyun4 gung1 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳的總管是阿明，他負責調度並安排員工的工作。
examples.english_sentence: The head manager of this restaurant is Ah Ming; he is responsible for scheduling and arranging the staff's work.

mandarin_meaning: 总结 (zǒngjié)
english_meaning: to summarize; summary; to conclude
explanation_mandarin: 總結指對事情或材料進行概括、歸納或作出結論，可用作動詞（對⋯進行總結）或名詞（做一個總結）。
explanation_english: To summarize or make a summary; to draw conclusions. It can function as a verb (to summarize) or as a noun (a summary).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開完會我會寫個總結畀你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 jyun4 wui6 ngo5 wui5 se2 go3 zung2 git3 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開完會我會寫個總結給你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll write a summary for you after the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總結嚟講，今次個計劃都算成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 git3 lai4 gong2, gam1 ci3 go3 gai3 waak6 dou1 syun3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 總結來說，這次計劃算是成功的。
examples.english_sentence: In summary, this project is considered a success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師要我哋寫份總結，總括成個學期嘅學習進展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 se2 fan6 zung2 git3, zung2 kut3 seng4 go3 hok6 kei4 ge3 hok6 zaap6 zeon3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師要我們寫一份總結，總括整個學期的學習進展。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher asked us to write a summary that summarizes the learning progress for the whole term.

mandarin_meaning: 总统 (zǒngtǒng) — 国家的元首或政府首脑，通常由选举产生
english_meaning: President — the head of state or head of government in a republic, typically elected
explanation_mandarin: 指由選舉或其他方式產生，代表國家並負責領導與管理政府事務的最高官員（國家元首或政府首腦）。
explanation_english: Refers to the highest official (head of state or head of government) in a republic, usually elected and responsible for leading and administering the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新任總統下個月就職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jam6 zung2 tung2 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新任总统下个月就职。
examples.english_sentence: The newly elected president will take office next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總統喺記者會上回應咗經濟問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 tung2 hai2 gei3 ze2 wui2 soeng6 wui4 jing3 zo2 ging1 zai3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总统在记者会上回应了经济问题。
examples.english_sentence: The president responded to questions about the economy at the press conference.

mandarin_meaning: 总统套房（酒店中最豪华的套房）
english_meaning: presidential suite (the most luxurious suite in a hotel); figuratively, extremely luxurious accommodation or lifestyle
explanation_mandarin: 指飯店或酒店內最豪華、設備最齊全的套房；也可用作比喻，形容居住或生活方式極為奢華。
explanation_english: Refers to the most luxurious, fully equipped suite in a hotel; can also be used figuratively to describe someone’s extremely lavish accommodation or lifestyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚住總統套房，景觀好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 zyu6 zung2 tung2 tou3 fong4, ging2 gwaan1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚住总统套房，景观很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: We're staying in the presidential suite tonight; the view is beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次訂咗最高級嘅總統套房，為重要客人準備。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 deng6 zo2 zeoi3 gou1 kap1 ge3 zung2 tung2 tou3 fong4, wai6 zung6 joeng6 haak3 jan4 zeon2 bei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次订了最高级的总统套房，为重要客人准备。
examples.english_sentence: He booked the top-tier presidential suite this time to host important guests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住得好闊綽，好似住緊總統套房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 dak1 hou2 fut3 coek3, hou2 ci5 zyu6 gan2 zung2 tung2 tou3 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生活很阔绰，好像住在总统套房。
examples.english_sentence: He lives very lavishly, as if he's staying in a presidential suite.

mandarin_meaning: 总经理 (zǒng jīng lǐ)
english_meaning: general manager; senior executive responsible for overall management and operations of a company or organization
explanation_mandarin: 企業中負責全面管理和營運的高層主管，通常對公司日常運作與策略執行負最終責任。
explanation_english: A senior executive who is responsible for the overall management and operations of a company or organization, typically accountable for daily operations and implementation of strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司啱啱請咗個新總經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 aam1 aam1 ceng2 zo2 go3 san1 zung2 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司刚刚请了一个新任总经理。
examples.english_sentence: Our company just hired a new general manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司新嘅總經理幾有經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 san1 ge3 zung2 ging1 lei5 gei2 jau5 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的新任总经理很有经验。
examples.english_sentence: The new general manager of our company is very experienced.

mandarin_meaning: 总编辑；总编
english_meaning: editor-in-chief; chief editor
explanation_mandarin: 在新聞、雜誌或出版機構中負責整體編輯工作的最高編輯職位，通常負責內容取捨、編輯方針與最終審定。
explanation_english: The highest editorial position at a news outlet, magazine, or publishing house; responsible for overall editorial direction, content decisions, and final approvals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總編話要喺下星期前交稿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 bin1 waa6 jiu3 hai6 haa6 sing1 kei4 cin4 gaau1 gou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总编说要在下星期之前交稿。
examples.english_sentence: The editor-in-chief said the manuscript must be submitted before next week.

mandarin_meaning: 總負責編輯工作的主管或最高編輯人員，負責統籌編輯團隊、審核內容並決定出版或發佈的最終版本。
english_meaning: editor-in-chief — the senior editor who heads the editorial team, oversees content, and makes final decisions on publication.
explanation_mandarin: 新聞、雜誌或出版社中負責整體編輯方針與最終把關的人，通常有權決定稿件的取捨與修改方向。
explanation_english: The person responsible for the overall editorial direction and final approval of content in a newspaper, magazine, or publishing house; typically has authority to accept, reject, or revise submissions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱被委任做呢份報紙嘅總編輯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aam1 aam1 bei6 wai2 jam6 zou6 ni1 fan6 bou3 zi2 ge3 zung2 bin1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛被任命為這份報紙的總編輯。
examples.english_sentence: He was just appointed editor-in-chief of this newspaper.

mandarin_meaning: 总而言之（zǒng ér yán zhī），相當於「總之」
english_meaning: In short; in summary; to sum up
explanation_mandarin: 用來引出總結或概括性的說法，表示對前述內容進行歸納或結論。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a summary or general conclusion; signals a brief recap or the speaker's overall point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總而言之，我哋要繼續努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 ji4 jin4 zi1, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总而言之，我们要继续努力。
examples.english_sentence: In short, we need to keep working hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總而言之，呢單買賣冇利潤，唔值得做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 ji4 jin4 zi1, ni1 dan1 maai5 maai6 mou5 lei6 jeon6, m4 zik1 dak1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总而言之，这笔买卖没有利润，不值得做。
examples.english_sentence: All in all, this deal has no profit and isn't worth doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總而言之，佢遲到嘅原因就係塞車同埋落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 ji4 jin4 zi1, keoi5 ci4 dou3 ge3 jyun4 jan4 zau6 hai6 sak1 ce1 tung4 maai4 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总而言之，他迟到的原因就是塞车和下雨。
examples.english_sentence: In short, the reason he was late was traffic jams and rain.

mandarin_meaning: 总行；总公司/总部（尤指银行的总行）
english_meaning: head office; headquarters (especially of a bank)
explanation_mandarin: 指銀行或其他機構的總部或主要分行，通常為管理與決策的中心，尤指銀行的總行。
explanation_english: Refers to the head office or main branch of a bank or organization; the central office responsible for management and decision-making (commonly used for banks).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽講呢間銀行嘅總行喺中環。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 gong2 ni1 gaan1 ngan4 hong4 ge3 zung2 hong4 hai2 zung1 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说这家银行的总行在中环。
examples.english_sentence: I heard the bank's head office is in Central.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定將啲文件送返總行處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 di1 man4 gin2 sung3 faan1 zung2 hong4 cyu3 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定把这些文件送回总行处理。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to send these documents back to the head office for processing.

mandarin_meaning: 总裁（公司或機構的最高管理者，常指總經理或首席執行官）
english_meaning: president; CEO; chief executive; the top executive of a company or organization
explanation_mandarin: 指公司或機構的最高管理者，通常指總經理或首席執行官（CEO）。在口語或小說中也常用來描述有權勢或強勢的領導形象。
explanation_english: Refers to the top executive of a company or organization (often the CEO). Also used descriptively to portray a powerful or commanding leader persona.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司新任總裁今日會嚟視察分公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 san1 jam6 zung2 coi4 gam1 jat6 wui5 lai4 si6 caat3 fan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的新任总裁今天会来视察分公司。
examples.english_sentence: The company's newly appointed CEO will visit the branch today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇落好似一個冷酷嘅總裁形象，但其實幾親切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 jat1 go3 laang5 huk6 ge3 zung2 coi4 jing4 zoeng6, daan6 kei4 sat6 gei2 can1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看起来像個冷酷的总裁形象，但其實很親切。
examples.english_sentence: He looks like a stern CEO-type, but he's actually quite friendly.

mandarin_meaning: 总要（表示无论如何也要、应该或必须做某事）
english_meaning: in any case / anyway / must / ought to
explanation_mandarin: 用作副词或情态词，表示无论如何也要做某事、应该或必须做某事，常带有劝说、无奈或强调的语气。
explanation_english: Used as an adverb/modal expression meaning that something should or must be done (in any case/anyway/ought to). Often conveys insistence, resignation, or emphasis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想去佢嘅生日派對，但總要去一次，禮貌上應該去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 keoi5 ge3 saang1 jat6 paai3 deoi3, daan6 zung2 jiu3 heoi3 jat1 ci3, lai5 maau6 soeng6 jing1 goi1 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想去他的生日派對，但總要去一次，出於禮貌應該去。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to go to his birthday party, but I should go once — out of politeness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工作仲未做晒，但總要先交一個草稿畀老細，等佢睇吓先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 zok3 zung6 mei6 zou6 saai3, daan6 zung2 jiu3 sin1 gaau1 jat1 go3 cou2 gou2 bei2 lou5 sai3, dang2 keoi5 tai2 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作還沒做完，但總要先交一個草稿給老闆，讓他先看一下。
examples.english_sentence: The work isn't finished yet, but you still need to submit a draft to the boss first so he can take a look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然件事已經發生，總要有人負責吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 faat3 saang1, zung2 jiu3 jau5 jan4 fu6 zaak3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然事情已經發生，總要有人負責啊。
examples.english_sentence: Now that the matter has happened, someone has to take responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 儿时的朋友；從小結交的交情（相當於“青梅竹馬”或“兒時玩伴”）
english_meaning: childhood friends; a friendship formed in early childhood
explanation_mandarin: “總角”原指幼年束髮的年紀，“總角之交”指從小結交的朋友，強調童年時期建立的深厚交情，屬文言成語用法。
explanation_english: Literary idiom meaning friends since childhood. Literally refers to the age of wearing a topknot (young age); it emphasizes a bond formed in early youth and is a classical/literary expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係總角之交，細個已經係好朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 zung2 gok3 zi1 gaau1, sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 hai6 hou2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是总角之交，从小就是好朋友。
examples.english_sentence: They are childhood friends; they've been close since they were little.

mandarin_meaning: 總之 / 總而言之（用於概括或總結）
english_meaning: in short; in summary; to sum up
explanation_mandarin: 用來對前述內容作總結或概括，常用於引出結論或總結性的陳述。
explanation_english: A phrase used to summarize or generalize previously stated points; commonly introduces a conclusion or summary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總言之，我哋唔可以再拖喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 jin4 zi1, ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 zoi3 to1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 總之，我們不能再拖了。
examples.english_sentence: In short, we can't delay any longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總言之，佢嘅表現唔係好理想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 jin4 zi1, keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2 m4 hai6 hou2 lei5 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 總而言之，他的表現不太理想。
examples.english_sentence: In summary, his performance isn't very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總言之，呢個決定對公司有利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 jin4 zi1, ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 deoi3 gung1 si1 jau5 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 總之，這個決定對公司有利。
examples.english_sentence: In short, this decision benefits the company.

mandarin_meaning: 总计；合计；总共
english_meaning: total; to total; in total; sum up
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 名词 / 副词
explanation_mandarin: 表示各项相加得出的总数或表示总共的意思。可作动词（把各项加起来）、名词（总数）或副词（表示总共）。常见于书面或正式场合。
explanation_english: Indicates the total or sum of items. Can function as a verb (to total up), a noun (the total), or an adverb (in total). Often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告總計有十頁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zung2 gai3 jau5 sap6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告总计有十页。
examples.english_sentence: This report totals ten pages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月總計開支一萬蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 zung2 gai3 hoi1 zi1 jat1 maan6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月总计开支一万元。
examples.english_sentence: This month the total expenses are ten thousand dollars.

mandarin_meaning: （集體）辭職、全部辭職
english_meaning: mass resignation; to resign en masse
explanation_mandarin: 表示全體或多數成員一起辭職，常用於政府內閣、公司高層等在重大事件或醜聞後集體離職的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to an act of resigning collectively — usually all or most members stepping down together. Commonly used for cabinets, senior management, or boards resigning en masse after scandals or major incidents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成個內閣因為醜聞宣布總辭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 go3 noi6 gok3 jan1 wai6 cau2 man4 syun1 bou3 zung2 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整個內閣因為醜聞宣布總辭。
examples.english_sentence: The entire cabinet announced its collective resignation because of the scandal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司高層宣布總辭，職員都好驚訝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gou1 cang4 syun1 bou3 zung2 ci4, zik1 jyun4 dou1 hou2 ging1 ngaa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司高層宣布總辭，職員都很驚訝。
examples.english_sentence: The company's senior management announced their collective resignation; the staff were very surprised.

mandarin_meaning: 总部 (zǒngbù)
english_meaning: headquarters
explanation_mandarin: 指組織或公司的主要辦公地點或管理中心，負責整體運作和決策。
explanation_english: The main office or administrative center of an organization or company, responsible for overall operations and decision-making.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司總部喺香港島。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zung2 bou6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的总部在香港岛。
examples.english_sentence: The company's headquarters are on Hong Kong Island.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要返總部開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faan1 zung2 bou6 hoi1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要回总部开会。
examples.english_sentence: We need to return to headquarters for a meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新總部落成嗰陣好多人嚟參觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 zung2 bou6 lok6 sing4 go2 zan6 hou2 do1 jan4 lai4 caam1 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新总部落成的时候很多人来参观。
examples.english_sentence: When the new headquarters was completed, many people came to visit.

mandarin_meaning: 总额；某项款项或多项相加后的总和
english_meaning: total amount; aggregate sum
explanation_mandarin: 指某一笔款项或多笔款项相加得到的总和，常用于财务、会计和报表中。
explanation_english: Refers to the overall sum of one or more items added together; commonly used in finance, accounting, and reports.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢筆訂單嘅總額係一萬蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bat1 ding6daan1 ge3 zung2 ngaak3 hai6 jat1 maan6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔订单的总额是1万港元。
examples.english_sentence: The total amount for this order is HK$10,000.

mandarin_meaning: 总体
english_meaning: overall; as a whole
explanation_mandarin: 表示整體或全部，常用於評估、總結時，意思相當於「整體來說」或「總體上」。
explanation_english: Refers to the whole or entirety; commonly used when evaluating or summarizing, equivalent to 'overall' or 'as a whole'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總體嚟講，呢個計劃係可行嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 tai2 lai4 gong2, ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 hai6 ho2 hang4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总体来说，这个计划是可行的。
examples.english_sentence: Overall, this plan is feasible.

mandarin_meaning: 成績；功績；業績
english_meaning: achievement; result; performance; merit
explanation_mandarin: 「績」常見於合成詞，如「成績」「功績」「績效」，用來表示成就、成績或業績等含義。
explanation_english: The character appears mainly in compounds (e.g. 成績, 功績, 績效) and denotes achievement, result, performance, or merit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試嘅成績好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ge3 sing4 zik1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這次考試的成績很好。
examples.english_sentence: His exam results this time are very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為公司做出咗好大嘅功績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 gung1 si1 zou6 ceot1 zo2 hou2 daai6 ge3 gung1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為公司做出了很大的功績。
examples.english_sentence: He made great contributions to the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要改善員工嘅績效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 goi2 sin6 jyun4 gung1 ge3 zik1 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要改善員工的績效。
examples.english_sentence: We need to improve employees' performance.

mandarin_meaning: 績分（指用於獎勵、績效或比賽的積分或分數）
english_meaning: points; score; performance points (points awarded for performance, rewards, or contests)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用於衡量或獎勵的分數或積分，例如員工績效評分、忠誠計劃的積分或比賽得分。視語境可與「積分」、「得分」互換。
explanation_english: Refers to points or scores used to measure or reward performance, such as employee performance scores, loyalty-program points, or contest scores. In context it can be used similarly to "points" or "score."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今季嘅績分夠唔夠攞獎金？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 gwai3 ge3 zik1 fan1 gau3 m4 gau3 lo2 zoeng2 gam1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這季的績分夠拿獎金嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Do you have enough points this quarter to get the bonus?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 客人可以用績分換禮品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haak3 jan4 ho2 ji5 jung6 zik1 fan1 wun6 lai5 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 顧客可以用績分兌換禮品。
examples.english_sentence: Customers can use their points to redeem gifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會根據員工嘅績分去調薪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 gan1 geoi3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 zik1 fan1 heoi3 tiu4 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會根據員工的績分調整薪酬。
examples.english_sentence: The company will adjust salaries based on employees' performance points.

mandarin_meaning: 繁（fán）：表示繁多、繁忙、繁複、繁榮等意思
english_meaning: numerous, busy, complex; flourishing (depending on compound)
explanation_mandarin: 「繁」常用作形容詞或詞根，表示數量多、繁忙或複雜，如「繁忙」、「繁複」、「繁體」、「繁榮」。在粵語中常見於各種合成詞或口語表達（例如「好繁」表示很忙）。
explanation_english: The character "繁" is commonly used as an adjective or morpheme meaning numerous, busy, or complex. It appears in compounds such as "繁忙" (busy), "繁複" (complex), "繁體" (traditional script), and can be used colloquially in Cantonese in compounds or expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近工作好繁忙，冇乜時間休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gung1 zok3 hou2 faan4 mong4, mou5 mat1 si4 gaan3 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近工作很繁忙，沒太多時間休息。
examples.english_sentence: I've been very busy at work lately and haven't had much time to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個手續好繁複，要成日排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sau2 zuk6 hou2 faan4 fuk1, jiu3 sing4 jat6 paai4 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個手續很繁複，經常要排隊。
examples.english_sentence: These procedures are very complicated and often require waiting in line.

mandarin_meaning: 繁多（數量或種類很多）
english_meaning: numerous; plentiful; diverse
explanation_mandarin: 表示數量眾多或種類繁複，常用來描述事物的數量或種類很多。
explanation_english: Indicates a large number or wide variety; commonly used to describe that things are numerous or diverse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅商品種類繁多，應有盡有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 soeng1 ban2 zung2 leoi6 faan4 do1, jing1 jau5 zeon6 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡的商品種類繁多，應有盡有。
examples.english_sentence: The products here come in a wide variety; there's everything you could want.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家資訊繁多，要學識過濾同分辨真假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 zi1 seon3 faan4 do1, jiu3 hok6 sik1 gwo3 leot6 tung4 fan1 bin6 zang1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在資訊繁多，要學會過濾和分辨真假。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays information is abundant; you need to learn to filter and discern what's true and false.

mandarin_meaning: 繁忙 (fánmáng)
english_meaning: busy; bustling; occupied
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情多、時間緊迫或處於忙碌狀態。
explanation_english: Describes a state of having many tasks or activities; being busy or occupied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近公司好繁忙，我冇時間出去食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 gung1 si1 hou2 faan4 mong4, ngo5 mou5 si4 gaan3 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近公司很繁忙，我沒時間出去吃飯。
examples.english_sentence: The company has been very busy lately; I don't have time to go out to eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 節日時市中心好繁忙，街上人山人海。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zit3 jat6 si5 si5 zung1 sam1 hou2 faan4 mong4, gaai1 soeng5 jan4 saan1 jan4 hoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 節日時市中心很繁忙，街上人山人海。
examples.english_sentence: The city center is very busy during the holidays, with crowds everywhere.

mandarin_meaning: 繁文縟節 (fán wén rù jié)：指過多的禮節或繁複的手續，常用於形容官僚主義或流程冗長。
english_meaning: Tedious formalities and redundant procedures; red tape.
explanation_mandarin: 指形式繁複、程序冗長的禮節或手續，常帶有批評官僚作風或不必要程序的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to overly complicated, redundant formalities or procedures. Often used to criticize bureaucratic red tape or needless ceremonial steps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請文件嗰啲繁文縟節真係令人頭痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 man4 gin2 go2 di1 faan4 man4 juk6 zit3 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 tau4 hon4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申请文件那些繁文缛节真让人头疼。
examples.english_sentence: Those tedious formalities for the application are really a headache.

mandarin_meaning: 繁荣（兴盛、发达）
english_meaning: prosperous; flourishing; thriving; prosperity
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容经济、事业、城市等兴旺发达、繁盛的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of prosperity or flourishing, often used for economies, businesses, cities, or general development.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅經濟多年來都保持繁榮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ging1 zai3 do1 nin4 loi4 dou1 bou2 ci4 faan4 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的经济多年来都保持繁荣。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's economy has remained prosperous for many years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市中心嘅商業區越嚟越繁榮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 zung1 sam1 ge3 soeng1 jip6 keoi1 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 faan4 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市中心的商业区越来越繁荣。
examples.english_sentence: The downtown commercial district is becoming increasingly prosperous.

mandarin_meaning: 繁殖（fánzhí）：生物繁衍或增加個體數量
english_meaning: reproduction; to breed; to multiply (increase in number of organisms)
explanation_mandarin: 表示生物產生後代或使數量增多的過程或行為，適用於動物、植物或微生物等。
explanation_english: Refers to the process or action by which living organisms produce offspring or increase in number; applicable to animals, plants, and microorganisms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種植物喺呢個溫室可以好快繁殖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 zik6 mat6 hai2 ni1 go3 wan1 sat1 ho2 ji5 hou2 faai3 faan4 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這種植物在這個溫室能夠快速繁殖。
examples.english_sentence: This plant species can reproduce quickly in this greenhouse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老鼠繁殖得好快，如果唔及時控制會有問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 syu2 faan4 zik6 dak1 hou2 faai3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 kap6 si4 hung3 zai3 wui5 jau5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老鼠繁殖得很快，如果不及時控制會有問題。
examples.english_sentence: Rats reproduce very quickly; if not controlled in time it will cause problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過度繁殖會破壞生態平衡，令某啲物種數量過剩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 dou6 faan4 zik6 wui5 po3 waai6 saang1 taai3 ping4 hang4, ling6 mau5 di1 mat6 zung2 sou3 loeng6 gwo3 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 過度繁殖會破壞生態平衡，導致某些物種數量過多。
examples.english_sentence: Overbreeding can disrupt ecological balance and lead to overpopulation of certain species.

mandarin_meaning: 繁琐，指事情繁杂、琐碎且麻烦
english_meaning: tedious; cumbersome; complicated and trivial, requiring time and effort to deal with
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事務繁複、細碎且處理起來麻煩、耗時。
explanation_english: Describes tasks or matters that are detailed, trivial, and troublesome to handle, often time-consuming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份文件好繁瑣，要用好多時間處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 hou2 faan4 so2, jiu3 jung6 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份文件很繁琐，需要花很多时间处理。
examples.english_sentence: This document is very tedious and requires a lot of time to process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請手續太繁瑣，我哋決定搵代理幫手。
