examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 sau2 zuk6 taai3 faan4 so2, ngo5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 wan2 doi6 lei5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申请手续太繁琐，我们决定找代理帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: The application procedures are too cumbersome, so we decided to hire an agent to help.

mandarin_meaning: 繁榮、興旺、昌盛
english_meaning: flourishing; prosperous; thriving
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物或經濟等狀態非常興旺、蓬勃發展。
explanation_english: Used to describe something (a place, business, or activity) that is very prosperous, flourishing, or thriving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街依家好繁盛，啲舖頭日日都有客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 ji1 gaa1 hou2 faan4 sing4, di1 pou3 tau2 jat6 jat6 dou1 jau5 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街现在很繁盛，店铺每天都有客人。
examples.english_sentence: This street is very prosperous now; the shops have customers every day.

mandarin_meaning: 繁华；兴旺热闹、富丽堂皇
english_meaning: bustling; flourishing; prosperous; glamorous
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容城市、街道或景象等繁榮熱鬧、富麗或華美的樣子，也可指表面光鮮的繁盛。
explanation_english: Describes a place or scene that is prosperous, bustling, or splendid; can also imply outward glamour or showy prosperity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街以前好繁華，依家已經冷清晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 ji5cin4 hou2 faan4 waa4, ji4gaa1 ji5ging1 laang5cing1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街以前很繁华，现在已经冷清了。
examples.english_sentence: This street used to be very bustling; now it's become quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅夜生活一向都好繁華，特別係蘭桂坊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 je6 saang1 wut6 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 faan4 waa4, dak6 bit6 hai6 laan4 gwai3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的夜生活一向都很繁华，特别是兰桂坊。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's nightlife has always been bustling, especially in Lan Kwai Fong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小說描寫咗一個繁華都市嘅浮華景象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 seot3 miu4 se2 zo2 jat1 go3 faan4 waa4 dou1 si5 ge3 fau4 waa4 ging2 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小说描写了一个繁华都市的浮华景象。
examples.english_sentence: The novel depicts the glamorous scenes of a prosperous city.

mandarin_meaning: 繁衍（生育后代、繁殖、扩展）
english_meaning: to reproduce; to propagate; to multiply
explanation_mandarin: 指生物繁殖后代或数量增加，也可泛指事物的发展、扩展或传播。
explanation_english: Refers to biological reproduction (producing offspring) or an increase in numbers; can also broadly mean the propagation, expansion, or spread of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 動物喺自然界度靠繁衍延續生命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6 mat6 hai2 zi6 jin4 gaai3 dou6 kaau3 faan4 jin2 jin4 zuk6 sang1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 动物在自然界中靠繁衍来延续生命。
examples.english_sentence: Animals in the natural world rely on reproduction to continue their species.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場希望啲魚可以快啲繁衍，咁就可以增加存量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 hei1 mong6 di1 jyu4 ho2 ji5 faai3 di1 faan4 jin2, gam2 zau6 ho2 ji5 zang1 gaa1 cyun4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农场希望这些鱼能够快点繁衍，这样就能增加存量。
examples.english_sentence: The farm hopes these fish will reproduce quickly so they can increase the stock.

mandarin_meaning: 繁复；复杂、繁琐
english_meaning: complex; complicated; intricate; elaborate
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物、程序或结构包含很多细节或步骤，因此不简单、处理起来繁琐。
explanation_english: Indicates that something (a process, structure, or matter) contains many details or steps, making it not simple and often cumbersome to handle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份表格太繁複，我要花多啲時間先填完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 taai3 faan4 fuk1, ngo5 jiu3 faa1 do1 di1 si4 gaan3 sin1 tim4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份表格太繁复，我要花更多时间才能填完。
examples.english_sentence: This form is too complicated; I'll need to spend more time to finish filling it out.

mandarin_meaning: 繁重 (fánzhòng) — 工作或負擔很重、繁複、艱巨
english_meaning: heavy; burdensome; onerous (describing work, responsibilities, or burdens)
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情、工作或責任負擔大、不輕鬆，可能耗時或耗力；用於描述任務、工作量或壓力。
explanation_english: Describes tasks, work, or responsibilities that are large in burden, time-consuming, or difficult; used for onerous or heavy workloads and duties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工作好繁重，我最近經常加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 hou2 faan4 zung6, ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 ging1 soeng4 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份工作很繁重，我最近經常加班。
examples.english_sentence: This job is very burdensome; I've been working overtime a lot recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬屋期間搬運嘅責任好繁重，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 uk1 kei4 gaan1 bun1 wan6 ge3 zaak3 jam6 hou2 faan4 zung6, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬家的時候搬運的責任很繁重，要小心一點。
examples.english_sentence: The responsibilities of moving house are heavy; be more careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校畀我哋嘅功課量繁重，學生壓力好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 fo3 loeng6 faan4 zung6, hok6 saang1 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校給我們的功課量很繁重，學生壓力很大。
examples.english_sentence: The school's workload for us is heavy; students are under a lot of pressure.

mandarin_meaning: 繁杂 (fán zá)：复杂、纷繁、不简单
english_meaning: complicated; complex; intricate; miscellaneous
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事情或內容繁多、錯綜或不易處理，需要較多時間或精力。
explanation_english: Describes something that is complex, composed of many parts or details, and not easy to deal with; often implies extra time or effort is needed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告好繁雜，要花多啲時間整理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 hou2 faan4 zaap6, jiu3 faa1 do1 di1 si4 gaan3 zing2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告很繁杂，需要花更多时间整理。
examples.english_sentence: This report is very complicated and will take more time to organize.

mandarin_meaning: 繁体字
english_meaning: traditional Chinese characters
explanation_mandarin: 指使用傳統筆畫和結構的漢字書寫系統，與簡體字對應，主要在香港、台灣等地使用。
explanation_english: Refers to Chinese characters written in the traditional forms (as opposed to simplified characters); commonly used in places like Hong Kong and Taiwan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意用繁體字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jung6 faan4 tai2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜歡使用繁體字。
examples.english_sentence: I like using traditional Chinese characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 這本書以繁體字印刷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze5 bun2 syu1 ji5 faan4 tai2 zi6 jan3 soek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書以繁體字印刷。
examples.english_sentence: This book is printed in traditional Chinese characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 手機可以切換簡體字同繁體字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 gei1 ho2 ji5 cit3 wun6 gaan2 tai2 zi6 tung4 faan4 tai2 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 手機可以切換簡體字和繁體字。
examples.english_sentence: Phones can switch between simplified and traditional characters.

mandarin_meaning: 捆绑；（精神或肌肉）紧张、僵硬；（作名词）绷带
english_meaning: to bind/strap (with a bandage); to be tense or stiff; (noun) bandage
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞／形容詞／名詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 1）用繃帶或繩子捆綁、包紮傷口；2）形容人或肌肉處於緊繃、緊張或僵硬的狀態；作名詞時指繃帶。
explanation_english: 1) To wrap or bind (e.g., a wound) with a bandage or strap. 2) To describe someone or muscles being tense or stiff. As a noun it can mean a bandage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個傷口要用繃帶繃好，先至唔會散。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 soeng1 hau2 jiu3 jung6 bong1 daai3 bong1 hou2, sin1 zi3 m4 wui5 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個傷口要用繃帶包紮好，才不會散開。
examples.english_sentence: This wound needs to be properly bandaged so it won't come apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嗰陣時我成個人繃緊，手都唔識郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 go2 zan6 si4 ngo5 sing4 go3 jan4 bong1 gan2, sau2 dou1 m4 sik1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試的時候我整個人很緊繃，手都不會動。
examples.english_sentence: During the exam I was totally tense; I couldn't even move my hands.

mandarin_meaning: 绷带（用于包扎、固定或保护伤口的布条或弹性材料）
english_meaning: bandage (a strip of cloth or elastic material used to dress, secure, or protect a wound)
explanation_mandarin: 醫療上用來包紮、固定或保護傷口或受傷部位的布條或彈性材料，可用於止血或固定敷料。
explanation_english: A medical strip of cloth or elastic material used to wrap, secure, or protect wounds or injured body parts; used for dressing, pressure, or immobilization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用繃帶包紮咗個傷口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 beng1 daai3 baau1 saat3 zo2 go3 soeng1 hau2。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用绷带包扎了伤口。
examples.english_sentence: He used a bandage to dress the wound.

mandarin_meaning: 繃緊 / 緊繃 (绷紧；紧绷)
english_meaning: to tense up; to be tight or on edge; to tighten
explanation_mandarin: 表示肌肉或情緒變得緊張、緊繃，或指把某物拉得很緊以致穩固。
explanation_english: Indicates becoming tense (physically or emotionally) or that something is tightened/taught so it is secure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面色繃緊，似乎好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 sik1 bung1 gan2, ci5 fu1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的臉色緊繃，似乎很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: His face looks tense; he seems very nervous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條繩要繃緊啲，先穩陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 sing4 jiu3 bung1 gan2 di1, sin1 wan2 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 繩子要繃緊一些，才穩固。
examples.english_sentence: Tighten the rope a bit so it's secure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前我一直繃緊，睡得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 ngo5 jat1 zik6 bung1 gan2, seoi6 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試前我一直很緊張，睡得不好。
examples.english_sentence: I was tense before the exam and couldn't sleep well.

mandarin_meaning: 緊張、拘謹、不放鬆
english_meaning: tense; uptight; anxious; not relaxed
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，形容一個人情緒或狀態很緊繃、不放鬆，可能因為緊張、擔心或嚴肅場合而表現出拘謹。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning someone is tense or uptight — not relaxed, often due to nervousness, worry, or a serious situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日成日繃繃緊，好似有啲擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 seng4 jat6 bung1 bung1 gan2, hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天整天很緊張，好像有點擔心。
examples.english_sentence: He's been tense all day today; he seems a bit worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會嗰陣大家都繃繃緊，氣氛好嚴肅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui2 go2 zan6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 bung1 bung1 gan2, hei3 fan1 hou2 jim4 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會的時候大家都很緊繃，氣氛很嚴肅。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting everyone was tense; the atmosphere was very serious.

mandarin_meaning: 繆 / 缪（拼音：miù）——表示荒謬、錯誤；亦為姓氏（常見漢語拼音譯作 Miao 或 Miu）
english_meaning: Absurd; mistaken; erroneous; (also a surname, e.g. Miu/Miao)
explanation_mandarin: 表示荒謬、不合情理或錯誤的意思；在現代漢語中常見於合成詞如「荒謬」、「謬誤」。此外亦為一個姓氏。
explanation_english: Denotes something absurd, unreasonable, or erroneous. Commonly appears in compounds such as '荒謬' (absurd) and '謬誤' (error). It can also be a family name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個理論好荒謬，證據根本唔成立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lei5 leon6 hou2 fong1 mau6, zing3 geoi3 gan1 bun2 m4 sing4 laap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个理论很荒谬，证据根本不成立。
examples.english_sentence: This theory is absurd; the evidence simply doesn't hold up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發表嘅數據有好多謬誤，結果被學界質疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 biu2 ge3 sou3 geoi3 jau5 hou2 do1 mau6 ng6, git3 gwo2 bei6 hok6 gaai3 zat1 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他發表的数据有很多谬误，結果被學界質疑。
examples.english_sentence: The data he published has many errors, and as a result it was questioned by the academic community.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見漢字（無現代通用意義）
english_meaning: A rare/archaic Chinese character with no common modern usage
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 古漢字 / 非現代詞彙
partOfSpeech_english: archaic character / not a modern lexical item
explanation_mandarin: 「繑」是一個非常罕見或古老的漢字，現代普通話與粵語中沒有固定或廣泛接受的讀音和詞義，通常視為不常用字或典籍用字。
explanation_english: “繑” is a very rare or archaic Chinese character. It has no widely accepted modern pronunciation or meaning in Standard Mandarin or Cantonese and is generally treated as an uncommon or classical character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「繑」呢個字好罕見，喺現代書面語好少見到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: 「繑」 ni1 go3 zi6 hou2 ham2 gin3, hai6 jin6 doi6 syu1 min6 jyu5 hou2 siu2 gin3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「繑」这个字很罕见，在现代书面语中很少见到。
examples.english_sentence: The character '繑' is very rare and is seldom seen in modern written language.

mandarin_meaning: 未在主要資料庫中收錄，含義不詳（可能是打錯字、方言變體或罕見詞）
english_meaning: Not attested in major sources; meaning unknown (possibly a typo, dialectal variant, or very rare term)
explanation_mandarin: 檢索常用粵語詞典與語料庫後，未能找到可靠的條目。字形「繑」本身十分罕見，可能是打字誤植、地方口語拼寫或俚語的個別寫法。需要提供更多語境或例句以便判定正確讀音與含義。
explanation_english: After checking common Cantonese dictionaries and corpora, there is no reliable entry for this form. The character 繑 is rare; this may be a typographical error, a local/dialectal spelling, or an extremely rare slang. More context or example sentences are needed to determine pronunciation and meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅「繑口」係乜意思？我喺辭典搵唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 "繑口" hai6 mat1 ji3 si1? ngo5 hai2 ci4 din2 wan2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的“繑口”是什么意思？我在词典里查不到。
examples.english_sentence: What do you mean by "繑口"? I can't find it in dictionaries.

mandarin_meaning: 雙手被束縛／束手無策（無法採取行動）
english_meaning: to have one's hands tied; be unable to act or intervene; helpless
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，字面可理解為把雙手綁起來，引申為因受限制或無權無能而無法採取行動、感到無奈或束手無策。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression literally meaning to have both hands tied. It figuratively describes being constrained or powerless to act — having one's hands tied or being helpless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司冇錢，老細繑埋雙手，唔可以加人工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 mou5 cin2, lou5sai3 kau2 maai4 soeng1 sau2, m4 ho2 ji5 gaa1 jan4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司沒錢，老闆束手無策，無法加薪。
examples.english_sentence: The company has no money; the boss has his hands tied and can't give raises.

mandarin_meaning: 拖延、磨蹭、敷衍塞責（廣東話俗語）
english_meaning: to dawdle or procrastinate; to stall or beat around the bush (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「繑絲邊」是廣東話俗語，用來形容做事拖拉、磨蹭或敷衍，不直接處理問題或遲遲不交代。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe dawdling, stalling, or being evasive about handling a matter—delaying action or procrastinating instead of dealing with something directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再繑絲邊，快啲交功課啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi6 gau2 si1 bin1, faai3 di1 gaau1 gung1 fo3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再拖拖拉拉了，快點交作業吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't dawdle any more—turn in your homework quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日繑絲邊，做嘢好慢，老闆都唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gau2 si1 bin1, zou6 je5 hou2 maan6, lou5 baan2 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是拖拖拉拉，做事很慢，老闆也不開心。
examples.english_sentence: He always stalls and works slowly; the boss isn't happy.

mandarin_meaning: 织；编织
english_meaning: to weave; to knit; to fabricate (metaphorically)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用線、紗等編成布、衣物或其他物品；也可比喻構造或編造事物/情節。
explanation_english: To weave or knit threads or yarn into cloth, garments, or other items; can also be used figuratively to mean to construct or fabricate (e.g., a plot).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽教我點樣織毛衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 gaau3 ngo5 dim2 joeng6 zik1 mou4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽教我怎樣織毛衣。
examples.english_sentence: Mom taught me how to knit a sweater.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺廠度織布，係紡織廠嘅工人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 cong2 dou6 zik1 bou3, hai6 fong2 zik1 cong2 ge3 gung1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在廠裡織布，是紡織廠的工人。
examples.english_sentence: He weaves cloth at the factory; he's a worker in a textile mill.

mandarin_meaning: 織毛衣；編織毛線衫
english_meaning: to knit a sweater (to knit a jumper); the activity of knitting sweaters
explanation_mandarin: 指用毛線等材料織造冷衫（即毛衣）。通常為字面用法，也可用來表示以編織毛衣為嗜好或手工活動。
explanation_english: Refers to knitting a sweater (making a jumper) from yarn. Mostly used literally to describe the act of knitting, and can also denote the hobby or craft of knitting sweaters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意喺屋企織冷衫，當做紓壓的活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 hai2 uk1 kei2 zik1 laang5 saam1, dong3 zou6 syu1 ngaat3 dik1 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡在家織毛衣，當作紓壓的活動。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to knit sweaters at home as a stress-relief activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我學咗好耐先識點樣織冷衫，宜家可以織一件送畀朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hok6 zo2 hou2 noi6 sin1 sik1 dim2 joeng6 zik1 laang5 saam1, ji4 gaa1 ho2 ji5 zik1 jat1 gin6 sung3 bei2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我學了很久才會織毛衣，現在可以織一件送給朋友。
examples.english_sentence: I learned for a long time before I could knit a sweater; now I can make one to give to a friend.

mandarin_meaning: 织女（zhī nǚ）：中国传说中的织布仙女，常指牛郎织女传说中的女主角；亦指天上的织女星（织女座亮星，Vega）。
english_meaning: Weaver Girl (zhī nǚ): the celestial weaver girl from Chinese mythology (the female protagonist of the Cowherd and Weaver Girl legend); also refers to the star Vega.
explanation_mandarin: 織女源自中國古代傳說，與牛郎相愛但被天帝分隔，傳說中每年七夕由喜鵲搭橋讓他們相會；在天文上也指織女星（Vega）。
explanation_english: In Chinese mythology, the Weaver Girl is the celestial weaver who falls in love with the Cowherd; they are separated by the heavens and permitted to meet once a year on the Qixi Festival. The term also names the star Vega.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個聽阿婆講過牛郎織女嘅故事，話佢哋每年七夕先可以見一次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 teng1 aa3 po4 gong2 gwo3 ngau4 long4 zik1 neoi5 ge3 gu3 si6, waa6 keoi5 dei6 mui5 nin4 cat1 zik6 sin1 ho2 ji5 gin3 jat1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候听奶奶讲过牛郎织女的故事，说他们每年七夕才能见一次。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a child my grandmother told me the story of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl — she said they can only meet once a year on Qixi.

mandarin_meaning: （口語，可能）編造謊言或誇大其詞
english_meaning: to make up stories / to fabricate/exaggerate (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「織蟀」為廣東話口語用語，常用來形容編造故事、說大話或誇大情況。此詞較口語或地區性，並非正式書面用語，使用時語氣可帶責備或戲謔。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression typically used to describe making up stories, telling lies, or exaggerating. It is informal and possibly regional or youth slang; not standard written usage. Tone can be reproachful or playful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度織蟀啦，講真啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 zik1 seoi3 laa1, gong2 zan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在這裡編造謊言，說得真實一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make up stories here — be more honest.

mandarin_meaning: 翻；翻译；翻阅；翻转（漢語普通話讀音：fān）
english_meaning: to flip/turn over; to peruse/flip through; to translate; to rummage through
explanation_mandarin: 「繙」通「翻」，意思是翻動、翻閱、翻譯或反覆查看，常用於書面語或古文，也見於複合詞如「繙譯」、「繙閱」。
explanation_english: The character 繙 is a literary variant of 翻, meaning to turn over, flip through, peruse, or translate. It is often used in written or classical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將舊相簿繙開，睇返以前啲相，回憶起好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 gau6 soeng2 bou2 faan1 hoi1, dai2 faan1 ji5 cin4 di1 soeng2, wui4 jik1 hei2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把舊相簿翻開，看看以前的照片，回憶起很多事情。
examples.english_sentence: He opened the old photo album, looked at the old pictures, and recalled many things.

mandarin_meaning: 翻譯
english_meaning: translate; translation
explanation_mandarin: 指把一種語言的內容用另一種語言表達；也可指翻譯出來的文本或翻譯的行為。
explanation_english: To render the meaning of text or speech from one language into another; can refer to the act of translating or the translated text.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫我將英文繙譯成廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 ngo5 zoeng1 jing1 man4 faan1 jik6 sing4 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他幫我把英文翻譯成廣東話。
examples.english_sentence: He helped translate the English into Cantonese for me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本小說未有正式繙譯出中文版本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 siu2 syut3 mei6 jau5 zing3 sik1 faan1 jik6 ceot1 zung1 man4 baan2 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本小說還沒有正式翻譯成中文版本。
examples.english_sentence: This novel hasn't been officially translated into Chinese yet.

mandarin_meaning: 繚（常見於「繚繞」）：縈繞、盤旋、纏繞、徘徊不散
english_meaning: to wind around; to linger; to haunt; to pervade (often used in the compound 繚繞)
explanation_mandarin: 多用於「繚繞」，表示某種氣味、聲音或情感在空間或心中盤旋、縈繞不散。
explanation_english: Mainly used in the phrase 繚繞 (liu4 naau6), meaning something (a scent, sound, or feeling) winds around or lingers and does not easily disperse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 那股香味繚繞在房間裡，好難散去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naa5 guk1 hoeng1 mei6 liu4 naau6 zoi6 fong4 gaan1 leoi5, hou2 naan4 saan3 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那股香味繚繞在房間裡，好難散去。
examples.english_sentence: That scent lingered in the room; it was hard to dissipate.

mandarin_meaning: （疑為罕見異體或誤寫）繚繞，纏繞、縈繞
english_meaning: to coil around; to linger; to entwine; to waft or hover about
explanation_mandarin: 「繚繑」並非常用現代詞彙，極可能是「繚繞」的罕見異體或誤寫。含義與「繚繞／縈繞」相同，用來表示物體纏繞、氣味或感覺盤旋不去、縈繞在周圍等。
explanation_english: "繚繑" is not a common modern Cantonese word and is very likely a rare variant or misspelling of 繚繞. It shares the meaning of coiling/entwining or lingering/hovering (e.g., a scent or mist lingering in the air).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚嘅霧喺條街上繚繑，行路要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 ge3 mou6 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 soeng6 liu4 jiu6, hang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上的霧在街道上繚繞，走路要小心。
examples.english_sentence: The night mist is lingering along the street; be careful when walking.

mandarin_meaning: 绕 (rào)；绕行、缠绕、环绕
english_meaning: to wind around; to encircle; to wrap; to take a detour
explanation_mandarin: 表示繞行、環繞或纏繞的動作，例如繞過某物、繞著轉或纏住。
explanation_english: Denotes the action of winding around, encircling, wrapping, or going around/around on a detour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路封咗，要繞路行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 fung1 zo2, jiu3 jiu6 lou6 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路被封了，要绕道行走。
examples.english_sentence: The road is closed; we need to take a detour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 藤蔓繞住條樹幹，唔容易拆走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tang4 maan5 jiu6 zyu6 tiu4 syu6 gon1, m4 jung4 ji6 caak3 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 藤蔓缠绕着树干，不容易拆掉。
examples.english_sentence: The vines are wrapped around the trunk and are hard to remove.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句係一個繞口令，好難講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 hai6 jat1 go3 jiu6 hau2 ling6, hou2 naan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句话是一个绕口令，很难说。
examples.english_sentence: This sentence is a tongue twister; it's hard to say.

mandarin_meaning: （說話、詞語）繞口、難以發音
english_meaning: tongue-twisting; hard to pronounce
explanation_mandarin: 表示說起來拗口、難以順利發音，常用來形容語句或詞語不易流暢地說出（如繞口令）。
explanation_english: Describes something that is difficult to pronounce or tongue-twisting; used for words or phrases that are awkward or hard to say smoothly (as in tongue twisters).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句好繞口，你講慢啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 hou2 naau6 hau2, nei5 gong2 maan6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句话很绕口，你可以说慢一点吗？
examples.english_sentence: This sentence is tongue-twisting; could you say it more slowly?

mandarin_meaning: 拐彎抹角；迴避正面回答
english_meaning: to beat around the bush; to be evasive and avoid giving a direct answer
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容說話或處事不直接，繞開重點或刻意模糊以迴避正面回應或責任。
explanation_english: Used to describe speaking or acting in an indirect, evasive way — skirting the main point or deliberately avoiding a straightforward response.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好繞絲邊，直接講你想要乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 naau6 si1 bin1, zik6 zip3 gong2 nei5 soeng2 jiu3 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別拐彎抹角，直接說你想要什麼。
examples.english_sentence: Don't beat around the bush; say directly what you want.

mandarin_meaning: 绕路（rào lù）：走较远或迂回的路线；比喻采取不直接的方式以避开或推托
english_meaning: to take a detour; to go out of the way; to avoid doing something directly
explanation_mandarin: 繞路表示行走或行駛時不走直線而走比較遠或迂回的路線，也可用作比喻，指為了避免直接接觸、回應或處理而採取迂迴的方式。
explanation_english: “繞路” means to take a longer, indirect route when walking or driving. Figuratively, it can mean avoiding direct contact or a direct response by using a roundabout approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日開車去公司，因為塞車，我要繞路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hoi1 ce1 heoi3 gung1 si1, jan1 wai6 sak1 ce1, ngo5 jiu3 naau6 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天开车去公司，因為塞車，我要绕路。
examples.english_sentence: I'm driving to work today; because of traffic jams, I need to take a detour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想正面答問題，成日繞路講其他嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 zing3 min6 daap3 man6 tai4, sing4 jat6 naau6 lou6 gong2 kei4 taa1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想正面回答問題，總是绕路說別的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to answer directly; he keeps beating around the bush and talks about other things.

mandarin_meaning: 绕道 (ràodào)：绕开、绕行；也可引申为委婉、迂回地表达或回避正面冲突
english_meaning: to take a detour; to go around (literally); to avoid the direct issue or speak in a roundabout way (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 指改變路線或行徑以避開阻礙（如交通事故），也可引申為說話或處事時不正面、委婉地迂回表達或避開敏感話題。
explanation_english: Literally, to change route to avoid an obstacle (e.g., take a different road after an accident). Figuratively, to avoid addressing something directly or to speak/act in a roundabout, indirect way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面有車禍，我哋要繞道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 jau5 ce1 wo6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 naau6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面發生了車禍，我們要繞道。
examples.english_sentence: There's an accident up ahead; we need to take a detour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋繞道講，唔想直接講老闆係咪做錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 naau6 dou6 gong2, m4 soeng2 zik6 zip3 gong2 lou5 baan2 hai6 mai6 zou6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們繞圈子地說話，不想直接說老闆是否做錯。
examples.english_sentence: They spoke around the issue; they didn't want to directly say whether the boss was at fault.

mandarin_meaning: 绣；刺绣
english_meaning: embroidery; to embroider
explanation_mandarin: 指用針線在布料上繡圖案或文字，亦可指繡出來的花樣或工藝。
explanation_english: To decorate cloth with needle and thread (embroidery); can also refer to the embroidered work or pattern.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺裙邊繡咗一朵花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 kwan4 bin1 sau3 zo2 jat1 do2 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在裙边绣了一朵花。
examples.english_sentence: She embroidered a flower on the hem of the skirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫嘅繡工好精細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 sau3 gung1 hou2 zing1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服的绣工很精细。
examples.english_sentence: The embroidery on this garment is very fine.

mandarin_meaning: 绣品；刺绣制品
english_meaning: embroidered goods; embroidery pieces
explanation_mandarin: 指以刺繡手工製作的織物或裝飾品，如桌布、衣飾、手帕等，強調繡花或針線工藝的成品。
explanation_english: Refers to textile items or decorative pieces made by embroidery, such as tablecloths, garments, and handkerchiefs — finished products that feature embroidered work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲繡品係佢奶奶親手做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 sau3 ban2 hai6 keoi5 naai5 naai5 can1 sau2 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些绣品是他奶奶亲手做的。
examples.english_sentence: These embroidered pieces were made by his grandmother.

mandarin_meaning: 绣出曲线；在布料上绣出弧形或曲线图案
english_meaning: to embroider a curved line; an embroidered curvilinear pattern
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 名词（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 指在布料或服饰上用针线绣出弧形或曲线的图案，常见于旗袍、刺绣工艺等；也可泛指在装饰上加入弯曲线条以增添美感。
explanation_english: Refers to embroidering curved or arched lines/patterns on fabric or garments, commonly seen in cheongsams and embroidery crafts; can also generally mean adding curved lines in decoration to enhance aesthetics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件旗袍上面繡曲線，睇落好精緻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 kei4 paau4 soeng6 min6 sau3 kuk1 sin3, tai2 lok6 hou2 zing1 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件旗袍上绣着曲线，看起来很精致。
examples.english_sentence: This cheongsam has embroidered curvilinear patterns; it looks very delicate.

mandarin_meaning: 绣球；绣球花（花卉）；传统用于抛掷的绣球（媒介、玩具）
english_meaning: 1) Hydrangea (the flower). 2) An embroidered ball (traditionally thrown in courtship games).
explanation_mandarin: 可指繡球花（Hydrangea）的花朵；亦可指傳統的繡球（用布或絲綢繡成的球），在某些婚俗或遊戲中用來拋接選伴或作為娛樂。
explanation_english: Refers to the hydrangea flower; can also mean an embroidered ball (made of cloth or silk) traditionally used in some courtship customs or games where the ball is thrown and caught to choose a partner or for fun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺花園種咗好多繡球花，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 faa1 jyun4 zung3 zo2 hou2 do1 sau3 gau1 faa1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在花园种了很多绣球花，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: He planted many hydrangeas in the garden; they look very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前有啲地方新娘會拋繡球，睇下邊個會接到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 jau5 di1 dei6 fong1 san1 noeng4 wui5 paau1 sau3 gau1, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 wui5 zip3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前有些地方新娘會拋繡球，看看誰會接到。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, brides in some places would throw embroidered balls to see who would catch them.

mandarin_meaning: 繡花 (xiùhuā)
english_meaning: embroidery; to embroider
explanation_mandarin: 指用針線在布料上繡出圖案的手工藝或用此技術製作的成品。
explanation_english: Refers to the craft of decorating fabric with needle and thread (embroidery), or items made by this technique.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽鍾意繡花，佢啲被單好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 zung1 ji3 sau3 faa1, keoi5 di1 bei6 daan1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我媽媽喜歡繡花，她的被單很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: My mother likes embroidering; her bedsheets are very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間舖頭賣好多繡花手工藝品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 hou2 do1 sau3 faa1 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家店賣很多繡花手工藝品。
examples.english_sentence: That shop sells many embroidered handicrafts.

mandarin_meaning: 绳子；绳索
english_meaning: rope; cord; string
explanation_mandarin: 用來綑綁、牽引或固定物品的長條柔性材料，通常由纖維或合成材料製成。
explanation_english: A long flexible material used for tying, binding, pulling, or securing objects, typically made from fibers or synthetic materials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我拎條繩嚟，我要綁啲箱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 ling1 tiu4 sing4 lai4, ngo5 jiu3 bong2 di1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幫我拿條繩來，我要綁箱子。
examples.english_sentence: Bring me the rope, I need to tie the boxes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條繩好舊，唔好再用喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sing4 hou2 gau6, m4 hou2 zoi3 jung6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條繩很舊，不要再用了。
examples.english_sentence: This rope is very old; don't use it anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 绳之以法 / 依法惩处
english_meaning: to bring to justice; punish according to law
explanation_mandarin: 表示依法对犯罪或违法行为进行惩处，使其受到法律制裁。
explanation_english: Means to punish criminals or lawbreakers according to the law; to bring someone to legal justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方最終將涉案嫌疑人繩之於法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zeoi3 zung1 zoeng1 sip3 on3 jim4 ji4 jan4 sing4 zi1 jyu1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方最终将涉案嫌疑人绳之以法。
examples.english_sentence: The police ultimately brought the suspect involved in the case to justice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 貪污官員終於被繩之於法，市民都鬆咗一口氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taam1 wu1 gun1 jyun4 zung1 jyu1 bei6 sing4 zi1 jyu1 faat3, si5 man4 dou1 sung1 zo2 jat1 hau2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 贪污官员终于被绳之以法，市民都松了一口气。
examples.english_sentence: The corrupt official was finally brought to justice, and citizens breathed a sigh of relief.

mandarin_meaning: 绳子（繩子）：用来捆绑、悬挂或牵拉物品的长条状纤维或合成材料。
english_meaning: rope; cord; string — a length of braided or twisted fibers or synthetic material used for tying, binding, or pulling objects.
explanation_mandarin: 繩子指由天然纖維或合成材料編織或捻成的長條，用於綑綁、捆紮、懸掛或牽引等日常用途，也可指一般的繩索。
explanation_english: A rope or cord made of natural fibers or synthetic material, used for tying, binding, hanging, or pulling. Common everyday object referring to lengths of rope or cordage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以借我條繩子？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 ngo5 tiu4 seng4 zi2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把繩子借給我嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you lend me the rope?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用條繩子綁住個花盆，等佢唔會跌落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jung6 tiu4 seng4 zi2 bong2 zyu6 go3 faa1 pun4, dang2 keoi5 m4 wui5 dit3 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用一條繩子把花盆綁住，免得它會掉下來。
examples.english_sentence: I tied the flower pot with a rope so it won't fall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條繩子好耐用，拎嚟綁重嘢都冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 seng4 zi2 hou2 noi6 jung6, ling1 lei4 bong2 zung6 je5 dou1 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條繩子很耐用，拿來綁重的東西也沒問題。
examples.english_sentence: This rope is very durable; it's fine to use it to tie heavy things.

mandarin_meaning: 绳索（用于捆绑、牵引或固定的长条状物）
english_meaning: rope; cord; cable — a long flexible material used for tying, pulling, or securing
explanation_mandarin: 指用來捆綁、牽引、固定或攀援的長條狀物，通常由纖維、合成材料或金屬繩製成；在口語中亦可泛指各類繩類物品。
explanation_english: Refers to a long, flexible item used for tying, pulling, securing, or climbing, typically made from fibers, synthetic materials, or metal; commonly used to denote various kinds of ropes or cords.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 救生員用繩索拋向落海嘅人，然後幫佢拉上岸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau3 saang1 jyun4 jung6 sang4 sok3 paau1 hoeng3 lok6 hoi2 ge3 jan4, jan4 hau6 bong1 keoi5 laai1 soeng5 ngon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 救生员用绳索抛向落水的人，然后把他拉上岸。
examples.english_sentence: The lifeguard threw a rope toward the person who fell into the sea, then helped pull them to shore.

mandarin_meaning: 绳结
english_meaning: knot (in a rope); knotting; tie
explanation_mandarin: 指绳子上通过打结形成的结；也泛指各种结法（如船结、活结等）。
explanation_english: Refers to a knot made in a rope; can also denote different types of knots (e.g. sailor's knot, slip knot).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條繩結綁得好實，拆唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sing4 git3 bong2 dak1 hou2 sat6, caak3 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个绳结绑得很牢，解不开。
examples.english_sentence: This knot is tied very tightly; it won't come undone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺船上，船員要識好多種繩結。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 syun4 soeng5, syun4 jyun4 jiu3 sik1 hou2 do1 zung2 sing4 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在船上，船员要懂得很多种绳结。
examples.english_sentence: On a ship, sailors need to know many kinds of knots.

mandarin_meaning: 由繩子或網構成的陣勢或陷阱；比喻複雜的網狀結構或圈套
english_meaning: a formation/web of ropes or nets used as a trap; figuratively, a complicated entanglement or snare
explanation_mandarin: 本詞原指用繩索或網布置成的陣勢以捉拿動物或設陷阱，延伸用作比喻，指複雜的圈套或讓人難以抽身的糾纏。
explanation_english: Originally refers to an arrangement of ropes or nets set up as a trap to catch animals; figuratively it describes a complicated trap or entanglement that is hard to get out of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺山林度布咗個繩網陣，想捉小動物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 saan1 lam4 dou6 bou3 zo2 go3 sing4 mong5 zan6, soeng2 zuk1 siu2 dung6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在山林裡布了個繩網陣，想抓小動物。
examples.english_sentence: They set up a web of ropes in the woods to catch small animals.

mandarin_meaning: 繪（huì）：繪畫、描繪、繪製（用於合成詞，如繪畫、繪本、繪製）
english_meaning: to draw/paint; to depict or illustrate; (used in compounds) illustration, picture
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 名詞（視詞性而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「繪」常用於合成詞中，表示用筆或其他工具製作圖像或描繪事物，例如「繪畫」「繪製」「繪本」。
explanation_english: Used mainly in compounds to mean drawing or painting, or the act of depicting/illustrating (e.g. 繪畫, 繪製, 繪本).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意繪畫風景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 wui6 waa6 fung1 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜歡繪畫風景。
examples.english_sentence: He likes painting landscapes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本繪本好啱細路仔睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 wui6 bun2 hou2 aam1 sai3 lou6 zai2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本繪本很適合小孩子看。
examples.english_sentence: This picture book is great for children to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 藝術家將佢嘅繪作展出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngai6 seot6 gaa1 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 wui6 zok3 zin2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 藝術家把他的繪作展出。
examples.english_sentence: The artist exhibited his artwork.

mandarin_meaning: 绘图；绘制图画或图形
english_meaning: to draw; to create graphics/illustrations (by hand or with a computer)
explanation_mandarin: 指用手工或電腦等工具繪製圖畫、插圖、示意圖或圖表，包含手繪與數位繪圖。
explanation_english: To draw or produce images/graphics—by hand or using software—such as illustrations, diagrams, or charts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意用電腦繪圖做設計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jung6 din6 nou5 wui6 tou4 zou6 cit3 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢用电脑绘图做设计。
examples.english_sentence: I like to use computer drawing/graphics to do design.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師教我哋點樣繪圖同上色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 dim2 joeng6 wui6 tou4 tung4 soeng5 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师教我们怎样绘图和上色。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher taught us how to draw and color.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電腦繪圖可以幫手整複雜嘅插圖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 nou5 wui6 tou4 ho2 ji5 bong1 sau2 zing2 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 caap3 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑绘图可以帮助制作复杂的插图。
examples.english_sentence: Computer drawing can help produce complex illustrations.

mandarin_meaning: 繪圖板 / 數位繪圖板
english_meaning: drawing tablet; graphics tablet
explanation_mandarin: 一種輸入設備，可透過壓感手寫筆在電腦或平板上繪畫、書寫或進行精細筆觸操作，常用於數位繪圖與修圖。
explanation_english: An input device that allows drawing or handwriting on a computer or tablet using a pressure-sensitive stylus, commonly used for digital illustration and photo editing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗部繪圖板，宜家用嚟畫數碼插畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 kwai3 tou4 baan2, ji4 gaa1 jung6 lai4 waa6 sou3 maa5 caat1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了繪圖板，現在用來畫數位插畫。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a drawing tablet; now I use it to draw digital illustrations.

mandarin_meaning: 栩栩如生；形容描寫或表演非常生動逼真
english_meaning: vivid and lifelike; describing something (a story, description, or performance) as very vivid and realistic
explanation_mandarin: 形容敘述、描寫或表演非常生動，好像有畫面和聲音一樣，令人有臨場感。
explanation_english: Describes a description, narration, or performance that is so vivid and realistic it feels as if images and sounds are being painted — very evocative and lifelike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講故仔講得繪影繪聲，大家聽得好投入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 gu3 zai2 gong2 dak1 kwai2 jing2 kwai2 sing1, daai6 gaa1 teng1 dak1 hou2 tau4 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他講故事講得繪影繪聲，大家聽得很投入。
examples.english_sentence: He told the story so vividly that everyone listened with great involvement.

mandarin_meaning: 繪本 / 圖畫書
english_meaning: picture book
explanation_mandarin: 以圖畫為主、文字較少、通常供兒童閱讀的書籍，強調圖像敘事或視覺表現。
explanation_english: A book that emphasizes illustrations with relatively little text, usually intended for children; focused on visual storytelling or pictorial presentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一本好靚嘅繪本俾細路睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 bun2 hou2 leng3 ge3 kwai2 bun2 bei2 sai3 lou6 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一本很漂亮的繪本給小朋友看。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a very pretty picture book for the child to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館有好多新嘅繪本可以借。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 jau5 hou2 do1 san1 ge3 kwai2 bun2 ho2 ji5 ze3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圖書館有很多新的繪本可以借。
examples.english_sentence: The library has many new picture books available for borrowing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師喺課堂上翻開繪本教小朋友識顏色同數字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 hai2 fo3 tong4 soeng5 faan1 hoi1 kwai2 bun2 gaau1 siu2 pang4 jau5 sik1 ngaan4 sik1 tung4 sou3 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師在課堂上翻開繪本，教小朋友認識顏色和數字。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher opened a picture book in class to teach the children colors and numbers.

mandarin_meaning: 繪畫；作畫；畫畫
english_meaning: painting; to paint; drawing
explanation_mandarin: 指用顏料、鉛筆等在紙、布等媒材上創作圖像的藝術行為或其作品，也可指繪圖的過程或技能。
explanation_english: The act or art of creating images with paint, pencil, etc., on surfaces like paper or canvas; can refer to the practice, the technique, or the finished artwork.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自細就鍾意繪畫，依家係位職業畫家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 sai3 zau6 zung1 ji3 kwai2 waa6, ji1 gaa1 hai6 wai6 zik1 jip6 waa6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他從小就喜歡繪畫，現在是一位職業畫家。
examples.english_sentence: He has liked painting since childhood and is now a professional painter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校開咗一個繪畫工作坊，畀學生試下不同材料同技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 hoi1 zo2 jat1 go3 kwai2 waa6 gung1 zok3 fong1, bei2 hok6 saang1 si3 haa5 bat1 tung4 coi4 liu2 tung4 gei6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校開了一個繪畫工作坊，讓學生嘗試不同的材料和技巧。
examples.english_sentence: The school started a painting workshop to let students try different materials and techniques.

mandarin_meaning: 绘制 (huìzhì)
english_meaning: to draw; to illustrate; to produce a diagram or map
explanation_mandarin: 表示用繪畫或圖表的方式製作圖像、地圖或示意圖，常用於設計、製圖或說明資料。
explanation_english: To produce drawings, illustrations, diagrams, or maps—often used in design, drafting, or making explanatory graphics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想用電腦繪製一張地圖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jung6 din6 nou5 wui6 zai3 jat1 zoeng1 dei6 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想用電腦繪製一張地圖。
examples.english_sentence: I want to use the computer to draw a map.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工程師用軟件繪製藍圖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 cing4 si1 jung6 jyun5 gin6 wui6 zai3 laam4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工程師用軟件繪製藍圖。
examples.english_sentence: The engineer used software to produce the blueprint.

mandarin_meaning: 系；系上（把东西用绳子或带子固定）
english_meaning: to tie; to fasten; to secure (with a rope, strap, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示用繩子、帶子等把物件固定或連接起來，常用於「繫安全帶」、「繫鞋帶」等情況。這個字在粵語有時可讀為 gai3 或 hai6，語境不同用法相同。
explanation_english: Means to fasten or tie something using a rope, strap, etc. Commonly used in contexts like 'fasten your seatbelt' or 'tie your shoelaces'. In Cantonese it can be pronounced gai3 or hai6 depending on usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開車之前記得繫好安全帶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 ce1 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 gai3 hou2 on1 cyun4 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开车之前记得系好安全带。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to fasten your seatbelt before driving.

mandarin_meaning: 蚕茧；皮肤因摩擦或压迫形成的茧（如老茧）
english_meaning: cocoon; (skin) callus
explanation_mandarin: 「繭」可指昆蟲（如蠶）吐絲繭成的外殼，也可指人或動物皮膚因長期摩擦或壓迫而形成的角質增厚處（老茧）。
explanation_english: “繭” refers to a cocoon spun by insects (e.g., silkworms). It can also mean a callus on the skin formed by repeated friction or pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 蠶繭可以抽絲做絲綢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caam4 gaan2 ho2 ji5 caau1 si1 zou6 si1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蚕茧可以抽丝做丝绸。
examples.english_sentence: Cocoons can be reeled to make silk fabric.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行咗成日路，我腳底起咗繭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 zo2 sing4 jat6 lou6, ngo5 goek3 dai2 hei2 zo2 gaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走了一整天路，我脚底起了茧。
examples.english_sentence: After walking all day, I developed calluses on the soles of my feet.

mandarin_meaning: 縊首死刑（以繩索勒頸致死的死刑）
english_meaning: death penalty by hanging (execution by strangling the neck)
explanation_mandarin: 一種古代或法律上的極刑，指以繩索等勒頸致死的處刑方式，屬死刑的一種。
explanation_english: An archaic/legal form of capital punishment referring to execution by hanging or strangulation with a rope; a type of death penalty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺古代，繯首死刑係用嚟懲罰重大罪行嘅一種極刑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gu2 doi6, wun6 sau2 sei2 hang4 hai6 jung6 lai4 cing4 faat3 zung6 daai6 zeoi6 hang4 ge3 jat1 zung2 gik6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在古代，繯首死刑是用來懲罰重大罪行的一種極刑。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, hanging as a death penalty was used as an extreme punishment for serious crimes.

mandarin_meaning: 交納、繳交（如繳費、繳交表格、繳械）
english_meaning: to pay (fees), to hand in/submit, to surrender (e.g. arms)
explanation_mandarin: 表示交付、繳納或上交某物或款項，如繳費、繳交文件或繳械投降。
explanation_english: Indicates handing over, paying, or submitting something (e.g. paying fees, submitting documents, surrendering arms).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要繳費先可以入場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 giu2 fai3 sin1 ho2 ji5 jap6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要繳費才能入場。
examples.english_sentence: You need to pay to enter.

mandarin_meaning: 繳交（提交、上交、繳納）
english_meaning: to submit; to hand in; to pay (fees)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把款項、文件或物品交付給有關單位或提交給上級，例如繳交費用或繳交申請表。
explanation_english: To hand over money, documents, or items to a relevant party; to submit or pay something (e.g., fees, forms).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請於下星期一之前將申請表繳交到辦公室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 jyu1 haa6 sing1 kei4 jat1 zi1 cin4 zoeng1 san1 cing2 biu2 giu2 gaau1 dou3 baan6 gung1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請於下星期一之前將申請表繳交到辦公室。
examples.english_sentence: Please submit the application form to the office before next Monday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得喺開學前繳交學費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 hai2 hoi1 hok6 cin4 giu2 gaau1 hok6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你記得在開學前繳交學費。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to pay/submit the tuition before the semester starts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 稅款要喺月底之前繳交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi3 fun2 jiu3 hai2 jyut6 dai2 zi1 cin4 giu2 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 稅款要在月底之前繳交。
examples.english_sentence: The tax payment must be submitted by the end of the month.

mandarin_meaning: 繳付 (缴付)；支付、繳納款項或費用
english_meaning: to pay; to hand over payment (fees, fines, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示將款項或費用支付或繳納給有關單位或個人的動作。
explanation_english: Denotes the action of paying or remitting money (such as fees, fines, or dues) to the relevant party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得喺限期之前繳付學費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 hai2 haan6 kei4 zi1 cin4 gaau2 fu6 hok6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你記得在限期之前繳付學費。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to pay the tuition before the deadline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經繳付咗罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 gaau2 fu6 zo2 faat3 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經繳付了罰款。
examples.english_sentence: He has already paid the fine.

mandarin_meaning: 缴械；放下武器；投降
english_meaning: to disarm; to lay down arms; to surrender (weapons)
explanation_mandarin: 指交出或放下武器，亦可引申為放棄抵抗、投降。
explanation_english: To hand over or lay down weapons; can also be used figuratively to mean giving up resistance or surrendering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方命令匪徒繳械投降。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 ming6 ling6 fei2 tou4 giu2 hei3 tau4 hong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方命令匪徒缴械投降。
examples.english_sentence: The police ordered the criminals to disarm and surrender.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最後佢繳械，接受咗老闆嘅條件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 hau6 keoi5 giu2 hei3, zip3 sau6 zo2 lou5 baan2 ge3 tiu4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最後他缴械，接受了老闆的條件。
examples.english_sentence: In the end he gave in and accepted the boss's terms.

mandarin_meaning: 繳交、支付（款項或稅費等）
english_meaning: to pay; to remit; to hand over (fees, taxes, fines, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指按照規定把款項、稅費或其他應繳之物交付或支付給相關單位或個人。
explanation_english: Refers to handing over or paying money or items that are required to be paid (such as fees, taxes, fines) to the relevant authority or person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嗰封通知話要喺月底前繳納管理費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 go2 fung1 tung1 zi1 waa6 jiu3 hai2 jyut6 dai2 cin4 giu2 naap6 gun2 lei5 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司那封通知說要在月底前繳納管理費。
examples.english_sentence: The company's notice says the management fee must be paid before the end of the month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果遲咗繳納，會有罰款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ci4 zo2 giu2 naap6, wui5 jau5 fat6 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果遲了繳納，會有罰款。
examples.english_sentence: If you pay late, there will be a fine.

mandarin_meaning: 繳費處（缴费处）：繳交費用的地方或櫃位
english_meaning: payment counter / payment office; a place or counter where fees or bills are paid
explanation_mandarin: 指可以繳交費用、付賬的地點或櫃位，例如銀行大堂、政府部門、屋苑管理處或商場內的繳費處。
explanation_english: Refers to a place or counter where payments or fees are made, such as a payment counter in a bank lobby, a government office, an estate management office, or a mall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺大堂嘅繳費處用現金交水電費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 daai6 tong4 ge3 giu2 fai3 cyu3 jung6 jin6 gam1 gaau1 seoi2 din6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以在大堂的繳費處用現金繳交水電費。
examples.english_sentence: You can pay your water and electricity bills in cash at the payment counter in the lobby.

mandarin_meaning: 繹（yì）：原指抽絲、解開；引申為梳理、推演或剖析事物來龍去脈
english_meaning: to untangle/unravel (originally silk); to sort out, analyze, deduce or interpret
explanation_mandarin: 繹字本義為抽絲解開。常用於書面語，表示把複雜的線索或文獻逐一梳理、分析並推演出原委或結論。
explanation_english: Originally refers to unravelling silk. In literary use it means to sift through and analyze complex clues or texts, deducing the underlying sequence of events or conclusions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察抽絲剝繭，終於繹出案件嘅真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 cau1 si1 bok3 gaan2, zung1 jyu1 jik6 ceot1 on3 gin6 ge3 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方抽絲剝繭，終於釐清了案件的真相。
examples.english_sentence: The police painstakingly unraveled the case and finally uncovered the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 继（繼）：继续、继承、随后
english_meaning: to continue; to inherit; to follow after
explanation_mandarin: 漢字「繼」常用於複合詞中，表示繼續或承接前者的行為或狀態，例如「繼續」「繼承」。也可表示接替、隨後之意。
explanation_english: The character 繼 is commonly used in compounds to mean to continue or to succeed/ inherit (e.g. 繼續, 繼承). It indicates continuation, succession, or following after.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢會繼承爸爸嘅公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wui5 gai3 sing4 baa4 baa1 ge3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他會繼承爸爸的公司。
examples.english_sentence: He will inherit his father's company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要繼續努力，冇得放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gai3 zuk6 nou5 lik6, mou5 dak1 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要继续努力，不能放弃。
examples.english_sentence: We must continue to work hard; we can't give up.

mandarin_meaning: 继任 (jìrèn)
english_meaning: to succeed (to a post); to take over a position or office
explanation_mandarin: 指接替前任而擔任某個職務或職位，成為新的任職者。
explanation_english: To take over a position or office from a predecessor; to succeed someone in a post.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將會繼任公司總經理嘅職位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 wui5 gai3 jam6 gung1 si1 zung2 ging1 lei5 ge3 zik1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他將會繼任公司總經理的職位。
examples.english_sentence: He will succeed to the position of general manager of the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 董事長宣佈由副董事長繼任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong2 si6 zoeng2 syun1 bou3 jau4 fu3 dong2 si6 zoeng2 gai3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 董事長宣布由副董事長繼任。
examples.english_sentence: The chairman announced that the vice chairman will succeed him.

mandarin_meaning: 继任者；接替原有職務或崗位的人
english_meaning: successor; a person who takes over a position or role
explanation_mandarin: 指接替原有職務或崗位的人，通常用於工作、官職或其他職位的交接情況。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who replaces another in a job, office, or role — commonly used when describing a handover of duties or position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 董事會已經揀咗繼任人，佢會喺下個月上任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong2 si6 wui2 ji5 ging1 gaan2 zo2 gai3 jam6 jan4, keoi5 wui5 hai2 haa6 go3 jyut6 soeng5 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 董事會已經選出繼任人，他會在下個月上任。
examples.english_sentence: The board has already chosen a successor; he will take office next month.

mandarin_meaning: 继位
english_meaning: to succeed to the throne; to ascend (to a position)
explanation_mandarin: 指在前任退位或去世後，承接君位或職位，尤指君主或最高領導者的繼承。
explanation_english: To take over a throne or official position after the predecessor abdicates or dies; especially used for a monarch or head of state assuming the throne.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太子會喺皇帝退位之後繼位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 zi2 wui5 hai2 wong4 dai3 teoi3 wai6 zi1 hau6 gai3 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太子會在皇帝退位之後繼位。
examples.english_sentence: The crown prince will succeed to the throne after the emperor abdicates.

mandarin_meaning: 繼承者；繼承家業或爵位的人；也可作動詞，意為繼承、承襲
english_meaning: successor; heir (one who succeeds to a family line, title, or estate); also a verb meaning to succeed or inherit
explanation_mandarin: 多用於正式或書面語，指承襲宗祧、爵位或家產的人，也可表示繼承這一動作。
explanation_english: A formal/literary term referring to someone who succeeds a family line, title, or estate; can also denote the act of succeeding or inheriting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個大家族冇繼嗣，擔心香火會斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 daai6 gaa1 zuk6 mou5 gai3 si6, daam1 sam1 hoeng1 fo2 wui5 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個大家族沒有繼嗣，擔心香火會斷。
examples.english_sentence: That extended family has no successor and worries the family line will die out.

mandarin_meaning: 繼子（配偶先前所生的兒子）
english_meaning: stepson (a male child of one's spouse from a previous relationship)
explanation_mandarin: 指配偶在婚前所生、婚後成為家庭成員的男性子女，特指不是親生而是繼關係的兒子。
explanation_english: Refers to a male child of one's spouse from a prior relationship who becomes a member of the family after marriage; specifically a non-biological son by marriage (stepson).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我老婆嘅繼子，但我哋都好錫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 lou5po4 ge3 gai3 zi2, daan6 ngo5 dei6 dou1 hou2 sek3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我老婆的繼子，但我們都很疼他。
examples.english_sentence: He is my wife's stepson, but we all care for him a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 继承过去，开创未来
english_meaning: To build on what has gone before and open up the future; inherit the past and forge ahead
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成语（可作谓语或名词短语）
explanation_mandarin: 表示承接過去的經驗或成就，同時開創新的局面或發展方向，常用於政治、工作或歷史語境。
explanation_english: Expresses carrying forward past achievements or experience while pioneering new developments; commonly used in political, organizational, or historical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新政府強調要繼往開來，承傳好的政策，同時帶來新氣象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 zing3 fu2 koeng4 diu6 jiu3 gai3 wong5 hoi1 loi4, sing4 cyun4 hou2 ge3 zing3 caak3, tung4 si4 daai3 loi4 san1 hei3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新政府强调要继往开来，承传好的政策，同时带来新气象。
examples.english_sentence: The new government emphasizes building on the past and opening up the future, inheriting good policies while bringing new developments.

mandarin_meaning: 繼承（取得財產、權利、職務或承接傳統等）
english_meaning: to inherit; to succeed to (property, rights, duties, traditions, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 表示從前人或上一個時期接收或承擔財產、權利、職務、責任或延續某種傳統或習俗。
explanation_english: To receive or take over property, rights, positions, responsibilities, or to carry on traditions from predecessors or a previous generation/period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢會繼承父母嘅遺產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wui5 gai3 sing4 fu6 mou5 ge3 wai4 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他會繼承父母的遺產。
examples.english_sentence: He will inherit his parents' estate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅管理權會由下一代繼承。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 gun2 lei5 kyun4 wui5 jau4 haa6 jat1 doi6 gai3 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的管理權會由下一代繼承。
examples.english_sentence: The company's management authority will be inherited by the next generation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該繼承並發揚傳統文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 gai3 sing4 bing6 faat3 joeng4 cyun4 tung2 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們應該繼承並發揚傳統文化。
examples.english_sentence: We should inherit and promote traditional culture.

mandarin_meaning: 繼母 / 继母 (jìmǔ)
english_meaning: stepmother
explanation_mandarin: 指父母一方再婚後，與自己沒有血緣關係但擔任母親角色的女性。
explanation_english: A woman who becomes a child's mother through a parent's remarriage; not biologically related but fulfills the mother role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅繼母好關心佢嘅學業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 mou5 hou2 gwaan1 sam1 keoi5 ge3 hok6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的繼母很關心他的學業。
examples.english_sentence: His stepmother cares a lot about his studies.

mandarin_meaning: 继父 (jìfù)
english_meaning: stepfather
explanation_mandarin: 指母親再婚後，與孩子沒有血緣關係但成為其父親身份的男人，即繼父。
explanation_english: The man who becomes a child's father by marrying the mother, not biologically related to the child; a stepfather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅繼父好照顧佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 fu6 hou2 ziu3 gu3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的继父很照顾他。
examples.english_sentence: His stepfather takes good care of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為舊年佢媽媽再婚，所以佢有個繼父。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 gau6 nin4 keoi5 maa4 maa1 zoi3 fan1, so2 ji5 keoi5 jau5 go3 gai3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为去年他媽媽再婚，所以他有了一个继父。
examples.english_sentence: Because his mother remarried last year, he now has a stepfather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法院會決定繼父有冇監護權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 jyun6 wui5 kyut3 ding6 gai3 fu6 jau5 mou5 gaam1 wu6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法院会决定继父是否有监护权。
examples.english_sentence: The court will decide whether the stepfather has custody rights.

mandarin_meaning: 继续 (jìxù)
english_meaning: to continue; to carry on; to resume; to proceed
explanation_mandarin: 表示某個動作或狀態不中斷地延續下去，或在暫停後再開始進行。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or state is carried on without stopping, or resumed after a pause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋繼續開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 zuk6 hoi1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们继续开会。
examples.english_sentence: Let's continue the meeting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇問題，我會繼續做落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 mou5 man6 tai4, ngo5 wui5 gai3 zuk6 zou6 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没有问题，我会继续做下去。
examples.english_sentence: If there are no problems, I'll continue doing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺講電話，繼續唔理我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gong2 din6 waa2, gai3 zuk6 m4 lei5 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在打电话，继续不理我。
examples.english_sentence: He was on the phone and continued to ignore me.

mandarin_meaning: 继而 (jì'ér)，表示随后、然后
english_meaning: subsequently; thereafter; then
explanation_mandarin: 表示某一動作或事件之後緊接發生另一動作或情況，語氣偏書面、正式。
explanation_english: A formal connective meaning 'then' or 'subsequently', used to indicate that one action or event follows another; commonly used in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢先完成報告，繼而開始準備簡報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sin1 jyun4 sing4 bou3 gou3, gai3 ji4 hoi1 ci2 zeon2 bei6 gaan2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他先完成報告，繼而開始準備簡報。
examples.english_sentence: He first finished the report, and then began preparing the presentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 調查顯示資金短缺，繼而多個項目要延期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: diu6 caa4 hin2 si6 zi1 gam1 dyun2 kyut3, gai3 ji4 do1 go3 hong6 muk6 jiu3 jin4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 调查显示资金短缺，继而多个项目要延期。
examples.english_sentence: The investigation revealed funding shortages, and subsequently many projects had to be postponed.

mandarin_meaning: 繁多、色彩紛繁（常見於「繽紛」），表示多樣且豐富
english_meaning: numerous/variegated; colorful; in profusion (often used in the compound '繽紛' to describe something richly varied)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（多用於合成詞，如「繽紛」）
explanation_mandarin: 單字本身表示繁多或紛亂，最常見於「繽紛」一詞，用來形容色彩或事物多樣且豐富。
explanation_english: The character denotes multitude or a profusion, often appearing in the compound '繽紛' to describe something colorful, diverse, or richly varied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上掛滿彩燈，顏色繽紛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng6 gwaa3 mun5 coi2 dang1, ngaan4 sik1 ban1 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上掛滿彩燈，顏色繽紛。
examples.english_sentence: The street is hung with colorful lanterns; the colors are vibrant and varied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 秋天樹葉顏色繽紛，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau1 tin1 syu6 jip6 ngaan4 sik1 ban1 fan1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 秋天樹葉顏色繽紛，很美。
examples.english_sentence: In autumn the leaves are colorful and beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 繽紛 (bīn fēn) — 色彩繁多、鮮豔多彩或事物多姿多彩
english_meaning: colorful; brightly colored; vividly varied
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容色彩繁多、鮮豔或多樣、多姿多彩的樣子，常用於描述場景、裝飾、服飾等。
explanation_english: Describes something that is rich in colors or richly varied in appearance; commonly used for scenes, decorations, clothing, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上掛滿繽紛嘅氣球，好有節日氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 seong6 gwaa3 mun5 ban1 fan1 ge3 hei3 kau4, hou2 jau5 zit3 jat6 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上掛滿了繽紛的氣球，很有節日氣氛。
examples.english_sentence: The street is hung with colorful balloons; it feels very festive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗一件繽紛嘅連身裙，吸引晒所有人嘅目光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 jat1 gin6 ban1 fan1 ge3 lin4 san1 kwan4, kap1 jan5 saai3 so2 jau5 jan4 ge3 muk6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿了一件繽紛的連衣裙，吸引了所有人的目光。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a colorful dress that drew everyone's attention.

mandarin_meaning: 编纂；编辑、撰写文献或资料
english_meaning: to compile; to edit; to compose (written works or records)
explanation_mandarin: 表示整理、编辑或撰写文献、资料或史料等。常見於「編纂」一詞。
explanation_english: Indicates compiling, editing, or composing documents, records, or historical materials. Often seen in the compound '編纂' (to compile).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責編纂呢本史書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6zaak3 bin1zyun2 ni1 bun2 si2 syu1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他負責編纂這本史書。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for compiling this history book.

mandarin_meaning: 缬（纈），指一種傳統的扎染／綁染技術；也可指用此法染出的布料
english_meaning: Tie-dye (traditional tie-and-dye technique) / cloth dyed by tie-dye
explanation_mandarin: 「纈」為傳統漢字，現多寫作「缬」，用來指以綁紮後染色的染布技術（即扎染或綁染），也可指用此技法製成的布料或花紋。
explanation_english: Traditional character for 缬, referring to a tie-and-dye dyeing technique (tie-dye) and to fabrics or patterns produced by that method.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫用纈染嘅技術做，色彩好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jung6 jit6 jim5 ge3 gei6 seot6 zou6, sik1 coi2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服用纈染的技術製作，顏色很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This garment was made using the tie-dye technique; the colors are very beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見漢字（與絲線相關的古字，今多不使用）
english_meaning: A rare/archaic Chinese character related to thread/twine; not used in modern Cantonese
explanation_mandarin: 「纊」為罕見或古字，帶有絲字旁，語源上與線、綑紮等概念相關，但在現代漢語中甚少使用，粵語並無固定的常用讀音。
explanation_english: 纊 is a rare or archaic character with the silk radical, historically connected to thread or binding. It is scarcely used in modern Chinese, and there is no established common Cantonese pronunciation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古籍入面見到「纊」呢個字，但而家好少人識讀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 zik6 jap6 min6 gin3 dou3 '纊' ni1 go3 zi6, daan6 ji4 gaa1 hou2 siu2 jan4 sik1 duk6 (無常用粵語讀音).
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古籍里能看到「纊」这个字，但现在很少有人会读（无常用粤语读音）。
examples.english_sentence: The character '纊' appears in old books, but nowadays few people can read it (there is no common Cantonese pronunciation).

mandarin_meaning: 罕見詞彙，意義不詳/已失傳（方言或古詞）
english_meaning: Obscure/rare term (meaning uncertain or lost; likely dialectal or archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 「纊褦」為非常罕見的詞彙，現代文獻與辭典中少有記載，可能是粵語方言或歷史遺留詞。具體意思與用法不明，通常在現代語境下被標記為不明或失傳詞。
explanation_english: “纊褦” is an extremely rare or obscure term with little to no attestation in modern references. It is likely dialectal or archaic; its precise meaning and usage are unclear or lost. In contemporary contexts it is treated as an unknown/obsolete word.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「纊褦」好罕見，冇人識用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 'gung1 noi6' hou2 hon2 gin3, mou5 jan4 sik1 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个词“纊褦”很罕见，没人会用。
examples.english_sentence: The term "纊褦" is very rare; nobody uses it.

mandarin_meaning: 絆倒；被絆住而跌倒（口語）
english_meaning: to trip (and fall); to be tripped up (physically or metaphorically)
explanation_mandarin: 「纊跌」為粵語口語用詞，表示被什麼東西絆倒或使人絆倒。既可指實際行走時被物件絆倒，也可比喻因阻礙而失敗或受挫。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to be tripped (and fall) or to trip someone. It can describe a literal stumble caused by an object, or be used figuratively for being hindered or set back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行路小心啲，唔好畀條繩纊跌你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang4 lou6 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 tiu4 sing4 baan6 dit3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走路小心，不要讓繩子絆倒你。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when you walk — don't let the rope trip you.

mandarin_meaning: 续 (xù)：表示继续、延续、续签、续订等
english_meaning: to continue; to renew; to extend; to follow on (often used in compounds like renew, sequel, renew subscription)
explanation_mandarin: 「續」用來表示延續或接續的動作，常見於合成詞如「續約」、「續集」、「續訂」，也可表示重新延長或補充。
explanation_english: Indicates continuation, renewal, or extension. Commonly appears in compounds such as 'renew contract' (續約), 'sequel' (續集), and 'renew subscription' (續訂).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想續約，因為而家嘅合約快到期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zuk6 joek3, jan1 wai6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 hap6 joek3 faai3 dou3 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想续约，因為現在的合約快到期。
examples.english_sentence: I want to renew the contract because the current one is about to expire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影有續集。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 jau5 zuk6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部電影有續集。
examples.english_sentence: This movie has a sequel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要續訂雜誌，唔想中斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 zuk6 deng6 zaat6 zi2, m4 soeng2 zung1 tyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要续訂雜誌，不想中斷。
examples.english_sentence: I want to renew my magazine subscription; I don't want it interrupted.

mandarin_meaning: 续任
english_meaning: to continue in office; to remain in a post; to be reappointed/continue one’s term
explanation_mandarin: 指继续担任某个职务或延长任期，可表示被延任或在同一岗位上继续任职。
explanation_english: To continue holding a position or office; to remain in or be reappointed to the same post, often implying an extension or continuation of the term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定讓佢續任董事長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 joeng6 keoi5 zuk6 jam6 dong2 si6 zoeng2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定让他续任董事长。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to let him continue as chairman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果評估結果良好，部長可以續任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ping4 gu1 git3 gwo2 loeng4 hou2, bou6 zoeng2 ho2 ji5 zuk6 jam6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果评估结果良好，部长可以续任。
examples.english_sentence: If the evaluation results are favorable, the minister may continue in office.

mandarin_meaning: 续保（续订保险、延续保单）
english_meaning: to renew an insurance policy; policy renewal
explanation_mandarin: 指在保單到期後再次辦理，使保險保障繼續生效或延長保單期限。
explanation_english: To renew an insurance policy so that the coverage continues or the policy term is extended after the original expiry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 車險到期，記得要續保。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ce1 him2 dou3 kei4, gei3 dak1 jiu3 zuk6 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车险到期，记得要续保。
examples.english_sentence: Your car insurance is about to expire; remember to renew it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔續保，保單就會失效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 zuk6 bou2, bou2 daan1 zau6 wui5 sat1 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不续保，保单就会失效。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't renew the policy, the insurance will lapse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保險公司通常會提前一個月通知你續保。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 him2 gung1 si1 tung1 soeng4 wui5 tai4 cin4 jat1 go3 jyut6 tung1 zi1 nei5 zuk6 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保险公司通常会提前一个月通知你续保。
examples.english_sentence: Insurance companies usually notify you about renewal one month in advance.

mandarin_meaning: 續借（延長借閱或借用期限）
english_meaning: to renew (a loan or borrowing period), e.g. renew a library book
explanation_mandarin: 用於借用物品（常見於圖書館或租借），表示在原有借期屆滿前或到期後延長借用期限。
explanation_english: Used when extending the borrowing period of an item (commonly for library books or rentals); it means to extend the original loan period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以喺圖書館續借呢本書嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 zuk6 ze3 ni1 bun2 syu1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以在圖書館續借這本書嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can I renew this book at the library?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來到期㗎，但我上網續借咗七日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 loi4 dou3 kei4 gaa3, daan6 ngo5 soeng5 mong5 zuk6 ze3 zo2 cat1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本來到期了，但我在網上續借了七天。
examples.english_sentence: It was due, but I renewed it online for seven days.

mandarin_meaning: 续审；继续审理（案件）；恢复或延续开庭审理
english_meaning: to continue or resume a hearing/trial; continued hearing
explanation_mandarin: 法律術語，指在某案件中延後或再次進行審理／開庭，或法院將案件續排至其他日期繼續審理。
explanation_english: A legal term meaning to continue or resume the hearing/trial of a case, typically when a court adjourns and schedules a later date to carry on proceedings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法庭決定下星期續審此案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 teng4 kyut3 ding6 haa6 sing1 kei4 zuk6 sam2 ci2 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法庭决定下星期继续审理此案。
examples.english_sentence: The court decided to continue hearing the case next week.

mandarin_meaning: 续庭（继续开庭或将案件押后到另一个日期审理）
english_meaning: to adjourn a court hearing; to continue a trial/hearing to a later date
explanation_mandarin: 「續庭」多用於法律/法庭語境，指法官或法庭將案件的審理延後到另一日期繼續進行。有時在日常說話中也可泛指將某事延後再處理。
explanation_english: Used mainly in legal/court contexts to indicate that a judge or court postpones a hearing so it will continue on a later date. Informally it can also mean postponing something to handle later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次案件今晚唔判，法官話要續庭到下星期一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ngaan6 gin6 gam1 maan5 m4 pun3, faat3 gun1 waa6 jiu3 zuk6 ting4 dou3 haa6 sing1 kei4 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次案件今晚不判，法官说要续庭到下星期一。
examples.english_sentence: The case won't be decided tonight; the judge said it will be adjourned to next Monday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法庭表示因為證據不足，案件要續庭再排期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 ting4 biu2 si6 jan1 wai6 zing3 geoi3 bat1 zuk1, ngaan6 gin6 jiu3 zuk6 ting4 zoi3 paai4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法庭表示因为证据不足，案件要续庭再排期。
examples.english_sentence: The court said that due to insufficient evidence, the case will be adjourned and rescheduled.

mandarin_meaning: 續弦（男子在配偶去世或離婚後再娶他人；亦可指更換弦線，為古語用法）
english_meaning: to take a second wife; to remarry (typically referring to a man remarrying after his spouse's death or divorce); archaically, to replace a string
explanation_mandarin: 指男子在配偶去世或離婚後重新娶妻，多用於指再娶第二任妻子。古代文獻中亦有指更換樂器弦線的用法，但較少見。
explanation_english: Refers to a man remarrying (taking another wife) after his spouse dies or following a divorce; traditionally used for a man taking a second wife. In classical/archaic contexts it can also mean replacing a string (e.g., on an instrument), though that usage is rare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爸喺太太過身之後續弦，屋企氣氛有啲尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baa4 hai6 taai3 taai2 gwo3 san1 zi1 hau6 zuk6 jin4, uk1 kei2 hei3 fan1 jau5 di1 gam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸在太太去世之後續弦，家裡的氣氛有點尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: His father took a second wife after his mother passed away, and the atmosphere at home was a bit awkward.

mandarin_meaning: 续期；延长合同、保单或服务的有效期限
english_meaning: to renew; renewal/extension of the term of a contract, subscription, insurance, etc.
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also be used as a noun: renewal/extension)
explanation_mandarin: 表示延长某个合约、保单或服务的有效期限，也可指续签合同的动作或结果。
explanation_english: To extend or renew the validity period of a contract, insurance, subscription, or service; can refer to the action of renewing or the renewal itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想續期電話合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zuk6 kei4 din6 waa2 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想续签手机合约。
examples.english_sentence: I want to renew my phone contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保險到期喇，要續期定唔續呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 him2 dou3 kei4 laa3, jiu3 zuk6 kei4 ding6 m4 zuk6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保险到期了，要续期还是不续？
examples.english_sentence: The insurance is due. Do you want to renew it or not?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經決定續期租約兩年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 kyut3 ding6 zuk6 kei4 zou1 joek3 loeng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已经决定将租约续期两年。
examples.english_sentence: The company has decided to renew the lease for another two years.

mandarin_meaning: 续租 (xùzū)
english_meaning: to renew a lease; to extend a rental agreement
explanation_mandarin: 指在租約到期後，與房東或業主續簽租約，繼續租用房屋、舖位或其他物業。
explanation_english: To extend or renew a rental agreement after it expires, continuing to rent a property (e.g., an apartment or shop).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想同房東續租多一年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 tung4 fong4 dung1 zuk6 zou1 do1 jat1 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想和房东续租一年。
examples.english_sentence: I want to renew my lease with the landlord for another year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舖頭到期，可以續租嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: pou3 tau2 dou3 kei4, ho2 ji5 zuk6 zou1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 店铺到期了，可以续租吗？
examples.english_sentence: The shop lease has expired — can it be renewed?

mandarin_meaning: 續篇；續集，作品或故事的後續篇章
english_meaning: sequel; continuation; follow-up chapter
explanation_mandarin: 表示作品或故事的續篇、後續篇章，常用於電影、電視劇、小說等媒體中。
explanation_english: Refers to a sequel or continuation of a work or story, commonly used for films, TV series, novels, and other media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇會唔會拍續篇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 wui5 m4 wui5 paak3 zuk6 pin1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這套劇會不會拍續集？
examples.english_sentence: Will this series have a sequel?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影完咗之後，導演話可能會出續篇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 jyun4 zo2 zi1 hau6, dou6 jin2 waa6 ho2 nang4 wui5 ceot1 zuk6 pin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電影結束後，導演說可能會出續集。
examples.english_sentence: After the movie ended, the director said they might release a sequel.

mandarin_meaning: 续约 (xùyuē)：重新签订或延长合约
english_meaning: to renew a contract; to extend or re-sign an agreement
explanation_mandarin: 指對原有的合約、租約、電話合約或工作合約等進行延長或重新簽訂，使合約繼續有效。
explanation_english: Refers to extending or re-signing an existing contract—commonly used for leases, employment contracts, phone plans, etc.—so the agreement continues to be in effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司同佢續約咗兩年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 tung4 keoi5 zuk6 joek3 zo2 loeng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司和他续约了两年。
examples.english_sentence: Our company renewed the contract with him for two years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個租約到期，佢打算續約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zou1 joek3 dou3 kei4, keoi5 daa2 syun3 zuk6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的租约到期，他打算续约。
examples.english_sentence: His lease has expired; he plans to renew it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想續約個手機合約，爭取新機優惠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zuk6 joek3 go3 sau2 gei1 hap6 joek3, zing1 ceoi2 san1 gei1 jau1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想续约手机合约，争取新机优惠。
examples.english_sentence: I want to renew my mobile phone contract to get the new phone discount.

mandarin_meaning: 续集
english_meaning: sequel; continuation
explanation_mandarin: 指在原有作品（如電影、電視劇、小說等）之後推出，延續或繼承原故事、人物或世界觀的作品。
explanation_english: Refers to a work released after an original (e.g., film, TV series, book) that continues or extends the original story, characters, or world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影會唔會出續集？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 wui5 m4 wui5 ceot1 zuk6 zaap6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影会不会出续集？
examples.english_sentence: Will this movie have a sequel?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 續集比第一集更長、更好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk6 zaap6 bei2 dai6 jat1 zaap6 gang3 coeng4, gang3 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 续集比第一集更长、更好看。
examples.english_sentence: The sequel is longer and better than the first installment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然有續集，但內容同角色已經唔同咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 jau5 zuk6 zaap6, daan6 noi6 jung4 tung4 gok3 sik1 ji5 ging1 m4 tung4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然有续集，但内容和角色已经不一样了。
examples.english_sentence: Although there is a sequel, the content and characters are already different.

mandarin_meaning: （與「累」通用）表示成堆、累累、眾多；亦可指使人疲累，主為書面或古文用法
english_meaning: A variant of '累' meaning piled up, numerous, or causing weariness; literary usage, often seen in the reduplicated form '纍纍' meaning abundant or numerous.
explanation_mandarin: 「纍」為古字或書面字，常見於重疊詞「纍纍」，用以形容事物繁多、堆積如山；亦可和「累」通用，表示使人疲累的意思。
explanation_english: A classical/literary character variant of 累. Commonly used in the reduplicated form '纍纍' to describe something numerous or piled up. It can also be associated with causing tiredness; primarily appears in written or idiomatic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅功績纍纍，值得表揚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 zik1 leoi4 leoi4, zik1 dak1 biu2 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功績累累，值得表揚。
examples.english_sentence: His accomplishments are numerous and deserve recognition.

mandarin_meaning: 缠 (chán)：缠绕、纠缠；也可指纠缠、困扰、缠住不放
english_meaning: to entangle, to wind around; (figurative) to pester, to plague, to bother
explanation_mandarin: 表示物體相互纏繞或人持續騷擾、糾纏不放；既可作為字面上的纏繞，也可作比喻用法（困擾、糾纏）。
explanation_english: Indicates literal winding or entangling of objects, or figuratively to pester, plague, or trouble someone; can be used both literally and metaphorically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日纏住我問啲私人嘢，我真係唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 cin4 zyu6 ngo5 man6 di1 si1 jan4 je5, ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常纏著我問一些私人的事，我真的不高興。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps pestering me with personal questions; I'm really not happy about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條繩被樹根纏住，好難解開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 sing4 bei6 syu6 gan1 cin4 zyu6, hou2 naan4 gaai2 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 繩子被樹根纏住，很難解開。
examples.english_sentence: The rope is tangled around the tree root and hard to untangle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊病一直纏住佢，影響到佢做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 beng6 jat1 zik6 cin4 zyu6 keoi5, jing2 hoeng2 dou3 keoi5 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 舊病一直困擾著他，影響到他的工作。
examples.english_sentence: A chronic ailment keeps bothering him and affects his work.

mandarin_meaning: 缠住；缠绕；纠缠（某人）
english_meaning: to wrap around; to entangle; to pester or cling to someone
explanation_mandarin: 可以指物理上把某物缠绕住，也可以比喻不断纠缠、缠着某人、打扰（多用於口語）。
explanation_english: Can mean physically to wind or wrap something around, or figuratively to pester/entangle someone — commonly used in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日纏住我，我好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 cin4 zyu6 ngo5, ngo5 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她成天缠着我，我很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He/she keeps pestering me; I'm really annoyed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 布條纏住柱，唔好拉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 tiu4 cin4 zyu6 zyu2, m4 hou2 laai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 布条缠住柱子，不要拉。
examples.english_sentence: The cloth is wrapped around the pole — don't pull it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿John對女朋友好纏住，經常打電話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 John deoi3 neoi5 pang4 jau5 hou2 cin4 zyu6, ging1 soeng4 daa2 din6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: John對女朋友很黏人，經常打電話。
examples.english_sentence: John is very clingy with his girlfriend; he calls her all the time.

mandarin_meaning: 缠绵（缠绵：感情深长而绵延，或缠绕不去）
english_meaning: lingering; tender and prolonged (often describing feelings, music, or pain); to entangle
explanation_mandarin: 常用來形容感情、情緒或旋律等持續而纏綿不絕，帶有依戀、深情或牽連的意味；作動詞時可指纏繞、糾纏。
explanation_english: Used to describe feelings, moods, or melodies that are prolonged and emotionally lingering—often tender or wistful; as a verb it can mean to entwine or be entangled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 首歌旋律好纏綿，聽到我忍唔住流淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau2 go1 syun4 leot6 hou2 cin4 min4, teng1 dou3 ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 lau4 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌旋律很缠绵，听到我忍不住流泪。
examples.english_sentence: The song's melody is very lingering; I couldn't help crying when I heard it.

mandarin_meaning: 缠绕
english_meaning: to entangle; to wind/coil around; to haunt or obsess (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 表示物体缠绕、盘旋，或指思绪、情感反复困扰。常用作动词。
explanation_english: Refers to physically winding or coiling around something, or figuratively to thoughts or feelings that persistently trouble or haunt someone. Used as a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細線纏繞住樹幹，好難拆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 sin3 cin4 jiu5 zyu6 syu6 gon3, hou2 naan4 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 细线缠绕在树干上，很难拆开。
examples.english_sentence: The thin thread is wound around the tree trunk and is hard to remove.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事一直喺佢腦海入面纏繞，令佢好困擾。
