examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jat1 zik6 hai2 keoi5 nou5 hoi2 jap6 min6 cin4 jiu5, ling6 keoi5 hou2 kwan3 jiu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事一直缠绕在他脑海里，让他很困扰。
examples.english_sentence: This matter keeps lingering in his mind and makes him very troubled.

mandarin_meaning: 缠脚带（用来缠绕脚的带子，历史上用于缠足/裹小脚）
english_meaning: foot-binding band; foot wrap — a band or ribbon used to wrap or bind the foot (historically used for foot‑binding)
explanation_mandarin: 指用來纏繞腳的帶子，歷史上常指用於裹小腳（缠足）的布帶；在現代也可指腳部的繃帶或護具。
explanation_english: A band or ribbon used to wrap or bind the foot. Historically it refers to the cloth used for foot‑binding; in modern contexts it can also mean a foot wrap, bandage, or strap used for support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲婦女會用纏腳帶裹細腳，呢個風俗已經消失咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 fu5 neoi5 wui5 jung6 cin4 goek3 daai3 gwo2 sai3 goek3, ni1 go3 fung1 zuk6 ji5 ging1 siu1 sat1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前妇女会用缠脚带缠小脚，这个风俗已经消失了。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, women used foot‑binding bands to bind their feet; this custom has already disappeared.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺博物館見到舊時嘅纏腳帶，好驚訝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bok3 mat6 gun2 gin3 dou2 gau6 si4 ge3 cin4 goek3 daai3, hou2 ging1 ngaa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在博物馆看到旧时的缠脚带，感到很惊讶。
examples.english_sentence: He saw old foot‑binding bands at the museum and was very surprised.

mandarin_meaning: 缠身（被……缠绕/困扰）
english_meaning: to be beset by; to be plagued by; to be entangled with
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人被問題、煩惱、責任或外在事物糾纏或困擾，難以擺脫。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is troubled or entangled by problems, worries, obligations, or other matters and finds it hard to get free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排工作同家庭嘅煩惱纏身，真係好難放鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 gung1 zok3 tung4 gaa1 ting4 ge3 faan4 nou5 cin4 san1, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 fong3 sung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近工作和家庭的烦恼缠身，真的很难放松。
examples.english_sentence: Lately I've been beset by work and family worries; it's really hard to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀債務同法律問題纏身，好耐都走唔出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zaai3 mou6 tung4 faat3 leot6 man6 tai4 cin4 san1, hou2 noi6 dou1 zau2 m4 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被债务和法律问题缠身，很久都走不出来。
examples.english_sentence: He is plagued by debts and legal problems and hasn't been able to move on for a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 纏、纏繞；纏著、糾纏（動作或狀態）
english_meaning: to wind/entangle/wrap around; to pester or cling to someone; to be entangled
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某物繞在別的物件上或持續粘著、糾纏不放；也可指精神上糾纏或纏擾他人。
explanation_english: Indicates wrapping or winding something around another object, or clinging/pestering continuously; can also mean being mentally preoccupied or embroiled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條長髮成日都纒住耳仔，好唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 coeng4 faat3 sing4 jat6 dou1 cin4 zyu6 ji5 zai2, hou2 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的長髮總是纏住耳朵，很不方便。
examples.english_sentence: His long hair keeps tangling around his ears; it's very inconvenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個小朋友成日纒住我，想我陪佢玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 sing4 jat6 cin4 zyu6 ngo5, soeng2 ngo5 pui4 keoi5 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個小朋友老是纏著我，想我陪他玩。
examples.english_sentence: That child keeps pestering me, wanting me to play with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 繩被風吹到纒喺樹枝上，拆唔開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 bei6 fung1 ceoi1 dou3 cin4 hai2 syu6 zi1 soeng5, caak3 m4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 繩子被風吹得纏在樹枝上，拆不開。
examples.english_sentence: The rope was blown and got tangled around the branch; it won't come apart.

mandarin_meaning: 缨 (yīng)：帽、盔上的穗饰、流苏（古代常作装饰或身份象征）
english_meaning: tassel; plume — a decorative tassel or cord (often on hats or helmets), sometimes a symbol of rank
explanation_mandarin: 指帽子或盔甲上的穗狀裝飾或流蘇，古代常見於帽頂或盔甲上，亦可作為身份或地位的象徵。
explanation_english: Refers to a tassel or plume used as an ornament on hats or helmets. Common in historical dress and often served as a decorative element or symbol of rank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰頂古帽有一條紅色纓，睇落好古典。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 ding2 gu2 mou6 jau5 jat1 tiu4 hung4 sik1 jeng1, tai2 lok6 hou2 gu2 din2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那頂古帽有一條紅色的缨，看起來很古典。
examples.english_sentence: The ancient hat has a red tassel; it looks very traditional.

mandarin_meaning: 盛大的紅色慶宴（多指婚宴或喜慶宴席）
english_meaning: a grand red-themed celebratory banquet (typically a wedding or festive feast)
explanation_mandarin: 「纓紅宴」為較文雅或書面用語，合成詞可理解為以紅色為主題的盛大慶宴，常用來指婚宴或其他喜慶場合的宴席。此詞在口語中並不常見，偏文學或古風描述。
explanation_english: “纓紅宴” is a literary/archaic-sounding term that denotes a grand celebratory banquet emphasizing red decorations — typically a wedding banquet or other festive feast. It is uncommon in everyday speech and is used in more literary or traditional contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋舉行咗一場盛大嘅纓紅宴，親戚朋友都嚟祝賀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 geoi2 hang4 zo2 jat1 coeng4 sing4 daai6 ge3 jeng1 hung4 jin3, can1 cik1 pang4 jau5 dou1 lai4 zuk1 ho6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們舉行了一場盛大的紅色慶宴（纓紅宴），親戚朋友都來祝賀。
examples.english_sentence: They held a grand red-themed celebratory banquet (a ying-hong banquet); relatives and friends all came to offer congratulations.

mandarin_meaning: （文言/書面）才、剛剛
english_meaning: a literary/written variant of '才', meaning 'just' or 'only (a short time ago)'
explanation_mandarin: 「纔」是「才」的文言或書面用字，常用來表示剛剛發生或只有在某個時間點才發生，主要作副詞使用，常見於正式或古文書面語。
explanation_english: “纔” is a literary/written variant of “才”, used to indicate that something happened just now or only at a particular time. It functions mainly as an adverb and appears in formal or classical written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我纔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 coi4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛到。
examples.english_sentence: I just arrived.

mandarin_meaning: 纖細、微小；也用於構成名詞「纖維」
english_meaning: slender; thin; fine; delicate; (in compounds) fiber
explanation_mandarin: 表示細小、纖薄或嬌細，常見於複合詞如「纖細」「纖維」，在不同語境可作形容詞或名詞的一部分。
explanation_english: Indicates thinness, fineness, or delicacy. Commonly appears in compounds such as '纖細' (slender) and '纖維' (fiber). Depending on context it functions as part of an adjective or noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有好纖細嘅手指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hou2 cim1 sai3 ge3 sau2 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她有很纖細的手指。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has very slender fingers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫用咗高品質嘅纖維。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jung6 zo2 gou1 ban2 zat1 ge3 cim1 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服用了高品質的纖維。
examples.english_sentence: This garment is made with high-quality fibers.

mandarin_meaning: 纤巧；小巧、纤细、灵巧
english_meaning: slender; delicate; dainty; graceful; (also: nimble/skillful)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容身材、物件或設計小巧、纖細或帶有靈巧、雅致的特質。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that is small, delicate, or dainty in form; can also imply nimbleness or refined craftsmanship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有一副纖巧嘅身材，穿旗袍好適合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 jat1 fu6 cim1 haau2 ge3 san1 coi4, cyun1 kei4 paau4 hou2 sik1 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她有一副纤巧的身材，穿旗袍很合适。
examples.english_sentence: She has a slender, delicate figure; wearing a qipao suits her well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻手錶設計得好纖巧，好適合送俾女朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 sau2 biu1 cit3 gai3 dak1 hou2 cim1 haau2, hou2 sik1 hap6 sung3 bei2 neoi5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只手表设计得很纤巧，很适合送给女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: This watch is designed to be very delicate and compact — perfect as a gift for a girlfriend.

mandarin_meaning: 纤细 (xiān xì)
english_meaning: slender; fine; delicate; thin; subtle
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容外觀、質地或差異等細小、纖薄或精緻，例如手指、線條、布料等非常細緻或輕薄。
explanation_english: Describes something that is thin, fine, delicate, or subtle in appearance, texture, or detail — e.g., fingers, lines, fabric, or subtle differences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅手指好纖細，好似鋼琴家咁靈巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sau2 zi2 hou2 cim1 sai3, hou2 ci5 gong3 kam4 gaa1 gam2 ling4 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的手指很纖細，好像鋼琴家一樣靈巧。
examples.english_sentence: Her fingers are very slender and delicate, like those of a pianist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫質地纖細，好似真絲咁滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 zat1 dei6 cim1 sai3, hou2 ci5 zan1 si1 gam2 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服質地纖細，好像真絲一樣滑順。
examples.english_sentence: This garment has a fine texture, smooth like silk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畫家用嘅筆觸好纖細，畫面睇落更加精緻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa6 gaa1 jung6 ge3 bat1 zuk1 hou2 cim1 sai3, waa6 min6 tai2 lok6 gang1 gaa1 zing1 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 畫家使用的筆觸很纖細，畫面看起來更精緻。
examples.english_sentence: The artist's brushstrokes are very delicate, making the painting look more refined.

mandarin_meaning: 纤维 (xiān wéi)：构成物质的细长单位；也指膳食纤维或纺织用的纤维。
english_meaning: fiber / fibre: slender thread-like units that make up materials; also refers to dietary fiber or textile fibers.
explanation_mandarin: 指構成某些物質的細長單位，既可指植物、動物或合成材料的纖維，也常用於指膳食纖維或紡織纖維。
explanation_english: Refers to slender, thread-like units that compose materials. Can mean natural, animal, or synthetic fibers, and is also used for dietary fiber and textile fibers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫係用天然纖維做嘅，著落好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hai6 jung6 tin1 jin4 cim1 wai4 zou6 ge3, zoek3 lok6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服是用天然纤维做的，穿起来很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This garment is made from natural fibers and is very comfortable to wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要多啲食含有膳食纖維嘅食物，對腸胃有好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 do1 di1 sik6 ham4 jau5 sin6 sik6 cim1 wai4 ge3 sik6 mat6, deoi3 coeng4 wai6 jau5 hou2 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说要多吃含有膳食纤维的食物，对肠胃有好处。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor says to eat more foods containing dietary fiber; it's good for the digestive system.

mandarin_meaning: 纤维瘤（xiān wéi liú）
english_meaning: fibroma (a benign tumor of fibrous/connective tissue)
explanation_mandarin: 一种起源于结缔组织（纤维组织）的良性肿瘤，通常由纤维结缔组织增生形成，可能需要观察或手术切除，视大小与症状而定。
explanation_english: A benign tumor originating from fibrous (connective) tissue, typically formed by proliferation of fibrous connective tissue. Treatment ranges from monitoring to surgical removal depending on size and symptoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢係纖維瘤，要開刀切除。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 him1 wai4 lau4, jiu3 hoi1 dou1 cit3 ceoi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他的是纤维瘤，要开刀切除。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said it's a fibroma and it needs to be surgically removed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大多數纖維瘤都係良性，但有時會增大，要定期檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 do1 sou3 him1 wai4 lau4 dou1 hai6 loeng4 sing3, daan6 jau5 si4 wui5 zang1 daai6, jiu3 ding6 kei4 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大多数纤维瘤都是良性的，但有时会增大，需要定期检查。
examples.english_sentence: Most fibromas are benign, but they can sometimes grow and require regular check-ups.

mandarin_meaning: 纖細的腰；纖腰，常用以形容女子苗條的腰身
english_meaning: slender waist; a slim, graceful waist (often used for women)
explanation_mandarin: 指纖細、苗條的腰部，常用來形容女子優美的腰身，多見於書面或詩詞語境。
explanation_english: Refers to a slender, slim waist; typically used to describe a woman's graceful waistline and often found in literary or poetic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有一條纖腰，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 jat1 tiu4 cim1 jiu1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她有一條纖細的腰，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She has a slender waist; it's very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 詩裡常用「纖腰」嚟形容女子婀娜多姿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 leoi5 soeng4 jung6 「cim1 jiu1」lai4 jing4 jung4 neoi5 zi2 o1 no4 do1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 詩裡常用「纤腰」來形容女子婀娜多姿。
examples.english_sentence: In poetry, '纖腰' is often used to describe a woman's graceful figure.

mandarin_meaning: 纤体（使身体变苗条；瘦身或相关疗程）
english_meaning: slimming; slimming the body; body-contouring (can refer to slimming treatments or achieving a slim figure)
explanation_mandarin: 指使身体变得更苗条、修长，或指为达到此目的而进行的减肥、美容或塑身疗程。
explanation_english: Refers to making the body slimmer or to slimming/body-contouring treatments aimed at achieving a more slender figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日去做纖體療程，想瘦返啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 zou6 him1 tai2 liu4 cing4, soeng2 sau3 faan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她最近常去做纤体疗程，想瘦一些。
examples.english_sentence: She's been going to slimming treatments a lot lately; she wants to slim down a bit.

mandarin_meaning: 缆（纜）：缆绳、缆索；电缆
english_meaning: cable; hawser; rope; (electric) cable
explanation_mandarin: 「纜」指粗大的繩索或鋼索，可用作拖曳、固定或傳輸電力（如電纜）。常見於複合詞如「纜車」「電纜」。
explanation_english: “纜” refers to a thick rope, hawser, or cable, used for towing, securing, or transmitting power (as in electric cables). Commonly appears in compounds like “cable car” or “power cable.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋用咗一條好粗嘅纜嚟拖嗰艘船。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jung6 zo2 jat1 tiu4 hou2 cou1 ge3 laam5 lai4 to1 go2 sou2 syun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们用了一条很粗的缆绳来拖那艘船。
examples.english_sentence: They used a very thick cable to tow that boat.

mandarin_meaning: 缆车
english_meaning: cable car; aerial tram; mountain funicular
explanation_mandarin: 沿著纜索運行、用來載人或物的交通工具，可指空中纜車（吊掛式）或山地索道/登山纜車（有時為齒軌或滑輪系統）。
explanation_english: A transport vehicle that runs on or is suspended from cables to carry people or goods. Can refer to aerial cable cars (gondolas/trams) or mountain funicular-type cable systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋坐纜車上山睇日落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 co5 laam6 ce1 soeng5 saan1 tai2 jat6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐缆车上山看日落。
examples.english_sentence: We took the cable car up the mountain to watch the sunset.

mandarin_meaning: 麻花針織圍巾（麻花紋圍巾）
english_meaning: cable-knit scarf (a scarf with a rope/cable knit pattern)
explanation_mandarin: 口語或縮略用法，通常指以麻花（纜狀）花紋針織的圍巾，強調紋路像繩索的編織效果。
explanation_english: A colloquial/abbreviated term referring to a scarf knitted with a cable (rope-like) pattern; emphasizes the twisted/cabled knit texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗條新嘅纜頸巾，好暖好型。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 tiu4 san1 ge3 laam6 geng2 gan1, hou2 nyun5 hou2 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他戴了一條新的麻花針織圍巾，很暖和也很有型。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is wearing a new cable-knit scarf; it's warm and stylish.

mandarin_meaning: 约 (yuē)；约定、邀请、预约；（在“大约”中表示）大概
english_meaning: to arrange/agree to meet; to invite; to schedule; (in compounds like '大约') approximately
explanation_mandarin: 作动词时表示约定、邀请或预约某个时间或活动；在如“大约”之类的词中表示数量或时间的近似。
explanation_english: As a verb, it means to arrange, agree on, or invite someone to meet or to schedule something. In compounds like '大约' it indicates an approximate amount or time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋約咗喺下晝見面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 joek3 zo2 hai6 haa6 zau3 gin3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们约好了在下午见面。
examples.english_sentence: We agreed to meet in the afternoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想唔想約佢出去食飯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 joek3 keoi5 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 faan6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想不想约他出去吃饭？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to ask him out to eat?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事大約要一個月先完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 daai6 joek3 jiu3 jat1 go3 jyut6 sin1 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事大约需要一个月才能完成。
examples.english_sentence: This will take about a month to complete.

mandarin_meaning: 级 / 級（等級、級別、階級）
english_meaning: level; grade; rank; class
explanation_mandarin: 表示等級、級別或階層，常用於構詞（如：初級、高級、等級）。繁體字為「級」。
explanation_english: Denotes a level, grade, rank, or class. Commonly used in compounds (e.g., beginner, advanced, level). Traditional form is "級".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅中文等級係三級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zung1 man4 dang2 kap1 hai6 saam1 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的中文等級是三級。
examples.english_sentence: His Chinese level is level three.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班係初級班，適合初學者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 hai6 co1 kap1 baan1, sik1 hap6 co1 hok6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這班是初級班，適合初學者。
examples.english_sentence: This class is a beginner class, suitable for beginners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面係高級經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 hai6 gou1 kap1 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡是高級經理。
examples.english_sentence: He is a senior manager in the company.

mandarin_meaning: 纷（紛）：表示杂乱、纷乱或接连不断，常见于“纷纷”“纷扰”等词。
english_meaning: Indicates disorder, confusion, or things occurring in succession; often used in compounds like '纷纷' (one after another).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词 / 副词（常用于复合词）
explanation_mandarin: “纷”常用来描述事物杂乱、纷乱或接连不断的状态，通常和自身或其他字组成词语，如“纷纷、纷扰、纷乱”。
explanation_english: The character denotes disorder, scattering, or successive actions/events. It commonly appears in compounds (e.g. '纷纷' meaning 'one after another').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上行人纷纷戴起口罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng5 hang4 jan4 fan1 fan1 daai3 hei2 hau2 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 街上行人纷纷戴起口罩。
examples.english_sentence: Pedestrians on the street began putting on masks one after another.

mandarin_meaning: 線（线）：線、繩、電線、線條；也可引申為線索、路線等
english_meaning: line; thread; wire; string; clue; route
explanation_mandarin: 「线」在粵語讀作 sin3，主要作名詞使用，可以指物理的線或繩（如電線、縫紉用的線）、線條，也可引申為線索、路線或抽象的聯繫。
explanation_english: The character "线" (sin3) in Cantonese is primarily a noun meaning a physical line or thread (e.g. wire, sewing thread), a line/stripe, and can also extend to meanings like clue or route.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企隔離條電線斷咗，要搵人嚟維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 gaak3 lei4 tiu4 din6 sin3 dyun6 zo2, jiu3 wan2 jan4 lai4 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家旁邊的電線斷了，要叫人來維修。
examples.english_sentence: The power line next to the house is broken; we need to get someone to repair it.

mandarin_meaning: 小；细（尺寸小、程度小或细致）
english_meaning: small; fine; detailed
explanation_mandarin: 表示尺寸、數量或程度較小，或表示事物細微、詳盡。
explanation_english: Indicates small size, amount, or degree; can also mean fine or detailed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫太細，我著唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 taai3 sai3, ngo5 zoek3 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服太小，我穿不上。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is too small; I can't wear it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候唔鍾意食菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小的時候不喜歡吃蔬菜。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I didn't like eating vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要睇清佢嘅細節先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 tai2 cing1 keoi5 ge3 sai3 zit3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要看清楚他的細節才行。
examples.english_sentence: You need to check his details carefully first.

mandarin_meaning: 终（终止、最终、终于）
english_meaning: end; to end; finally; in the end
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 动词 / 副词（视用法而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「终」表示結束或最终的意思。作名词时可指「终点、结局」，作动词时可表示「结束、终止」，在词组如「终於/终于」中可作副词表示「终于、最终」。
explanation_english: The character indicates an end or finality. As a noun it can mean 'the end' or 'conclusion'; as a verb it can mean 'to end' or 'to terminate'; in compounds such as '終於/终于' it functions adverbially to mean 'finally' or 'in the end'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我終於完成咗份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 jyun4 sing4 zo2 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我终于完成了那份报告。
examples.english_sentence: I finally finished that report.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定終止呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 zung1 zi2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定终止这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to terminate this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢簽咗個終身合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cim1 zo2 go3 zung1 san1 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他签了份终身合约。
examples.english_sentence: He signed a lifetime contract.

mandarin_meaning: 经过、经常、经书（多义字，读作 jīng）
english_meaning: to pass through; often; scripture/classic (multiple senses)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 名词 / 副词
explanation_mandarin: “经”为多义字，可表示经过、经历（如“经过”）、表示频率（如“经常”），也可以指经书、经典等文化/宗教文献。
explanation_english: “经” is a polysemous character: it can mean to pass through or undergo (e.g. '经过'), indicate frequency (e.g. '经常'), or refer to scriptures/classics (e.g. '经书').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇經過樓下嗰間咖啡店？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 ging1 gwo3 lau4 haa6 go2 gaan1 gaa3 fe1 dim3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有经过楼下那间咖啡店？
examples.english_sentence: Did you pass by the coffee shop downstairs?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我經常遲到，應該要改變習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ging1 soeng4 ci4 dou3, jing1 goi1 jiu3 goi2 bin3 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我经常迟到，应该要改变习惯。
examples.english_sentence: I often arrive late; I should change my habits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本經書保存得好好，係一件珍貴嘅文化遺產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 ging1 syu1 bou2 cyun4 dak1 hou2 hou2, hai6 jat1 gin6 zan1 gwai3 ge3 man4 faa3 wai4 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本经书保存得很好，是一件珍贵的文化遗产。
examples.english_sentence: This scripture is well preserved; it's a valuable cultural heritage.

mandarin_meaning: 结（系、绑、结束、形成、结婚等）
english_meaning: to tie/knot; to conclude or finish; to form; (in compounds) to marry; also appears in nouns like guitar (結他)
explanation_mandarin: 「结」在粤语中讀作 git3，主要作動詞使用，表示系、綁、結成、結束或在合成詞中表示結婚等意義。常見於結婚、完結、結他等詞語。
explanation_english: '结' (Jyutping: git3) is a Cantonese verb meaning to tie or knot, to conclude/finish, to form, and (in compounds) to marry. It appears in words like 結婚 (get married), 完結 (end), 結他 (guitar).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幫我結好條鞋帶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 git3 hou2 tiu4 haai4 daai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幫我把鞋帶綁好。
examples.english_sentence: Help me tie my shoelaces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 git3 fun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們下個月結婚。
examples.english_sentence: We're getting married next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇終於完結喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 zung1 jyu1 jyun4 git3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部劇終於完結了。
examples.english_sentence: This series has finally ended.

mandarin_meaning: 给 (gěi) — 给予；让、给与（也可作介词）
english_meaning: to give; to grant; (coverb) to let/allow; for
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 介词（视语境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「给/給」在粤语中可作动词表示“给、给予”，也可作介词/介词性动词表示“让、使（某人做某事）”。书面或正式场合常用「给/給」，口语中常用对应的粤语字「俾」（jyutping: bei2）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 给/給 can be used as a verb meaning 'to give' or as a coverb/preposition meaning 'to let/allow' or 'for'. It appears in more formal/written contexts; in colloquial speech Cantonese speakers more often use the character 俾 (bei2).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢給咗我一本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kap1 zo2 ngo5 jat1 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给了我一本书。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a book.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請給我一個機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 kap1 ngo5 jat1 go3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请给我一个机会。
examples.english_sentence: Please give me a chance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好給佢嚇親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kap1 keoi5 haak3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要让他被吓到。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let him get scared.

mandarin_meaning: 络（繁體：絡/絡（常寫為「絡」或「絡」字的繁簡差異））在漢語中常作構詞成分，表示網、連結、牽扯等意思，如「網絡」、「經絡」。普通話讀音常為 luò。
english_meaning: The character '络' (traditional 絡) is a bound morpheme meaning 'net, network, to entangle, web, connection', commonly found in compounds like '網絡' (network) and '經絡' (meridians).
explanation_mandarin: 「络」常用作構詞字，表示網狀、連結或牽扯的概念，通常不單獨使用，而出現在複合詞中，例如「網絡」（網路）和「經絡」（中醫所指的經絡）。
explanation_english: The character '络' is typically used as part of compounds to denote a net-like structure, connections or entanglement. It rarely appears alone and is found in words such as '網絡' (network) and '經絡' (meridians in TCM).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企嘅網絡又慢又唔穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 ge3 mong5 lok3 jau6 maan6 jau6 m4 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家的網絡又慢又不穩定。
examples.english_sentence: My home network is slow and unstable again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫話我嘅經絡堵塞，要去按一按。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 waa6 ngo5 ge3 ging1 lok3 duk6 sak1, jiu3 heoi3 on3 jat1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中醫說我的經絡堵塞，需要去按一按。
examples.english_sentence: The TCM practitioner said my meridians are blocked; I should get a massage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋喺網絡上見過面未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 hai2 mong5 lok3 soeng6 gin3 gwo3 min6 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你們在網絡上見過面嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Have you met online?

mandarin_meaning: 断绝、极、非常、绝对；也可表示惊叹（粤语口语）
english_meaning: to sever/discontinue; extreme/absolute; very; (Cantonese slang) amazing/awesome
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 形容詞 / 副詞 / 感嘆詞（視語境而定）
partOfSpeech_english: verb / adjective / adverb / interjection (depends on context)
explanation_mandarin: 「绝」常用於表示切斷或終止（如絕交、絕種），也可表示極端、絕對（如絕對），在粤語口語中常作感嘆用字表示很棒或厲害（如「絕了」）。
explanation_english: “绝” can mean to sever or discontinue (e.g. 絕交, 絕種), indicate extreme/absolute (e.g. 絕對), or as Cantonese slang act as an exclamation meaning amazing/awesome (e.g. 絕了). Part of speech depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個唱歌真係絕了！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 coeng3 go1 zan1 hai6 zyut6 liu5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌真的太棒了！
examples.english_sentence: His singing is really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為嗰件事而絕交咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 go2 gin6 si6 ji4 zyut6 gaau1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们因为那件事绝交了。
examples.english_sentence: They broke off their friendship because of that matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰種動物快要絕種。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zung2 dung6 mat6 faai3 jiu3 zyut6 zung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那种动物快要绝种了。
examples.english_sentence: That species is about to become extinct.

mandarin_meaning: 继 (jì)：继续；继承；接着
english_meaning: to continue; to succeed; to inherit; to follow on
explanation_mandarin: 表示延续、接续或承接的动作或状态，常见于复合词如“继承”“继续”“继而”。
explanation_english: Indicates continuation, succession, or inheritance. Commonly appears in compounds such as '继承' (inherit), '继续' (continue), and '继而' (thereupon).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋繼續落去做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 zuk6 lok6 heoi3 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们继续下去做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's continue doing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢會繼承阿爸嘅公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wui5 gai3 sing4 aa3 baa4 ge3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会继承爸爸的公司。
examples.english_sentence: He will inherit his father's company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢先冷靜，繼而作出決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sin1 laang5 zing6, gai3 ji4 zok3 ceot1 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他先冷静，继而作出决定。
examples.english_sentence: He calmed down first and then made a decision.

mandarin_meaning: 续 (xù) — 继续；延续；续订（如续约、续集）
english_meaning: to continue; to renew; to extend; (n.) sequel
explanation_mandarin: 表示繼續或延續某事，或重新訂立/延長（如續約、續集、續寫等）。
explanation_english: Indicates continuation or renewal of something, or extending/adding on (e.g. renew a contract, a sequel, continue writing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套電影好受歡迎，可能會有續集。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 din6 jing2 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 zuk6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部电影很受欢迎，可能会有续集。
examples.english_sentence: That movie is very popular; there may be a sequel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要續約上網服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 zuk6 joek3 soeng5 mong5 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要续约上网服务。
examples.english_sentence: I need to renew my internet service subscription.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師叫我續寫呢篇作文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 giu3 ngo5 zuk6 se2 ni1 pin1 zok3 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师让我续写这篇作文。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher asked me to continue writing this essay.

mandarin_meaning: 绮（綺）：华丽，绮丽；亦指有花纹的丝织品或锦缎（绮为绮丽、华美之意）
english_meaning: Ornate; gorgeous; brocade — suggests something richly patterned or beautiful (can also refer to brocade fabric)
explanation_mandarin: “绮”常用来形容华美、绮丽的外观或纹饰，也可指一种有花纹的丝织品／锦缎。常见用法如“绮丽”。
explanation_english: Used to describe something ornate or gorgeous, often richly patterned; can also denote brocade or patterned silk. Commonly appears in compounds like “绮丽.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰件綺麗嘅裙好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gin6 kei2 lai6 ge3 kwan4 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件绮丽的裙子很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: That ornate dress is very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 缸；大罐子，用來盛水、醃製或發酵等
english_meaning: jar; large earthenware or metal container used for holding water, pickles, fermenting, etc.
explanation_mandarin: 指容量較大的罐子，常見材料有陶、瓷或金屬，用於盛水、醃製食物或發酵（例如釀酒、醃菜）等家用或農業用途。
explanation_english: Refers to a relatively large jar or vat, commonly made of pottery, ceramic, or metal, used domestically or agriculturally for holding water, pickling, fermenting (e.g., brewing wine, pickling vegetables), etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個缸係我阿婆用嚟醃酸菜嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gong1 hai6 ngo5 aa3 po4 jung6 lai4 jim1 syun1 coi3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个缸是我的外婆用来腌酸菜的。
examples.english_sentence: This jar is what my grandmother uses to pickle vegetables.

mandarin_meaning: 陶器或瓦片（常指陶片或瓦片，亦可指碎裂的陶瓷片）
english_meaning: pottery or tiles (often refers to pottery shards or tile fragments)
explanation_mandarin: 由「缸」（陶缸、陶器）和「瓦」（瓦片）組成，通常指陶器、瓦片或其碎片。在口語或建築、拆遷場景中可能用來描述地上散落的陶瓦碎片。
explanation_english: A compound of 缸 (jar/pottery) and 瓦 (tile); commonly refers to pottery, tiles, or ceramic fragments — often used to describe shards or pieces of ceramic/tile, especially in demolition or construction contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工人拆屋時，地下散落住好多缸瓦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jan4 caak3 uk1 si4, dei6 haa6 saan3 lok6 zyu6 hou2 do1 gong1 ngaa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人拆房子時，地上散落著很多缸瓦（陶片／瓦片）。
examples.english_sentence: When the workers were demolishing the house, many pieces of pottery and tiles were scattered on the ground.

jyutping: gong1 ngaa5 syun4 daa2 lou5 fu2
mandarin_meaning: 自不量力／以弱撼強（拿微弱的力量對付強大的對手或做不可能的事）
english_meaning: to overestimate one's ability; to take on a task far beyond one's capability; a hopeless or foolhardy attempt
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，字面意思是用缸瓦船去打老虎，比喻用薄弱、不足的力量去對付強大或不可能克服的對象，表示不自量力或作徒勞無功的行為。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial idiom literally meaning 'using jars-and-tiles boat to beat a tiger.' It describes attempting something hopeless with inadequate means — overestimating oneself or making a foolhardy attempt against a much stronger opponent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住憑一兩個人搞掂成個大項目，真係用缸瓦船打老虎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam2 zyu6 ping4 jat1 loeng5 go3 jan4 gaau2 dim6 sing4 go3 daai6 hong6 muk6, zan1 hai6 jung6 gong1 ngaa5 syun4 daa2 lou5 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想凭一两个人完成整个大项目，真是自不量力。
examples.english_sentence: He intends to finish the whole big project with just one or two people — that's really overestimating his abilities.

cantonese: 缸瓦船打老虎 - 盡地一煲
jyutping: gong1 ngaa5 syun4 daa2 lou5 fu2 zeon6 dei6 jat1 bou1
mandarin_meaning: 把各種不同的東西或人全部混為一談；全部攪在一起，不作區分
english_meaning: To lump everything together; to mix different things/people into one pot without distinguishing them
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容把不同的事物或人全部混在一起，不加區分或不做細緻判斷，等同於「混為一談」或「一鍋端」的意思。
explanation_english: An informal idiom meaning to lump different things or people together without distinguishing them — similar to 'mix everything into one pot' or 'treat all as the same'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁講係將所有嘢都講到缸瓦船打老虎——盡地一煲，完全唔分青紅皂白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 gong2 hai6 zoeng1 sou2 jau5 je5 dou1 gong2 dou3 gong1 ngaa5 syun4 daa2 lou5 fu2 zeon6 dei6 jat1 bou1, wun4 cyun4 m4 fan1 cing1 hung4 zou6 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那樣說是把所有東西都混為一談，完全不作區分。
examples.english_sentence: By saying that, he lumps everything together without any distinction.

mandarin_meaning: 缺（quē）：缺少、不足；也可指器物有缺口或破损
english_meaning: to lack; to be short of; a missing piece or chip (in an object)
explanation_mandarin: 表示缺少或不足（如缺錢、缺人手），也可指物件有缺口或破損（如有缺口的杯子）。在粵語口語中常用作動詞，與名詞連用構成短語。
explanation_english: Indicates lacking or being short of something (e.g., money, staff); can also refer to a chip or missing part of an object. Commonly used as a verb in Cantonese speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家好缺錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 kyut3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在很缺錢。
examples.english_sentence: I'm short on money right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個杯有個缺口，唔好用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bui1 jau5 go3 kyut3 hau2, m4 hou2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個杯子有個缺口，不要用。
examples.english_sentence: This cup has a chip; don't use it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家缺人手，要快啲搵人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 kyut3 jan4 sau2, jiu3 faai3 di1 wan2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司現在缺人手，要快點找人。
examples.english_sentence: The company is short-staffed now; we need to hire people quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 缺少一個也不行；每一個都必不可少
english_meaning: indispensable; none can be omitted; every part is essential
explanation_mandarin: 表示每一個部分或每一個人都很重要，不能缺少任何一個。
explanation_english: Indicates that every component or person is essential and none can be left out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個團隊每個成員都好重要，缺一不可。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 tyun4 deoi2 mui5 go3 sing4 jyun4 dou1 hou2 zung6 jiu3, kyut3 jat1 bat1 ho2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个团队每个成员都很重要，缺一不可。
examples.english_sentence: Every member of this team is important; none can be missing.

mandarin_meaning: 缺乏（表示沒有或不足）
english_meaning: to lack; to be deficient in; to be short of
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有或不足某種必要的事物或條件，常用於抽象名詞前，如缺乏經驗、缺乏資源。
explanation_english: Indicates the absence or insufficiency of something needed or required. Often used before nouns (e.g., lack of experience, lack of resources).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司缺乏人手，做唔切啲項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 fat6 jan4 sau2, zou6 m4 cit3 di1 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司缺乏人手，做不完這些項目。
examples.english_sentence: The company lacks staff and can't finish the projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢缺乏經驗，未準備好獨立處理呢份工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 fat6 ging1 jim6, mei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 duk6 lap6 syu2 lei5 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他缺乏經驗，還沒準備好獨立處理這份工作。
examples.english_sentence: He lacks experience and isn't ready to handle this job independently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地區缺乏乾淨嘅水源，居民生活好艱難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 kyut3 fat6 gon1 zeng6 ge3 seoi2 jyun4, geoi1 man4 saang1 wut6 hou2 gaan1 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個地區缺乏干淨的水源，居民生活很艱難。
examples.english_sentence: This area lacks clean water sources; residents' lives are very difficult.

mandarin_meaning: 缺勤 (quēqín)：缺席、未到崗或未上課
english_meaning: absence (from work or class); to be absent; absenteeism
explanation_mandarin: 表示未出席工作、上課或應到的崗位，可以指單次缺席或經常性的缺勤行為。
explanation_english: Indicates not attending work, class, or one's scheduled duty; can refer to a single absence or recurring absenteeism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日缺勤，冇返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 kyut3 kan4, mou5 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天缺勤，沒有來上班。
examples.english_sentence: He was absent today; he didn't come to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生如果成日缺勤，會影響成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 saang1 jyu4 gwo2 seng4 jat6 kyut3 kan4, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學生如果經常缺勤，會影響成績。
examples.english_sentence: If students are frequently absent, it will affect their grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司紀錄顯示佢上個月有三日缺勤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gei2 luk6 hin2 si6 keoi5 soeng6 go3 jyut6 jau5 saam1 jat6 kyut3 kan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司記錄顯示他上個月有三天缺勤。
examples.english_sentence: Company records show he had three days of absence last month.

mandarin_meaning: 缺口 (quēkǒu)：裂縫、缺陷；也指供應、人手等方面的短缺或空缺。
english_meaning: gap; opening; breach; a shortage or deficit (e.g., in supply or manpower).
explanation_mandarin: 指物體表面或結構上的裂縫或缺陷；也可比喻某方面的空缺或短缺，例如供應缺口或人手缺口。
explanation_english: Refers to a physical opening or break in something; can also be used figuratively for an absence or shortage in areas like supply or staffing (e.g., a supply gap or staffing gap).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牆上有一個缺口，要修補。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 soeng6 jau5 jat1 go3 kyut3 hau2, jiu3 sau1 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 墙上有一个缺口，需要修补。
examples.english_sentence: There's a gap in the wall that needs repairing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家人手有缺口，我哋要請人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 jan4 sau2 jau5 kyut3 hau2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ceng2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司现在人手有缺口，我们要招聘。
examples.english_sentence: The company is currently understaffed; we need to hire people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，口罩供應出現缺口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 cing4 kei4 gaan1, hau2 zau3 gung1 jing3 ceot1 jin2 kyut3 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期间，口罩供应出现缺口。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic there was a shortage in mask supplies.

mandarin_meaning: 缺乏；不完整，丢失（quēshī）
english_meaning: deficiency; something missing; to be missing or lacking
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物或某部分缺少、不完整或丢失，可用作名詞（指缺少的部分）或動詞（指缺少、丟失）。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is missing, incomplete, or lost. Can function as a noun (the missing part) or a verb (to be missing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告有好多數據缺失，無法完成分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jau5 hou2 do1 sou3 geoi3 kyut3 sat1, mou4 faat3 jyun4 sing4 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告有很多数据缺失，无法完成分析。
examples.english_sentence: This report has a lot of missing data, so it's impossible to complete the analysis.

mandarin_meaning: 缺乏
english_meaning: to lack; to be short of; shortage
explanation_mandarin: 表示缺乏或不足某種東西、條件或數量。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is lacking or insufficient in quantity, quality, or condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃缺少資金，可能要延期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 kyut3 siu2 zi1 gam1, ho2 nang4 jiu3 jin4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划缺少资金，可能要延期。
examples.english_sentence: This project lacks funding and may need to be postponed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好因為缺少經驗就唔去試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 jan1 wai6 kyut3 siu2 ging1 jim6 zau6 m4 heoi3 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要因为缺少经验就不去尝试。
examples.english_sentence: Don't avoid trying just because you're lacking experience.

mandarin_meaning: 缺席 (quēxí)
english_meaning: absent; not present (e.g., at a meeting, class, or event)
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有出席或未到場，常用於會議、課堂、活動等情況。
explanation_english: Indicates not attending or being present, commonly used for meetings, classes, events, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為病，佢今日缺席咗會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 beng6, keoi5 gam1 jat6 kyut3 zik6 zo2 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為生病，他今天缺席了會議。
examples.english_sentence: Because he was ill, he was absent from the meeting today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你無故缺席，成績會受影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 mou4 gu3 kyut3 zik6, sing4 zik1 wui5 sau6 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你無故缺席，成績會受影響。
examples.english_sentence: If you are absent without reason, your grades will be affected.

mandarin_meaning: 缺乏德行；不道德、沒良心（口語）
english_meaning: shameless; lacking moral virtue; mean or unkind (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人或行為沒有道德、沒良心，常用作口語的責備或抱怨。
explanation_english: A colloquial expression describing someone or an action as unethical, heartless, or mean; often used to scold or complain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做真係好缺德。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 kyut3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做真是太缺德了。
examples.english_sentence: What you did is really shameless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺人背後講人壞話，真係好缺德。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jan4 bui3 hau6 gong2 jan4 waai6 waa6, zan1 hai6 hou2 kyut3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在別人背後說壞話，真的是很缺德。
examples.english_sentence: He talks badly about people behind their backs; that's really mean.

mandarin_meaning: 遗憾；欠缺、不尽如人意之处
english_meaning: regret; a shortcoming or something unsatisfactory; a sense of loss or pity about something not achieved
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事不完美或未達到期望而感到不滿或遺憾，也可指事物本身的不足之處。
explanation_english: Indicates a feeling of regret or dissatisfaction about something imperfect or unmet expectations; can also refer to a shortcoming in something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我有啲缺憾，冇攞到第一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 jau5 di1 kyut3 ham6, mou5 lo2 dou3 dai6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我有点遗憾，没能拿到第一。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a bit regretful about this competition; I couldn't get first place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於未能完成目標，佢覺得好有缺憾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 mei6 nang4 jyun4 sing4 muk6 biu1, keoi5 gok3 dak1 hou2 jau5 kyut3 ham6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于未能完成目标，他觉得很遗憾。
examples.english_sentence: He feels regretful for not being able to achieve the goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作品雖然好，但仍有啲缺憾，細節可以再好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 ban2 seoi1 jin4 hou2, daan6 jing4 jau5 di1 kyut3 ham6, sai3 zit3 ho2 ji5 zoi3 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作品虽然好，但仍有些缺憾，细节可以更好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Although the work is good, it still has some shortcomings; the details could be improved.

mandarin_meaning: 缺氧 (quē yǎng)：缺乏氧氣，導致生理功能受影響
english_meaning: hypoxia; lack of oxygen (in the body or environment)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词 / 动词（醫學上亦作名词）
explanation_mandarin: 指人體或周圍環境中氧氣不足，可能引起頭暈、胸悶、呼吸困難等症狀；也可用作比喻，形容感覺窒悶或呼吸不到自由。
explanation_english: Refers to insufficient oxygen in the body or environment, which can cause dizziness, chest tightness, and difficulty breathing; can also be used figuratively to describe feeling stifled or uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得有啲缺氧，頭暈，同埋有啲唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 kyut3 joeng5, tau4 wan4, tung4 maai4 jau5 di1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我覺得有點缺氧，頭暈，還有點不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I feel a bit short of breath and dizzy; I'm not feeling well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上高山如果唔帶氧氣樽，可能會缺氧，要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng5 gou1 saan1 jyu4 gwo2 m4 daai3 joeng5 hei3 zeon1, ho2 nang4 wui5 kyut3 joeng5, jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上高山如果不帶氧氣罐，可能會缺氧，要小心。
examples.english_sentence: If you climb high mountains without oxygen tanks, you may suffer from hypoxia — be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 缺失；遗漏；有不足或遗漏的地方（quēlòu）
english_meaning: omission; deficiency; something missing or overlooked
explanation_mandarin: 表示有缺失或遗漏的部分，指事情、文件或系統中不完整或被遗漏的内容，也可用作动词表示有遗漏。
explanation_english: Refers to a deficiency or omission — something missing or overlooked in a document, plan, or system. Can be used as a noun or verb to indicate an omission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報告入面有啲缺漏，要補返先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 kyut3 lau6, jiu3 bou2 faan1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报告里面有一些缺漏，需要补上才能通过。
examples.english_sentence: There are some omissions in the report; they need to be filled in before it can be accepted.

mandarin_meaning: 缺课（在课堂上缺席或没有上某堂课）
english_meaning: to miss class; to be absent from class
explanation_mandarin: 指學生未有出席課堂或未上某堂課，可能因病、私事或故意不去（也可指累積缺席導致影響成績或學分）。
explanation_english: Refers to a student not attending a class or being absent from a particular lesson, whether due to illness, personal reasons, or deliberately skipping; can affect grades or credits if repeated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日缺課，成績又差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 kyut3 fo3, sing4 zik1 jau6 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常缺課，成績又差。
examples.english_sentence: He often misses class and his grades are poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你再缺課，會影響學分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zoi3 kyut3 fo3, wui5 jing2 hoeng2 hok6 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你再缺課，會影響學分。
examples.english_sentence: If you miss more classes, it will affect your credits.

mandarin_meaning: 缺货 (quē huò) — 没有存货，暂时无法供应
english_meaning: out of stock; sold out; (there is) a shortage of the item
explanation_mandarin: 表示商品暂时没有库存或无法供应，可作动词或形容词使用，例如“這件已經缺貨”。
explanation_english: Indicates that an item is temporarily unavailable because there is no stock. Can function as a verb or an adjective (e.g., “This item is out of stock”).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部新手機而家缺貨，舖頭話要等幾個星期先有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1 ji4 gaa1 kyut3 fo3, pou3 tau4 waa6 jiu3 dang2 gei2 go3 sing1 kei4 sin1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那款新手機現在缺貨，店家說要等好幾個星期才有。
examples.english_sentence: That new phone is currently out of stock; the shop said it will take several weeks to restock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網店顯示呢款衫已經缺貨，唔可以落單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 dim3 hin2 si6 ni1 fun2 saam1 ji5 ging1 kyut3 fo3, m4 ho2 ji5 lok6 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网店显示这款衣服已经缺货，不能下单。
examples.english_sentence: The online store shows this shirt is already out of stock, you can't place an order.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想買但缺貨，我哋可以幫你預訂，送到你屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 maai5 daan6 kyut3 fo3, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 jyu6 ding6, sung3 dou3 nei5 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想买但缺货，我们可以帮你预订，送到你家。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to buy it but it's out of stock, we can pre-order it for you and deliver it to your home.

mandarin_meaning: 缺席；未到場或未參與（通常指比賽、會議、排班等）
english_meaning: to be absent; not present or not participating (often referring to matches, meetings, or shifts)
explanation_mandarin: 「缺陣」用於表示某人或某隊未到場或未參加某個活動或職務，常用於比賽、會議、排班等情境。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that a person or team is not present or not taking part in an event or duty; commonly used for matches, meetings, shifts, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日有兩個球員缺陣，球隊實力大減。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jau5 loeng5 go3 kau4 jyun4 kyut3 zan6, kau4 deoi3 sat6 lik6 daai6 gaam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天有兩個球員缺陣，球隊實力大減。
examples.english_sentence: Two players are absent today, so the team's strength is greatly reduced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因病缺陣，未能參加今日嘅會議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 beng6 kyut3 zan6, mei6 nang4 caam1 gaa1 gam1 jat6 ge3 wui6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因病缺席，未能參加今天的會議。
examples.english_sentence: He was absent due to illness and couldn't attend today's meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 缺点；瑕疵；缺陷
english_meaning: defect; flaw; shortcoming; imperfection
explanation_mandarin: 指事物、計劃或人的不足、缺點或不完善之處，可能導致功能失常或效果不佳。
explanation_english: Refers to a shortcoming, imperfection, or defect in something (or someone) that may cause malfunction or unsatisfactory results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機有好明顯嘅缺陷，影相成日唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 jau5 hou2 ming4 hin2 ge3 kyut3 ham6, jing2 soeng2 seng4 jat6 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機有很明顯的缺陷，拍照常常不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This phone has a clear defect; photos often come out blurry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅計劃有一個致命嘅缺陷，令整個項目失敗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6 jau5 jat1 go3 zi3 ming6 ge3 kyut3 ham6, ling6 zing2 go3 hong6 muk6 sat1 baai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的計劃有一個致命的缺陷，導致整個項目失敗。
examples.english_sentence: His plan has a fatal flaw that caused the whole project to fail.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）腦袋少一頁；神經有問題／行為怪異或愚蠢
english_meaning: Cantonese slang literally 'missing a page' — used to say someone is mentally off, acting crazy, foolish, or lacking common sense (pejorative).
explanation_mandarin: 「缺頁」是廣東話口語俚語，字面意思為『少了一頁』，比喻腦袋或思維缺少一部分，常用來形容人行為怪異、愚笨或精神狀態不穩定，帶有貶義，屬於不禮貌的罵法。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term literally meaning 'missing a page.' It figuratively describes someone whose mind seems incomplete — acting weird, foolish, or mentally unstable. It's pejorative and can be insulting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係缺頁，成日講啲奇怪嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 kyut3 jip6, sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 kei4 gwaai3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是腦袋少一頁，總是說奇怪的話。
examples.english_sentence: He's really missing a page — always says strange things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咪講咁多啦，聽落好似有啲缺頁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mai4 gong2 gam3 do1 laa1, ting1 lok6 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 kyut3 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別說那麼多了，聽起來他有點神經不太正常。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk so much; it sounds like he's a bit off his rocker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師唔接受學生互相叫「缺頁」，因為好無禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 m4 zip3 sau6 hok6 saang1 wu6 soeng1 giu3 "kyut3 jip6", jan1 wai6 hou2 mou4 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師不允許學生互相叫『缺頁』，因為很沒禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher doesn't allow students to call each other '缺頁' because it's impolite.

mandarin_meaning: 缺点 (quēdiǎn)
english_meaning: shortcoming; defect; flaw; weakness
explanation_mandarin: 表示人或事物不完美、有不足或缺陷的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's or thing's shortcomings, defects, weaknesses, or imperfections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有能力，但都有啲缺點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 nang4 lik6, daan6 dou1 jau5 di1 kyut3 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有能力，但也有一些缺点。
examples.english_sentence: He is very capable, but he also has some shortcomings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話嘅最大缺點係電池唔耐用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 ge3 zeoi3 daai6 kyut3 dim2 hai6 din6 ci4 m4 noi6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部手机最大的缺点是电池不耐用。
examples.english_sentence: The biggest drawback of this phone is that the battery doesn't last long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試時，老闆問你嘅缺點，你點答？
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 si4, lou5 baan2 man6 nei5 ge3 kyut3 dim2, nei5 dim2 daap3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试时，老板问你的缺点，你怎么回答？
examples.english_sentence: In an interview, when the boss asks about your weaknesses, how do you answer?

mandarin_meaning: 缽（bō）：器皿，碗狀容器；常指僧人盛食或化緣用的鉢盂。
english_meaning: bowl; a bowl-shaped vessel (often an alms bowl used by Buddhist monks).
explanation_mandarin: 指一種碗狀的器皿，可用來盛食物或作為僧人化緣用的鉢盂。在廣東話中也出現在一些粵式小吃名稱（如「缽仔糕」）。
explanation_english: Refers to a bowl-shaped vessel used to hold food or, in a religious context, an alms bowl carried by monks. Also appears in Cantonese food names (e.g. Put Chai Ko, 缽仔糕).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆用個缽裝粥畀街坊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 jung6 go3 bot3 zong1 zuk1 bei2 gaai1 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶用碗盛粥給鄰居。
examples.english_sentence: The grandmother used a bowl to give porridge to the neighbor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 和尚拎住缽去化緣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wo4 soeng1 ling1 zyu6 bot3 heoi3 faa3 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 和尚拿著缽去化緣。
examples.english_sentence: The monk carried the alms bowl to collect alms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係傳統嘅缽仔糕，好味㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 cyun4 tung2 ge3 bot3 zai2 gou1, hou2 mei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這是傳統的缽仔糕，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This is a traditional Put Chai Ko (steamed cake); it's tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 碗仔糕 / 小碗蒸糕
english_meaning: small bowl steamed cake (Hong Kong street snack)
explanation_mandarin: 缽仔糕（亦常寫作碗仔糕或砵仔糕）是香港常見的小吃，通常用米粉或澱粉加糖和水蒸成小杯狀或碗狀的糕點，有時會有不同顏色或夾餡（如紅豆、椰汁等）。常在街市或小食店出售。
explanation_english: 缽仔糕 (also written 碗仔糕 or 砵仔糕) is a common Hong Kong snack — a small steamed cake made from rice flour or starch with sugar, served in little bowls. It can come in different colors or flavors and is often sold at street stalls or small snack shops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺街市買咗兩個缽仔糕，味道好正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 loeng5 go3 bot6 zai2 gou1, mei6 dou6 hou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在街市买了两个缽仔糕，味道很好。
examples.english_sentence: I bought two boh zai gou at the market — they taste great.

mandarin_meaning: 盛放缽、碗或餐具的櫃子（罕用）
english_meaning: a cabinet/cupboard for storing bowls or tableware (rare/archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 「缽櫃」字面意思是用來放缽（或碗、餐具）的櫃子。此詞較少使用，屬於書面或方言用法，可理解為碗櫃或餐具櫃的舊稱或變體。
explanation_english: Literally 'bowl cabinet' — a cupboard used to store bowls or tableware. The term is uncommon/archaic and can be seen as an older or dialectal variant of 'bowl cabinet' or 'cupboard for dishes'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面有個缽櫃，擺滿咗碗碟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong2 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 bot3 gwai6, baai2 mun5 zo2 wun2 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房裡有一個放碗碟的缽櫃，擺滿了碗碟。
examples.english_sentence: There is a bowl cabinet in the kitchen, filled with bowls and dishes.

mandarin_meaning: 把酒盛在缽（碗）中；指以缽盛的酒（多為古語或書面用法）
english_meaning: wine/spirits served in a bowl; to drink wine from a bowl (archaic/literary)
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can be used descriptively/verbally in literary contexts)
explanation_mandarin: “缽酒”是書面或古語用法，字面意思是把酒盛在缽（類似碗或缽狀器皿）中。現代口語中較少使用，多見於古文、詩詞或描述早期風俗的語境。
explanation_english: “缽酒” is a literary/archaic term meaning wine kept or drunk from a bowl (alms-bowl–type vessel). It is uncommon in modern spoken Cantonese and appears mainly in classical texts or descriptive passages about earlier customs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時窮人有時會用缽酒飲，器皿樸素，卻也能解渴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 kung4 jan4 jau5 si4 wui5 jung6 but3 zau2 jam2, hei3 man5 pok3 sou3, koek3 jaa5 nang4 gaai2 hot3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过去穷人有时会用缽盛酒来喝，器皿朴素，但也能解渴。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, poor people would sometimes drink wine from a bowl; the vessels were plain, but they still quenched thirst.

mandarin_meaning: 缽头；用于化缘、讨饭的钵（乞讨、收受施舍用的器皿），也可引申指托缽乞讨的行为
english_meaning: alms bowl; begging bowl (the bowl used to collect alms); can also refer to the act of begging with such a bowl
explanation_mandarin: 指僧人或乞丐用來盛放供養、募化的器皿（缽、钵），常見於宗教或托缽化緣的場景；有時也用來泛指托缽、乞討的行為。
explanation_english: Refers to the bowl used by monastics (or beggars) to receive alms or offerings. Common in religious contexts (alms-collecting); can also be used figuratively to refer to the act of begging with such a bowl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出家人拎住缽頭去街度化緣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaa1 jan4 ling1 zyu6 bot3 tau4 heoi3 gaai1 dou6 faa3 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出家人拿着缽头去街上化缘。
examples.english_sentence: Monastics carry an alms bowl and go into the streets to collect alms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬話佢見到和尚拎住缽頭行過街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 waa6 keoi5 gin3 dou2 wo4 soeng6 ling1 zyu6 bot3 tau4 hang4 gwo3 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟说他看到有和尚拿着缽头走过街道。
examples.english_sentence: My younger brother said he saw a monk carrying an alms bowl walking down the street.

mandarin_meaning: 用盡；耗盡；空
english_meaning: to use up; to exhaust; empty
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物被完全用盡或耗盡，例如存貨、資源等。常見於成語如「罄竹難書」，形容罪行或過失多到難以盡述。
explanation_english: Indicates that something has been completely used up or exhausted (e.g., stock, resources). Appears in idioms like "罄竹難書", describing an amount so large it is hard to record or recount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲儲備已經罄晒，唔知仲可以點做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 cyu5bei6 ji5ging1 king3 saai3, m4 zi1 zung6 ho2 ji5 dim2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的儲備已經用盡了，不知道還能怎麼辦。
examples.english_sentence: My reserves are already used up; I don't know what else to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個禮物嘅存貨罄咗，要等多幾日先有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lai5mat6 ge3 cyun4fo3 king3 zo2, jiu3 dang2 do1 gei2 jat6 sin1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個禮物的存貨用完了，要再等幾天才有。
examples.english_sentence: The stock of this gift is sold out; you'll have to wait a few days.

mandarin_meaning: 罄竹难书（形容罪行或缺点多得难以尽述）
english_meaning: Too numerous to list; (often about crimes or faults) so many that they cannot all be written down
explanation_mandarin: 形容壞事、罪行或缺點很多，多得難以一一寫出來或列舉出來。
explanation_english: Describes misdeeds, faults, or items so numerous that it is impractical or impossible to list them all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲罪行多到罄竹難書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 zeoi6 hang4 do1 dou3 king3 zuk1 naan4 syu1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的罪行多到罄竹难书。
examples.english_sentence: His crimes are too numerous to list.

mandarin_meaning: 裂縫；縫隙；（口語）機會、漏洞
english_meaning: crack; gap; fissure; (colloquial) a chance or loophole
explanation_mandarin: 「罅」通常指物體上的裂縫或縫隙，在口語中也可引申為可以利用的機會或漏洞。
explanation_english: “罅” usually refers to a crack or gap in an object; colloquially it can be extended to mean an opportunity or loophole that can be exploited.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張枱有一條罅，要修吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi4 jau5 jat1 tiu4 hat6, jiu3 sau1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子有一道裂縫，要修一下。
examples.english_sentence: The table has a crack; it needs repairing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺合約入面搵到罅，就用嚟避責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hap6 joek3 jap6 min6 wan2 dou3 hat6, zau6 jung6 lai4 bei6 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在合約裡面找到罅（漏洞），就用來逃避責任。
examples.english_sentence: He found a loophole in the contract and used it to evade responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 門口有罅，風好容易吹入嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mun4 hau2 jau5 hat6, fung1 hou2 jung4 ji6 ceoi1 jap6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 門口有縫，風很容易吹進來。
examples.english_sentence: There's a gap at the door; the wind blows in easily.

mandarin_meaning: 缝隙；裂缝
english_meaning: crack; gap; fissure; crevice; a small opening or space
explanation_mandarin: 指物體表面或兩物之間的細小裂縫或縫隙，也可用於比喻抽象的空隙或漏洞。
explanation_english: Refers to a small crack or gap on a surface or between objects; can also be used metaphorically for an opening or loophole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牆上有一道罅隙，雨水會從嗰度滲入屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 soeng6 jau5 jat1 dou6 hat6 sik1, jyu5 seoi2 wui5 cung4 go2 dou6 sam3 jap6 uk1 kei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 墙上有一道缝隙，雨水会从那里渗入屋内。
examples.english_sentence: There's a crack in the wall; rainwater will seep into the house through it.

mandarin_meaning: 罉是罕见的汉字，现代汉语中极少使用，可能为罌/罂等字的异体或指古代器物的用字，常见于古文或铭刻中
english_meaning: A very rare/archaic Chinese character with no common modern Cantonese usage; possibly a variant of 罌/罂 or an old word for a vessel; mainly seen in classical texts or inscriptions
explanation_mandarin: 此字在現代粵語、現代漢語中鮮少出現，通常被視為古字或異體字，可能與「罌/罂」（如「罌粟」）有關或曾用以指稱古代的罐器。若遇到需參考古文或字書確認。
explanation_english: This character is scarcely used in modern Cantonese or Mandarin. It is generally treated as an archaic or variant form, possibly related to 罌/罂 (as in 罌粟, 'poppy') or used historically for a type of vessel. Consultation of classical sources or dictionaries is needed for specific meanings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「罉」呢個字好罕見，日常粵語唔會用到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: 「罉」ni1 go3 zi6 hou2 hon2 gin3, jat6 soeng4 jyut6 jyu5 m4 wui5 jung6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “罉”这个字很罕见，日常粤语不会用到。
examples.english_sentence: "罉" is a very rare character and is not used in everyday Cantonese.

mandarin_meaning: 罊：罕見或古字、方言字，現代普通話及粵語中無統一常用讀音或明確通用義，通常只見於古籍或專門字典。
english_meaning: 罊: a rare or obsolete character (possibly dialectal). It has no standardized modern Cantonese pronunciation or widely accepted meaning and is usually found only in classical texts or specialist dictionaries.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 無固定詞性（罕見字／古字）
partOfSpeech_english: no fixed part of speech (rare/obsolete character)
explanation_mandarin: 此字屬罕見字，現代粵語詞典中通常不收錄或標註讀音與詞性。若需查詢具體來源或義項，應參考古籍或通行的字書、方言調查資料。
explanation_english: This character is rare/obsolete and normally not listed with a standard Cantonese reading or part of speech in modern dictionaries. For specific citations or meanings one should consult classical sources or specialist character dictionaries and dialect surveys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「罊」呢個字好罕見，平時唔會見到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: 「罊」ni1 go3 zi6 hou2 hon2 gin3, ping4 si4 m4 wui5 gin3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「罊」这个字很罕见，平时不会看到。
examples.english_sentence: '罊' is a very rare character; you won't usually see it.

mandarin_meaning: 罌（罂）：罐、罎等容器；也見於合成詞如「罌粟」（罂粟，指罌粟植物）
english_meaning: A jar or pot; also appears in compounds such as "poppy" (as in 罌粟)
explanation_mandarin: 古文字，原指器皿類的罐、罎，現代漢語中多見於複合詞（例如「罌粟」表示罌粟植物）。單字作為日常用語較少，常用來表示容器或作為植物名稱的一部分。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a vessel (jar or pot). In modern Chinese it is mainly seen in compounds (for example, "罌粟" meaning poppy). The single character is uncommon in everyday speech and is typically used to mean a container or as part of plant names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企有個古老嘅陶瓷罌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 jau5 go3 gu2 lou5 ge3 tou4 ci4 jing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家裡有一個古老的陶瓷罎子。
examples.english_sentence: He has an old ceramic jar at home.

mandarin_meaning: 罂粟（yīngsù），指罂粟属植物，尤指可用来提炼鸦片的罂粟（鴉片罌粟），也可指其花或种子。
english_meaning: Poppy (Papaver), especially the opium poppy used to produce opium; can refer to the plant, its flowers, or seeds.
explanation_mandarin: 罌粟是一種植物，常指可提煉鴉片的罂粟。含有生物鹼（如罂粟生物鹼），在鴉片和相關藥物、毒品的生產中被提及。
explanation_english: A plant (poppy), commonly referring to the opium poppy used to extract opium. It contains alkaloids used in the production of opiates and is therefore associated with drug production.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度有一片罌粟田。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jau5 jat1 pin3 jing1 suk1 tin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有一片罂粟田。
examples.english_sentence: There is a field of poppies here.

mandarin_meaning: 罐；罐子；罐頭（容器）
english_meaning: jar; can; tin; container
explanation_mandarin: 指用來盛載液體或固體的容器，如罐子或罐頭。在廣東話中可單獨作名詞，也常出現在複合詞或作量詞（如一罐汽水）。
explanation_english: Refers to a container used to hold liquids or solids (e.g., jar, can, tin). In Cantonese it is used as a noun and appears in compounds or as part of quantity phrases (e.g., 一罐汽水).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一罐汽水，放咗喺雪櫃入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 gun3 hei3 seoi2, fong3 zo2 hai2 syut3 gwai6 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一罐汽水，放在冰箱里。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a can of soda and put it in the fridge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用玻璃罐儲蜜糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 bo1 lai4 gun3 cou5 mat6 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用玻璃罐储存蜂蜜。
examples.english_sentence: He uses a glass jar to store honey.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開罐嗰陣要小心，易割到手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 gun3 go2 zan6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, ji6 got3 dou3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 开罐的时候要小心，容易割到手。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when opening a can; it's easy to cut your hand.

mandarin_meaning: 罐装（用金属或其他材料的罐子包装）
english_meaning: canned; packaged in a can
explanation_mandarin: 表示食物或飲品以罐子包裝的狀態或類別，如罐裝食品、罐裝飲料。
explanation_english: Indicates that a food or drink is packaged in a can (e.g., canned food or canned beverage).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲罐裝飲品喺便利店好常見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gun3 zong1 jam2 ban2 hai2 bin6 lei6 dim3 hou2 soeng4 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些罐装饮品在便利店很常见。
examples.english_sentence: These canned drinks are commonly found in convenience stores.

mandarin_meaning: 罐頭（罐裝食品）；也可指預先錄製或程式化、沒有即興的「罐頭式」
english_meaning: canned food; can; (figurative) canned/pre-recorded or formulaic
explanation_mandarin: 原指裝在罐裡的食品（罐頭、罐裝食品）；引申用法可指預先錄製或機械化、缺乏即興與變化的事物（例如「罐頭歌」、「罐頭節目」）。
explanation_english: Originally refers to food sold in cans (canned food). Figuratively it can describe something pre-recorded or formulaic — lacking spontaneity (e.g., 'canned performance' or 'canned response').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚冇時間煮飯，買罐頭食算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 mou5 si4 gaan1 zyu2 faan6, maai5 gun3 tau4 sik6 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚沒時間煮飯，買罐頭吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have time to cook tonight; I'll just eat canned food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啲表演好似罐頭，完全冇即興。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 di1 biu2 jin2 hou2 ci5 gun3 tau4, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 zik1 hing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的表演像罐頭一樣，完全沒有即興。
examples.english_sentence: Their performances are like canned shows — completely without improvisation.

mandarin_meaning: 開罐器 / 開罐刀
english_meaning: can opener
explanation_mandarin: 指用來打開金屬罐頭的工具，既有手動款式也有電動款式，通常指手持的開罐器。
explanation_english: A tool used to open metal cans; can be manual or electric. Commonly refers to a handheld can opener.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一把新嘅罐頭刀，開罐頭容易好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 baa2 san1 ge3 gun3 tau4 dou1, hoi1 gun3 tau4 jung4 ji6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一把新的罐頭刀，開罐頭容易多了。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new can opener; opening cans is much easier.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房抽屜入面有把舊罐頭刀，你可以攞嚟幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 cau1 teoi3 jap6 min6 jau5 baa2 gau6 gun3 tau4 dou1, nei5 ho2 ji5 lo2 lai4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房抽屜裡有把舊的罐頭刀，你可以拿來幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: There's an old can opener in the kitchen drawer; you can use it to help.

mandarin_meaning: 罐装商品；比喻为事先包装、缺乏个性或新意的商品或艺人
english_meaning: literally 'canned goods'; figuratively a mass‑produced or prepackaged product (or artist/act) that is formulaic, lacking originality or authenticity
explanation_mandarin: 原指罐装的商品，口语中常用作贬义，形容某物或某人像工厂生产的“罐头”一样千篇一律、没有新意或真诚，亦可指經包裝製造出來的偶像／藝人。
explanation_english: Originally refers to canned goods; colloquially used pejoratively to describe products or people that are mass‑produced or 'packaged' with little originality or authenticity (e.g. manufactured pop idols, formulaic songs).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲歌聽落好似罐頭貨，冇乜新意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 go1 teng1 lok6 hou2 ci5 gun3 tau4 fo3, mou5 mat1 san1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些歌听起来像是罐头货，没有什么新意。
examples.english_sentence: These songs sound like canned products — there's nothing new about them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司出嘅偶像好似罐頭貨，一個樣，俾人感覺唔真誠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ceot1 ge3 ngau5 zoeng6 hou2 ci5 gun3 tau4 fo3, jat1 go3 joeng6, bei2 jan4 gam2 gok3 m4 zan1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司推出的偶像像罐头货，千篇一律，让人感觉不真诚。
examples.english_sentence: The idols produced by their company feel like packaged acts — all the same and insincere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 超市而家減價，罐頭貨買一送一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 si5 ji4 gaa1 gaam2 gaa3, gun3 tau4 fo3 maai5 jat1 sung3 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 超市现在减价，罐头货买一送一。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket is having a sale; canned goods are buy‑one‑get‑one‑free.

mandarin_meaning: （文言）欺騙、無、沒有；表示輕忽、不顧（如罔顧）
english_meaning: Classical/literary verb meaning 'to deceive', 'not/without', or 'to disregard' (appears in compounds like 罔顧)
explanation_mandarin: 罔為古漢語用字，常見於複合詞中，表示欺騙、沒有或不顧。例如：罔顧（不顧）、罔知（不知道）。
explanation_english: A Classical Chinese character used as a verb meaning to deceive, to lack/not have, or to disregard. Commonly seen in compounds such as 罔顧 (to disregard) and 罔知 (to be unaware).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日罔顧規矩，做嘢好散慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 mong5 gu3 kwai1 geoi2, zou6 je5 hou2 saan3 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常罔顧規矩，做事很散漫。
examples.english_sentence: He often disregards the rules and is very lax in his work.

mandarin_meaning: 罔顾（不顾、忽视）
english_meaning: to disregard; to ignore; to pay no heed to
explanation_mandarin: 表示不顾、不理会或忽视某事或某人，常用于书面或正式语境。
explanation_english: Indicates disregarding or ignoring something or someone; often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢罔顧後果，硬係咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mong5 gu3 hau6 gwo2, ngaang6 hai6 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他罔顾后果，还是那样做。
examples.english_sentence: He disregarded the consequences and did it anyway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府罔顧民意，推行新政策，引起市民不滿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 mong5 gu3 man4 ji3, teoi1 hang4 san1 zing3 caak3, jan5 hei2 si5 man4 bat1 mun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府罔顾民意，推行新政策，导致市民不满。
examples.english_sentence: The government ignored public opinion and implemented the new policy, causing public dissatisfaction.

mandarin_meaning: 罕见／稀少
english_meaning: rare; scarce; uncommon
explanation_mandarin: 表示很少見或稀少，常用於「罕見」「罕有」等詞語中。
explanation_english: Indicates something is rare or scarce; commonly used in compounds like "罕見" or "罕有."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲動物喺香港好罕見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 dung6 mat6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 hon2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些动物在香港很罕见。
examples.english_sentence: These animals are very rare in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 發生呢種情況嘅機會好罕有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 sang1 ni1 zung2 cing4 fong3 ge3 gei1 wui6 hou2 hon2 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 发生这种情况的机会很少有。
examples.english_sentence: The chance of this situation happening is very rare.

mandarin_meaning: 罕见；少有
english_meaning: rare; uncommon; seldom seen
explanation_mandarin: 表示很少出現或不常見，形容事物或情況稀有。
explanation_english: Indicates that something appears very infrequently or is uncommon; used to describe rare things or situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲機會好罕有，你唔好錯過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gei1 wui6 hou2 haam2 jau5, nei5 m4 hou2 co3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些机会很罕见，你不要错过。
examples.english_sentence: These opportunities are very rare; don't miss them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅才能咁全面真係好罕有，係難得嘅人才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 coi4 noi6 gam2 cyun4 min6 zan1 hai6 hou2 haam2 jau5, hai6 naan4 dak1 ge3 jan4 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的才能如此全面真是很罕见，是难得的人才。
examples.english_sentence: His talents are so well-rounded that they're truly rare — a remarkable talent.

mandarin_meaning: 罕见 (hǎnjiàn)：很少见、不常出现
english_meaning: rare; uncommon; seldom seen
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物很少见或不常出现，用來形容罕有的現象或事物。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is rare or seldom seen; used to describe uncommon phenomena or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種鳥好罕見，好多人一生都未見過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 niu5 hou2 ham2 gin3, hou2 do1 jan4 jat1 sang1 dou1 mei6 gin3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种鸟很罕见，很多人一辈子都没见过。
examples.english_sentence: This kind of bird is very rare; many people never see it in their lifetime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲情況喺現代社會入面都幾罕見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cing4 fong3 hai2 jin6 doi6 se5 wui6 jap6 min6 dou1 gei2 ham2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些情况在现代社会中也很罕见。
examples.english_sentence: These situations are also quite rare in modern society.

mandarin_meaning: 罟（大網、漁網，用來捕魚的大型網具）
english_meaning: a large fishing net; dragnet used for catching fish
explanation_mandarin: 罟指傳統漁業中用來捕撈魚類的大型網具，常出現在合網、圍網等捕魚方式中，也出現在複合詞如「罟網」「魚罟」。
explanation_english: 罟 refers to a large net used in traditional fishing for catching fish. It appears in compounds such as 罟網 or 魚罟 and is associated with community or large-scale net-fishing methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 漁民用罟捕魚，成日捉到好多魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 man4 jung6 gu2 bou6 jyu4, sing4 jat6 zuk1 dou3 hou2 do1 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 漁民用罟捕魚，經常捕到很多魚。
examples.english_sentence: Fishermen use nets to catch fish and often catch many fish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲老人講以前成條村都靠罟為生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 lou5 jan4 gong2 ji5 cin4 sing4 tiu4 cyun1 dou1 kaau3 gu2 wai4 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人說以前整個村子都以罟為生。
examples.english_sentence: The elders said the whole village used to make a living by fishing with nets.

mandarin_meaning: 罡（gāng）：古代指天上的星宿之一，常見於道教、占星或武俠語境（如「天罡」、「罡星」）；在複合詞中也帶有威猛、強大的意味。屬文學或術語用法，較為書面與古雅。
english_meaning: 罡 (gong1): an archaic term referring to certain celestial stars/constellations (appearing in compounds such as "Heavenly Gang" 天罡 or "Gang Star" 罡星); used in Daoist/astral, literary or wuxia contexts. Can imply might or ferocity in compounds.
explanation_mandarin: 「罡」多見於複合詞，如「天罡」、「罡星」，指特定的星宿或天象，常用於道教、占星或武俠敘事中，語感偏古雅與書面。
explanation_english: Used chiefly in compounds (e.g. 天罡, 罡星) to denote a particular celestial star/constellation. Appears in Daoist, astrological, or literary/wuxia contexts and has an archaic, formal tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部武俠小說講天罡地煞嘅故事，人物好精彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 mou5 hap6 siu1 syut3 gong2 tin1 gong1 dei6 saat3 ge3 gu3 si6, jan4 mat6 hou2 zing1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部武俠小說講述天罡地煞的故事，人物很精彩。
examples.english_sentence: This wuxia novel tells the story of the Heavenly Gang and Earth Fiends; the characters are very vivid.

mandarin_meaning: （古）覆蓋、包紮；作敷貼之用
english_meaning: archaic: to cover, to wrap or bandage; a compress/dressing
explanation_mandarin: 「罨」為較少見或書面、古漢語用字，常指用布或藥物覆蓋、包紮傷口或作敷貼之用。在現代漢語中多見於醫療或古文語境，口語常用「敷」或「包紮」。
explanation_english: A rare/archaic character used to mean to cover or wrap (especially as a bandage or compress). It appears mainly in literary or medical contexts; in everyday speech speakers usually use words like "bandage" or "dress".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 護士用罨敷住嗰個傷口，等多陣先換藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wu6 si6 jung6 aan3 fu1 zyu6 go2 go3 soeng1 hau2, dang2 do1 zan6 sin1 wun6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 護士用罨敷住那個傷口，等一會兒再換藥。
examples.english_sentence: The nurse covered the wound with a dressing and waited a while before changing the bandage.

mandarin_meaning: 把醬汁淋/抹在食物上（淋汁、澆汁）
english_meaning: to baste or pour sauce over food; to smother with sauce
explanation_mandarin: 罨汁是廣東話口語用法，常見於烹飪或上菜時，指將醬汁淋或抹在食物表面以入味或增色。用法較口語化、地區性較強，常見於燒味、煎炸等料理描述。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb used in cooking contexts meaning to pour, brush, or smother sauce over food (for example, basting roast meats). It is informal and regionally used.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲燒鵝要罨汁先至夠味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 siu1 ngo4 jiu3 aan3 zap1 sin1 zi6 gau3 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些燒鵝要淋汁才夠味。
examples.english_sentence: These roast geese need to be basted with sauce to be flavorful.

mandarin_meaning: 垂頭喪氣；沒精神；無精打采
english_meaning: listless; dejected; droopy; lacking energy
explanation_mandarin: 「罨耷」是廣東話口語，形容人沒有精神、垂頭喪氣或無精打采；也可以形容表情或身體姿態顯得鬆垮、下垂。
explanation_english: “罨耷” is a Cantonese colloquial term describing someone who is listless, dejected, or lacking energy. It can also describe a droopy or slack expression or posture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日成日都罨耷，咩都提不起精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1jat6 sing4jat6 dou1 aan3 daap6, me1 dou1 tai4 bat1 hei2 zing1san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天整天都垂頭喪氣，什麼都提不起精神。
examples.english_sentence: He's been listless all day today and can't muster any energy.

mandarin_meaning: 罩 (zhào)：覆盖、保护；（名）罩子、口罩等
english_meaning: cover; mask; to protect; (noun) cover, mask, shroud
explanation_mandarin: 「罩」可以當名詞指罩子、口罩等覆蓋物，也可以當動詞表示覆蓋或保護。在廣東話口語中常見於「口罩」「罩住」「有得罩」等用法。
explanation_english: “罩” can be a noun meaning a cover or mask (e.g., face mask) or a verb meaning to cover or protect. In Cantonese it appears in everyday phrases like '口罩' (mask), '罩住' (cover/keep protected), and slang uses meaning to look out for or handle someone/something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得帶口罩出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 daai3 hau2 zaau3 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得带口罩出门。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring/wear a face mask when going out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，有我罩住你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1, jau5 ngo5 zaau3 zyu6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用怕，有我罩着你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid — I've got you covered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我換咗個燈罩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wun6 zo2 go3 dang1 zaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我换了个灯罩。
examples.english_sentence: I changed the lampshade.

mandarin_meaning: 罩杯（胸罩的杯型/尺碼，例如A杯、B杯）
english_meaning: bra cup size (the cup measurement of a bra, e.g., A, B, C)
explanation_mandarin: 指胸罩的杯型或尺碼，用來表示胸部的體積大小，常以A、B、C等字母區分。
explanation_english: Refers to the cup size of a bra, indicating breast volume; commonly denoted by letters such as A, B, C.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知道自己係B杯定C杯，想去舖頭試下罩杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 hai6 B bui1 ding6 C bui1, soeng2 heoi3 pou3 tau2 si3 haa5 zau3 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道自己是B罩杯還是C罩杯，想去店裡試穿看看。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know if I'm a B cup or a C cup; I want to go to the store to try them on.

mandarin_meaning: 弱点；把柄；致命弱点
english_meaning: weak point; vulnerability; Achilles' heel
explanation_mandarin: 指某人或某事在某方面的弱點或漏洞，常用於口語，表示容易被攻擊或被利用的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's or thing's weak point or flaw—an area of vulnerability that can be exploited. Commonly used in colloquial speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好聰明，但社交係佢嘅罩門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 cung1 ming4, daan6 se5 gaau1 hai6 keoi5 ge3 zaau3 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聰明，但社交是他的弱點。
examples.english_sentence: He's very smart, but socializing is his weak point.

mandarin_meaning: 罪、罪行、过错
english_meaning: crime; sin; guilt; fault; offense
explanation_mandarin: 表示犯罪、罪行或道德上的过错；在不同詞語中可指具體的罪行（如「罪行」）或道歉與懲戒相關的錯誤（如「罪過」）。
explanation_english: Denotes a crime, sin, guilt, or moral fault. In compounds it can indicate specific criminal acts (e.g. "罪行") or wrongdoing/moral fault (e.g. "罪過").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢犯咗罪，要坐監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan6 zo2 zeoi6, jiu3 co5 gaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他犯了罪，要坐牢。
examples.english_sentence: He committed a crime and has to go to jail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話佢有罪定係無罪？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 keoi5 jau5 zeoi6 ding6 hai6 mou4 zeoi6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说他有罪还是无罪？
examples.english_sentence: Do you say he's guilty or not guilty?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢承認咗自己嘅罪過，向大家道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jing6 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 zeoi6 gwo3, hoeng3 daai6 gaa1 dou6 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他承认了自己的罪过，向大家道歉。
examples.english_sentence: He admitted his wrongdoing and apologized to everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 罪大惡極，不可赦免 (拼音: zuì bù róng zhū)
english_meaning: A crime so grave that it cannot be tolerated or pardoned; utterly unforgivable
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容罪行極為嚴重，應該受到最嚴厲的懲罰，無法寬恕或赦免。
explanation_english: Used to describe actions or crimes so severe that they cannot be tolerated or pardoned and deserve the harshest punishment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲行為簡直罪不容誅，應該畀最嚴厲嘅懲罰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 hang4 wai6 gaan2 zik6 zeoi6 bat1 jung4 zyu1, jing1 goi1 bei2 zeoi3 jim4 lai6 ge3 cing4 fat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为简直罪不容诛，应该受到最严厉的惩罚。
examples.english_sentence: His actions are simply unforgivable and should receive the harshest punishment.

mandarin_meaning: 罪人 (zuìrén)
english_meaning: sinner; a person who has committed a moral or religious wrong
explanation_mandarin: 指在道德或宗教上有過失或犯錯、應受譴責或感到內疚的人；也可泛指做錯事、招人責備的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has committed a moral or religious wrong and is considered blameworthy or feels guilty; can also be used generally for someone at fault.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己係個罪人，唔值得大家原諒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 go3 zeoi6 jan4, m4 zik1 dak1 daai6 gaa1 jyun4 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己是個罪人，不值得大家原諒。
examples.english_sentence: He said he was a sinner and didn't deserve everyone's forgiveness.

mandarin_meaning: 使罪行加重；在原本的罪行上再增加一重罪責（可用「罪上加罪」替換）
english_meaning: to aggravate an offence; to make a crime worse or add another degree of guilt
explanation_mandarin: 表示在已有的過錯或罪行上再添一重過錯或指控，形容情況更加惡劣或責任加重。
explanation_english: Indicates that an existing wrongdoing or offense is made more serious, or another offense is added; used to describe an aggravation of guilt or worsening of the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔單止犯咗一宗罪，仲喺事後隱瞞證據，真係罪加一等。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 daan1 zi2 faan6 zo2 jat1 zung1 zeoi6, zung6 hai6 si6 hau6 jan2 maan4 zing3 geoi3, zan1 hai6 zeoi6 gaa1 jat1 dang2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不但犯了一宗罪，還在事後隱瞞證據，真是罪上加罪。
examples.english_sentence: Not only did he commit a crime, but he also hid the evidence afterward — that's truly making the offense even worse.

mandarin_meaning: 指對某人所提出或指控的犯罪名稱或罪行
english_meaning: a charge or accusation of a crime; the name of an alleged offense
explanation_mandarin: 指控某人犯下的具體罪行或檢方提出的罪狀名稱，可用於法律語境如起訴、檢控等。
