examples.mandarin_sentence: 美術展下個月在藝術館舉行。
examples.english_sentence: The art exhibition will be held at the art gallery next month.

mandarin_meaning: 美观；外觀好看、悅目
english_meaning: aesthetically pleasing; pleasing to the eye; attractive in appearance
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容事物外觀好看、讓人覺得賞心悅目的樣子，常用於描述設計、裝飾或外觀。
explanation_english: Used to describe something whose appearance is pleasing or attractive; often applied to design, decoration, or general appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫好美觀，擺喺客廳啱晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 hou2 mei5 gwaan1, baai2 hai2 haak3 teng1 aam1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画很美观，摆在客厅很合适。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is very aesthetically pleasing; it fits well in the living room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個包裝設計唔夠美觀，顧客可能唔會買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 baau1 zong1 cit3 gai3 m4 gau3 mei5 gwaan1, gu3 haak3 ho2 nang4 m4 wui5 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个包装设计不够美观，顾客可能不会买。
examples.english_sentence: This packaging design isn't attractive enough; customers might not buy it.

mandarin_meaning: 美好的故事；值得傳頌的軼事或佳話
english_meaning: a beautiful tale; a noteworthy or praise-worthy anecdote; a pleasant story often retold
explanation_mandarin: 指值得讚賞或傳頌的美好故事或軼事，常用來形容令人感到溫馨、可喜或值得傳頌的經歷。
explanation_english: Refers to a pleasant or noteworthy story/anecdote worth praising or retelling; often describes warm, admirable, or exemplary experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚嘅經歷真係一段美談。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 ge3 ging1 lik6 zan1 hai6 jat1 dyun6 mei5 taam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們結婚的經歷真是一段美談。
examples.english_sentence: Their marriage story is truly a beautiful tale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫助鄰居嗰件事成為街坊嘅美談。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 zo6 leon4 geoi1 go2 gin6 si6 sing4 wai4 gaai1 fong1 ge3 mei5 taam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他幫助鄰居的那件事成了街坊的美談。
examples.english_sentence: The thing he did to help his neighbor became the neighborhood's favorite story.

mandarin_meaning: 美誉（受到称赞的名声）
english_meaning: good reputation; high praise; acclaim
explanation_mandarin: 指受到讚譽的名聲或榮譽，表示外界對人、機構或事物的高度評價。
explanation_english: Refers to a favorable reputation or high praise given to a person, organization, or thing, indicating high regard from others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司喺業界享有好高嘅美譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 hai2 jip6 gaai3 hoeng2 jau5 hou2 gou1 ge3 mei5 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司在业界享有很高的美誉。
examples.english_sentence: This company enjoys a high reputation in the industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢憑住多年努力，贏得咗社會上嘅美譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 zyu6 do1 nin4 nou5 lik6, jing4 dak1 zo2 se5 wui6 soeng6 ge3 mei5 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他凭借多年的努力，赢得了社会的美誉。
examples.english_sentence: He has, through many years of effort, won wide acclaim from society.

mandarin_meaning: 美貌（měimào）：容貌美麗，外表美
english_meaning: beauty; attractive appearance; good looks
explanation_mandarin: 指外表的美麗或姣好的容貌，常用來描述一個人的長相吸引人。
explanation_english: Refers to an attractive physical appearance or pleasing facial features; used to describe someone's good looks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅美貌令人印象深刻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mei5 mou6 ling6 jan4 jan3 soeng2 sam1 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的美貌令人印象深刻。
examples.english_sentence: Her beauty leaves a deep impression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美貌唔係人生最重要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 mou6 m4 hai6 jan4 sang1 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美貌不是人生中最重要的東西。
examples.english_sentence: Beauty is not the most important thing in life.

mandarin_meaning: 美资（由美国出资、投资或控股的）
english_meaning: US-funded; American-capital (referring to companies, institutions, or assets financed or controlled by U.S. capital)
explanation_mandarin: 指由美國資金投資、出資或控股的公司、機構或資產，常用於描述企業的資本來源，如「美資公司」。可作名詞或定語使用。
explanation_english: Refers to companies, institutions, or assets funded, invested in, or controlled by American (U.S.) capital. Commonly used to describe the source of capital (e.g., 'a US-funded company'). Can function as a noun or attributive descriptor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間係一間美資公司，員工待遇幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hai6 jat1 gaan1 mei5 zi1 gung1 si1, jyun4 gung1 doi6 jyu6 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一家美资公司，员工待遇挺好。
examples.english_sentence: This is a US-funded company; the employee benefits are quite good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺一間美資銀行做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jat1 gaan1 mei5 zi1 ngan4 hong4 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一家美资银行当经理。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a manager at a US-funded bank.

mandarin_meaning: 形容建築、裝潢或陳設華美壯觀
english_meaning: describing something as magnificent, splendid, ornate, or grand in appearance
explanation_mandarin: 「美輪美奐」是四字成語，用來形容建築、裝飾或陳設等非常華麗、宏偉、壯觀。
explanation_english: A four-character idiom used to describe buildings, decorations, or arrangements that are exceptionally beautiful, splendid, and grand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座新博物館真係美輪美奐，吸引咗好多人嚟睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 san1 bok3 mat6 gun2 zan1 hai6 mei5 leon4 mei5 wun6, kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 lai4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座新博物馆真是美轮美奂，吸引了很多人来参观。
examples.english_sentence: This new museum is truly magnificent, attracting many visitors.

mandarin_meaning: 美元
english_meaning: US dollar (United States dollar)
explanation_mandarin: 指美國的貨幣──美元。「美金」為口語常用說法，臺灣話中也常用此稱呼。
explanation_english: Refers to the currency of the United States — the US dollar (USD). «美金» is a colloquial term commonly used in Cantonese and in Taiwanese Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可以用美金付款嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 ji5 jung6 mei5 gam1 fuk6 fun2 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以用美金付款嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can I pay with US dollars?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫要一百美金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jiu3 jat1 baak3 mei5 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服要一百美金。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt costs one hundred US dollars.

mandarin_meaning: 美元鈔票；美國的紙幣
english_meaning: US dollar banknotes; American paper money (cash)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，指美國流通的紙幣（美元鈔票）。在香港日常對話中常用以稱呼美金現鈔。
explanation_english: A colloquial term referring to American paper money (US dollar banknotes). Commonly used in Hong Kong speech to refer to physical US dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街記得帶少少美鈔備用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 siu2 siu2 mei5 cau1 bei6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門記得帶一些美鈔備用。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring some US dollars (cash) when you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 美颜 (měiyán)；美化容貌的功能或效果
english_meaning: beautify face; beauty enhancement (e.g., beauty filter or beautification feature)
explanation_mandarin: 指使容貌看起來更好看的功能或效果，常見於相機、美顏App或化妝相關描述。
explanation_english: Refers to making the face look more attractive — a feature or effect (such as a camera filter or app) that enhances appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部手機有美顏功能，自拍好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 sau2 gei1 jau5 mei5 ngaan4 gung1 nang4, zi6 paak3 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機有美顏功能，自拍很方便。
examples.english_sentence: This phone has a beauty mode, so taking selfies is very convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇化妝，但用咗美顏功能，張相都幾好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 faa3 zong1, daan6 jung6 zo2 mei5 ngaan4 gung1 nang4, zoeng1 soeng2 dou1 gei2 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天沒化妝，但用了美顏功能，照片也挺好看的。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't wear makeup today, but I used the beauty feature and the photos looked quite good.

mandarin_meaning: 美食 (měishí)
english_meaning: delicacies; gourmet food; delicious food
explanation_mandarin: 指味道很好或烹調精緻的食物，也可泛指具有地方特色或高品質的菜餚與飲食文化。
explanation_english: Refers to tasty or well-prepared food, delicacies, or gourmet dishes; can also broadly denote local specialty foods or high-quality cuisine and food culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港街市有好多地道美食，一定要試下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 gaai1 si5 jau5 hou2 do1 dei6 dou6 mei5 sik6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港街市有很多地道的美食，一定要试一试。
examples.english_sentence: There are many authentic delicacies at Hong Kong's street markets; you must try them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去旺角搵啲好嘅美食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 wong6 gok3 wan2 di1 hou2 ge3 mei5 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去旺角找些好的美食吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Mong Kok tonight to find some good food.

mandarin_meaning: 美食广场（购物中心或商场内的美食集中区）
english_meaning: food court (a communal dining area in a mall with multiple food stalls)
explanation_mandarin: 指位於商場或購物中心內，集合多家餐飲檔口或小吃店、並有共享座位的公共用餐區，選擇多樣且方便顧客用餐。
explanation_english: Refers to a communal dining area inside a mall or shopping center that contains multiple food stalls or small restaurants, usually with shared seating and a wide selection of dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去購物中心嘅美食廣場食晏啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 gau3 mat6 zung1 sam1 ge3 mei5 sik6 gwong2 coeng4 sik6 ngaan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們去購物中心的美食廣場吃午飯吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the mall's food court for lunch.

mandarin_meaning: 美丽 (měilì)
english_meaning: beautiful; pretty; lovely
explanation_mandarin: 表示外表或事物好看、悦目，可用于形容人、风景或事物，语气较为书面或正式。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as attractive, pleasing to the eye; can refer to people, scenery, or things. Relatively formal in tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日好美麗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 mei5 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天很美丽。
examples.english_sentence: You look very beautiful today.

mandarin_meaning: 美点双辉：两件美好的事情同时发生，互相衬托、相得益彰，常用于祝贺或称赞。
english_meaning: Two good things happen at the same time and complement each other; often used to congratulate or praise.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 片語（祝賀用語）
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容兩件喜事或優點同時出現，彼此映襯，使整體更為美好，常見於賀詞或稱讚語境。
explanation_english: Describes two favorable events or qualities occurring simultaneously that enhance each other; commonly used in congratulatory messages or to praise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試考到第一，仲攞到獎學金，真係美點雙輝！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dou3 dai6 jat1, zung6 lo2 dou3 zoeng2 hok6 gam1, zan1 hai6 mei5 dim2 soeng1 fai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這次考試考到第一，還拿到了獎學金，真是美點雙輝！
examples.english_sentence: He came first in the exam and also received a scholarship — truly a case of two blessings at once!

mandarin_meaning: 羔（羔羊），小羊
english_meaning: lamb; young sheep
explanation_mandarin: 「羔」指幼小的羊，常見於合成詞如「羔羊」、「羔羊肉」。文書或書面語中常見。
explanation_english: Refers to a young sheep (lamb). Often appears in compounds such as 羔羊 (lamb) or 羔羊肉 (lamb meat). Mainly a noun, used in written and compound forms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚煮羔羊肉，一齊嚟食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 zyu2 gou1 joeng4 juk6, jat1 cai4 lai4 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們今晚煮羔羊肉，一起吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: We're cooking lamb tonight — let's eat together.

mandarin_meaning: 羔羊（幼羊）
english_meaning: lamb (young sheep); figuratively an innocent or sacrificial person
explanation_mandarin: 指年幼的羊，也可用來比喻天真無辜或被犧牲的人（如“替罪羔羊”）。
explanation_english: Refers to a young sheep (lamb). Can also be used figuratively to mean an innocent or someone sacrificed for others (e.g., "scapegoat" or "sacrificial lamb").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隻羔羊好可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zek3 gou1 joeng4 hou2 ho2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只羔羊很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: That lamb is very cute.

mandarin_meaning: 羚（常見於複合詞如「羚羊」）指一類小至中等的有蹄草食動物，通常指羚羊或羚鹿
english_meaning: Refers to antelope or gazelle (often appears in compounds like '羚羊'); a small- to medium-sized hoofed herbivorous mammal
explanation_mandarin: 「羚」字常用於與「羊」「鹿」等字組成「羚羊」「羚鹿」，指一類生活於山地或草原的有蹄動物。單字在口語中較少單獨使用，多見於書面或動物名稱中。
explanation_english: The character '羚' is typically used in compounds such as '羚羊' (antelope) or '羚鹿' and denotes a group of hoofed mammals found in mountains or grasslands. The single character is uncommon in everyday speech and usually appears in names or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺山上見到一隻羚羊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 saan1 soeng6 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 ling4 joeng4。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在山上看到一只羚羊。
examples.english_sentence: I saw an antelope on the mountain.

mandarin_meaning: 羚羊 (língyáng)
english_meaning: antelope
explanation_mandarin: 一种生活在草原、山地或半沙漠地区的反刍哺乳动物，属偶蹄目，多数体态轻盈，善于奔跑与跳跃。
explanation_english: A ruminant mammal found in grasslands, mountains, or semi-desert areas; an even-toed ungulate, typically agile and fast-moving (antelope).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺動物園見到一隻羚羊，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dung6 mat6 jyun4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 ling4 joeng4, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在动物园看到一只羚羊，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: I saw an antelope at the zoo; it was so cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 羚羊喺草原上奔跑得好快，幾乎追唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ling4 joeng4 hai2 cou2 jyun4 soeng6 ban1 paau2 dak1 hou2 faai3, gei2 fu1 zeoi1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 羚羊在草原上奔跑得很快，几乎追不到。
examples.english_sentence: The antelope runs very fast across the grassland; it's almost impossible to catch.

mandarin_meaning: 羞 / 羞愧、害羞
english_meaning: shy; ashamed; embarrassed
explanation_mandarin: 表示害羞或覺得羞愧、不好意思的情緒。常見於「害羞」「羞愧」等詞語中，也可用於書面或複合詞。
explanation_english: Denotes feeling shy, ashamed, or embarrassed. Commonly appears in compounds like "害羞" (be shy) and "羞愧" (be ashamed); used in both written and compound forms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢答錯問題，面紅耳赤，好羞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daap3 co3 man6 tai4, min6 hung4 ji5 cek3, hou2 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答錯問題，臉紅耳赤，很害羞。
examples.english_sentence: He answered the question incorrectly, turned beet-red, and felt very embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為自己嘅行為感到羞愧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zi6 ge3 hang4 wai4 gam2 dou3 sau1 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為自己的行為感到羞愧。
examples.english_sentence: He felt ashamed of his own behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路第一次上台會好害羞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 dai6 jat6 ci3 soeng5 toi4 wui5 hou2 hoi6 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子第一次上台會很害羞。
examples.english_sentence: Children are usually very shy the first time they go on stage.

mandarin_meaning: 害羞；覺得不好意思
english_meaning: to feel shy or embarrassed; to be bashful
explanation_mandarin: 「羞家」是廣東話的口語/俚語用法，表示感到害羞或不好意思，常用於自謙或被人逗笑時的反應。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to feel shy or embarrassed. Often used in casual speech as a self-deprecating or bashful response.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁講，我都羞家喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 dou1 sau1 gaa1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼說，我也覺得害羞了。
examples.english_sentence: If you say that, I feel shy too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當眾讚我，我有啲羞家，唔知點回應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong1 zung3 zaan3 ngo5, ngo5 jau5 di1 sau1 gaa1, m4 zi1 dim2 wui4 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他當眾稱讚我，我有點害羞，不知道怎麼回應。
examples.english_sentence: He praised me in front of everyone; I was a bit embarrassed and didn't know how to respond.

mandarin_meaning: 羞耻 (xiūchǐ)
english_meaning: shame; feeling ashamed; embarrassment
explanation_mandarin: 表示因為做錯事、失體面或受到侮辱而感到難堪、尷尬或羞愧的情緒。
explanation_english: Indicates the feeling of shame or embarrassment when one has done something wrong, lost face, or been humiliated; feeling ashamed or mortified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯嘢，覺得好羞恥，唔敢見人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 je5, gok3 dak1 hou2 sau1 ci2, m4 gam2 gin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做錯事，覺得很羞恥，不敢見人。
examples.english_sentence: He did something wrong and felt very ashamed, not daring to face people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你公開批評朋友，會令佢覺得羞恥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gung1 hoi1 pai1 ping4 pang4 jau5, wui5 ling6 keoi5 gok3 dak1 sau1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你公開批評朋友，會讓他覺得羞恥。
examples.english_sentence: If you publicly criticize a friend, it'll make them feel ashamed.

mandarin_meaning: 感到羞恥、慚愧
english_meaning: ashamed; feeling guilty and embarrassed
explanation_mandarin: 表示因為自己的過錯或失誤而感到臉紅或內心不安、覺得慚愧、羞恥。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of shame or guilt arising from a mistake or wrongdoing; feeling embarrassed and remorseful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為咁做感到好羞愧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai6 gam2 zou6 gam2 dou3 hou2 sau1 kwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我為這樣做感到很羞愧。
examples.english_sentence: I feel very ashamed for doing that.

mandarin_meaning: 羞辱；使蒙羞、侮辱
english_meaning: to humiliate; to shame; to insult
explanation_mandarin: 指用言語或行為使別人感到羞愧、喪失尊嚴或被侮辱。
explanation_english: To cause someone to feel ashamed, lose dignity, or be insulted through words or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當住大家嘅面羞辱咗我，令我好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong3 zyu6 daai6 gaa1 ge3 min6 sau1 juk6 zo2 ngo5, ling6 ngo5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他當著大家的面羞辱了我，讓我很不開心。
examples.english_sentence: He humiliated me in front of everyone, which made me very upset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用言語羞辱細路，否則會傷害佢嘅自尊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung6 jin4 jyu5 sau1 juk6 sai3 lou6, fau2 zak1 wui5 soeng1 hoi6 keoi5 ge3 zi6 zyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用言語羞辱孩子，否則會傷害他的自尊心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't humiliate children with words; otherwise you'll hurt their self-esteem.

mandarin_meaning: 羡慕／羨慕（对他人的境遇、才能、财物等表示羡慕）
english_meaning: to envy; to admire; to feel envious
explanation_mandarin: 表示对别人拥有的事物、境遇或才能感到希望自己也有，带有羡慕或佩服的意味。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of envy or admiration toward someone else's possessions, situation, or abilities — wishing to have the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好羡慕你有咁多假期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 sin6 mou6 nei5 jau5 gam2 do1 gaa3 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很羡慕你有这么多假期。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really envious that you have so many holidays.

mandarin_meaning: 羡慕 (xiànmù)
english_meaning: to envy; to admire; to feel envious
explanation_mandarin: 表示對他人擁有的東西、境遇或能力產生羡慕、想要的情感，常用作動詞。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of envy or admiration toward someone else's possessions, situation, or abilities; commonly used as a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好羡慕你成日有假可以去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 sin3 mou6 nei5 sing4 jat6 jau5 gaa3 ho2 ji5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很羡慕你經常有假期可以去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really envious that you often have time off to travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢新買嗰部電話，好多人都羡慕佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 maai5 go2 bou6 din6 waa2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 sin3 mou6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛買了那部手機，很多人都很羡慕他。
examples.english_sentence: He just bought that phone; many people envy him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好羡慕佢，努力做好自己啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sin3 mou6 keoi5, nou5 lik6 zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要羡慕他，努力把自己做好吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't envy him; work hard and focus on improving yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 群 (qún) — 群体；一群人或动物
english_meaning: group; crowd; flock; cluster
explanation_mandarin: “羣”是“群”的異體字，用於書面或古文，表示動物、人或事物的集合。
explanation_english: “羣” is a variant form of the character 群. It denotes a group, flock, crowd, or collection of animals, people, or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有一羣鴨喺游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 kwan4 ngaap3 hai2 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公園裡有一群鴨在游水。
examples.english_sentence: There is a group of ducks swimming in the park.

mandarin_meaning: 群；一群、群體（人或動物、事物的集合）
english_meaning: group; crowd; flock; collective
explanation_mandarin: 「羣」表示多人或多個事物聚集成的集合體，常用於複合詞，如羣眾、羣體、羣集。此字為「群」的異體字或書寫變體。
explanation_english: Indicates a group or collection of people, animals, or things. Commonly used in compounds (e.g., 羣眾, 羣體). This character is a variant form of 群.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有一羣小朋友喺度玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun2 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 kwan4 siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 dou6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公園裡有一群小朋友在玩。
examples.english_sentence: There is a group of children playing in the park.

mandarin_meaning: 群像剧 (qúnxiàngjù)
english_meaning: ensemble drama; drama with an ensemble cast
explanation_mandarin: 指以多位主要角色為中心、刻畫不同人物群體或階層命運與關係的戲劇體裁，並非單一主角主導的劇作。
explanation_english: A drama genre that focuses on multiple principal characters — an ensemble cast — portraying the lives, relationships, or destinies of a group rather than a single protagonist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇係一齣羣像劇，描寫唔同階層嘅人物命運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 hai6 jat1 ceot1 kwan4 zoeng6 kek6, miu4 se2 m4 tung4 gaai1 cang4 ge3 jan4 mat6 ming6 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部剧是一部群像剧，描写不同阶层的人物命运。
examples.english_sentence: This series is an ensemble drama that depicts the fates of characters from different social classes.

mandarin_meaning: 聚在一起／一夥兒（常帶有湊合、圍攻或一起做某事的意思）
english_meaning: to gather together; to gang up (on someone); to cluster together
explanation_mandarin: 「羣埋」是廣東話口語用法，常用來表示一群人聚在一起（可中性），或多人合力針對／圍攻某人（帶負面含義）。星號表示後面可接動詞或方向詞（如「羣埋鬧」、「羣埋嚟」）。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning to gather together or cluster; often used to describe people ganging up on someone or assembling together. The asterisk indicates it can be followed by verbs or direction words (e.g., "羣埋鬧", "羣埋嚟").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人又羣埋鬧佢，真係唔公平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 jau6 kwan4 maai4 nau6 keoi5, zan1 hai6 m4 gung1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些人又聚在一起骂他，真的不公平。
examples.english_sentence: They ganged up and scolded him again; it's really unfair.

mandarin_meaning: 群島 (qúndǎo)
english_meaning: archipelago; a group or chain of islands
explanation_mandarin: 指由多個島嶼組成的地理單元，通常位於海洋或海域，形成相互靠近的一組島嶼。
explanation_english: A geographic unit made up of multiple islands, typically located in a sea or ocean; a group or chain of islands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 附近嗰片海域係一個羣島，由好多細小島嶼組成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 gan6 go2 pin3 hoi2 wik6 hai6 jat1 go3 kwan4 dou2, jau4 hou2 do1 sai3 siu2 dou2 jyu5 zou2 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 附近的海域是一個群島，由許多小島組成。
examples.english_sentence: The nearby sea area is an archipelago, made up of many small islands.

mandarin_meaning: 群島；由多個島嶼組成的島群
english_meaning: archipelago; a group or chain of islands
explanation_mandarin: 指由多個島嶼構成的一個島群，常用於地理或旅遊描述。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of islands (an archipelago); commonly used in geographic or travel contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度一帶有好幾個羣島，適合去旅行同潛水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jat1 daai3 jau5 hou2 gei2 go3 kwan4 dou2, sik1 hap6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 tung4 cim4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這一帶有好幾個群島，適合去旅行和潛水。
examples.english_sentence: There are several islands in this area; it's suitable for traveling and diving.

mandarin_meaning: 群情汹涌（形容公眾情緒高漲或激烈，常指民眾不滿或抗議情緒）
english_meaning: public sentiment surging; widespread public unrest or outcry (describes strong, rising emotions or indignation among the public)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容大量人民或群體的情緒激烈高漲，常見於描述民眾對某事不滿、抗議或強烈關注的情況。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where public feelings are intense and rising, often used for widespread dissatisfaction, protests, or a strong public outcry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢項政策公布後，市民群情洶湧，上街示威。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 hong6 zing3 caak3 gung1 bou3 hau6, si5 man4 kwan4 cing4 hung1 jung2, soeng5 gaai1 si6 wai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这项政策公布后，市民群情汹涌，上街示威。
examples.english_sentence: After the policy was announced, public sentiment surged and people took to the streets to protest.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）一群人合力抓住、圍住或針對某人；群起而攻之
english_meaning: Colloquial/slang for a group ganging up on, grabbing, or mobbing someone
explanation_mandarin: 口語/俚語，用來形容多數人一起合力圍住、抓住、欺負或攻擊某個人，帶有群體性施暴或針對的意思。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang phrase describing a group of people jointly grabbing, surrounding, bullying, or attacking someone — i.e., to mob or gang up on someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人羣揪，成班人一齊揪住佢，佢唔敢還手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 kwan4 zau1, seng4 baan1 jan4 jat1 cai4 zau1 zyu6 keoi5, keoi5 m4 gam2 waan4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人群起揪住，成群的人一起抓住他，他不敢還手。
examples.english_sentence: He was mobbed — a group of people grabbed him together, and he didn't dare to fight back.

mandarin_meaning: 群星拱照（qún xīng gǒng zhào）：字面為眾多星辰簇擁照耀，常用來形容群星聚集、名人雲集或場面光彩奪目。
english_meaning: Literally 'a host of stars bow and shine'; an idiom describing a scene filled with stars (celebrities) or a dazzling gathering where many notable people converge.
explanation_mandarin: 成語，原指眾多星辰環繞照耀。現多用來形容某個活動或場合名人雲集、熱鬧輝煌，或用於比喻有眾多傑出人物圍繞某人或某事。
explanation_english: An idiom originally referring to many stars shining together. It is commonly used to describe events or occasions crowded with celebrities, a glittering scene, or metaphorically a situation where many distinguished people gather around someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺電影首映禮上，群星拱照，成晚都有明星圍住佢影相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 din6 jing2 sau2 jing2 lai5 soeng6, kwan4 sing1 gung2 ziu3, sing4 maan5 dou1 jau5 ming4 sing1 wai4 zyu6 keoi5 jing2 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在電影首映禮上，群星拱照，整晚都有明星圍著他拍照。
examples.english_sentence: At the film premiere he was surrounded by stars; celebrities kept crowding around him taking photos all night.

mandarin_meaning: 群殴 (qún'ōu)
english_meaning: mob beating; group assault; gang brawl
explanation_mandarin: 指多數人聚集起來毆打一人或多人，含有暴力、聚衆鬥毆的意思，常見於新聞或法律語境。
explanation_english: Refers to multiple people gathering to beat one or more persons; implies a violent group assault or brawl. Commonly used in news reports or legal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚喺夜市發生咗一宗群毆，幾個人受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok6 maan5 hai2 je6 si5 fat1 saang1 zo2 jat1 zung1 kwan4 au3, gei2 go3 jan4 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚在夜市发生了一起群殴，几个人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: Last night a mob brawl occurred at the night market; several people were injured.

mandarin_meaning: 群眾（指一般民眾或聚集的人群）
english_meaning: the masses; a crowd; the public
explanation_mandarin: 指一般民眾或在某處聚集的一群人，常用於正式語境或新聞報導。
explanation_english: Refers to the general public or a group of people gathered in a place; commonly used in formal contexts or news reporting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚大批羣眾喺廣場示威，警方到場維持秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 daai6 pat1 kwan4 zung3 hai6 gwong2 coeng4 si6 wai1, ging2 fong1 dou3 coeng4 wai4 ci4 zat6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚大量群眾在廣場示威，警方到場維持秩序。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight a large crowd is protesting in the square; the police arrived to maintain order.

mandarin_meaning: 群众（大多数人民或公众）
english_meaning: the masses; the crowd; the public
explanation_mandarin: 指大量的人民或群体，常用于描述公众或在某事件中聚集的人群。
explanation_english: Refers to a large group of people — the masses or public; often used to describe people collectively, especially those gathered at an event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 示威期間，羣眾在街上高喊口號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 wai1 kei4 gaan3, kwan4 zung3 zoi6 gaai1 soeng6 gou1 haam3 hau2 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 示威期间，群众在街上高喊口号。
examples.english_sentence: During the protest, the masses were chanting slogans on the street.

mandarin_meaning: 群众压力（qúnzhòng yālì），指来自公众或群体的舆论或社会压力
english_meaning: public pressure; crowd or social pressure that pushes individuals to conform (similar to peer/social pressure)
explanation_mandarin: 指來自群體或公眾的壓力，讓個人感到必須順從、改變行為或想法的心理或社會壓力，常見於社交媒體、群體討論或公共場合。
explanation_english: Pressure coming from a crowd or the public that makes an individual feel compelled to conform or change behaviour or opinions; often appears in social media, group settings, or public discourse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺社交媒體上，大家嘅留言有時會造成好大嘅羣眾壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 soeng6, daai6 gaa1 ge3 lau4 jin4 jau5 si4 wui5 zou6 cing4 hou2 daai6 ge3 kwan4 zung3 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在社交媒体上，大家的留言有时会造成很大的群众压力。
examples.english_sentence: On social media, people's comments can sometimes create a lot of public pressure.

mandarin_meaning: 众人出谋划策、共同努力
english_meaning: Everyone contributes ideas and works together to achieve a goal
explanation_mandarin: 表示大家一起出主意、共同努力解决问题或完成任务。
explanation_english: Expresses that people pool ideas and combine efforts to solve a problem or complete a task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目成功，多得大家羣策羣力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 sing4 gung1, do1 dak1 daai6 gaa1 kwan4 caak3 kwan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目成功，多亏大家群策群力。
examples.english_sentence: This project succeeded thanks to everyone contributing ideas and working together.

mandarin_meaning: 群组（聊天或討論的小組）
english_meaning: group (e.g., chat group or discussion group)
explanation_mandarin: 指線上或線下的一個群體或小組，常用來指聊天群組、討論群或工作協作群。
explanation_english: Refers to a group or small team, online or offline; commonly used for chat groups, discussion groups, or collaboration groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺WhatsApp有個羣組，成日喺度傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 WhatsApp jau5 go3 kwan4 zou2, sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在WhatsApp有一个群组，经常在里面聊天。
examples.english_sentence: We have a group on WhatsApp and often chat there.

mandarin_meaning: 群组（如聊天群、組織分組）
english_meaning: group; group (e.g., chat group or organizational grouping)
explanation_mandarin: 指由多人或多個單位組成的一個集合體，常用於聊天群、討論群或分類分組等情境。
explanation_english: Refers to a collection of people or units grouped together; commonly used for chat groups, discussion groups, or organizational/grouping contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你已經加入嗰個群組未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 ging1 gaa1 jap6 go2 go3 kwan4 zou2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你已經加入那個群組了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Have you already joined that group?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以喺群組入面傳送文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 hai2 kwan4 zou2 jap6 min6 cyun4 sung3 man4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們可以在群組裡面傳送文件。
examples.english_sentence: We can send files within the group.

mandarin_meaning: 群英（qún yīng）：一群英才或傑出人物，常指各界翹楚聚集。
english_meaning: a group of outstanding people or heroes; leading figures or elites gathered together.
explanation_mandarin: “羣英”用於書面或正式語境，指一群優秀或有影響力的人物，常見於“群英會”等詞組，表示各界精英齊聚。
explanation_english: Used in formal or written contexts to refer to a group of outstanding or influential people. Often appears in compounds like “群英會” meaning a gathering of elites or celebrated figures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅論壇聚集咗政界、商界嘅羣英，一齊討論經濟前景。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 leon4 taan4 zeoi6 zaap6 zo2 zing3 gaai3, soeng1 gaai3 ge3 kwan4 jing1, jat1 cai4 tou2 leon6 ging1 zai3 cin4 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的论坛聚集了政界、商界的群英，一起讨论经济前景。
examples.english_sentence: This forum brought together leading figures from politics and business to discuss the economic outlook.

mandarin_meaning: 群眾
english_meaning: the masses; the crowd; the public
explanation_mandarin: 指廣泛的人民或在某一場合聚集的一群人，常用於描述公眾、群體或支持者。
explanation_english: Refers to the general public or a crowd gathered in a place; commonly used to describe the masses, a group of people, or supporters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方呼籲羣衆保持冷靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 fu1 jyu1 kwan4 zung3 bou2 ci4 laang5 zing6 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方呼籲群眾保持冷靜。
examples.english_sentence: The police urged the crowd to remain calm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個活動吸引咗好多羣衆參加。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wut6 dung6 kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 kwan4 zung3 caam1 gaa1 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個活動吸引了很多群眾參加。
examples.english_sentence: The event attracted many people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好忽視基層羣衆嘅聲音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fat1 si6 gei1 cang4 kwan4 zung3 ge3 sing1 jam1 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要忽視基層群眾的聲音。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ignore the voices of the grassroots public.

mandarin_meaning: 群眾壓力（來自大眾或同儕的壓力）
english_meaning: crowd pressure; public/social pressure; peer pressure
explanation_mandarin: 指來自群眾、社會或同儕的壓力，可能迫使個人改變行為、言論或決定，常用於描述社會或人際環境對個人的影響。
explanation_english: Refers to pressure coming from the crowd, the public, society, or peers that may push an individual to change their behavior, opinions, or decisions. Often used to describe social or interpersonal influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為羣衆壓力而改變咗主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 kwan4 zung3 aat3 lik6 ji4 goi2 bin3 zo2 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為群眾壓力而改變了主意。
examples.english_sentence: He changed his mind because of crowd pressure.

mandarin_meaning: 群雄（qúnxióng）：许多英雄或有实力的人物，比喻多方势力并立、争夺霸权。
english_meaning: a group of powerful figures or heroes; many contenders vying for supremacy; rival forces.
explanation_mandarin: “羣雄”常用于成语或书面语中，表示许多有实力的人物并立或互相争夺，常见搭配如“羣雄逐鹿”、“羣雄并起”。
explanation_english: Used in literary or idiomatic contexts to refer to many powerful figures or contenders standing against each other, often used in phrases like '羣雄逐鹿' (many contenders vie for supremacy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個行業入面，羣雄逐鹿，競爭非常激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai6 nei1 go3 hong4 jip6 jap6 min6, gwan4 hung4 zuk6 luk6, ging6 zang1 fei1 soeng4 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个行业里，群雄逐鹿，竞争非常激烈。
examples.english_sentence: In this industry, numerous contenders are vying for dominance; the competition is very intense.

mandarin_meaning: 群雄 (qúnxióng)：各路英雄或強勁的競爭者
english_meaning: many heroes/contenders; powerful figures or rivals competing for supremacy
explanation_mandarin: 指各路英雄或有實力的人物並起，形容競爭者眾多且實力強勁，常用於描述各方勢力或人物爭奪霸主地位或同場競爭的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to various heroes or powerful figures rising up; describes many strong contenders competing with one another. Often used to depict rival forces or individuals vying for dominance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年電競界群雄並起，各隊實力相當，賽事越嚟越難預料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 din6 ging1 gaai3 kwan4 hung4 bing6 hei2, gok3 deoi6 sat6 lik6 soeng1 dong3, coi3 si6 jyut6 lei4 jyut6 naan4 jyu6 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年电竞界群雄并起，各队实力相当，赛事越来越难预料。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years many strong contenders have emerged in the esports scene; each team is quite powerful, and matches have become increasingly unpredictable.

mandarin_meaning: 群体 (qúntǐ)：由多個個體組成的集合；集體。
english_meaning: Group; collective — a collection of individuals or entities considered as a single unit.
explanation_mandarin: 指由多個人或事物組成的整體，強調作為一個集合體的屬性或利益，例如社會群體、動物群體或功能性群體。
explanation_english: Refers to a collection of people, animals, or things considered as a single unit; emphasizes collective attributes, identity, or interests (e.g., social groups, biological groups).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會上好多問題都牽涉到唔同羣體嘅利益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui6 soeng6 hou2 do1 man6 tai4 dou1 hin1 sip3 dou3 m4 tung4 kwan4 tai2 ge3 lei6 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会上许多问题都牵涉到不同群体的利益。
examples.english_sentence: Many social issues involve the interests of different groups.

mandarin_meaning: 群体
english_meaning: group; collective; body of people
explanation_mandarin: 指由多個個體組成，具有某些共同特徵、關係或目的的集合體，如社會群體或生物學上的群體。
explanation_english: Refers to a collection of individuals that form a unit due to shared characteristics, relationships, or purposes, such as social groups or biological populations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個多元文化嘅城市，有好多唔同嘅羣體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 do1 jyun4 man4 faa3 ge3 sing4 si5, jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 kwan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一個多元文化的城市，有很多不同的群體。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a multicultural city with many different groups.

mandarin_meaning: 群魔乱舞（形容社会动荡或邪恶势力猖獗）
english_meaning: a scene of chaos and mayhem; literally 'demons dancing wildly', used to describe rampant disorder or villains running amok
explanation_mandarin: 原指眾魔胡亂舞動，現多用來比喻社會秩序混亂、惡人或壞事猖獗。
explanation_english: Originally referred to demons dancing wildly; now used metaphorically to describe social disorder, chaotic scenes, or evil forces running rampant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家社會好亂，真係羣魔亂舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 se5 wui6 hou2 lyun6, zan1 hai6 kwan4 mo1 lyun6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在社會很混亂，真是群魔亂舞。
examples.english_sentence: Society is very chaotic right now — it's truly pandemonium.

mandarin_meaning: 群龙无首（沒有人擔任領導，缺乏統一指揮）
english_meaning: Leaderless; lacking leadership or coordination, resulting in disorder
explanation_mandarin: 原指許多龍沒有首領，比喻集體缺乏領導或指揮，大家各自為政，導致混亂或無序。
explanation_english: Originally referring to many dragons without a head; metaphorically describes a group that lacks leadership or coordination, with members acting independently and causing disorder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司而家真係羣龍無首，唔知應該由邊個負責決策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 kwan4 lung4 mou4 sau2, m4 zi1 jing1 goi1 jau4 bin1 go3 fu6 zaak3 kyut3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間公司現在真的是群龍無首，不知道應該由誰負責決策。
examples.english_sentence: This company is truly leaderless right now; we don't know who should be responsible for decision-making.

mandarin_meaning: 群龙无首（没有领导；缺乏统率，导致混乱）
english_meaning: Leaderless; lacking a head or leader—resulting in disorder or lack of direction
explanation_mandarin: 形容一群人或一個組織沒有領導或統籌，因而無法有序運作或陷入混亂。
explanation_english: Describes a group or organization that lacks a leader or coordinator, causing disorder, lack of direction, or ineffective operation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啲項目冇人統籌，搞到羣龍無首，進度好慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 di1 hong6 muk6 mou5 jan4 tung2 cau4, gaau2 dou3 kwan4 lung4 mou4 sau2, zeon3 dou6 hou2 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的项目没有人统筹，变得群龙无首，进度很慢。
examples.english_sentence: The company's projects have nobody coordinating them, so they're leaderless and progress is very slow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊教練辭咗，球員冇人帶領，場上完全係羣龍無首。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi2 gaau3 lin6 ci4 zo2, kau4 jyun4 mou5 jan4 daai3 ling5, coeng4 soeng6 jyun4 cyun4 hai6 kwan4 lung4 mou4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队教练辞了，球员没有人带领，场上完全是群龙无首。
examples.english_sentence: The team's coach resigned, there's no one to lead the players, and on the field it's completely leaderless.

mandarin_meaning: 群（表示一群人或动物；作量词表示一批、一起）
english_meaning: group; crowd; flock; herd; (used as a classifier/quantifier)
explanation_mandarin: 表示若干聚集在一起的個體（人、動物等），也可作量詞使用，表示一批、一起。
explanation_english: Denotes a collection of individuals (people, animals, etc.) gathered together; can also function as a classifier/quantifier meaning a batch or collective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有一群細路仔玩緊足球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 kwan4 sai3 lou6 zai2 waan2 gan2 zuk1 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里面有一群小朋友在踢足球。
examples.english_sentence: There is a group of kids playing football in the park.

mandarin_meaning: 群像剧（以多位主要或重要角色為焦點的戲劇類型）
english_meaning: ensemble drama (a drama focusing on an ensemble cast and their interrelationships)
explanation_mandarin: 指以多位主要或重要配角為焦點，描繪群體間關係與互動的戲劇或劇集類型，常見於電視劇或舞台劇。
explanation_english: A genre of drama (often TV series or stage plays) that centers on an ensemble cast—multiple main or significant characters—and depicts their relationships and interactions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇係一部群像劇，描寫咗唔同人物之間嘅關係同互動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 hai6 jat1 bou6 kwan4 zoeng6 kek6, miu4 se2 zo2 m4 tung4 jan4 mat6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 tung4 wu6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部劇是一部群像劇，描寫了不同人物之間的關係和互動。
examples.english_sentence: This series is an ensemble drama that depicts the relationships and interactions among different characters.

mandarin_meaning: 一起／聚在一起（通常指合夥針對、責罵或排擠某人）
english_meaning: to gather together (often to gang up on, criticize, or ostracize someone)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示一群人聚在一起，常帶負面含義，指大家合力針對或罵某人、排擠某人。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning people gather as a group; often used negatively to describe ganging up on, criticizing, or ostracizing someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成班人群埋嚟鬧佢，真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 baan1 jan4 kwan4 maai4 lai4 nau6 keoi5, zan1 hai6 deng2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一群人围着骂他，真是受不了。
examples.english_sentence: They all ganged up on him and scolded him; it's unbearable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好群埋去排擠新同事，大家要包容啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 kwan4 maai4 heoi3 paai4 zai3 san1 tung4 si6, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 baau1 jung4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要一起去排挤新同事，大家要包容一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't gang up to ostracize the new colleague; everyone should be more inclusive.

mandarin_meaning: 群岛（qún dǎo）：由许多岛屿组成的集合，常用于地理学。
english_meaning: archipelago — a group or chain of islands.
explanation_mandarin: “群岛”指由许多岛屿组成的集合体，可以是紧密成群的岛屿或沿海延伸的岛链，常用于地理描述。
explanation_english: “群島” (archipelago) refers to a group or chain of islands, either clustered together or forming an island chain; commonly used in geographic contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個暑假打算去菲律賓嘅群島旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 syu3 gaa3 daa2 syun3 heoi3 Fei1 leot6 ban1 ge3 kwan4 dou2 leoi5 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们打算下个暑假去菲律宾的群岛旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to travel to the archipelago in the Philippines next summer.

mandarin_meaning: 群眾情緒高漲，怒氣或激動的情緒湧現
english_meaning: public sentiment surging; widespread agitation or intense public outcry
explanation_mandarin: 形容眾人的情緒激昂、憤怒或憂慮等情緒像潮水般湧現，通常用來描述社會或群體對某事強烈反應。
explanation_english: Describes a situation in which the emotions of the masses — anger, agitation, or strong concern — surge like a tide; used to describe strong public reaction to an issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事曝光之後，社交媒體上群情洶湧，大家都好憤怒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 baau1 gwong3 zi1 hau6, se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 soeng6 kwan4 cing4 hung1 jung5, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 fan5 nou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事曝光之后，社交媒体上群情汹涌，大家都很愤怒。
examples.english_sentence: After the incident was exposed, public sentiment surged on social media and everyone was very angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司裁員消息傳出之後，員工間群情洶湧，經理要開會安撫大家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 coi4 jyun4 siu1 sik1 cyun4 ceot1 zi1 hau6, yun4 gung1 gaan1 kwan4 cing4 hung1 jung5, ging1 lei5 jiu3 hoi1 wui6 on1 fu2 daai6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司裁员消息传出之后，员工之间群情汹涌，经理要开会安抚大家。
examples.english_sentence: After the company's layoff news came out, emotions among employees surged and the manager had to hold a meeting to calm everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 一群人一起欺負或攻擊某人（群起而攻之）
english_meaning: to gang up on someone; to mob or collectively target someone
explanation_mandarin: 「群揪」是廣東話口語，指多人一起圍攻、欺負或針對某人，常帶有網絡或生活中被多人攻擊的情況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang verb meaning for a group of people to gang up on, mob, or collectively attack/target someone—used for online or real-life situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日畀班同學群揪，真係好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bei2 baan1 tung4 hok6 kwan4 zau1, zan1 hai6 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常被同學群起欺負，真的很慘。
examples.english_sentence: He is often ganged up on by classmates; it's really awful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次喺討論區，啲網民群揪一個留言者，情況幾激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 hai2 tou2 leon6 keoi1, di1 mong5 man4 kwan4 zau1 jat1 go3 lau4 jim4 ze2, cing4 fong3 gei2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次在討論區，網民群起攻擊一個留言者，情況相當激烈。
examples.english_sentence: Last time on the forum, netizens ganged up on a commenter; it was quite intense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁，遇到意見不合咪群揪人，坐低講清楚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2, jyu6 dou3 ji3 gin3 bat1 hap6 mai6 kwan4 zau1 jan4, co5 dai1 gong2 cing1 co2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要這樣，遇到意見不合不要群起攻擊別人，坐下把話講清楚吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't do that; when opinions differ, don't gang up on someone—sit down and explain things clearly.

mandarin_meaning: 群星拱照（qún xīng gǒng zhào）：众多名人或显赫人物簇拥、照耀；比喻受人瞩目或场面热闹。
english_meaning: Literally 'stars surround and illuminate.' Metaphorically used to describe a scene where many celebrities or eminent people gather around someone or someplace, indicating prominence, glamour, or being the center of attention.
explanation_mandarin: 原指众多星辰环绕照耀，现多用于比喻在某个场合有许多名人或重要人物簇拥，场面热闹或某人备受瞩目。
explanation_english: Originally describes many stars surrounding and shining; now commonly used figuratively to indicate that many celebrities or important people are gathered together, creating a dazzling or high-profile scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次首映禮好熱鬧，群星拱照，紅地氈上站滿咗電影圈嘅大星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 sau2 jing2 lai5 hou2 jit6 naau6, kwan4 sing1 gung2 ziu3, hung4 dei6 zin1 soeng6 zaam6 mun5 zo2 din6 jing2 hyun1 ge3 daai6 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次首映礼很热闹，群星拱照，红毯上站满了电影圈的大牌明星。
examples.english_sentence: This premiere was lively, with stars all around—the red carpet was filled with big movie stars.

mandarin_meaning: 群殴（多人一起殴打）
english_meaning: mob assault; group beating (to beat someone up as a group)
explanation_mandarin: 指一群人合伙殴打另一个或多个人的行为，通常用于描述暴力事件。
explanation_english: Refers to an act in which a group of people assault and beat one or more persons together; commonly used to describe a violent incident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 昨晚地鐵站外發生群毆，幾個人被打傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 maan5 dei6 tit3 zaam6 ngoi6 faat3 saang1 kwan4 au1, gei2 go3 jan4 bei6 daa2 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚地铁站外发生群殴，几个人被打伤。
examples.english_sentence: A mob assault occurred outside the subway station last night; several people were injured.

mandarin_meaning: 群众
english_meaning: the masses; crowd; the public
explanation_mandarin: 指一大群人，通常指社會上的一般民眾或聚集在一起的群體，常用於描述公眾、群體行動或意見。
explanation_english: Refers to a large group of people, typically the general public or a gathered group; often used to describe public opinion, crowds, or collective actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 群眾喺政府門口集會抗議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kwan4 zung3 hai2 zing3 fu2 mun4 hau2 zaap6 wui6 kong3 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 群众在政府门口集会抗议。
examples.english_sentence: The crowd gathered at the government entrance to protest.

mandarin_meaning: 群众压力（来自公众或多数人的压力，常指舆论或社会压力）
english_meaning: public pressure; pressure from the masses; social/crowd pressure
explanation_mandarin: 指來自大眾或多數人的壓力，包含輿論、社會期望等，會影響個人或團體的決策與行為。
explanation_english: Pressure coming from the public or the masses—often in the form of public opinion or social expectations—that influences individuals' or groups' decisions and actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多時候，我哋會受群眾壓力影響而改變主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 sau6 kwan4 zung3 aat3 lik6 jing2 hoeng2 ji4 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多时候，我们会受到群众压力的影响而改变主意。
examples.english_sentence: Often we change our minds because of public pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政治上，群眾壓力可以迫使政府回應訴求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 zi6 soeng6, kwan4 zung3 aat3 lik6 ho2 ji5 bik1 si2 zing3 fu2 wui4 jing3 sou3 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在政治上，群众压力可以迫使政府回应诉求。
examples.english_sentence: In politics, public pressure can force the government to respond to demands.

mandarin_meaning: 集思廣益、大家齊心協力
english_meaning: To pool everyone's ideas and efforts; to work together collaboratively
explanation_mandarin: 指大家一起出主意、出力，共同解決問題或完成任務。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning everyone contributes ideas and effort to solve a problem or accomplish a task together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題好複雜，需要大家群策群力先至可以解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, seoi1 jiu3 daai6 gaa1 kwan4 caak3 kwan4 lik6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個問題很複雜，需要大家群策群力才能解決。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is quite complex; it requires everyone pooling ideas and efforts to solve it.

mandarin_meaning: 群组（指社交媒体或即时通讯软件中的群体/群聊）
english_meaning: group (e.g., a chat group or group on social media)
explanation_mandarin: 指由多人组成的集合，常用于描述社交平台或即时通讯中的聊天群体或某个分组（例如工作群、家庭群）。
explanation_english: Refers to a collection of people grouped together, commonly used for chat groups or groups on social media and messaging apps (e.g., work groups, family groups).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你已經加入咗個群組未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 ging1 gaa1 jap6 zo2 go3 kwan4 zou2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你已经加入群组了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you already joined the group?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以喺群組度傳相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 hai2 kwan4 zou2 dou6 cyun4 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以在群组里传照片。
examples.english_sentence: We can send photos in the group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司整咗個工作群組，專門用嚟安排項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zing2 zo2 go3 gung1 zok3 kwan4 zou2, zyun1 mun4 jung6 lai4 on1 paai4 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司建立了一个工作群组，专门用来安排项目。
examples.english_sentence: The company set up a work group to organize projects.

mandarin_meaning: 群英 (qúnyīng)：众多杰出的人物、英雄或精英
english_meaning: a group of outstanding people; elites; heroes
explanation_mandarin: 指許多傑出的人物或英雄，常用於描述聚集了很多精英的場合，如「群英荟萃」。
explanation_english: Refers to many outstanding people or heroes; often used to describe an event or occasion where numerous elites are gathered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅比賽群英雲集，競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 bei2 coi3 kwan4 jing1 wan4 zaap6, ging3 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的比赛群英荟萃，竞争非常激烈。
examples.english_sentence: This competition gathered many outstanding people; the competition is very intense.

mandarin_meaning: 群眾（普通大众、聚集的人群）
english_meaning: the masses; the crowd; the general public
explanation_mandarin: 指一大群人，常用來表示社會上的一般民眾或聚集在某處的人群。
explanation_english: Refers to a large group of people, often the general public or people gathered in a crowd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察喺集會現場控制住群眾嘅秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 hai2 zaap6 wui6 jin6 coeng4 hung3 zai3 zyu6 kwan4 zung3 ge3 zat6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察在集會現場控制住群众的秩序。
examples.english_sentence: The police maintained order among the crowd at the rally.

mandarin_meaning: 群众；大众；一大群人
english_meaning: the crowd; the masses; the public
explanation_mandarin: 指一大群人或社會大眾，常用於正式或新聞語境，強調人群或民眾整體的概念。
explanation_english: Refers to a large group of people or the general public; commonly used in formal or news contexts to emphasize the collective of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 示威期間，警方要控制好群眾的秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 wai1 kei4 gaan1, ging2 fong1 jiu3 hung3 zai3 hou2 kwan4 zung3 dik1 zat6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 示威期间，警方要控制好群众的秩序。
examples.english_sentence: During the protest, the police must maintain order among the crowd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該聽取群眾的意見，制訂更貼近民眾需要的政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 ting1 ceoi2 kwan4 zung3 dik1 ji3 gin3, zai3 ding6 gang3 tip3 gan3 man4 zung3 seoi1 jiu3 dik1 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该听取群众的意见，制订更贴近民众需要的政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government should listen to the opinions of the people and make policies that better meet public needs.

mandarin_meaning: 群眾壓力 / 群體壓力 (qúnzhòng yālì)
english_meaning: public pressure; pressure from the crowd or the masses
explanation_mandarin: 指來自大眾或一群人對個人、組織或決策施加的壓力，會影響其行為或判斷。
explanation_english: Pressure exerted by the public or a group of people that influences an individual's or group's decisions or behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為群眾壓力，佢改變咗主意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 kwan4 zung3 ngaat3 lik6, keoi5 goi2 bin3 zo2 zyu2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因為群體壓力，他改變了主意。
examples.english_sentence: Because of public pressure, he changed his mind.

mandarin_meaning: 群雄 / 许多英雄或势力并立，互相竞争的局面
english_meaning: a number of heroes or powerful figures (often rivals); competing powers; contenders
explanation_mandarin: 「群雄」指眾多有實力或地位的人物（如英雄、豪傑或勢力）並立，常用來形容競爭激烈、各方爭奪霸權的局面。
explanation_english: Refers to a group of powerful or prominent figures (heroes, leaders, factions) standing together or contending; often used to describe a situation of intense competition for dominance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個行業入面，群雄逐鹿，競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 jap6 min6, kwan4 hung4 zuk1 luk6, ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个行业里，群雄逐鹿，竞争非常激烈。
examples.english_sentence: In this industry, many rivals contend; the competition is intense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊年嘅比賽有好多強隊，真係群雄爭霸嘅舞台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 nin4 ge3 bei2 coi3 jau5 hou2 do1 koeng4 deoi6, zan1 zing3 hai6 kwan4 hung4 zaang1 baa3 ge3 mou5 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去年的比赛有很多强队，真的是群雄争霸的舞台。
examples.english_sentence: Last year's tournament had many strong teams; it was truly a stage where champions battled for supremacy.

mandarin_meaning: 群体
english_meaning: group; collective; body
explanation_mandarin: 指由多個個體組成的整體，強調這些個體具有某些共同特徵或關係，作為一個單位來看待或行動。
explanation_english: Refers to a whole made up of multiple individuals, emphasizing shared characteristics or relationships and considered or acting as a single unit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司由唔同背景嘅人組成一個群體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau4 m4 tung4 bui3 ging2 ge3 jan4 zou2 sing4 jat1 go3 kwan4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司由不同背景的人組成一個群体。
examples.english_sentence: The company is made up of people from different backgrounds, forming a group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 群體免疫可以保護較弱嘅人免受疾病侵害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kwan4 tai2 min5 jik6 ho2 ji5 bou2 wu6 gaau3 joek6 ge3 jan4 min5 sau6 zat6 beng6 cam1 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 群体免疫可以保护较弱的人免受疾病侵害。
examples.english_sentence: Herd immunity (collective immunity) can protect vulnerable people from disease.

mandarin_meaning: 群魔乱舞（形容混乱无序、恶人或坏事猖獗）
english_meaning: literally 'a host of demons dancing chaotically'; figuratively, pandemonium or utter chaos, often with evildoers running rampant
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語（名詞/形容詞性短語）
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容局面非常混亂、無秩序，常帶有邪惡勢力或壞人橫行的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a situation of extreme disorder and chaos, often implying malicious actors or wrongdoing running unchecked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次選舉搞到成個城市都群魔亂舞，假新聞同暴力事件層出不窮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syun2 geoi2 gaau2 dou3 sing4 go3 sing4 si5 dou1 kwan4 mo1 lyun6 mou5, gaa2 san1 man4 tung4 bou6 lik6 si6 gin2 cang4 ceot1 bat1 kung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次选举搞得整个城市都群魔乱舞，假新闻和暴力事件层出不穷。
examples.english_sentence: This election has plunged the whole city into pandemonium, with fake news and violent incidents emerging constantly.

mandarin_meaning: 群龙无首（没有领导、缺乏首领）
english_meaning: Leaderless; lacking a head or central leadership; in disarray
explanation_mandarin: 出自文言，字面意思是「一群龍沒有首領」。常用來形容一個團體沒有領導、缺乏指揮或組織混亂，行動無章法。
explanation_english: Literally 'a group of dragons without a head.' Used to describe a group lacking leadership or direction, resulting in disorganization or chaotic action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司最近人事變動，好多部門群龍無首，工作亂晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 jan4 si6 bin3 dung6, hou2 do1 bou6 mun4 kwan4 lung4 mou4 sau2, gung1 zok3 lyun6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近人事变动，很多部门群龙无首，工作一团糟。
examples.english_sentence: The company has had recent personnel changes; many departments are leaderless and the work is a mess.

mandarin_meaning: 羡（羡慕、嫉妒）
english_meaning: to envy; to admire (jealous/admiring feeling)
explanation_mandarin: 表示對別人的優勢或幸運感到羡慕或嫉妒。常與「羨慕」連用，口語中亦可單獨使用（如「好羨」）。
explanation_english: Expresses envy or admiration for someone else's advantage or good fortune. Commonly appears in the compound '羨慕' and can be used alone colloquially (e.g. '好羨' = 'so envious').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好羨你放咁多假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 sin6 nei5 fong3 gam2 do1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很羡慕你放这么多假。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so envious that you get so many days off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好羨啲人表面風光，佢哋都有自己嘅煩惱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sin6 di1 jan4 biu2 min6 fung1 gwong1, keoi5 dei6 dou1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 faan4 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要羡慕那些表面风光的人，他们也有自己的烦恼。
examples.english_sentence: Don't envy people who look glamorous on the surface; they have their own troubles too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日放旅行相，我真係羨死你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 fong3 leoi5 hang4 soeng2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 sin6 sei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老是发旅游照片，真让人羡慕。
examples.english_sentence: You always post travel photos—I'm so jealous.

mandarin_meaning: 羡慕 (xiànmù)；对别人的优点、成就或条件表示羡慕、希望自己也有。
english_meaning: to envy; to admire; to feel envious of someone else's qualities, achievements, possessions, or circumstances
explanation_mandarin: 對別人的優點、成就或擁有的東西感到羨慕，希望自己也能擁有或達到相似的情況。
explanation_english: To feel envy or admiration toward someone else's qualities, achievements, possessions, or circumstances, often wishing to have the same.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好羨慕佢可以成日去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 sin3 mou6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很羡慕他能經常去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really envious that he can travel often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好羨慕人哋嘅生活，做好自己就夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sin3 mou6 jan4 dei6 ge3 sang1 wut6, zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2 zau6 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要羡慕别人的生活，做好自己就够了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't envy other people's lives; focus on being your best self.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢頭先升咗職，我真係好羨慕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 sin1 sing1 zo2 zik1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sin3 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他剛剛升職了，我真的很羡慕。
examples.english_sentence: He just got promoted; I'm really envious.

mandarin_meaning: 羡慕、妒忌、怨恨（對他人的優勢或幸福產生的複雜負面情緒）
english_meaning: envy, jealousy and resentment/hatred (a complex of negative emotions toward someone else's advantage or happiness)
explanation_mandarin: 指看到別人有優勢、成就或幸福時，同時出現羨慕、妒忌乃至怨恨等混合的負面情感。
explanation_english: Refers to the mixed negative feelings—envy, jealousy and even resentment—when one sees another's advantages, achievements, or good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢咁成功，我心裏有羨慕妒忌恨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 keoi5 gam2 sing4 gung1, ngo5 sam1 leoi5 jau5 sin6 mou6 dou6 gei3 han6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他那麼成功，我心裡有羡慕、妒忌，甚至怨恨。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him so successful, I felt envy, jealousy, even resentment.

mandarin_meaning: 令人羡慕；使旁人妒羡
english_meaning: to make others envious; to inspire envy
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某物非常出色或吸引，以至於令旁人羨慕或眼紅。
explanation_english: Indicates someone or something is so outstanding or attractive that it causes others to feel envious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢新買嗰部跑車真係羨煞旁人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 maai5 go2 bou6 paau2 ce1 zan1 hai6 sin3 saat3 pong4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他新买的跑车真是羡煞旁人。
examples.english_sentence: His newly bought sports car really makes others envious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啲婚紗相影得好靚，羨煞旁人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 di1 fan1 saa1 soeng2 jing2 dak1 hou2 leng3, sin3 saat3 pong4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的婚纱照拍得很漂亮，羡煞旁人。
examples.english_sentence: Their wedding photos are so beautiful they make others envious.

mandarin_meaning: 义；正义、公义、道义，也可指义气或忠义
english_meaning: righteousness; justice; moral duty; (can also mean personal loyalty as in 'yi‑qi')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 形容词（视具体词语用法而定）
explanation_mandarin: 漢字“義”常表示正義、公義或道義，也用於表示義氣、忠義等人際間的道德或情義概念，經常出現在複合詞中如“正義”、“義氣”、“義務”等。
explanation_english: The character '義' commonly denotes righteousness, justice, or moral duty. It is also used to express personal loyalty or honor (e.g. 'yi‑qi'). It often appears in compounds such as 'justice', 'loyalty', or 'duty'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有義氣，朋友有難嘅時候一定幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 ji6 hei3, pang4 jau5 jau5 naan6 ge3 si4 hau6 jat1 ding6 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有義氣，朋友有難的時候一定會幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He is very loyal; when his friends are in trouble he always helps.

mandarin_meaning: 义不容辞
english_meaning: cannot refuse because of moral duty; duty-bound
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成语（四字成语，可作谓语或定语）
explanation_mandarin: 表示有道义或责任，不能推辞或回避某项任务，常用来强调应当承担的义务。
explanation_english: Indicates a moral obligation or responsibility that cannot be refused; used to stress that someone must accept or carry out a duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司遇到水浸，作為員工，你義不容辭要參與救援工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jyu6 dou3 seoi2 zam3, zok3 wai4 jyun4 gung1, nei5 ji6-bat1-jung4-ci4 jiu3 caam1 jyu5 gau3 wun4 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司遇到水灾，作为员工，你义不容辞要参与救援工作。
examples.english_sentence: When the company faced flooding, as an employee you are duty-bound to take part in the relief work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於朋友遇到困難，佢義不容辭伸出援手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 pang4 jau5 jyu6 dou3 kwan3 naan4, keoi5 ji6-bat1-jung4-ci4 san1 ceot1 wun4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于朋友遇到困难，他义不容辞地伸出援手。
examples.english_sentence: When a friend is in trouble, he doesn't hesitate to lend a helping hand.

mandarin_meaning: 義乳（假乳、乳房假體）
english_meaning: breast prosthesis; artificial breast (breast form)
explanation_mandarin: 指乳房切除手術後或因其他原因使用的外置人工乳房或胸部義體，用於恢復外觀與身形平衡，也可作為假體填充物。
explanation_english: An artificial breast (breast prosthesis) worn after mastectomy or for cosmetic/medical reasons. Usually an external prosthesis placed in a bra or pocket to restore appearance and balance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗乳癌切除手術之後，就配咗個義乳，出街都冇咁唔自在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 jyu5 ngaam4 cit3 ceoi4 sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6, zau6 pui3 zo2 go3 ji6 jyu5, ceot1 gaai1 dou1 mou5 gam2 m4 zi6 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她做了乳癌切除手術之後，就配戴了義乳，出門也不會那麼不自在。
examples.english_sentence: After she had surgery to remove breast cancer, she got a breast prosthesis, so she no longer felt so self-conscious going out.

mandarin_meaning: 义勇军（yì yǒng jūn）：由民众自愿组织、在战时或紧急情况下参加保卫或救援的武装力量。
english_meaning: volunteer army; volunteer corps; militia — an armed group formed by volunteers to fight or assist in wartime or emergencies.
explanation_mandarin: 指由平民自愿组成、在战争或突发事件中参加防卫、抵抗或救援任务的武装组织或临时队伍。
explanation_english: Refers to an armed group formed voluntarily by civilians to defend, resist, or carry out rescue duties during war or emergencies; essentially a volunteer militia or corps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰班義勇軍喺颱風期間幫手疏散居民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 baan1 ji6 jung5 gwan1 hai2 toi4 fung1 kei4 gaan1 bong1 sau2 sou1 saan3 geoi1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那批义勇军在台风期间帮忙疏散居民。
examples.english_sentence: The volunteer corps helped evacuate residents during the typhoon.

mandarin_meaning: 义务 (yìwù) — 应尽的责任或义务
english_meaning: duty; obligation; mandatory responsibility (also used to refer to unpaid voluntary service in some contexts)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（在某些合成词中可作形容词）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (can be used attributively as an adjective in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 義務指應履行的責任或職責，例如納稅或接受義務教育；在某些語境下（如“做義務工作”）也指無償的志願服務。
explanation_english: 義務 denotes a duty or obligation one is expected to perform (e.g., paying taxes, compulsory education). In some contexts (e.g., "do義務 work") it can refer to unpaid voluntary service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 照法律，納稅係我哋嘅義務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu3 faat3 leot6, naap6 seoi3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 ji6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按照法律，纳税是我们的义务。
examples.english_sentence: By law, paying taxes is our duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我暑假會去做義務工作，幫手照顧老人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 syu2 gaa3 wui5 heoi3 zou6 ji6 mou6 gung1 zok3, bong1 sau2 ziu3 gu3 lou5 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我暑假会去做义务工作，帮忙照顾老人。
examples.english_sentence: I'll do volunteer work during the summer to help take care of the elderly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港實行九年義務教育。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 sat6 haang4 gau2 nin4 ji6 mou6 gaau3 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港实行九年义务教育。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong implements nine years of compulsory education.

mandarin_meaning: 义和团（義和團）——清朝末年的一個民間秘密社團與群眾運動，反對外國勢力與基督教，與1900年義和團運動（庚子事變）相關。
english_meaning: Yihetuan (the Righteous and Harmonious Fists), commonly known as the Boxers — a late Qing secret society and popular movement opposed to foreign influence and Christianity, associated with the 1900 Boxer Rebellion.
explanation_mandarin: 義和團原為民間武術與秘密結社，清末發展成反外國與反基督教的群眾運動，1900年曾引發大規模衝突與國際干預（八國聯軍）。
explanation_english: Originally a folk martial and secret-society movement, the Yihetuan grew in the late Qing into an anti-foreign and anti-Christian popular movement; in 1900 it sparked large-scale conflict and international intervention (the Boxer Rebellion and the Eight-Nation Alliance).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺歷史課我哋學到義和團喺清朝末年發起嘅反外國運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 lik6 si2 fo3 ngo5 dei6 hok6 dou3 ji6 wo4 tyun4 hai2 cing1 ciu4 mut6 nin4 faat3 hei2 ge3 faan2 ngoi6 gwok3 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在历史课上我们学到义和团是在清朝末年发起的反外国运动。
examples.english_sentence: In history class we learned that the Yihetuan (Boxers) was an anti-foreign movement that arose in the late Qing dynasty.

mandarin_meaning: 義堂（yì táng）：指社會或宗族中設立的會堂、慈善或互助機構，常用於辦理喪葬、救濟或公共事務的場所。
english_meaning: yi-tang; a hall or meeting place of a benevolent or mutual-aid society—often used for charitable activities, funerary arrangements, or community affairs.
explanation_mandarin: 義堂多指由鄉里、宗族或互助團體設立的會所或公所，傳統上用來辦理喪事、救濟貧困或作為社區聚會場所。有時與「義莊」、「會堂」意義相近。
explanation_english: A yi-tang is a hall established by a village, clan, or benevolent society for mutual aid. Traditionally used for funerary arrangements, charitable relief, and community gatherings. It is similar in sense to "yi-zhuang" or a community meeting hall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 村入面有間義堂，專門幫手安排清明節同喪事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun1 jap6 min6 jau5 gaan1 ji6 tong4, zyun1 mun4 bong1 sau2 on1 paai4 cing1 ming4 zit3 tung4 song3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 村裡有一間義堂，專門幫忙安排清明節和喪事。
examples.english_sentence: There is a yi-tang in the village that helps arrange Qingming and funeral matters.

mandarin_meaning: 義塚（義冢）：為了紀念為正義或國家犧牲者而設立的墓地或墓塚，常指烈士或義士的墓
english_meaning: A burial mound or tomb erected to commemorate those who died for a righteous cause or the country; often refers to martyrs' graves
explanation_mandarin: 指為紀念為國家或正義犧牲的人而立的墓地或紀念墓，歷史或社會語境中常用來指烈士、義士的陵墓。
explanation_english: A noun referring to a tomb or burial mound established to commemorate people who sacrificed themselves for the country or a righteous cause; commonly used for martyrs or righteous heroes in historical and social contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰座義塚係為咗紀念為國捐軀嘅英雄而建嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zo6 ji6 zung2 hai6 wai6 zo2 gei3 nim6 wai4 gwok3 gyun1 keoi1 ge3 jing1 hung4 ji4 gin3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座義塚是為了紀念為國捐軀的英雄而建的。
examples.english_sentence: That martyrs' tomb was built to commemorate the heroes who sacrificed their lives for the country.

mandarin_meaning: 义士；指为伸张正义或保护他人而英勇行动的人，常用于称赞具有正义感或舍身奋战者。
english_meaning: righteous person; hero who acts for justice; a person who bravely stands up for justice or others
explanation_mandarin: 指為伸張正義或保護他人而挺身而出、英勇行動的人；可用來稱讚有義氣或為公義犧牲的人，亦常見於歷史或抗爭語境中。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who bravely acts to uphold justice or protect others; used to praise a righteous or honorable person and often appears in historical or protest contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺抗爭期間挺身而出，成為咗大家心目中嘅義士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 kong3 zaang1 kei4 gaan1 ting5 san1 ji4 ceot1, sing4 wai4 zo2 daai6 gaa1 sam1 muk6 zung1 ge3 ji6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在抗争期间挺身而出，成为了大家心目中的义士。
examples.english_sentence: He stood up during the struggle and became regarded by everyone as a righteous hero.

mandarin_meaning: 義子（yìzǐ）：被非血緣收養或以義結為子的男子，類似養子、義結子。
english_meaning: adopted son; foster son (a male taken as a son by non-biological means, often by ritual or family arrangement)
explanation_mandarin: 「義子」指不是親生但被家族或個人以收養、義結等方式視為子嗣的男子，常見於傳統或宗族關係中，強調禮義或情感上的父子關係。
explanation_english: “義子” refers to a male regarded as a son though not biologically related—taken in by a family through fostering, adoption, or ritual bonds. It emphasizes a social or moral parent–child relationship rather than blood ties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係屋企嘅義子，雖然唔係親生，但大家都當佢係真正嘅家庭成員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 uk1 kei2 ge3 ji6 zi2, seoi1 jin4 m4 hai6 can1 saang1, daan6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 dong3 keoi5 hai6 zan1 zeng3 ge3 gaa1 ting4 sing4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是家裡的義子，雖然不是親生，但大家都把他當作真正的家庭成員。
examples.english_sentence: He is the family's adopted son; although not biologically related, everyone treats him as a real family member.

mandarin_meaning: 義學（免費或義務性質的教學機構，通常為救濟貧困兒童所設）
english_meaning: charity school; voluntary/free school for the poor
explanation_mandarin: 義學指舊時或社區設立的免費或義務性學校，主要為貧困或弱勢兒童提供基礎教育，亦可指現代的義務教學活動或慈善性學校。
explanation_english: A charity or voluntary school (historically or community-run) that provides free basic education to poor or disadvantaged children. Can also refer to modern voluntary educational initiatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺村入面開咗間義學，免費教啲細路識字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 cyun1 jap6 min6 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 ji6 hok6, min5 fai3 gaau3 di1 sai3 lou6 sik1 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在村里開了一所義學，免費教孩子識字。
examples.english_sentence: They opened a charity school in the village that teaches children to read and write for free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清朝嗰陣，好多地方有義學，幫助貧苦嘅小朋友入學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ciu4 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 jau5 ji6 hok6, bong1 zo6 pan4 fu2 ge3 siu2 pang4 jau5 jap6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清朝時期，很多地方有義學，幫助貧苦的兒童入學。
examples.english_sentence: During the Qing dynasty many places had charity schools that helped poor children attend school.

mandarin_meaning: 義工 / 志願者
english_meaning: volunteer (a person who offers services without pay)
explanation_mandarin: 指無償提供服務或協助社會團體、社區或活動的人，通常為義務性質。
explanation_english: A person who offers their time and services without pay to help organizations, communities, or events; typically an unpaid, voluntary role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個義工，每個星期六喺老人院幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 ji6 gung1, mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 luk6 hai2 lou5 jan4 jyun2 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一名義工，每個星期六在老人院幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He is a volunteer who helps at the elderly home every Saturday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暴雨過後，好多義工自發到受災地區清理垃圾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 jyu5 gwo3 hau6, hou2 do1 ji6 gung1 zi6 faat3 dou3 sau6 zoi1 dei6 keoi1 cing1 lei5 laat6 saap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暴雨過後，很多義工自發到受災地區清理垃圾。
examples.english_sentence: After the heavy rain, many volunteers spontaneously went to the disaster areas to clear garbage.

mandarin_meaning: 義憤填膺 (yìfèn tiányīng)：因不義或冤屈而充滿正義感的憤怒
english_meaning: filled with righteous indignation; indignant at injustice
explanation_mandarin: 表示因見到不公平、不義或冤屈而在胸中燃起強烈的憤慨與正義感，常用來形容人對不正之事感到極度憤怒。
explanation_english: Describes being filled with intense, righteous anger upon witnessing injustice or wrongdoing; used to portray strong moral indignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到嗰件事情係咁樣發生之後，真係義憤塡膺，想替受害者討回公道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go2 gin6 si6cing4 hai6 gam2 joeng6 faat3saang1 zi1hau6, zan1hai6 ji6 fan5 tim4 jing1, soeng2 tai3 sau6hoi6jan4 tou2 wui4 gung1dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到那件事情是這樣發生之後，真的義憤填膺，想替受害者討回公道。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing that the incident happened that way, he was truly filled with righteous indignation and wanted to seek justice for the victims.

mandarin_meaning: 義憤填膺（充滿正義感的憤怒）
english_meaning: filled with righteous indignation; morally outraged
explanation_mandarin: 表示因見到不公平或惡行而充滿正義感的憤怒，通常含強烈的道德譴責意味。
explanation_english: Describes being filled with anger motivated by a sense of justice, usually implying strong moral condemnation of wrongdoing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到嗰啲黑心商人欺騙窮人，我真係義憤填膺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 go2 di1 hak1 sam1 soeng1 jan4 hei1 pin3 kung4 jan4, ngo5 zan1 hai6 ji6 fan5 tin4 jing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到那些黑心商人欺騙窮人，我真是義憤填膺。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing that those unscrupulous merchants cheated the poor, I was filled with righteous indignation.

mandarin_meaning: （1）義務性或免費的教學活動；（2）宣揚正義或道德的教導（書面或古文用法）
english_meaning: voluntary or free teaching (e.g., free tutoring); moral or righteous instruction
explanation_mandarin: 「義教」可指以義務或免費形式提供的教學（如社區義務補習），亦可指宣揚正義、道德的教化。此詞較少見，書面或古文中出現較多。
explanation_english: In Cantonese/Chinese, '義教' can mean volunteer or free teaching (for example, free tutoring) or teachings that promote righteousness/moral instruction. The term is relatively uncommon and more often found in formal or classical contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺社區中心做義教，逢星期六免費教小朋友中文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 se5 keoi1 zung1 sam1 zou6 ji6 gaau3, fung4 sing1 kei4 luk6 min5 fai3 gaau3 siu2 pang4 jau5 zung1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在社區中心做義務教學，每週六免費教小朋友中文。
examples.english_sentence: He/She volunteers at the community centre, giving free Chinese lessons to children every Saturday.

mandarin_meaning: 義務教學；志願性提供免費教學或補習
english_meaning: volunteer teaching; providing instruction or tutoring for free
explanation_mandarin: 「義教」通常指以志願或免費形式提供教學或補習，常見於教會、社區中心或非牟利機構，既可指行為也可指擔任該職務的人（如義教老師）。
explanation_english: “義教” refers to volunteer teaching — giving instruction or tutoring free of charge. It is common in churches, community centres, or NGOs and can refer both to the activity and to the person doing it (e.g., a volunteer teacher).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺教會做義教，免費幫街坊補習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaau3 wui2 zou6 ji6 gaau3, min5 fai3 bong1 gaai1 fong1 bou2 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在教會做義務教學，免費幫鄰居補習。
examples.english_sentence: He volunteers as a teacher at the church, giving free tutoring to neighbors.

mandarin_meaning: 義會：結義的團體或會議，指結拜兄弟或互助性的社團；有時亦指具有秘密性或幫會性質的組織，也可泛指為慈善、互助或紀念目的而舉行的集會。
english_meaning: An association or meeting of sworn brothers or a fraternal society; can mean a mutual-aid or charitable gathering; historically may refer to secret brotherhoods or triad-like organizations.
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語中，義會多指結義或互助的團體與聚會，既可用於正面慈善、互助的場合，也可能帶有幫會、結義兄弟或秘密社團的歷史色彩。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, 義會 usually denotes an association or gathering of sworn brothers or a mutual-aid society. It can refer to charitable or community meetings but also carries historical connotations of brotherhoods or secret-society groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次義會係為咗幫助災民同籌款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ji6 wui6 hai6 wai6 zo2 bong1 zo6 zoi1 man4 tung4 cau4 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次義會是為了幫助災民籌款。
examples.english_sentence: This charitable gathering is to raise funds to help disaster victims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺年輕時加入過義會，講過啲幫人出頭嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 nin4 heng1 si4 gaa1 jap6 gwo3 ji6 wui6, gong2 gwo3 di1 bong1 jan4 ceot1 tau4 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爺爺年輕時加入過義會，說過一些幫人出頭的事。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather joined an yi-hui when he was young and talked about standing up for others.

mandarin_meaning: 義正詞嚴：以正義立場，用嚴厲有力的語詞斥責或辯駁。
english_meaning: To speak sternly with righteous indignation; to rebuke or defend strongly and justifiably.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語／四字成語（可作述語或狀語）
partOfSpeech_english: idiom (four-character idiom), used predicatively or adverbially
explanation_mandarin: 表示以正義或道德立場，語氣嚴厲、有理有據地斥責或反駁不正當的行為或指控。
explanation_english: Indicates speaking from a moral or righteous standpoint with stern, forceful words to condemn wrongdoing or rebut accusations; implies justification and firmness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對不公平嘅批評，佢義正詞嚴噉替自己辯護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 bat1 gung1 ping4 ge3, keoi5 ji6 zing3 ci4 jim4 gam2 tai3 zi6 gei2 bin6 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面對不公平的批評，他義正詞嚴地為自己辯護。
examples.english_sentence: Facing unfair criticism, he defended himself sternly and with righteous indignation.

mandarin_meaning: 義正辭嚴（以正義之名、嚴厲的語氣斥責或批評不正當行為）
english_meaning: To speak righteously and sternly; to denounce or reprimand wrongdoing with a strong moral tone.
explanation_mandarin: 形容以正義的立場，用嚴厲且有理有據的語氣斥責或譴責他人的錯誤或不當行為。
explanation_english: Describes speaking from a position of moral righteousness in a stern, forceful manner to criticize or condemn improper behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢義正辭嚴咁批評嗰啲貪污行為，指出唔可接受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji6 zing3 ci4 jim4 gam2 pai1 ping4 go2 di1 taam1 wu1 hang4 wai4, zi2 ceot1 m4 ho2 zip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他義正辭嚴地批評那些貪污行為，指出不能接受。
examples.english_sentence: He sternly criticized those acts of corruption, pointing out they are unacceptable.

mandarin_meaning: 義母（指被收養或在名義上承擔母親角色的女性）
english_meaning: adoptive mother; foster mother; honorary mother (a woman who assumes a mother's role but is not the biological mother)
explanation_mandarin: 指非親生但被收養或在名義上（如儀式、禮節等）承擔母親角色的女性。可用於法律或社會關係上，如養母、義父義母等稱呼。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who is not the biological mother but has taken on the role of mother through adoption, fostering, or as an honorary/social/religious mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅義母，從細照顧我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 ji6 mou5, cung4 sai3 ziu3 gu3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是我的義母，從小照顧我。
examples.english_sentence: She is my adoptive mother; she has cared for me since childhood.

mandarin_meaning: 义气；重视情义，对朋友忠诚、讲义气的态度或行为
english_meaning: a sense of loyalty and solidarity among friends; brotherhood; willingness to help or defend friends out of honor
explanation_mandarin: 表示朋友之间重视情谊、讲义气，愿意为朋友两肋插刀或互相支持的一种品德或行为规范，既可褒义也可有时带有盲目性。
explanation_english: Refers to a cultural value of loyalty, solidarity, and mutual support among friends — the willingness to help, defend, or stand by friends out of camaraderie and honor. It can be praised or criticized when it becomes blind loyalty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好有義氣，朋友有難佢一定幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 ji6 hei3, pang4 jau5 jau5 naan6, keoi5 jat1 ding6 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很有义气，朋友有难他一定会帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He's really loyal — he'll always help a friend in trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋講義氣，永遠唔會放朋友落水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gong2 ji6 hei3, wing5 jyun5 m4 wui5 fong3 pang4 jau5 lok6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们讲义气，永远不会把朋友推入困境。
examples.english_sentence: We stand by our friends; we'll never betray them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰種義氣有時會令人覺得盲目，唔夠理性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 zung2 ji6 hei3 jau5 si4 wui5 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 maang4 muk6, m4 gau3 lei5 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的那种义气有时会让人觉得盲目，不够理性。
examples.english_sentence: That kind of loyalty can sometimes be blind and not very rational.

mandarin_meaning: 把義氣當作兒戲／擺義氣作秀
english_meaning: to put on a show of loyalty; to display ostentatious or theatrical loyalty as a stunt
explanation_mandarin: 「義氣博兒戲」指為了表現或炫耀對朋友、兄弟的忠義而做出誇張、戲劇化或不負責任的行為，帶有作秀或把義氣當兒戲的負面意味，常用作貶義描述。
explanation_english: Refers to performing exaggerated or theatrical acts of loyalty to show off allegiance to friends or 'brothers', often irresponsibly—implying a stunt or treating loyalty as a game. Usually used derogatorily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係識得義氣博兒戲，真正有難幫唔到人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 ji6 hei3 bok3 ji4 hei3, zan1 zing3 jau5 naan4 bong1 m4 dou3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只會擺義氣作秀，真正有難時幫不了人。
examples.english_sentence: He only puts on a show of loyalty; when real trouble comes he can't help.

mandarin_meaning: 义无反顾（yì wú fǎn gù）：出于正义或责任感，毫不犹豫地向前行动，不回头。
english_meaning: To act resolutely and without hesitation out of a sense of duty or righteousness; to press forward without looking back.
explanation_mandarin: 表示因為正義或責任而堅決地採取行動，毫不猶豫、不顧後路地前進或投入某事。
explanation_english: Expresses taking decisive action without hesitation or turning back because of a sense of duty or righteousness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗幫朋友，佢義無反顧咁走入火場救人。
