examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 bong1 pang4 jau5, keoi5 ji6 mou4 faan2 gu3 gam2 zau2 jap6 fo2 coeng4 gau3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮朋友，他义无反顾地走进火场救人。
examples.english_sentence: To help a friend, he went into the burning building without hesitation to rescue people.

mandarin_meaning: 义父 (yìfù)：非亲生但因收养或结义等成为父亲角色的人（即养父、收养的父亲）。
english_meaning: Adoptive father / foster father — a man who assumes the role of father without a biological relationship.
explanation_mandarin: 指不是親生，但因為收養、結義或其他原因而被稱為父親或擔任父親角色的男性。
explanation_english: Refers to a man who is not the biological father but takes on the role of father through adoption, fostering, or symbolic/juristic ties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅義父係一個好好嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji6 fu6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的义父是一个很好的人。
examples.english_sentence: His adoptive father is a very kind person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個畀義父收養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 bei2 ji6 fu6 sau1 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候被义父收养。
examples.english_sentence: He was adopted by his adoptive father when he was a child.

mandarin_meaning: 義肢（假肢）
english_meaning: prosthesis; artificial limb
explanation_mandarin: 用來替代或補償缺失或失能肢體的人工裝置，常指假手、假腿等義肢。
explanation_english: An artificial device that replaces or compensates for a missing or disabled limb, typically referring to artificial arms, legs, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為意外失咗條腿，而家裝緊義肢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 ji3 ngoi6 sat1 zo2 tiu4 teoi2, ji4 gaa1 zong1 gan2 ji6 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為意外失去了一條腿，現在正在裝義肢。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a leg in an accident and is now being fitted with a prosthetic limb.

mandarin_meaning: 義舉（指正義或高尚的行為）
english_meaning: a righteous or noble deed; an act of charity or justice
explanation_mandarin: 指出於正義、良心或慈悲而做出的高尚行為，常用來稱讚對社會或他人有益的舉動。
explanation_english: Refers to an act done out of righteousness, conscience, or compassion; a noble or charitable deed often praised for benefiting others or society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢救咗落水嘅細路，真係一件義舉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gau3 zo2 lok6 seoi2 ge3 sai3 lou6, zan1 hai6 jat1 gin6 ji6 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他救了落水的小孩，真是一件義舉。
examples.english_sentence: He saved the drowning child — truly a noble deed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔求回報咁捐咗錢幫助災民，呢個係義舉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 kau4 wui4 bou3 gam2 gyun1 zo2 cin2 bong1 zoi1 man4, ni1 go3 hai6 ji6 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不求回報地捐錢幫助災民，這是義舉。
examples.english_sentence: He donated money to help disaster victims without seeking anything in return — that's a noble act.

mandarin_meaning: 义庄（yìzhuāng）：传统宗族或乡里设立的互助机构或场所，主要用于为贫困或无依的族人办理丧葬、祭祀、救济及管理宗族财产。
english_meaning: yi zhuang (benevolent/charitable clan burial hall or mutual-aid association): a traditional clan or village institution that provides burial services, ancestral rites, relief and mutual aid for needy clan members, and sometimes manages clan property.
explanation_mandarin: 義莊是中國南方尤其是廣東、廣西等地常見的宗族或鄉里組織，通常由家族或鄉里集資建立，用來幫助貧困族人辦喪、祭祀祖先、提供救濟，亦有管理宗族財產或辦理貸款等功能，帶有濃厚的互助與宗族色彩。
explanation_english: An yi zhuang is a traditional mutual-aid institution found mainly in southern China. Founded by a clan or village, it was financed collectively to help poorer or dependent members with funerals, ancestral rites and relief, and sometimes to manage clan assets or provide loans. It reflects clan-based mutual support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間義莊係由我家祖先創立，用嚟幫助家族內嘅貧困親戚辦喪事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 ji6 zong1 hai6 jau4 ngo5 gaa1 zou2 sin1 cong3 laap6, jung6 lai4 bong1 zo6 gaa1 zuk6 noi6 ge3 pan4 kwan3 can1 cik1 baan6 song1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間義莊是由我家祖先創立，用來幫助家族中貧困的親戚辦理喪事。
examples.english_sentence: That yi zhuang was founded by my ancestors to help impoverished relatives in the family with funeral arrangements.

mandarin_meaning: 義薄雲天（yì bó yún tiān）——形容義氣極大、正義感高尚，義行廣大如同高天。
english_meaning: An idiom describing towering righteousness or lofty sense of justice; great moral integrity and selfless loyalty.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人講義氣、正直仗義，義行高尚，令人敬佩。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone with great loyalty and righteousness — morally noble and selflessly just, inspiring admiration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿強為咗幫阿明擋一擋，出手相救，真係義薄雲天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 koeng4 wai6 zo2 bong1 aa3 ming4 dong2 jat1 dong2, ceot1 sau2 soeng1 gau3, zan1 hai6 ji6 bok3 wan4 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿强为了帮阿明挡一挡，出手相救，真是義薄雲天。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Keung stepped in to help Ah Ming and rescued him — it was truly an act of great righteousness.

mandarin_meaning: 义卖（慈善义卖）
english_meaning: charity sale; fundraising sale; to sell items for charity
explanation_mandarin: 為了慈善或公益而舉辦的銷售活動，出售物品以籌集款項；也可作為動詞，表示為慈善而出售物品。
explanation_english: A sale held to raise money for charity or public causes; selling items to collect funds. Can be used as a noun (the event) or a verb (to sell for charity).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校下星期舉辦義賣，籌款幫助貧困學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 haa6 sing1 kei4 geoi2 baan6 ji6 maai6, cau4 fun2 bong1 zo6 pan4 kwan3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学校下星期举办义卖，筹款帮助贫困学生。
examples.english_sentence: The school is holding a charity sale next week to raise funds to help underprivileged students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 她把自己的手工藝品拿去義賣，所得款項會捐給流浪動物中心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taa1 baa2 zi6 gei2 dik1 sau2 gung1 ngai6 ban2 naa4 heoi3 ji6 maai6, so2 dak1 fun2 hong6 wui5 gyun1 kap1 lau4 long6 dung6 mat6 zung1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她把自己的手工艺品拿去义卖，所得款项会捐给流浪动物中心。
examples.english_sentence: She took her handmade crafts to the charity sale; the proceeds will be donated to the stray animal center.

mandarin_meaning: gēng (羹) — 汤、浓羹；一种以肉、鱼或蔬菜熬成的羹汤
english_meaning: geng — a thick soup or broth (a traditional Chinese-style thick soup)
explanation_mandarin: 指以肉、魚、菜等熬成的濃湯或羹。此字較古或書面用，與「羹」意義相同，亦可泛指湯羹類食物。
explanation_english: Refers to a thick soup or broth made by simmering meat, fish, or vegetables. This character is literary/archaic and is equivalent in meaning to 羹; it broadly denotes soup-like dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋食咗碗魚羮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik6 zo2 wun2 jyu4 gang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们吃了一碗鱼羹。
examples.english_sentence: We ate a bowl of fish soup.

mandarin_meaning: 羯（古代少数民族名，指羯族）；亦有文献中作古义用法（如指阉羊或出现在佛教術語中）
english_meaning: Jie (a historical ethnic/nomadic group); also appears in archaic usages (e.g., a castrated ram or in certain Buddhist terms)
explanation_mandarin: “羯”主要指古代史料中的羯族（五胡之一），在中國南北朝時期有過建立政權的記載；在少數文獻中亦見其他古義用法。
explanation_english: Primarily refers to the Jie people, a historical ethnic group mentioned in Chinese sources (one of the Five Hu); they founded regimes during the Sixteen Kingdoms/Northern and Southern dynasties period. The character also appears with other archaic meanings in some texts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史上，後趙係由羯族嘅石勒所建立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 soeng6, hau6 ziu6 hai6 jau4 git3 zuk6 ge3 sek6 lak6 so2 gin3 laap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史上，后赵是由羯族的石勒所建立的。
examples.english_sentence: Historically, Later Zhao was founded by Shi Le of the Jie (羯) people.

mandarin_meaning: （常用于人名或专有名词）如古代神话人物“伏羲”，该字本身多见于人名、传说称谓。
english_meaning: A classical Chinese character mainly used in proper names; notably appears in 'Fuxi' (伏羲), a culture-hero in Chinese mythology.
explanation_mandarin: 羲为汉字，现代汉语中多见于专有名词，最常见于神话人物“伏羲”（中华远古的文化英雄）。单字在日常口语中罕见。
explanation_english: The character 羲 is primarily used in proper names. It most commonly appears in the name Fuxi (伏羲), a legendary culture-hero in Chinese mythology. The character is rarely used alone in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日喺堂上學咗關於伏羲嘅傳說。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 hai2 tong4 soeng5 hok6 zo2 gwaan1 jyu1 fuk6 hei1 ge3 cyun4 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天在课堂上学了关于伏羲的传说。
examples.english_sentence: Today in class we learned about the legends of Fuxi.

mandarin_meaning: 瘦弱；虛弱
english_meaning: thin; emaciated; weak
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體瘦弱、力氣不足或消瘦，也可用來形容人看起來沒有精神或體力。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is thin, emaciated, or physically weak; can also describe a person who lacks energy or strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近病咗，羸咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 beng6 zo2, leoi4 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近生病了，瘦了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He has been ill recently and has lost a lot of weight.

mandarin_meaning: 湯；濃湯（亦見於文言有替代、輪換等義）
english_meaning: soup; thick soup or broth (archaically can mean to alternate or replace in Classical Chinese)
explanation_mandarin: “羹”指一種較稠的湯或羹類料理，常以肉、魚、蔬菜等熬製；在文言文中有時作動詞，表示更替或輪換。
explanation_english: “羹” denotes a type of soup or thick broth often made with meat, fish, or vegetables; in Classical Chinese it can occasionally function as a verb meaning to replace or alternate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽今晚煲咗一鍋魚片羹，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 gam1 maan5 bou1 zo2 jat1 wo1 jyu4 pin3 gang1, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽今晚煲了一鍋魚片羹，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Mom cooked a pot of fish-slice soup tonight; it's delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 羽 (yǔ)：羽毛
english_meaning: feather; plumage
explanation_mandarin: 表示鳥類的羽毛或翎羽，也常用於構成複合詞，如羽毛、羽絨、羽毛球等。
explanation_english: Refers to a bird's feather or plumage; commonly used in compound words (e.g., feather, down, badminton).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻鸚鵡換羽，掉咗啲羽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 jing1 mou2 wun6 jyu5, diu6 zo2 di1 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻鸚鵡在換羽，掉了些羽毛。
examples.english_sentence: The parrot is molting and has lost some feathers.

mandarin_meaning: 羽毛 (yǔmáo) — 鳥類或其他動物身上的毛；也可引申為微小的利益、面子或名譽。
english_meaning: feather (plumage); also used metaphorically for a small benefit, credit, or honor.
explanation_mandarin: 指鳥類等動物身上的羽毛，具有保溫、飛行等功能；在口語中有時用來比喻微不足道的利益或面子。
explanation_english: Refers to the feathers on birds or similar animals, used for insulation and flight; colloquially can be used figuratively to mean a minor gain, perk, or reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻雀嘅羽毛好柔軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 zoek3 ge3 jyu5 mou4 hou2 jau4 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻鳥的羽毛很柔軟。
examples.english_sentence: The bird's feathers are very soft.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢淨係諗住攞啲羽毛，唔理其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing6 hai6 lam2 zyu6 lo2 di1 jyu5 mou4, m4 lei5 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只想着撈些羽毛，不顧其他人。
examples.english_sentence: He's only thinking about getting a bit of credit/perk, not caring about others.

mandarin_meaning: 羽毛球（指羽毛製的球，或指羽毛球這項運動）
english_meaning: shuttlecock (and by extension badminton/the sport)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，通常指羽毛球（用羽毛製成的球），也常用來指打羽毛球這項運動或活動。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for the shuttlecock used in badminton; it can also refer to the activity/sport of playing badminton.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去打羽毛波，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 daa2 jyu5 mou4 bo1, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們明天去打羽毛球，好嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go play badminton tomorrow?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日返工之後去打羽毛波，保持身形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 faan1 gung1 zi1 hau6 heoi3 daa2 jyu5 mou4 bo1, bou2 ci4 san1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常下班後去打羽毛球，保持身材。
examples.english_sentence: He often plays badminton after work to stay in shape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻羽毛波已經爛咗，要換一隻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 jyu5 mou4 bo1 ji5 ging1 laan6 zo2, jiu3 wun6 jat1 zek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個羽毛球已經壞了，要換一個。
examples.english_sentence: This shuttlecock is already damaged; we need to replace it.

mandarin_meaning: 羽毛球
english_meaning: badminton; shuttlecock
explanation_mandarin: 可指用羽毛和塞子制成的球（即“羽球”），也指以此为器材进行的球类运动，即羽毛球运动。
explanation_english: Refers to the shuttlecock made with feathers and a cork base (also called a 'shuttle') and the racket sport played with it, commonly known as badminton.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我星期六會同朋友去打羽毛球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing1 kei4 luk6 wui5 tung4 pang4 jau5 heoi3 daa2 jyu5 mou4 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我星期六会和朋友去打羽毛球。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to play badminton with my friends on Saturday.

mandarin_meaning: 羽绒
english_meaning: down (soft feathers used for insulation, e.g., in jackets, quilts)
explanation_mandarin: 指鸟类的细小、柔软且蓬松的羽毛，常用作保暖填充材料（如羽绒服、羽绒被）。
explanation_english: Refers to the fine, soft, fluffy feathers from birds used as insulating filling material (e.g., in down jackets and comforters).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件羽絨褸好暖，啱冬天著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 jyu5 jung4 leoi1 hou2 nyun5, aam1 dung1 tin1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件羽绒服很暖和，适合冬天穿。
examples.english_sentence: This down jacket is very warm, suitable for wearing in winter.

mandarin_meaning: 翅膀；（比喻）支持、助力或屬下、左右手
english_meaning: Wings; (figuratively) supporters, auxiliaries or subordinates
explanation_mandarin: 本義指鳥或昆蟲的翅膀；引申為比喻性的支持或助力，常用來指有能力的助手或屬下。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the wings of birds or insects; figuratively used to denote support, auxiliaries, or capable subordinates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺商界打滾多年，已經有一班得力嘅羽翼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 soeng1 gaai3 daa2 gwan2 do1 nin4, ji5 ging1 jau5 jat1 baan1 dak1 lik6 ge3 jyu5 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在商界打滾多年，已經有一班得力的羽翼。
examples.english_sentence: He has been in the business world for many years and already has a group of capable supporters.

mandarin_meaning: 羽翼渐丰（yǔ yì jiàn fēng）
english_meaning: to grow stronger or better supported; to gain strength, resources, or backing
explanation_mandarin: 指實力、勢力或後援逐漸增強，通常形容個人、機構或團體有了更多支持或資源，變得更有能力。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone's strength, influence, or support is gradually increasing; often used to describe a person, organization, or group gaining more backing or resources and becoming more capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間新創公司經過幾年發展，羽翼漸豐，已經有十幾個分部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 san1 cong3 gung1 si1 ging1 gwo3 gei2 nin4 faat3 zin2, jyu5 jik6 zim6 fung1, ji5 ging1 jau5 sap6 gei2 go3 fan1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間新創公司經過幾年發展，羽翼漸豐，已經有十幾個分部。
examples.english_sentence: After a few years of development, the startup has grown stronger and now has more than a dozen branches.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跟住有幾個贊助人出現，佢嘅羽翼漸豐，可以承接更多大型項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 zyu6 jau5 gei2 go3 zaan3 zo6 jan4 ceot1 jin2, keoi5 ge3 jyu5 jik6 zim6 fung1, ho2 ji5 sing4 zip3 gong3 do1 daai6 jing4 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隨著幾位贊助人出現，他的羽翼漸豐，可以承接更多大型項目。
examples.english_sentence: With several sponsors coming on board, his support has grown and he can take on larger projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾次勝利，軍隊羽翼漸豐，士氣更高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 ci3 sing3 lei6, gwan1 deoi2 jyu5 jik6 zim6 fung1, si6 hei3 gang1 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經過幾次勝利，軍隊羽翼漸豐，士氣更高。
examples.english_sentence: After several victories the army's strength increased and morale rose.

mandarin_meaning: 羽衣甘蓝 (yǔyī gānlán)，一種葉菜，常指西洋甘藍的無心葉用變種（即 kale），富含維生素和纖維。
english_meaning: Kale (a leafy green vegetable), a type of Brassica often eaten raw in salads or cooked; nutritious and high in vitamins and fiber.
explanation_mandarin: 羽衣甘蓝是一種十字花科的葉菜，葉片外觀常呈捲曲或蓬鬆狀，可生食或烹調，營養價值高（如維生素K、C、纖維等）。
explanation_english: A leafy green vegetable in the Brassica family (kale). It has curly or ruffled leaves, can be eaten raw or cooked, and is known for its high nutritional content (vitamins K, C, fiber, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日喺街市買咗啲羽衣甘藍，今晚整沙律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 di1 jyu5 ji1 gam1 laam4, gam1 maan5 zeng2 saa1 leot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天在菜市場買了些羽衣甘蓝，今晚做沙拉。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some kale at the market today; I'll make a salad tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 羽衣甘藍好有營養，含有好多維生素K同維他命C，煮嘅時候唔好煮得太耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu5 ji1 gam1 laam4 hou2 jau5 jing4 joeng6, ham4 jau5 hou2 do1 wai4 saang1 sou3 K tung4 wai4 taa1 ming6 C, zyu2 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 hou2 zyu2 dak1 taai3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 羽衣甘蓝很有营养，含有丰富的维生素K和维他命C，烹調時不要煮太久。
examples.english_sentence: Kale is very nutritious, containing plenty of vitamin K and vitamin C; don't overcook it.

mandarin_meaning: 羿（后羿），中國神話中的神射手，著名於射下九日的傳說
english_meaning: Yi (Hou Yi), a legendary archer in Chinese mythology, famous for shooting down nine suns
explanation_mandarin: 羿通常指神話人物后羿，為古代傳說中的弓箭手，最知名的事跡是射下九個太陽以拯救大地。
explanation_english: Refers to the mythological figure Hou Yi, a legendary archer in Chinese folklore best known for shooting down nine suns to save the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 羿係中國神話入面嘅著名神射手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngai6 hai6 zung1 gwok3 san4 waa6 jap6 min6 ge3 zyu3 ming4 san4 se6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 羿是中国神话中的著名神射手。
examples.english_sentence: Yi (Hou Yi) is a famous divine archer in Chinese mythology.

mandarin_meaning: 老翁；年長的男子；（古）對老年男性的稱呼，也作姓氏
english_meaning: old man; elderly man; (classical) term for an older male; also a surname
explanation_mandarin: 「翁」一般指年紀較大的男子或作為對老人的稱呼，常見於複合詞如「老翁」。在古籍中亦可見作姓氏或敬稱。
explanation_english: “翁” denotes an elderly man or a respectful term for an older male, often appearing in compounds such as “老翁”. It also occurs in classical texts and as a surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公園入面有位老翁喺度餵鴿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 wai2 lou5 jung1 hai2 dou6 wai3 gap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里有位老翁在喂鸽子。
examples.english_sentence: There is an old man in the park feeding pigeons.

mandarin_meaning: （文言或方言）老年夫婦；長者；有時指配偶一方的父母（即姻親）
english_meaning: an elderly couple; old folks; sometimes used (archaically) to refer to parents-in-law
explanation_mandarin: 「翁姑」為較書面或方言用語，常指年紀較大的男女、老夫妻或長者，有時在語境中也可指姻親（如岳父岳母/公婆），在現代口語中較少使用，帶有古雅或地域色彩。
explanation_english: “翁姑” is a literary or dialectal term referring to elderly people, an old couple, or elders. In some contexts it can mean parents-in-law. It is less common in modern colloquial speech and carries an archaic or regional flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰對翁姑已經喺鄉下住咗幾年，成日返嚟探親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 deoi3 jung1 gu1 ji5 ging1 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 zyu6 zo2 gei2 nin4, sing4 jat6 faan1 lai4 taam3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那对翁姑已经在乡下住了好几年，经常回來探亲。
examples.english_sentence: That elderly couple have been living in the countryside for several years and often come back to visit family.

mandarin_meaning: 公公與媳婦（父親與媳婦之間的關係或互動）
english_meaning: father-in-law and daughter-in-law (the relationship or interactions between them)
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭中父親（如公公或岳父）與媳婦之間的關係、相處或矛盾，常用於描述雙方互動或衝突。
explanation_english: Refers to the father-in-law and daughter-in-law relationship — used to describe their interactions, convivencia, or conflicts within a family context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對翁媳成日爭吵，屋企氣氛好緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 jung1 sik1 sing4 jat6 zang1 caau3, uk1 kei2 hei3 fan1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這對翁媳經常爭吵，家庭氣氛很緊張。
examples.english_sentence: This father-in-law and daughter-in-law argue all the time; the household atmosphere is tense.

mandarin_meaning: 翅；翅膀（鳥、昆蟲等的飛行器官）；也指食物名稱如「雞翅」
english_meaning: wing (of a bird, insect, etc.); wing used in compounds (e.g., chicken wing)
explanation_mandarin: 指動物（如鳥、昆蟲）用來飛行的肢體（翅膀）；在日常用語中常見於複合詞，如雞翅、翅膀。
explanation_english: Refers to the wing of an animal (birds, insects) used for flying; commonly appears in compounds such as 'chicken wing' or 'wings'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食炸雞翅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 zaa3 gai1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃炸鸡翅。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat fried chicken wings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻鳥用翅膀飛得好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 niu5 jung6 ci3bong2 fei1 dak1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只鸟用翅膀飞得很高。
examples.english_sentence: The bird used its wings to fly very high.

mandarin_meaning: 翅膀 (chìbǎng)，指鳥類或昆蟲等用來飛行的翼，也可作比喻，表示能力、依靠或保護。
english_meaning: wing(s) — the appendages birds, insects, or other animals use for flying; also used metaphorically to mean ability, support, or protection.
explanation_mandarin: 指動物用來飛行的翼；在比喻用法中可指支援、保護或使人能發揮才能的條件。
explanation_english: Refers to the wings animals use for flight. Metaphorically, it can mean support, protection, or the means by which someone can realize their potential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小鳥扇動翅膀飛走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 niu5 sin3 dung6 ci3 bong2 fei1 zau2 zo2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小鸟扇动翅膀飞走了。
examples.english_sentence: The bird flapped its wings and flew away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母應該畀子女展翅膀，等佢哋學識獨立。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 jing1 goi1 bei2 zi2 neoi5 zin2 ci3 bong2, dang2 keoi5 dei6 hok6 sik1 duk6 laap6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母应该让子女展翅，学会独立。
examples.english_sentence: Parents should let their children spread their wings and learn to be independent.

mandarin_meaning: yì（助、辅佐；协助）
english_meaning: to assist; to help; to support (classical/literary)
explanation_mandarin: 古漢語常用字，意為幫助、輔佐、支持，亦常作人名用字或出現在書面語與成語中。
explanation_english: A classical Chinese character meaning to assist, help, or support. Often found in literary contexts and personal names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個名有個「翊」字，意思係輔助、支持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ming4 jau5 go3 jik6 zi6, ji3si1 hai6 fu6zo6, zi1ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他名字里有个「翊」字，意思是帮助、支持。
examples.english_sentence: His name contains the character "翊", which means to assist or support.

mandarin_meaning: 翌（yì）：次日、第二天；随后、接着（多用于书面语）
english_meaning: A literary/formal character meaning 'next' or 'following' (as in 'the next day')
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词 / 时间名词（书面语）
explanation_mandarin: ‘翌’为书面或古汉语用字，常与日、年等字连用表示紧接着的那一天或那一年，如‘翌日’、‘翌年’。
explanation_english: A literary/formal character used to indicate the next or following time period, commonly seen in compounds like '翌日' (the next day) or '翌年' (the following year).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我哋翌日再處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 dei6 jik6 jat6 zoi6 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事我们翌日再处理。
examples.english_sentence: We'll handle this matter the next day.

mandarin_meaning: 翌年（yìnián）——指某一年之後的那一年，次年
english_meaning: the following year; the year after (a referenced year)
explanation_mandarin: 表示相对于某一指定年份的下一年，可作时间名词或时间副词，常見於書面或較正式的語境。
explanation_english: Refers to the year following a referenced year. Used as a time noun or adverbial; commonly found in written or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我去年買咗樓，翌年先至可以搬入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 heoi3 nin4 maai5 zo2 lau4, jik6 nin4 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 bun1 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我去年買了樓，翌年才可以搬進去。
examples.english_sentence: I bought an apartment last year; I could only move in the following year.

mandarin_meaning: 次日；第二天（書面或文言用法）
english_meaning: the next day; the following day (formal/written)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 時間名詞/時間副詞（書面用法）
explanation_mandarin: 「翌日」用來表示「第二天、隔天」，較常見於書面或較正式的語境。
explanation_english: Indicates the next day or the following day. It is more literary or formal and often used in written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋約好今晚開會，翌日再跟進計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 joek3 hou2 gam1 maan5 hoi1 wui2, jik6 jat6 zoi3 gan1 zeon3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們約好今晚開會，第二天再跟進計劃。
examples.english_sentence: We agreed to meet tonight and follow up on the plan the next day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份文件需要喺翌日內交返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 seoi1 jiu3 hai2 jik6 jat6 noi6 gaau1 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份文件需要在次日內交回來。
examples.english_sentence: This document needs to be returned by the next day.

mandarin_meaning: 翎毛；鳥類的羽毛，尤指尾羽或用作裝飾的長羽
english_meaning: plume; feather (especially tail feathers or ornamental long feathers)
explanation_mandarin: 指鳥類的羽毛，常指尾羽或用來裝飾的長羽，也常見於文學或成語中作描寫用語。
explanation_english: Refers to bird feathers, often tail feathers or long ornamental plumes; used in literal and literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻孔雀嘅翎好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 hung2 zoek3 ge3 ling4 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這隻孔雀的翎毛很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The peacock's plumage is very beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: 習、學習、練習；習慣
english_meaning: to practice; to study; to get used to; habit
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞（也可作名詞，表示習慣）
explanation_mandarin: 表示學習或練習某種技能，也可表示養成的習慣。常見於構詞如「習慣」、「學習」。
explanation_english: Indicates studying or practicing something, or becoming accustomed to it. Often appears in compounds like '習慣' (habit) and '學習' (study).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應該習下廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jing1 goi1 zaap6 haa5 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你應該學習／練習廣東話。
examples.english_sentence: You should practice/learn Cantonese.

mandarin_meaning: 习以为常（xí yǐ wéi cháng）——对某种情况或行为长期习惯，认为正常、不再觉得奇怪或惊讶。
english_meaning: To be used to something; to regard something as normal or commonplace; to take for granted.
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某種情況或行為因長期接觸而習慣，覺得理所當然或不再感到奇怪。
explanation_english: Indicates being accustomed to a situation or behavior through long exposure, so that one regards it as normal and is no longer surprised or bothered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家成日塞車，我都習以為常喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sing4 jat6 sak1 ce1, ngo5 dou1 zaap6 ji5 wai4 soeng4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经常塞车，我都习以为常了。
examples.english_sentence: There are traffic jams all the time now; I'm used to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期加班，佢已經習以為常，唔會再投訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 gaa1 baan1, keoi5 ji5 ging1 zaap6 ji5 wai4 soeng4, m4 wui5 zoi3 tau4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期加班，他已经习以为常，不会再抱怨。
examples.english_sentence: After long-term overtime, he's become used to it and no longer complains.

mandarin_meaning: 習以為常
english_meaning: to be used to something; to regard as normal; to take something for granted
explanation_mandarin: 指對某種情況或現象習慣了，認為是正常的，不再感到驚訝或關注。
explanation_english: Indicates becoming so accustomed to a situation or phenomenon that one regards it as normal and is no longer surprised or concerned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企隔離經常有嘈音，久而久之我都習以爲常啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 gaak3 lei4 ging1 soeng4 jau5 cou4 jam1, gau2 ji4 gau2 zi1 ngo5 dou1 zaap6 ji5 wai4 soeng4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡隔壁經常很吵，久而久之我都習以為常了。
examples.english_sentence: The neighbors are noisy all the time; after a while I got used to it.

mandarin_meaning: 習作（學生為練習寫作或完成作業而寫的文章或練習）
english_meaning: a written exercise or composition produced for practice or schoolwork
explanation_mandarin: 指學生為練習寫作或做練習題而寫的文章或作業，常見於學校教材或課堂布置。
explanation_english: Refers to a piece of written work or exercise created by a student to practice writing or complete assigned exercises, commonly used in school contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日交咗一篇習作俾老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 gaau1 zo2 jat1 pin1 zaap6 zok3 bei2 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天交了一篇習作給老師。
examples.english_sentence: I handed in a composition to the teacher today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰本習作簿有好多題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bun2 zaap6 zok3 bou6 jau5 hou2 do1 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那本習作簿有很多題目。
examples.english_sentence: That exercise book has many problems.

mandarin_meaning: 習俗（xísú）：指社會或群體長期形成的生活方式、風俗和禮儀
english_meaning: customs; social or folk practices and conventions
explanation_mandarin: 習俗是指一個社會、地區或群體在日常生活、節慶、禮儀等方面長期形成並沿襲的行為模式與規範。
explanation_english: Customs are the habitual practices, rituals, and conventions that a society, community, or group has developed and maintained over time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅習俗同我喺屋企見過嘅好唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 zaap6 zuk6 tung4 ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei5 gin3 gwo3 ge3 hou2 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這裡的習俗跟我在家看到的很不同。
examples.english_sentence: The customs here are very different from those I saw at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每逢節日，嗰度嘅習俗都會好熱鬧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 fung4 zit3 jat6, go2 dou6 ge3 zaap6 zuk6 dou1 wui5 hou2 jit6 naau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每逢節日，那裡的習俗都很熱鬧。
examples.english_sentence: During festivals, the customs there are always lively.

mandarin_meaning: 習性（指習慣性或反覆出現的行為傾向或性格特點）
english_meaning: habit; habitual tendency; disposition
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人長期形成的行為模式或傾向，常用來描述習慣、性格中固定的表現。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's long-established behavior pattern or tendency; commonly used to describe habitual actions or stable traits in one's character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有拖延嘅習性，成日遲交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 to1 jin4 ge3 zaap6 sing3, sing4 jat6 ci4 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有拖延的習性，常常遲交作業。
examples.english_sentence: He has a habit of procrastinating and often hands in homework late.

mandarin_meaning: 习惯 (xíguàn) — 习性；习惯于（表示已适应或形成的行为）
english_meaning: habit; to be used to; customary practice
explanation_mandarin: 表示长期形成的习惯或对某事物已适应，也可作动词表示“习惯于”。
explanation_english: Indicates a habitual behavior or being accustomed to something; can be used as a noun (habit) or as a verb phrase meaning 'to be/get used to'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經習慣早起身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 zaap6gwaan3 zou2 hei2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经习惯早起。
examples.english_sentence: I'm already used to getting up early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食完飯之後，我習慣飲杯茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 jyun4 faan6 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zaap6gwaan3 jam2 bui1 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃完饭后，我习惯喝一杯茶。
examples.english_sentence: After eating, I usually drink a cup of tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢未習慣呢度嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mei6 zaap6gwaan3 ni1 dou6 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还不习惯这里的生活。
examples.english_sentence: He's not yet used to life here.

mandarin_meaning: 染上、沾染（坏习惯或不良倾向）；受影响
english_meaning: to pick up or contract (a habit, vice, or bad influence); to be influenced/tainted
explanation_mandarin: 表示受到他人或環境影響而慢慢沾染某種習慣、壞毛病或不良風氣，也可指逐漸養成某種習慣。
explanation_english: Indicates gradually acquiring or being influenced by a habit, vice, or bad practice due to people or environment; can also mean forming a habit over time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個成日見到屋企人抽煙，慢慢就習染咗呢個壞習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 gin3 dou3 uk1 kei5 jan4 cau1 jin1, maan6 maan6 zau6 zaap6 jim5 zo2 ni1 go3 waai6 zaap6 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候常看到家人抽烟，慢慢就染上了这个坏习惯。
examples.english_sentence: As a child I often saw family members smoking, and gradually picked up this bad habit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新員工好容易被舊同事嘅壞習氣習染。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jyun4 gung1 hou2 ji6 bei6 gau6 tung4 si6 ge3 waai6 zaap6 hei3 zaap6 jim5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新员工很容易被旧同事的不良风气影响或沾染。
examples.english_sentence: New employees are easily influenced by the bad practices of older colleagues.

mandarin_meaning: 习武 / 练武（学习武术）
english_meaning: to practice martial arts; to learn martial arts
explanation_mandarin: 指學習或練習武術、拳術或其他格鬥技的動作或過程。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or process of learning or practicing martial arts, such as boxing, kung fu, or other fighting techniques.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就開始習武，依家已經好叻喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 ci2 zaap6 mou5, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hou2 lak6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候就开始习武，现在已经很厉害了。
examples.english_sentence: He started practicing martial arts when he was young; now he is really skilled.

mandarin_meaning: 把错误当成正确；把非对的事习以为常
english_meaning: To regard wrong actions or ideas as correct; to come to accept errors as right through habit
explanation_mandarin: 指把錯誤的看法或做法視為正確，久而久之成為習慣或普遍現象。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to treat wrong views or practices as if they were right, often because they have become habitual or widely accepted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有啲流程唔啱，但無人糾正，久而久之就習非成是。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 di1 lau4 cing4 m4 ngaam1, daan6 mou4 jan4 gau2 zing3, gau2 ji4 gau2 zi1 zau6 zaap6 fei1 sing4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有些流程不太對，但沒有人糾正，久而久之就習非成是。
examples.english_sentence: Some procedures in the company are incorrect, but nobody corrects them; over time these mistakes have come to be accepted as right.

mandarin_meaning: 翔（xiáng）：飞翔、翱翔
english_meaning: to soar; to fly; to glide
explanation_mandarin: 「翔」本義為飛翔、翱翔，常見於書面語或用作人名、形容飛行姿態。
explanation_english: The character 翔 means to soar or fly. It is often used in literary contexts or in personal names to evoke flying or lofty imagery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想自由飛翔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zi6 jau4 fei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想自由地飞翔。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to fly freely.

mandarin_meaning: 閉合；收攏；合攏（多見於文言或書面語）
english_meaning: to close together; to draw together; to unite (literary/classical usage)
explanation_mandarin: 翕為一個較偏文言的字，表示閉合、收攏或合攏的動作，常見於複合詞如「翕合」。在現代口語中較少單獨使用。
explanation_english: A relatively literary/classical character meaning to close together, contract, or unite. It appears in compounds such as '翕合' and is seldom used alone in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩扇門翕合咗，冇縫隙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 sin3 mun4 hip6 hap6 zo2, mou5 fung4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两扇门翕合了，没有缝隙。
examples.english_sentence: The two doors closed together, leaving no gap.

mandarin_meaning: 眨眼；使眼色
english_meaning: to wink; to blink (deliberately to signal someone)
explanation_mandarin: “翕眼”指快速闭合并张开眼睛以示意或传情、开玩笑等，类似“眨眼”或“使眼色”。
explanation_english: “翕眼” means to close and open the eyes quickly as a signal or expression (e.g., to wink or make a gesture with the eyes).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢向我翕咗一隻眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng3 ngo5 hap6 zo2 jat1 zek3 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他向我眨了一下眼睛。
examples.english_sentence: He winked at me.

mandarin_meaning: 姓氏；一種鳥（古書中指雉類、鳳毛之類的鳥）
english_meaning: surname Zhai; a type of bird (archaic/poetic, often pheasant-like)
explanation_mandarin: 「翟」常作姓氏使用，在古代文獻中也用來指雉類或帶有羽毛色彩的鳥，屬於文語或書面用法。
explanation_english: “翟” is commonly used as the surname Zhai. In classical or literary Chinese it can also refer to a pheasant-like bird or ornamental-feathered bird.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有個朋友姓翟，佢好風趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 go3 pang4 jau5 sing3 zaak6, keoi5 hou2 fung1 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有个朋友姓翟，他很风趣。
examples.english_sentence: I have a friend surnamed Zhai; he is very witty.

mandarin_meaning: cuì（青綠色；翡翠、玉石）
english_meaning: emerald; emerald-green; bright green; jade
explanation_mandarin: 表示青綠色或用來指翡翠、玉石等，常見於複合詞如「翠綠」「翡翠」。亦可作人名或形容色澤鮮豔。
explanation_english: Refers to a bright green color or to jade/emerald. Often appears in compounds like "翠綠" or "翡翠"; can describe vivid green color or be used in names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊翡翠好翠，好值錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 fei1 ceoi3 hou2 ceoi3, hou2 zik6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊翡翠很翠，很值錢。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of jade is very green and valuable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 春天山上啲樹葉變得翠綠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceon1 tin1 saan1 soeng6 di1 syu6 jip6 bin3 dak1 ceoi3 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 春天山上的樹葉變得翠綠。
examples.english_sentence: In spring, the leaves on the mountain turn emerald green.

mandarin_meaning: （蔬菜名稱）翠玉瓜，常指某些綠色的瓜類品種（在部分地區可指西葫芦、节瓜等）
english_meaning: A green gourd/squash; in Cantonese usage (especially Hong Kong) it can refer to certain varieties of zucchini or other green squashes
explanation_mandarin: 一种绿色的瓜类蔬菜。香港粤语口语或菜市场标示中，有时将某些西葫芦或节瓜品种称为“翠玉瓜”，可用于煲汤、清炒或蒸煮等料理。
explanation_english: A green gourd or squash. In Cantonese (notably in Hong Kong) the name is sometimes used to label certain varieties of zucchini or similar green squashes. Used in soups, stir-fries, or steaming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽去街市買咗啲翠玉瓜，今晚用嚟煲湯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 heoi3 gaai1 si5 maai5 zo2 di1 ceoi3 juk6 gwaa1, gam1 maan5 jung6 lai4 bou1 tong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽去菜市场买了些翠玉瓜，今晚用来煲汤。
examples.english_sentence: Mom went to the market and bought some cuìyù gua; we'll use them to make soup tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺超市我見到一款標籤寫住翠玉瓜，其實係一種西葫芦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ciu1 si5 ngo5 gin3 dou2 jat1 fun2 biu1 cim1 se2 zyu6 ceoi3 juk6 gwaa1, kei4 sat6 hai6 jat1 zung2 sai1 wu4 lou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在超市我看到一种标签写着“翠玉瓜”，其实是一种西葫芦。
examples.english_sentence: At the supermarket I saw a label reading 'cuiyu gua' — it's actually a type of zucchini.

mandarin_meaning: 翠绿（cuì lǜ），指像翡翠一样鲜艳明亮的绿色
english_meaning: emerald green; a bright, vivid green color
explanation_mandarin: 形容顏色，指像翡翠那樣鮮豔或明亮的綠色，常用來描述植物、山水或布料等。
explanation_english: An adjective describing a bright, vivid green color reminiscent of jade or emerald; often used for foliage, landscapes, or fabrics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 山上嘅樹木翠綠，景色好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saan1 soeng6 ge3 syu6 muk6 ceoi3 luk6, ging2 sik1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 山上的树木翠绿，景色很美。
examples.english_sentence: The trees on the mountain are emerald green; the scenery is beautiful.

mandarin_meaning: （古义）红色的玉；现代多用于“翡翠”一词，指翡翠玉或翡翠的颜色（通常为翠绿色）
english_meaning: Originally a character for reddish jade; nowadays mainly seen in the compound '翡翠' (jadeite) and associated with emerald/green color
explanation_mandarin: ‘翡’为汉字，古代常指红色的玉石。现代汉语中多出现在复合词如“翡翠”，用来指一种玉（翡翠）或描述其颜色（翠绿色）。单字‘翡’在口语中单独使用较少，常与‘翠’配对出现。
explanation_english: The character '翡' historically referred to reddish jade. In modern usage it mainly appears in compounds such as '翡翠' (jadeite) and is associated with a green/emerald color. The single character is rarely used alone in everyday speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊玉石帶有翡色，好珍貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 juk6 sek6 daai3 jau5 fei1 sik1, hou2 zan1 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块玉石带有翡色，很珍贵。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of jade has a 'fei' color and is very precious.

mandarin_meaning: 指意大利城市佛羅倫斯的文藝式稱呼（翡冷翠亦作詩意譯名）
english_meaning: A poetic/literary name for the city of Florence, Italy
explanation_mandarin: 翡冷翠是對意大利城市佛羅倫斯的一種文藝、詩意的稱呼，字面帶有翡翠般的色彩意象，常見於旅遊、文學或廣告等語境中作為別名或修辭用法。
explanation_english: A literary or poetic name for Florence, Italy. The term evokes a jade-like (green) image and is used in travel writing, literature, or promotional contexts as a stylistic or evocative alternative to the standard place name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去翡冷翠旅行，想去睇烏菲茲美術館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 fei1 laang5 ceoi3 leoi5 hang4, soeng2 heoi3 tai2 wu1 fei1 zi1 mei5 seot6 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去翡冷翠旅行，想去参观乌菲兹美术馆。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Florence (翡冷翠) next month; I want to visit the Uffizi Gallery.

mandarin_meaning: 翡翠（指翡翠玉）；翠鸟（鸟类）
english_meaning: jadeite (a type of jade); kingfisher (bird)
explanation_mandarin: 翡翠一方面指一種珍貴的玉石（翡翠玉），常用來做珠寶；另一方面也是對翠鳥等小型鮮豔鳥類的稱呼。
explanation_english: 翡翠 can refer to jadeite, a valuable gem used in jewelry, or to the kingfisher, a small brightly colored bird.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條翡翠手鐲好靚，幾時買嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 fei1 ceoi3 sau2 zoek3 hou2 leng3, gei2 si4 maai5 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条翡翠手镯很漂亮，什么时候买的？
examples.english_sentence: This jadeite bangle is very beautiful; when did you buy it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公園見到隻翡翠喺河邊捕魚，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 jyun4 gin3 dou2 zek3 fei1 ceoi3 hai2 ho4 bin1 bou6 jyu4, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公园看到一只翠鸟在河边捕鱼，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: I saw a kingfisher fishing by the river in the park; it was very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 振翅高飞；飞翔（书面语）
english_meaning: to soar; to fly (literary)
explanation_mandarin: 文言或書面語用字，形容鳥類振翅高飛、翱翔。
explanation_english: A literary verb meaning to soar or fly, typically used for birds in written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雄鷹喺藍天上翥，睇落好威。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung4 jing1 hai2 laam4 tin1 soeng6 zyu6, tai2 lok6 hou2 wai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雄鹰在蓝天上翥，看起来很威武。
examples.english_sentence: The hawk soars in the blue sky, looking very majestic.

mandarin_meaning: 剪；剪裁；铲除、消灭（书面语）
english_meaning: to cut; to trim or shear; to eliminate or eradicate (literary/formal)
explanation_mandarin: “翦”多用于书面或古文，表示用剪或刀切割、裁剪，也可引申为铲除、消灭。
explanation_english: A literary/formal verb meaning to cut or trim (as with scissors); can also mean to eliminate or eradicate. Rarely used as a noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 裁縫師用剪刀翦布做衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coi4 fung4 si1 jung6 zin2 dou1 zin2 bou3 zou6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裁缝师用剪刀剪布做衣服。
examples.english_sentence: The tailor uses scissors to cut fabric to make clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝廷命人翦除叛黨，恢復地方秩序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ciu1 ting4 ming6 jan4 zin2 ceoi4 bun6 dong2, wui1 fuk6 dei6 fong1 zat6 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 朝廷命人铲除叛党，恢复地方秩序。
examples.english_sentence: The court ordered the removal of the rebel faction to restore local order.

mandarin_meaning: 翦除 (jiǎnchú)：消除、根除、剷除（多用於正式或書面語）
english_meaning: to eradicate; to eliminate completely; to cut out
explanation_mandarin: 表示把不良事物徹底剪除或消滅，常見於正式或書面語，用於政治、治理或除害等語境。
explanation_english: Indicates completely cutting out or eradicating something undesirable. Commonly used in formal or written contexts, e.g., governance, pest control, or rooting out corruption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要翦除貪污問題，先可以恢復民心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3fu2 jiu3 zin2 ceoi4 taam1wu1 man6tai4, sin1 ho2 ji5 fui1fuk6 man4sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要翦除貪污問題，才能恢復民心。
examples.english_sentence: The government must eradicate corruption before it can restore public trust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場要徹底翦除害蟲，唔好等到成災。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jiu3 cit3 dai2 zin2 ceoi4 hoi6 cung4, m4 hou2 dang2 dou3 sing4 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 農場要徹底翦除害蟲，不要等到成災。
examples.english_sentence: The farm must thoroughly eliminate pests; don't wait until there's a full-blown infestation.

mandarin_meaning: 翩（piān）：輕盈、飄然，多用於“翩翩”或“翩翩起舞”等詞語，表示動作優雅、輕快
english_meaning: pin: graceful; light and fluttering (often used in compounds like '翩翩' or '翩翩起舞' to describe graceful movement)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 副詞（常見於複合詞或成語中）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective / adverb (commonly appears in compounds or idioms)
explanation_mandarin: “翩”是個比較書面或詩意的字，常用於“翩翩起舞”等表現動作輕盈、優雅的詞語中。
explanation_english: A literary/poetic character meaning graceful or lightly fluttering. Commonly found in compounds and idioms such as '翩翩起舞' to describe elegant, light movements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢翩翩起舞，姿態非常優雅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pin1 pin1 hei2 mou5, zi1 taai3 fei1 soeng4 jau1 ngaa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他翩翩起舞，姿態非常優雅。
examples.english_sentence: He/She danced gracefully, with very elegant posture.

mandarin_meaning: 翩翩（piānpiān）— 形容姿态轻快、优雅，常用于“翩翩起舞”等。
english_meaning: graceful; elegant; light and fluttering (describing movements or manner)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词/形容词（可作状语或定语）
explanation_mandarin: “翩翩”用于形容动作轻盈、优雅、飘然，如“翩翩起舞”“翩翩而至”。语气偏书面、文雅。
explanation_english: Describes light, graceful, or elegant movements or manner. Often appears in literary or set phrases such as '翩翩起舞' (to dance gracefully).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢翩翩起舞，好有氣質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pin1 pin1 hei2 mou5, hou2 jau5 hei3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他翩翩起舞，很有气质。
examples.english_sentence: She danced gracefully and looked very elegant.

mandarin_meaning: 形容舞姿輕盈、優美地起舞。
english_meaning: to dance lightly and gracefully; to glide or whirl in elegant dance.
explanation_mandarin: 「翩翩起舞」多用來描寫舞者舞姿輕巧、優美，也可用作比喻形容舉止或活動輕快優雅。
explanation_english: A literary idiom describing someone dancing with light, graceful movements. It can also be used metaphorically to describe actions or behavior that are elegant and lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舞者喺台上翩翩起舞，掌聲連連。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 ze2 hai2 toi4 soeng6 pin1 pin1 hei2 mou5, zoeng2 sing1 lin4 lin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 舞者在台上翩翩起舞，掌聲連連。
examples.english_sentence: The dancers moved gracefully on stage, receiving continuous applause.

mandarin_meaning: 翰（hàn）：筆、文辭、書寫；常見於複合詞中，如翰墨、翰林。
english_meaning: han (classical): pen/brush, writing or literary composition; often appears in compounds (e.g. calligraphy, Hanlin Academy).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞（常用於複合詞，表示書寫或文詞相關）
partOfSpeech_english: noun/adjective (used in compounds referring to writing, literature, or calligraphy)
explanation_mandarin: ‘翰’原指羽毛、筆，延伸為書寫、文辭之意，主要出現在書面或古典詞語中，如‘翰墨’（書法）、‘翰林’（翰林院）。
explanation_english: Originally referring to feathers or a writing brush, '翰' has come to mean writing or literary style. It is mainly used in literary or classical compounds such as '翰墨' (calligraphy) and '翰林' (Hanlin Academy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考入咗翰林院，將來可能做官。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 jap6 zo2 hon4 lam4 jyun6, zoeng1 loi4 ho2 nang4 zou6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考入了翰林院，將來可能做官。
examples.english_sentence: He was admitted to the Hanlin Academy; he may become an official in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意翰墨，成日練書法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 hon4 mak6, sing4 jat6 lin6 syu1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜歡翰墨，整天練習書法。
examples.english_sentence: He loves calligraphy and practices writing with brush and ink all the time.

mandarin_meaning: （动）在空中盘旋、飞翔；常见于书面语和合成词如“翱翔”
english_meaning: to soar; to hover or circle in the air (often literary; used in compounds like 'to soar')
explanation_mandarin: “翱”指在空中飞翔或盘旋，多用于书面语或与“翔”组成“翱翔”表示高远飞行。
explanation_english: The character means to soar or hover in the air, often used in literary contexts or in compounds such as '翱翔' meaning to fly high and freely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老鷹喺天空翱翔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jing1 hai2 tin1 hung1 ngou4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老鹰在天空翱翔。
examples.english_sentence: The eagle is soaring in the sky.

mandarin_meaning: 翱翔（áoxiáng）：在天空中自由飛翔，盤旋
english_meaning: to soar; to fly freely or hover in the sky; (figurative) to rise or roam freely
explanation_mandarin: 指鳥類或飛行物在空中自由地飛行、盤旋；也常用作比喻，形容人在事業或理想上自由高飛、展翅發展。
explanation_english: Describes birds or flying objects soaring or circling freely in the sky; often used figuratively to describe a person freely pursuing ambitions or rising in their career.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老鷹喺天空中翱翔，令人心生敬畏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo5 jing1 hai2 tin1 hung1 zung1 ngo4 coeng4, ling6 jan4 sam1 saang1 ging3 wai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老鹰在天空中翱翔，令人心生敬畏。
examples.english_sentence: The eagle soars in the sky, inspiring awe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年輕人應該有夢想，勇敢喺世界上翱翔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 hing1 jan4 jing1 goi1 jau5 mung6 soeng2, jung5 gam2 hai2 sai3 gaai3 soeng5 ngo4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年輕人應該有夢想，勇敢在世界上翱翔。
examples.english_sentence: Young people should have dreams and bravely soar across the world.

mandarin_meaning: 遮蔽、遮挡；（医学）指眼睛表面或晶状体的混浊，形成遮挡（如白内障）
english_meaning: to cover or obscure; (medical) a film or opacity over the eye (e.g. cataract)
explanation_mandarin: 古漢語中可表示遮蔽、遮挡，在醫學語境常指眼睛的混濁或膜狀遮擋，會影響視力。
explanation_english: Literary/archaic term meaning to cover or obscure. In medical contexts it refers to an opacity or film over the eye (affecting vision).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻眼有翳，要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 ngaan5 jau5 ngai3, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的眼睛有翳，要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: He has a film over his eye and needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 把情緒或秘密悶在心裡／隱藏於內心深處
english_meaning: to keep feelings or secrets to oneself; to bottle up emotions
explanation_mandarin: 「翳五臟廟」是廣東話的口語表達，字面上指遮蓋五臟（內臟），引申為將情緒、煩惱或秘密悶在心裡、不向人表露。多用來形容一個人不願意傾訴或把不快悶在心內。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase literally meaning 'cover the five organs.' It figuratively refers to keeping emotions, troubles, or secrets inside and not revealing them to others — i.e., bottling up one's feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明唔開心，但係一直翳五臟廟，冇同任何人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 m4 hoi1 sam1, daan6 hai6 jat1 zik6 ai3 ng5 zong6 miu6, mou5 tung4 jam6 ho4 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明不開心，但一直把情緒悶在心裡，沒有跟任何人說。
examples.english_sentence: He was obviously unhappy, but kept his feelings to himself and didn't tell anyone.

mandarin_meaning: 感到尷尬／窘迫
english_meaning: to feel awkward or embarrassed; to be in an awkward/tight spot
explanation_mandarin: 「翳侷」是廣東話的口語說法，表示在某種情境下感到尷尬、窘迫或不知如何應對。常用於描述氣氛不自在或行為受限的狀況。
explanation_english: “翳侷” is a colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to feel awkward, embarrassed, or put in a tight/awkward spot. It describes an uncomfortable atmosphere or a situation where someone doesn’t know how to act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講到嗰啲敏感話題，大家都覺得好翳侷，唔敢再講落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 dou3 go2 di1 man5 gam2 waa6 tai4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 ai3 guk6, m4 gam2 zoi3 gong2 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 說到那些敏感話題，大家都覺得很尷尬，不敢再說下去。
examples.english_sentence: When those sensitive topics came up, everyone felt very awkward and didn't dare to continue talking.

mandarin_meaning: 憋悶、悶悶不舒服（可指胸悶或情緒鬱悶）
english_meaning: stuffy; oppressive; feeling suffocated or emotionally low
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一種悶悶不舒服的感覺，可以是身體上胸悶、呼吸不暢，也可以指情緒上的憋悶、悶悶不樂。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of stuffiness or oppression—physically (chest tightness, poor ventilation) or emotionally (sulky, downhearted).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐喺密封嘅房間會覺得好翳悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co5 hai2 mat6 fung1 ge3 fong4 gaan1 wui5 gok3 dak1 hou2 ai3 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐在密閉的房間會覺得很憋悶。
examples.english_sentence: Sitting in a sealed room can feel very stuffy.

mandarin_meaning: 鬱悶、悶悶不樂、耍脾氣
english_meaning: sulky; sullen; in a bad mood; sulking
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，形容一個人心情不好、悶悶不樂或耍脾氣、鬧情緒。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term describing someone who is in a bad mood, sullen, sulking, or easily irritable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好翳氣，乜嘢都唔想講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ai3 hei3, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 soeng2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天很翳氣（很悶），什麼都不想說。
examples.english_sentence: He's in a sulk today; he doesn't want to talk about anything.

mandarin_meaning: 闷热、空气不流通
english_meaning: stuffy and oppressive (hot, lacking ventilation)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容天氣或室內空間悶熱、缺乏通風，讓人覺得窒悶不舒服。
explanation_english: Describes weather or an enclosed space that is hot, stuffy and lacking ventilation, causing a stifling, uncomfortable feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日成日都好翳焗，屋企冇風真係好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 ngai3 guk6, uk1 kei2 mou5 fung1 zan1 hai6 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天整天又闷又热，家里没有风真的很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: It's been stuffy and hot all day — there's no breeze at home and it feels really uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 悶熱
english_meaning: hot and stuffy; sultry; muggy
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用語，表示天氣或環境悶熱、潮濕、令人不舒服的狀態，也可形容人體感到悶熱不適。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term describing sultry, hot and humid conditions (muggy) or the uncomfortable feeling caused by oppressive heat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好翳熱，成日出汗，好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 ai3 jit6, sing4 jat6 ceot1 hon4, hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天很悶熱，一直出汗，覺得很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: It's very hot and humid today; I'm sweating constantly and feeling uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 把心裡的話或情緒憋在肚子裡（不說出來）
english_meaning: to bottle up feelings or keep matters to oneself (not say what's on one's mind)
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話詞彙，表示將心事、苦衷或情緒壓在心裡、不說出來，長期如此會導致壓力或不快。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to keep one's feelings, worries, or complaints inside instead of expressing them; doing so can lead to stress or unhappiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日翳肚唔講，結果壓力好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ai3 tou5 m4 gong2, git3 gwo2 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是把話憋在肚子裡不說，結果壓力很大。
examples.english_sentence: He always bottles things up and doesn't speak; as a result he was under a lot of stress.

mandarin_meaning: 翹 (qiáo)：抬起、翹起、突出；口語中與「課/班」等合用表示逃課或曠工
english_meaning: to raise/stick up/protrude; (colloquial Cantonese) to skip class or skip work (when used in compounds like 翹課/翹班)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某物抬起或翹起、突出。廣東話口語中，與「課」「班」等連用（如「翹課」「翹班」）表示逃避上課或不上班。
explanation_english: Means to lift, stick up, or protrude. In Cantonese colloquial use, when combined with words like '課' or '班' (e.g. 翹課, 翹班) it means to skip class or skip work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日翹課，成績愈來愈差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 kiu4 fo3, sing4 zik1 jyu6 loi4 jyu6 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常翹課，成績越來越差。
examples.english_sentence: He often skips class; his grades are getting worse and worse.

mandarin_meaning: 翘楚；杰出的人物，某一领域中最优秀者
english_meaning: an outstanding person; a leading figure or outstanding talent in a field
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一领域中出类拔萃、最优秀的人物，常用于称赞或评价。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who stands out as the most outstanding or eminent in a particular field; often used to praise or describe a top figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺音樂界係公認嘅翹楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jam1 ngok6 gaai3 hai6 gung1 jing6 ge3 kiu4 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在音乐界是公认的翘楚。
examples.english_sentence: He is widely recognized as a leading figure in the music world.

mandarin_meaning: 抬起；翹起（指身體某部位向上或向外翹）
english_meaning: to lift up; to raise; to stick up or curl up (a body part)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把身體的某一部分（如頭、腳、嘴角等）向上或向外抬起、翹起的動作或狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates the action or state of raising or sticking up a part of the body (e.g., head, feet, corner of the mouth).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢翹起頭望住天，好似諗緊嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kiu4 hei2 tau4 mong6 zyu6 tin1, hou2 ci5 lam2 gan2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他抬起頭望着天空，好像在思考。
examples.english_sentence: He lifted his head to look at the sky, as if thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢坐係張櫈上，翹起腳，舒服晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 co5 hai6 zoeng1 dang3 seong6, kiu4 hei2 goek3, syu1 fuk6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他坐在椅子上，翹起腳，真舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He sat on the chair with his feet up, feeling very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到禮物，佢個嘴角都翹起咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 lai5 mat6, keoi5 go3 zeoi2 gok3 dou1 kiu4 hei2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到禮物，他的嘴角都翹起了。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the gift, the corner of his mouth lifted.

mandarin_meaning: 翘首以待（表示殷切等待某事的发生）
english_meaning: To wait eagerly; to look forward with great anticipation
explanation_mandarin: 比喻抬起頭來期待，形容非常期待或急切等待某個事件的發生。
explanation_english: A figurative expression meaning to raise one's head in expectation; to await something eagerly and with anticipation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家都翹首以待新劇上映。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 dou1 kiu4 sau2 ji5 doi6 san1 kek6 soeng5 jing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都翘首以待新剧上映。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone is eagerly awaiting the premiere of the new drama.

mandarin_meaning: 翻（翻转；再、反复；翻译）
english_meaning: to flip/turn over; to repeat/do again; (in compounds) to translate
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词（有时作副词/前缀表示再次）
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also indicate repetition/again or appear in compounds meaning 'translate')
explanation_mandarin: 「翻」在粤语常读作 faan1，主要用来表示翻转、翻动、反复或表示再次；在合成词中亦可表示翻译等意义。
explanation_english: In Cantonese (faan1), the character '翻' commonly means to flip or turn over, to repeat/do again, or to indicate repetition; in compounds it can mean to translate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煎蛋記得翻一面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin1 daan6 gei3 dak1 faan1 jat1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煎蛋记得翻一面。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to flip the fried egg to the other side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日翻嚟翻去講同一樣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 faan1 lei4 faan1 heoi3 gong2 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常反复说同样的话。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps repeating the same thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章要翻譯成英文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 jiu3 faan1 jik6 sing4 jing1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章要翻译成英文。
examples.english_sentence: This article needs to be translated into English.

mandarin_meaning: 反复；来回翻动；一再（也可指在床上翻来覆去，睡不着）
english_meaning: repeatedly; over and over; back and forth; (also) tossing and turning in bed
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事反复发生或來回變動，也可用來形容人在床上翻身、無法入睡或不停思考同一件事。
explanation_english: Indicates something happening repeatedly or back-and-forth; can also describe someone tossing and turning in bed or repeatedly thinking about the same thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成晚翻來覆去，瞓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 maan5 faan1 loi4 fuk1 heoi3, fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整晚翻來覆去，睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: He/she tossed and turned all night and couldn't sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗咗成日都係翻來覆去諗同一樣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam2 zo2 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 faan1 loi4 fuk1 heoi3 lam2 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想了整天還是反反覆覆地想同一件事。
examples.english_sentence: I've been thinking about the same thing over and over all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋翻來覆去改呢個計劃，最後都未有定案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 faan1 loi4 fuk1 heoi3 goi2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 mei6 jau5 ding6 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們反覆修改這個計劃，最後仍然沒有定案。
examples.english_sentence: They kept revising the plan back and forth and still didn't reach a decision.

mandarin_meaning: 翻身；翻來翻去（在床上）
english_meaning: to turn over; to roll over (especially in bed); to toss and turn
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，指人在床上由一邊翻到另一邊（翻身、輾轉），也可指把物件翻到另一面。常用於描述睡覺不安穩或頻繁翻動的狀況。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to turn over or roll over (usually in bed). Often used to describe tossing and turning or repeatedly changing position; can also mean flipping an object to its other side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚瞓覺嗰陣，佢成日翻側，訓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 fan3 gaau3 go2 zan6, keoi5 sing4 jat6 faan1 zak1, fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上睡覺時，他老是翻來翻去，睡不著。
examples.english_sentence: At night when trying to sleep, he keeps tossing and turning and can't fall asleep.

mandarin_meaning: 把口袋翻出来、翻遍口袋（也指搜身或把某人口袋里的东西掏出来）；口语中可指扒窃或把别人兜里的钱掏光
english_meaning: to turn out one's pockets; to rummage through someone's pockets; (slang) to rob/pickpocket someone or to empty someone's pockets
explanation_mandarin: 「翻兜」原指把衣服或裤子的口袋翻出來查看或整理，口语中常用来表示搜身、翻弄别人衣兜或扒走、掏尽别人财物的动作。
explanation_english: Originally means to turn a pocket inside out to check or tidy it. Colloquially used to mean rummaging through someone's pockets, frisking, or (slang) pickpocketing/emptying someone's pockets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，啲扒手成日係巴士度翻兜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, di1 paa4 sau2 sing4 jat6 hai6 baa1 si2 dou6 faan1 dau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，扒手经常在巴士上翻别人的口袋。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, pickpockets often turn out people's pockets on the bus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢驚俾人翻兜，所以唔帶太多現金。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geng1 bei2 jan4 faan1 dau1, so2 ji5 m4 daai3 taai3 do1 jin6 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他害怕被人翻口袋，所以不带太多现金。
examples.english_sentence: He's afraid of having his pockets rummaged, so he doesn't carry much cash.

mandarin_meaning: 翻印（重新印刷或複製已印刷的資料）
english_meaning: to reprint; to reproduce printed material
explanation_mandarin: 指將已經印刷過的書籍、文件等再次印製或複製，通常用於再版或製作拷貝。
explanation_english: Refers to printing again or reproducing materials that have already been printed, typically used for reissuing or making copies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲文件有版權，未經授權唔可以翻印。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 man4 gin6 jau5 baan2 kyun4, mei6 ging1 sau6 kyun4 m4 ho2 ji5 faan1 jan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些文件有版权，未经授权不能翻印。
examples.english_sentence: These documents are copyrighted; you cannot reprint them without permission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰本小說已經絕版，出版社決定翻印再版。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bun2 siu2 seot3 ji5 ging1 zyut6 baan2, ceot1 baan2 se5 kyut3 ding6 faan1 jan3 zoi3 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那本小说已经绝版，出版社决定翻印再版。
examples.english_sentence: That novel had been out of print; the publisher decided to reprint it.

mandarin_meaning: 重新加熱（通常用微波爐）
english_meaning: to reheat (usually in a microwave)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，指把已冷的食物再次加熱，常指放入微波爐「叮」熱。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to heat food again, commonly by using a microwave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個飯凍咗，要唔要翻叮先食？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faan6 dung3 zo2, jiu3 m4 jiu3 faan1 ding1 sin1 sik6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個飯冷了，要不要重新加熱才吃？
examples.english_sentence: This rice has gone cold — do you want to reheat it before eating?

mandarin_meaning: 翻唱 (fānchàng)：重新演唱別人已發表的歌曲
english_meaning: to cover (a song); to perform/record someone else's song
explanation_mandarin: 指重新演繹或演唱他人已發表的歌曲，常加入不同的編曲或個人風格。
explanation_english: To perform or record a song that was originally released by someone else, often with a new arrangement or personal interpretation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近好紅，成日喺社交媒體翻唱熱門歌曲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hou2 hung4, sing4 jat6 hai2 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 faan1 coeng3 jit6 mun4 go1 kuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近很紅，經常在社交媒體翻唱熱門歌曲。
examples.english_sentence: They're really popular lately; they keep posting covers of hit songs on social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想唔想翻唱呢首歌？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 faan1 coeng3 ni1 sau2 go1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想不想翻唱這首歌？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to cover this song?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢翻唱嗰個版本比原唱更加有感情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan1 coeng3 go2 go3 baan2 bun2 bei2 jyun4 coeng3 gang1 gaa1 gau3 jau5 gam2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他翻唱的那個版本比原唱更有感情。
examples.english_sentence: His cover version is more emotional than the original.

mandarin_meaning: 反覆啄食；（比喻）反覆挑剔或反覆糾纏、來回爭執
english_meaning: to peck repeatedly (literally); figuratively, to pick at or nitpick repeatedly, to bicker/back-and-forth over small matters
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指鳥類反覆用嘴啄食；口語中可用來形容人對細節反覆挑剔或雙方來回爭執、糾纏不休。
explanation_english: Literally describes a bird pecking repeatedly. Colloquially it can describe someone repeatedly picking at details, nitpicking, or parties going back-and-forth in an argument.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻鳥成日喺窗台翻啄啲麵包屑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 niu5 sing4 jat6 hai2 coeng1 toi4 faan1 zoek3 di1 min6 baau1 sit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻鳥一直在窗臺上翻啄麵包屑。
examples.english_sentence: The bird kept pecking at the breadcrumbs on the windowsill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋唔好成日翻啄細節，會拖慢成個專案進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 faan1 zoek3 sai3 zit3, wui5 to1 maan6 sing4 go3 zyun1 on3 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你們不要老是為細節反覆挑剔，會拖慢整個專案進度。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep nitpicking the details — it will slow down the whole project's progress.

mandarin_meaning: 暗自嘲笑；偷笑（帶有輕蔑或取笑意味）
english_meaning: to snigger or sneer (secretly mock or laugh at someone, often scornfully)
explanation_mandarin: 「翻啅」是香港口語中的俚語，指在背後或暗中笑話、嘲弄別人，帶有輕蔑或譏諷的意味，通常是不公開的大聲嘲笑，而是小聲或帶諷刺地笑。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang verb meaning to snigger or mock someone secretly—to laugh or sneer (often scornfully) behind someone's back or in a low, derisive way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺背後翻啅我，真係好討厭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 bui3 hau6 faan1 zeot3 ngo5, zan1 hai6 hou2 tou2 jim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常在背後暗自嘲笑我，真讓人討厭。
examples.english_sentence: He often snickers at me behind my back — it's really annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 回来 (huílái)
english_meaning: come back; return; (also used in reduplicated form to mean go back and forth)
explanation_mandarin: 表示回到原来的地方或返回；在口语中也可用于重复形式（如“翻嚟翻去”）表示来回、反复的动作。
explanation_english: Indicates returning to a place or coming back. In colloquial Cantonese it can also appear in reduplicated form (e.g. "翻嚟翻去") to mean going back and forth or repeating an action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幾時翻嚟香港？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei2 si4 faan1 lai4 hoeng1 gong2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你什么时候回来香港？
examples.english_sentence: When will you come back to Hong Kong?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經走咗，但遲啲會翻嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2, daan6 ci4 di1 wui5 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经走了，但一会儿会回来的。
examples.english_sentence: He already left, but he'll come back later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日翻嚟翻去諗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 faan1 lai4 faan1 heoi3 lam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要老是反反复复地想了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep going back and forth thinking about it.

mandarin_meaning: 翻天覆地（成语），形容变化巨大、彻底的变动或动荡不安
english_meaning: An idiom meaning dramatic or earth-shattering change; tremendous upheaval; drastic transformation
explanation_mandarin: 原指天地顛倒、動盪不安，現多用來形容事物發生極大、徹底的變化或翻天覆地的轉變。
explanation_english: Originally referring to heaven and earth being turned over, it now describes extremely large or thorough changes — a complete upheaval or dramatic transformation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從新政策實施，社會變化真係翻天覆地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 san1 zing3 caak3 sat6 si1, se5 wui6 bin3 faa3 zan1 hai6 faan1 tin1 fuk1 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从新政策实施，社会变化真的是翻天覆地。
examples.english_sentence: Since the new policy was implemented, society has changed drastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出名之後，人生翻天覆地，從平凡變到咁有錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 ming4 zi1 hau6, jan4 sang1 faan1 tin1 fuk1 dei6, cung4 ping4 faan4 bin3 dou3 gam2 jau5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出名之后，人生翻天覆地，從平凡變得如此有錢。
examples.english_sentence: After he became famous, his life underwent dramatic changes, going from ordinary to very wealthy.

mandarin_meaning: 翻越山岭；跋山涉水，指越过重重山岭，常用以形容路途艰难或历尽辛劳去到某处
english_meaning: to cross mountains and ridges; to make a long/arduous journey (often implying overcoming many difficulties)
explanation_mandarin: 成语/习语。原指翻越山岭，现多用来形容为达某目的而历经艰辛、奔波跋涉。
explanation_english: An idiomatic phrase meaning to traverse mountains and ranges; used figuratively to describe going through great hardship or traveling a long, difficult route to achieve something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋翻山越嶺嚟幫手，真係好感激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 faan1 saan1 jyut6 ling5 lai4 bong1 sau2, zan1 hai6 hou2 gam2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们翻山越岭来帮忙，真的很感激。
examples.english_sentence: They crossed mountains to come and help; we're really grateful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗完成呢個工程，佢哋翻山越嶺調查咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 gung1 cing4, keoi5 dei6 faan1 saan1 jyut6 ling5 diu6 caa4 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了完成这个工程，他们翻山越岭调查了很久。
examples.english_sentence: To complete this project, they traversed mountains and surveyed for a long time.

mandarin_meaning: 抄写、复制（有时含抄袭的意思）
english_meaning: to copy out; to transcribe; to copy (sometimes implying plagiarism)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把別人的文字或資料抄過來或重抄，有時帶有抄襲、不經創作的負面含義。
explanation_english: Means to copy someone else's text or materials or to recopy; can carry a negative sense of plagiarism when used about others' work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好翻抄人哋嘅功課，要自己寫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 faan1 caau1 jan4 dei6 ge3 gung1 fo3, jiu3 zi6 gei2 se2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要抄别人的功课，要自己写。
examples.english_sentence: Don't copy other people's homework; do it yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成篇文章都係翻抄嚟嘅，結果俾人話係抄襲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 pin1 man4 zoeng1 dou1 hai6 faan1 caau1 lai4 ge3, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 waa6 caau1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整篇文章都是抄来的，結果被人说是抄襲。
examples.english_sentence: He copied the whole article; as a result people accused him of plagiarism.

mandarin_meaning: 和好；复合
english_meaning: to get back together (a couple); to reconcile after a breakup
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俗语，指分手或闹翻之后重新和好、复合，通常用于情侣之间。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning to reconcile or get back together after a breakup, typically used for romantic partners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋分手咗幾個月，啱啱又翻撻喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fan1 sau2 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6, ngaam1 ngaam1 jau6 faan1 taat3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们分手了几个月，刚刚又复合了。
examples.english_sentence: They broke up for a few months, and just got back together.

mandarin_meaning: 翻新 (fānxīn)：翻修、整修或更新，使舊的物品、房屋或設備看起來或功能恢復得較新
english_meaning: to renovate; to refurbish; to renew (make something old look or function more like new)
explanation_mandarin: 表示對房屋、家具、設備或物品進行修理、改造或更新，使其恢復或接近新的狀態。也可指電子產品等的翻新/翻修處理（如翻新機）。
explanation_english: Refers to repairing, remodeling, or updating a house, furniture, equipment, or item to restore or make it more like new. It can also refer to refurbished electronics (e.g., a refurbished device).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋要翻新，先至賣得貴啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 jiu3 faan1 san1, sin1 zi3 maai6 dak1 gwai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間房子要翻新，才能賣得比較貴。
examples.english_sentence: This house needs renovating before it can be sold for a higher price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部手機係翻新機，價錢平，但保養期短啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 sau2 gei1 hai6 faan1 san1 gei1, gaa3 cin4 peng4, daan6 bou2 joeng5 kei4 dyun2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機是翻新的，價格便宜，但保固期比較短。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is refurbished; it's cheaper but has a shorter warranty period.

mandarin_meaning: 翻本 / 收回损失；翻盘
english_meaning: to recoup losses; to make a comeback; to turn the tables
explanation_mandarin: 指把先前的亏损（通常是金钱）追回来，或把不利的局面扭转过来，常用於赌博、投资或生意场合。
explanation_english: Refers to recovering previous losses (usually money) or reversing an unfavorable situation; often used in gambling, investment, or business contexts to mean making a comeback or breaking even and profiting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次輸咗兩千，我要翻本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syu1 zo2 loeng5 cin1, ngo5 jiu3 faan1 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次输了两千，我要翻本。
examples.english_sentence: I lost two thousand this time; I need to make it back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢慢慢賺返啲，終於翻本喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maan6 maan6 zaan6 faan1 di1, zung1 jyu1 faan1 bun2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他慢慢赚回了一些，终于翻本了。
examples.english_sentence: He slowly earned some back and finally recouped his losses.

mandarin_meaning: 翻查；查閱（資料、記錄等）
english_meaning: to look up; to search through records or documents
explanation_mandarin: 表示檢視或翻閱資料、記錄或檔案，以查找所需資訊或核實內容。
explanation_english: To examine or search through documents, records, or files in order to find information or verify details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想翻查一下舊電郵，睇下有冇重要資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 faan1 caa4 jat1 haa5 gau6 din6 jau4, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 zung6 jiu3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想翻查一下舊電郵，看看有沒有重要資料。
examples.english_sentence: I want to look up my old emails to see if there is any important information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方已經翻查監控錄影，尋找案發時間的線索。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 fong1 ji5 ging1 faan1 caa4 gam1 hung3 luk6 jing2, cam4 zoek3 on3 faat3 si4 gaan3 dik1 sin3 sok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方已經翻查監控錄像，尋找案發時間的線索。
examples.english_sentence: The police have checked the surveillance footage to look for clues about the time of the incident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果要報稅，你要翻查所有收據同發票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jiu3 bou3 seoi3, nei5 jiu3 faan1 caa4 so2 jau5 sau1 geoi3 tung4 faat3 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果要報稅，你要翻查所有收據和發票。
examples.english_sentence: If you need to file taxes, you should go through all the receipts and invoices.

mandarin_meaning: 推翻（既定的）判决或结论，重新审理案件；比喻扭转舆论或恢复名誉。
english_meaning: to overturn a verdict or reverse a previously decided case; to reopen and reverse a legal judgment; figuratively, to reverse public opinion or restore someone's reputation.
explanation_mandarin: 指对已经结案或已有结论的案件重新审理并推翻原判；在非法律语境下可指扭转先前的结论或评价，恢复名誉。
explanation_english: Refers to re-examining and overturning an already decided legal case or verdict. In non-legal contexts it can mean reversing a previous conclusion or public judgment, restoring reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢要求重啟調查，等法庭可以翻案，還佢清白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jiu1kau4 cung4 hei2 diu6 caa4, dang2 faat3 ting4 ho2 ji5 faan1 on3, waan4 keoi5 cing1 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他要求重启调查，让法庭可以翻案，还他清白。
examples.english_sentence: He is asking to reopen the investigation so the court can overturn the verdict and clear his name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單新聞出咗條震撼嘅證據，可能會令件事翻案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 san1 man4 ceot1 zo2 tiu4 zan3 ham6 ge3 zing3 geoi3, ho2 nang4 wui5 ling6 gin6 si6 faan1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这则新闻出现了震撼性的证据，可能会使事件翻案。
examples.english_sentence: This news revealed shocking evidence that could lead to the case being overturned.

mandarin_meaning: 再次變回渣（人）；又當渣男/渣女
english_meaning: to revert to being a scumbag (esp. in relationships); to behave selfishly or hurtfully again
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人在感情或行為上又回復到自私、無責任或傷人的「渣」的狀態，通常指原本似乎改變或分手後，卻重新做出令人失望或傷害人的行為。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone reverting to scummy, selfish, or hurtful behavior—often in relationships—after appearing to improve or after a breakup; essentially 'being a scumbag' again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢分手之後又同舊愛聯絡，真係翻渣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan1 sau2 zi1 hau6 jau6 tung4 gau6 oi3 lyun4 lok3, zan1 hai6 faan1 zaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他分手後又和舊愛聯絡，真的是又變回渣男／渣女。
examples.english_sentence: He contacted his ex after breaking up — he's really gone back to being a scumbag.

jyutping: faan1 zaa1 caa4 -- mou5 lei4 mei6 dou6
mandarin_meaning: 翻舊料／翻舊帳——帶有無厘頭、荒誕或沒有新意的感覺
english_meaning: Rehashing old gossip/scandal — with a nonsensical or gimmicky tone (no substance, mo lei tau flavor)
explanation_mandarin: “翻渣茶”字面為把茶渣再沖一次，隱喻把舊料、舊事重提或翻炒；“冇厘味道”指帶有無厘頭、荒誕或沒有邏輯、沒有新意的味道。合起來常用以形容某人或某篇內容只是重複舊八卦、且表現荒誕、毫無建設性或新意。
explanation_english: Literally 're-steeping tea dregs' (faan1 zaa1 caa4) — figuratively to rehash old gossip/scandals; 'mou5 lei4 mei6 dou6' means it has a 'mo lei tau' (nonsensical) flavor. Together the phrase criticizes someone or something for recycling stale material in a silly, illogical, or unoriginal way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度翻渣茶，寫啲嘢又冇厘味道，大家都唔想睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 faan1 zaa1 caa4, se2 di1 je5 jau6 mou5 lei4 mei6 dou6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 soeng2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在那裡翻舊料，寫的東西又很無厘頭，大家都不想看。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps rehashing old gossip and what he writes is nonsensical; nobody wants to read it.

mandarin_meaning: 翻滚（翻身、打滚；比喻情绪翻腾或剧烈波动）
english_meaning: to roll; to tumble; to roll about; (figurative) to churn or be in turmoil
explanation_mandarin: 表示在地面或其他表面上翻身、打滾或滾動；也可用作比喻，形容情緒、思緒翻騰不安。
explanation_english: Denotes physically rolling or tumbling on a surface; can also be used figuratively to describe emotions or thoughts churning or being in turmoil.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲小朋友喺草地上翻滾，整到件衫污糟晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 cou2 dei6 soeng6 faan1 gwan2, zing2 dou3 gin6 saam1 wu1 zou1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友在草地上翻滾，把衣服弄得很髒。
examples.english_sentence: The kids were rolling on the grass and got their clothes all dirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到嗰件事之後心入面翻滾，夜晚都訓唔着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 go2 gin6 si6 zi1 hau6 sam1 jap6 min6 faan1 gwan2, je6 maan5 dou1 fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到那件事後心裡翻滾，晚上都睡不著。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing about it, his mind was in turmoil and he couldn't sleep at night.

mandarin_meaning: 翻炒（烹飪）；（比喻）反覆重提或炒作舊話題
english_meaning: to stir-fry (again); to rehash or repeatedly bring up/rehash an old topic
explanation_mandarin: 1) 烹飪術語，指在鑊中把食材翻動並炒；2) 口語/媒體用法，指重新提出、反覆報導或炒作舊的事件或話題。
explanation_english: 1) Culinary term meaning to stir and fry ingredients in a wok (often again); 2) Colloquial/media usage meaning to bring up, rehash, or repeatedly report an old issue or story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢道餸唔夠鑊氣，要翻炒吓先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 sung3 m4 gau3 wok6 hei3, jiu3 faan1 caau2 haa5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜没有锅气，要再翻炒一下才行。
examples.english_sentence: This dish lacks wok hei; it needs to be stir-fried again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媒體又再翻炒舊聞，受害人好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui4 tai2 jau6 zoi3 faan1 caau2 gau6 man4, sau6 hoi6 jan4 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媒体又在翻炒旧闻，受害人很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: The media are rehashing old news again — it's hard on the victims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再翻炒呢單舊事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 faan1 caau2 ni1 daan1 gau6 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再翻炒这件旧事了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't rehash this old matter again.

mandarin_meaning: 翻墙（字面：翻越牆；引申：翻越網路封鎖/使用工具訪問被屏蔽的網站）
english_meaning: to climb over a wall (literal); to bypass internet censorship / use tools (VPN, proxies) to access blocked websites (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 「翻牆」可指字面上翻越實體牆壁，也常用作網絡術語，指使用 VPN、代理等技術繞過網絡封鎖以訪問被屏蔽的網站。
explanation_english: Literally 'to climb over a wall.' Commonly used as internet slang to mean using VPNs or proxies to bypass online censorship and access blocked sites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多香港人都會翻牆上外國嘅網站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 jan4 dou1 wui5 faan1 coeng4 soeng5 ngoi6 gwok3 ge3 mong5 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很多香港人會翻牆訪問外國的網站。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many Hongkongers use tools to bypass censorship to visit foreign websites.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個人翻牆入咗屋企畀警察捉咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 jan4 faan1 coeng4 jap6 zo2 uk1 kei2 bei2 ging2 caat3 zuk1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個人翻牆進了屋子被警察抓住了。
examples.english_sentence: That person climbed over the wall into the house and was caught by the police.

mandarin_meaning: 翻版（fānbǎn）：复制品、翻印、重制；也指与先前作品非常相似的重复之作
english_meaning: a copy/reproduction; a reprint or remake; something that is essentially a repeat or carbon-copy of an earlier work
explanation_mandarin: 指通过复制、翻印或重制得到的版本，也可用于形容某作品与先前作品高度相似，像是重复出品或翻拍。
explanation_english: Refers to a reproduced or reprinted version of something; can also describe a work that closely mirrors an earlier one (a remake or near-identical repeat).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套電影簡直係舊作嘅翻版。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 din6 jing2 gaan2 zik6 hai6 gau6 zok3 ge3 faan1 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影简直就是旧作的翻版。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is basically a copy of the earlier work.

mandarin_meaning: 復活 / 起死回生 / 恢復生機
english_meaning: to revive; to come back to life; to recover from a near-failure; to get a second chance
explanation_mandarin: 表示從瀕死、瀕臨失敗或極度低迷的狀態中恢復過來，重新獲得生機或機會。可用於醫療、經濟或比喻性情況。
explanation_english: Means to be revived or come back to life; to recover from a near-death or near-failure state and regain vitality or a second chance. Used for medical resuscitation, business recovery, or figurative situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個病人本來冇呼吸，經過搶救而家翻生喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 beng6 jan4 bun2 loi4 mou5 fu1 kap1, ging1 gwo3 coeng2 gau3 ji4 gaa1 faan1 saang1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個病人本來沒呼吸，經過搶救現在復活了。
examples.english_sentence: The patient originally had no breathing; after the resuscitation he has come back to life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司業績一度下跌，推出新產品之後終於翻生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jip6 zik1 jat1 dou6 haa6 dit3, ceot1 teoi1 san1 caan2 ban2 zi1 hau6 zung1 jyu1 faan1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司業績一度下滑，推出新產品之後終於恢復生機。
examples.english_sentence: The company's performance had fallen for a while, but after launching a new product it finally recovered.

mandarin_meaning: 重发；重新发送/发布
english_meaning: to resend; to reissue; to repost
