examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候經常和表親一起去媽媽家玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid I often went to my mom's house to play with my cousins.

mandarin_meaning: 岳父；老婆的父親
english_meaning: father-in-law (specifically the wife's father)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語的親屬稱謂，通常指配偶（特別是妻子）的父親。在香港粵語口語中常用來稱呼或提到岳父。
explanation_english: A Cantonese kinship term typically referring to one's father-in-law (usually the wife's father). Commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese when addressing or referring to the wife's father.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我帶埋啲禮物去見老襟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 daai3 maai4 di1 lai5 mat6 heoi3 gin3 lou5 gam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我要帶禮物去見岳父。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I'm going to bring gifts to meet my father-in-law.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）丈夫、老公
english_meaning: husband; hubby (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗稱，通常由妻子或女性伴侶用來稱呼自己的丈夫，語氣可親暱或戲稱，與「老公」相似。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term typically used by a wife or female partner to refer to her husband. It is similar to 'hubby' or 'old man' and can be affectionate or teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日同老襯去買餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 tung4 lou5 can3 heoi3 maai5 sung3。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天和老公去買菜。
examples.english_sentence: I went grocery shopping with my husband today.

mandarin_meaning: （疑為粵語俚語/地區用語）指老舊、老字號或經營多年的小攤檔／攤位（用法不廣，可能為地方口語或誤寫）
english_meaning: (likely regional Cantonese slang) an old/stablished stall or small vendor booth; a long-running, familiar market stall (rare/obscure usage; may be a local term or a misheard form)
explanation_mandarin: 「老襯亭」為粵語口語或地區性用語，字面上可拆為「老」（年久、老牌）＋「襯亭」（此處作攤位/檔口之意）。詞彙使用較少見，可能用來稱呼街市或巷口的老舖、老字號小檔口，或是地方方言變體。若遇到此詞建議向說話者確認具體含義或是否為別字／誤聽。
explanation_english: “老襯亭” appears to be a rare or regional Cantonese slang term. Literally it combines “old” with a component suggesting a stall/booth; in practice it would likely refer to an old, long-established market stall or vendor booth. Usage is uncommon and may be a local variant or a misheard/mistyped form — when encountered, check with the speaker for the exact sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿叔喺街市有間老襯亭，做咗三十年喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 suk1 hai2 gaai1 si5 jau5 gaan1 lou5 can3 ting4, zou6 zo2 saam1 sap6 nin4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 叔叔在街市有一個老襯亭，做了三十年了。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle has an old stall in the market; he's been running it for thirty years.

mandarin_meaning: （某人或某物）原本不受注意或過時，但突然變得流行、走紅或搶手。
english_meaning: An old or unfashionable person or thing that suddenly becomes fashionable, popular, or in demand.
explanation_mandarin: 「老襯當旺」常用於粵語口語，指原本冷門、舊式或過時的東西（或人）突然重新受到歡迎，變得搶手或熱潮回歸。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang phrase used to describe something (or someone) that was previously out of fashion or overlooked but suddenly becomes trendy, popular, or in high demand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲舊衫而家老襯當旺，間舖日日有好多客嚟買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gau6 saam1 ji4 gaa1 lou5 can3 dong1 wong6, gaan1 pou3 jat6 jat6 jau5 hou2 do1 haak3 lai4 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些旧衣服現在突然變得很受歡迎，店裡每天都有很多顧客來買。
examples.english_sentence: Those old clothes have suddenly become very popular — the shop gets lots of customers every day.

mandarin_meaning: 西方人；洋人（口語）
english_meaning: a Westerner; a Western person (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，指西方人或洋人。語氣通常非正式，視語境可中性、親切或帶有輕微貶義／戲謔意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term referring to Westerners/people from the West. Usage is informal and can be neutral, friendly, or mildly derogatory depending on context and tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個老西好好人，幫我哋指路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 lou5 sai1 hou2 hou2 jan4, bong1 ngo5 dei6 zi2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個老西（西方人）人很好，幫我們指路。
examples.english_sentence: That Westerner was really nice and helped us with directions.

mandarin_meaning: 很會說話、善於解釋或找理由（廣東話俚語，口語用法）
english_meaning: slang for someone who is good at explaining, talking their way out, or finding justifications (colloquial Cantonese)
explanation_mandarin: 「老解」是廣東話口語俚語，通常用來形容一個人很會說話、善於解釋事情或為自己找藉口、把話說得頭頭是道。用法非正式，常見於香港日常對話。
explanation_english: “老解” is a colloquial Cantonese slang term used to describe someone who is good at talking — able to explain things well, talk their way out of situations, or come up with justifications. It is informal and commonly used in everyday speech in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好老解，咩問題都可以搵到講法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 lou5 gaai2, me1 man6 tai4 dou1 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou3 gong2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很會說話，什麼問題都能找到說法。
examples.english_sentence: He's really good at talking; he can find a way to explain any problem.

mandarin_meaning: 老頭；（口語）老公/那個男人；（口語）老人
english_meaning: old man; (colloquial) the old man (husband) or guy; elderly man
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用詞，主要指年紀較大的男士（老人家），也可泛指某個男人或口語稱呼自己的丈夫／伴侶。語氣可親暱也可帶貶義，依上下文與語氣而定。常見於香港話語環境。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term mainly meaning an older man or elderly gentleman. It can also be used loosely to refer to a man in general or, informally, one's husband/partner. Tone can be affectionate or derogatory depending on context and speaker. Common in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個老記行得好慢，我哋等一陣先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 lou5 gei3 hang4 dak1 hou2 maan6, ngo5 dei6 dang2 jat1 zan6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個老頭走得很慢，我們等一下再走。
examples.english_sentence: That old man walks very slowly; let's wait a moment before we go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日掛住個老記，唔理屋企嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gwaa3 zyu6 go3 lou5 gei3, m4 lei5 uk1 kei2 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她整天掛念著她的老公，不管家的事。
examples.english_sentence: She's always preoccupied with her old man and ignores the household matters.

mandarin_meaning: 老调重弹 / 再次重复老观点或老话题
english_meaning: To repeat the same old refrain; to rehash old ideas, complaints, or arguments
explanation_mandarin: 指再次說出同樣的話或重提已經講過、令人厭倦的內容，通常帶有不耐煩或厭煩的語氣。
explanation_english: Refers to saying the same thing again or bringing up an old, tiresome topic; usually conveys impatience or annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再老調重彈，我真係聽厭喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 lou5 diu6 cung4 daan6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 teng1 jim6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再老调重弹了，我真的听腻了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep repeating the same old thing — I'm really tired of hearing it.

mandarin_meaning: 老謀（多指老謀深算，形容老練、狡猾、深謀遠慮）
english_meaning: shrewd; crafty; calculating (often implying experienced and scheming)
explanation_mandarin: 「老謀」常用於粵語，指人老練且有心機，善於算計或深思熟慮。常見短語為「老謀深算」。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '老謀' describes someone who is experienced and shrewd—often crafty or calculating. It is commonly seen in the fuller phrase '老謀深算'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好老謀，做事成日諗埋幾步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lou5 mau4, zou6 si6 sing4 jat6 nam2 maai4 gei2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很老謀，做事總是想到好幾步。
examples.english_sentence: He's very shrewd; he always thinks several steps ahead when doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位中介好老謀，簽約之前要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 zung1 gaai3 hou2 lou5 mau4, cim1 joek3 zi1 cin4 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位中介很老謀，簽約之前要小心。
examples.english_sentence: This agent is quite crafty; be careful before signing the contract.

mandarin_meaning: 老謀深算 (lǎo móu shēn suàn)：形容人有豐富經驗，善於謀劃且計算深遠，通常帶有精明、算計的意思。
english_meaning: old and deeply scheming; shrewd, highly strategic and calculating (often implies crafty or cunning).
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人經驗豐富、擅長謀劃與算計，做事深思熟慮且策略性強。有時帶負面含義，指過於算計或老謀深算令人生畏。
explanation_english: Describes someone experienced and very good at planning and calculating; thoughtful and strategic. Can carry a negative nuance of being overly cunning or scheming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事一向老謀深算，唔會衝動決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 jat1 hoeng3 lou5 mau4 sam1 syun3, m4 wui5 cung1 dung6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事一向老謀深算，不會衝動決定。
examples.english_sentence: He always handles things with careful calculation and won't make impulsive decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢老謀深算，但有時會太過算計，令人反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 lou5 mau4 sam1 syun3, daan6 jau5 si4 wui5 taai3 gwo3 syun3 gai3, ling6 jan4 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然他老謀深算，但有時會太過算計，令人反感。
examples.english_sentence: Although he is very calculating, sometimes he can be overly scheming, which puts people off.

mandarin_meaning: 父親；爸爸（粵語俗稱）
english_meaning: dad; father (colloquial Cantonese term)
explanation_mandarin: 「老豆」是香港粵語中對父親的俗稱，語氣可親切或隨意，多用於口語場合。
explanation_english: “老豆” is a colloquial Cantonese term for father or dad, commonly used in Hong Kong in informal spoken contexts, with a familiar or casual tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老豆今日唔返工，喺屋企煮飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 dau6 gam1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1, hai2 uk1 kei5 zyu2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老爸今天不上班，在家做飯。
examples.english_sentence: Dad isn't working today; he's cooking at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日同老豆去釣魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 sing4 jat6 tung4 lou5 dau6 heoi3 diu3 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小時候經常和爸爸去釣魚。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little I often went fishing with my dad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同老豆講咗未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 lou5 dau6 gong2 zo2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你和爸爸說了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Have you told your dad?

mandarin_meaning: 字面為「老貓燒鬚」，比喻經歷過一次教訓或小損失後變得小心謹慎（相當於「一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩」或「吃一堑，长一智」）
english_meaning: Literally "old cat burns its whiskers"; figuratively someone who, after suffering a scare or minor punishment, becomes much more cautious — akin to "once bitten, twice shy."
explanation_mandarin: 俗語，常用來形容即使是有經驗的人，經歷過一次小的教訓或不愉快後便變得畏縮、小心，以免再受損失。
explanation_english: A Cantonese saying used to describe someone — even an experienced person — who becomes wary and cautious after a scare or minor setback; it conveys the idea of learning a lesson from a previous mishap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次差啲遲到，被老闆罰咗錢，之後佢就老貓燒鬚，每日都提早出門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 caa1 di1 ci4 dou3, bei6 lou5 baan2 fat6 zo2 cin2, zi1 hau6 keoi5 zau6 lou5 maau1 siu1 sou1, mui5 jat6 dou1 tai4 ziu1 ceot1 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次差点迟到，被老板罚了钱，之后他就老猫烧须，每天都提前出门。
examples.english_sentence: Last time he almost arrived late and got fined by his boss; after that he became cautious — like an "old cat with burned whiskers" — and now leaves early every day.

synonyms: 一朝被蛇咬，十年怕草繩

mandarin_meaning: （年長女性自稱）我／這個老女人（帶自謙、幽默或戲謔色彩）
english_meaning: A self-referential pronoun used by an older woman to refer to herself, often with self-deprecation, humor, or a theatrical tone (literally "this old woman").
explanation_mandarin: 「老身」是粵語中常見的自稱，主要由年長女性使用。語氣可帶自謙、幽默、戲謔或強調年紀的意味，常見於口語、戲劇或與熟悉的人交談時。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "老身" is a self-referential term primarily used by older women. It can convey humility, humor, self-mockery, or emphasize age, and commonly appears in colloquial speech, theatrical contexts, or familiar conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老身今日唔舒服，想休息下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 san1 gam1 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6, soeng2 jau1 sik1 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天不舒服，想休息一下。
examples.english_sentence: This old woman isn't feeling well today; I want to rest a bit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老身唔使你擔心，我自己處理得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 san1 m4 sai2 nei5 daam1 sam1, ngo5 zi6 gei2 cyu2 lei5 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不用你擔心，我自己能處理好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry about me; I can handle it myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺戲裏面，佢扮演嗰個老太婆時會叫自己『老身』，帶有自嘲同幽默嘅味道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hei3 leoi5 min6, keoi5 baan6 jin2 go2 go3 lou5 taai3 po4 si4 wui5 giu3 zi6 gei2 'lou5 san1', daai3 jau5 zi6 caau1 tung4 jau1 mak6 ge3 mei6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在戲裡，她扮演那個老太婆時會稱自己為「老身」，帶有自嘲和幽默的意味。
examples.english_sentence: In plays, when she portrays the old woman she calls herself '老身', which carries a self-mocking and humorous tone.

mandarin_meaning: 老練、世故、圓滑（有時含貶義，指精明或狡猾）
english_meaning: seasoned; worldly-wise; shrewd — sometimes implying crafty or cunning
explanation_mandarin: 形容人處事老練、世故，做事精明或圓滑。有時帶有負面含義，暗指狡猾或不夠坦率。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is experienced and worldly-wise in dealing with matters; often implies shrewdness or smoothness. Can carry a negative sense of being crafty or not straightforward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意咁多年，做人好老辣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 gam2 do1 nin4, zo6 jan4 hou2 lou5 laat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意這麼多年，處世很老練。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in business for so many years; he's very seasoned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新入職嗰個人睇落單純，但其實幾老辣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jap6 zik1 go2 go3 jan4 tai2 lok6 daan1 seon4, daan6 kei4 sat6 gei2 lou5 laat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新入職的那個人看起來很單純，但其實相當老練。
examples.english_sentence: The new hire looks naive, but is actually quite shrewd.

mandarin_meaning: 老道（lǎodào）：有經驗、老練、世故；有時含貶義，指圓滑或狡猾。
english_meaning: experienced; seasoned; worldly-wise; can imply being slick, crafty or shrewd.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人經驗豐富、處事老練、通曉人情世故；在某些語境下可帶負面含義，指人圓滑或狡猾。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is experienced and seasoned, good at handling situations and worldly-wise; in some contexts it can carry a negative sense of being slick or crafty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好老道，處理客人嘅投訴得心應手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lou5 dou6, cyu2 lei5 haak3 jan4 ge3 tau4 sou3 dak1 sam1 jing3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很老道，處理客人的投訴得心應手。
examples.english_sentence: He's very experienced; he handles customer complaints with ease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做生意好老道，小心佢有啲圓滑手段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 saang1 ji3 hou2 lou5 dou6, siu2 sam1 keoi5 jau5 di1 jyun4 waat6 sau2 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做生意很老道，要小心他有點圓滑的手段。
examples.english_sentence: He's very shrewd in business; be careful, he's a bit slick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新同事問咗好多野，老道啲前輩幫手教佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 tung4 si6 man6 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, lou5 dou6 di1 cin4 bui3 bong1 sau2 gaau3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新同事問了很多問題，有經驗的前輩幫忙教他。
examples.english_sentence: The new colleague asked many questions; the experienced seniors helped teach him.

mandarin_meaning: 很遠；特意從遠處來（副詞）
english_meaning: from far away; a long way off; going out of one's way
explanation_mandarin: 表示從很遠的地方來，或強調特意走很遠的路程，也可用作比喻表示遠遠地、特意地。
explanation_english: Indicates coming from a long distance or emphasizes making a special effort to travel far; can also be used figuratively to mean 'by far' or 'deliberately from afar'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老遠由日本嚟探我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 jyun5 jau4 jat6 bun2 lai4 taam3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他特意從日本來看我。
examples.english_sentence: He came all the way from Japan to visit me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你老遠過嚟幫手，我真係好感激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lou5 jyun5 gwo3 lai4 bong1 sau2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gam2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你特意從遠處過來幫忙，我真的很感激。
examples.english_sentence: You came all the way to help — I'm really grateful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使老遠嚟，呢度都有分店。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 lou5 jyun5 lai4, ni1 dou6 jau5 fan1 dim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用特意從遠處過來，這裡也有分店。
examples.english_sentence: No need to come all the way — there's a branch here too.

mandarin_meaning: 老迈（年纪大、衰老）
english_meaning: aged; advanced in years; feeble from old age
explanation_mandarin: 指年紀很大、體力或精神衰退，常用來形容老人或動物年老虛弱的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes someone (or an animal) who is very old, whose physical strength or mental vigor has declined; often used to refer to elderly or feeble condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都幾老邁，行路要人攙扶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 gei2 lou5 maai6, haang4 lou6 jiu3 jan4 caam1 fu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已經相當老邁，走路需要人攙扶。
examples.english_sentence: He is quite elderly and needs someone to help him walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位老師年紀老邁，但經驗豐富，仍然受學生尊重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai6 lou5 si1 nin4 gei2 lou5 maai6, daan6 ging1 jim6 fung1 fu3, jing4 jin4 sau6 hok6 saang1 zyun1 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位老師年紀雖然老邁，但經驗豐富，仍然受學生尊重。
examples.english_sentence: This teacher is elderly but experienced and is still respected by students.

mandarin_meaning: 老乡 (lǎoxiāng) — 同一故鄉的人；同鄉
english_meaning: fellow villager / someone from the same hometown; countryman
explanation_mandarin: 「老鄉」指來自同一個村莊或同一故鄉的人，常用來表示彼此是同鄉或有相同家鄉背景。
explanation_english: “老鄉” refers to someone from the same village or hometown; used to indicate that two people share the same place of origin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 原來你都係老鄉？我哋係同一個村㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 loi4 nei5 dou1 hai6 lou5 hoeng1? ngo5 dei6 hai6 tung4 jat1 go3 cyun1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 原来你也是老乡？我们是同一个村的！
examples.english_sentence: So you're also a fellow villager? We're from the same village!

mandarin_meaning: 信醫不信卜；依靠醫學而非占卜/算命
english_meaning: Trust doctors/medicine rather than divination or fortune-telling
explanation_mandarin: 一句廣東話俗語，意思是遇到疾病或健康問題應該相信醫學、求醫診治，不要迷信占卜或算命。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb advising people to rely on medicine and doctors rather than superstition or fortune-telling when dealing with illness or health issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生病唔好亂搵算命，老醫少卜，應該去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 beng6 m4 hou2 lyun6 wan2 syun3 ming6, lou5 ji1 siu2 buk1, jing1 goi1 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生病不要亂去找算命，信醫不信卜，應該去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: If you're ill, don't randomly consult fortune-tellers; trust doctors, not divination — you should see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: （香港粵語網絡俚語）指男人、兄弟或泛指某人（相當於「那個人/傢伙/兄弟」）
english_meaning: Hong Kong Cantonese internet slang for a guy/bro; a casual way to refer to someone (like 'that guy' or 'bro')
explanation_mandarin: 常見於香港網絡平台（例如 LIHKG）的粵語俚語，用來非正式地稱呼或指代男性或某個人，語氣隨上下文可親切或貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term commonly used on Hong Kong online forums to refer casually to a man or someone in general. Depending on context it can be friendly or derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好理嗰個老銅，佢淨係識鬧人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lei5 go2 go3 lou5tung4, keoi5 zing6 hai6 sik1 nau6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別理那個人，他只會罵人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pay attention to that guy; he only knows how to insult people.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗）用作加強語氣或感嘆，相當於「非常／他媽的」
english_meaning: (vulgar) used as an intensifier or exclamation meaning 'damn', 'freaking', or 'very'
explanation_mandarin: 「老閉」是香港粵語俚語，多用來加強語氣或發洩情緒，常置於形容詞之前或單獨成句。語氣粗俗，有時帶冒犯意味，屬口語用法。
explanation_english: '老閉' is Hong Kong Cantonese slang used as an intensifier or expletive. It carries a coarse/vulgar tone and is used before adjectives or alone as an exclamation to express strong feeling. It is informal and can be offensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日老閉熱，成個人都流晒汗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lou5 bai3 jit6, seng4 go3 jan4 dou1 lau4 saai3 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天他媽的很熱，整個人都滿頭大汗。
examples.english_sentence: It's damn hot today; I'm sweating all over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老閉！你做咩嘢搞成咁？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 bai3! nei5 zou6 me1 je5 gaau2 sing4 gam2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 該死！你在幹嘛把事情弄成這樣？
examples.english_sentence: Damn! What are you doing to make things like this?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日咁樣，真係老閉煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gam2 joeng6, zan1 hai6 lou5 bai3 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是這樣，真是煩死人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always like that, it's really annoyingly so.

mandarin_meaning: 連（連最不可能的人）都……（粗俗用法，帶貶義）
english_meaning: even (used as a vulgar intensifier; literally 'even the old cunt')
explanation_mandarin: 「老閪都」是香港粵語中的粗俗口語，用作強調或表示「連...都」的意思，帶有貶義或粗話色彩，常用於表示「甚至連最不可能的人或事也會/也知道」。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese intensifier used like 'even...'; literally 'even the old cunt'. It's colloquial and offensive, used to emphasize that even the least likely person or thing would do/know something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事咁明顯，老閪都知，唔使你講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gam2 ming4 hin2, lou5 hai1 dou1 zi1, m4 sai2 nei5 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事這麼明顯，連最不可能的人都知道，不用你說了。
examples.english_sentence: This is so obvious even the least likely person knows — you don't need to say it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好呃人，老閪都唔會信你嗰啲藉口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ngaak1 jan4, lou5 hai1 dou1 m4 wui5 seon3 nei5 go2 di1 zek3 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別騙人，連誰都不會相信你的那些藉口。
examples.english_sentence: Don't lie — nobody would believe those excuses.

mandarin_meaning: 老板 (lǎobǎn)：店主、企業負責人、老闆
english_meaning: boss; owner; shopkeeper
explanation_mandarin: 指商店或公司的負責人或業主，口語中常用來稱呼掌權或經營的人。
explanation_english: Refers to the person in charge of a shop or company — the owner or manager; commonly used informally to address or refer to the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖嘅老闆好好人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 lou5 baan2 hou2 hou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間店的老闆人很好。
examples.english_sentence: The owner of this shop is a very nice person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆，埋單！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2, maai4 daan1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆，結帳！
examples.english_sentence: Boss, the bill please!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司換咗個新老闆，政策改變咗，好多同事都有啲擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wun6 zo2 go3 san1 lou5 baan2, zing3 caak3 goi2 bin3 zo2, hou2 do1 tung4 si6 dou1 jau5 di1 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司換了個新老闆，政策改變了，很多同事都有點擔心。
examples.english_sentence: The company got a new boss; policies changed, and many colleagues are a bit worried.

mandarin_meaning: 老板娘（女店主、老板的妻子）
english_meaning: proprietress; the boss's wife; female shop owner
explanation_mandarin: 指店舖或企業的女性負責人，或指老闆的妻子。廣東話和香港口語常用來稱呼女性店主或店內掌櫃。
explanation_english: Refers to a female proprietor or the wife of the boss. Commonly used in Cantonese to address or refer to a female shop owner or the woman in charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間茶餐廳嘅老闆娘好親切，成日招呼客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 lou5 baan2 noeng4 hou2 can1 cit3, sing4 jat6 ziu1 fu1 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家茶餐廳的老板娘很親切，常常招待客人。
examples.english_sentence: The proprietress of that cha chaan teng is very friendly and often attends to customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係老闆娘，係老闆嘅妹妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 lou5 baan2 noeng4, hai6 lou5 baan2 ge3 mui6 mui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她不是老板娘，是老板的妹妹。
examples.english_sentence: She isn't the boss's wife; she's the boss's younger sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆娘話今晚要提前打烊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 noeng4 waa6 gam1 maan5 jiu3 tai4 cin4 daa2 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板娘說今晚要提前打烊。
examples.english_sentence: The proprietress said the shop will close early tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：老麻雀；俚語：對年長者（多指女性）的貶稱
english_meaning: Literally 'old sparrow'; slang derogatory term for an elderly person (often a woman), similar to 'old biddy' or 'old hag'.
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指年老的麻雀；在香港粵語口語中，『老雀』常用作對年長者（多指女性）的蔑稱或貶稱，帶有不禮貌的語氣。
explanation_english: Literally refers to an old sparrow. In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, '老雀' is often used as a derogatory term for an elderly person (usually a woman), carrying an impolite or contemptuous tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺公園見到一隻老雀，羽毛都灰晒，飛得好慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 lou5 zoek3, jyu5 mou4 dou1 fui1 saai3, fei1 dak1 hou2 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在公園看到一隻老麻雀，羽毛都變灰了，飛得很慢。
examples.english_sentence: I saw an old sparrow in the park; its feathers had turned gray and it flew very slowly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣稱呼佢做老雀，咁樣好失禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng6 cing1 fu1 keoi5 zou6 lou5 zoek3, gam2 joeng6 hou2 sat1 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那樣稱呼她為「老雀」，這樣很沒禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call her 'old sparrow' like that — it's very impolite.

mandarin_meaning: （口語、貶義）很雜亂／很混亂；（形容人）不可靠、做事很馬虎
english_meaning: (colloquial, derogatory) very messy/chaotic; (of a person) unreliable or sloppy
explanation_mandarin: 「老雜」為廣東話口語用法，常用作強調「雜、亂、馬虎」的程度，也可用來罵人做事不可靠或很混亂。屬非正式、帶貶義的說法，多見於香港日常口語。
explanation_english: '老雜' is a Cantonese colloquial expression used to emphasize that something is messy, chaotic, or sloppy. It can also describe a person as unreliable or careless. It is informal and mildly derogatory, common in Hong Kong speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日啲文件搞到好老雜，無人知道點整理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 di1 man4 gin2 gaau2 dou3 hou2 lou5 zaap6, mou5 jan4 zi1 dou3 dim2 zing2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的文件弄得很雜亂，沒人知道怎麼整理。
examples.english_sentence: Today's documents are a mess; no one knows how to organize them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係老雜，約咗人又唔嚟，成日遲到又做錯嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 lou5 zaap6, joek3 zo2 jan4 jau6 m4 lai4, sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3 jau6 zou6 co3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是很不可靠，約了人又不來，常常遲到還做錯事。
examples.english_sentence: He's really unreliable; he makes plans and doesn't show up, is always late, and makes mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）老手；資深人士；也可指古怪/瘋癲的言行（口語、貶義或戲謔用法）
english_meaning: (slang) an old hand / veteran; colloquially can also mean eccentric/crazy behavior or talk (informal, sometimes pejorative or jocular)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 俚語，名詞／形容詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「老電」是香港廣東話的俚語。常用來稱呼在某範疇很有經驗的「老手、資深人士」。在另一種口語用法中，也可用來形容某人言行古怪或說話很離譜（有時帶貶義或戲謔）。屬非正式口語，視語境可為稱讚或貶義。
explanation_english: “老電” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang. It is commonly used to refer to a veteran or an experienced person (an old hand). In another informal use it can describe eccentric or outrageous speech/behavior (sometimes pejorative or joking). It is informal and context-dependent — can be complimentary or derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋班嘅老電，教咗好多新人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 baan1 ge3 lou5 din6, gaau3 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我們組裡的老電，教了很多新人。
examples.english_sentence: He's the veteran in our team and has trained many newcomers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好講咁老電嘢啦，聽落好離譜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gong2 gam2 lou5 din6 je5 laa1, teng1 lok6 hou2 lei4 pou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要說那麼離譜/瘋狂的話，聽起來很誇張。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say such outrageous/crazy things — it sounds way over the top.

mandarin_meaning: 老是頂嘴；愛頂嘴
english_meaning: to habitually talk back; to be argumentative/talk back
explanation_mandarin: 「老頂」是香港廣東話的口語/俚語，用來形容某人經常頂嘴、愛反駁或不服從他人意見。
explanation_english: “老頂” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang used to describe someone who habitually talks back, argues, or frequently contradicts others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老頂老師，成日唔聽指示。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 ding2 lou5 si1, seng4 jat6 m4 ting1 zi2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是頂撞老師，成天不聽指示。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks back to the teacher and never listens to instructions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友唔好老頂，聽返啲人講啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 m4 hou2 lou5 ding2, teng1 faan1 di1 jan4 gong2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友不要老是頂嘴，聽別人說話吧。
examples.english_sentence: Kids, don't keep talking back; listen to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經解釋晒，你仲老頂做咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gaai2 sik1 saai3, nei5 zung6 lou5 ding2 zou6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已經解釋清楚了，你還在頂嘴做什麼？
examples.english_sentence: I've already explained everything; why are you still arguing back?

mandarin_meaning: 年紀較大但性格像小孩般頑皮、愛玩的人（“老頑童”亦可作愛稱或自嘲）
english_meaning: an older person who behaves playfully or mischievously like a child; a playful/mischievous old fellow
explanation_mandarin: 指年紀較大但性格像小孩子般頑皮、愛玩或不拘小節的人。可用作描寫、愛稱或自嘲，帶有親切或戲謔的語氣。
explanation_english: Refers to an older person who acts playful or mischievous like a child. Often used affectionately or jokingly to describe someone who is lively, cheeky, or not overly serious despite their age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿伯雖然年紀大，但係個老頑童，成日同細路仔玩同埋講笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baak3 seoi1 jin4 nin4 gei2 daai6, daan6 hai6 go3 lou5 waan4 tung4, sing4 jat6 tung4 sai3 lou6 zai2 waan2 tung4 maai4 gong2 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位老伯雖然年紀大，但像個老頑童，經常和小孩玩耍並講笑話。
examples.english_sentence: Although the old man is elderly, he's like a mischievous old child — he often plays with kids and tells jokes.

mandarin_meaning: 老头子 / 老头（口语，可指年紀大的男子或對丈夫的戲稱）
english_meaning: old man; (colloquial) the old man / husband; old fellow (can be affectionate or pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，常用來稱呼年長的男性或作為對丈夫的戲稱。語氣可親切、打趣或帶貶義，視語境和說話者語氣而定。
explanation_english: A colloquial term used to refer to an older man or as a teasing/affectionate way to call one's husband. Depending on context and tone it can be affectionate, teasing, or derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個老頭子喺屋企訓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 lou5 tau4 zi2 hai2 uk1 kei2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我那個老頭子在家睡覺。
examples.english_sentence: My old man is sleeping at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個老頭子成日喺度亂講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 lou5 tau4 zi2 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 lyun6 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個老頭子成天在那裡亂說話。
examples.english_sentence: That old geezer is always spouting nonsense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同你個老頭子鬧交啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 nei5 go3 lou5 tau4 zi2 naau6 gaau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別跟你那個老頭子吵架了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't argue with your old man.

mandarin_meaning: 老古董；老派的人（俚語）
english_meaning: old-timer; old-fashioned person; fuddy-duddy (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指思想或行為保守、老派的人，也可泛指年紀較大的人，語氣可帶戲謔或輕微貶義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for someone who is old-fashioned or conservative in attitude or behavior; can also refer to an older person. Tone can be teasing or mildly derogatory depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好老餅，成日唔肯試新嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 lou5 beng2, sing4 jat6 m4 hang2 si3 san1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是個老古董，總是不肯嘗試新事物。
examples.english_sentence: He's such an old-timer; he never wants to try new things.

mandarin_meaning: 老饕（愛好美食的人／美食家）
english_meaning: a foodie; gourmet; gourmand
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指對美食有高度興趣或鑑賞力的人，類似「美食家」或「饕客」。
explanation_english: A colloquial term for a person who loves, seeks out, and appreciates good food — essentially a foodie or gourmet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個老饕，成日搵新餐廳試食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 lou5 tou1, sing4 jat6 wan2 san1 caan1 teng1 si3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個老饕，經常找新的餐廳去試吃。
examples.english_sentence: He's a foodie who often looks for new restaurants to try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你係老饕，可以跟我去夜市睇下啲小食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hai6 lou5 tou1, ho2 ji5 gan1 ngo5 heoi3 je6 si5 tai2 haa5 di1 siu2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你是個老饕，可以跟我去夜市看看小吃。
examples.english_sentence: If you're a foodie, you can come with me to the night market to check out the snacks.

mandarin_meaning: 對姓馮的男性的俗稱或暱稱（普通話寫作「老冯」）
english_meaning: A colloquial way to refer to a man surnamed Fung ("Old Fung" / "Mr. Fung"), often informal or familiar
explanation_mandarin: 「老馮」是粵語中用來稱呼或提到姓馮的男子的俗稱或暱稱。語氣較為非正式，可帶親切、戲謔或視情況略帶不敬的意味，常用於口語和熟人之間。
explanation_english: "Old Fung" is a Cantonese colloquial form of address for a man with the surname Fung. It's informal and can be affectionate, teasing, or, depending on context and tone, mildly disrespectful. Commonly used in spoken language among acquaintances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老馮今日冇返工？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 fung4 gam1 jat6 mou5 faan1 gung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老冯今天沒來上班？
examples.english_sentence: Is Old Fung not coming to work today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好同老馮講嗰啲事，佢好易嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tung4 lou5 fung4 gong2 go2 di1 si6, keoi5 hou2 ji6 naau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要跟老冯說那些事，他很容易生氣。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tell Old Fung about those things; he gets angry easily.

mandarin_meaning: 老家伙；坏狐狸（带戏谑或轻微贬义的称呼）
english_meaning: an old rascal / old devil (playful or mildly derogatory term for a person)
explanation_mandarin: 「老鬼」是粤语口语常用词，可用来表示亲昵的戏谑（如“你個老鬼”当作打趣称呼），也可带有责备或轻微贬义，指狡猾、老练或令人讨厌的人。根据语气和语境，含义可从亲切到侮辱不等。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '老鬼' is a colloquial term used either playfully ('you old rascal') or with mild reproach to describe someone who is crafty, old hand, or annoying. Tone and context determine whether it's affectionate or insulting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個老鬼，又遲到啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 lou5 gwai2, jau6 ci4 dou3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个老家伙，又迟到了！
examples.english_sentence: You old rascal, late again!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個老鬼，成日呃人錢，不可以信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 lou5 gwai2, sing4 jat6 ak1 jan4 cin2, bat1 ho2 ji5 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个老滑头，总是骗别人的钱，不能信他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a sly old fox, always cheating people out of money — you can't trust him.

mandarin_meaning: 老鸨 (lǎo bǎo)：經營妓院或負責安排、牽線賣淫的女性頭目
english_meaning: madam (brothel keeper); a woman who runs or manages a brothel or arranges prostitution
explanation_mandarin: 指在妓院或賣淫活動中擔任經營、管理或仲介角色的女性，常帶有貶義或非法活動的含義。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who runs or manages a brothel or acts as a procuress/agent in prostitution; often carries negative or illegal connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢條街出名嘅老鴇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 tiu4 gaai1 ceot1 ming4 ge3 lou5 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是這條街上有名的老鸨。
examples.english_sentence: She is the notorious madam on this street.

mandarin_meaning: 麦当劳（快餐连锁店的俗称）
english_meaning: McDonald's (the fast-food chain; colloquial name)
explanation_mandarin: 「老麥」是香港廣東話的俗稱，用來指稱快餐連鎖店「麦当劳」。常在口語中使用，例如說「去老麥食嘢」。
explanation_english: “老麥” (lou5 mak6) is Hong Kong Cantonese slang for McDonald's. It's a colloquial, casual name used in everyday speech (e.g., “go to 老麥”).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去老麥食嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 lou5 mak6 sik6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去麦当劳吃东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to McDonald's tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝我喺老麥買咗個早餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ngo5 hai2 lou5 mak6 maai5 zo2 go3 zou2 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上我在麦当劳买了个早餐。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I bought a breakfast at McDonald's.

mandarin_meaning: （一）指姓黎的年長者或對黎姓人士的稱呼；（二）在個別口語情境中可作綽號或俗稱，使用時視語境可能帶有非禮貌或地域色彩
english_meaning: Primarily a casual form of address for an older person with the surname Lai; occasionally used as a colloquial nickname — context-dependent and can be impolite in some uses
explanation_mandarin: 「老黎」字面上是對姓黎的年長者或熟人間的稱呼。它也可能在某些口語或網絡語境中被用作綽號或俗稱。由於屬於口語稱呼，使用時應注意語氣與對象，避免冒犯。
explanation_english: Literally a way to address an older person with the surname Lai. It can also appear as a colloquial nickname in informal contexts. Because it is informal, be mindful of tone and audience — it can offend in some situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老黎係我哋公司嘅財務經理，做嘢好細心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 lai4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 mou6 ging1 lei5, zou6 je5 hou2 sai3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老黎是我们公司的财务经理，做事很细心。
examples.english_sentence: Old Mr. Lai is our company's finance manager; he works very carefully.

mandarin_meaning: 对皮肤较黑的人的称呼（俚语，常带贬义）
english_meaning: A slang term used to refer to a Black person or someone with dark skin; often derogatory
explanation_mandarin: 在香港粤语中，「老黑」常用来称呼皮肤较黑的人，有时作为绰号，但往往带有贬义或歧视意味，可能冒犯别人，应避免使用。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese, "老黑" is a colloquial term used to refer to people with darker skin or Black people. It is slang and often carries derogatory or discriminatory connotations, so it can be offensive and should be avoided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢膚色較深，但唔應該叫佢做「老黑」，咁樣好歧視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu1 sik1 gaau3 sam1, daan6 m4 jing1 goi1 giu3 keoi5 zou6 'lou5 hak1', gam2 joeng6 hou2 kei4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他皮膚較黑，但不應該叫他「老黑」，這樣很歧視。
examples.english_sentence: His skin is darker, but you shouldn't call him 'old black' — that's very discriminatory.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）老點子；老把戲；陳舊的招數
english_meaning: old trick; stale tactic; the same old ruse
explanation_mandarin: 「老點」為廣東話口語用法，常作「老點子」的簡稱，指一成不變、陳舊或常用的把戲、手段或做法，語氣多帶貶義或不耐煩，較常見於香港口語中。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term, often a shortened form of '老點子', referring to an old, predictable trick or stale tactic. It carries a mildly derogatory or dismissive tone and is common in Hong Kong Cantonese speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日用啲老點嚟呃人，大家都唔信佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jung6 di1 lou5 dim2 lai4 aak1 jan4, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 seon3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是用那些老套的把戲騙人，大家都不相信他了。
examples.english_sentence: He always uses those old tricks to deceive people; nobody trusts him anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 老鼠 (lǎoshǔ)，指小型啮齿类动物
english_meaning: mouse; rat
explanation_mandarin: 指小型啮齿动物，如家鼠、田鼠等；在口語中也可用來比喻卑鄙、膽小或偷偷摸摸的人或行為。
explanation_english: Refers to small rodents such as mice and rats (house mice, field mice). In colloquial usage it can also metaphorically describe someone cowardly, sneaky, or despicable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企有老鼠，要打電話搵人滅鼠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jau5 lou5 syu2, jiu3 daa2 din6 waa2 wan2 jan4 mit6 syu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里有老鼠，要打电话找人灭鼠。
examples.english_sentence: There are mice in the house; we need to call someone to exterminate them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢貪污被揭發後，真係老鼠過街，人人喊打。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taam1 wu1 bei6 git3 faat3 hau6, zan1 hai6 lou5 syu2 gwo3 gaai1, jan4 jan4 haam3 daa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他贪污被揭发后，真的成了老鼠过街，人人喊打。
examples.english_sentence: After his corruption was exposed, he really became like a rat in the street — everybody condemned him.

mandarin_meaning: 小老鼠；（俚語）形容狡猾、偷偷摸摸或愛搗蛋的小孩/人
english_meaning: little mouse; (slang) a sneaky or mischievous person (often a child) or someone cowardly/sly
explanation_mandarin: 「老鼠仔」字面上指小老鼠。口語或俚語用法上可用來稱呼頑皮或偷偷摸摸、狡猾的人（有時特指小孩子或賊），語氣可親切、戲謔或帶貶義，視語境而定。
explanation_english: Literally 'little mouse.' In colloquial/slang use it can refer to a small mouse or be used to describe a sneaky, mischievous, or cowardly person (often a child). Tone can be affectionate, teasing, or derogatory depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企入面有隻老鼠仔，嚇到我喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei5 jap6 min6 jau5 zek3 lou5 syu2 zai2, hek3 dou3 ngo5 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家裡有只小老鼠，嚇得我哭了。
examples.english_sentence: There was a little mouse in the house; it scared me and I cried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日偷嘢，真係隻老鼠仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 tau1 je5, zan1 hai6 zek3 lou5 syu2 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是偷東西，真是個小老鼠（指偷偷摸摸、狡猾的人）。
examples.english_sentence: He always steals things; he's such a sneaky little rat.

mandarin_meaning: 老鼠仓（指內部人員或基金經理在公開買賣前暗自買入或挪用客戶資金謀取私利的行為，屬於內幕交易或挪用資金的非法操作）
english_meaning: A form of insider trading / front-running where insiders (e.g., fund managers, brokers) secretly buy securities for personal profit or misuse clients' funds before public transactions.
explanation_mandarin: 俗稱，指金融從業人員利用內幕資訊或管理權限，秘密為自己或關聯戶買入或持有股票、基金等，以待市場波動後獲利，屬違法行為。
explanation_english: A colloquial term for an illegal practice in finance where professionals use insider information or their control over funds to buy securities for themselves or associates ahead of client or public trades, profiting from ensuing price moves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有報導話嗰位基金經理涉嫌搞老鼠倉，依家正接受調查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 bou3dou6 waa6 go2 wai6 gei1gam1 ging1lei5 sip3ham4 gaau2 lou5 syu2 cong1, ji1gaa1 zeng3 zip3sau6 diu6caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有报道说那位基金经理涉嫌搞老鼠仓，现在正接受调查。
examples.english_sentence: Reports say the fund manager is suspected of running a '老鼠仓' (insider trading); he is currently under investigation.

mandarin_meaning: 禍不單行 / 麻煩接踵而至
english_meaning: Troubles never come alone; problems keep coming one after another
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容壞事或麻煩接二連三發生，或小問題引發一連串更大的困擾。
explanation_english: Used to describe misfortunes or problems occurring one after another, or a small issue that triggers a chain of bigger troubles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起初只係一個細小嘅錯，點知老鼠尾生瘡，依家成單嘢搞得好複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 co1 zi2 hai6 jat1 go3 sai3 siu2 ge3 co3, dim2 zi1 lou5 syu2 mei5 saang1 cong1, ji1 gaa1 sing4 daan1 je5 gaau2 dak1 hou2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 起初只是一个小错误，没想到禍不單行，現在整件事變得很複雜。
examples.english_sentence: At first it was just a small mistake; unexpectedly troubles piled up, and now the whole matter has become very complicated.

mandarin_meaning: 字面：老鼠的粪便；引申：比喻損害整體的少數壞分子或一個會破壞整體的小污點（如「一粒老鼠屎壞了一鍋粥」）。
english_meaning: Literal: rat droppings; Figurative: a bad element/person that spoils the whole (a blot or 'one bad apple').
explanation_mandarin: 用來比喻在團體或事情中那個少數會破壞整體的人或事，帶有貶義。也可指微小但影響大的污點。
explanation_english: Used figuratively to refer to a person or small element that harms or spoils the group or overall situation; derogatory. Can also mean a small blemish with a big negative effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入面有個老鼠屎，成日遲到，搞到成件事都麻煩晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jap6 min6 jau5 go3 lou5 syu2 si2, sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3, gaau2 dou3 sing4 gin6 si6 dou1 maa4 faan4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司里有一个害群之马，总是迟到，弄得所有事情都很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: There's a bad apple in the company who's always late and causes trouble for everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 拖拖拉拉 / 慢吞吞 / 磨蹭
english_meaning: to dawdle; to drag one's feet; to move very slowly
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俚语，字面意思是老鼠拉著烏龜，形容做事進展非常緩慢或拖拉不快，多用於口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang phrase literally meaning 'a mouse pulling a turtle.' It describes doing things very slowly or procrastinating; used informally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好老鼠拉龜，快啲交份報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 lou5 syu2 laai1 gwai1, faai3 di1 gaau1 fan6 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事別拖拖拉拉，快點交報告。
examples.english_sentence: Don't dawdle on the work — hand in the report quickly.

cantonese: 老鼠拉龜 - 無從入手
jyutping: lou5 syu2 laai1 gwai1 mou4 cung4 jap6 sau2
mandarin_meaning: 无从入手／无从下手
english_meaning: to have no idea where to start; be at a loss how to begin
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容面對一件事情或問題時不知道怎麼開始，沒有頭緒、無從下手。
explanation_english: Used to describe a situation where one does not know how to begin dealing with a task or problem; having no clue where to start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告亂到我真係老鼠拉龜，無從入手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 lyun6 dou3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 lou5 syu2 laai1 gwai1 mou4 cung4 jap6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告乱得我真是无从下手。
examples.english_sentence: This report is so messy that I'm really at a loss where to start.

jyutping: lou5 syu2 wan2 maau1 lo2 lei4 seoi1
mandarin_meaning: 自找麻煩／自討苦吃（去招惹強於自己的人或事，結果受害）
english_meaning: asking for trouble; courting disaster — provoking someone/something stronger and suffering the consequences
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容主動去挑釁或招惹比自己強的人或危險的事物，結果造成損害或麻煩，類似「自找麻煩」。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who unnecessarily provokes or antagonizes a more powerful person or a dangerous situation and ends up suffering the consequences — similar to "asking for trouble."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日挑釁老細，真係老鼠搵貓——攞嚟衰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 tiu1 han3 lou5 sai3, zan1 hai6 lou5 syu2 wan2 maau1 lo2 lei4 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是挑衅老板，真是自找麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps provoking the boss — he's really asking for trouble.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）霉斑/污漬（常指衣物或牆壁上的小黑褐色斑點）
english_meaning: colloquial term for mould/mildew spots or small dark stains (often on clothes or walls)
explanation_mandarin: 「老鼠斑」是廣東話的口語說法，通常用來形容衣物、牆壁或其他表面出現的小黑褐色斑點，常由潮濕發霉或污漬造成。在日常用語中也可泛指難看的小斑點。
explanation_english: “老鼠斑” is a colloquial Cantonese term used to describe small dark/brown spots on surfaces such as clothes or walls, typically caused by mould, mildew, or staining. It can also be used more generally for unsightly small spots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫有老鼠斑，唔可以著出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 jau5 lou5 syu2 baan1, m4 ho2 ji5 zoek3 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件衣服有霉斑，不能穿出去。
examples.english_sentence: That shirt has mould spots; I can't wear it out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房牆有啲老鼠斑，要用漂白水清潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 coeng4 jau5 di1 lou5 syu2 baan1, jiu3 jung6 piu3 baak6 seoi2 cing1 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房牆上有些霉斑，要用漂白水清潔。
examples.english_sentence: There are some mould spots on the kitchen wall; we need to clean them with bleach.

mandarin_meaning: （1）一種細米粉或米線的俗稱，廣東、潮汕一帶有此叫法；（2）俚語，指在網上或社交平台上潛伏、匿名支持或發表虛假支持言論的粉絲（地域、語境不同含義可能不同）。
english_meaning: (1) a regional name for a very thin rice vermicelli; (2) slang for 'lurker' or covert/inauthentic fans who post anonymous or fake supportive comments (usage varies by region and context).
explanation_mandarin: 「老鼠粉」可指食物（細米粉）或比喻用法（指隱蔽或虛假的支持者）。在口語或網絡語境出現時要根據上下文判斷是哪一種含義。
explanation_english: “老鼠粉” can mean a type of very thin rice vermicelli (food) or, figuratively, a covert/inauthentic fan (slang). Determine the intended sense from context, especially online.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想食老鼠粉湯，好啱胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 lou5 syu2 fan2 tong1, hou2 aam1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想吃老鼠粉湯，很合胃口。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat a bowl of laoshufen soup tonight; it really suits my appetite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人喺社交網下匿名留言支持，大家話佢哋係老鼠粉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 hai2 se5 gaau1 mong5 haa6 nik1 ming4 lau4 jim4 zi1 ci4, daai6 gaa1 waa6 keoi5 dei6 hai6 lou5 syu2 fan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人在社交網匿名留言支持，大家說他們是老鼠粉。
examples.english_sentence: Some people leave anonymous supportive comments on social media; people say they're 'mouse fans' (covert/inauthentic supporters).

mandarin_meaning: 黏鼠板 / 捕鼠胶
english_meaning: mouse glue; glue trap (sticky adhesive used to catch mice)
explanation_mandarin: 指用来捕捉老鼠的黏性胶或黏鼠板，常见的害虫防治用品。亦可泛指黏性很强的东西或偶尔作比喻用。
explanation_english: Refers to an adhesive product (glue/board) used to trap mice; a common pest-control item. Can also be used more loosely to mean something very sticky or, occasionally, figuratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企成日有老鼠，所以上個禮拜買咗幾張老鼠膠放喺廚房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 sing4 jat6 jau5 lou5 syu2, so2 ji5 soeng5 go3 lai5 baai3 maai5 zo2 gei2 zoeng1 lou5 syu2 gaau1 fong3 hai2 ceoi4 fong2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家经常有老鼠，所以上个礼拜买了几张黏鼠板放在厨房。
examples.english_sentence: We often have mice at home, so last week I bought several glue traps and put them in the kitchen.

mandarin_meaning: 老鼠药 (lǎoshǔ yào) — 用来毒杀老鼠的化学药物；也可引申为会造成严重伤害或损失的事物或手段。
english_meaning: Rat poison — a chemical poison used to kill rats; figuratively, something that causes serious harm or a harmful trick/ploy.
explanation_mandarin: 原义指用于捕杀或毒死老鼠的毒药。口语中有时把对人或事物有害、会导致严重后果的东西比喻为“老鼠药”。
explanation_english: Literally a poison used to kill rats. In colloquial use it can be used figuratively for something harmful or a scheme that causes serious damage or loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好擺老鼠葯喺屋企，細路會誤食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 baai2 lou5 syu2 joek6 hai2 uk1 kei5, sai3 lou6 wui5 ng6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把老鼠药放在家里，孩子会误食。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave rat poison at home; children might accidentally ingest it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個投資計劃係老鼠葯，睇落回報好高，其實係騙局。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 tau4 zi1 gai3 waak6 hai6 lou5 syu2 joek6, tai2 lok6 wui4 bou3 hou2 gou1, kei4 sat6 hai6 pin3 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个投资计划是老鼠药，看起来回报很高，其实是骗局。
examples.english_sentence: That investment scheme is a 'rat poison' — it looks high-return but it's actually a scam.

mandarin_meaning: 老鼠药
english_meaning: rat poison; (figurative) a trap or harmful temptation
explanation_mandarin: 字面指用來毒死老鼠的藥；引申為比喻性說法，指有害的事物、陷阱或誘使人上當、引致損失的東西。
explanation_english: Literally a poison used to kill rats; figuratively used to describe something harmful, a trap, or a temptation that leads someone to be harmed or deceived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我發現廚房有老鼠藥，記得唔好畀小朋友摸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faat3 jin6 cyu4 fong2 jau5 lou5 syu2 joek6, gei3 dak1 m4 hou2 bei2 siu2 pang4 jau5 mo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我發現廚房有老鼠藥，記得不要讓小朋友碰。
examples.english_sentence: I found rat poison in the kitchen; remember not to let the children touch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話嗰個投資有高回報，但其實係老鼠藥，唔好畀佢騙咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 go2 go3 tau4 zi1 jau5 gou1 wui4 bou3, daan6 kei4 sat6 hai6 lou5 syu2 joek6, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 pin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說那個投資回報很高，但其實是老鼠藥，別讓他騙了你。
examples.english_sentence: He said the investment had high returns, but it's actually a trap; don't be fooled by him.

mandarin_meaning: 次货；劣质或仿冒商品
english_meaning: shoddy goods; counterfeit or low-quality merchandise
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語，指劣質、仿冒或來源可疑的商品，常用來形容質量差或來路不正的貨品。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for low-quality, counterfeit, or suspicious-source goods. Used to describe merchandise that is inferior or potentially illicit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭賣嘅衫有啲係老鼠貨，品質好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 maai6 ge3 saam1 jau5 di1 hai6 lou5 syu2 fo3, ban2 zat1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖的衣服有些是次货，质量很差。
examples.english_sentence: Some of the clothes sold at this shop are shoddy goods; the quality is very poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心買到老鼠貨，最好去信譽好嘅舖頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 maai5 dou3 lou5 syu2 fo3, zeoi3 hou2 heoi3 seon3 jyu6 hou2 ge3 pou3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心买到次货，最好去信誉好的店铺。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful of buying shoddy goods; it's best to go to reputable shops.

jyutping: lou5 syu2 dit3 lok6 tin1 ping4
mandarin_meaning: 露出馬腳 / 東窗事發
english_meaning: to be exposed; a hidden wrongdoing or secret is revealed
explanation_mandarin: 比喻原本想隱瞞的事情或壞事被揭發、露出破綻。通常用來形容壞事或秘密終於曝光，當事人被抓包。
explanation_english: A Cantonese idiom meaning that a hidden misdeed or secret has been exposed — the culprit is found out. Used when someone’s cover is blown or a scheme is revealed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲陰謀終於畀人揭發，真係老鼠跌落天平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 jam1 mou4 zung1 jyu1 bei2 jan4 kit3 faat3, zan1 hai6 lou5 syu2 dit3 lok6 tin1 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的陰謀終於被揭發，真是露出馬腳。
examples.english_sentence: His scheme was finally exposed — he was completely found out.

cantonese: 老鼠跌落天平 - 自己秤自己
jyutping: lou5 syu2 dit3 lok6 tin1 ping4 —— zi6 gei2 cang3 zi6 gei2
mandarin_meaning: 自己给自己评判／在与自己有关的事情上充当裁判（带有偏袒、自利的意思）
english_meaning: To judge or decide one's own case; to act as judge in a matter that involves oneself (implies bias or self-interest).
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在有利害关系的事情上自己作评判或决定，带有偏袒或不公正的含义。
explanation_english: A metaphor meaning someone judges or measures a matter that concerns themselves—i.e., they are effectively their own judge, implying bias or unfairness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話件事係老鼠跌落天平——自己秤自己，唔好指望佢公平處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 gin6 si6 hai6 lou5 syu2 dit3 lok6 tin1 ping4 —— zi6 gei2 cang3 zi6 gei2, m4 hou2 zi2 mong6 keoi5 gung1 ping4 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说这件事是老鼠掉到天平上——自己称自己，别指望他会公平处理。
examples.english_sentence: He said this matter is like a mouse falling onto the scale — weighing itself; don't expect him to handle it fairly.

jyutping: lou5 syu2 dit3 lok6 tin1 cang3
mandarin_meaning: 露餡；現形；真相被揭露（被發現）
english_meaning: to be exposed; a secret or wrongdoing is revealed; to be found out
explanation_mandarin: 比喻某人的祕密、謊言或不當行為被揭發，真相顯露出來。
explanation_english: A metaphor meaning that someone's secret, lie, or wrongdoing has been revealed — their true situation or guilt is exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話冇偷錢，但啲監控片出咗，真係老鼠跌落天秤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 mou5 tau1 cin2, daan6 di1 gaam1 hung3 pin3 ceot1 zo2, zan1 hai6 lou5 syu2 dit3 lok6 tin1 cang3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说没偷钱，但监控视频出来了，真的露馅了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he didn't steal the money, but the surveillance footage came out — he was really exposed.

mandarin_meaning: 愛挑剔、吹毛求疵（口語）
english_meaning: nitpicky; picky; habitual fault-finding (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「老齧齧」是廣東話口語，形容一個人經常對細節挑剔、愛計較或愛吹毛求疵，帶有負面評價。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing someone who is habitually nitpicky or picky — someone who frequently finds fault with small details. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日咁老齧齧，連啲細事都要計較。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gam2 lou5 ngit6 ngit6, lin4 di1 sai3 si6 dou1 jiu3 gai3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天這麼老齧齧，連些小事都要計較。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so nitpicky; he even quibbles over small things.

mandarin_meaning: 懦弱、膽小的人；也可用來形容保守、不願冒險的人（俚語）。
english_meaning: A coward; someone timid or overly cautious; can also describe a conservative, risk-averse person (slang).
explanation_mandarin: 「老龜殼」是粵語俗語，用來形容遇事退縮、怕事或過於保守、不肯冒險的人。帶有貶義或戲謔成份。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe a person who shrinks from challenges, is fearful or overly conservative. It carries a derogatory or teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做個老龜殼，試下先啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 go3 lou5 gwai1 hok3, si3 haa5 sin1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當懦夫，先試一試吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a coward — give it a try!

mandarin_meaning: 考（考试；考察；考虑）
english_meaning: to take an exam / to test or examine / to consider
explanation_mandarin: 表示參加考試、對人或事進行考察或檢查，也可表示考慮、斟酌。
explanation_english: Used to indicate taking an exam, testing or inspecting someone/something, or to mean considering or thinking over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要考駕駛執照。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 haau2 gaa3 si2 zap1 ziu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要考驾照。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to take the driving test next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考唔過，要重考啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 m4 gwo3, jiu3 cung4 haau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考不过，要重考。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam; he'll have to retake it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要好好考慮先決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 hou2 hou2 haau2 leoi6 sin1 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要好好考虑再决定。
examples.english_sentence: You should think it over carefully before deciding.

mandarin_meaning: 通过考试获得（资格、录取等）
english_meaning: to obtain admission or a qualification by passing an exam; to be admitted via examination
explanation_mandarin: 表示透過考試取得某種資格、學位或被錄取，常用於報考學校、公職或專業資格時。
explanation_english: Means to obtain a qualification, admission, or position by passing an examination. Commonly used for gaining entry to schools, professional programs, or civil service posts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考取咗醫學院，將來可以做醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 ceoi2 zo2 ji1 hok6 jyun6, zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 zou6 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考上了医学院，将来可以当医生。
examples.english_sentence: He was admitted to medical school; he can become a doctor in the future.

mandarin_meaning: 考古；（網路/口語）翻查別人的舊帖子或舊照片
english_meaning: archaeology; (internet/slang) to dig up someone's old posts or past
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 動詞（口語/網路用語）
explanation_mandarin: 1) 正式用法指考古學或進行考古研究。2) 網路或口語用法指在社交媒體上搜尋或挖掘某人的舊貼文、舊照片或過去記錄。
explanation_english: 1) Formal: refers to archaeology or conducting archaeological research. 2) Internet/slang: to search through someone's old social media posts, photos, or past records.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學讀考古學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 daai6 hok6 duk6 haau2 gu2 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大學讀考古學。
examples.english_sentence: He studies archaeology at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要考古佢，睇下佢以前點樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 haau2 gu2 keoi5, tai2 haa5 keoi5 ji5 cin4 dim2 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要考古他，看看他以前怎麼樣。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight I'm going to dig up his past (look through his old posts) to see what he was like before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好無啦啦考古人哋，會傷害佢哋嘅私隱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 mou4 laa1 laa1 haau2 gu2 jan4 dei6, wui5 soeng1 hoi6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 si1 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要無緣無故去考古別人，會傷害他們的隱私。
examples.english_sentence: Don't randomly dig into people's pasts; it can violate their privacy.

mandarin_meaning: 考场
english_meaning: exam hall; examination venue; testing center
explanation_mandarin: 指进行各类考试的场所，例如考場、考試中心或考場內的試室。
explanation_english: A place where examinations are held, such as an exam hall or testing center.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去考場應考，緊張到訓唔着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 haau2 coeng4 jing3 haau2, gan2 zoeng1 dou3 fan3 m4 zoek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去考场应考，紧张得睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to the exam hall tomorrow to sit the exam; I'm so nervous I can't sleep.

mandarin_meaning: 考官（考試的評審或監考人員）
english_meaning: examiner; proctor; assessor (person who supervises or grades an exam)
explanation_mandarin: 指負責監督、評分或評審考試的工作人員，例如監考人員或口試評審。
explanation_english: Refers to a person responsible for supervising, assessing, or grading an examination (e.g., a proctor or oral exam assessor).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個考官話我答得唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 haau2 gwaan1 waa6 ngo5 daap3 dak1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考官說我回答得不錯。
examples.english_sentence: The examiner said I answered well.

mandarin_meaning: 考察 (kǎochá)：调查、视察、实地了解情况或收集资料
english_meaning: to inspect; to examine; to investigate (often on-site), to conduct a survey or field study
explanation_mandarin: 指到现场或目标处进行调查、查看或检查，以了解情况或收集资料，常用于正式或书面语境。
explanation_english: Refers to going to a site or target to investigate, inspect, or examine in order to understand the situation or collect information; commonly used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司派咗一班人去內地考察市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 paai3 zo2 jat1 baan1 jan4 heoi3 noi6 dei6 haau2 caat3 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司派了一批人到内地考察市场。
examples.english_sentence: The company sent a team to the mainland to study the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下星期要去工廠考察生產線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 heoi3 gung1 cong2 haau2 caat3 saang1 caan2 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下星期要去工厂考察生产线。
examples.english_sentence: We will go to the factory next week to inspect the production line.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）考核/測試技術人員；刁難或考驗某人以展示其技術
english_meaning: Colloquial Cantonese slang meaning to test or assess a skilled worker/technician (to put them on the spot to demonstrate ability); can also imply giving someone a hard time by testing them
explanation_mandarin: 「考師傅」為廣東話口語用語，通常指對師傅、技術工人或有經驗的人進行考核或測試，要求其示範技術、證明能力。有時亦帶有刁難或故意考對方的含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression used when evaluating or testing a skilled worker or experienced person, asking them to demonstrate skills or prove competence. It can also carry the nuance of deliberately putting someone on the spot or giving them a hard time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆今日嚟工場考師傅，要求好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gam1 jat6 lei4 gung1 coeng4 haau2 si1 fu2, jiu1 kau4 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板今天來工廠考核師傅，要求很高。
examples.english_sentence: The boss came to the workshop today to test the workers; his demands were very high.

mandarin_meaning: 考虑 (kǎolǜ)
english_meaning: to consider; to think over; to take into account
explanation_mandarin: 表示仔細思考、斟酌或權衡各種可能性或因素，通常用於在決定或採取行動前的心智活動。
explanation_english: To think about something carefully; to weigh options or factors before making a decision or taking action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我需要考慮一下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 haau2 leoi6 jat1 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我需要考虑一下。
examples.english_sentence: I need to think it over for a moment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇考慮過搬去香港？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 haau2 leoi6 gwo3 bun1 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有考虑过搬去香港？
examples.english_sentence: Have you considered moving to Hong Kong?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺決策之前，要充分考慮所有風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 kyut3 caak3 zi1 cin4, jiu3 cung1 fan6 haau2 leoi6 so2 jau5 fung1 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在决策之前，要充分考虑所有风险。
examples.english_sentence: Before making a decision, fully consider all the risks.

mandarin_meaning: 考据（对古籍、史料或文字进行校勘、考证）
english_meaning: textual research/criticism; to collate and verify texts or historical sources
explanation_mandarin: 指對古籍、文字或史料進行考證、校勘與核查，以還原正確的文本或事實。也可泛指對資料做嚴謹的查證工作。
explanation_english: To examine, collate, and verify texts or historical materials (textual criticism); can also refer broadly to rigorous fact-checking or source verification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇文章引用咗好多資料，但考據部分做得唔夠詳盡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 jan5 jung6 zo2 hou2 do1 zi1 liu6, daan6 haau2 geoi3 bou6 fan6 zou6 dak1 m4 gau3 coeng4 zeon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇文章引用了很多资料，但考据部分做得不够详尽。
examples.english_sentence: This article cites many sources, but the textual research part isn't thorough enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學者喺古籍上面考據，發現咗幾個長期嘅誤傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 ze2 hai2 gu2 zik6 soeng6 min6 haau2 geoi3, faat3 jin4 zo2 gei2 go3 coeng4 kei4 ge3 ng6 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学者在古籍上考据，发现了几个长期的误传。
examples.english_sentence: Scholars examined the ancient texts and found several long-standing misconceptions.

mandarin_meaning: 考查（对人、事、物进行检查、考核或调查）
english_meaning: to examine; to inspect; to investigate; to assess
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事物進行檢查、審核或調查，以了解情況或評估能力、表現。
explanation_english: To check, inspect, investigate, or assess someone or something in order to find out the situation or evaluate ability/performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會考查你嘅工作表現，然後決定會唔會升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 haau2 caa4 nei5 ge3 gung1 zok3 biu2 jin6, jin4 hau6 kyut3 ding6 wui5 m4 wui5 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司會考查你的工作表現，然後決定會不會升職。
examples.english_sentence: The company will assess your job performance and then decide whether to promote you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方會考查現場證據，了解發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 wui5 haau2 caa4 jin6 coeng4 zing3 geoi3, liu5 gaai2 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方會考查現場證據，了解發生了什麼事。
examples.english_sentence: The police will inspect the on-site evidence to find out what happened.

mandarin_meaning: 对工作、学习或能力等进行评定或测验（考察、评估）
english_meaning: to assess; to evaluate; assessment
explanation_mandarin: 指通过测验、观察或评分等方式对人员或事物的表现、能力、质量等进行检验和评定。
explanation_english: Refers to testing, observing or rating someone's performance, ability, or the quality of something in order to evaluate it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司下個月會對新員工做考核。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 deoi3 san1 jyun4 gung1 zou6 haau2 hat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司下个月会对新员工进行考核。
examples.english_sentence: The company will assess new employees next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工作要通過考核先至有正式聘用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 jiu3 tung1 gwo3 haau2 hat6 sin1 zi3 jau5 zing3 sik1 ping3 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作需要通过考核才能正式聘用。
examples.english_sentence: This job requires passing an assessment before formal employment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師會考核學生嘅口語能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 wui5 haau2 hat6 hok6 saang1 ge3 hau2 jyu5 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师会考核学生的口语能力。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher will evaluate the students' spoken language ability.

mandarin_meaning: 考驾照 / 考取执照（参加牌照考试）
english_meaning: to take a licence exam (commonly a driving test); to sit for a licence/permit test
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語用法，指参加以取得牌照（通常指駕照）為目的的考試。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to take an exam to obtain a licence (most commonly a driving licence).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下星期要去考牌，希望可以一次過通過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 heoi3 haau2 paai4, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jat1 ci3 gwo3 tung1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下星期要去考牌，希望可以一次通过。
examples.english_sentence: I'm taking my driving test next week; I hope I can pass it in one go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考牌考咗兩次先過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 paai4 haau2 zo2 loeng5 ci3 sin1 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考牌考了两次才通过。
examples.english_sentence: He took the licence test twice before he passed.

mandarin_meaning: 考生（參加考試的人）
english_meaning: examinee; test taker; candidate
explanation_mandarin: 指參加各類考試（如學校考試、公開考試、資格考試）的人。常用於教育或官方語境。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is taking an examination (school tests, public exams, qualification tests). Commonly used in educational or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考生記得帶身份證去考場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 saang1 gei3 dak1 daai3 san1 fan6 zing3 heoi3 haau2 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考生記得帶身份證去考場。
examples.english_sentence: Examinees should remember to bring their ID to the exam venue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲考生準備咗好耐，應該可以考得唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 haau2 saang1 zeon2 bei6 zo2 hou2 noi6, jing1 goi1 ho2 ji5 haau2 dak1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些考生準備了很久，應該能考得不錯。
examples.english_sentence: These candidates have prepared for a long time; they should perform well on the exam.

mandarin_meaning: 开阔眼界；增长见识
english_meaning: to broaden one's horizons; to be eye-opening
explanation_mandarin: 口语用语，表示某種經驗或事物讓人擴展視野或增加見識，常用來形容新奇、令人驚訝或有啓發性的經歷。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning an experience or thing that broadens one's horizons or is eye-opening; often used for surprising, impressive, or enlightening experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個展覽真係考眼界，令我大開眼界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zin2 laam5 zan1 hai6 haau2 ngaan5 gaai3, ling6 ngo5 daai6 hoi1 ngaan5 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个展览真是开阔了我的眼界，让我大开眼界。
examples.english_sentence: This exhibition really broadened my horizons; it truly opened my eyes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋帶我去試食高級食肆，真係考眼界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 si3 sik6 gou1 kap1 sik6 si2, zan1 hai6 haau2 ngaan5 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们带我去尝试高档餐厅的菜，真是开阔了眼界。
examples.english_sentence: They took me to try dishes at a high-end restaurant — it was really eye-opening.

mandarin_meaning: 考究 (kǎojiū)：研究、考证；也可指讲究、精致、注重细节
english_meaning: kaojiu / to investigate or study; meticulous, particular, exquisite; to pay attention to details
explanation_mandarin: “考究”可作動詞，表示對某事物進行研究或考證；亦可作形容詞，表示對細節或品質很講究、要求高、精緻。
explanation_english: “考究” can be a verb meaning to investigate or verify (research); it can also be an adjective meaning meticulous, particular, or aiming for fine quality and detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好考究，成日好注重細節同質素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 haau2 gau3, sing4 jat6 hou2 zyu3 zung6 sai3 zit3 tung4 zat1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很講究，總是很注重細節和品質。
examples.english_sentence: He is very particular, always paying attention to details and quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇論文要考究史料先得，唔可以隨便引用出處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 leon6 man4 jiu3 haau2 gau3 si2 liu2 sin1 dak1, m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin6 jan5 jung6 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇論文需要考證史料才能行，不能隨便引用來源。
examples.english_sentence: This paper needs to verify historical sources before it's acceptable; you can't cite sources casually.

mandarin_meaning: 考綱（考試大綱、考試範圍）
english_meaning: exam syllabus; exam outline specifying scope and topics
explanation_mandarin: 指由教育或考試機構公布的考試範圍、重點、題型與要求的綱要，用以指導教學與命題。
explanation_english: An official outline or syllabus issued by educational or examination authorities that specifies the scope, topics, key points, and requirements of an exam; used to guide teaching and test design.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教育局話會修訂考綱，老師要快啲更新教材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 juk6 guk6 waa6 wui5 sau1 ding6 haau2 gong1, lou5 si1 jiu3 faai3 di1 gang1 san1 gaau3 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教育局說會修訂考綱，老師要趕快更新教材。
examples.english_sentence: The Education Bureau said they will revise the exam syllabus, so teachers need to update the teaching materials quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果考綱改咗，考生要留意考試範圍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 haau2 gong1 goi2 zo2, haau2 saang1 jiu3 lau4 ji3 haau2 si3 faan6 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果考綱改了，考生要注意考試範圍。
examples.english_sentence: If the exam syllabus changes, candidates should pay attention to the scope of the exam.

mandarin_meaning: （香港）考試及評核局，負責舉辦公開考試及相關評核工作
english_meaning: Hong Kong Examinations and Assessment Authority (HKEAA) — the body responsible for administering public examinations and assessments
explanation_mandarin: 香港的公共考試與評核機構，負責如DSE等公開考試的命題、評卷和成績發放等工作。
explanation_english: The statutory body in Hong Kong that organizes public examinations (e.g. the DSE), handles setting papers, marking, and releasing results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考評局已經公佈下年DSE嘅報名安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 ping4 guk6 ji5 ging1 gung1 bou3 haa6 nin4 DSE ge3 bou3 ming4 on1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考評局已經公布明年DSE的報名安排。
examples.english_sentence: The Examinations and Assessment Authority has announced the registration arrangements for next year's DSE.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果對考試有爭議，可以向考評局申訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 deoi3 haau2 si3 jau5 zang1 ji4, ho2 ji5 hoeng3 haau2 ping4 guk6 san1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果對考試有爭議，可以向考評局申訴。
examples.english_sentence: If there is a dispute about the exam, you can appeal to the HKEAA.

mandarin_meaning: 考试 (kǎoshì)
english_meaning: exam; to take/administer an exam; test
explanation_mandarin: 指對知識或技能進行的測驗，可以指進行考試的行為，也可指考題或試卷本身。
explanation_english: An assessment to evaluate knowledge or skills; can refer to the act of taking/administering an exam or to the exam/test paper itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下星期有一個考試，要準備多啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jau5 jat1 go3 haau2 si3, jiu3 zeon2 bei6 do1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下星期有一场考试，要多加准备。
examples.english_sentence: I have an exam next week; I need to prepare more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師會喺星期五幫我哋改考試卷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 wui5 hai2 sing1 kei4 ng5 bong1 ngo5 dei6 goi2 haau2 si3 gyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师会在星期五帮我们改考试卷。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher will grade our exam papers on Friday.

mandarin_meaning: 把某人考倒、難住或刁難（使人回答不出或處於尷尬境地）
english_meaning: to stump someone; to put someone on the spot; to catch someone out
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，表示用問題或刁難的方式令對方答不出或處於尷尬，常用於口頭交流或會議場合，如「被考起」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang verb meaning to trick or question someone in a way that stumps them or puts them on the spot (often used as 'be stumped' or 'be put on the spot').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲問題好刁鑽，考起咗我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 man6tai4 hou2 diu1zyun3, haau2 hei2 zo2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的问题很刁钻，把我考倒了。
examples.english_sentence: His questions were tricky and they stumped me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會做報告嗰陣，我俾人考起，講唔出點解要咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 zou6 bou3gou3 go2 zan6, ngo5 bei2 jan4 haau2 hei2, gong2 m4 ceot1 dim2 gaai2 jiu3 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在開會做報告的時候，我被人考倒了，說不出為什麼要這樣做。
examples.english_sentence: During the meeting when I was giving the report, I was put on the spot and couldn't explain why we had to do it that way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂考起人，佢哋會唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 haau2 hei2 jan4, keoi5dei6 wui5 m4 hoi1sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要隨便刁難別人，他們會不高興。
examples.english_sentence: Don't randomly put people on the spot; they'll be unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 考駕照 / 參加駕駛執照考試
english_meaning: to take a driving test (to attempt to get a driver's license)
explanation_mandarin: 指參加取得駕駛執照的考試，為口語用法，常見於香港粵語。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to take the driving test (to attempt to obtain a driver's license). Commonly used in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下星期要去考車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 heoi3 haau2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下星期要去考駕照。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to take my driving test next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上次考車失敗，依家重新預約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 ci3 haau2 ce1 sat1 baai6, ji1 gaa1 cung4 san1 jyu6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上次考駕照失敗，現在重新預約。
examples.english_sentence: He failed his driving test last time and is rebooking now.

mandarin_meaning: 考慮、衡量（在做決定前權衡各種因素）
english_meaning: to consider; to take into account; to weigh (factors before making a decision)
explanation_mandarin: 表示在做決定或判斷前，衡量、斟酌各種因素或利弊。
explanation_english: Indicates weighing or taking into account various factors or pros and cons before making a decision or judgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺做決定之前要好好考量各種風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 zou6 kyut3 ding6 zi1 cin4 jiu3 hou2 hou2 haau2 loeng4 gok3 zung2 fung1 him2 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們在做決定之前要好好考量各種風險。
examples.english_sentence: We need to carefully consider all kinds of risks before making a decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆會考量你嘅經驗同埋工作態度先決定聘唔聘你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 wui5 haau2 loeng4 nei5 ge3 ging1 jim6 tung4 maai4 gung1 zok3 taai3 dou6 sin1 kyut3 ding6 ping3 m4 ping3 nei5 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老闆會考量你的經驗和工作態度才決定要不要聘用你。
examples.english_sentence: The boss will consider your experience and work attitude before deciding whether to hire you.

mandarin_meaning: 考題 / 考試中的題目 (kǎotí)
english_meaning: exam question; test item
explanation_mandarin: 指考試或測驗中出現、供考生回答的題目。
explanation_english: Questions that appear on an exam or test for examinees to answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試嘅考題好難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ge3 haau2 tai4 hou2 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這次考試的考題很難。
examples.english_sentence: The exam questions this time are very difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份考題主要考邏輯同概念。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 haau2 tai4 zyu2 jiu3 haau2 lo4 zik1 tung4 goi3 nim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份考題主要考察邏輯與概念。
examples.english_sentence: This set of exam questions mainly tests logic and concepts.

mandarin_meaning: 考验 (kǎoyàn)：检验、试炼、磨练
english_meaning: to test; a test or trial; to put someone or something to the test
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某人或某事進行檢驗或磨練，可指實際的測試或比喻性的考驗（如耐性、意志等）。
explanation_english: Refers to testing or putting someone/something through a trial. Can mean a literal test or a figurative trial of qualities like patience or resolve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幾年對佢嚟講係一個好大嘅考驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gei2 nin4 deoi3 keoi5 lai4 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 haau2 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这几年对他/她来说是一个很大的考验。
examples.english_sentence: These past few years have been a big test for him/her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試係一個考驗，記得要準備好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 hai6 jat1 go3 haau2 jim6, gei3 dak1 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试是一个考验，记得要准备好。
examples.english_sentence: The interview is a test; remember to prepare well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目會考驗你嘅耐性同埋技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 wui5 haau2 jim6 nei5 ge3 noi6 sing3 tung4 maai4 gei6 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目会考验你的耐性和技巧。
examples.english_sentence: This project will test your patience and skills.

mandarin_meaning: 年老；耄耋，指年約八、九十歲或非常年邁
english_meaning: aged; very old (often referring to someone in their eighties or older); used in compounds like '耄耋'
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 詞素（常用於複合詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「耄」在漢語中常作詞素出現，如「耄耋」，用來形容人年紀非常大（多指八、九十歲），有時帶有健忘或衰老的含義。
explanation_english: The character 耄 is commonly used as a bound morpheme (e.g., in 耄耋) to describe someone very old (often in their eighties or nineties); it can also imply senility or decline associated with advanced age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已到耄耋之年，行路要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 dou3 mou6 dit6 zi1 nin4, hang4 lou6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已到耄耋之年，走路要小心。
examples.english_sentence: He has reached old age (in his eighties/nineties); he should be careful when walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該多啲支援耄耋人士，照顧他們的生活需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 do1 di1 zi1 jyun4 mou6 dit6 jan4 si6, ziu3 gu3 ta1 mun4 dik1 sang1 wut6 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該多一些支援耄耋人士，照顧他們的生活需要。
examples.english_sentence: The government should provide more support for the very elderly and take care of their daily needs.

mandarin_meaning: ……者（指人或事物的後綴，表示“……的人/事物”）
english_meaning: a nominalizing suffix meaning 'one who/that which' (literary/formal)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 助詞 / 名詞化後綴（書面語、文言）
explanation_mandarin: 「者」常用於書面或文言，用作後綴把動作或性質名詞化，表示「……的人」或「……的事物」，如「作者」「讀者」。
explanation_english: The character 者 is a literary/formal particle used as a nominalizing suffix to indicate 'one who...' or 'that which...'. Common in compounds like 'author' or 'reader'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書嘅作者係邊個？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 ge3 zok3 ze2 hai6 bin1 go3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的作者是谁？
examples.english_sentence: Who is the author of this book?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 讀者可以喺下面留言。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 ze2 ho2 ji5 hai2 haa6 min6 lau4 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 读者可以在下面留言。
examples.english_sentence: Readers can leave comments below.

mandarin_meaning: 年老；長者；尊稱（如耆老）
english_meaning: elder; elderly; venerable (as in 'venerable elder')
explanation_mandarin: 「耆」常用於合成詞，如「耆老」，表示年紀較大、受人敬重的長者，用作尊稱或表明資歷較高。
explanation_english: The character '耆' appears in compounds such as '耆老' and denotes an elderly or venerable person; used as an honorific or to indicate seniority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 村入面嘅耆老都嚟參加慶祝會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun1 jap6 min6 ge3 kei4 lou5 dou1 lai4 caam1 gaa1 hing3 zuk1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 村裡的耆老都來參加慶祝會。
examples.english_sentence: The village elders all came to attend the celebration.

mandarin_meaning: 耆英（qí yīng）：年長且有經驗或有聲望的長者；老年人、前輩
english_meaning: elderly person; senior; elder statesman; a venerable or experienced elder
explanation_mandarin: 常用於正式或書面語，指年紀較大且有經驗、值得尊重的人；有時泛指長者或前輩。
explanation_english: A formal or literary term referring to elderly people, especially those of distinguished age, experience, or status; can be used to mean elders or respected seniors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社區中心每個禮拜都有活動，特別為耆英而設。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 keoi1 zung1 sam1 mui5 go3 lai5 baai3 dou1 jau5 wut6 dung6, dak6 bit6 wai6 kei4 jing1 ji4 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社區中心每個星期都有活動，特別為耆英而設。
examples.english_sentence: The community centre holds activities every week, specially arranged for elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅活動請咗幾位耆英上台分享佢哋嘅經驗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 wut6 dung6 ceng2 zo2 gei2 wai2 kei4 jing1 soeng5 toi4 fan1 hoeng2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ging1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的活動請了幾位耆英上台分享他們的經驗。
examples.english_sentence: The event invited several elders to come on stage and share their experiences.

mandarin_meaning: 年約七十歲；指高齡（常見於「耄耋」等詞中）
english_meaning: an advanced age around the seventies; elderly (often seen in compounds like 'mào dié')
explanation_mandarin: 古漢語詞，原指大約七十歲的年紀，現多用來表示高齡或與其他字組成表示年老的詞語（如「耄耋」）。
explanation_english: A classical Chinese character denoting roughly the seventies in age. Today it is mainly used to indicate advanced age or in compounds that refer to elderly years (e.g. 'mào dié').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家已經耋年，行路都慢咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 dip6 nin4, haang4 lou6 dou1 maan6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在已經耋年，走路也慢了。
