examples.english_sentence: Since this movie came out, he has become very famous and has received nonstop invitations.

mandarin_meaning: 声名狼藉；臭名昭著，名声极坏
english_meaning: Notorious; having a very bad reputation; infamous
explanation_mandarin: 形容名聲非常不好，廣為人知且帶有強烈的負面評價。
explanation_english: Describes a person or entity whose reputation is extremely bad and widely known; infamous or notorious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗貪污嘅事，俾人揭發之後聲名狼藉，搵唔到工做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 taam1 wu1 ge3 si6, bei2 jan4 kit3 faat3 zi1 hau6 sing1 ming4 long4 zik6, wan2 m4 dou3 gung1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了貪污的事，被揭發之後声名狼藉，找不到工作。
examples.english_sentence: He was involved in embezzlement; after being exposed he became notorious and couldn't find a job.

mandarin_meaning: 出聲、說話或表達意見（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: to speak up; to make a sound; to voice one's opinion (colloquial/slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「聲吶」為粵語口語或網絡用語，用來表示發聲、說話或鼓勵某人把意見說出來，帶有較隨意或略帶催促的語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression meaning to make a sound, speak up, or voice an opinion. It is used informally and often to urge someone to say something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣唔滿意就聲吶出嚟啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng6 m4 mun5 ji3 zau6 seng1 naat6 ceot1 lai4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果這樣不滿意就說出來吧！
examples.english_sentence: If you're not satisfied, then speak up!

mandarin_meaning: 喉嚨、聲音；（口語）發言權、話事權、影響力
english_meaning: throat/voice; (colloquial) having a say, influence, or authority
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指喉嚨或聲音；在廣東話口語中常用來指在某個圈子或機構裡有發言權、話事權或影響力（例如「佢有好大嘅聲喉」）。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the throat or voice. Colloquially in Cantonese it often means having a say, authority, or influence within a group or organization (e.g. "he has a lot of say").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司度有好大嘅聲喉，決定晒好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 jau5 hou2 daai6 ge3 sing1 hau2, kyut3 ding6 saat3 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡很有聲喉，決定了很多事情。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lot of say in the company and decides many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聲喉痛，今日唔想講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing1 hau2 tung3, gam1 jat6 m4 soeng2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的喉嚨痛，今天不想說話。
examples.english_sentence: My throat hurts, I don't feel like talking today.

mandarin_meaning: 声嘶力竭
english_meaning: to shout until hoarse; to exhaust one's voice/strength
explanation_mandarin: 形容因大聲喊叫或極度用力而聲音嘶啞，也可引申為竭盡全力、用盡氣力。
explanation_english: Describes a voice grown hoarse from shouting or extreme exertion; figuratively used to mean exhausting one's strength or efforts (e.g., 'shout oneself hoarse').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗救朋友，聲嘶力竭噉喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 gau3 pang4 jau5, sing1 si1 lik6 git6 gam2 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了救朋友，聲嘶力竭地喊。
examples.english_sentence: He shouted himself hoarse to save his friend.

mandarin_meaning: 又說得很響亮但不準確／不可靠
english_meaning: Loud/assertive but inaccurate or unreliable; all mouth and no accuracy
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人說話張揚、聲勢大，但內容不準確或不可靠，常帶貶義，屬口語化表達。
explanation_english: Describes someone who talks loudly or confidently but is inaccurate or unreliable. It's an informal/slang expression with a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日聲大夾冇準，講嘢唔準又唔負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4jat6 sing1 daai6 gaap3 mou5 zeon2, gong2 je5 m4 zeon2 jau6 m4 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是說得很響亮但不準確，說話不準又不負責。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks loudly but inaccurately — his words are unreliable and he's irresponsible.

mandarin_meaning: 又大聲又態度惡劣；大聲斥責或刻薄對待他人
english_meaning: to be loud and nasty; to speak loudly in an aggressive or mean way
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，形容一個人說話又大聲又刻薄、態度兇惡或常責罵別人，帶負面評價。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial phrase describing someone who speaks loudly and nastily—aggressive, abusive, or harsh in tone; used negatively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日對細佬聲大夾惡，個仔成日驚佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 deoi3 sai3 lou2 seng1 daai6 gaap3 ngok6, go3 zai2 sing4 jat6 geng1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常對弟弟大聲又刻薄，弟弟總是很怕他。
examples.english_sentence: He often speaks to his younger brother loudly and nastily; the boy is always afraid of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 辦公室入面有人唔滿意政策，就對經理聲大夾惡，氣氛好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan6 gung1 sat1 jap6 min6 jau5 jan4 m4 mun5 ji3 zing3 caak3, zau6 deoi3 ging1 lei5 seng1 daai6 gaap3 ngok6, hei3 fan1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 辦公室裡有人對經理大聲又刻薄，氣氛很差。
examples.english_sentence: Someone in the office was loudly and nastily criticizing the manager; the atmosphere was terrible.

mandarin_meaning: 声带
english_meaning: vocal cords (vocal folds)
explanation_mandarin: 位於喉部的薄帶狀組織，通過振動產生聲音，常與發聲功能和聲帶損傷有關。
explanation_english: Thin band-like tissues in the larynx that vibrate to produce sound; related to voice production and possible vocal cord injuries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唱歌唱到聲帶受損，要休息幾日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng3 go1 coeng3 dou3 sing1 daai3 sau6 syun2, jiu3 jau1 sik1 gei2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他唱歌把声带唱伤了，要休息几天。
examples.english_sentence: He sang so much that his vocal cords were damaged and needs to rest for a few days.

mandarin_meaning: 声情并茂：声音和感情兼备、表达生动（常用来形容说话或表演）
english_meaning: To combine vivid vocal expression with heartfelt emotion; a performance or narration that is both expressive in voice and moving in feeling.
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容說話、朗誦或表演時，聲音、語氣與情感表達都很到位，既有技巧又感人。
explanation_english: Used to describe speech, recitation, or performance in which both vocal delivery and emotional expression are effective and moving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講故事嘅時候聲情並茂，令我哋好投入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 gu3 si6 ge3 si4 hau6 seng1 cing4 bing6 mau6, ling6 ngo5 dei6 hou2 tau3 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲故事的时候声情并茂，让我们很投入。
examples.english_sentence: He told the story vividly and emotionally, making us very engaged.

mandarin_meaning: 說得誇張或不可靠（謠言、說法不準）
english_meaning: spoken claims or rumors that are exaggerated, unreliable, or inaccurate
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，用來形容某些說法、傳聞或預測誇大、不可靠、沒有根據，意即『說得不準』或『不可信』。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase used to describe claims, rumors, or forecasts that are exaggerated, inaccurate, or not to be trusted — essentially 'not reliable' or 'hit-or-miss'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人喺度傳開啲謠言，聽落好誇張，但好多都係聲打夾冇準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 hai2 dou6 cyun4 hoi1 di1 jiu4 jam4, teng1 lok6 hou2 kwaa1 zoeng1, daan6 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 sing1 daa2 gaap3 mou5 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人在散播謠言，聽起來很誇張，但很多都是不可靠的說法。
examples.english_sentence: People are spreading rumors that sound exaggerated, but many of them are unreliable.

mandarin_meaning: 裝作兇惡或大聲威嚇、虛張聲勢
english_meaning: to put on a fierce act or shout aggressively; to bluff and act tough
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人故意大聲、做出兇惡的樣子來嚇唬別人或裝腔作勢，但往往只是表面功夫，並不真心凶惡或真有本事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who deliberately acts loudly or menacingly to intimidate or bluff others — a show of toughness that is often more for appearance than real intent or ability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度聲打夾惡，實際上冇膽做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 seng1 daa2 gaap3 ok3, sat6 zai3 soeng6 mou5 daam2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在那裡大聲嚷嚷裝兇，實際上沒膽做事。
examples.english_sentence: He always makes a loud show of being fierce, but actually has no guts to act.

mandarin_meaning: 声援
english_meaning: to show support; to rally behind; to voice solidarity
explanation_mandarin: 表示以言語、行動或其他方式支持或幫助某人或某群體，常用於政治、勞工或社會運動等場合。
explanation_english: To express support for or stand in solidarity with someone or a group—by words, actions, or gestures. Often used in contexts like politics, labor strikes, or social movements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日有好多人上街聲援罷工嘅工人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 soeng5 gaai1 sing1 wun6 baa6 gung1 ge3 gung1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天有很多人上街声援罢工的工人。
examples.english_sentence: Today many people took to the streets to show support for the striking workers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋寫信去聲援受不公平對待嘅同事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 se2 seon3 heoi3 sing1 wun6 sau6 bat1 gung1 ping4 deoi3 doi6 ge3 tung4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们写信去声援受到不公平对待的同事。
examples.english_sentence: They wrote letters to support a colleague who was treated unfairly.

mandarin_meaning: 声明（公開表示、聲明或宣布）
english_meaning: statement; declaration; to declare or make a statement
explanation_mandarin: 指以書面或口頭形式公開表達立場、說明事實或澄清誤會的文字或聲音。
explanation_english: A formal statement or declaration, often issued publicly in writing or verbally to explain facts, announce a position, or clarify misunderstandings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司已經發出聲明，澄清市面上嘅誤傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 faat3 ceot1 seng1 ming4, cing4 cing1 si5 min6 soeng6 ge3 ng6 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已經發出聲明，澄清市面上的誤傳。
examples.english_sentence: The company has issued a statement to clarify the misinformation circulating in the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方就事件發表聲明，呼籲市民保持冷靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zau6 si6 gin6 faat3 biu2 seng1 ming4, fu1 jyu1 si5 man4 bou2 ci4 laang5 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方就事件發表聲明，呼籲市民保持冷靜。
examples.english_sentence: The police issued a statement regarding the incident, urging the public to remain calm.

mandarin_meaning: 聲望；名望
english_meaning: reputation; prestige; standing
explanation_mandarin: 指個人或機構在社會上獲得的名聲和威信，反映別人對其能力或品德的評價。
explanation_english: Refers to the reputation or prestige a person or organization has in society, reflecting others' evaluation of their ability or character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司裏面有好高嘅聲望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 leoi5 min6 jau5 hou2 gou1 ge3 seng1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司裡面有很高的聲望。
examples.english_sentence: He has a high reputation within the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要維持大學嘅聲望，校方要繼續提高教學質素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 wai4 ci4 daai6 hok6 ge3 seng1 mong6, haau6 fong1 jiu3 gai3 zuk6 tai4 gou1 gaau3 hok6 zat1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要維持大學的聲望，校方要繼續提高教學質素。
examples.english_sentence: To maintain the university's reputation, the administration must continue improving teaching quality.

mandarin_meaning: 聲東擊西（声东击西）：以声势或假动作吸引注意，实则在另一方向发动攻势或实现目的的策略
english_meaning: Make a feint to the east and strike in the west; a diversionary tactic — draw attention to one place while acting elsewhere
explanation_mandarin: 聲東擊西指用假象、聲勢或佯動來轉移對方注意力，藉此在另一方向出其不意地達成目標。常見於軍事、政治、商業等情況，用作迷惑或掩護真正的行動。
explanation_english: A tactic of creating a diversion to draw attention to one place while attacking or acting elsewhere. Commonly used in military, political, or business contexts to deceive or conceal the true intention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋聲東擊西，先喺門口搞聲勢，實際上打算由後門溜入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng1 dung1 gik1 sai1, sin1 hai2 mun4 hau2 gaau2 seng1 sai3, sat6 zai3 soeng6 daa2 syun3 jau4 hau6 mun4 lau4 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們聲東擊西，先在門口製造聲勢，實際上打算從後門溜進去。
examples.english_sentence: They used a diversion — making a show at the front entrance while actually planning to sneak in through the back.

mandarin_meaning: 声乐
english_meaning: vocal music; singing (the art or study of singing)
explanation_mandarin: 指以人声为主要表现手段的音乐类型；也指声乐艺术或声乐的学习与训练。
explanation_english: Refers to music that uses the human voice as the primary medium; also denotes the art, study, or training of singing and vocal technique.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個學期會去報讀聲樂班，想學唱歌同改善發聲技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 hok6 kei4 wui5 heoi3 bou3 duk6 seng1 ngok6 baan1, soeng2 hok6 coeng3 go1 tung4 goi2 sin6 faat3 seng1 gei6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下学期会去报名声乐班，想学唱歌并改善发声技巧。
examples.english_sentence: Next semester I'll sign up for a vocal class; I want to learn singing and improve my vocal technique.

mandarin_meaning: 声母（音节开头的辅音）
english_meaning: initial consonant (onset of a syllable)
explanation_mandarin: 指構成音節時位於開頭的輔音音位，與韻母、聲調一起構成一個音節的聲學結構，是語音學中的術語。
explanation_english: The consonant sound at the beginning (onset) of a syllable, contrasted with the rime/final and tone; a phonological term used in linguistics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學粵語要先識聲母同韻母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jyut6 jyu5 jiu3 sin1 sik1 seng1 mou5 tung4 wan6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学粤语要先识声母和韵母。
examples.english_sentence: To learn Cantonese, you should first learn the initials and finals.

mandarin_meaning: 声气；语气；消息、动静
english_meaning: tone of voice; manner/attitude in speech; a sign, news, or clue (of activity)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指說話的聲音或語氣、態度。2. 指消息、動靜或跡象（常見用法如「有聲氣」「冇聲氣」）。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to the sound or tone of someone's voice, the manner or attitude in speaking. 2. Refers to a sign, news, or clue of activity (commonly used in expressions like 'have word' or 'no sign').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嘅聲氣好急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ge3 seng1 hei3 hou2 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話的語氣很急促。
examples.english_sentence: His tone of voice was very urgent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司最近冇乜聲氣，可能會有人離職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 mou5 mat1 seng1 hei3, ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 jan4 lei4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近沒有什麼動靜，可能會有人離職。
examples.english_sentence: There hasn't been much word from the company recently; maybe someone will leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇聲氣啊？有冇人通知你？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 seng1 hei3 aa3? jau5 mou5 jan4 tung1 zi1 nei5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有消息啊？有沒有人通知你？
examples.english_sentence: Have you heard anything? Has anyone informed you?

mandarin_meaning: 聲音沙啞；聲嘶
english_meaning: hoarse; husky (voice); vocal hoarseness
explanation_mandarin: 指聲音變得粗啞或沙啞，常由感冒、用聲過度、喉嚨發炎或過度疲勞造成。
explanation_english: Refers to a rough or hoarse voice quality, commonly caused by a cold, overuse of the voice, throat inflammation, or fatigue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我感冒咗，而家聲沙，講唔出咁多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam2 mou6 zo2, ji4 gaa1 seng1 saa1, gong2 m4 ceot1 gam2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我感冒了，現在聲音沙啞，說不出太多話。
examples.english_sentence: I caught a cold and my voice is hoarse right now; I can't say much.

mandarin_meaning: 声波
english_meaning: sound wave
explanation_mandarin: 由振動在介質中傳播的波動，常見於空氣、水或固體中，用於描述聲音以波的形式傳遞。
explanation_english: A wave produced by vibrations that propagates through a medium (air, water, or solids); used to describe how sound travels as a wave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聲波可以喺空氣入面傳播。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng1 bo1 ho2 ji5 hai2 hung1 hei3 jap6 min6 cyun4 bo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 声波可以在空气中传播。
examples.english_sentence: Sound waves can propagate through the air.

mandarin_meaning: （1）聲音的波動（聲波、聲浪）；（2）比喻公眾的呼聲或輿論（輿論聲浪、聲勢、抗議聲）。
english_meaning: 1) sound wave(s); 2) figuratively, a groundswell of public opinion or outcry (public pressure, wave of voices).
explanation_mandarin: 「聲浪」原指聲音的波動（物理意義的聲波），但在社會語境中常用來比喻公眾或媒體的呼聲、輿論的波動與壓力。
explanation_english: Literally refers to sound waves; in social contexts it is commonly used metaphorically for a groundswell of public opinion or outcry — the collective voices or pressure from the public/media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近社交媒體上嘅聲浪好大，大家都要求政府交代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 se5 gaau1 mui4 tai2 soeng6 ge3 seng1 long6 hou2 daai6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu1 kau4 zing3 fu2 gaau1 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近社交媒體上的聲浪很大，大家都要求政府交代。
examples.english_sentence: There's a big public outcry on social media recently; everyone is demanding an explanation from the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺科學課上，老師講解聲浪係點樣傳播。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 fo1 hok6 fo3 soeng6, lou5 si1 gong2 gaai2 seng1 long6 hai6 dim2 joeng6 cyun4 bo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在科學課上，老師講解聲浪如何傳播。
examples.english_sentence: In science class, the teacher explained how sound waves propagate.

mandarin_meaning: 声泪俱下（shēng lèi jù xià）——形容說話時哽咽落淚，情緒激動。
english_meaning: To speak with tears and sobs; to be deeply moved or grief-stricken and speak in a tearful voice.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人在敘述往事或表達情感時，哽咽、流淚，語氣哀傷或感動。
explanation_english: Describes someone speaking while sobbing or with tears in their voice — used when a person is emotionally moved or grieving while speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講起阿媽過身嗰陣，聲淚俱下，令大家都好心痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 hei2 aa3 maa1 gwo3 san1 go2 zan6, seng1 leoi6 geoi1 haa6, ling6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 sam1 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一說起媽媽過世的那段往事，聲淚俱下，讓大家都很心痛。
examples.english_sentence: When he spoke about his mother's passing, he spoke tearfully and sobbed, which made everyone very heartbroken.

mandarin_meaning: 配音；擔任配音演出
english_meaning: to voice-act; to provide voice acting (to dub a character)
explanation_mandarin: 指為角色或作品提供聲音表演，通常用於配音、為動畫或影視角色配音的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to providing vocal performance for a character or work—commonly used for dubbing or performing as a voice actor in animation or film.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次喺電影入面聲演一個配角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 hai2 din6 jing2 jap6 min6 seng1 jin2 jat1 go3 pui3 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這次在電影裡聲演一個配角。
examples.english_sentence: He voices a supporting character in this movie.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套日本動畫嘅廣東話版由本地配音員聲演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 jat6 bun2 dung6 waa6 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2 baan2 jau4 bun2 dei6 pui3 jam1 jyun4 seng1 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部日本動畫的粵語版由本地配音員聲演。
examples.english_sentence: The Cantonese version of this Japanese animation is voiced by local voice actors.

mandarin_meaning: 声称；宣称
english_meaning: to claim; to assert
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人宣称某事属实或发生过，但未必有证据。常用于新闻或正式语境，含中性或略带怀疑的意味。
explanation_english: To state or assert that something is true or has happened, often without providing proof. Commonly used in news or formal contexts and can imply neutrality or skepticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聲稱冇做過嗰件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 cing1 mou5 zou6 gwo3 go2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他声称没有做过那件事。
examples.english_sentence: He claims he didn't do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有報導話有人聲稱醫院隱瞞疫情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 bou3 dou6 waa6 jau5 jan4 sing1 cing1 ji1 jyun2 jan2 maan4 jing4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有报道说有人声称医院隐瞒疫情。
examples.english_sentence: Reports say someone claimed the hospital concealed the outbreak.

mandarin_meaning: （漢字的）聲符；表示發音的符號或部件
english_meaning: phonetic component (of a Chinese character); sound symbol
explanation_mandarin: 指漢字中用以提示或表示讀音的那一部分（即聲旁、聲符）；也可泛指表示聲音或讀音的符號。
explanation_english: Refers to the phonetic component of a Chinese character that provides clues to its pronunciation; can also more generally mean a symbol denoting sound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 漢字嘅聲符通常會提供讀音嘅線索。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hon3 zi6 ge3 seng1 fu4 tung1 soeng4 wui5 tai4 gung1 duk6 jam1 ge3 sin3 sok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 汉字的声符通常会提供读音的线索。
examples.english_sentence: The phonetic components of Chinese characters usually provide clues to pronunciation.

mandarin_meaning: 声纹（聲音的生物识别特征）
english_meaning: voiceprint; voice biometric (unique acoustic pattern of a speaker's voice used for identification)
explanation_mandarin: 指聲音的獨特頻譜或特徵，可用於識別說話者，屬於生物識別技術的一種。
explanation_english: The unique acoustic pattern or spectral features of a person's voice used to identify a speaker; a type of biometric identifier used in voice recognition systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司用聲紋嚟驗證員工身份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jung6 seng1 man4 lai4 jim6 zing3 jyun4 gung1 san1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司用聲紋來驗證員工身份。
examples.english_sentence: The company uses voiceprints to verify employee identities.

mandarin_meaning: 聲納（shēngnà）
english_meaning: sonar (sound navigation and ranging)
explanation_mandarin: 聲納是一種利用聲波發射與接收來探測、定位水下或其他介質中物體的裝置或系統，常用於潛艇、拖曳聲納或海洋測量等領域。
explanation_english: Sonar is a device or system that uses emitted and received sound waves to detect and locate objects underwater (or in other media). It is commonly used on submarines, towed arrays, and for oceanographic surveying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢艘潛艇裝咗先進嘅聲納系統，可以探測到水下嘅目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sou1 cim4 teng5 zong1 zo2 sin1 zeon3 ge3 sing1 naap6 hai6 tung2, ho2 ji5 taam3 cek3 dou3 seoi2 haa6 ge3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這艘潛艇裝有先進的聲納系統，可以探測到水下的目標。
examples.english_sentence: This submarine is equipped with an advanced sonar system and can detect underwater targets.

mandarin_meaning: 声线（指声音的音色、音域或音质）
english_meaning: vocal timbre; voice quality; vocal range
explanation_mandarin: 指人說話或唱歌時聲音的特徵，包括音色、音域、音質及表現方式等。
explanation_english: Refers to the characteristic quality of a person's voice when speaking or singing, including timbre, range, tone, and style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅聲線好有磁性，唱歌好好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 seng1 sin3 hou2 jau5 ci4 sing3, coeng3 go1 hou2 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的声线很有磁性，唱歌很好听。
examples.english_sentence: Her voice is very magnetic; she sings beautifully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過練習之後，佢嘅聲線變得更穩定，唱高音亦冇咁費力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 lin6 zaap6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 seng1 sin3 bin3 dak1 gang3 wan2 ding6, coeng3 gou1 jam1 jik6 mou5 gam3 fai3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过练习之后，她的声线变得更稳定，唱高音也没那么吃力。
examples.english_sentence: After practice, her vocal tone became more stable and singing high notes is less strenuous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲演員會特意改變聲線去扮唔同嘅角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jin2 jyun4 wui5 dak6 ji3 goi2 bin3 seng1 sin3 heoi3 baan6 m4 tung4 ge3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些演员会刻意改变声线去扮不同的角色。
examples.english_sentence: Some actors deliberately change their vocal timbre to portray different characters.

mandarin_meaning: 沉溺于声色享乐；生活放纵，沉迷酒色、娱乐等享乐行为（含贬义）
english_meaning: to indulge in sensual pleasures; living a debauched or hedonistic lifestyle (often derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: “聲色犬馬”原指以聲樂、女色、馳騁馬匹等享樂，後用來形容沉迷於聲色享樂、生活奢靡放縱，通常含有貶義。
explanation_english: Originally referred to enjoying music, women, dogs and horses (luxuries); now used to describe indulgence in sensual pleasures and a decadent, self-indulgent lifestyle. The phrase usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢近排成日聲色犬馬，生意越做越差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan6 paai4 sing4 jat6 sing1 sik1 hyun2 maa5, saang1 ji3 jyut6 zou6 jyut6 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近整天沉湎于声色犬马，生意越来越差。
examples.english_sentence: He's been indulging in sensual pleasures lately, and his business is getting worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期聲色犬馬，遲早會自食其果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 sing1 sik1 hyun2 maa5, ci4 zou2 wui5 zi6 sik6 kei4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期声色犬马，迟早会自食其果。
examples.english_sentence: If you live a life of debauchery for a long time, you'll sooner or later reap the consequences.

mandarin_meaning: 聲稱；宣稱
english_meaning: to claim; to state; to declare
explanation_mandarin: 表示口頭上宣稱或聲明某事為真，通常用於正式語境或新聞報導中，帶有當事人主張但未必有充分證據的意味。
explanation_english: To state or declare something (usually verbally), often used in formal contexts or reports; implies someone asserts something as true but the claim may not be proven.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聲言冇參與嗰件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 jin4 mou5 caam1 jyu5 go2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聲稱沒有參與那件事。
examples.english_sentence: He claimed he did not take part in that matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司聲言會喺下星期公佈結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sing1 jin4 wui5 hai2 haa6 sing1 kei4 gung1 bou3 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司聲稱會在下星期公布結果。
examples.english_sentence: The company stated it would announce the results next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢聲言無辜，但證據不足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 sing1 jin4 mou4 gu1, daan6 zing3 geoi3 bat1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然他聲稱無辜，但證據不足。
examples.english_sentence: Although he claimed to be innocent, the evidence is insufficient.

mandarin_meaning: 公开谴责；指责
english_meaning: to denounce; to condemn publicly; to criticize vehemently
explanation_mandarin: 指公开（或集体）对某人或某事表示强烈谴责或抨击，通常用于批评不当行为或处理方式。
explanation_english: To publicly (often collectively) express strong condemnation or criticism of someone or something, typically used when denouncing improper actions or handling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民公開聲討警方的處理方式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 gung1 hoi1 sing1 tou2 ging2 fong1 dik1 cyu2 lei5 fong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民公开声讨警方的处理方式。
examples.english_sentence: Citizens publicly denounced the police's way of handling the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網民聲討公司隱瞞醜聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 man4 sing1 tou2 gung1 si1 jan2 maan4 cau2 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网民声讨公司隐瞒丑闻。
examples.english_sentence: Netizens condemned the company for concealing the scandal.

mandarin_meaning: 声调：语音的高低、音高变化（也可指说话的语调或唱歌时的音高）
english_meaning: tone; pitch; intonation (the pitch pattern of syllables or the intonation in speech/singing)
explanation_mandarin: 指語言中音節的高低升降和音高差別（語音學上的聲調），也可用來指說話或唱歌時的語調、音色變化。
explanation_english: Refers to the pitch pattern of syllables (phonological tones) — the high/low pitch distinctions — and can also refer to intonation or pitch used when speaking or singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學廣東話要注意聲調，唔同聲調意思可以完全唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 jiu3 zyu3 ji3 seng1 diu6, m4 tung4 seng1 diu6 ji3 si1 ho2 ji5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学广东话要注意声调，不同声调意思可能完全不同。
examples.english_sentence: When learning Cantonese you must pay attention to the tones; different tones can change the meaning completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嘅聲調好有趣，令人好易明白佢嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 ge3 seng1 diu6 hou2 jau5 ceoi3, ling6 jan4 hou2 ji6 ming4 baak6 keoi5 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話的聲調很有趣，讓人很容易明白他的意思。
examples.english_sentence: His way of speaking (intonation) is very interesting; it makes his meaning easy to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唱歌嘅時候要控制聲調同氣息，先可以唱得好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng3 go1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 hung3 zi3 seng1 diu6 tung4 hei3 sik1, sin1 ho2 ji5 coeng3 dak1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唱歌的時候要控制聲調和氣息，才能唱好。
examples.english_sentence: When singing you need to control pitch and breath; only then can you sing well.

mandarin_meaning: 口頭討論；以語音進行的談話（書面或正式語境中較少見）
english_meaning: spoken discussion; verbal talk (a discussion carried out orally rather than in writing)
explanation_mandarin: 「聲談」一般指以語音進行的談話或討論，偏向書面或正式表達時使用，強調口頭而非書面交流。此詞在日常口語中較少見，可能用於區分口頭與書面溝通。
explanation_english: “聲談” refers to a discussion conducted orally — a verbal conversation as opposed to a written one. It is somewhat formal or literary and is used to emphasize spoken (not written) communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事我哋明天要聲談，唔好喺電郵度講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 dei6 ming4 tin1 jiu3 sing1 taam4, m4 hou2 hai2 din6 jau4 dou6 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事我們明天要口頭討論，不要在電郵裡面寫或講。
examples.english_sentence: We should discuss this matter verbally tomorrow; don't handle it over email.

mandarin_meaning: 聲譽（評價、名聲）
english_meaning: reputation; prestige; good name; credibility
explanation_mandarin: 指個人或組織在他人心目中的評價或名聲，通常用來表示榮譽、信譽或社會評價。
explanation_english: Refers to the opinion or esteem in which a person or organization is held by others; denotes prestige, credibility, or social standing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好注重自己嘅聲譽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyu3 zung6 zi6 gei2 ge3 sing1 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很重視自己的聲譽。
examples.english_sentence: He cares a lot about his reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅聲譽受咗嗰宗醜聞影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 sing1 jyu6 sau6 zo2 go2 zung1 cau2 man4 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的聲譽受了那宗醜聞影響。
examples.english_sentence: The company's reputation was affected by that scandal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 保持良好嘅聲譽好緊要，特別係喺學術界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou2 ci4 loeng4 hou2 ge3 sing1 jyu6 hou2 gan2 jiu3, dak6 bit6 hai6 hok6 seot6 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 保持良好的聲譽很重要，特別是在學術界。
examples.english_sentence: Maintaining a good reputation is important, especially in the academic community.

mandarin_meaning: 声部 (shēngbù)
english_meaning: voice part; musical part (e.g., soprano, alto, tenor, bass); a single vocal or instrumental line in polyphony
explanation_mandarin: 指合唱或多聲部音樂中各自獨立的聲線或聲部，如女高音、女低音、男高音、男低音等。也可指樂曲中不同的聲部或聲線。
explanation_english: Refers to an individual vocal or instrumental part in polyphonic music or a choir (e.g., soprano, alto, tenor, bass). It denotes a distinct melodic line or section within a composition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 合唱團要分聲部練習，每個聲部都要熟習自己的旋律。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hap6 coeng3 tyun4 jiu3 fan1 seng1 bou6 lin6 zaap6, mui5 go3 seng1 bou6 dou1 jiu3 suk6 zaap6 zi6 gei2 dik1 syun4 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 合唱团要分声部练习，每个声部都要熟习自己的旋律。
examples.english_sentence: The choir needs to practice by parts; each part must be familiar with its own melody.

mandarin_meaning: 一聲不響；沒有任何聲音或反應
english_meaning: completely silent; not making any sound or response
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容完全沒有聲音或反應，表示沉默、不作聲或沒有任何回應，常用於口語或廣東話日常表達。
explanation_english: Used to describe having no sound or response at all; indicates silence, not making a sound, or giving no reaction. Common in colloquial Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到成績單之後，坐喺度聲都唔聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 sing4 zik1 daan1 zi1 hau6, co5 hai2 dou6 seng1 dou1 m4 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到成績單後，坐在那裡一聲不響。
examples.english_sentence: After seeing the report card, he sat there without making a sound.

mandarin_meaning: 声音
english_meaning: sound; voice
explanation_mandarin: 表示由物體振動產生並被耳朵感知的聲響，也可指人的聲線或說話的聲音。
explanation_english: Refers to sounds produced by vibration and perceived by the ears; can also mean a person's voice or the way someone speaks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽唔到佢嘅聲音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 m4 dou2 keoi5 ge3 seng1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听不到他的声音。
examples.english_sentence: I can't hear his/her voice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部錄音機嘅聲音好清晰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 luk6 jam1 gei1 ge3 seng1 jam1 hou2 cing1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這台錄音機的聲音很清晰。
examples.english_sentence: The sound from this recorder is very clear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電話入面冇聲音，可能係訊號唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 waa2 jap6 min6 mou5 seng1 jam1, ho2 nang4 hai6 seon3 hou6 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電話裡沒聲音，可能是訊號不好。
examples.english_sentence: There's no sound on the phone; the signal might be poor.

mandarin_meaning: 声韵（指語言的聲音和韻律成分）
english_meaning: sound and rhyme; the phonological components of a language (e.g., initials, finals, tones); prosody/rhyme
explanation_mandarin: 聲韻指語言中與發音、韻律有關的部分，通常包括聲母、韻母和聲調；在詩詞研究中也常用來指押韻和音韻規律。
explanation_english: Refers to the sounds and rhyming/phonological aspects of a language, typically including initials, finals, and tones; also used in the study of rhyme and prosodic patterns in poetry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學粵語要認識聲韻和聲調。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jyut6 jyu5 jiu3 jing6 sik1 seng1 wan6 wo4 seng1 diu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习粤语要认识声韵和声调。
examples.english_sentence: Learning Cantonese requires understanding its sounds and tones.

mandarin_meaning: 声响；声音；响声（shēngxiǎng/ shēngyīn）
english_meaning: sound; noise; a sound or an audible disturbance
explanation_mandarin: 指聲音或響動，常用於描述從某處傳出的聲音或雜音。
explanation_english: Refers to a sound or noise; commonly used to describe a sound coming from somewhere or an audible disturbance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽到隔離房有奇怪嘅聲響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 dou3 gaak3 lei4 fong4 jau5 kei4 gwaai3 ge3 seng1 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听到隔壁房间有奇怪的声响。
examples.english_sentence: I heard a strange sound coming from the next room.

mandarin_meaning: 耸；耸立；耸肩（耸动、引起震惊，如“聳人聽聞”）
english_meaning: to tower; to rise steeply; to shrug (one's shoulders); to arouse alarm or sensation
explanation_mandarin: 表示高高耸立或竖起，也可表示耸肩示意不在乎或漠不关心；在成语中有“聳人聽聞”，表示耸动听闻、夸张渲染。
explanation_english: Used to indicate towering or standing tall, or to shrug one's shoulders as a gesture; also appears in idioms like '聳人聽聞' meaning to sensationalize or alarm people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係聳下肩，冇講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 sung2 haa6 gin1, mou5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只耸了耸肩，没说话。
examples.english_sentence: He just shrugged his shoulders and didn't say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座大廈高聳入雲，好壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 daai6 haa6 gou1 sung2 jap6 wan4, hou2 zong6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座大厦高耸入云，很壮观。
examples.english_sentence: This building towers into the clouds; it's spectacular.

mandarin_meaning: （高高地）矗立、聳起
english_meaning: to tower; to stand tall; to rise high
explanation_mandarin: 表示在某處高高矗立，常用來形容建築、山峰、塔等直立、高聳的物體。
explanation_english: Describes something standing tall or towering in a place; commonly used for buildings, peaks, towers, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 摩天大樓聳立喺市中心，成條街都望到佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mo1 tin1 daai6 lau4 sung2 laap6 hai2 si5 zung1 sam1, sing4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 mong6 dou3 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 摩天大樓矗立在市中心，整條街都能看到它們。
examples.english_sentence: The skyscrapers tower in the city center; you can see them from the whole street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 那座孤零零的燈塔聳立喺懸崖上，望落好孤獨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naa5 zo6 gu1 ling4 ling4 dik1 dang1 taap3 sung2 laap6 hai2 jyun4 ngai4 seong6, mong6 lok6 hou2 gu1 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那座孤零零的燈塔聳立在懸崖上，看起來很孤獨。
examples.english_sentence: The lone lighthouse stands on the cliff, looking very solitary.

mandarin_meaning: 耸肩（表示不在乎、无奈或不知道）
english_meaning: to shrug (one's) shoulders; to show indifference, ignorance, or resignation
explanation_mandarin: 用肩膀上下耸动来表示不在乎、不知道或无奈的肢体动作或表情。
explanation_english: A physical gesture of raising the shoulders to indicate indifference, lack of knowledge, or resignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聳肩，話唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung2 gin1, waa6 m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他耸了耸肩，说不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: He shrugged his shoulders and said he didn't know what had happened.

mandarin_meaning: 听 (tīng)；聽見、傾聽、服從
english_meaning: to listen; to hear; to obey; to heed
explanation_mandarin: 「聴」為「聽」的異體字，表示用耳朵接收聲音、聆聽或聽從別人意見。常用於日常會話如「聽到」「聽話」「聽意見」。
explanation_english: “聴” is a variant form of 聽 (listen). It means to hear or listen (and can also imply obeying or heeding someone's advice). Used in phrases like “hear”, “listen to someone”, or “take advice”.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇聴到樓下啲聲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 teng1 dou3 lau4 haa6 di1 seng1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有沒有聽到樓下的聲音？
examples.english_sentence: Did you hear the noise downstairs?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路要聴老師講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 jiu3 teng1 lou5 si1 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子要聽老師說話。
examples.english_sentence: Kids should listen to the teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會聴你朋友嘅意見先至決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 teng1 nei5 pang4 jau5 ge3 ji3 gin3 sin1 zi3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我會聽你朋友的意見再決定。
examples.english_sentence: I'll listen to your friend's opinion before deciding.

mandarin_meaning: 聶（姓）；（文言）低聲細語、耳語
english_meaning: Nie (a Chinese surname); (archaic/literary) to whisper, to murmur
explanation_mandarin: 「聶」常用作漢姓，也有文言義「低聲細語、耳語」，在現代漢語中多見於人名或書面用字。
explanation_english: The character is commonly used as the Chinese surname Nie. In classical/literary usage it can mean to whisper or murmur. In modern usage it mainly appears as a surname or in names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢姓聶，好少見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing3 nip6, hou2 siu2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他姓聶，很少見。
examples.english_sentence: His surname is Nie; it's uncommon.

mandarin_meaning: 職（职）：職務、職位、職責或職業
english_meaning: job; post; duty; position; occupation
explanation_mandarin: 表示工作上的職務、職位或責任，常見於職位、職員、職責等詞語中。
explanation_english: A character referring to a job, post, duty, or responsibility; commonly appears in compounds such as 職位 (position), 職員 (staff), 職責 (responsibility).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺公司做職員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 gung1 si1 zou6 zik1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在在公司做職員。
examples.english_sentence: He is currently working as a staff member at the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個職位好難請人做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zik1 wai6 hou2 nan4 ceng2 jan4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個職位很難找到人做。
examples.english_sentence: This position is hard to find someone to fill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為老師，你嘅職責係教書同照顧學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai6 lou5 si1, nei5 ge3 zik1 zaak3 hai6 gaau3 syu1 tung4 ziu3 gu3 hok6 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作為老師，你的職責是教書和照顧學生。
examples.english_sentence: As a teacher, your responsibilities are teaching and looking after students.

mandarin_meaning: 職位 (zhíwèi)
english_meaning: position; job post; office; vacancy
explanation_mandarin: 指公司或機構內的工作崗位或職務名稱，也可指某個職務的空缺。
explanation_english: Refers to a job position or post within a company or organization; can also mean a vacancy for that role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司而家有個職位空缺，你想唔想申請？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ji4 gaa1 jau5 go3 zik1 wai6 hung1 kyut3, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 san1 cing2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司現在有一個職位空缺，你想不想申請？
examples.english_sentence: The company currently has a job opening. Do you want to apply?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家嘅職位係市場經理，做緊市場推廣同分析。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ge3 zik1 wai6 hai6 si5 coeng4 ging1 lei5, zou6 gan2 si5 coeng4 teoi1 gwong2 tung4 fan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在的職位是市場經理，負責市場推廣和分析。
examples.english_sentence: His current position is Marketing Manager, responsible for marketing and analysis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請職位嘅截止日期係下星期五。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 zik1 wai6 ge3 git3 zi2 jat6 hai6 haa6 sing1 kei4 ng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申請該職位的截止日期是下星期五。
examples.english_sentence: The deadline to apply for the position is next Friday.

mandarin_meaning: 职位空缺 (zhíwèi kōngquē)
english_meaning: job vacancy; open position
explanation_mandarin: 表示公司或機構中尚未有人擔任、需要招聘的職位。
explanation_english: Refers to a position in a company or organization that is unfilled and needs to be recruited for.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司有一個職位空缺，佢哋而家開始招聘新同事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 jat1 go3 zik1 wai6 hung1 kyut3, keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 hoi1 ci2 ziu1 pin3 san1 tung4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有一个职位空缺，他们现在开始招聘新同事。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a job vacancy; they're now starting to recruit a new colleague.

mandarin_meaning: 職責、職務或應盡的本分
english_meaning: duty; responsibility; one's role or obligation
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人在工作或生活中應該履行的責任或職務範圍。
explanation_english: Refers to the duties, responsibilities, or role someone is expected to carry out in work or daily life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 照顧小朋友係我嘅職分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu3 gu3 siu2 pang4 jau5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zik1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照顾小朋友是我的职责。
examples.english_sentence: Taking care of children is my responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 完成工作係每個員工嘅職分，唔可以偷懶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 sing4 gung1 zok3 hai6 mui5 go3 jyun4 gung1 ge3 zik1 fan6, m4 ho2 ji5 tau1 laan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 完成工作是每个员工的职责，不可以偷懒。
examples.english_sentence: Finishing the work is every employee's duty; you can't slack off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢哋嘅職分唔同，但係要互相幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zik1 fan6 m4 tung4, daan6 hai6 jiu3 wu6 soeng1 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他们的职责不同，但要互相帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Although their responsibilities differ, they should help one another.

mandarin_meaning: 職務（職位或工作上應履行的任務與責任）
english_meaning: job duties; position; the tasks and responsibilities of a post
explanation_mandarin: 指在工作或職場中所擔任的崗位及其所需履行的任務與責任，強調職責與工作內容。
explanation_english: Refers to a position at work and the tasks and responsibilities assigned to that post; emphasizes duties and job content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份職務需要高度嘅責任感，同埋良好嘅溝通能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 zik1mou6 seoi1 jiu3 gou1 dou6 ge3 zaak3 jam6 gam2, tung4 maai4 loeng4 hou2 ge3 kau1 tung1 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這份職務需要高度的責任感，以及良好的溝通能力。
examples.english_sentence: This position requires a high sense of responsibility and good communication skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 升職後，我嘅職務範圍擴大咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 zik1 hau6, ngo5 ge3 zik1mou6 faan6 wai4 kwok3 daai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 升職後，我的職務範圍擴大了。
examples.english_sentence: After the promotion, my range of duties expanded.

mandarin_meaning: 职员；员工
english_meaning: staff member; employee
explanation_mandarin: 指在某公司或機構中受僱從事工作的人，通常指一般員工或職場人員。
explanation_english: A person employed by an organization; a staff member or employee, typically referring to regular personnel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司入面嘅職員都好努力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jap6 min6 ge3 zik1 jyun4 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司里的职员都很努力。
examples.english_sentence: The company's staff are all very hardworking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個職員可以幫我查一查資料嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 zik1 jyun4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 caa4 jat1 caa4 zi1 liu2 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个职员可以帮我查一下资料吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can that employee help me look up the information?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府職員要遵守規定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zik1 jyun4 jiu3 zeon1 sau2 gwai1 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府工作人员必须遵守规定。
examples.english_sentence: Government staff must follow the regulations.

mandarin_meaning: 职场；工作场所或职业环境
english_meaning: workplace; professional environment
explanation_mandarin: 指人们工作或从事职业的场所与环境，也可泛指与工作相关的人际关系、职场文化和制度。
explanation_english: Refers to the place or environment where people work or pursue a career; can also broadly mean workplace relationships, culture, and systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅職場競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 zik1 coeng4 ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的职场竞争很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: Competition in today's workplace is intense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺職場上好有經驗，升職都幾快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zik1 coeng4 soeng6 hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6, sing1 zik1 dou1 gei2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在职场上很有经验，升职也挺快的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very experienced in the workplace and gets promoted fairly quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 履行職責；值守（崗位）
english_meaning: to perform one's duties; to be on duty/guard a post; sense of duty
explanation_mandarin: 指在崗位上履行職責或值守，強調對工作或崗位的負責與守護。
explanation_english: Refers to performing duties at a post or being on duty; emphasizes responsibility and guarding one's position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做任何工作都要有職守。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jam6 ho4 gung1 zok3 dou1 jiu3 jau5 zik1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做任何工作都要有職守。
examples.english_sentence: In any job you must have a sense of duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜班職員需要輪流職守門崗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 baan1 zik1 jyun4 seoi1 jiu3 leon4 lau4 zik1 sau2 mun4 gong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜班職員需要輪流值守門崗。
examples.english_sentence: Night-shift staff need to take turns guarding the gate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做得好有職守，老闆好放心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 dak1 hou2 jau5 zik1 sau2, lou5 baan2 hou2 fong3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有職守，老闆很放心。
examples.english_sentence: He is very responsible in his duties; the boss is very reassured.

mandarin_meaning: 職業安全與健康（职业安全与健康）
english_meaning: Occupational safety and health (OSH); workplace safety and employee health
explanation_mandarin: 「職安健」是香港粵語中對「職業安全與健康」的簡稱，指工作場所的安全、員工的身體與心理健康，以及相關的法規、管理制度、培訓與預防措施。
explanation_english: “職安健” is a Cantonese abbreviation used in Hong Kong for “occupational safety and health.” It refers to workplace safety, employees' physical and mental health, and the related regulations, management, training, and preventive measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要提高職安健意識，減少工傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 tai4 gou1 zik1 on1 gin6 ji3 sik1, gaam2 siu2 gung1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要提高職業安全與健康意識，減少工傷。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to raise occupational safety and health awareness to reduce workplace injuries.

mandarin_meaning: 职工（指在单位或公司工作的人员，员工）
english_meaning: worker; staff; employee
explanation_mandarin: 指在单位、公司或工厂工作的人员，常用于正式或集体称谓，有时侧重指工人或受雇的职员。
explanation_english: Refers to persons employed by an organization, company, or factory; used as a formal or collective term for workers or staff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要求所有職工下星期二出席職工大會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 so2 jau5 zik1 gung1 haa6 sing1 kei4 ji6 ceot1 zik6 zik1 gung1 daai6 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要求所有职工下星期二出席职工大会。
examples.english_sentence: The company requires all employees to attend the staff meeting next Tuesday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 職工應該享有合理嘅休息同福利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik1 gung1 jing1 goi1 hoeng2 jau5 ho4 lei5 ge3 jau1 sik1 tung4 fuk1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 职工应该享有合理的休息和福利。
examples.english_sentence: Workers should be entitled to reasonable rest and benefits.

mandarin_meaning: 職業（工作、行業或專業）
english_meaning: occupation; profession; vocation
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人從事的工作類別或專業身份，例如教師、醫生、律師等。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's line of work, profession, or vocation — the type of job or professional role someone has (e.g., teacher, doctor, lawyer).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅職業係老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zik1 jip6 hai6 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的職業是老師。
examples.english_sentence: His occupation is a teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對而家呢份職業滿唔滿意？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 ji4 gaa1 ni1 fan6 zik1 jip6 maan5 m4 maan5 ji3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你對現在這份職業滿意嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you satisfied with this job/profession?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 職業道德喺醫護行業好緊要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik1 jip6 dou6 dak1 hai2 ji1 wu6 hong4 jip6 hou2 gan2 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 職業道德在醫護行業很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Professional ethics are very important in the healthcare profession.

mandarin_meaning: 職業學生；長期以學生身份存在的人；有時作貶義，指把當學生或參與學生活動當作職業的人
english_meaning: 'professional student' — someone who remains a student for a long time or treats being a student as their occupation; sometimes derogatory, used for perpetual students or student-activists who act full-time.
explanation_mandarin: 指長期維持學生身份的人（例如多次重讀或不斷升學），亦可作貶義，形容把做學生或參與示威、社運當作正職、全職從事的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who maintains student status long-term (e.g., repeating years or continuously enrolling). Also used pejoratively to describe someone who treats being a student — or engaging in student activism — as their full-time job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人話佢係職業學生，成日參加示威，好似將做學生當正職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 keoi5 hai6 zik1 jip6 hok6 saang1, sing4 jat6 caam1 gaa1 si6 wai1, hou2 ci5 zoeng1 zou6 hok6 saang1 dong3 zing3 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人說他是職業學生，整天參加示威，好像把做學生當成正職。
examples.english_sentence: Some people call him a 'professional student' — he joins protests all the time, as if being a student is his full-time job.

jyutping: zik1 jip6 mou4 fan1 gwai3 zin6
mandarin_meaning: 職業沒有貴賤之分
english_meaning: There is no high or low in occupations; no occupation is inferior or superior
explanation_mandarin: 這句話表示不應該以人的職業來評價其高低貴賤，每一種工作都有其價值與尊嚴。
explanation_english: This phrase expresses that one should not judge people by their occupations; every job has value and dignity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要明白，職業無分貴賤，每種工作都有價值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ming4 baak6, zik1 jip6 mou4 fan1 gwai3 zin6, mui5 zung2 gung1 zok3 dou1 jau5 gaa3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要明白，職業沒有貴賤之分，每種工作都有價值。
examples.english_sentence: We should understand that there is no high or low in occupations; every job has value.

mandarin_meaning: 職業病（指由工作環境或職業性質引起的疾病；引申為因職業形成的習慣或傾向）
english_meaning: Occupational disease (an illness caused by work or workplace); figuratively, a professional habit or tendency developed from one's job
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指由於工作環境或工作性質導致的疾病或健康問題；在口語中常用作比喻，指因職業習慣或職業特性而形成的行為傾向或反應（例如醫生見人就想診斷）。
explanation_english: Literally an illness caused by one's occupation or workplace conditions. Figuratively used to mean an ingrained professional habit or tendency that someone develops because of their job (e.g., a doctor who always wants to diagnose).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗十幾年廚師，依家有職業病，成日背痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 sap6 gei2 nin4 ceoi4 si1, ji1 gaa1 jau5 zik1 jip6 beng6, seng4 jat6 bui3 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了十幾年廚師，現在有職業病，經常背痛。
examples.english_sentence: He has worked as a chef for over ten years; now he has an occupational ailment and often has back pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生有時會有職業病，見病人就想幫手檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 jau5 si4 wui5 jau5 zik1 jip6 beng6, gin3 beng6 jan4 zau6 soeng2 bong1 sau2 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生有時會有職業病，看到病人就想幫忙檢查。
examples.english_sentence: Doctors sometimes have 'occupational habits' — they want to check patients even when not on duty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我做記者，成日都會有職業病，見到有趣嘅事就想採訪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zou6 gei3 ze2, seng4 jat6 dou1 wui5 jau5 zik1 jip6 beng6, gin3 dou3 jau5 ceoi3 ge3 si6 zau6 soeng2 coi2 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做記者，常常有職業病，看到有趣的事情就想採訪。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a journalist; I often have occupational instincts — when I see something interesting I want to report it.

mandarin_meaning: 职权；权力或权限
english_meaning: authority; power or jurisdiction attached to a position or office
explanation_mandarin: 指在职务或职位上所拥有的权力、权限或管辖范围。
explanation_english: Refers to the power, authority, or jurisdiction that a person holds by virtue of their job, position, or office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個決定超出咗我嘅職權，我需要上報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ciu1 ceot1 zo2 ngo5 ge3 zik1 kyun4, ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 soeng5 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个决定超出了我的职权，我需要上报。
examples.english_sentence: This decision exceeds my authority; I need to report it.

mandarin_meaning: 职称（职位名称、专业称号）
english_meaning: job title; professional title
explanation_mandarin: 指在工作或職場上用來表示職務或專業身分的名稱，例如「經理」、「工程師」等。
explanation_english: The name of a job or professional designation used in the workplace, e.g., "manager," "engineer."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅職稱係咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 zik1 cing1 hai6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的职称是什么？
examples.english_sentence: What's your job title?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為升職，職稱改咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 sing1 zik1, zik1 cing1 goi2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为升职，职称改了。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted, and his job title changed.

mandarin_meaning: 职级 (zhíjí) — 职位的等级、级别
english_meaning: job grade; rank; position level
explanation_mandarin: 指组织或机构中根据职责、资历或职务划分的等级或级别，常用于决定薪酬、升迁和责任范围。
explanation_english: Refers to the level or grade of a position within an organization, often used to determine salary, promotion and scope of responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司會根據職級安排薪酬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wui5 gan1 geoi3 zik1 kap1 on1 paai4 san1 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司会根据职级安排薪酬。
examples.english_sentence: The company will arrange salaries according to job grades.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗一個職級，責任更大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 jat1 go3 zik1 kap1, zaak3 jam6 gang3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升了一个职级，责任更大。
examples.english_sentence: He was promoted one rank; his responsibilities are greater.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公務員嘅職級表會列出唔同等級。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 mou6 jyun4 ge3 zik1 kap1 biu2 wui5 lit6 ceot1 m4 tung4 dang2 kap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公务员的职级表会列出不同等级。
examples.english_sentence: The civil servant rank table lists different grades.

mandarin_meaning: 职能（zhínéng）：指工作或组织中承担的职责或功能。
english_meaning: Function; job function; the duties and responsibilities associated with a position or organizational unit.
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述職位或部門所負責的具體職務、任務與功能範圍。
explanation_english: Used to describe the specific duties, tasks and functional scope assigned to a job position or department.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個職位嘅職能包括市場推廣同客戶管理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zik1 wai6 ge3 zik1 nang4 baau1 kwaa3 si5 coeng4 teoi1 gwong2 tung4 haak3 wu6 gun2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个职位的职能包括市场推广和客户管理。
examples.english_sentence: The job functions of this position include marketing and client management.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司需要重新界定各部門嘅職能，避免職責重疊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 cung4 san1 gaai3 ding6 gok3 bou6 mun4 ge3 zik1 nang4, bei6 min5 zik1 zaak3 cung4 dip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司需要重新界定各部门的职能，避免职责重叠。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to redefine the functions of each department to avoid overlapping responsibilities.

mandarin_meaning: 职责
english_meaning: duty; responsibility; job responsibilities
explanation_mandarin: 指个人或组织在工作或职位上应承担的责任和任务。
explanation_english: Refers to the responsibilities and tasks an individual or organization is expected to undertake in a role or position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個職責由我負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zik1 zaak3 jau4 ngo5 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个职责由我负责。
examples.english_sentence: This duty is my responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司劃分咗每個職員嘅職責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 waak6 fan1 zo2 mui5 go3 zik1 jyun4 ge3 zik1 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司划分了每个职员的职责。
examples.english_sentence: The company has assigned each employee's responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 履行職責係做事嘅基本要求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: leoi5 hang4 zik1 zaak3 hai6 zou6 si6 ge3 gei1 bun2 jiu1 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 履行职责是做事的基本要求。
examples.english_sentence: Fulfilling responsibilities is a basic requirement for doing work.

mandarin_meaning: 职称；职位名称
english_meaning: job title; official/position title
explanation_mandarin: 指在公司、機構或職場中用以表明一個人職務、等級或專業身份的稱謂。
explanation_english: A designation used in a company or organization to indicate a person's position, rank, or professional title.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅職銜係高級經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zik1 haam4 hai6 gou1 kap1 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的职称是高级经理。
examples.english_sentence: His job title is Senior Manager.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請表上要填寫清楚你嘅職銜同部門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 cing2 biu2 soeng6 jiu3 tin4 se2 cing1 co2 nei5 ge3 zik1 haam4 tung4 bou6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申请表上要填写清楚你的职称与部门。
examples.english_sentence: On the application form you must clearly fill in your job title and department.

mandarin_meaning: 听 / 聽（tīng）：听见、倾听、听从
english_meaning: to listen; to hear; to obey; to heed
explanation_mandarin: 表示用耳朵接收聲音（聽、聽見、傾聽），也可表示聽從、接受建議或命令。
explanation_english: Indicates perceiving sound (to hear, to listen) and can also mean to obey or heed advice/instructions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽唔聽到隻雀喺度唱歌？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 teng1 m4 teng1 dou3 zek3 zoek3 hai2 dou6 coeng3 go1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你听不听到那只鸟在唱歌？
examples.english_sentence: Can you hear the bird singing?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話你應該聽佢嘅建議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 nei5 jing1 goi1 teng1 keoi5 ge3 gin3 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说你应该听他的建议。
examples.english_sentence: He said you should listen to his advice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔要學識聽話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 jiu3 hok6 sik1 teng1 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子要学会听话。
examples.english_sentence: Children should learn to be obedient / to listen.

mandarin_meaning: 聽他的甜言蜜語；被花言巧語哄騙
english_meaning: to fall for someone's sweet talk; to be taken in by flattery or persuasive talk
explanation_mandarin: 「聽⋯支笛」是廣東話口語用法，字面指「聽某人吹笛」，實際上比喻聽信別人的花言巧語、甜言蜜語而受騙或被說服做某事。
explanation_english: This Cantonese colloquial expression literally means "listen to someone's flute (playing)", but figuratively it refers to believing someone's smooth talk or flattery and being taken in or persuaded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好聽佢支笛，佢係想呃你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teng1 keoi5 zi1 dek6, keoi5 hai6 soeng2 ngok6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別聽他的甜言蜜語，他想騙你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fall for his sweet talk; he wants to cheat you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我真係聽咗佢支笛，買咗好多唔需要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zan1 hai6 teng1 zo2 keoi5 zi1 dek6, maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 m4 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我真的信了他的花言巧語，結果買了很多不需要的東西。
examples.english_sentence: I really fell for his smooth talk and ended up buying a lot of things I didn't need.

mandarin_meaning: 听一下/听一听；听听看；（让某人）听完、听一下
english_meaning: listen for a moment; try listening; hear someone out
explanation_mandarin: 「聽下」是廣東話的口語說法，表示請對方稍微聽一聽、試着聽或把話聽完，常用來軟化語氣或邀請別人聽意見或內容。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase meaning 'listen for a bit', 'try listening', or 'hear someone out'. It's often used to soften a request or invite someone to listen to an opinion or content briefly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽下，我有件事想講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 teng1 haa5, ngo5 jau5 gin6 si6 soeng2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你听一下，我有件事想说。
examples.english_sentence: Listen for a moment, I have something I want to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好即刻走，聽下佢講完先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zik1 haak1 zau2, teng1 haa5 keoi5 gong2 jyun4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别马上走，先听他/她说完。
examples.english_sentence: Don't leave immediately — hear them out first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試吓聽下呢首歌，幾好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 haa5 teng1 haa5 ni1 sau2 go1, gei2 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你试着听一听这首歌，很好听。
examples.english_sentence: Try listening to this song — it's pretty good.

mandarin_meaning: 听从别人 / 听别人说话
english_meaning: to listen to or obey someone; to heed others' opinions
explanation_mandarin: 表示听从别人的话或意见，也可指倾听他人所说。
explanation_english: Indicates listening to or obeying someone, or paying heed to what others say or advise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日好聽人，乜都聽人講，冇主見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hou2 teng1 jan4, mat1 dou1 teng1 jan4 gong2, mou5 zyu2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常很听别人的话，什么都听别人说，没有主见。
examples.english_sentence: He often listens to others too much; he does whatever others say and has no opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係聽人講，要自己先諗下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 teng1 jan4 gong2, jiu3 zi6 gei2 lam2 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只听别人说，要自己先想一想。
examples.english_sentence: Don't only listen to what others say; think for yourself first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽人勸，所以出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 teng1 jan4 hyun3, so2 ji5 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听劝，所以出了事。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't take advice, so something went wrong.

mandarin_meaning: 听别人说；据说
english_meaning: to hear someone say; reportedly; it is said
explanation_mandarin: 表示聽到別人說某事，常用於轉述或傳聞，帶有傳聞語氣。
explanation_english: Used to indicate having heard something from others; commonly used to report hearsay or what people say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽人講嗰間餐廳好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 jan4 gong2 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听别人说那家餐厅很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that restaurant is really tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽人講佢辭職喇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 teng1 jan4 gong2 keoi5 ci4 zik1 laa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你听别人说他辞职了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Did you hear that he resigned?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽人講，佢要結婚喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 jan4 gong2, keoi5 jiu3 git3 fan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听别人说，他要结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: People say he's getting married.

mandarin_meaning: 等一下；先別急；先聽我說
english_meaning: Hold on; wait a moment; hang on (colloquial request to pause or pay attention)
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，用來請對方暫停、等一下或先聽說話，常用於打斷或要求暫停行動的情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to ask someone to pause or wait, or to get their attention before continuing. Commonly used to interrupt or to request a short delay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽住先，我未講完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 zyu6 sin1, ngo5 mei6 gong2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下，我還沒說完。
examples.english_sentence: Hold on, I'm not finished yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽住先，俾啲時間我諗下先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 zyu6 sin1, bei2 di1 si4 gaan1 ngo5 lam2 haa5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等一下，給我一點時間想一想。
examples.english_sentence: Wait a moment, give me some time to think.

mandarin_meaning: 听信（相信別人說的話或傳聞，有時含被誤導或受騙之意）
english_meaning: to believe (what someone says); to be led into believing; to be taken in by rumors or false claims
explanation_mandarin: 表示相信別人說的話、傳聞或宣傳，有時暗含輕信或被誤導、受騙的意思。
explanation_english: Used to indicate believing someone's words, rumors, or advertising; often implies gullibility or being misled/deceived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁容易聽信陌生人嘅話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 jung4 ji6 teng1 seon3 mak6 sang1 jan4 ge3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那麼容易相信陌生人的話。
examples.english_sentence: Don't so easily believe what strangers say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日聽信街坊八卦，結果散播錯誤消息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 teng1 seon3 gaai1 fong1 baat3 gwaa3, git3 gwo2 saan3 bo3 co3 ng6 siu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常聽信街坊的八卦，結果散播錯誤的消息。
examples.english_sentence: He often believes neighborhood gossip and ends up spreading false information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為聽信廣告而買咗唔必要嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 teng1 seon3 gwong2 gou3 ji5 maai5 zo2 m4 bit1 jiu3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為相信廣告而買了不必要的東西。
examples.english_sentence: He bought unnecessary things because he believed the advertisement.

mandarin_meaning: 只听价格不听争吵/面子（只看重價錢，不在乎排場或口頭爭辯）
english_meaning: Only cares about the price/offer and ignores boasting, disputes, or appearances; pragmatic and money-focused
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人在談判或買賣時只關心價格，不在意面子、爭吵或虛張聲勢，重實際利益。
explanation_english: Describes a person (often in bargaining or business) who focuses solely on the price or offer and pays no attention to face, arguments, or showy talk — pragmatic and money-oriented.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢講排場，佢係聽價唔聽斗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 paai4 coeng4, keoi5 hai6 teng1 gaa3 m4 teng1 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和他談面子，他只看價格不理排場。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to appeal to his sense of face; he only cares about the price, not appearances.

mandarin_meaning: 聽到厭煩 / 聽得膩
english_meaning: to be sick/tired of hearing something because it's been repeated too often; to hear something so often it becomes tiresome
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，形容反覆聽某句話、某首歌或某件事，聽得太多而覺得厭煩或膩煩。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang phrase describing the feeling of having heard something so many times that one becomes annoyed or fed up with it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌我聽到出耳油啦，換首啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ngo5 teng1 dou3 ceot1 ji5 jau4 laa3, wun6 sau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這首歌我聽到聽膩了，換一首吧！
examples.english_sentence: I've heard this song so many times I'm sick of it — switch to another one!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講同一樣嘢，聽到出耳油，已經冇新意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 tung4 jat1 joeng6 je5, teng1 dou3 ceot1 ji5 jau4, ji5 ging1 mou5 san1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是講同一件事，聽到讓人厭煩，已經沒有新意。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps saying the same thing; hearing it so often is tiresome — there's no novelty left.

mandarin_meaning: 听到
english_meaning: to hear; to be able to hear; to have heard
explanation_mandarin: 表示用耳朵接收到聲音，或已經聽到某個訊息或內容。
explanation_english: Indicates perceiving sound with the ears or having received/heard a piece of information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽到樓下有隻狗喺度叫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 dou3 lau4 haa6 jau5 zek3 gau2 hai2 dou6 giu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听到楼下有只狗在叫。
examples.english_sentence: I heard a dog barking downstairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你有冇聽到我講嘢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau5 mou5 teng1 dou3 ngo5 gong2 je5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你有没有听到我说话？
examples.english_sentence: Did you hear what I said?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到呢個消息之後好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到这个消息之后很开心。
examples.english_sentence: He was very happy after hearing the news.

mandarin_meaning: 听力
english_meaning: hearing; auditory ability
explanation_mandarin: 指人听声音的能力或听觉功能。
explanation_english: The ability to perceive sounds; the auditory sense or capacity to hear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話你嘅聽力有啲差，要做聽力測試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 nei5 ge3 teng1 lik6 jau5 di1 caa1, jiu3 zou6 teng1 lik6 cak1 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说你的听力有点差，要做听力测试。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said your hearing is a bit poor; you need to have a hearing test.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老人家嘅聽力通常會隨住年紀而退化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 jan4 gaa1 ge3 teng1 lik6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 ceoi4 zyu6 nin4 gei2 ji4 teoi3 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老人的听力通常会随着年纪而退化。
examples.english_sentence: Elderly people's hearing usually deteriorates with age.

mandarin_meaning: 听取（意见/报告/信息）
english_meaning: to listen to; to hear; to solicit or receive opinions/information
explanation_mandarin: 表示傾聽並收集或接受他人的意見或資訊，常用於正式或書面語，如「聽取意見」「聽取報告」。
explanation_english: Indicates listening to and collecting or accepting others' opinions or information; commonly used in formal or written contexts (e.g., "listen to opinions", "hear a report").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要聽取市民嘅意見先至可以改善政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 teng1 ceoi2 si5 man4 ge3 ji3 gin3 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 goi2 sin6 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要听取市民的意见才能改善政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to listen to citizens' opinions in order to improve policies.

mandarin_meaning: 听命；服从命令
english_meaning: to obey orders; to follow instructions; to comply with commands
explanation_mandarin: 表示服从别人的命令或指示，按照要求去做；有时也带有听凭、受支配的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates obeying someone's orders or instructions; acting according to commands; can also imply being at someone's disposal or under their control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽命老細去做，冇得揀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 ming6 lou5 sai3 heoi3 zou6, mou5 dak1 gaan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听从老板的安排去做，没有选择。
examples.english_sentence: He follows the boss's orders; there's no choice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍人喺訓練期間要學識聽命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 jan4 hai6 fan3 lin6 kei4 gaan1 jiu3 hok6 sik1 teng1 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军人在训练期间要学会服从命令。
examples.english_sentence: Soldiers must learn to obey orders during training.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果公司有命令，我哋就要聽命去做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gung1 si1 jau5 ming6 ling6, ngo5 dei6 zau6 jiu3 teng1 ming6 heoi3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果公司下达命令，我们就必须照做。
examples.english_sentence: If the company issues an order, we have to comply.

mandarin_meaning: 听不进去（不愿意听、接受别人的话或劝告）
english_meaning: won't listen; won't heed; unable or unwilling to take advice or criticism
explanation_mandarin: 表示对别人的话、意见或劝告不听、不接受或无法听进心里，带有不愿意或不在意的含义。
explanation_english: An expression meaning someone does not listen to or accept others' words, advice, or criticism — either unwilling or unable to take it in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢講咗好多次要早啲返屋企，但係佢聽唔入耳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3 jiu3 zou2 di1 faan1 uk1 kei5, daan6 hai6 keoi5 teng1 m4 jap6 ji5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我跟他说了很多次要早点回家，但他听不进去。
examples.english_sentence: I told him many times to come home earlier, but he wouldn't listen.

mandarin_meaning: 听天由命
english_meaning: to resign oneself to fate; to accept whatever fate brings
explanation_mandarin: 表示對結果無能為力，只能任由命運安排，帶有無奈或順從的意味。
explanation_english: Expresses resignation to fate — being unable to change the outcome and accepting whatever happens, often with a sense of helplessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試失利，我唯有聽天由命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 sat1 lei6, ngo5 wai4 jau5 teng1 tin1 jau4 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试失利，我只好听天由命。
examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam; I can only resign myself to fate.

mandarin_meaning: 網球
english_meaning: tennis
explanation_mandarin: 「聽尼士」是廣東話裡以音譯或戲稱英語 tennis 的非正式說法，指「網球」這項運動。常見於口語或輕鬆、玩笑的語境中。
explanation_english: “聽尼士” is an informal Cantonese phonetic rendering of the English word "tennis", used to refer to the sport of tennis. It appears in colloquial or playful contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意打聽尼士，逢星期六都去練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 daa2 teng1 nei4 si6, fung4 sing1 kei4 luk6 dou1 heoi3 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜歡打網球，每週六都去練習。
examples.english_sentence: I really like playing tennis; I go practice every Saturday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今晚想唔想去公園睇聽尼士比賽？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 tai2 teng1 nei4 si6 bei2 coi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今晚想不想去公園看網球比賽？
examples.english_sentence: Do you want to go to the park to watch the tennis match tonight?

mandarin_meaning: 听从
english_meaning: to obey; to comply with; to follow someone's advice or orders
explanation_mandarin: 表示服從別人的勸告、命令或安排，按照對方的意見行事。
explanation_english: Indicates obeying or complying with someone's advice, orders, or arrangements; acting according to another's wishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好聽從爸爸嘅安排，冇反抗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 teng1 cung4 baa4 baa1 ge3 on1 paai4, mou5 faan2 kong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很聽從爸爸的安排，沒有反抗。
examples.english_sentence: He readily followed his father's arrangements and did not resist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要求員工聽從新規定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 jyun4 gung1 teng1 cung4 san1 gwai1 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要求員工聽從新規定。
examples.english_sentence: The company requires employees to comply with the new regulations.

jyutping: teng1 gu3 m4 hou2 bok3 gu3
mandarin_meaning: 听了（别人的）理由就不要反驳 / 听着别争辩
english_meaning: Listen (to someone's explanation) and don't contradict them / don't argue back
explanation_mandarin: 一種粵語口語表達，用來勸說別人在別人說明原因或解釋時不要反駁或爭辯，通常帶有讓步或勸和的意味。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression advising someone to listen to another person's explanation and not contradict or argue back; often used to urge patience or avoid conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺講原因，你就聽故唔好駁故啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gong2 jyun4 jan1, nei5 zau6 teng1 gu3 m4 hou2 bok3 gu3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在讲原因，你就听着别反驳了。
examples.english_sentence: He's explaining the reason—just listen and don't argue back.

mandarin_meaning: 听从；听课／接受教导
english_meaning: to obey/heed instructions; to listen to teaching (attend class)
explanation_mandarin: 在粵語裡，'聽教'（或寫作'聽敎'）字面上是聽老師或長輩教導；口語上可用來表示聽從指示或勸告。有時也用作'上課'或'聽課'的意思。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '聽教' (variant '聽敎') literally means to listen to teaching. Colloquially it can mean to heed or obey instructions/advice. It is also sometimes used to mean attending a class (similar to 'listen to a lesson').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要聽教，唔好亂嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 teng1 gaau3, m4 hou2 lyun6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要听从，不要乱来。
examples.english_sentence: You should heed the instructions; don't act recklessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生要準時去聽教，唔好遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 saang1 jiu3 zeon2 si4 heoi3 teng1 gaau3, m4 hou2 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生要准时去上课，不要迟到。
examples.english_sentence: Students should attend class on time; don't be late.

mandarin_meaning: 聽從教導、乖順、聽話
english_meaning: obedient; compliant; to listen to instructions or guidance
explanation_mandarin: 表示願意聽從他人的教導或指示、行為乖順。常用來形容小孩或某人很聽話、易於管教。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is obedient and willing to follow guidance or instructions. Often used to describe children or people who are well-behaved and compliant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢由細就好聽教聽話，唔會亂頂嘴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 sai3 zau6 hou2 teng1 gaau3 teng1 waa6, m4 wui5 lyun6 deng2 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他從小就很聽教聽話，不會亂頂嘴。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has been obedient since childhood and doesn't talk back.

mandarin_meaning: 聽（宗教）講道／接受教誨；口語：被訓斥或接受教導、聽從指示
english_meaning: to listen to a (religious) sermon or teaching; colloquially, to receive a lecture/scolding or to heed someone's instruction
explanation_mandarin: 1) 原指到教堂、寺廟等地方聽宗教的講道或教導。2) 口語中也可指被人訓斥、接受教誨，或表示要聽從指示。
explanation_english: 1) Originally refers to attending and listening to religious sermons or teachings (e.g., in a church or temple). 2) Colloquially it can mean being lectured/scolded or accepting someone's instruction; sometimes used to tell someone to obey directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期日我哋一齊去教堂聽教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 gaau3 tong4 teng1 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期日我們一起去教堂聽教。
examples.english_sentence: On Sunday we go to church together to listen to the sermon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細佬做錯嘢，俾爸媽聽教咗一輪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zou6 co3 je5, bei2 baa4 maa1 teng1 gaau3 zo2 jat1 leon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 弟弟做錯事，被爸媽訓斥了一頓。
examples.english_sentence: My younger brother messed up and got lectured by our parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新入職嘅員工要聽教，唔好亂嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jap6 zik1 ge3 jyun4 gung1 jiu3 teng1 gaau3, m4 hou2 lyun6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新入職的員工要接受教導，不要胡亂行事。
examples.english_sentence: New employees should take guidance and not act recklessly.

mandarin_meaning: 听从指示、听话（乖巧、服从）
english_meaning: to be obedient; to listen to instructions and behave
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語短語，常用來形容小孩或下屬等能聽從指示、守規矩、乖巧。也可用作提醒或督促別人要聽話。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase used to describe someone (often a child or subordinate) who listens to instructions, behaves, and follows rules. It can also be used to urge someone to behave or comply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要聽教聽話，唔好亂跑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 teng1 gaau3 teng1 waa6, m4 hou2 lyun6 paau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要听话，别乱跑。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be obedient and not run around.

mandarin_meaning: 明天
english_meaning: tomorrow
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話用詞，表示「明天」，可作時間名詞或時間副詞使用，常見於香港日常對話。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term meaning "tomorrow." It functions as a time noun or time adverb and is commonly used in everyday speech in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 jat6 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天上班。
examples.english_sentence: I'll go to work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日先傾啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 teng1 jat6 sin1 king1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們明天再談吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's talk tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽日有冇空？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 teng1 jat6 jau5 mou5 hung1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天有空嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you free tomorrow?

mandarin_meaning: 明天早上 / 明早
english_meaning: tomorrow morning
explanation_mandarin: 「聽早」是廣東話的口語說法，意思是「明天早上」，用來指明下一個早上發生的事情，香港日常會話常見。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning "tomorrow morning." Commonly used in Hong Kong to refer to the morning of the next day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽早要早啲返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 zou2 jiu3 zou2 di1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天早上要早一點去上班。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to work earlier tomorrow morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽早見！
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 zou2 gin3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天早上見！
examples.english_sentence: See you tomorrow morning!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聽早得閒嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 teng1 zou2 dak1 haan4 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明天早上有空嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you free tomorrow morning?

mandarin_meaning: 明晚
english_meaning: tomorrow evening / tomorrow night
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，表示「明天晚上」，即下一個晚上的時間。常用於約定或敘述時間。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression meaning "tomorrow evening" (the evening of the next day). Commonly used in casual speech to make plans or refer to that time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽晚我哋去食飯，好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 faan6, hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明晚我們去吃飯，好嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go eat tomorrow evening?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽晚要做功課，可能唔得閒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 maan5 jiu3 zou6 gung1 fo3, ho2 nang4 m4 dak1 haan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明晚要做功課，可能沒空。
examples.english_sentence: I have homework tomorrow evening; I might not be free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果聽晚落雨，記得帶雨傘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 teng1 maan5 lok6 jyu5, gei3 dak1 daai3 jyu5 saan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果明晚下雨，記得帶傘。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains tomorrow evening, remember to bring an umbrella.

mandarin_meaning: 有空聽（別人說話）
english_meaning: have time to listen; be free to listen
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語用法，詢問對方是否有時間或空閒聽自己說話，常用於打招呼或引入要談的內容。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to ask whether someone has time or is free to listen; commonly used to start a conversation or introduce something one wants to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家聽暇無？我有啲嘢想同你講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 teng1 haa6 mou5? ngo5 jau5 di1 je5 soeng2 tung4 nei5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你現在有空聽我說嗎？我有些事想跟你說。
examples.english_sentence: Are you free to listen now? I have something I want to tell you.

mandarin_meaning: 聽曲子；聽歌、聽戲曲（尤指粵曲或傳統曲藝）
english_meaning: to listen to a tune or piece of music; often refers to listening to songs or traditional operatic tunes (e.g. Cantonese opera)
explanation_mandarin: 指聆聽曲子或音樂作品，口語中常用於指聽歌或聽戲曲（如粵曲、戲曲）以娛樂或放鬆。
explanation_english: Refers to listening to musical pieces or tunes. In Cantonese usage it commonly denotes listening to songs or traditional operatic music (for example Cantonese opera) for enjoyment or relaxation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日鍾意喺屋企聽曲放鬆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 zung1 ji3 hai2 uk1 kei5 teng1 kuk1 fong3 sung1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我常常在家聽曲放鬆。
examples.english_sentence: I often listen to music at home to relax.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意聽曲，尤其係粵曲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 teng1 kuk1, jau4 kei4 hai6 jyut6 kuk1。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜歡聽曲，尤其是粵曲。
examples.english_sentence: He really likes listening to tunes, especially Cantonese opera.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）明天早上／明天上午
english_meaning: tomorrow morning (colloquial Cantonese)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 時間詞 / 副詞性時間短語
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示「明天早上」，常用於日常會話中作時間點的表達。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning "tomorrow morning." Used in everyday speech as a time expression/adverbial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽朝八點返工，未準備好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 ziu1 baat3 dim2 faan1 gung1, mei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天早上八點上班，還沒準備好。
examples.english_sentence: I start work at 8 tomorrow morning and I'm not ready yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽朝再傾，今日唔方便。
