examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 faan1 lai4 gei3 dak1 jung6 fei4 zou6 sai2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出去回來記得用肥皂洗手。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to wash your hands with soap when you come back from outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰塊肥皂好香，係邊度買嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 faai3 fei4 zou6 hou2 hoeng1, hai6 bin1 dou6 maai5 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那塊肥皂很香，是在哪裡買的？
examples.english_sentence: That bar of soap smells nice — where did you buy it?

mandarin_meaning: 肥皂剧（指情节夸张、连载播出的通俗电视剧）
english_meaning: soap opera (a melodramatic, serialized TV drama)
explanation_mandarin: 指以连载形式播出的通俗电视剧，剧情常以家庭、爱情、恩怨等俗套冲突为主，情节夸张或煽情，吸引观众追看。
explanation_english: A serialized television drama characterized by melodramatic, often formulaic plots focusing on family, romance, and interpersonal conflict; designed to attract regular viewers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都睇肥皂劇，話入面嘅人物好狗血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 tai2 fei4 zou6 kek6, waa6 jap6 min6 ge3 jan4 mat6 hou2 gau2 hyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都看肥皂剧，说里面的人物很狗血。
examples.english_sentence: He watches soap operas every day, saying the characters are very melodramatic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套肥皂劇收視一般，但討論度好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 fei4 zou6 kek6 sau1 si6 jat1 bun1, daan6 tou2 leon6 dou6 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部肥皂剧收视一般，但讨论度很高。
examples.english_sentence: This soap opera has average ratings but a lot of discussion/popularity.

mandarin_meaning: 肥羊（比喻易被敲詐或能從中獲利的對象，如有錢人或高消費客戶）
english_meaning: literally 'fat sheep'; figuratively an easy mark or a lucrative target (e.g. wealthy people or high-spending customers) — a 'cash cow' or 'easy mark'.
explanation_mandarin: 原指肥壯的羊，口語中常作比喻，指那些容易被騙、剝削或可從中獲利的對象，常用於形容有錢人或高消費的客戶。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a fat sheep; in colloquial use it metaphorically denotes someone who is an easy target to be fleeced or profited from — often wealthy individuals or high-spending customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲騙徒專挑有錢嘅人做肥羊，慢慢搵盡佢哋嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 pin3 tou4 zyun1 tiu1 jau5 cin2 ge3 jan4 zou6 fei4 joeng4, maan6 maan6 wan2 zeon6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些騙子專挑有錢人當肥羊，慢慢把他們的錢騙光。
examples.english_sentence: Those scammers specifically target wealthy people as easy marks, slowly taking all their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司計劃將呢啲高消費嘅客戶當成肥羊，好好開發佢哋嘅需求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gai3 waak6 zoeng1 ni1 di1 gou1 siu1 fai3 ge3 haak3 wu6 dong1 sing4 fei4 joeng4, hou2 hou2 hoi1 faat3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 seoi1 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司計劃把這些高消費的客戶當成肥羊，好好開發他們的需求。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to treat these high-spending customers as cash cows and thoroughly develop their needs.

mandarin_meaning: 肥美 (féiměi)：肥厚、鮮美、肉質豐腴
english_meaning: plump; fat and succulent; rich and tasty (often of seafood or meat)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容食物（如魚、蝦、肉）肉質肥厚、鮮美多汁；有時也可比喻生意或收益豐厚。
explanation_english: Describes food (e.g., fish, shrimp, meat) that is plump, rich and succulent; can also be used metaphorically for something lucrative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條魚好肥美，好適合清蒸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 jyu4 hou2 fei4 mei5, hou2 sik1 hap6 cing1 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条鱼很肥美，很适合清蒸。
examples.english_sentence: This fish is very plump and is perfect for steaming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲蝦好肥美，口感彈牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 haa1 hou2 fei4 mei5, hau2 gam2 daan6 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些虾很肥美，口感弹牙。
examples.english_sentence: These prawns are plump and have a springy texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單生意好肥美，佣金幾豐厚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 sang1 ji3 hou2 fei4 mei5, jung1 gam1 gei2 fung1 hau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔生意很肥美，佣金相当丰厚。
examples.english_sentence: This deal is very lucrative; the commission is quite generous.

mandarin_meaning: 腹部赘肉；肚腩（口語）
english_meaning: belly fat; potbelly; paunch
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，指腹部累積的脂肪，常用來描述肚子凸起的贅肉。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term referring to excess fat around the abdomen (the paunch or belly fat).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想有肥肚腩，所以要做運動同埋節食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 jau5 fei4 tou5 naam5, so2 ji5 jiu3 zou6 wan6 dung6 tung4 maai4 zit3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想有肚腩，所以要做運動和節食。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to have belly fat, so I need to exercise and go on a diet.

mandarin_meaning: 胖嘟嘟、白白淨淨（通常形容嬰兒或動物）
english_meaning: chubby and fair/white; plump and fair-skinned—often used affectionately for babies or animals
explanation_mandarin: 「肥肥白白」是廣東話口語，重疊形容詞形式，表示又胖又白、圓潤可愛，常用於形容嬰兒、小動物或外表圓潤的人，帶親昵語氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial reduplicated adjective meaning plump/chubby and fair/pale. It conveys an affectionate, cute tone and is commonly used for babies, small animals, or someone with a round, soft appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個BB肥肥白白，好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 BB fei4 fei4 baak6 baak6, hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個寶寶胖嘟嘟、白白淨淨，很可愛。
examples.english_sentence: The baby is chubby and fair—so cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條小狗肥肥白白，成日黐人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 siu2 gau2 fei4 fei4 baak6 baak6, sing4 jat6 ci1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻小狗又胖又白，整天黏人。
examples.english_sentence: The puppy is chubby and white, always clingy.

mandarin_meaning: 胎儿过大（巨大胎儿）
english_meaning: an oversized fetus; fetal macrosomia
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，指胎儿体重或体型较大，俗称胎儿过大，医学上多称为巨大儿或胎儿巨大（macrosomia）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term referring to a fetus that is unusually large or heavy. Medically this condition is often called fetal macrosomia or a large-for-gestational-age fetus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話個胎好肥，可能要剖腹產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 go3 toi1 hou2 fei4, ho2 nang4 jiu3 pou2 fuk1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说胎儿偏大，可能要剖腹产。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the baby is large and may need a C-section.

mandarin_meaning: 肥胖 (féi pàng)
english_meaning: obese; fat; overweight
explanation_mandarin: 指身體脂肪過多、體重過重，可能對健康造成不良影響。
explanation_english: Refers to having excessive body fat or being significantly overweight, which can negatively affect health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為肥胖，醫生叫佢減肥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 fei4 pun5, ji1sang1 giu3 keoi5 gaam2fei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為肥胖，醫生叫他減肥。
examples.english_sentence: He is obese, and the doctor told him to lose weight.

mandarin_meaning: 肥與腫難以分清（比喻兩者混淆不清或糾纏難分）
english_meaning: Literally 'fat and swelling hard to separate' — used figuratively to say two things are indistinguishable or so entangled that they cannot be separated
explanation_mandarin: 原指『肥』與『腫』難以分辨，常用來形容兩種狀態、關係或利益互相混雜、糾纏不清，難以切割或分清楚。既可形容體態（如臉既胖又腫），亦可作比喻用於社會或人際關係上。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the difficulty of telling fat from swelling. Commonly used to describe two states, interests, or relationships that are mixed together or so entangled they cannot be separated or distinguished. It can be used literally (e.g., appearance) or figuratively (e.g., tangled interests).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢近排食得多，面又肥又腫，真係肥腫難分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan6 paai4 sik6 dak1 do1, min6 jau6 fei4 jau6 zung2, zan1 hai6 fei4 zung2 naan4 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近吃得多，臉又胖又腫，真是肥腫難分。
examples.english_sentence: He's been eating a lot recently; his face is both fat and swollen — it's hard to tell fat from swelling.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）胖嘟嘟、肉肉圓潤的樣子
english_meaning: chubby; pudgy; plump and cute
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話的口語形容詞，用來形容人或動物胖嘟嘟、圓潤可愛的外表或手感，語氣通常帶親切或可愛的意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese adjective describing someone or an animal as chubby/pudgy — round, soft and cute in appearance; often used affectionately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個BB肥腯腯，好得意呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 BB fei4 tuk1 tuk1, hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個寶寶胖嘟嘟，很可愛啊。
examples.english_sentence: The baby is chubby and so cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻貓肥腯腯，睇落好可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 maau1 fei4 tuk1 tuk1, tai2 lok6 hou2 ho2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那隻貓胖嘟嘟，看起來很可愛。
examples.english_sentence: That cat is pudgy and looks very cute.

mandarin_meaning: 比喻可觀的利益、好處（類似「肥水」、「肥肉」）
english_meaning: lucrative benefit; gravy; extra profit or perk
explanation_mandarin: 指容易得到或數額可觀的利益、額外好處或利潤，常用來形容生意、職位或機會帶來的大利益。
explanation_english: Refers to easy-to-obtain or sizable benefits, extra perks, or profits. Commonly used to describe lucrative deals, jobs, or opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個生意有好多肥膏，大家都想爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sang1 ji3 jau5 hou2 do1 fei4 gou1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 soeng2 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔生意有很多肥水，大家都想争抢。
examples.english_sentence: This deal has a lot of gravy/profit; everyone wants to grab it.

mandarin_meaning: 肥腻（油腻、过于油脂或过于甜腻、令人反感）
english_meaning: fatty/greasy; cloying or overly rich (can be literal for food or figurative for style/feelings)
explanation_mandarin: 指食物含脂肪多、口感油重，也可比喻某事物過於甜膩、肉麻或讓人覺得膩煩、不舒服。
explanation_english: Describes food that is high in fat or oily; figuratively it describes something overly rich, cloying, or sickly (e.g., overly sentimental words or style).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟燒肉好肥膩，唔係幾好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 siu1 juk6 hou2 fei4 naap6, m4 hai6 gei2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這盤燒肉很肥膩，不是很可口。
examples.english_sentence: This plate of roast pork is very fatty/greasy; it's not very tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲情話太肥膩，聽到我有啲反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 cing4 waa6 taai3 fei4 naap6, ngo5 teng1 dou3 jau5 di1 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的情話太肉麻／太膩人，聽了我有點反感。
examples.english_sentence: His love talk is too cheesy/cloying; it makes me a bit put off.

mandarin_meaning: 肥美的蟹；（口語）戲稱食量大或體型較胖的人
english_meaning: a fat/robust crab (good for eating); (colloquial) a teasing term for someone who eats a lot or is chubby
explanation_mandarin: （1）字面上指體型肥美、蟹膏豐富、適合食用的螃蟹。 （2）口語用法可作戲稱或綽號，形容食量大或體型較胖的人，語氣可親切或帶輕微貶義，視語境而定。
explanation_english: (1) Literally, a fat/robust crab — often prized for its roe. (2) Colloquially used as a teasing nickname for someone who eats a lot or is chubby; tone can be affectionate or mildly derogatory depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚喺街市買到隻好肥嘅蟹，蟹膏好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hai2 gaai1 si5 maai5 dou3 zek3 hou2 fei4 ge3 haai4, haai4 gou1 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚在街市買到一隻很肥的蟹，蟹膏很香。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a very fat crab at the market tonight; the crab roe is very fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日食咁多，大家笑佢係隻肥蟹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sik6 gam2 do1, daai6 gaa1 siu3 keoi5 hai6 zek3 fei4 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是吃那麼多，大家笑他是隻肥蟹。
examples.english_sentence: He always eats so much; everyone teases him as a 'fat crab'.

mandarin_meaning: 小胖豬／（對胖嘟嘟者的）暱稱
english_meaning: chubby/pudgy piggy (affectionate or teasing nickname)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，通常用來戲稱或親暱地稱呼體型圓潤、胖嘟嘟的人。語氣可親切亦可帶貶義，視語境與語調而定。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang nickname literally meaning 'fat piggy' used to tease or affectionately refer to someone who is chubby. Tone and context determine whether it's playful or insulting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你又食咁多，做咗肥豚豚喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau6 sik6 gam2 do1, zou6 zo2 fei4 tyun4 tyun4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你又吃那麼多，變成小胖豬了！
examples.english_sentence: You ate so much again — you've turned into a little chubby pig!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好叫佢肥豚豚，佢會嬲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 giu3 keoi5 fei4 tyun4 tyun4, keoi5 wui5 nau1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要叫他/她『肥豚豚』，會生氣的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call them 'fei tyun tyun' — they'll get upset.

mandarin_meaning: 肥猪肉 / （俚語）胖猪（用于辱骂）
english_meaning: fatty pork; (slang, derogatory) 'fat pig' used to insult someone
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（口语；作人身攻击时为贬义用法）
partOfSpeech_english: noun (literal); slang/derogatory noun when used about a person
explanation_mandarin: 可指烹调用的猪肉中较肥的部分（字面意思）。在粤语口语中也常作俚语，用来侮辱体型肥胖的人，相当于“胖猪”或“肥猪”，有明显贬义，可能冒犯他人。
explanation_english: Literally the fatty part of pork used for cooking. Colloquially in Cantonese it is used as slang to call someone a 'fat pig' — a derogatory insult directed at someone's weight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽媽買咗一塊肥豬肉，今晚煮嚟做晚餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa1 maai5 zo2 jat1 faai3 fei4 zyu1 juk6, gam1 maan5 zyu2 lai4 zou6 maan5 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈买了一块肥猪肉，今晚用来做晚餐。
examples.english_sentence: Mom bought a piece of fatty pork to use for tonight's dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日話佢係肥豬肉，真係好冇禮貌！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 waa6 keoi5 hai6 fei4 zyu1 juk6, zan1 hai6 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你老是说他/她是肥猪，真的很没礼貌！
examples.english_sentence: You keep calling him/her a 'fat pig'; that's really rude!

mandarin_meaning: 油腻/大份的鸡肉套餐；俚语上指高热量、容易使人发胖的鸡肉快餐
english_meaning: a large/greasy chicken set meal; (slang) a high‑calorie chicken combo that tends to make you gain weight
explanation_mandarin: 「肥雞餐」是廣東話中對分量大、油炸或較油膩的雞肉套餐的一種俗稱。有時帶有玩笑或批評意味，用來形容會讓人容易發胖的高熱量餐點。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "肥雞餐" colloquially refers to a large or greasy chicken meal/set. It can be used jokingly or critically to describe a high‑calorie, fattening chicken fast‑food combo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成日食嗰啲肥雞餐，會肥㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing4 jat6 sik6 go2 di1 fei4 gai1 caan1, wui5 fei4 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总是吃那些肥鸡餐会发胖的。
examples.english_sentence: If you keep eating those 'fat chicken' meals, you'll get fat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快餐店推出新嘅肥雞餐，好抵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 caan1 dim3 teoi1 ceot1 san1 ge3 fei4 gai1 caan1, hou2 dai2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快餐店推出了新的肥鸡餐，很划算。
examples.english_sentence: The fast‑food place launched a new 'fat chicken' meal — it's a good deal.

mandarin_meaning: 自滿；得意洋洋（形容人自以為了不起、滿不在乎的樣子）
english_meaning: smug; self-satisfied; complacent (describing someone acting conceited or overly pleased with themselves)
explanation_mandarin: 「肥頭耷耳」是一個粵語成語，用來形容一個人滿臉得意、自鳴得意或自滿，常帶有貶義，表示對他人感受或意見漠不關心。
explanation_english: A Cantonese idiom describing someone who looks smug or self-satisfied. It often carries a negative connotation, implying the person is conceited and indifferent to others' feelings or opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆見到生意好，就成日肥頭耷耳，唔理員工感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gin3 dou2 saang1 ji3 hou2, zau6 seng4 jat6 fei4 tau4 daap3 ji5, m4 lei5 jyun4 gung1 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板看到生意好，就常常自滿，忽視員工的感受。
examples.english_sentence: When the boss saw business was good, he often became smug and ignored the employees' feelings.

mandarin_meaning: 肥嘟嘟／胖嘟嘟；肥胖、飽滿（常帶可愛或誘人之意）
english_meaning: chubby; plump; pudgy — pleasantly fat or well-rounded, often cute or appetizing
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語形容詞，通常用來形容人、動物或食物看起來肥胖、飽滿、肥潤，語氣可愛或帶誘人食欲。相當於普通話的「肥嘟嘟／胖嘟嘟」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial adjective used to describe a person, animal, or food as plump, chubby, or fatty in a pleasant way. The tone can be cute or appetizing. Equivalent to Mandarin '肥嘟嘟' or English 'chubby/plump'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻豬仔肥騰騰，好想捏一捏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 zyu1 zai2 fei4 tang4 tang4, hou2 soeng2 nip3 jat1 nip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小豬胖嘟嘟的，很想捏一捏。
examples.english_sentence: The piglet is plump and chubby — makes you want to give it a little squeeze.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊燒肉烤得油光、肥騰騰，好惹味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 siu1 juk6 haau1 dak1 jau4 gwong1, fei4 tang4 tang4, hou2 je5 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這塊燒肉烤得油亮、肥滋滋，很有滋味。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of roast pork is glistening and fatty — very appetizing.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）可能指豐厚的利益、優渥的待遇或好賺的工作/生意
english_meaning: A slang term (literally 'fat-chicken meal') that likely refers to a very lucrative deal, a cushy job, or generous perks/benefits.
explanation_mandarin: 此詞為粵語俚語，使用較為口語或地區性，並非標準詞彙。一般用來形容某項工作、合約或機會特別賺錢、待遇優厚或容易得益。由於用法不一定固定，具體含義會根據語境而定。
explanation_english: This is a Cantonese slang expression, colloquial and region-specific rather than standard. It is typically used to describe a job, contract, or opportunity that is especially profitable, offers generous benefits, or is easy money. Exact meaning depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單生意真係肥鷄餐，唔好錯過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dan1 sang1 ji3 zan1 hai6 fei4 gai1 caan1, m4 hou2 co3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這筆生意真是肥雞餐，別錯過。
examples.english_sentence: This deal is really a 'fat-chicken meal' (very lucrative); don't miss it.

mandarin_meaning: 肥婆
english_meaning: fat woman; 'fatty' (derogatory slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粗俗的粤语俚语，用来侮辱或嘲笑体型较胖的女性，相当于“肥婆”。带有贬义，不礼貌。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese slang term used to insult or mock an overweight woman — equivalent to 'fei-po' (肥婆). It is derogatory and impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁樣叫人做肥𣲷，會好傷人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 joeng6 giu3 jan4 zou6 fei4 po4, wui5 hou2 soeng1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这样叫人“肥婆”，会很伤人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't call someone 'fei-po' like that; it's really hurtful.

mandarin_meaning: 罕见、古字；在现代普通话和粤语中无固定通用词义，常见于古籍、人名或地名中
english_meaning: A rare/archaic character; no established modern meaning in Mandarin or Cantonese; sometimes appears in historical texts or as a name character
explanation_mandarin: 「肨」為較罕見的漢字，現代漢語中無固定詞義或常用讀音。多見於古文、族譜或人名用字，具體含義與讀音需根據具體文獻與語境判定。
explanation_english: “肨” is a rare/archaic Chinese character with no established modern meaning or standard Cantonese pronunciation. It mainly appears in historical documents, genealogies, or as part of personal/place names; meaning and pronunciation depend on context and specific sources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「肨」好罕見，日常生活幾乎唔見到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 '肨' hou2 hon2 gin3, jat6 soeng4 sang1 wut6 gei2 fu1 m4 gin3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字「肨」很罕见，日常生活几乎看不到。
examples.english_sentence: The character “肨” is very rare and hardly seen in everyday life.

mandarin_meaning: 肩膀；肩部（也可引申為承擔、負責）
english_meaning: shoulder (body part); (figuratively) to shoulder, to bear responsibility
explanation_mandarin: 表示人體連接頸部與上肢的部位（肩膀）。在口語或書面語中也可比喻承擔責任或負擔。
explanation_english: Refers to the body part connecting the neck and the upper limbs (the shoulder). Can also be used figuratively to mean taking on responsibility or burden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻肩好痛，唔識郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 gin1 hou2 tung3, m4 sik1 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的肩膀很痛，不能動。
examples.english_sentence: My shoulder hurts a lot; I can't move it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢拎起個箱，個肩頭畀壓到紅晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ling1 hei2 go3 soeng1, go3 gin1 tau4 bei6 aat3 dou3 hung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿起箱子，肩膀被压得通红。
examples.english_sentence: He lifted the box and his shoulder was pressed red.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經常揹重嘢會傷肩，要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 soeng4 bui1 zung6 je5 wui5 soeng1 gin1, jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经常背重物會傷肩，要小心。
examples.english_sentence: Frequently carrying heavy things can hurt your shoulders; be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 肩膀 (jiānbǎng)
english_meaning: shoulder
explanation_mandarin: 指連接手臂和軀幹的部位；也常用作比喻，表示情感上的依靠或責任的承擔。
explanation_english: The body part connecting the arm to the torso; also used metaphorically for emotional support or bearing responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以靠喺我個肩膀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 kaau3 hai2 ngo5 go3 gin1bong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以靠在我的肩膀上。
examples.english_sentence: You can lean on my shoulder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揹住個行李，肩膀好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui1 zyu6 go3 haang4 lei5, gin1bong2 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背着行李，肩膀很痛。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is carrying the luggage; his/her shoulders hurt a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 肩膀（身體部位）
english_meaning: shoulder; shoulders (the part of the body)
explanation_mandarin: 指人體的肩膀部位，也可用於比喻承擔責任或負荷。
explanation_english: Refers to the shoulder area of the body; can also be used metaphorically to mean bearing responsibility or a burden.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我背咗重嘅袋，宜家肩膊好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bui3 zo2 zung6 ge3 daai3, ji4gaa1 gin1 bok3 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我背了重的包，現在肩膀很痛。
examples.english_sentence: I carried a heavy bag and now my shoulders hurt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攬住我嘅肩膊，感覺好溫暖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 laam5 zyu6 ngo5 ge3 gin1 bok3, gam2 gok3 hou2 wan1 nyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摟著我的肩膀，感覺很溫暖。
examples.english_sentence: He put his arm around my shoulder; it felt very warm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫對肩膊有啲緊，試細一碼啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 deoi3 gin1 bok3 jau5 di1 gan2, si3 sai3 jat1 maa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服肩膀有點緊，試小一號吧。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is a bit tight at the shoulders; try a smaller size.

mandarin_meaning: 肩負；承擔（責任、使命、任務等）
english_meaning: to shoulder; to bear or undertake (responsibility, a task, a mission)
explanation_mandarin: 表示承擔某項責任、任務或使命，通常用於描述負起應有的責任或擔當重任。
explanation_english: To take on or bear responsibility, a task, or a mission; often used to describe accepting duties or an important role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要肩負保護環境嘅責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gin1 fu6 bou2 wu6 waan4 ging2 ge3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們要肩負保護環境的責任。
examples.english_sentence: We must shoulder the responsibility of protecting the environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定由佢肩負呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 jau4 keoi5 gin1 fu6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司決定由他肩負這個項目。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided that he will take on this project.

mandarin_meaning: 脂肪；體內的油脂組織
english_meaning: fat; adipose tissue
explanation_mandarin: 「肪」常用於複合詞（如「脂肪」），指生物體內的脂肪組織或油脂。
explanation_english: The character is used mainly in compounds (e.g. 脂肪) and refers to fat or adipose tissue in the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我需要減少體內脂肪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 gaam2 siu2 tai2 noi6 zi1 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我需要减少体内脂肪。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I need to reduce my body fat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款零食好高脂肪，唔好成日食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 ling4 sik6 hou2 gou1 zi1 fong1, m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款零食脂肪含量很高，不要经常吃。
examples.english_sentence: This snack is high in fat; don't eat it often.

mandarin_meaning: 愿意；肯（表示愿意或答应）
english_meaning: to be willing to; to agree to
explanation_mandarin: 表示愿意做某事或答应，常用於口語。例如「肯幫忙」「肯定（在複合詞中）」。
explanation_english: Indicates willingness or agreement to do something; commonly used in spoken Cantonese. (In compounds like '肯定' it has related meanings in Mandarin.)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢肯幫我，真係好幫到手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hang2 bong1 ngo5, zan1 hai6 hou2 bong1 dou3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他愿意帮我，真的很有帮助。
examples.english_sentence: He is willing to help me; it's really helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你肯唔肯一齊去？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hang2 m4 hang2 jat1 cai4 heoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你肯不肯一起去？
examples.english_sentence: Are you willing to go together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔肯食辣嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hang2 sik6 laat6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不愿意吃辣的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not willing to eat spicy food.

mandarin_meaning: 肯尼亞（國名，非洲東部國家，正式名稱：肯尼亞共和國）
english_meaning: Kenya (country in East Africa)
explanation_mandarin: 「肯亞」是指非洲東部國家肯尼亞的音譯或簡稱。標準中文全名通常寫作「肯尼亞／肯尼亞共和國」，口語或簡寫時有時會省略「尼」字寫成「肯亞」。
explanation_english: “肯亞” is a transliteration or abbreviated form referring to the country Kenya in East Africa. The standard Chinese name is usually written as 肯尼亞 (Kenya) or 肯尼亞共和國 (Republic of Kenya); colloquially the middle character 尼 is sometimes omitted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下年想去肯亞旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 nin4 soeng2 heoi3 hang2 aa3 leoi5 hang4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明年想去肯尼亞旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I want to travel to Kenya next year.

mandarin_meaning: 肯定 (kěndìng)：表示确认、确定或赞同，也可作副词表示‘一定、无疑’
english_meaning: to affirm; to confirm; certainly; definitely
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞 / 副詞 / 形容詞
explanation_mandarin: 表示對某事有把握或表示同意、確認。作動詞是『肯定、確認』；作副詞是『一定、毫無疑問地』；作形容詞是『確定的』。
explanation_english: Expresses certainty, affirmation, or agreement. As a verb it means to affirm/confirm; as an adverb it means certainly/definitely; as an adjective it means certain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我肯定佢會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hang2 ding6 keoi5 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我肯定他會來。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sure he will come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢肯定唔會接受呢個條件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hang2 ding6 m4 wui5 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 tiu4 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他肯定不會接受這個條件。
examples.english_sentence: He definitely won't accept these terms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司肯定咗呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hang2 ding6 zo2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司已經肯定了這個計劃。
examples.english_sentence: The company has confirmed the plan.

mandarin_meaning: 肯尼亞（國家名）
english_meaning: Kenya (country)
explanation_mandarin: 肯尼亞是位於非洲東部的國家，首都是內羅畢，以大草原、野生動物和馬拉松聞名。
explanation_english: Kenya is a country in East Africa, capital Nairobi, known for its savannahs, wildlife and long-distance running.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好想去肯尼亞睇大草原同埋長頸鹿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 soeng2 heoi3 hang2 nei4 aa3 tai2 daai6 cou2 jyun4 tung4 maai4 coeng4 geng2 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想去肯尼亞看大草原和長頸鹿。
examples.english_sentence: I really want to go to Kenya to see the savannah and giraffes.

mandarin_meaning: 肯德基（KFC，快餐連鎖品牌）
english_meaning: KFC (Kentucky Fried Chicken), a fast-food restaurant chain
explanation_mandarin: 肯德基是美國的連鎖快餐品牌，以炸雞和速食為主。中文名稱「肯德基」是英文 Kentucky 的音譯品牌名。
explanation_english: KFC is an American fast-food chain known for fried chicken and quick-service meals. The Chinese name "肯德基" is a transliteration of Kentucky (as a brand name).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去肯德基食嘢啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 hang2 dak1 gei1 sik6 je5 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去肯德基吃東西嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go to KFC tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意去肯德基食薯條同炸雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 heoi3 hang2 dak1 gei1 sik6 syu4 tiu4 tung4 zaa3 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她喜歡去肯德基吃薯條和炸雞。
examples.english_sentence: He/She likes going to KFC to eat fries and fried chicken.

mandarin_meaning: （俗語）比喻為討好、奉承而做出的尷尬或誇張的小動作/「跳舞」，也可指為求得對方歡心而做表面功夫（此詞較口語、罕見）
english_meaning: (colloquial/slang) a little awkward/obsequious 'dance' — figuratively, small showy or ingratiating actions performed to please someone; a display of sycophancy (rare/informal)
explanation_mandarin: 「肯肯舞」為粵語口語/俗語，常用來形容某人為討好他人而做出尷尬、誇張或做作的動作（像是在跳一支小舞），也可泛指表面功夫或奉承行為。此詞較罕見，使用上多見於非正式語境或地區性口語中。
explanation_english: “肯肯舞” is a Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone performing awkward, showy, or affected actions (as if doing a little dance) to ingratiate themselves; it can also mean doing superficial/appeasing gestures. The term is informal and relatively rare, typically used in casual or regional speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到老細就開始跳肯肯舞，想搵佢歡心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou3 lou5 sai3 zau6 hoi1 ci2 tiu3 hang2 hang2 mou5, soeng2 wan2 keoi5 fun1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一見到老闆就開始做肯肯舞，想討好他。
examples.english_sentence: He starts doing the '肯肯舞' when he sees the boss, trying to ingratiate himself.

mandarin_meaning: 肯尼亚（口語/縮寫，用作國名）
english_meaning: Kenya (colloquial/abbreviated name for the country)
explanation_mandarin: 「肯雅」是對英語國名 Kenya 的口語化或簡寫寫法，多見於非正式書寫或口語中，等同於標準中文「肯尼亞」。
explanation_english: “肯雅” is a colloquial or abbreviated writing of the English country name Kenya, equivalent to the standard Chinese name "肯尼亞" (Kenya). Used mainly in informal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我諗住去肯雅旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 lam2 zyu6 heoi3 hang2 ngaa5 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我打算去肯尼亞旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to travel to Kenya tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朋友喺肯雅做義工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pang4 jau5 hai2 hang2 ngaa5 zou6 ji6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我朋友在肯尼亞做義工。
examples.english_sentence: My friend is doing volunteer work in Kenya.

mandarin_meaning: yù：养育、培养、教育
english_meaning: to raise; to nurture; to educate (often appears in compounds)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞（在複合詞中也可作名詞）
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can also appear as a noun in compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 表示撫養、培養或教育的動作，常用於複合詞，如「教育」「育兒」「培育」。
explanation_english: Denotes the action of raising, nurturing, or educating. Commonly used in compounds such as '教育' (education), '育兒' (child-rearing), and '培育' (to cultivate).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間學校好重視學生嘅全面教育。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 hou2 zung6 si6 hok6 saang1 ge3 cyun4 min6 gaau3 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间学校很重视学生的全面教育。
examples.english_sentence: This school places great emphasis on students' holistic education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢辭咗工返屋企專心育兒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 zo2 gung1 faan1 uk1 kei5 zyun1 sam1 juk6 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他辞了工回家专心育儿。
examples.english_sentence: He quit his job and went home to focus on raising his child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司致力培育新一代嘅人才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zi3 lik6 pui4 juk6 san1 jat1 doi6 ge3 jan4 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司致力培养新一代的人才。
examples.english_sentence: The company is committed to cultivating the next generation of talent.

mandarin_meaning: 育儿 (yù'ér) — 养育孩子、照顾和教育子女
english_meaning: child-rearing; parenting — the act of raising, caring for, and educating children
explanation_mandarin: 指對嬰兒或子女的養育、照顧與教育，包括生活照料、教養和情感支持。
explanation_english: Refers to raising and caring for children, including daily care, education, and emotional support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多父母都好重視育兒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 fu6 mou5 dou1 hou2 cung4 si6 juk6 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 現在很多父母都很重視育兒。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays many parents pay a lot of attention to child-rearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 育兒可以好開心，但都有好大壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: juk6 ji4 ho2 ji5 hou2 hoi1 sam1, daan6 dou1 jau5 hou2 daai6 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 育兒可以很開心，但也有很大的壓力。
examples.english_sentence: Raising children can be very joyful, but it can also be very stressful.

mandarin_meaning: 育嬰（育婴）：照顧嬰兒
english_meaning: infant care; to care for and raise infants
explanation_mandarin: 指照顧、養育嬰兒的行為或工作，常用於職業或場所名稱，如育嬰師、育嬰室。
explanation_english: Refers to the act or work of caring for and raising infants. Often used for jobs or facilities (e.g., infant caregiver, nursery).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司有育嬰室，媽媽可以去餵奶同休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1si1 jau5 juk6 jing1 sat1, maa1 maa1 ho2 ji5 heoi3 wai3 naai5 tung4 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們公司有育嬰室，媽媽可以去餵奶和休息。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has a nursery room where mothers can breastfeed and rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係專業育嬰師，專門照顧初生嬰兒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zyun1 jip6 juk6 jing1 si1, zyun1 mun4 ziu3 gu3 co1 saang1 jing1 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她是專業育嬰師，專門照顧初生嬰兒。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is a professional infant caregiver who specializes in looking after newborn babies.

mandarin_meaning: 育婴室（提供給父母或照護者餵奶、換尿布及暫時照顧嬰兒的專用空間）
english_meaning: nursing room / baby care room (a dedicated space for feeding, changing diapers, and temporarily caring for infants)
explanation_mandarin: 育嬰室是指在公共場所或單位內，為嬰兒及其照護者提供餵奶、換尿布、安置嬰兒椅或臥台等設施的專用空間，方便照顧嬰兒的需要。
explanation_english: A nursing room (baby care room) is a dedicated space in public venues or workplaces equipped for feeding, diaper changing, and temporarily caring for infants, making it easier for caregivers to tend to babies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場有育嬰室，方便媽媽替嬰兒換片同餵奶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 coeng4 jau5 juk6 jing1 sat1, fong1 bin6 maa4 maa1 tai3 jing1 ji4 wun6 pin3 tung4 wai4 naai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商场有育婴室，方便妈妈给婴儿换尿布和喂奶。
examples.english_sentence: The mall has a nursing room, which makes it convenient for mothers to change diapers and feed their babies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司設有育嬰室，支持有小朋友嘅員工返工同照顧孩子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 cit3 jau5 juk6 jing1 sat1, zi1 ci4 jau5 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 jyun4 gung1 faan1 gung1 tung4 ziu3 gu3 haai4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司设有育婴室，支持有小孩的员工上班期間照顧孩子。
examples.english_sentence: The company provides a nursing room to support employees with young children during work.

mandarin_meaning: 菜肴（yáo）；指飯菜、菜餚，尤指祭祀或宴席上的熟食。
english_meaning: dish; cooked food or meat dishes (literary/classical), often refers to dishes served at banquets or for sacrificial offerings.
explanation_mandarin: 「肴」為文言或書面語用字，原指作祭祀或宴席的熟肉、菜餚。現代漢語中常見於合成詞如「菜肴／菜餚」。
explanation_english: A literary/classical term referring to cooked dishes or meat served at banquets or as sacrificial offerings. In modern usage it commonly appears in compounds such as "菜肴" meaning dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚師準備咗好多美味嘅菜肴畀客人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 si1 zeon2 bei6 zo2 hou2 do1 mei5 mei6 ge3 coi3 ngau4 bei2 haak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚師準備了很多美味的菜肴給客人。
examples.english_sentence: The chef prepared many delicious dishes for the guests.

mandarin_meaning: （粵語）剩菜；留作下次食用的菜餚（有時與「餸底」通用）
english_meaning: Cantonese colloquial term for leftover dishes; portions of food set aside to be eaten later
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指飯菜中剩下的部分或特意留作下次/以後食用的菜餚，有時會寫作或對應為「餸底」。屬生活用語，常在家居或飲食場合出現。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial noun referring to leftover food or portions of a dish deliberately saved for later eating. Often used in everyday home or food contexts; sometimes written or treated as the same as "餸底".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚煮多咗，留咗啲肴底畀你聽日食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 zyu2 do1 zo2, lau4 zo2 di1 ngaau4 dai2 bei2 nei5 ting1 jat6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚煮多了，留下了一些剩菜給你明天吃。
examples.english_sentence: I cooked extra tonight and saved some leftovers for you to eat tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 臀（臀部、屁股）
english_meaning: buttocks; rear; hip
explanation_mandarin: 肶為較少見或古字，指人的臀部、屁股。現代漢語中不常使用，多見於古籍、方言或作為書面異體字。
explanation_english: A rare/archaic character referring to the buttocks or hip. It is uncommon in modern usage and typically appears in classical texts, dialectal usage, or as a variant character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌親，肶好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 can1, teon4 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔倒了，屁股很痛。
examples.english_sentence: He fell and his buttocks hurt.

mandarin_meaning: 臀溝；屁股縫隙（俗語、粗俗用語）
english_meaning: butt crack; the cleft between the buttocks (colloquial/vulgar)
explanation_mandarin: 口語或粗俗的說法，指臀部中間的裂縫或臀溝，常用於非正式語境中。
explanation_english: A colloquial/vulgar term for the cleft between the buttocks (butt crack). Used in informal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁屈身，會見到肶罅㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 wat1 san1, wui5 gin3 dou2 but6 haa6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那麼彎身，會看到臀溝的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bend over so much — your butt crack will show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙太短，一坐低就見到肶罅，好尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 taai3 dyun2, jat1 co5 dai1 zau6 gin3 dou2 but6 haa6, hou2 gam1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 裙子太短，一坐下就看到臀溝，很尷尬。
examples.english_sentence: The skirt is too short — when you sit down your butt crack shows; it's embarrassing.

mandarin_meaning: 肺（呼吸器官）
english_meaning: lung (respiratory organ)
explanation_mandarin: 指動物或人的呼吸器官，位於胸腔內，負責氧氣與二氧化碳的氣體交換。
explanation_english: Refers to the respiratory organ in humans or animals located in the chest, responsible for gas exchange (oxygen and carbon dioxide).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢個肺有啲問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 go3 fai3 jau5 di1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他的肺有问题。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his lungs have some problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期吸煙會傷害肺部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 kap1 jin1 wui5 soeng1 hoi6 fai3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期吸烟会伤害肺部。
examples.english_sentence: Long-term smoking damages the lungs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為感染肺炎，要住院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 gam2 jim5 fai3 jim4, jiu3 zyu6 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为感染肺炎，要住院。
examples.english_sentence: He was hospitalized because he contracted pneumonia.

mandarin_meaning: 肺活量（fèi huó liàng）——肺部在一次最大呼吸过程中能够吸入或呼出的空气体积，即肺容量。
english_meaning: Lung capacity — the maximum volume of air the lungs can hold or move in a single deep breath.
explanation_mandarin: 指肺在一次最大吸氣或呼氣時可容納或排出的空氣體積，常用於體檢或評估呼吸功能。
explanation_english: Refers to the volume of air the lungs can inhale or exhale during a maximal breath; commonly measured in medical checkups to assess respiratory function.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 體檢時醫生量咗我嘅肺活量，話比一般人細啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 gim2 si4 ji1 sang1 loeng4 zo2 ngo5 ge3 fei6 wut6 loeng4, waa6 bei2 jat1 bun1 jan4 sai3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 体检时医生量了我的肺活量，说比一般人小一点。
examples.english_sentence: At the medical checkup the doctor measured my lung capacity and said it's a bit smaller than average.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經常做有氧運動可以提升肺活量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 soeng4 zou6 jau5 joeng5 wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 tai1 sing1 fei6 wut6 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经常做有氧运动可以提升肺活量。
examples.english_sentence: Regular aerobic exercise can improve lung capacity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 吸煙會減低肺活量，對呼吸功能唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kap1 jin1 wui5 gaam2 dai1 fei6 wut6 loeng4, deoi3 fu1 kap1 gung1 nang4 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吸烟会降低肺活量，对呼吸功能不好。
examples.english_sentence: Smoking reduces lung capacity and harms respiratory function.

mandarin_meaning: 肺炎 (fèiyán)
english_meaning: pneumonia
explanation_mandarin: 肺部（肺）發生的炎症，通常由感染（細菌、病毒、黴菌等）或其他原因引起，可能導致發燒、咳嗽、呼吸困難等症狀，嚴重時需住院治療。
explanation_english: An inflammation of the lungs (pneumonia), usually caused by infection (bacteria, viruses, fungi) or other factors. Symptoms can include fever, cough, and difficulty breathing; severe cases may require hospitalization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為肺炎要入院休養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 fei6 jim4 jiu3 jap6 jyun2 jau1 joeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為肺炎要住院休養。
examples.english_sentence: He had to be hospitalized to recuperate because of pneumonia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢有肺炎，要食抗生素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 fei6 jim4, jiu3 sik6 kong3 saang1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他有肺炎，需要吃抗生素。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he has pneumonia and needs to take antibiotics.

mandarin_meaning: 一种四川凉菜，通常为牛肉或牛杂（如牛肚、牛肺等）切片，拌以麻辣酱料（常见菜名为“夫妻肺片”）
english_meaning: A Sichuan cold appetizer of sliced beef and offal (originally lung), served in a spicy, numbing chili sauce (often known as 'fuqi feipian' or 'feipian')
explanation_mandarin: “肺片”原指以牛肺等內臟切片為主的麻辣涼拌菜，現代多指包含牛肉、牛肚等的川味涼菜，常作為開胃小菜或冷盤。
explanation_english: Originally referring to lung slices, 'feipian' is a Sichuan spicy cold dish made of thinly sliced beef and offal (such as tripe), dressed in a numbing chili-oil sauce; commonly served as an appetizer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去食川菜，記得叫埋肺片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 cyun1 coi3, gei3 dak1 giu3 maai4 fei6 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去吃川菜，记得也点上肺片。
examples.english_sentence: We're going for Sichuan food tonight—remember to order feipian (spicy sliced beef and tripe).

mandarin_meaning: 肺病（指肺部的疾病，常指肺結核或其他肺部感染與慢性肺病）
english_meaning: lung disease; pulmonary disease (historically often refers to tuberculosis)
explanation_mandarin: 指影響肺部的各類疾病，舊時常專指肺結核（肺結核在口語中亦稱為「肺病」），現代亦可泛指肺炎、慢性阻塞性肺疾病等肺部問題。
explanation_english: Refers to diseases affecting the lungs. Historically it commonly meant pulmonary tuberculosis, but it can also refer more generally to conditions such as pneumonia, COPD, or other lung infections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近檢查出有肺病，要留醫觀察。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 gim2 caa4 ceot1 jau5 fei6 beng6, jiu3 lau4 ji1 gun1 caat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近检查出有肺病，需要住院观察。
examples.english_sentence: He was recently diagnosed with a lung disease and needs to be hospitalized for observation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時所講嘅「肺病」多數係指肺結核。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 so2 gong2 ge3 “fei6 beng6” do1 sou3 hai6 zi2 fei6 git3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧时所说的“肺病”多数是指肺结核。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, the term 'fei-bing' usually referred to pulmonary tuberculosis.

mandarin_meaning: 肺痨（肺结核）
english_meaning: pulmonary tuberculosis (old term for tuberculosis of the lungs)
explanation_mandarin: 肺癆是旧称，指肺结核（肺部结核性疾病），由结核分枝杆菌引起，主要影响肺组织并具有传染性。
explanation_english: An old term for pulmonary tuberculosis — an infectious disease caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis that primarily affects the lungs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢早年得過肺癆，之後接受咗長期治療才康復。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou2 nin4 dak1 gwo3 fei6 lou4, zi1 hau6 zip3 sau6 zo2 coeng4 kei4 zi6 liu4 coi4 hong1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他早年得过肺痨，之后接受了长期治疗才康复。
examples.english_sentence: He had pulmonary tuberculosis years ago and only recovered after long-term treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 肺结核 (fèi jiéhé)
english_meaning: pulmonary tuberculosis; tuberculosis
explanation_mandarin: 肺结核是一种由结核分枝杆菌感染肺部引起的传染病，主要症状包括咳嗽、咳痰、咳血、发热、消瘦等，通常需要长期服用抗结核药物治疗。
explanation_english: An infectious disease of the lungs caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Common symptoms include cough, sputum production, coughing up blood, fever, and weight loss. Treatment usually requires prolonged anti-tuberculosis medication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢患咗肺結核，要開始服用抗結核藥物，同埋要好好休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 waan6 zo2 fei6 git3 hok6, jiu3 hoi1 ci2 fuk6 jung6 kong3 git3 hok6 joek6 mat6, tung4 maai4 jiu3 hou2 hou2 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他患了肺结核，要开始服用抗结核药物，并且要好好休息。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he has pulmonary tuberculosis; he needs to start taking anti-tuberculosis medication and get plenty of rest.

mandarin_meaning: 肺腑（指内心深处的真诚感情）
english_meaning: heartfelt; from the bottom of one's heart
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词（也可作名词，指内心深处）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (can also function as a noun)
explanation_mandarin: 表示由内心深处发出的真诚感情、真心或由衷。常用于“肺腑之言”等短语，形容话语或感情非常诚恳。
explanation_english: Expresses sincere feelings coming from the depths of one's heart; genuine and heartfelt. Often used in phrases like '肺腑之言' to describe earnest, sincere speech or emotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅係肺腑之言，我都好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 hai6 fei6 fu2 zi1 jin4, ngo5 dou1 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的都是肺腑之言，我很感动。
examples.english_sentence: What he said was heartfelt; I was very moved.

mandarin_meaning: 肺腑之言（衷心的話，發自內心的真誠言語）
english_meaning: heartfelt words; words straight from the heart; sincere and genuine expression
explanation_mandarin: 成語，指發自內心、真誠坦率的話語，常用來形容說話動人或真心表達的意圖。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning words spoken from the bottom of one's heart — sincere, heartfelt remarks or expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同我講嘅都係肺腑之言，我聽到好感動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 ngo5 gong2 ge3 dou1 hai6 fei6 fu2 zi1 jin4, ngo5 teng1 dou3 hou2 gam2 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對我說的都是肺腑之言，我聽了很感動。
examples.english_sentence: What he said to me were heartfelt words; I was very moved.

mandarin_meaning: 脅 / 胁（xié）：側腹、肋部；脅迫、威脅
english_meaning: flank; side (of the body); to coerce; to threaten
explanation_mandarin: 「胁」可指身體的側腹或肋部（名詞），也常見於合成詞表示脅迫、威脅等行為（動詞）。在簡體中寫作「胁」，繁體常用「脅」。
explanation_english: The character can mean the flank or side of the body (noun) and is also used in compounds meaning to coerce or threaten (verb). Simplified form is 胁; traditional is 脅.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用脅迫嘅手段，逼我交出資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 hip3 bik1 ge3 sau2 dyun6, bik1 ngo5 gaau1 ceot1 zi1 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用脅迫的手段，逼我交出資料。
examples.english_sentence: He used coercive methods to force me to hand over the information.

mandarin_meaning: 胃
english_meaning: stomach
explanation_mandarin: 指消化系統中的器官，主要負責儲存食物並開始消化過程。
explanation_english: Refers to the organ in the digestive system responsible for storing food and beginning the digestion process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個胃好痛，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 wai6 hou2 tung3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的胃很痛，要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: My stomach hurts a lot; I need to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 胃口（wèikǒu），指食慾；也可比喻對事物的興趣或喜好
english_meaning: appetite (for food); metaphorically, interest or taste for something
explanation_mandarin: 「胃口」字面上指一個人想吃東西的程度（食慾），口語中也常用來比喻對某事物的興趣或偏好，例如「對那類電影冇胃口」表示不感興趣。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a person's desire to eat (appetite). Colloquially it can also be used figuratively to mean interest or liking for something (e.g., "no appetite" for a type of activity or thing).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家冇胃口，唔想食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 mou5 wai6 hau2, m4 soeng2 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在沒有胃口，不想吃東西。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have an appetite right now; I don't want to eat anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝訓得好，胃口特別好，想食好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 fan3 dak1 hou2, wai6 hau2 dak6 bit6 hou2, soeng2 sik6 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上睡得好，胃口特別好，想吃很多東西。
examples.english_sentence: I slept well this morning and have a particularly good appetite; I want to eat a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對流行音樂冇胃口，所以唔去音樂會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 lau4 hang4 jam1 ngok6 mou5 wai6 hau2, so2 ji5 m4 heoi3 jam1 ngok6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對流行音樂沒有興趣，所以不去音樂會。
examples.english_sentence: He has no appetite/interest for pop music, so he doesn't go to concerts.

mandarin_meaning: 胃气；胃内积气、消化不良；中医所说的胃的气机失调。
english_meaning: stomach gas; bloating/indigestion; (TCM) imbalance or dysfunction of the stomach's qi.
explanation_mandarin: 可指胃裡的氣體積聚，導致脹痛或不適，或在中醫語境中指胃的氣機不暢、消化功能失調需要調理。
explanation_english: Can mean trapped gas in the stomach causing bloating or discomfort, or in Traditional Chinese Medicine refer to a dysfunction/imbalance of the stomach's qi requiring treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚食咗太多野，依家覺得有胃氣，成個肚脹住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 sik6 zo2 taai3 do1 je5, ji4 gaa1 gok3 dak1 jau5 wai6 hei3, sing4 go3 tou5 zoeng3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚吃太多東西，現在覺得有胃氣，整個肚子脹。
examples.english_sentence: I ate too much tonight; now I have gas in my stomach and my belly feels bloated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日講佢胃氣唔順，要去睇中醫調理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 gong2 keoi5 wai6 hei3 m4 seon6, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 zung1 ji1 tiu4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽常說她胃氣不順，要去看中醫調理。
examples.english_sentence: My mom often says her stomach qi is off; she needs to see a TCM doctor to adjust it.

mandarin_meaning: 胃液 (wèi yè)
english_meaning: gastric juice; stomach juice
explanation_mandarin: 胃液是由胃壁細胞分泌的消化液，含鹽酸、消化酶和黏液，有助分解食物並殺滅食物中的細菌。
explanation_english: Gastric juice is the digestive fluid secreted by the stomach lining; it contains hydrochloric acid, digestive enzymes, and mucus, helping to break down food and kill bacteria.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚瞓覺前食太多，胃液倒流會令你覺得胸口灼熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 fan3 gaau3 cin4 sik6 taai3 do1, wai6jik6 dou3 lau4 wui5 ling6 nei5 gok3 dak1 hung1 hau2 coek3 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚間睡前吃太多，胃液倒流會讓你感到胸口灼熱。
examples.english_sentence: Eating too much before bed can cause gastric juice reflux, making you feel heartburn.

mandarin_meaning: 胃溃疡 (wèi kuì yáng)
english_meaning: stomach ulcer; gastric ulcer
explanation_mandarin: 指胃黏膜或胃壁局部出現潰爛或潰瘍，常由幽門螺旋桿菌感染、長期服用非類固醇抗炎藥（NSAIDs）、胃酸過多或其他因素引起，會導致胃痛、消化不良甚至出血。
explanation_english: An open sore in the lining of the stomach (gastric mucosa). Common causes include H. pylori infection, long-term NSAID use, and excess stomach acid. Symptoms can include stomach pain, indigestion, and bleeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢有胃潰瘍，要食藥同改飲食習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 wai6 kwai3 joeng4, jiu3 sik6 joek6 tung4 goi2 jam2 sik6 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他有胃溃疡，需要吃药并改掉不良饮食习惯。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he has a stomach ulcer; he needs medication and to change his eating habits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 長期服用止痛藥可能增加胃潰瘍風險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 kei4 fuk6 jung6 zi2 tung3 joek6 ho2 nang4 zeng1 gaa1 wai6 kwai3 joeng4 fung1 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 长期服用止痛药可能增加胃溃疡的风险。
examples.english_sentence: Long-term use of painkillers can increase the risk of stomach ulcers.

mandarin_meaning: 胃病
english_meaning: stomach illness; stomach disease (e.g. gastritis, indigestion)
explanation_mandarin: 指胃部的疾病或不適，例如胃痛、胃炎、消化不良等，既可指具體的醫學診斷，也可泛指胃部不舒服的狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to illnesses or discomforts of the stomach, such as stomachache, gastritis, or indigestion. Can denote a specific medical diagnosis or a general stomach problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近胃病發作，成日覺得胃痛，消化又唔良。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 wai6-beng6 faat3 zok3, sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 wai6-tung3, siu1 faa3 jau6 m4 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近胃病發作，經常胃痛，而且消化不良。
examples.english_sentence: My stomach problems have flared up recently; I often have stomach pain and poor digestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我要戒口，先至可以控制胃病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 gaai3 hau2, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 hung3 zai3 wai6-beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說我要忌口，才能控制胃病。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I need to watch my diet to be able to control my stomach problem.

mandarin_meaning: 胃酸
english_meaning: stomach acid; gastric acid
explanation_mandarin: 胃酸是胃內分泌的消化液，主要成分為鹽酸，幫助分解食物。胃酸過多或反流會引起胃灼熱、反酸等不適症狀。
explanation_english: Gastric (stomach) acid produced in the stomach—primarily hydrochloric acid—that helps digest food. Excess acid or acid reflux can cause heartburn, regurgitation, and other discomfort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱食完嘢，依家覺得胃酸倒流，好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aam1 aam1 sik6 jyun4 je5, ji1 gaa1 gok3 dak1 wai6 syun1 dou3 lau4, hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我剛剛吃完東西，現在覺得胃酸倒流，很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: I just finished eating and now feel acid reflux; it's very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我有胃酸過多，要食藥調理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jau5 wai6 syun1 gwo3 do1, jiu3 sik6 joek6 tiu4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說我胃酸過多，要吃藥調理。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I have excess stomach acid and need to take medicine to manage it.

mandarin_meaning: 胃酸倒流（又稱胃食管逆流），指胃內的酸性內容物回流到食管
english_meaning: acid reflux (gastroesophageal reflux) — the backflow of stomach acid into the esophagus
explanation_mandarin: 胃酸倒流是指胃內的胃酸或胃內容物逆流到食管，常引起燒心、胸口不適、喉嚨痛或反酸等症狀，嚴重時需就醫治療。
explanation_english: Acid reflux occurs when stomach acid or contents flow back up into the esophagus. It commonly causes heartburn, chest discomfort, sore throat, or regurgitation; severe or chronic cases may require medical treatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚食完嘢之後成晚都覺得胃酸倒流，好難受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 sik6 jyun4 je5 zi1 hau6 seng4 maan5 dou1 gok3 dak1 wai6 syun1 dou2 lau4, hou2 naan4 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚吃完東西後整晚都覺得胃酸倒流，很難受。
examples.english_sentence: After eating tonight I had acid reflux all night; it was very uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 胃镜 (胃部內窺鏡檢查；或指用於檢查的器械)
english_meaning: gastroscopy; gastroscope (an endoscopic examination of the stomach, or the instrument used)
explanation_mandarin: 指用內窺鏡檢查胃部的醫療檢查（胃鏡檢查），也可指用於該檢查的器械（胃鏡）。
explanation_english: A medical procedure that examines the stomach using an endoscope (gastroscopy), or the instrument used for that examination (gastroscope).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我需要做胃鏡檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 zou6 wai6 geng3 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我需要做胃镜检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I need to have a gastroscopy.

mandarin_meaning: 胆（胆囊；勇气、胆量）
english_meaning: gallbladder; courage, guts; nerve
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指人体的胆囊（器官），引申为胆量、勇气或胆小、胆怯等性格特征。亦可出现在成语中（如“胆大包天”）。
explanation_english: Literally the gallbladder (an organ); metaphorically refers to courage, guts, or lack of courage. Also appears in idioms (e.g. “膽大包天”).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇膽追佢鍾意嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 daam2 zeoi1 keoi5 zung1ji3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他没有勇气追他喜欢的人。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't have the courage to pursue the person he likes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話你個膽有結石，要做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1sang1 waa6 nei5 go3 daam2 jau5 git3sek6, jiu3 zou6 sau2seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说你的胆囊有结石，需要做手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said you have gallstones and need surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢膽大包天，偷咗公司啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daam2 daai6 baau1 tin1, tau1 zo2 gung1si1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他胆大包天，偷了公司的钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is outrageously bold; he stole the company's money.

mandarin_meaning: 背 (bèi)：背部；把東西背在背上；背誦；背叛；（口語）倒霉、不走運
english_meaning: back (body); to carry on one's back; to memorize/recite; to betray; (colloquial) unlucky/jinxed
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞、動詞、形容詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 「背」可作名詞指身體的背部；作動詞表示把東西背在背上、背誦或背叛；在口語中也可表示不走運、倒霉。
explanation_english: “背” can mean the back (body) as a noun; as a verb it can mean to carry on one's back, to memorize/recite, or to betray; colloquially it can mean unlucky or jinxed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌傷咗背脊，宜家好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 soeng1 zo2 bui3 zek3, ji4 gaa1 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔伤了背部，現在很痛。
examples.english_sentence: He injured his back; it's very painful now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 爸爸背住個細路上山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa4 baa1 bui3 zyu6 go3 sai3 lou6 soeng5 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸背着孩子上山。
examples.english_sentence: Dad carried the child on his back up the mountain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你準備好背書未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeon2 bei6 hou2 bui3 syu1 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你準備好背書了嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Are you ready to memorize/recite (the text)?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝真係好背，成日撞啲唔好嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 zan1 hai6 hou2 bui3, sing4 jat6 zong6 di1 m4 hou2 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天真是不走運，總是遇到不好的事。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really unlucky today; bad things keep happening.

mandarin_meaning: 背着；在背后
english_meaning: to carry on one's back; (do/say) behind someone's back
explanation_mandarin: 「背住」在廣東話中為動詞 + 著（表持續）的結構，常見有兩個意思：1) 把人或物背在背上（如背住細路）；2) 在某人不知情的情況下在背後做事或說話（背後、偷偷地）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '背住' (bei3 zyu6) is a verb + aspect particle indicating continuous state. It commonly means: 1) to carry a person or object on one's back; 2) to do or say something behind someone's back (without their knowledge).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我背住個細路去街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bei3 zyu6 go3 sai3 lou6 heoi3 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我背着小孩出門。
examples.english_sentence: I carried the child on my back to go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背住阿媽偷咗啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei3 zyu6 aa3 maa1 tau1 zo2 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背着媽媽偷了些錢。
examples.english_sentence: He stole some money behind his mother's back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好背住我講我壞話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bei3 zyu6 ngo5 gong2 ngo5 waai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別在我背後說我的壞話。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk bad about me behind my back.

mandarin_meaning: 背信弃义：违背信用和道义，背叛他人或失信无义。
english_meaning: To betray trust and abandon moral principles; to act faithlessly or treacherously.
explanation_mandarin: 形容违背信用或道义，背叛他人、失信且无廉耻。
explanation_english: An idiom describing the act of breaking trust and abandoning moral obligations; behaving treacherously or perfidiously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗金錢背信棄義，出賣咗老友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2 gam1 cin2 bui3 seon3 hei3 ji6, ceot1 maai6 zo2 lou5 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了金錢背信弃义，出賣了老朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He betrayed his old friend for money; he acted treacherously and sold him out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司高層背信棄義，違反合約，令合作夥伴受到損失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gou1 cang4 bui3 seon3 hei3 ji6, wai4 faan6 hap6 joek3, ling6 hop6 zok3 fo2 bun2 sau6 dou3 syun2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司高层背信弃义，违约，导致合作伙伴遭受损失。
examples.english_sentence: The company's senior management breached trust and broke the contract, causing their partners to suffer losses.

mandarin_meaning: 逆光；背光（顯示器或照明的背後光源）
english_meaning: backlight; backlighting (lighting from behind); the backlight of a display
explanation_mandarin: 指從物體背後照射的光線，攝影上稱為逆光；在電子設備上指顯示器的背光系統。
explanation_english: Refers to light coming from behind a subject (backlighting) in photography; also denotes the backlight system of electronic displays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張相背光，啲人面都影得好黑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 soeng2 bui3 gwong1, di1 jan4 min6 dou1 jing2 dak1 hou2 hak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照片逆光，人的臉都拍得很黑。
examples.english_sentence: The photo is backlit; the people's faces are very dark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電視嘅背光有問題，要維修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 si6 ge3 bui3 gwong1 jau5 man6 tai4, jiu3 wai4 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這台電視的背光有問題，需要維修。
examples.english_sentence: The TV's backlight has a problem and needs repair.

mandarin_meaning: 背包 / 背囊（背在背上的包）
english_meaning: backpack; rucksack
explanation_mandarin: 指背在背上的包，常用來裝書、衣物或旅行用品。可指雙肩背包、登山背包等各類背負式包款。
explanation_english: A bag worn on the back, used to carry books, clothes, or travel gear. It can refer to school backpacks, hiking rucksacks, and other types of shoulder/back-worn bags.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要拎個背包去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 ling1 go3 bui3 baau1 heoi3 hang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要背背包去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: I'm taking my backpack to go hiking today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個背包好重，入面裝咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 bui3 baau1 hou2 zung6, jap6 min6 zong1 zo2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的背包很重，裡面裝了很多東西。
examples.english_sentence: His backpack is very heavy; it's packed with a lot of stuff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生每朝都要背包返學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 saang1 mui5 ziu1 dou1 jiu3 bui3 baau1 faan1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學生每天早上都要背背包去上學。
examples.english_sentence: Students need to carry their backpacks to school every morning.

mandarin_meaning: 背叛；出卖、违背信任或忠诚
english_meaning: to betray; to desert or act disloyally toward someone or something
explanation_mandarin: 指违背对个人、组织或信念的忠诚或信任，转而支持对方或泄露秘密等行为。
explanation_english: To violate someone's trust or loyalty by switching allegiance, revealing secrets, or otherwise acting disloyally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背叛咗我嘅信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 baan6 zo2 ngo5 ge3 seon3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背叛了我的信任。
examples.english_sentence: He betrayed my trust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被指控背叛國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 zi2 hung3 bui3 baan6 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被指控背叛国家。
examples.english_sentence: He was accused of betraying the country.

mandarin_meaning: 背对；背向
english_meaning: to face away from; to turn one's back (on); to ignore
explanation_mandarin: 指身体或面向背对某人或某物，也可引申为在态度上不理会或与某人/某事决裂。
explanation_english: Refers to physically facing away from someone or something. It can also be used figuratively to mean ignoring or turning one's back on someone/something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背向住我坐，完全唔理我講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 hoeng3 zyu6 ngo5 co5, wan4 cyun4 m4 lei5 ngo5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背对着我坐，完全不理我说话。
examples.english_sentence: He sat with his back to me and completely ignored what I said.

mandarin_meaning: 背包、行囊
english_meaning: backpack; rucksack
explanation_mandarin: 指背在背部用來裝載物品的包，常用於旅行或日常攜帶。
explanation_english: A bag worn on the back used for carrying items, commonly used for travel or everyday use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出街記得帶個背囊，入面擺咗水同手機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 go3 bui3 nong4, jap6 min6 baai2 zo2 seoi2 tung4 sau2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門記得帶上背包，裡面放了水和手機。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to bring your backpack when you go out; there's water and a phone inside.

mandarin_meaning: 背地里（暗中、私下、在别人不知情或看不见的时候）
english_meaning: behind someone's back; secretly; in private
explanation_mandarin: 表示在別人不知道或看不見的情況下暗中做某事，通常帶有秘密或不光明的含義。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something secretly or behind someone's back, often implying surreptitious or disapproving behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背地裏講我壞話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 dei6 leoi5 gong2 ngo5 waai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背地里说我的坏话。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks ill of me behind my back.

mandarin_meaning: 背地里；在背後、暗中、私下裡
english_meaning: behind someone's back; secretly; in private
explanation_mandarin: 表示在別人不知道的情況下、在背後或私底下做某事，常帶有隱蔽或不公開的含義。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something secretly or out of sight of others, often with the sense of acting privately or behind someone's back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背地裡講我壞話，我聽到好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 dei6 leoi5 gong2 ngo5 waai6 waa2, ngo5 teng1 dou3 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背地里说我的坏话，我聽到很不高興。
examples.english_sentence: He talked bad about me behind my back; I was very upset when I heard it.

mandarin_meaning: 背水一战；孤注一掷，放手一搏
english_meaning: a do-or-die effort; to stake everything on one final attempt; a last-ditch stand
explanation_mandarin: 形容在绝境中进行最后一搏，倾尽全力、孤注一掷去争取胜利或挽回局面。
explanation_english: Describes making a final, desperate effort with everything at stake — to fight or act with one's back to the wall and give it all in one decisive attempt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次我哋要背城借一，拼盡全力去贏返嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bui3 sing4 ze3 jat1, ping3 zeon6 cyun4 lik6 heoi3 jing4 faan1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次我们要背水一战，拼尽全力争取胜利。
examples.english_sentence: This time we must make a do-or-die effort and give it our all to win.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）很倒霉、屢遭不幸
english_meaning: colloquial: very unlucky; repeatedly jinxed; having a streak of bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 「背」在廣東話可表示倒霉或被霉運纏上；「背多」表示經常或接連倒霉；句尾的「fun」是借用英文口語形式，令說法更口語化、強調語氣。整體用來抱怨近來接連遇到不好的事。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang phrase meaning 'very unlucky' or 'constantly jinxed'. 背 (bui3) conveys being unlucky, 背多 indicates it happens frequently, and the final 'fun' is a colloquial borrowing that gives an informal emphatic tone. Used to complain about repeated bad luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我真係背多fun，成日衰嘢發生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 bui3 do1 fun1, sing4 jat6 seoi1 je5 faat3 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我真的很倒霉，老是有不好的事情發生。
examples.english_sentence: I've been really unlucky lately; bad things keep happening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次面試唔掂，真係背多fun。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 min6 si3 m4 dim6, zan1 hai6 bui3 do1 fun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這次面試沒通過，真是很倒霉。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the interview this time — really unlucky.

mandarin_meaning: 背多分 / 多背一些能在考試中得分的重點
english_meaning: to memorize extra score-worthy points (for an exam); to cram additional key facts to get more marks
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，常在香港學生間使用，指在考試或測驗前刻意背誦那些能拿分的重點、例子或公式，以提高成績。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase commonly used among students in Hong Kong. It means to deliberately memorize additional points, examples, or formulas that are likely to score marks in an exam in order to raise one’s score.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下星期有化學測驗，老師話我哋要背多分，尤其係反應方程式同計算方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 sing1 kei4 jau5 fo3 hok6 cak1 jim6, lou5 si1 waa6 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bei6 do1 fan1, jau4 kei4 hai6 faan2 jing3 fong1 cing4 sik1 tung4 gai3 syun3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下星期有化學測驗，老師說我們要背多分，尤其是反應方程式和計算方法。
examples.english_sentence: There’s a chemistry quiz next week; the teacher said we should memorize extra score-worthy points, especially reaction equations and calculation methods.

mandarin_meaning: 背对
english_meaning: to turn one's back on; to face away from
explanation_mandarin: 表示身體或面向與某個方向或某人相反，常用來描述不看、背離或不理睬的行為。
explanation_english: Indicates facing away from a direction or person; often describes turning one's back, not looking at, or ignoring someone/something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背對住門口，唔留意身後發生嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 deoi3 zyu6 mun4 hau2, m4 lau4 ji3 san1 hau6 faat3 sang1 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背对着门口，没有注意身后发生的事。
examples.english_sentence: He was facing away from the door, not noticing what was happening behind him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為爭執，佢哋而家背對住對方唔講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 zaang1 zik1, keoi5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 bui3 deoi3 zyu6 deoi3 fong1 m4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为争执，他们现在互相背对着不说话。
examples.english_sentence: Because of an argument, they're now facing away from each other and not speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 影相嘅時候唔好背對住光，會影到相暗啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing2 soeng2 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 hou2 bui3 deoi3 zyu6 gwong1, wui5 jing2 dou3 soeng2 aam3 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍照的时候不要背对光，会把照片拍得暗一些。
examples.english_sentence: When taking photos don't face away from the light; the picture will turn out darker.

mandarin_meaning: 背山面海（背靠山，面向海）；表示地勢或位置有山作靠山、面向大海，常用於風水或描述地理優勢；也可引申指有靠山和廣闊前景
english_meaning: literally 'back to the mountain, facing the sea' — describes a location with mountains at the back and the sea in front (considered favourable in feng shui); figuratively, to have solid backing and broad prospects
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 短語 / 形容詞性短語（方位描述/成語性用法）
explanation_mandarin: 指建築或地點背靠山、面向海的方位，常被視為風水佳局；也可用作比喻，表示有依靠與良好發展前景。
explanation_english: Describes a site situated with a mountain at its back and the sea in front — traditionally seen as a favourable feng shui orientation. Can also be used metaphorically to mean having strong backing and promising prospects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋背山面海，風水好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 bei3 saan1 min6 hoi2, fung1 seoi2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那間房子是背山面海，風水很好。
examples.english_sentence: That house has the mountain at its back and faces the sea; it has good feng shui.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司背山面海，前景廣闊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 bei3 saan1 min6 hoi2, cin4 ging2 gwong2 fut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這家公司背山面海，前景廣闊。
examples.english_sentence: This company has strong backing and wide prospects.

mandarin_meaning: 背影（從後面看到的人的身影或輪廓）
english_meaning: the view or silhouette of a person seen from behind; someone's back
explanation_mandarin: 指從後面看到的人的身影或輪廓。除了字面意思外，在文學語境中常用來表達離別、思念或憂傷的情感（如朱自清的散文《背影》）。
explanation_english: Refers to the image or silhouette of a person seen from behind. Beyond the literal meaning, it is often used in literature to evoke separation, longing, or melancholy (for example, Zhu Ziqing's essay "Back View").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢望住佢嘅背影走遠咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mong6 zyu6 keoi5 ge3 bei3 jing2 zau2 jyun5 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她看着他的背影走远了。
examples.english_sentence: She watched his back as he walked away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 讀《背影》嗰篇文章時，我忍唔住流眼淚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 《bei3 jing2》 go2 pin1 man4 zoeng1 si4, ngo5 jan2 m4 zyu6 lau4 ngaan5 leoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 讀《背影》那篇文章時，我忍不住流淚。
examples.english_sentence: When I read the essay "Back View," I couldn't help crying.

mandarin_meaning: 背後 / 背后（在…的後面；在背地裡、暗中）
english_meaning: behind; at the back; behind someone's back; at the rear
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介詞 / 名詞 / 副詞
explanation_mandarin: 表示位置（在某物或某人的後面）；也可表示在別人不知道或不在場時暗中進行（如在背後說人壞話、背後支持等）。作名詞時可指人的背部。
explanation_english: Indicates location (at the back of something or someone). It can also mean doing something secretly or unofficially (e.g., speaking behind someone's back, supporting behind the scenes). As a noun it may refer to the back (part of the body).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個背包擺喺櫃嘅背後，攞唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bui3 baau1 baai2 hai2 gwai6 ge3 bui3 hau6, lo2 m4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個背包放在櫃子的背後，拿不到。
examples.english_sentence: The backpack is at the back of the cabinet; I can't reach it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺我背後講我嘢，真係令我唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 bui3 hau6 gong2 ngo5 je5, zan1 hai6 ling6 ngo5 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們總是在我背後說我的壞話，真的讓我很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: They keep talking about me behind my back, it really makes me uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 原來係佢一直喺背後支持我哋個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 loi4 hai6 keoi5 jat1 zik6 hai2 bui3 hau6 zi1 ci4 ngo5 dei6 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 原來是他一直在背後支持我們的項目。
examples.english_sentence: It turned out he had been supporting our project behind the scenes.

mandarin_meaning: 背心 / 無袖上衣（汗衫、馬甲等）
english_meaning: vest; sleeveless shirt; undershirt (tank top)
explanation_mandarin: 指無袖的上衣，可指作為內搭的汗衫（背心）或作外穿的無袖上衣；在不同語境下也可指馬甲等款式。
explanation_english: Refers to a sleeveless garment — an undershirt/tank top or a sleeveless top; in some contexts it can also mean a vest/waistcoat-style piece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著咗一件白色背心去海灘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 jat1 gin6 baak6 sik1 bui3 sam1 heoi3 hoi2 taan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她穿了一件白色背心去海滩。
examples.english_sentence: He/She wore a white vest to the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏天淨係著背心好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 tin1 zing6 hai6 zoek3 bui3 sam1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏天只穿背心很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: In summer, just wearing a vest is very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺襯衫下面著咗件背心，保暖又唔會太熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 can3 saam1 haa6 min6 zoek3 zo2 gin6 bui3 sam1, bou2 nyun5 jau6 m4 wui5 taai3 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在衬衫下面穿了一件背心，保暖又不會太熱。
examples.english_sentence: He wore a vest under his shirt — it keeps him warm without being too hot.

mandarin_meaning: 背心式塑料袋（一次性購物袋）
english_meaning: T-shirt style plastic bag; single-use shopping plastic bag
explanation_mandarin: 指那種形狀像背心、兩邊有提手的薄塑料購物袋，常用於超市或小店裝物品，屬一次性或短期使用的塑料袋。
explanation_english: Refers to the thin plastic shopping bag shaped like a T-shirt/vest with two handles; commonly used at supermarkets or small shops to carry purchases. Typically single-use or short-term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去超市買嘢，店員畀咗我一個背心袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 ciu1 si5 maai5 je5, dim3 jyun4 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 go3 bui3 sam1 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去超市買東西，店員給了我一個背心袋。
examples.english_sentence: I went to the supermarket to buy things; the staff gave me a T-shirt plastic bag.

mandarin_meaning: （雙手）背在身後；（引申）袖手旁觀、不插手
english_meaning: to have one's hands behind one's back (posture); figuratively, to stand idly by or not get involved
explanation_mandarin: 指把雙手放在背後的姿勢。也可引申為不出手幫忙或袖手旁觀，不參與處理事務。
explanation_english: Refers to the posture of placing both hands behind one's back. Figuratively it can mean refraining from helping or remaining a bystander, not getting involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日企喺度背手，望住啲細路玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 kei5 hai2 dou6 bui3 sau2, mong6 zyu6 di1 sai3 lou6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常站在那裡背著手，看著小朋友玩。
examples.english_sentence: He often stands there with his hands behind his back, watching the kids play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺會議上一直背手，好似唔想參與討論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 wui6 ji5 soeng6 jat1 zik6 bui3 sau2, hou2 ci5 m4 soeng2 caam1 jyu5 tou2 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在會議上一直背著手，好像不想參與討論。
examples.english_sentence: He kept his hands behind his back during the meeting, as if not wanting to participate in the discussion.

mandarin_meaning: 背手照 / 背影照
english_meaning: a back-view photo (often with the subject's hands held behind their back); a back-shot
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語詞，指拍攝對象背對鏡頭、常見地雙手放在背後的照片或背影照，常用於社交媒體與日常會話中描述一種姿勢或照片類型。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for a photograph taken from behind showing the subject's back—often with their hands held behind them. Commonly used to describe a pose or type of photo on social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢影咗張背手影，顯得好有氣質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jing2 zo2 zoeng1 bei3 sau2 jing2, hin2 dak1 hou2 jau5 hei3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她拍了一張背手照，看起來很有氣質。
examples.english_sentence: He/She took a back-view photo (hands behind the back); it looks very classy.

mandarin_meaning: 背景 (bèijǐng)
english_meaning: background; context; setting
explanation_mandarin: 指事情或人物的環境、來歷、情況或幕後支持等，例如家庭背景、事件背景或背景音樂。
explanation_english: Refers to the environment, history, context, circumstances, or behind-the-scenes support of something or someone — e.g., family background, incident background, or background music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有好好嘅家庭背景，喺申請工作嗰陣好有優勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hou2 hou2 ge3 gaa1 ting4 bui3 ging2, hai2 san1 cing2 gung1 zok3 go2 zan6 hou2 jau5 jau1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有很好的家庭背景，在申請工作時很有優勢。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong family background, which gives him an advantage when applying for jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌做電影嘅背景音樂，非常合適。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 zo6 din6 jing2 ge3 bui3 ging2 jam1 ngok6, fei1 soeng4 hap6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這首歌作為電影的背景音樂，非常合適。
examples.english_sentence: This song, used as the film's background music, is very fitting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要了解事發嘅背景先至可以判斷責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 liu5 gaai2 si6 faat3 ge3 bui3 ging2 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 pun3 dyun6 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要了解事情發生的背景，才能判斷責任。
examples.english_sentence: You need to understand the background of the incident before you can determine responsibility.

mandarin_meaning: 背景音乐 (bèijǐng yīnyuè)
english_meaning: background music (BGM)
explanation_mandarin: 指在電影、電視、廣告、商場或活動等環境中播放，用以襯托情緒或營造氣氛的音樂。
explanation_english: Music played in the background of films, TV, advertisements, shops, events, etc., used to enhance mood or create atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電影入面嘅背景音樂好有氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 jing2 jap6 min6 ge3 bui3 ging2 jam1 ngok6 hou2 jau5 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 電影裡的背景音樂很有氛圍。
examples.english_sentence: The background music in the movie creates a great atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 商場裏通常會播背景音樂來營造氣氛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng1 coeng4 leoi5 tung1 soeng4 wui5 bo3 bui3 ging2 jam1 ngok6 lai4 jing4 zou6 hei3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 商場裡通常會播放背景音樂來營造氣氛。
examples.english_sentence: Shopping malls usually play background music to create an atmosphere.

mandarin_meaning: 背诵 / 背书（在票据上签名转让） /（为某人或事）背书、支持
english_meaning: to memorize/recite (by heart); to endorse (a cheque or a person/cause); to give public support
explanation_mandarin: “背書”有幾個常見意思：1）背誦、把文章或課文記住並能朗讀；2）在票據背面簽名以轉讓票據（金融用法）；3）公開支持或為某人/某事背書、背書宣傳。
explanation_english: “背書” has several common senses: 1) to memorize or recite a text by heart; 2) to endorse a negotiable instrument by signing its back (financial usage); 3) to publicly endorse or support a person, product, or cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日要背書第十章，老師會測你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 bui3 syu1 dai6 sap6 zoeng1, lou5 si1 wui5 cak1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天要背诵第十章，老师会考你。
examples.english_sentence: You have to memorize chapter ten today; the teacher will test you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺支票上背書，將支票轉俾公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zi1 piu3 soeng6 bui3 syu1, zoeng1 zi1 piu3 zyun2 bei2 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在支票上背书，把支票转给公司。
examples.english_sentence: He endorsed the cheque, transferring it to the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位名人為候選人背書，幫佢拉攏咗唔少選票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 ming4 jan4 wai6 hau6 syun2 jan4 bui3 syu1, bong1 keoi5 laai1 lung5 zo2 m4 siu2 syun2 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位名人为候选人背书，帮他拉来了不少选票。
examples.english_sentence: That celebrity endorsed the candidate and helped bring in quite a few votes.

mandarin_meaning: 背弃 (bèiqì)：放弃、抛弃或背离某人、某事、信念或承诺
english_meaning: to abandon, forsake, renounce, or betray (a person, responsibility, belief, or promise)
explanation_mandarin: 表示放弃、抛弃或背离某人、某事、信念或承诺，常含违背责任或承诺的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates abandoning, forsaking, or renouncing someone, something, a belief, or a promise; often implies breaking a duty or commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背棄咗對家人嘅責任，令大家好失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 hei3 zo2 deoi3 gaa1 jan4 ge3 zaak3 jam6, ling6 daai6 gaa1 hou2 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背弃了对家人的责任，让大家很失望。
examples.english_sentence: He abandoned his responsibilities to his family, leaving everyone very disappointed.

mandarin_meaning: 背水一战（bèishuǐ yízhàn）
english_meaning: a do-or-die fight; to be forced into a situation with no retreat and fight with all one's might
explanation_mandarin: 形容处于没有退路的绝境，只能奋力一战，通常用来比喻下定决心进行最后的拼搏。
explanation_english: Describes being in a situation with no way to retreat, forcing one to fight desperately; often used metaphorically for making a final, all-out effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司老闆話今次係背水一戰，冇得退路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 lou5 baan2 waa6 gam1 ci3 hai6 bui3 seoi2 jat1 zin3, mou5 dak1 teoi3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司老板说这次是背水一战，没有退路。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said this is a do-or-die battle; there's no way to retreat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試決定放手一搏，算係背水一戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 kyut3 ding6 fong3 sau2 jat1 bok3, syun3 hai6 bui3 seoi2 jat1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试决定放手一搏，算是背水一战。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to go all out on this exam; it's a do-or-die effort.

mandarin_meaning: 仰泳
english_meaning: backstroke (swimming style); to swim backstroke
explanation_mandarin: 指一種游泳姿勢，面向上仰，背對水面，用手臂和腳踢推進；也可作為動詞，表示以仰泳的方式游泳。
explanation_english: Refers to the swimming style where the swimmer lies on their back facing up and propels themselves with arm strokes and kicks; can also be used as a verb meaning to swim using the backstroke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢游背泳游得好好，成日都練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau4 bui3 wing6 jau4 dak1 hou2 hou2, sing4 jat6 dou1 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他仰泳游得很好，經常練習。
examples.english_sentence: He swims the backstroke very well and practices often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺比賽入面，佢用背泳贏咗金牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6, keoi5 jung6 bui3 wing6 jing4 zo2 gam1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在比賽中，他用仰泳贏得了金牌。
examples.english_sentence: In the competition, he won the gold medal in the backstroke.

mandarin_meaning: 把⋯背熟 / 背熟（記牢、熟記）
english_meaning: to memorize thoroughly; to know by heart
explanation_mandarin: 表示把某些內容（如課文、單字、句子）記得很熟練，能背誦出來或隨時說出。
explanation_english: Indicates having learned something so well that it can be recited or recalled from memory (e.g., a text, vocabulary, or lines).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇課文我已經背熟晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 fo3 man4 ngo5 ji5 ging1 bui3 suk6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這篇課文我已經背熟了。
examples.english_sentence: I've already memorized this passage.
