examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試之前要將所有生字背熟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 zi1 cin4 jiu3 zoeng1 so2 jau5 saang1 zi6 bui3 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試前要把所有生字背熟。
examples.english_sentence: You should memorize all the new words before the exam.

mandarin_meaning: 背部的肌肉（背肌）
english_meaning: back muscle(s)
explanation_mandarin: 指位於背部的肌肉群，負責支撐脊柱、協助上肢活動與維持姿勢。
explanation_english: Refers to the muscles of the back — the muscle groups that support the spine, assist upper-limb movement, and help maintain posture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近做重訓，背肌好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 zou6 zung6 fan3, bui3 gei1 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近在做重训，背肌很痛。
examples.english_sentence: I've been doing strength training lately; my back muscles are very sore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做瑜伽可以強化背肌，改善姿勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyu4 gaa1 ho2 ji5 koeng4 faa3 bui3 gei1, goi2 sin6 zi1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做瑜伽可以强化背肌，改善姿势。
examples.english_sentence: Doing yoga can strengthen the back muscles and improve posture.

mandarin_meaning: 背部；脊背（指人的後背或脊椎所在的部位）
english_meaning: back; the back of the body (area of the spine)
explanation_mandarin: 指人體的後背部位，常用來描述背部的位置或背部感到不適（如疼痛）的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the posterior part of the human body (the back), especially the area of the spine; used to describe the body part or discomfort/pain there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日瞓姿勢唔啱，依家個背脊好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 fan3 zi1 si6 m4 ngaam1, ji4 gaa1 go3 bui3 zek3 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我經常睡姿不正，現在背脊很痛。
examples.english_sentence: I often sleep in a bad position; now my back really hurts.

mandarin_meaning: 臉皮厚／厚顏無恥
english_meaning: thick-skinned; shameless; brazen
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人臉皮厚、不知羞恥、無禮或厚顏無恥的行為或性格。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is thick-skinned, shameless, brazen, or behaves without a sense of shame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係背脊厚，欠晒人錢仲唔還，仲要笑人吖！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 bui3 zek3 hau6, him3 saai3 jan4 cin2 zung6 m4 waan4, zung6 jiu3 siu3 jan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是臉皮厚，欠了別人的錢還不還，還嘲笑人家！
examples.english_sentence: He's really shameless — he owes people money and won't pay back, and even mocks others!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背脊厚到可以向老闆要求加薪，仲講到好似啲人欠佢咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 zek3 hau6 dou3 ho2 ji5 hoeng3 lou5 baan2 jiu1 kau4 gaa1 san1, zung6 gong2 dou3 hou2 ci5 di1 jan4 him3 keoi5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他厚臉皮到可以向老闆要求加薪，還說得好像大家欠他一樣。
examples.english_sentence: He's so brazen that he asks the boss for a raise and talks as if everyone owes him.

mandarin_meaning: （字面）背脊有洞；（口語）背脊發涼或背部劇痛
english_meaning: (literal) a hole in the back/spine; (colloquial) a chill down one's spine or a sudden sharp pain in the back
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，字面指背部有洞。引申常用來形容突然感到背脊發涼（被嚇到）或感到背部一陣劇痛。多見於香港粵語的俗語或俚語語境中。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression. Literally 'a hole in the back/spine'. Figuratively used to describe a sudden chill down the spine (from fear) or an acute, sharp pain in the back. Mainly used informally in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽晚嗰套恐怖片，搞到我成晚都背脊開窿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 maan5 go2 tou3 hung2 bou3 pin2, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 bui3 zek3 hoi1 lung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看了那部恐怖片後，我整晚都背脊發涼。
examples.english_sentence: That horror movie gave me chills down my spine all night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌親，當時背脊開窿，好快去咗醫院檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 can1, dong1 si4 bui3 zek3 hoi1 lung4, hou2 faai3 heoi3 zo2 ji1 jyun2 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔傷時背部劇痛，立刻去醫院檢查。
examples.english_sentence: He fell and had severe back pain, so he quickly went to the hospital for a check.

mandarin_meaning: 脊椎；脊骨；（比喻）骨氣、骨幹
english_meaning: spine; backbone (literal anatomical spine; figuratively: backbone/courage)
explanation_mandarin: 指人體的脊椎骨，位於背部；在比喻用法上可指人的骨氣或支柱般的力量。
explanation_english: Refers to the vertebral bones of the back (the spine). Figuratively, it can mean someone's backbone or moral courage/support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我背脊骨痛，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bui3 zek3 gwat1 tung3, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的脊椎疼，要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: My spine/back hurts; I need to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇背脊骨，一遇到困難就退縮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 bui3 zek3 gwat1, jat1 jyu6 dou3 kwan3 naan4 zau6 teoi3 sok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他沒有骨氣，一遇到困难就退缩。
examples.english_sentence: He has no backbone — he shrinks from difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 運動不當可能會傷到背脊骨，要小心保護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan6 dung6 bat1 dong3 ho2 nang4 wui5 soeng1 dou3 bui3 zek3 gwat1, jiu3 siu2 sam1 bou2 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动不当可能会伤到脊椎，要小心保护。
examples.english_sentence: Improper exercise can injure the spine; you should take care to protect it.

mandarin_meaning: （讓人）感到背脊發冷、毛骨悚然
english_meaning: to feel a chill down one's spine; to be spooked or creeped out
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，形容因恐怖、驚訝或不寒而慄而感到背部發冷或起雞皮疙瘩。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression describing the physical or emotional reaction of getting chills down the back—used when something is frightening, creepy, or extremely unsettling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢講嗰件事，我背脊骨落晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 gong2 go2 gin6 si6, ngo5 bui3 zik6 gwat1 lok6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他講的那件事，我後背都發冷了。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing what he said gave me chills down my spine.

mandarin_meaning: 背着包裹；比喻替别人承担负担或责任
english_meaning: to carry a pack/backpack; figuratively, to bear someone else's burden or take the blame
explanation_mandarin: 原本指背着包裹（褡），口語中常用來比喻替別人承擔責任、吃虧或背鍋。
explanation_english: Literally 'to carry a pack (褡) on one's back'. Colloquially used to mean taking on others' burdens, shouldering responsibility for someone else, or taking the blame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日替朋友背褡，做晒啲工，自己攰到冇晒力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tai3 pang4 jau5 bui3 daap3, zou6 saai3 di1 gung1, zi6 gei2 gui6 dou3 mou5 saai3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常替朋友背負損失，做完所有工作，自己累得沒有力氣。
examples.english_sentence: He often takes the loss for his friends, does all the work, and ends up exhausted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，阿爺教我點樣背褡去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, aa3 je5 gaau3 ngo5 dim2 joeng6 bui3 daap3 heoi3 hang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，爷爷教我怎样背包去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my grandfather taught me how to carry a pack for hiking.

mandarin_meaning: 房間或空間的後方角落；後角
english_meaning: back corner; the rear corner or nook of a room or space
explanation_mandarin: 「背角」字面上指背面或後方的角落，多用來描述房間、店舖或空間內較隱蔽、靠後的位置。在廣東話口語中可用於實體位置的描述。
explanation_english: Literally 'back corner' — refers to the rear corner or nook of a room or space. Commonly used in Cantonese to describe a less visible or tucked-away location.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書放咗喺房間嘅背角，唔係好易搵到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 fong3 zo2 hai2 fong4 gaan1 ge3 bui3 gok3, m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 wan2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那本書放在房間的後角，不太容易找到。
examples.english_sentence: The book was placed in the back corner of the room and is not easy to find.

mandarin_meaning: 在背後說別人的壞話；說閒話、說人壞話（口語、貶義）
english_meaning: to speak ill of someone behind their back; to badmouth or gossip about someone
explanation_mandarin: 「背語」為香港粵語俗語，通常指在某人不在場時說他的壞話或評論，帶有負面、背後議論的意思。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe speaking negatively about someone when they are not present — i.e. badmouthing or gossiping behind their back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日背語其他人，令我哋唔想同佢講心事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 bui3 jyu5 kei4 taa1 jan4, ling6 ngo5 dei6 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 sam1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在背後說別人的壞話，讓我們不想跟他訴心事。
examples.english_sentence: He often talks badly about others behind their backs, so we don't want to confide in him.

mandarin_meaning: 背诵 (bèi sòng) — 记忆并朗读或默写出所学内容
english_meaning: to recite from memory; to memorize and recite (learn by heart)
explanation_mandarin: 表示把文章、詩詞、課文等記住並口頭或默默地念出來，用於學習或考試等語境。
explanation_english: Refers to committing a text (such as an article, poem, or lesson) to memory and reciting it aloud or silently; commonly used in study or exam contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要背誦成篇文章，因為聽日有考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 bui3 sung3 seng4 pin1 man4 zoeng1, jan1 wai6 teng1 jat6 jau5 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚要背诵整篇文章，因為明天有考試。
examples.english_sentence: I have to memorize and recite the whole article tonight because there's an exam tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 背负（承擔、肩負）
english_meaning: to bear; to shoulder (a burden or responsibility)
explanation_mandarin: 表示承受或擔負（責任、負擔、壓力等），常用於比喻承擔重任或負擔。
explanation_english: Indicates bearing or shouldering something (responsibility, burden, pressure, etc.); often used metaphorically for taking on heavy duties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人背負成個家嘅重擔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 bui3 fu6 sing4 go3 gaa1 ge3 zung6 daam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一個人背負整個家庭的重擔。
examples.english_sentence: He alone bears the heavy burden of the whole family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲錯誤唔應該由佢一個人背負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 co3 ng6 m4 jing1 goi1 jau4 keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 bui3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些錯誤不應該由他一個人承擔。
examples.english_sentence: These mistakes shouldn't be borne by him alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔可以叫新員工背負咁多責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 ho2 ji5 giu3 san1 jyun4 gung1 bui3 fu6 gam2 do1 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不可以要求新員工背負這麼多責任。
examples.english_sentence: The company can't make new employees shoulder so many responsibilities.

mandarin_meaning: 背道而驰（与对方的方向、做法或目标完全相反）
english_meaning: Literally 'to run in opposite directions'; to be completely at odds with someone/something; to conflict or diverge
explanation_mandarin: 表示方向相反。比喻彼此的做法、目標或意見完全相反、互相衝突，難以一致或合作。
explanation_english: Indicates going in opposite directions. Figuratively, it describes actions, goals, or opinions that are completely contrary or in conflict, making agreement or cooperation difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅做法同我哋背道而馳，難以合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 zou6 faat3 tung4 ngo5 dei6 bui3 dou6 ji4 ci4, naan4 ji5 hap6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們的做法與我們背道而馳，很難合作。
examples.english_sentence: Their approach runs counter to ours, so it's hard to work together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嘅新政策同以往嘅方向背道而馳，引起好大爭議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ge3 san1 zing3 caak3 tung4 ji5 wong5 ge3 fong1 hoeng3 bui3 dou6 ji4 ci4, jan5 hei2 hou2 daai6 zang1 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府的新政策與以往的方向背道而馳，引起很大爭議。
examples.english_sentence: The government's new policy runs counter to the previous direction and has caused significant controversy.

mandarin_meaning: 靠、倚靠；依靠（某人或勢力作後盾）
english_meaning: to lean against (with one's back); to be backed by or rely on someone/something
explanation_mandarin: 可以指用背部靠著某物（如樹、牆）休息；引申為依靠或倚仗某人、勢力或資源獲得支持或保障。
explanation_english: Can mean physically leaning one's back against something (e.g., a tree or wall); figuratively, to depend on or be backed by a person, organization, or resource for support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢背靠住條樹休息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bui3 kaau3 zyu6 tiu4 syu6 jau1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他背靠著一棵樹休息。
examples.english_sentence: He is leaning his back against a tree to rest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間細公司背靠住大公司，所以唔使太擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 sai3 gung1si1 bui3 kaau3 zyu6 daai6 gung1si1, so2 ji5 m4 sai2 taai3 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間小公司依靠大公司作後盾，所以不用太擔心。
examples.english_sentence: This small company is backed by a big company, so it doesn't need to worry too much.

mandarin_meaning: 背面；後面；物體的反面，也可指人的背部
english_meaning: back; reverse side; the rear or posterior side of an object or a person's back
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示物體的背側或後面（例如紙張、相片的反面），也可指人體的背部位置。
explanation_english: Refers to the back or reverse side of something (e.g., the reverse side of a photo or paper); can also denote the back area of a person's body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張相嘅背面寫咗佢嘅電話號碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 soeng2 ge3 bui3 min6 se2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照片的背面寫了他的電話號碼。
examples.english_sentence: The back of the photo has his phone number written on it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張紙嘅背面仲有其他資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 zi2 ge3 bui3 min6 zung6 jau5 kei4 taa1 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張紙的背面還有其他資料。
examples.english_sentence: There is additional information on the reverse side of this paper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我背面好痛，做運動嘅時候扭親咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bui3 min6 hou2 tung3, zou6 wan6 dung6 ge3 si4 hau6 nau2 can1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我背部很痛，可能是在運動時扭傷了。
examples.english_sentence: My back hurts a lot; I probably strained it while exercising.

mandarin_meaning: 默默背誦；在心裏默念或默默溫習
english_meaning: to silently recite or rehearse something to oneself; to memorize quietly
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，表示不出聲地在心裏背誦或溫習（例如背書、背劇本等）。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term meaning to silently recite or rehearse/ memorize something to oneself (e.g., lines, notes) without speaking aloud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺房度背默劇本，準備演出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fong2 dou6 bui3 mak6 gik6 bun2, zeon2 bei6 jin2 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在房間裡默默背劇本，準備演出。
examples.english_sentence: He's in the room silently rehearsing the script, preparing for a performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前夕我成晚都喺度背默啲重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 zik6 ngo5 seng4 maan5 dou1 hai2 dou6 bui3 mak6 di1 zung6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試前夕我整晚都在默默背重點。
examples.english_sentence: On the eve of the exam I spent the whole night silently memorizing the key points.

mandarin_meaning: 胎；胎兒；（在複合詞中）輪胎
english_meaning: fetus; (in compounds) tire (as in wheel tire)
explanation_mandarin: 表示胚胎、胎兒；在某些複合詞中（如「輪胎」）指輪胎。
explanation_english: Refers to an embryo or fetus; in some compounds (e.g. 輪胎) it refers to a tire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話胎冇事，媽媽可以放心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 toi1 mou5 si6, maa4 maa1 ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說胎兒沒事，媽媽可以放心。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the fetus is fine, so the mother can be relieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢肚入面嘅胎已經八個月喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tou5 jap6 min6 ge3 toi1 ji5 ging1 baat3 go3 jyut6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他肚子裡的胎兒已經八個月了。
examples.english_sentence: The fetus in her womb is already eight months along.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出門前記得檢查吓條胎有冇漏氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 mun4 cin4 gei3 dak1 gim2 caa4 haa5 tiu4 toi1 jau5 mou5 lau6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 出門前記得檢查一下輪胎有沒有漏氣。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to check the tires for leaks before you go out.

mandarin_meaning: 胎儿
english_meaning: fetus; unborn baby
explanation_mandarin: 指妊娠期間在子宮內發育、尚未出生的嬰兒階段，介於胚胎期與出生之前。
explanation_english: The unborn baby developing in the uterus during pregnancy; the stage after embryo and before birth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話胎兒發育正常。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 toi1 ji4 faat3 juk6 zing3 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生說胎儿發育正常。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the fetus is developing normally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢懷孕三個月，胎兒已經開始有心跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waai4 jan6 saam1 go3 jyut6, toi1 ji4 ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 jau5 sam1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她懷孕三個月，胎儿已經開始有心跳。
examples.english_sentence: She is three months pregnant; the fetus already has a heartbeat.

mandarin_meaning: 胎囊（胚囊、妊娠囊）— 妊娠早期子宫内的囊状结构，包含胚胎及其附属腔室
english_meaning: gestational sac — the early pregnancy sac in the uterus that contains the embryo and related fluid-filled cavities
explanation_mandarin: 指妊娠早期在子宮內形成的囊狀結構，內含胚胎、羊膜腔等，通常於超聲檢查中可見，用以評估是否為子宮內妊娠及妊娠週數的初步判斷。
explanation_english: A sac-like structure formed in the uterus during early pregnancy that contains the embryo and associated cavities (e.g., amniotic space). It is commonly seen on ultrasound and used to confirm intrauterine pregnancy and estimate gestational age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話喺超聲波見到一個胎囊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 hai2 ciu1 sing1 bo1 gin3 dou2 jat1 go3 toi1 nong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说在超声波上能看到一个胎囊。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said they could see a gestational sac on the ultrasound.

mandarin_meaning: 胎教 (tāijiào)：在孕期透過音樂、語言、環境等刺激來影響胎兒，以促進其發育或培養性格與習慣的做法或活動。
english_meaning: Prenatal education: practices during pregnancy (music, talking, environment, etc.) intended to influence or stimulate the fetus's development or temperament.
explanation_mandarin: 胎教是指孕婦在懷孕期間通過各種方式（如播放音樂、朗誦、控制情緒與生活環境等）來刺激或影響胎兒，目的是促進其身心發展或形成良好習慣。
explanation_english: Prenatal education refers to activities by the pregnant parent (playing music, speaking to the fetus, maintaining a calm environment, etc.) intended to stimulate or positively influence fetal development and future behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我老婆好注重胎教，成日畀寶寶聽古典音樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lou5 po4 hou2 zyu3 zung6 toi1 gaau3, sing4 jat6 bei2 bou2 bou2 teng1 gu2 din2 jam1 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我太太很重視胎教，經常讓寶寶聽古典音樂。
examples.english_sentence: My wife pays a lot of attention to prenatal education; she often has the baby listen to classical music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 胎教唔只係放音樂，仲要保持媽媽嘅情緒穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi1 gaau3 m4 zi2 hai6 fong3 jam1 ngok6, zung6 jiu3 bou2 ci4 maa4 maa1 ge3 cing4 ceoi3 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 胎教不僅是放音樂，還要保持媽媽的情緒穩定。
examples.english_sentence: Prenatal education is not only about playing music; it's also important for the mother to keep her emotions stable.

mandarin_meaning: 胎死腹中
english_meaning: to miscarry; figuratively, a plan or project that fails in the early stages or is abandoned before implementation
explanation_mandarin: 原指胎兒在母腹中夭折；引申為計劃、構想在開始階段就失敗或被迫放棄，未能實施。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a fetus dying in the womb; figuratively used for a plan, proposal, or project that fails at an early stage or is abandoned before it can be carried out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個新產品計劃因為冇錢而胎死腹中。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 san1 caan2 ban2 gai3 waak6 jan1 wai6 mou5 cin2 ji4 toi1 sei2 fuk1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個新產品計劃因為沒錢而胎死腹中。
examples.english_sentence: The new product plan was aborted due to lack of funds.

mandarin_meaning: 胎毛（胎兒或新生兒身上的絨毛）
english_meaning: lanugo; the fine soft hair on a fetus or newborn
explanation_mandarin: 胎毛指胎兒或剛出生的嬰兒身上覆蓋的細軟絨毛，通常出生後幾天或數週會脫落。有時家長會保存剃下的初生毛作紀念。
explanation_english: Refers to the fine soft hair (lanugo) that covers a fetus or appears on a newborn. It usually falls out within days or weeks after birth. In some cultures parents keep the first hair as a keepsake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嬰兒出世嗰陣通常會有胎毛，幾日後就會脫落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 ji4 ceot1 sai3 go2 zan6 tung1 soeng4 wui5 jau5 toi1 mou4, gei2 jat6 hau6 zau6 wui5 tyut3 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婴儿出生时通常会有胎毛，几天后就会脱落。
examples.english_sentence: Newborns usually have lanugo at birth; it falls out after a few days.

mandarin_meaning: 孩子氣、愛耍脾氣
english_meaning: being childish/spoiled; throwing tantrums; sulky
explanation_mandarin: 口語，常用來形容一個人像嬰兒或小孩子般愛耍脾氣、任性或愛發脾氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term describing someone who behaves like a spoiled child — sulky, capricious, or prone to throwing tantrums.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日發脾氣，好有胎氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 faat3 pei4 hei3, hou2 jau5 toi1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是發脾氣，很孩子氣。
examples.english_sentence: He often throws tantrums; he's very childish/spoiled.

mandarin_meaning: 胎生
english_meaning: viviparous; live-bearing
explanation_mandarin: 指胚胎在母體內發育並生出活體幼體的生殖方式；作為形容詞用來描述動物的生殖類型。
explanation_english: Refers to a reproductive mode in which the embryo develops inside the mother's body and the mother gives birth to live young; used as an adjective to describe animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人類係胎生嘅動物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 leoi6 hai6 toi1 saang1 ge3 dung6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人类是胎生的动物。
examples.english_sentence: Humans are viviparous animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲蛇係卵生，有啲係胎生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 se4 hai6 lyun5 saang1, jau5 di1 hai6 toi1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有的蛇是卵生的，有的是胎生的。
examples.english_sentence: Some snakes are oviparous, others are viviparous.

mandarin_meaning: 胎痣（胎記）——先天性的色素痣或胎記
english_meaning: birthmark; congenital nevus (a pigment mole present from birth)
explanation_mandarin: 指在胚胎期或出生時就存在的色素沉著或痣，常見為先天性的胎記或痣，可能在外觀上顯眼或較小不明顯。
explanation_english: Refers to a pigment mark or mole that exists from fetal development or at birth. It is a congenital mark (birthmark) or nevus that can be noticeable or small and unobtrusive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢面上有一粒胎痣，細個已經有喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 min6 soeng6 jau5 jat1 lap1 toi1 zi6, sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 jau5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他臉上有一顆胎痣，從小就有了。
examples.english_sentence: He has a birthmark on his face; he's had it since childhood.

mandarin_meaning: 胎盘
english_meaning: placenta
explanation_mandarin: 胎盤是在妊娠期間於子宮內發育的臟器，通過臍帶與胎兒相連，負責交換營養與氧氣、排泄代謝廢物並分泌荷爾蒙，通常於生產後排出。
explanation_english: The placenta is an organ that develops in the uterus during pregnancy, connects to the fetus via the umbilical cord, supplies oxygen and nutrients, removes waste, and secretes hormones; it is usually expelled after delivery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生產完之後，醫生會檢查胎盤有冇完整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 caan2 jyun4 zi1 hau6, ji1 sang1 wui5 gim2 caa4 toi1pun4 jau5 mou5 jyun4 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生產後，醫生會檢查胎盤是否完整。
examples.english_sentence: After delivery, the doctor will check whether the placenta is intact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生懷疑胎盤前置，建議剖腹產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waai4 ji4 toi1pun4 cin4 zi6, gin3 ji3 pou2 fuk1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生懷疑胎盤前置，建議剖腹產。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor suspects placenta previa and recommends a cesarean section.

mandarin_meaning: 胖 (pàng) — 胖、體重較重
english_meaning: fat; chubby; overweight
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述體型有較多脂肪或體重超出一般標準的人或動物。
explanation_english: Describes a person or animal that has excess body fat or is heavier than typical; fat or overweight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近食太多，變得好胖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 sik6 taai3 do1, bin3 dak1 hou2 bun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近吃太多，變得很胖。
examples.english_sentence: I've eaten too much recently and have become very fat.

mandarin_meaning: 胗（zhēn）：指禽類（尤其是雞）的砂囊，常作為食材
english_meaning: gizzard (the muscular stomach/ventricular organ of birds, commonly eaten as food)
explanation_mandarin: 胗是指鳥類的砂囊，通常特指雞胗，為一種常見內臟食材，可炒、燒或滷製。
explanation_english: Refers to the gizzard (the muscular stomach) of birds, especially chicken gizzards; a common edible offal used in stir-fries, braises, or soups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚買咗啲雞胗，炒嚟食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 di1 gai1 zan1, caau2 lei4 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚買了些雞胗，就炒來吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: I bought some chicken gizzards tonight; I'll stir-fry them to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 胗和肝（動物內臟，常用作食材）
english_meaning: gizzard and liver (offal; edible internal organs)
explanation_mandarin: 指雞、鴨等動物的胗（砂囊）與肝，屬於內臟類食材，常見於廣東菜及街頭小食中。
explanation_english: Refers to the gizzard and liver of animals (commonly poultry); these internal organs are used as food, often found in Cantonese cuisine and street food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食胗肝，尤其係滷得入味嗰啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 jan1 gon1, jau4 kei4 hai6 lou2 dak1 jap6 mei6 go2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃胗和肝，尤其是卤得入味的那种。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat gizzard and liver, especially the ones braised until flavorful.

mandarin_meaning: 胚、胚胎；毛坯（未加工的坯料）
english_meaning: embryo; fetus; blank/unfinished piece (e.g., pottery blank); raw material
explanation_mandarin: 通常指生物發育早期的胚胎；在工藝或製造上可指還未加工的坯料或毛坯。在粵語口語裡，胚也出現在某些貶義詞中（例如「死胚」）作為侮辱用語。
explanation_english: Generally refers to an embryo in early development; in crafts or manufacturing it can mean an unworked blank or raw piece. In Cantonese colloquial speech, 胚 appears in some derogatory expressions (e.g. "死胚") used as an insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話個胚胎仲好細，要等多幾個星期先穩定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 go3 pui1 toi1 zung6 hou2 sai3, jiu3 dang2 do1 gei2 go3 sing1 kei4 sin1 wan2 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说胚胎还很小，要等多几个星期才稳定。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the embryo is still very small; we need to wait a few more weeks for it to stabilize.

mandarin_meaning: 胚囊（pēináng）：胚胎早期的囊狀結構；在植物學上指雌配子體（胚囊、胚囊室）
english_meaning: embryo sac; blastocyst — a sac-like structure in early embryonic development (in animals often refers to a blastocyst; in plants the embryo sac/female gametophyte)
explanation_mandarin: 指早期胚胎或配子體中的囊狀結構。在動物或人工受孕研究中常指囊胚（blastocyst）；在植物學中指雌配子體的胚囊。
explanation_english: Refers to a sac-like structure in early embryonic development. In animal embryology (and assisted reproduction) it often denotes the blastocyst stage; in botany it denotes the embryo sac (female gametophyte).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話胚囊發育正常，依家可以繼續跟進治療方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 pui1 nong4 faat3 juk6 zing3 coeng4, ji1 gaa1 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 gan1 zeon3 zi6 liu6 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说胚囊发育正常，现在可以继续跟进治疗方案。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the embryo sac (blastocyst) is developing normally; we can proceed with the treatment plan now.

mandarin_meaning: 胚胎（早期發育中的胎兒）
english_meaning: embryo (the early stage of development in a multicellular organism, especially a human)
explanation_mandarin: 指受精後早期發育階段的胚體，通常用於描述哺乳動物（包括人類）在懷孕早期的發育階段。也可用作比喻，表示事物的初期、雛形階段。
explanation_english: Refers to the early developmental stage after fertilization, typically describing the early stage of development in mammals (including humans). It can also be used metaphorically to mean an initial or embryonic stage of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話個胚胎發育正常。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 go3 pui1 toi1 faat3 juk6 zing3 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說胚胎發育正常。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said the embryo is developing normally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孕婦做咗超聲，見到胚胎心跳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan6 fu5 zou6 zo2 ciu1 seng1, gin3 dou2 pui1 toi1 sam1 tiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孕婦做了超聲，看到胚胎有心跳。
examples.english_sentence: The pregnant woman had an ultrasound and saw the embryo's heartbeat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃仲喺胚胎階段，未有詳細方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zung6 hai2 pui1 toi1 gaai1 dyun6, mei6 jau5 soeng4 sai3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個計劃還處於胚胎階段，還沒有詳細方案。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is still in its embryonic stage and doesn't have a detailed proposal yet.

mandarin_meaning: 胚芽（pēiyá），指種子內的胚，或指穀物（如小麥）中的芽，富含營養。
english_meaning: germ (of a seed); seed embryo; (in food) grain germ, e.g. wheat germ
explanation_mandarin: 胚芽是種子中發育成新植物的部分，含有豐富的蛋白質、維生素與油脂。在食品中常指穀物的胚芽，如小麥胚芽，常被當作營養補充成分。
explanation_english: The germ is the part of a seed that develops into a new plant; it is rich in proteins, vitamins and oils. In food contexts it often refers to the germ of grains (e.g. wheat germ), used as a nutritious ingredient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 胚芽係種子入面嘅胚，含有豐富嘅養分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: pui1 ngaa4 hai6 zung2 zi2 jap6 min6 ge3 pui1, ham4 jau5 fung1 fu3 ge3 joeng5 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 胚芽是种子里面的胚，含有丰富的养分。
examples.english_sentence: The germ is the embryo inside a seed and contains abundant nutrients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款麵包有加胚芽，食落比較有益健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 min6 baau1 jau5 gaa1 pui1 ngaa4, sik6 lok6 bei2 gaau3 jau5 jik1 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款面包加了胚芽，吃起来比较有益健康。
examples.english_sentence: This type of bread has added germ; it's relatively healthier to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 胜 (shèng) — 胜利；战胜；超过
english_meaning: win; victory; to defeat; to surpass
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词 / 名词 / 形容词
explanation_mandarin: 汉字“胜”（读作 shèng），表示取得胜利、打败对手或超越；也可作形容词表示“更胜一筹”。常见于词组如“胜出”、“胜过”。
explanation_english: The character '胜' (Jyutping sing3; Mandarin shèng) means to win, to defeat, victory, or to surpass. It can function as a verb, noun, or adjective and appears in compounds like '胜出' (to win) and '胜过' (to surpass).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場比賽我哋勝出，大家好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 sing3 ceot1, daai6 gaa1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛我们获胜，大家很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: We won this match; everyone is very happy.

mandarin_meaning: 胞（bāo）：細胞；同胎出生者；用於構成與生物體或血緣相關的詞素（如細胞、同胞、胞兄）。
english_meaning: bao: cell; of the same womb (sibling); a bound morpheme in words related to biological cells or kin (e.g., cell, compatriot, elder brother by same mother).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 詞素（構詞成分）
explanation_mandarin: 「胞」多作詞素使用，用於表示生物學上的細胞或表示同一母體出生的親屬關係（如同胞、胞兄）；也可出現在醫學或生物詞彙中。
explanation_english: The character denotes a cell (biological) or kin born of the same womb; commonly used as a bound morpheme in words related to biology or familial relation (e.g., cell, compatriot).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細胞係生物最基本嘅單位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 baau1 hai6 saang1 mat6 zeoi3 gei1 bun2 ge3 daan1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 细胞是生物最基本的单位。
examples.english_sentence: Cells are the most basic units of living organisms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港人係我哋嘅同胞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jan4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 tung4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港人是我们的同胞。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong people are our compatriots.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就係我嘅胞兄，係同一個媽媽生嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 baau1 hing1, hai6 tung4 jat1 go3 maa4 maa1 saang1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的胞兄，是同一个妈妈生的。
examples.english_sentence: He is my biological elder brother; we were born of the same mother.

mandarin_meaning: 胞兄（指同父母所生的哥哥，書面或正式用語）
english_meaning: elder brother (biological; formal term)
explanation_mandarin: 指與說話者同父母所生的哥哥，為較書面或正式的稱呼。
explanation_english: A formal term for a biological older brother—one who shares the same parents as the speaker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅胞兄大我五年，佢而家喺大學教書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 baau1 hing1 daai6 ngo5 ng5 nin4, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 daai6 hok6 gaau3 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的胞兄比我大五歲，他現在在大學教書。
examples.english_sentence: My elder (biological) brother is five years older than me; he's now teaching at a university.

mandarin_meaning: 胞妹（指同父母所生的比自己年幼的女性兄弟姊妹）
english_meaning: younger sister (biological sister sharing the same parents)
explanation_mandarin: “胞妹”指與自己有同一父母所生、年紀比自己小的女性兄弟姊妹，常用於書面或口語中區分親生妹妹。
explanation_english: “胞妹” denotes a female sibling who is younger than oneself and shares the same parents; used to refer to a biological younger sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有個胞妹，佢而家喺大學讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 go3 baau1 mui6, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有一個胞妹，她現在在大學讀書。
examples.english_sentence: I have a younger (biological) sister; she is currently attending university.

mandarin_meaning: 親姐姐；同父母或有血緣關係的年長女性兄弟姊妹
english_meaning: elder sister (biological); a formal/literary term for one's older sister
explanation_mandarin: 「胞姊」指與自己有血緣關係的年長女性兄弟姊妹，即親姐姐。語感較書面或正式，有時在法律或家族書信中使用。
explanation_english: Refers to an older sister who shares the same blood relation (a biological elder sister). The term is somewhat formal or literary compared with everyday words like “姐姐.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個胞姊比我大五年，細個時佢成日照顧我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 baau1 zi2 bei2 ngo5 daai6 ng5 nin4, sai3 go3 si4 keoi5 seng4 jat6 ziu3 gu3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我親姐姐比我大五歲，小时候她常常照顾我。
examples.english_sentence: My elder sister is five years older than me; when we were little she often took care of me.

mandarin_meaning: 親姐姐
english_meaning: biological older sister
explanation_mandarin: 指與自己有血緣關係的年長女性兄弟姊妹中的姊姊，等同於「親姐姐」。這是廣東話常用的稱呼。
explanation_english: Refers to an elder sister who is a biological sibling (born of the same parents); equivalent to "biological older sister." Commonly used in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅胞姐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 bou1 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是我的親姐姐。
examples.english_sentence: She is my biological older sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 星期日我同胞姐去買衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 tung4 bou1 ze2 heoi3 maai5 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 星期日我和親姐姐去買衣服。
examples.english_sentence: On Sunday I went clothes shopping with my older sister.

mandarin_meaning: 胞弟（生物學上或書面語指同父母所生、年紀較小的男性兄弟）
english_meaning: younger brother (biological; sibling born of the same parents)
explanation_mandarin: 指與自己同父母所生且年紀較小的男性兄弟，較偏書面或強調血親關係的用詞。
explanation_english: Refers to a male sibling who is younger and shares the same parents; a more formal/biological term than the casual '弟弟'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個胞弟而家喺大學讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 baau1 dai6 ji4 gaa1 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的胞弟現在在大學讀書。
examples.english_sentence: My younger brother is currently studying at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅胞弟，但我哋唔係好常聯絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 baau1 dai6, daan6 ngo5 dei6 m4 hai6 hou2 soeng4 lyun4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的胞弟，但我們不常聯絡。
examples.english_sentence: He is my younger brother (biological), but we don't keep in touch often.

mandarin_meaning: 胡（表示隨意、亂、無根據；亦為姓氏）
english_meaning: Hu (used as a prefix meaning random/wanton/nonsense; also a surname)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞/副詞/動詞（構詞成分）/姓氏（專有名詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「胡」常用作構詞成分，表示隨意、亂或無根據的行為或言論（如：胡說、胡鬧、胡亂），也可作為姓氏历史用字亦可指「胡人、胡族」等。
explanation_english: "胡" is often used as a morpheme meaning random, wanton, or baseless (e.g., 胡說, 胡鬧, 胡亂). It is also a common Chinese surname (Hu). Historically it could refer to non-Han peoples.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡說八道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 syut3 baat3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要胡说八道。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢胡亂拎人嘅嘢，簡直唔尊重人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wu4 lyun6 ling1 jan4 ge3 je5, gaan2 zik6 m4 zyun1 zung3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他胡乱拿别人的东西，简直不尊重人。
examples.english_sentence: He grabs other people's things recklessly; it's simply disrespectful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我班有個學生姓胡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 baan1 jau5 go3 hok6 saang1 sing3 wu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我班上有個學生姓胡。
examples.english_sentence: There is a student surnamed Hu in my class.

mandarin_meaning: 胡乱（随便、草率地，没有经过仔细考虑或分辨地）
english_meaning: carelessly; recklessly; randomly; without proper thought or consideration
explanation_mandarin: 表示做事沒有經過仔細考慮、隨便或草率地去做，常用來形容說話或行為不負責任或不謹慎。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something without careful thought or consideration — doing it carelessly, recklessly, or at random. Often describes irresponsible or hasty speech or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡亂講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 lyun6 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別胡乱说话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak carelessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢胡亂用啲化學品，結果中咗毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wu4 lyun6 jung6 di1 faa3 hok6 ban2, git3 gwo2 zung1 zo2 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他胡乱使用化学品，结果中毒了。
examples.english_sentence: He used chemicals recklessly and ended up poisoned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你胡亂改動設定，個系統可能會出問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 wu4 lyun6 goi2 dung6 se3 ding6, go3 hai6 tung2 ho2 nang4 wui5 ceot1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你胡乱改动设置，系统可能会出问题。
examples.english_sentence: If you change the settings recklessly, the system may encounter problems.

mandarin_meaning: 胡亂作惡，任意做壞事或不正當的行為
english_meaning: to act wantonly or unscrupulously; to engage in wrongdoing or outrageous behavior
explanation_mandarin: 形容肆意做壞事或不顧後果、違反規矩的行為，帶有強烈貶義。
explanation_english: Describes acting recklessly or immorally, committing wrongful or outrageous acts without regard for consequences; strongly negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日胡作非為，公司都頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 wu4 zok3 fei1 wai4, gung1 si1 dou1 ding2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近成天胡作非為，公司都快受不了了。
examples.english_sentence: He's been acting outrageously lately; the company can hardly tolerate it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果任由佢胡作非為，後果會好嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jam6 jau4 keoi5 wu4 zok3 fei1 wai4, hau6 gwo2 wui5 hou2 jim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果任由他胡作非為，後果會很嚴重。
examples.english_sentence: If he is allowed to act unscrupulously, the consequences will be serious.

mandarin_meaning: 胡作非为
english_meaning: to act recklessly or wantonly; to behave outrageously and commit misdeeds
explanation_mandarin: 形容肆意做壞事或無視規矩、擅自胡鬧，通常帶有強烈的貶義。
explanation_english: Describes acting wantonly or lawlessly, ignoring rules or morals; usually negative and indicates outrageous or harmful behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個老闆成日胡作非爲，公司啲人都唔敢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 wu4 zok3 fei1 wai4, gung1 si1 di1 jan4 dou1 m4 gam2 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老板经常胡作非为，公司的人都不敢说话。
examples.english_sentence: That boss frequently behaves outrageously; the employees don't dare to speak up.

mandarin_meaning: 胡同（北京等北方城市的狭窄巷道）
english_meaning: hutong; a narrow alley or lane (especially in Beijing)
explanation_mandarin: 指中国北方，尤其是北京传统的狭窄巷道，多为居民聚居的街巷，具有历史文化特色。
explanation_english: Refers to traditional narrow lanes or alleys in northern China (especially Beijing), typically residential and carrying historical and cultural characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺北京行咗好耐，嗰啲胡同好窄，好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 bak1 ging1 hang4 zo2 hou2 noi6, go2 di1 wu4 tung4 hou2 zaak3, hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在北京走了很久，那些胡同很窄，很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: We walked around Beijing for a long time; those hutongs are very narrow and full of character.

mandarin_meaning: 糊涂（hútu）
english_meaning: muddled; confused; foolish; absent-minded
explanation_mandarin: 形容頭腦不清楚、糊里糊塗或做事粗心、愚昧。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is muddled or confused, not thinking clearly, or acting carelessly/foolishly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做真係好胡塗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 wu4 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做真是很糊涂。
examples.english_sentence: What you did is really muddled/stupid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為太攰，所以有啲胡塗，忘記鎖門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 taai3 gui6, so2 ji5 jau5 di1 wu4 tou4, mong4 gei3 so2 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为太累，所以有点糊涂，忘了锁门。
examples.english_sentence: He was too tired and a bit muddled, so he forgot to lock the door.

mandarin_meaning: （與「胡天胡地」相近）胡說八道、亂來、行為或言語荒唐
english_meaning: colloquial expression meaning to act recklessly or speak nonsense; utterly arbitrary or absurd
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語說法，用來形容言行胡亂、荒唐或不負責任。此寫法把常見的「胡天胡地」中的「地」換成「帝」，多為戲謔或強調用法，意思與「胡說八道」「亂來」相近。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase used to describe reckless, nonsensical, or arbitrary behavior or speech. It is essentially a playful/variant spelling of 胡天胡地 (hu tian hu di) and carries the same sense as "talking nonsense" or "messing around recklessly."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日胡天胡帝，做嘢要認真啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 wu4 tin1 wu4 dai3, zou6 je5 jiu3 jing6 zan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要整天亂來，做事要認真一點。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be reckless all the time; take your work more seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢完全係胡天胡帝，根本唔可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 wan4 cyun4 hai6 wu4 tin1 wu4 dai3, gan1 bun2 m4 ho2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話完全是胡說八道，根本不可信。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is pure nonsense and totally untrustworthy.

mandarin_meaning: 越南胡志明市（前稱西貢）
english_meaning: Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam), formerly known as Saigon
explanation_mandarin: 越南最大城市之一，重要的經濟與文化中心，歷史上亦稱為西貢。
explanation_english: A major city in Vietnam (formerly Saigon), an important economic and cultural center.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去胡志明市旅遊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 wu4 zi3 ming4 si5 leoi5 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去胡志明市旅游。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Ho Chi Minh City next month.

mandarin_meaning: 胡思乱想（毫无根据地乱想或过度担忧）
english_meaning: to overthink; to have wild or unfounded thoughts; to worry unnecessarily
explanation_mandarin: 表示無根據地胡亂想象或過度擔心，常指把不必要或不切實際的念頭放大。
explanation_english: Describes thinking wildly or worrying without good reason; often means letting unnecessary or unrealistic thoughts spiral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試前唔好胡思亂想，專心溫書就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 cin4 m4 hou2 wu4 si1 lyun6 soeng2, zyun1 sam1 wan1 syu1 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考試前不要胡思乱想，专心复习就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't overthink before the exam; just focus on studying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日胡思亂想，連細微嘅事都會擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 wu4 si1 lyun6 soeng2, lin4 sai3 mei4 ge3 si6 dou1 wui5 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是胡思乱想，连小事也会担心。
examples.english_sentence: He constantly overthinks and worries even about small things.

mandarin_meaning: 胡桃 (hútáo)：核桃（坚果），亦可指胡桃木
english_meaning: walnut (the nut of the walnut tree); can also refer to walnut wood
explanation_mandarin: 指胡桃树的果实，即核桃，常作为零食或烘焙材料；有时亦指由胡桃木制成的木材或制品。
explanation_english: Refers to the fruit of the walnut tree (walnut), commonly eaten as a snack or used in baking; can also mean walnut wood or items made from it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一袋胡桃，準備做餅乾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 doi6 wu4tou4, zeon2 bei6 zou6 beng2 gon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一袋胡桃，準備做餅乾。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a bag of walnuts to make cookies.

mandarin_meaning: 胡椒（通常指黑胡椒或胡椒粉）
english_meaning: pepper (the spice, e.g., black pepper or ground pepper)
explanation_mandarin: 指用作調味的胡椒植物果實或磨成的粉，常見於烹飪中用來增加辛辣風味。
explanation_english: The spice made from peppercorns (commonly black pepper) or its ground form, used in cooking to add a pungent, spicy flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以畀啲胡椒粉我？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 di1 wu4 ziu1 fan2 ngo5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以把胡椒粉給我嗎？
examples.english_sentence: Can you give me some pepper?

mandarin_meaning: 胡椒喷雾
english_meaning: pepper spray (a self-defense aerosol containing capsaicin/oleoresin capsicum)
explanation_mandarin: 一种含辣椒素（如辣椒素油树脂）的喷雾剂，用于自卫或驱散人群，会刺激眼睛和呼吸道。不同地区对携带和使用有法律限制，使用时要注意安全。
explanation_english: A spray containing capsaicin (oleoresin capsicum) used for self-defense or crowd control. It causes eye and respiratory irritation. Laws and restrictions on possession and use vary by jurisdiction; handle with caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗支胡椒噴霧放喺包度，以防萬一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 zi1 wu4 ziu1 pan3 mou6 fong3 hai2 baau1 dou6, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了胡椒喷雾，放在包里，以防万一。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a can of pepper spray and kept it in his bag just in case.

mandarin_meaning: 胡椒球 / 胡椒粒（整顆的胡椒，也可指裝有辣椒粉的彈丸，如執法或驅散用的 pepper‑ball）
english_meaning: pepper ball; peppercorn (literal whole pepper); pepper‑ball projectile (a small munition filled with pepper powder used for crowd control)
explanation_mandarin: 「胡椒球」可指整顆的胡椒（即胡椒粒、peppercorn），也可指一種彈丸（pepper‑ball），內含辣椒粉或刺激性化學物質，用於執法或驅散人群的非致命彈藥。具體意思要看語境。
explanation_english: “胡椒球” can mean a peppercorn (a whole pepper) or a pepper‑ball projectile — a small munition filled with powdered pepper/irritant used for crowd control. The intended meaning depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面有啲胡椒球，用嚟整湯好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 fong4 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 wu4 ziu1 kau4, jung6 lai4 zing2 tong1 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房里有一些胡椒球，用来煮汤很香。
examples.english_sentence: There are some peppercorns in the kitchen; they make the soup fragrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 示威期間警方發射胡椒球去驅散人群。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 wai1 kei4 gaan1 ging2 fong1 faat3 se6 wu4 ziu1 kau4 heoi3 keoi1 saan3 jan4 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 示威期间警方发射胡椒球驱散人群。
examples.english_sentence: During the protest, the police fired pepper balls to disperse the crowd.

mandarin_meaning: 胡椒粉（磨成的胡椒，用作調味）
english_meaning: pepper powder (ground pepper used as a seasoning)
explanation_mandarin: 指把胡椒磨成的細粉，常用於烹調中提味，可指黑胡椒粉或白胡椒粉等。
explanation_english: Refers to ground pepper used as a seasoning in cooking; can mean ground black pepper or white pepper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟魚加咗胡椒粉，味道好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 jyu4 gaa1 zo2 wu4 ziu1 fan2, mei6 dou6 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這道魚加了胡椒粉，味道很香。
examples.english_sentence: This fish has pepper on it and tastes/aromas great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面冇胡椒粉喇，我哋要買返包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4 fong4 jap6 min6 mou5 wu4 ziu1 fan2 laa3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 maai5 faan1 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房裡面沒有胡椒粉了，我們要買一包。
examples.english_sentence: There is no pepper powder left in the kitchen; we need to buy a pack.

mandarin_meaning: 胡混（敷衍、糊弄，混日子）
english_meaning: to muddle along; to mess around and slack off; to do something perfunctorily
explanation_mandarin: 指做事不認真、敷衍了事或隨便應付，有時帶有混日子或偷懶的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to doing things carelessly or perfunctorily, fooling around or slacking off; implies not taking responsibility or putting in effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡混，呢份報告要認真做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 wan6, ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 jing6 zan1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要胡混，這份報告要認真做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around; this report must be done properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔可以胡混，要準時交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 ho2 ji5 wu4 wan6, jiu3 zeon2 si4 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不能胡混，要準時交作業。
examples.english_sentence: I can't muddle through; I have to turn in my homework on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺公司胡混，做嘢好敷衍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 wu4 wan6, zou6 je5 hou2 fuk1 jin5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天在公司胡混，做事很敷衍。
examples.english_sentence: He spends his days slacking off at the company and does his work half-heartedly.

mandarin_meaning: 胡琴（húqín）是中國拉弦樂器的總稱，常指二胡、高胡、京胡等，以弓拉奏，通常有兩根弦。
english_meaning: Huqin — a family of Chinese bowed string instruments (e.g. erhu, gaohu, zhonghu), typically two-stringed and played with a bow.
explanation_mandarin: 胡琴泛指中國傳統的拉弦樂器家族，構造多為琴筒與兩根弦，用弓摩擦發音，常見於民樂、戲曲伴奏及獨奏。
explanation_english: Refers to a family of traditional Chinese bowed string instruments. Usually consists of a resonator body and two strings, played with a bow; used in folk ensembles, opera accompaniment, and solo performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺舞台上拉胡琴，聲音好感人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 mou5 toi4 soeng6 laai1 wu4 kam4, sing1 jam1 hou2 gam2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在舞台上拉胡琴，声音很感人。
examples.english_sentence: He played the huqin on stage; the sound was very moving.

mandarin_meaning: （形容）糊里糊塗、敷衍混日子、不認真
english_meaning: muddled/careless; muddling along or being perfunctory and not taking things seriously
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人做事敷衍、不認真或頭腦糊塗、漫不經心，帶有輕微貶義。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is careless, muddled, or perfunctory — someone who muddles through tasks or doesn't take things seriously. Slightly derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都胡胡混混，乜嘢都唔認真做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 wu4 wu4 wan6 wan6, me1 je5 dou1 m4 jing6 zan1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是胡胡混混，什么事情都不认真做。
examples.english_sentence: He's always muddled and careless; he doesn't take anything seriously.

mandarin_meaning: 胡萝卜
english_meaning: carrot
explanation_mandarin: 胡萝卜是一种根茎类蔬菜，通常为橙色或红橙色，富含β-胡萝卜素和维生素A，可生吃或用来烹调。
explanation_english: A root vegetable, typically orange in color, rich in beta-carotene and vitamin A. Carrots can be eaten raw or cooked and are commonly used in many dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日超市有特價，胡蘿蔔一袋兩蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ciu1 si5 jau5 dak6 gaa3, wu4 lo4 baak6 jat1 doi2 loeng5 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天超市特价，胡萝卜一袋两块钱。
examples.english_sentence: The supermarket has a special today — a bag of carrots for two dollars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢道菜落咗胡蘿蔔，味道甜咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 coi3 lok6 zo2 wu4 lo4 baak6, mei6 dou6 tim4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道菜加了胡萝卜，味道更甜了。
examples.english_sentence: This dish has carrots added and tastes sweeter.

mandarin_meaning: 胡萝卜素（類胡蘿蔔素，能作為維生素A的前體）
english_meaning: Carotene (a group of pigments, provitamin A; e.g., beta-carotene)
explanation_mandarin: 一類天然色素（類胡蘿蔔素），存在於紅蘿蔔等蔬果中，可轉化為維生素A，並具有抗氧化作用。
explanation_english: A group of natural pigments (carotenoids) found in carrots and other fruits/vegetables; can be converted to vitamin A and acts as an antioxidant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 紅蘿蔔含有豐富嘅胡蘿蔔素，有助視力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung4 lo4 baak6 ham4 jau5 fung1 fu3 ge3 wu4 lo4 baak6 sou3, jau5 zo6 si6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 胡萝卜含有丰富的胡萝卜素，有助于视力。
examples.english_sentence: Carrots contain abundant carotene, which helps eyesight.

mandarin_meaning: 糊里糊涂（糊裡糊塗），指糊塗、迷糊、沒有頭緒或做事馬虎
english_meaning: muddled; confused; muddle-headed; careless and not clear-headed
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人思路不清、糊塗或做事馬虎、不細心。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is confused, muddled, or careless — lacking clear thought or acting without attention to detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好胡裏胡塗，成日整錯嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 wu4 leoi5 wu4 tou4, seng4 jat6 zing2 co3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很糊里糊涂，常常做錯事。
examples.english_sentence: He's very muddle-headed at work and often makes mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 糊里糊涂；迷糊、糊涂
english_meaning: muddled; confused; muddle-headed; acting carelessly or without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 成語，用來形容頭腦不清楚、糊塗或做事隨便、不認真。
explanation_english: An idiomatic expression describing someone who is confused, muddle-headed, or acts carelessly and without clear thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡裡胡塗答應佢，要諗清楚先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 leoi5 wu4 tou4 daap3 jing3 keoi5, jiu3 nam2 cing1 co2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要糊里糊涂地答应他，要先想清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blindly promise him; think it through first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都胡裡胡塗，成件事搞到一團亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 wu4 leoi5 wu4 tou4, seng4 gin6 si6 gaau2 dou3 jat1 tyun4 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是糊里糊涂，把事情弄得一团糟。
examples.english_sentence: He's always muddled, making everything a mess.

mandarin_meaning: 糊裡糊塗（形容人糊塗、迷糊、沒有頭緒）
english_meaning: muddle-headed, confused, muddled or clueless
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人做事或思考時頭腦不清楚、糊塗或沒有條理，常指健忘或粗心。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is confused, muddled, or absent-minded — acting without clarity or order, often forgetful or careless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日胡裡胡塗，經常忘記帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sing4 jat6 wu4 leoi5 wu4 tou4, ging1 soeng4 mong4 gei3 daai3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事總是糊裡糊塗，經常忘記帶鑰匙。
examples.english_sentence: He always does things in a muddled way; he often forgets to bring his keys.

mandarin_meaning: 胡言乱语（说没有道理或胡说八道）
english_meaning: to talk nonsense; to babble; to speak wildly or make baseless remarks
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话没有道理、胡说或乱讲，常用于批评或驳斥别人的言论。
explanation_english: Describes speaking nonsense or making baseless remarks; commonly used to criticize or dismiss what someone is saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度胡言亂語，講啲冇根據嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 wu4 jin4 lyun6 jyu5, gong2 di1 mou5 gan1 geoi3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天在胡言乱语，说些没有根据的话。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps talking nonsense, saying things without any basis.

mandarin_meaning: 胡说（胡說）——说没有根据的话；胡乱说话
english_meaning: to talk nonsense; nonsense; to speak recklessly
explanation_mandarin: 用于表示某人说的话没有根据、荒唐或不可信，既可作动词（胡说），也可作感叹（“胡说！”）以否定对方的话。
explanation_english: Used to say someone is speaking without basis or is being ridiculous. It can be used as a verb (to talk nonsense) or as an interjection ("Nonsense!") to dismiss a remark.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡說，我根本冇偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 syut3, ngo5 gan1 bun2 mou5 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要胡说，我根本没偷东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense — I didn't steal anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嗰啲嘢全部都係胡說。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 go2 di1 je5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 wu4 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲的那些话全都是胡说。
examples.english_sentence: What he said is all nonsense.

mandarin_meaning: 胡说（說話荒唐、不合情理）
english_meaning: to talk nonsense; to speak absurdly; "nonsense!"
partOfSpeech_english: verb (can be used as an interjection)
explanation_mandarin: 表示說話不合邏輯、荒唐或不可信，常用來反駁別人的話。
explanation_english: Used to say that something spoken is illogical, absurd, or not believable; often used to rebut someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡說，呢件事唔係咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 syut3, ni1 gin6 si6 m4 hai6 gam2 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要胡说，这件事不是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense; this isn't how the matter is.

mandarin_meaning: 胡说八道（húshuō bādào），说话没有根据，胡乱讲话或胡扯。
english_meaning: to talk nonsense; to utter rubbish; to speak absurdly without basis.
explanation_mandarin: 表示說話毫無根據、胡亂編說或說荒唐的話，常用來批評別人說話不可靠或荒謬。
explanation_english: Indicates speaking without basis or fabricating things; used to criticize someone for talking nonsense or making absurd claims.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日胡說八道，唔好理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 wu4 syut3 baat3 dou6, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是胡说八道，别理他。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks nonsense; ignore him.

mandarin_meaning: 胡说八道（胡乱说话、没有根据地乱讲）
english_meaning: to talk nonsense; to speak rubbish; to spout absurd or unfounded remarks
explanation_mandarin: 表示随便或没有根据地乱说话、胡扯，经常用来责备或形容言论荒谬不可信。
explanation_english: A phrase used to describe speaking recklessly or without basis—saying nonsense. Often used to scold someone or to dismiss absurd or untrustworthy remarks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡說八道啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 syut3 baat3 dou6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要胡说八道！
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度胡說八道，冇人理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 wu4 syut3 baat3 dou6, mou5 jan4 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在那儿胡说八道，没人理他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always talking nonsense; nobody pays attention to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲都係胡說八道，唔好信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 dou1 hai6 wu4 syut3 baat3 dou6, m4 hou2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些都是胡说八道，不要相信。
examples.english_sentence: Those are all nonsense; don't believe them.

mandarin_meaning: 胡说 (húshuō)：乱说、没有根据地说话（可作动词或感叹词）
english_meaning: to talk nonsense; to speak rubbish; (interjection) 'nonsense!'
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示某人說話沒有根據、荒唐或不可信，常用來反駁或表達不滿/懷疑。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that someone is speaking without basis or is talking rubbish; often used to rebut or express disbelief/annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡說啦，我冇偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 syut3 laa1, ngo5 mou5 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別胡說，我沒偷東西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense — I didn't steal anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己係老闆，係咪胡說八道？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 lou5 baan2, hai6 mai6 wu4 syut3 baat3 dou6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說自己是老闆，難道是在胡說八道嗎？
examples.english_sentence: He says he's the boss — is he just talking nonsense?

mandarin_meaning: 胡说八道（说没有根据或荒唐的话）
english_meaning: to talk nonsense; to speak rubbish or absurdities
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容说话没有根据、荒唐或随便编造，常用于责备或否定对方的言论。
explanation_english: Used to describe speaking without basis or making up absurdities; often used to rebuke or dismiss someone's statements as nonsense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡説八道，講啲有根據嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 syut3 baat3 dou6, gong2 di1 jau5 gan1 geoi3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别胡说八道，讲些有根据的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk nonsense; say something with evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日胡説八道，冇人理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 wu4 syut3 baat3 dou6, mou5 jan4 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是胡说八道，没人理他。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks rubbish, and no one pays attention to him.

mandarin_meaning: 糊里糊涂
english_meaning: muddled; confused; bewildered
explanation_mandarin: 形容頭腦不清楚、混亂或糊塗，常用來形容人或情況迷惘、不明白。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is confused, muddled, or bewildered; indicates lack of clarity in thought or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好似有啲胡里胡塗，連鑰匙放咗喺邊都唔記得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 wu4 lei5 wu4 tou4, lin4 joek6 si4 fong3 zo2 hai2 bin1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天好像有點糊里糊涂，連鑰匙放在哪兒都忘了。
examples.english_sentence: He seems a bit muddled today; he even forgot where he put his keys.

mandarin_meaning: 胡闹（húnào）：胡乱捣乱、闹事、无理取闹
english_meaning: to mess around; to make a fuss; to act up or cause trouble
explanation_mandarin: 表示胡亂搗蛋、鬧事或不嚴肅、不負責任的行為，常用來責備別人不要亂來或制造麻煩。
explanation_english: Indicates behaving foolishly or causing a disturbance—acting irresponsibly, making a scene, or messing around. Often used to scold someone for fooling around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好胡鬧啦，等我講完先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wu4 naau6 laa1, dang2 ngo5 gong2 jyun4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要胡闹，等我讲完再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around—wait until I've finished speaking.

mandarin_meaning: 胥：古代指小吏、差役；亦為姓氏；在古文中有“皆、都”之意。
english_meaning: A minor official or clerk in ancient times; also a surname; archaically can mean 'all' or 'together'.
explanation_mandarin: “胥”原指古代的差役或小吏，常見於古書或歷史文獻；同時可作為姓氏。在古文中也有“皆、都”的用法，但現代漢語中較少單獨使用。
explanation_english: Originally referred to low-ranking officials or clerks in ancient China; appears in historical texts and can also be a surname. In classical usage it could mean 'all' or 'together'. It is infrequently used alone in modern speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺古裝劇入面演一個胥吏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gu2 zong1 guk6 jap6 min6 jin2 jat1 go3 syu1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在古装剧里演一个胥吏（小官吏）。
examples.english_sentence: He plays a minor official (a low-ranking clerk) in a costume drama.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 胥先生今日嚟到公司開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 sin1 saang1 gam1 jat6 lai4 dou3 gung1 si1 hoi1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 胥先生今天到公司开会。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Xu came to the company for a meeting today.

mandarin_meaning: 胭脂（化妝用的腮紅、胭脂粉）
english_meaning: rouge; blush (cosmetic)
explanation_mandarin: 常見於複合詞如「胭脂」，指用於面部的化妝品腮紅或胭脂粉。廣東話中多以「胭脂」一詞出現。
explanation_english: Frequently appears in compounds such as "胭脂"; refers to rouge or blush used as a facial cosmetic. In Cantonese it is commonly used in the word for blush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個面搽咗好多胭脂，睇落好有精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 min6 caat3 zo2 hou2 do1 jin1 zi1, tai2 lok6 hou2 jau5 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她擦了很多胭脂，看起來很有精神。
examples.english_sentence: She put on a lot of rouge; she looks very lively.

mandarin_meaning: 胭脂 (yānzhī)：用於臉部的紅色或粉色化妝品（如腮紅或胭脂膏），也可泛指化妝品
english_meaning: rouge; blush (a red or pink cosmetic used on the cheeks); cosmetics (generally)
explanation_mandarin: 胭脂通常指塗抹在臉頰上的紅色或粉色粉末或膏狀化妝品，用來使臉色看起來紅潤或有氣色；有時也泛指化妝品本身。
explanation_english: Refers to rouge or blush — a red or pink powder or cream cosmetic applied to the cheeks to give color; can also be used more generally to mean cosmetics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日搽咗咩胭脂呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 caat3 zo2 me1 jin1 zi1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天擦了什麼胭脂？
examples.english_sentence: What blush are you wearing today?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢化咗濃妝，塊面有好重嘅胭脂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa3 zo2 nung4 zong1, faai3 min6 jau5 hou2 zung6 ge3 jin1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她化了濃妝，臉上用了很多胭脂。
examples.english_sentence: She wore heavy makeup and had a lot of rouge on her face.

mandarin_meaning: 胭脂红 (yānzhī hóng)，接近胭脂（化妆用腮红/口红）的红色，偏粉红或鲜红
english_meaning: rouge red; a bright reddish-pink color (like cosmetic rouge or lipstick)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种像胭脂（化妆品）顏色的红色，常用來描述衣物、妝容或物件的色調。
explanation_english: Refers to a red color resembling cosmetic rouge—often a pinkish to bright red—used to describe clothing, makeup, or objects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰件裙係胭脂紅，好襯你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gin6 kwan4 hai6 jin1 zi1 hung4, hou2 can3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件裙子是胭脂红，很衬你。
examples.english_sentence: That dress is rouge red; it really suits you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢化咗胭脂紅嘅唇妝，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faa3 zo2 jin1 zi1 hung4 ge3 seon4 zong1, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她化了胭脂红的唇妆，很抢眼。
examples.english_sentence: She wore rouge-red lip makeup; it's very eye-catching.

mandarin_meaning: 嬌氣、矯揉造作的人（通常指女性）
english_meaning: a pampered/dainty person (usually a woman); someone overly delicate or unable to endure hardship
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，用來形容人（通常指女性）過分嬌氣、怕吃苦、只注重外表或不願做粗重工作。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang used to describe someone (typically a woman) who is excessively delicate or pampered, unwilling to do hard work, and overly concerned with appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好胭脂腳，連搬嘢都唔想做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jin1 zi1 goek3, lin4 bun1 je5 dou1 m4 soeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很嬌氣，連搬東西都不想做。
examples.english_sentence: She's very pampered/dainty; she won't even help move things.

mandarin_meaning: （廣東話俚語）指化妝濃艷、只注重外表的女子（帶貶義）
english_meaning: Cantonese slang (derogatory): a woman who wears heavy makeup and is superficial / valued mainly for her looks
explanation_mandarin: 「胭脂馬」是廣東話的俗語或俚語，字面上含有「胭脂（化妝）」的意思，通常用來形容一個人（多指女性）打扮濃艷、重外表而輕內在，帶有貶義或戲謔意味。使用時要注意語境與禮貌。
explanation_english: "胭脂馬" is Cantonese slang combining 胭脂 (rouge/makeup) and 馬; it typically describes someone (usually a woman) who wears heavy makeup and is superficial — valued mainly for appearance. It is derogatory or teasing in tone and should be used with caution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係睇佢外表，佢唔係嗰種胭脂馬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tai2 keoi5 ngoi6 biu2, keoi5 m4 hai6 go2 zung2 jin1 zi1 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只看她的外表，她不是那種只靠美貌的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't judge her by her looks; she's not that kind of superficial, heavily-made-up person.

mandarin_meaning: 胯；胯部，髋部（大腿与躯干连接处）
english_meaning: hip; groin; the area where the thigh joins the torso
explanation_mandarin: 指人體大腿與軀幹相連的部位，常指胯部或胯下一帶，與髖（髋）部相近。
explanation_english: Refers to the part of the body where the thigh connects to the torso — the hip/groin area (similar to 'hip' or 'crotch').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日跑步跑到胯位好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 paau2 bou6 paau2 dou3 kwaa3 wai6 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天跑步把胯部弄疼了。
examples.english_sentence: I ran today and hurt my hip/groin; it hurts a lot.

mandarin_meaning: 胰（胰腺、胰臟）
english_meaning: pancreas
explanation_mandarin: 表示胰腺或胰臟，屬於內分泌與消化系統的器官，常與「胰臟」、「胰島素」、「胰液」等詞搭配使用。
explanation_english: Refers to the pancreas, an organ of the endocrine and digestive systems. Commonly appears in compounds such as 'pancreas', 'insulin', and 'pancreatic juice'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅胰臟出問題，醫生話要做進一步檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ji4 zong6 ceot1 man6 tai4, ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 zou6 zeon3 jat1 bou6 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的胰臟出問題，醫生說要做進一步檢查。
examples.english_sentence: His pancreas has a problem; the doctor said further tests are needed.

mandarin_meaning: 胰島素 (yídǎosù)
english_meaning: insulin
explanation_mandarin: 由胰腺β細胞分泌的激素，主要功能是降低血糖並促進葡萄糖進入細胞，常用於糖尿病的治療。
explanation_english: A hormone secreted by pancreatic beta cells that lowers blood glucose and helps cells take up glucose; commonly used as a treatment for diabetes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 糖尿病病人要每日注射胰島素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tong4 niu6 beng6 beng6 jan4 jiu3 mui5 jat6 zyu3 se6 ji4 dou2 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 糖尿病患者要每天注射胰島素。
examples.english_sentence: Diabetic patients need to inject insulin every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 胰島素可以調節血糖水平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 dou2 sou3 ho2 ji5 tiu4 zit3 hyut3 tong4 seoi2 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 胰島素可以調節血糖水平。
examples.english_sentence: Insulin can regulate blood glucose levels.

mandarin_meaning: 胰臟（胰脏），位於腹部的一種消化與內分泌器官，負責分泌消化酶與胰島素等。
english_meaning: Pancreas — an abdominal organ involved in digestion and endocrine function; secretes digestive enzymes and insulin.
explanation_mandarin: 胰臟是人體的一個重要器官，既有外分泌功能（分泌消化酶），也有內分泌功能（分泌胰島素等荷爾蒙）。
explanation_english: The pancreas is an important organ that has both exocrine functions (secreting digestive enzymes) and endocrine functions (secreting hormones like insulin).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我爸爸嘅胰臟有問題，要做進一步檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 baa4 baa1 ge3 ji4 zong6 jau5 man6 tai4, jiu3 zou6 zeon3 jat1 bou6 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我爸爸的胰脏有问题，要做进一步检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said my father's pancreas has a problem and needs further examination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 胰臟發炎可以好痛，可能要即刻住院治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 zong6 faat3 jim4 ho2 ji5 hou2 tung3, ho2 nang4 jiu3 zik1 hak1 zyu6 jyun6 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 胰脏发炎会很痛，可能要立刻住院治疗。
examples.english_sentence: Pancreatitis can be very painful and may require immediate hospitalization for treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 膀胱（儲存尿液的器官）
english_meaning: urinary bladder
explanation_mandarin: 指儲存尿液的器官，即膀胱；常見於醫學用語或與其他字組合（如「膀胱」）。
explanation_english: Refers to the urinary bladder — the organ that stores urine. Commonly appears in medical terms or compounds (e.g., "膀胱").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢嘅膀胱有問題，要做檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 ge3 pong4 gwong1 jau5 man6 tai4, jiu3 zou6 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他的膀胱有问题，要做检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his bladder has a problem and he needs to have an examination.

mandarin_meaning: 胳（用于“胳膊”等词），指上肢的部分
english_meaning: arm (as in compounds like '胳膊')
explanation_mandarin: 表示上肢的一部分，常见于复合词如“胳膊”“胳肢窝”。单独使用时多作为构词成分。
explanation_english: Refers to the upper limb (arm); commonly appears in compounds such as '胳膊' (arm) and '胳肢窩' (armpit). Rarely used alone except as a morpheme.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你隻胳膊傷咗未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zek3 gok3 bok3 soeng1 zo2 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的胳膊受伤了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is your arm injured?

mandarin_meaning: 腋下；胳肢窩
english_meaning: armpit; underarm
explanation_mandarin: 指手臂與身體之間的凹陷部位，即腋下，日常用語，用於描述身體位置或個人衛生相關情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the hollow area between the arm and the torso, i.e. the armpit/underarm. Common everyday term used to describe body location or personal hygiene issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我胳肋底痕，點算？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 lap6 dai2 han4, dim2 syun3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的腋下癢，怎麼辦？
examples.english_sentence: My armpit is itchy. What should I do?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要教小朋友點樣洗胳肋底，免得有異味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaau3 siu2 pang4 jau5 dim2 joeng6 sai2 gok3 lap6 dai2, min5 dak1 jau5 ji6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要教小朋友怎麼清洗腋下，以免有異味。
examples.english_sentence: Teach children how to clean their armpits to avoid odors.

mandarin_meaning: 胳膊（手臂）
english_meaning: arm (the limb from shoulder to wrist)
explanation_mandarin: 指人的手臂，從肩膀到手腕的部分，也可用於描述動物的前肢（口語用詞）。
explanation_english: Refers to the arm, the limb between the shoulder and the wrist. Common everyday word for human arm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻胳膊受咗傷，要去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 gok3 bok3 sau6 zo2 soeng1, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 saang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的胳膊受伤了，要去看医生。
examples.english_sentence: His arm is injured; he needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 躯干；躯体（多用于书面或医学用语）
english_meaning: trunk; torso; body (usually the trunk of a body, used in formal/medical contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 「胴」指人的身躯的躯干部分，常见于复合词如「胴体」、用于书面或医学语境，强调躯干而非整体日常说法的「身体」。
explanation_english: The character refers to the trunk or torso of a body. It appears in compounds like "胴體" and is used more in written or medical contexts to denote the trunk rather than the colloquial "body."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生檢查咗佢嘅胴體，發現冇受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gim2 caa4 zo2 keoi5 ge3 dung6 tai2, faat3 jin4 mou5 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生检查了他的胴体，发现没有受伤。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor examined his torso and found no injuries.

mandarin_meaning: 軀幹；身體（尤指軀幹）
english_meaning: torso; trunk (the body excluding head and limbs); body
explanation_mandarin: 指人體的軀幹部分（不包括頭部與四肢），多用於醫學或正式語境，有時也泛指身體本身。
explanation_english: Refers to the torso or trunk of the human body (excluding head and limbs). Commonly used in medical or formal contexts; can also broadly mean the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢嘅胴體冇大礙，只係有幾處擦傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 ge3 dung6 tai2 mou5 daai6 ngai6, zi2 hai6 jau5 gei2 co3 caat3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說他的軀幹沒有大礙，只是有幾處擦傷。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his torso isn't seriously injured, just a few abrasions.

mandarin_meaning: 胝（皮肤因摩擦或压迫形成的硬厚处，俗称茧）
english_meaning: callus (hardened thickened skin formed by friction or pressure)
explanation_mandarin: 本字較罕見，常作「胝」的別寫，用以指代手腳等處因長期摩擦或壓力而形成的硬厚皮層（俗稱茧或老繭）。
explanation_english: A rare character, often used as a variant of 胝. It denotes a callus — a hardened, thickened area of skin caused by repeated friction or pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢隻腳底起咗個胵，行路好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 goek3 dai2 hei2 zo2 go3 zi1, haang4 lou6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的脚底长了一个胝，走路很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has developed a callus on the sole of the foot, making walking painful.

mandarin_meaning: 胸；胸部；胸膛（指人體的胸部，有時也指胸懷、胸襟）
english_meaning: chest; breast; bosom (also figuratively: mind/heart, e.g. magnanimity)
explanation_mandarin: 指人體前部包裹心肺的部位（如胸部、胸口、胸膛），也可用於抽象意義表示胸懷或氣量（如胸襟）。
explanation_english: Refers to the front part of the body enclosing the heart and lungs (chest, breast, bosom). Can also be used figuratively to mean one's mind or magnanimity (e.g., '胸襟').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日胸口好痛，要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hung1 hau2 hou2 tung3, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天胸口很痛，要看医生。
examples.english_sentence: My chest hurts a lot today; I need to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係新手媽媽，餵奶時要保護好胸部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 san1 sau2 maa4 maa1, wai3 naai5 si4 jiu3 bou2 wu6 hou2 hung1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是新手媽媽，哺乳時要保護好胸部。
examples.english_sentence: She's a new mother; she should protect her breasts while breastfeeding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有胸襟，唔會記仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 hung1 gam1, m4 wui5 gei3 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有胸襟，不會記仇。
examples.english_sentence: He is very magnanimous and doesn't hold grudges.

mandarin_meaning: 胸口（胸膛、胸前）；也可指內心、心裡的感受或疼痛
english_meaning: chest (front part of the torso); figuratively, one's heart or inner feelings; chest pain
explanation_mandarin: 指人體胸部前側的部位（胸膛、心口），在口語中也常用來比喻內心的感受或情緒（例如胸口悶、胸口痛）。
explanation_english: Refers to the front part of the torso (the chest). In colloquial usage it can also figuratively denote one's inner feelings or emotions (e.g. feeling a tightness or pain in the chest).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我胸口好痛，可能要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hung1 hau2 hou2 tung3, ho2 nang4 jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我胸口很痛，可能要看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: My chest hurts a lot; I might need to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢咁講，我胸口好悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 hung1 hau2 hou2 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到他那樣說，我胸口很悶。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say that made me feel heavy in my chest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣，我胸口好緊張，手都震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 go2 zan6, ngo5 hung1 hau2 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, sau2 dou1 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試的時候，我胸口很緊張，手都在抖。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview my chest felt tight with anxiety and my hands were trembling.

mandarin_meaning: 胸围（指胸部的周长，用于表示胸罩尺码）
english_meaning: bust/chest circumference; bra size
explanation_mandarin: 指胸部一圈的周長，常用來表示胸罩或衣服的尺碼。
explanation_english: The circumference of the chest or bust, commonly used to indicate bra size or garment sizing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請問你嘅胸圍係幾多？
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 man6 nei5 ge3 hung1 wai4 hai6 gei2 do1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问你的胸围是多少？
examples.english_sentence: May I ask what your bust measurement is?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間內衣店有好多唔同嘅胸圍尺碼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 noi6 ji1 dim3 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 hung1 wai4 cek3 maa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家内衣店有很多不同的胸围尺码。
examples.english_sentence: This lingerie store has many different bust sizes.

mandarin_meaning: 胸垫（放在胸罩或衣物內，用來支撐、塑形或增加胸部容量的墊片）
english_meaning: bra pad; chest pad (a pad placed inside a bra or clothing to support, shape, or add volume to the breasts)
explanation_mandarin: 胸墊是放在胸罩或衣服內的墊片，用來支撐、塑形或增加胸部的飽滿度與舒適性，常見於內衣、泳衣等，有可拆卸與固定式兩種。
explanation_english: A pad inserted into a bra or clothing to support, shape, or add volume to the breasts. Commonly found in bras and swimsuits; can be removable or sewn in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一對新胸墊，著衫好睇啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 deoi3 san1 hung1 din6, zoek3 saam1 hou2 tai2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買了一對新的胸墊，穿衣服好看一些。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new pair of bra pads — my clothes look better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 泳衣有冇胸墊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wing6 ji1 jau5 mou5 hung1 din6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 泳衣有沒有胸墊？
examples.english_sentence: Does the swimsuit have bra pads?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款內衣嘅胸墊係可拆式，洗嘢好方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fun2 noi6 ji1 ge3 hung1 din6 hai6 ho2 caak3 sik1, sai2 je5 hou2 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這款內衣的胸墊是可拆卸的，洗衣服很方便。
examples.english_sentence: The bra pads in this underwear are removable, so it's convenient for washing.

mandarin_meaning: 胸怀 (xiōnghuái) — 胸膛或心胸；比喻人的气量、志向或怀抱
english_meaning: chest; the heart or mind; figuratively, one's mindset, breadth of mind, ambitions, or what one harbors in heart
explanation_mandarin: 可指实体的胸膛，也常用作比喻，表示一個人的氣量、胸襟或懷抱（例如懷抱理想或抱負）。
explanation_english: Can refer to the physical chest but is commonly used figuratively to describe someone's breadth of mind, disposition, or what they harbor (e.g., ambitions or feelings).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢胸懷廣闊，唔會為細微嘢記仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung1 waai4 gwong2 fut3, m4 wui5 wai6 sai3 mei4 je5 gei3 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他胸襟宽广，不会为小事记仇。
examples.english_sentence: He has a broad mind and doesn't hold grudges over small matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢胸懷大志，希望改變世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung1 waai4 daai6 zi3, hei1 mong6 goi2 bin3 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他胸怀大志，希望改变世界。
examples.english_sentence: He harbors great ambitions and hopes to change the world.

mandarin_meaning: 胸怀大志（xiōng huái dà zhì）：怀有远大抱负
english_meaning: to harbor great ambitions; to have lofty aspirations
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人有遠大的志向和抱負，立志做成大事。
explanation_english: Describes a person who has great ambitions and lofty goals; determined to achieve significant accomplishments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢胸懷大志，打算創立自己嘅公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung1 waai4 daai6 zi3, daa2 syun3 cong3 laap6 zi6 ge3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他胸怀大志，打算创立自己的公司。
examples.english_sentence: He harbors great ambitions and plans to start his own company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然起步難，但只要胸懷大志，就唔怕挫折。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 hei2 bou6 naan4, daan6 zi2 jiu3 hung1 waai4 daai6 zi3, zau6 m4 paa3 co3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然起步难，但只要胸怀大志，就不怕挫折。
examples.english_sentence: Although it's hard to get started, if you have great ambitions you're not afraid of setbacks.

mandarin_meaning: 胸有成竹（成語），比喻心中已有周詳的計劃或把握
english_meaning: An idiom meaning to have a well-thought-out plan or full confidence; to be well-prepared
explanation_mandarin: 成語，原指胸中已有完整的竹子構圖，比喻做事之前已有周詳的打算或把握，處事沉著、不慌張。
explanation_english: An idiom literally meaning 'to have a complete bamboo in one's chest' — figuratively, it means to have a clear, well-prepared plan or confidence about the outcome; to act with assurance and calm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會之前，佢已經想好每一步，顯得胸有成竹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 zi1 cin4, keoi5 ji5 ging1 soeng2 hou2 mui5 jat1 bou6, hin2 dak1 hung1 jau5 sing4 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 開會之前，他已經想好每一步，看起來胸有成竹。
examples.english_sentence: Before the meeting, he had already planned every step and seemed to have a well-thought-out plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣，面試官見佢答得好有條理，覺得佢胸有成竹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si3 go2 zan6, min6 si3 gun1 gin3 keoi5 daap3 dak1 hou2 jau5 tiu4 lei5, gok3 dak1 keoi5 hung1 jau5 sing4 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試時，面試官看到他回答得很有條理，覺得他胸有成竹。
examples.english_sentence: At the interview, the interviewer saw that he answered very systematically and thought he was well-prepared.

mandarin_meaning: 胸罩 / 文胸 (xiōngzhào / wénxiōng)
english_meaning: bra; brassiere
explanation_mandarin: 支撐並覆蓋女性胸部的內衣，一般稱為胸罩或文胸，用以提供支撐與塑形。
explanation_english: An undergarment worn by women to support and cover the breasts; commonly called a bra or brassiere, providing support and shaping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日買咗個新胸罩，好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 hung1 zaau3, hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天買了個新胸罩，很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: She bought a new bra today; it's very comfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 胸肌（胸部的肌肉，通常指胸大肌等）

explanation_mandarin: 指胸部的肌肉群，常在健身、解剖或描述體型時使用，尤其指胸大肌等主要肌肉。
explanation_english: Refers to the muscles of the chest (especially the pectoralis muscles); commonly used in contexts of fitness, anatomy, or describing body appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近喺健身室專心練胸肌，胸肌已經好明顯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 gin6 san1 sat1 zyun1 sam1 lin6 hung1 gei1, hung1 gei1 ji5 ging1 hou2 ming4 hin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近在健身房专心练胸肌，胸肌已经很明显。
examples.english_sentence: He's been focusing on training his chest muscles at the gym recently; his pectorals are already very noticeable.

mandarin_meaning: 胸腔（xiōngqiāng）
english_meaning: thoracic cavity; chest cavity
explanation_mandarin: 指胸部內部的一個腔隙，包裹心臟、肺臟等器官，由肋骨、胸骨和膈肌等構成。
explanation_english: The anatomical cavity of the chest that houses organs such as the heart and lungs, bounded by the ribs, sternum, and diaphragm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢嘅胸腔入面有積水，要抽出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 ge3 hung1 hong1 jap6 min6 jau5 zik1 seoi2, jiu3 cau1 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說他的胸腔裡面有積水，需要抽出來。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said there is fluid in his chest cavity and it needs to be drained.
