examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 hung1 hong1 sau2 seot6 tung1 soeng4 seoi1 jiu3 cyun4 san1 maa4 zeoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做胸腔手術通常需要全身麻醉。
examples.english_sentence: Thoracic surgery usually requires general anesthesia.

mandarin_meaning: 胸膛 (xiōngtáng)：胸部前方的部位，包含胸腔、肺和心臟周圍的區域。
english_meaning: Chest; the front part of the torso that contains the chest cavity, lungs, and heart area.
explanation_mandarin: 指人體胸部前面的部分，包含胸腔、肺部和心臟附近的區域；也可指胸口一帶的肌肉或感覺。
explanation_english: Refers to the front part of the human torso — the chest area containing the chest cavity, lungs, and heart; can also denote the chest region or sensations in the chest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人打咗一拳，胸膛好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 daa2 zo2 jat1 kyun4, hung1 tong4 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人打了一拳，胸膛很痛。
examples.english_sentence: He got punched and his chest hurts a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑完步，我個胸膛覺得好悶，喘唔過氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 jyun4 bou6, ngo5 go3 hung1 tong4 gok3 dak1 hou2 mun6, cyun2 m4 gwo3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑完步後，我的胸膛感到悶，喘不過氣。
examples.english_sentence: After running, my chest felt tight and I couldn't catch my breath.

mandarin_meaning: 胸襟（xiōngjīn）：指心胸、氣度、包容力
english_meaning: broad-mindedness; a person's breadth of mind or tolerance
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人的胸懷和氣量，表示能否包容別人或處理是非得失，常用來形容心胸寬廣或狹窄。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's mental breadth or tolerance—how generous, open, or accommodating someone is; used to describe whether someone is broad-minded or narrow-minded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢胸襟好闊，唔會為小事計較。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung1 gam1 hou2 fut3, m4 wui5 wai6 siu2 si6 gai3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的胸襟很宽广，不会为小事计较。
examples.english_sentence: He is broad-minded and doesn't fuss over trivial matters.

mandarin_meaning: 猥褻性觸摸胸部；性騷擾（對他人胸部進行不當觸碰）
english_meaning: to grope someone's chest/breasts; groping (a form of sexual molestation or harassment)
explanation_mandarin: 指以不當或猥褻的方式觸摸他人的胸部，常用於描述在公共場所發生的性騷擾或猥褻行為。
explanation_english: Refers to touching someone's chest/breasts in an indecent or non-consensual way; commonly used to describe groping or sexual harassment in public settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺地鐵度胸襲咗個女仔，已經畀人報警。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dei6tit3 dou6 hung1 zaap6 zo2 go3 neoi5 zai2, ji5 ging1 bei2 jan4 bou3 ging2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在地鐵上對一名女孩子進行了胸襲，已被報警處理。
examples.english_sentence: He groped a girl on the subway and has been reported to the police.

mandarin_meaning: 胸部／胸膛（也可指女性的乳房）
english_meaning: chest; (also) breasts
explanation_mandarin: 指人或動物的胸部位置，包含肋骨、心臟、肺等結構；在日常語境下亦可用來指女性的乳房。
explanation_english: Refers to the chest area of a person or animal (including ribs, heart, lungs); in everyday usage it can also refer to a woman's breasts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢胸部痛，要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung1 bou6 tung3, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她胸部疼，要看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: His/her chest hurts; (he/she) needs to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫太緊，壓住我個胸部，好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 taai3 gan2, aat3 zyu6 ngo5 go3 hung1 bou6, hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服太緊，壓到我的胸部，很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is too tight and is pressing on my chest; it's very uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去做乳房檢查，確定冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zou6 jyu5 fong4 gim2 caa4, kok3 ding6 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她去做乳房檢查，確定沒有問題。
examples.english_sentence: She went for a breast check-up to make sure there are no problems.

mandarin_meaning: 胸骨（xiōnggǔ）
english_meaning: sternum; breastbone
explanation_mandarin: 位於胸前中央的一塊扁平骨，連接肋骨並保護心臟和肺臟的前側。
explanation_english: A flat bone in the center front of the chest that connects the ribs and helps protect the heart and lungs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我胸骨撞親，要照X光檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 hung1 gwat1 zong6 can1, jiu3 ziu3 X gwong1 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的胸骨被撞到了，需要照X光检查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said my sternum was hit and I need to get an X-ray.

mandarin_meaning: 胺（àn）— 有机化学中指含氮的有机化合物（胺类），也用作表示胺的后缀（如胺基、胺类）。
english_meaning: Amine — an organic compound containing nitrogen (amine group); also used as the suffix '-amine'.
explanation_mandarin: 化學術語，指含有氮原子的有機化合物（例如胺類），常見於有機合成、生物化學與藥物化學相關詞彙中。
explanation_english: A chemical term referring to organic compounds that contain nitrogen (amines). Commonly used in organic synthesis, biochemistry, and pharmaceutical contexts; also appears as a suffix indicating an amine group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 實驗中我哋檢測到一種胺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat6 jim6 zung1 ngo5 dei6 gim2 cak1 dou3 jat1 zung2 am3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在實驗中我們檢測到一種胺。
examples.english_sentence: In the experiment we detected an amine.

mandarin_meaning: 氨基酸（ānjīsuān）：蛋白質的基本組成單位
english_meaning: amino acid
explanation_mandarin: 胺基酸是構成蛋白質的基本組成單位。按人體能否自行合成，可分為必需胺基酸與非必需胺基酸；某些胺基酸對生長、修復組織與代謝非常重要。
explanation_english: Amino acids are the basic building blocks of proteins. They can be classified as essential or non-essential depending on whether the human body can synthesize them. Certain amino acids are crucial for growth, tissue repair, and metabolism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 胺基酸係構成蛋白質嘅基本單位。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 氨基酸是構成蛋白質的基本單位。
examples.english_sentence: Amino acids are the basic building blocks of proteins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲胺基酸人體無得自己合成，叫做必需胺基酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 am3 gei1 syun1 jan4 tai2 mou5 dak1 zi6 gei2 hap6 sing4, giu3 zou6 bit1 seoi1 am3 gei1 syun1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些胺基酸人體無法自行合成，稱為必需胺基酸。
examples.english_sentence: Some amino acids cannot be synthesized by the human body and are called essential amino acids.

mandarin_meaning: 能（néng）：能够；有能力；可以
english_meaning: can; to be able to; ability
explanation_mandarin: 表示有能力或可能性，也可指能力或才能。口語中常與「能夠」、「未能」等搭配，書面語較常見。
explanation_english: Indicates ability or possibility (to be able to). It can also refer to one's capacity or talent. Commonly used with words like '能夠' or 'unable'; more frequent in written/formal contexts than in casual speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢能夠一個人應付晒所有工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nang4 gau3 jat1 go3 jan4 jing3 fu6 saai3 so2 jau5 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他能夠一個人應付所有工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is able to handle all the work by himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 只要努力，你就能成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 jiu3 nou5 lik6, nei5 zau6 nang4 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 只要努力，你就能成功。
examples.english_sentence: If you work hard, you can succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現時我未能回覆你嘅電郵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 si4 ngo5 mei6 nang4 wui4 fuk1 nei5 ge3 din6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 目前我未能回覆你的電郵。
examples.english_sentence: At the moment I am unable to reply to your email.

mandarin_meaning: 能做一般人做不到的事
english_meaning: able to do what others cannot; accomplish what others find impossible
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人能做到一般人辦不到的事情，常用來稱讚其才能或本領。
explanation_english: Describes someone who can do what ordinary people cannot; often used to praise a person's ability or skill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係能人所不能，喺短時間內完成晒成個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 nang4 jan4 so2 bat1 nang4, hai2 dyun2 si4 gaan3 noi6 jyun4 sing4 saai3 sing4 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的是能人所不能，在短时间内完成了整个项目。
examples.english_sentence: He really could do what others couldn't — he completed the entire project in a short time.

mandarin_meaning: 能力 (nénglì)
english_meaning: ability; capability; competence; capacity
explanation_mandarin: 表示個人具備完成某事或履行某項職責的能力或技能，既可指先天素質，也可指後天習得的本領。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's capacity to perform a task or fulfill a role—can mean natural aptitude or acquired skills and competence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅工作能力好強，老細好依賴佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3 nang4 lik6 hou2 koeng4, lou5 sai3 hou2 ji1 laai6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作能力很强，老板很依赖他。
examples.english_sentence: His work ability is very strong; the boss relies on him a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工需要語言能力同溝通技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 seoi1 jiu3 jyu5 jin4 nang4 lik6 tung4 kau1 tung1 gei6 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作需要语言能力和沟通技巧。
examples.english_sentence: This job requires language ability and communication skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多啲實踐可以幫助你發展能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 di1 sat6 zin3 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 nei5 faat3 zin2 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多些实践可以帮助你发展能力。
examples.english_sentence: More practice can help you develop your abilities.

mandarin_meaning: 能力值（通常指數值化的能力或屬性，常見於遊戲，也可口語化指能力程度）
english_meaning: ability value / ability score / stat (a numeric measure of ability or attributes; common in games, also used colloquially for competence)
explanation_mandarin: 「能力值」原本多用於遊戲或角色扮演中，指角色各項能力的數值化指標；在日常口語裡，也可用來比喻一個人的能力或實力高低。
explanation_english: Originally used in games/RPGs to denote a character's numeric attribute or stat; colloquially it can refer to a person's level of ability or competence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺遊戲入面，你應該提升你個角色嘅能力值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6, nei5 jing1 goi1 tai1 sing1 nei5 go3 gok3 sik1 ge3 nang4-lik6-zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在遊戲裡，你應該提升你角色的能力值。
examples.english_sentence: In the game, you should increase your character's ability stats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嘅時候，佢嘅能力值表現得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 ge3 nang4-lik6-zi6 biu2 jin6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面試的時候，他的能力值表現得很好。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview, his ability (score) performed very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅能力值未夠，做唔到咁快完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 nang4-lik6-zi6 mei6 gau3, zou6 m4 dou2 gam2 faai3 jyun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的能力值不夠，做不到那麼快完成。
examples.english_sentence: Your ability score isn't enough; you can't finish that quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 能否
english_meaning: whether (something can be done); can or cannot
explanation_mandarin: 用于询问是否能够或是否可以做某事，语气较正式，常见于书面或正式场合。
explanation_english: Used to ask whether something is possible or permitted; a relatively formal expression often used in writing or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你能否幫我睇一睇呢份報告？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nang4 fau2 bong1 ngo5 tai2 jat1 tai2 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能否帮我看一看这份报告？
examples.english_sentence: Could you take a look at this report for me?

mandarin_meaning: 能够（有能力或有可能做某事）
english_meaning: to be able to; can; capable of
explanation_mandarin: 表示具有做某事的能力或可能性，常用來說明可以做到某事。
explanation_english: Indicates having the ability or possibility to do something; used to state that something can be done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你好好溫書，你就能夠通過考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hou2 hou2 wan1 syu1, nei5 zau6 nang4 gau3 tung1 gwo3 haau2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你好好复习，你就能够通过考试。
examples.english_sentence: If you study well, you'll be able to pass the exam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個禮拜我應該能夠幫你搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 ngo5 jing1 goi1 nang4 gau3 bong1 nei5 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个星期我应该能够帮你搬家。
examples.english_sentence: I should be able to help you move this week.

mandarin_meaning: 能屈能伸 (néng qū néng shēn)：能夠在逆境中忍讓、退讓，必要時又能夠伸展才幹、表現能力；形容人有彈性和應變能力。
english_meaning: Able to bend and stretch — figuratively: adaptable and resilient; able to yield when necessary and assert oneself or show ability when the opportunity arises.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人遇事能夠忍讓、退讓以避開矛盾，但在合適的時機又能夠發揮能力、爭取應有的地位或權益，強調彈性和應變能力。
explanation_english: Describes someone who can be accommodating or submissive when necessary to avoid conflict, yet is able to assert themselves and demonstrate ability when the situation calls for it — emphasizes flexibility and adaptability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做人能屈能伸，遇到困難都唔會輕易放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jan4 nang4 wat1 nang4 san1, jyu6 dou3 fan3 naan4 dou1 m4 wui5 hing1 ji6 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為人能屈能伸，遇到困難也不輕易放棄。
examples.english_sentence: He is flexible and resilient; he doesn't give up easily when facing difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 職場上要能屈能伸，先至可以長久發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik1 coeng4 soeng6 jiu3 nang4 wat1 nang4 san1, sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 coeng4 gau2 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在職場上要能屈能伸，才能長久發展。
examples.english_sentence: In the workplace you need to be adaptable to achieve long-term development.

mandarin_meaning: 能干（有能力、能勝任、做事有效率）
english_meaning: capable; competent; efficient; able to do things well
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個人有能力、做事有條理且有效率，能勝任工作或任務。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is capable and competent, who handles tasks efficiently and can be relied on to get things done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好能幹，啲工作分分鐘就做完。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nang4 gon3, di1 gung1 zok3 fan1 fan1 zung1 zau6 zou6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很能幹，工作很快就做完。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is very capable; the work gets done very quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 能幹的廚師；會做菜的人
english_meaning: a capable cook; someone skilled at cooking
explanation_mandarin: 口語用詞，表示某人在廚藝方面很有能力，會做出好味道的菜餚。
explanation_english: Colloquial term referring to a person who is skilled in cooking and can prepare tasty dishes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個能廚，啲菜成日都好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 nang4 cyu4, di1 coi3 seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個能幹的廚師，做的菜經常都很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: He's a capable cook; his dishes are always delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 能手；擅長某方面技能的人
english_meaning: an expert; a skilled person; an adept
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一領域或工作上技術高超、很有能力的人，常用來稱讚某人的專業或技藝。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is highly skilled or capable in a particular field or task; often used to praise someone's expertise or craft.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明係廚房嘅能手，成日都幫手整餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai6 ceoi4 fong4 ge3 nang4 sau2, sing4 jat6 dou1 bong1 sau2 zing2 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明是廚房的能手，經常幫忙做菜。
examples.english_sentence: A-Ming is the kitchen expert; he often helps cook.

mandarin_meaning: 并非常用词，可能是“能耐”（能力、本事）的误写；字面读音可读作“néng xiè”。
english_meaning: Not a standard Cantonese word; likely a misspelling of 能耐 (ability / skill / capability).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词（若按“能耐”理解）/ 非标准用语（错字）
explanation_mandarin: “能械”并非廣東話常用詞彙，可能是書寫或輸入錯誤。常見且正確的詞是“能耐”（Jyutping: nang4 noi6），用來表示一個人的能力或本事。此詞在香港口語或文字中偶爾可見作誤寫或錯字註記。
explanation_english: “能械” is not a standard Cantonese term and is likely a misspelling. The correct and common word is 能耐 (Jyutping: nang4 noi6), meaning ability, capability, or skill. “能械” may appear occasionally as a typo or nonstandard written form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「能械」唔係正確寫法，應該寫「能耐」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nang4 haai6 m4 hai6 zing3 kok3 se2 faat3, jing1 goi1 se2 nang4 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “能械”不是正确写法，应该写成“能耐”（表示能力/本事）。
examples.english_sentence: '能械' is not the correct spelling; it should be '能耐' (meaning ability/skill).

mandarin_meaning: 能歌善舞（néng gē shàn wǔ）：善於歌舞，形容有表演才能或性格活潑、愛好表演。
english_meaning: Able to sing and dance; good at performing (often used to describe someone talented in singing and dancing or lively and sociable).
explanation_mandarin: 表示擅長唱歌和跳舞。既可指有藝術表演才能，也常用來形容性格活潑、喜歡在社交場合表現自己。
explanation_english: Describes someone skilled at singing and dancing. It can refer to actual performing talent or be used figuratively for a lively, sociable person who enjoys showing off at gatherings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個能歌善舞嘅人，成日喺婚禮同派對上表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 nang4 go1 sin6 mou5 ge3 jan4, seng4 jat6 hai2 fan1 lai5 tung4 paai3 deoi3 soeng6 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個能歌善舞的人，經常在婚禮和派對上表演。
examples.english_sentence: He is a person who can sing and dance well, often performing at weddings and parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢唔係專業表演者，但好能歌善舞，喺派對上好搶鏡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 m4 hai6 zyun1 jip6 biu2 jin2 ze2, daan6 hou2 nang4 go1 sin6 mou5, hai6 paai3 deoi3 soeng6 hou2 coeng2 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 雖然他不是專業表演者，但非常能歌善舞，在派對上很搶鏡。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's not a professional performer, he's very good at singing and dancing and really steals the spotlight at parties.

mandarin_meaning: 能歌善舞（擅長唱歌和跳舞）
english_meaning: to be good at singing and dancing; gifted in performing arts
explanation_mandarin: 形容人擅長唱歌和跳舞，常用來讚揚具有表演才能的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone skilled at singing and dancing; often used to praise a person with performing talents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢能歌擅舞，喺學校嘅聯歡會上表演，好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nang4 go1 sin6 mou5, hai2 hok6 haau6 ge3 lyun4 fun1 wui6 seong6 biu2 jin2, hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他能歌善舞，在学校的联欢会上表演时很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is good at singing and dancing; when performing at the school's variety show they were very popular.

mandarin_meaning: 能源 (néngyuán)
english_meaning: energy; energy resources
explanation_mandarin: 指可供人類利用的能量及其來源，例如石油、天然氣、風能、太陽能等，常用作名詞討論資源或供能來源。
explanation_english: Refers to sources of power or usable energy (e.g., oil, natural gas, wind, solar). Used as a noun to discuss resources or sources of energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港需要多元化嘅能源來源。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 seoi1 jiu3 do1 jyun4 faa3 ge3 nang4 jyun4 loi4 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港需要多元化的能源來源。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong needs diversified energy sources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃增加對清潔能源嘅投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 zang1 gaa1 deoi3 cing1 git3 nang4 jyun4 ge3 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府計劃增加對清潔能源的投資。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to increase investment in clean energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間工廠改用可再生能源，減少碳排放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 cong2 goi2 jung6 ho2 zoi3 saang1 nang4 jyun4, gaam2 siu2 taan3 paai4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間工廠改用可再生能源，減少碳排放。
examples.english_sentence: This factory switched to renewable energy to reduce carbon emissions.

mandarin_meaning: 能者多劳
english_meaning: The capable ones do more work; those who are able often take on more responsibilities
explanation_mandarin: 表示有能力的人往往會被分配或承擔更多工作或責任。
explanation_english: Indicates that capable people are often assigned or take on more work or responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司入面，能者多勞，做得好嘅同事往往要負擔多啲任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6, nang4 ze2 do1 lou4, zou6 dak1 hou2 ge3 tung4 si6 wong5 wong5 jiu3 fu6 daam1 do1 di1 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司里，能者多劳，做得好的人常常要承担更多任务。
examples.english_sentence: In the company, the capable ones do more work; colleagues who perform well often have to take on more tasks.

mandarin_meaning: 本事；能力（口語）
english_meaning: ability; capability; skill; talent
explanation_mandarin: 「能耐」在廣東話中指一個人的本領或能力，屬口語用法。可用來讚賞某人有本事，也可在質疑或挑釁語氣中使用（如「有冇能耐……」）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "能耐" refers to a person's ability, capability, or skill. It is colloquial and can be used approvingly to praise someone's competence or sarcastically/challengingly in expressions like "got the guts/ability...?"

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係有能耐，嗰啲問題好快就解決咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jau5 nang4 noi6, go2 di1 man6 tai4 hou2 faai3 zau6 gaai2 kyut3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的有本事，那些問題很快就解決了。
examples.english_sentence: He really has ability; those problems were solved quickly.

mandarin_meaning: 能见度 / 可见度
english_meaning: visibility (the distance at which objects can be clearly seen, used in weather/aviation/maritime contexts)
explanation_mandarin: 描述在特定氣象或環境條件下，能看清遠處物體的最大距離，常用於天氣、航海和航空等情況。
explanation_english: A measure of how far one can clearly see under given conditions; commonly used in weather reports, maritime and aviation contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅能見度好低，唔適合開車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 nang4-gin3-dou6 hou2 dai1, m4 sik1-hap6 hoi1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的能见度很低，不适合开车。
examples.english_sentence: Today's visibility is very low; it's not safe to drive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 根據天氣報告，聽日早上能見度會跌至一公里以下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1-geoi3 tin1-hei3 bou3-gou3, ting1-jat6 zou2-soeng6 nang4-gin3-dou6 wui5 dit3-zi3 jat1 gong1-lei5 ji5-haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 根据天气报告，明天早上的能见度会下降到一公里以下。
examples.english_sentence: According to the weather report, tomorrow morning the visibility will drop below one kilometer.

mandarin_meaning: 能言善辩 (形容善於言辭、辯論，口才好)
english_meaning: eloquent; persuasive; good at arguing or debating
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容一個人善於言辭和辯論，能說服別人，口才出眾。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is skilled with words and debate — eloquent and persuasive, able to argue or convince others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺辯論會上能言善辯，說服咗唔少人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bin6 leon6 wui2 soeng5 nang4 jin4 sin6 bin6, syut3 fuk6 zo2 m4 siu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在辩论会上能言善辩，说服了不少人。
examples.english_sentence: He was eloquent at the debate and persuaded quite a few people.

mandarin_meaning: 能治病卻治不好自己；比喻能幫助別人卻無法解決自己的問題
english_meaning: Literally 'can cure others but not oneself' — someone who can help others but cannot help themselves; used metaphorically for a person skilled at solving others' problems yet unable to resolve their own
explanation_mandarin: 出自古語，字面意思是能治療他人卻治不好自己。常用來形容能幫別人解決困難或提供建議，卻無法解決自己的問題或照顧好自己。
explanation_english: A classical saying meaning someone who can treat or advise others but cannot do the same for themselves. Often used to describe people who are good at helping others yet fail to address their own issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個出色嘅心理輔導員，能醫不自醫，自己都需要人傾訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 ceot1 sik1 ge3 sam1 lei5 fu6 dou6 jyun4, nang4 ji1 bat1 zi6 ji1, zi6 gei2 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 jan4 king1 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個出色的心理輔導員，能醫不自醫，他自己也需要有人傾訴。
examples.english_sentence: He's an excellent counselor who can help others but can't heal himself; he also needs someone to talk to.

mandarin_meaning: 能量（néngliàng）：指物理上的能量或比喻的精神、氣場、活力。
english_meaning: Energy — physical energy or, figuratively, a person's vitality/vibes.
explanation_mandarin: 可指物理學上的能量（如電能、化學能、動能等），也常用作比喻，表示個人的活力、氣場或正/負面的情緒影響。
explanation_english: Can refer to energy in physics (electrical, chemical, kinetic, etc.) and is also commonly used figuratively to mean a person's vitality, vibe, or positive/negative influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日冇乜能量，唔想做運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 mat1 nang4 loeng6, m4 soeng2 zou6 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天沒什麼能量，不想運動。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have much energy today; I don't want to exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有正能量，成日幫人打氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 zeng3 nang4 loeng6, sing4 jat6 bong1 jan4 daa2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有正能量，經常鼓勵別人。
examples.english_sentence: They have positive energy and often encourage others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個電池嘅能量足夠支撐一日嘅使用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 din6 ci4 ge3 nang4 loeng6 zuk1 gau3 zi1 cang1 jat1 jat6 ge3 si6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個電池的能量足夠支撐一天的使用。
examples.english_sentence: This battery's energy is enough to power a day's use.

mandarin_meaning: 能夠使人驚駭／震驚
english_meaning: capable of shocking or terrifying (someone)
explanation_mandarin: 書面或文言色彩的詞語，表示某事或某物有能力使人感到驚駭、震撼或恐懼。
explanation_english: A literary expression meaning something is capable of shocking, horrifying, or startling people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰件事真係能駭到我，我一陣都唔想諗起佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 nang4 haai6 dou3 ngo5, ngo5 jat1 zan6 dou1 m4 soeng2 lam2 hei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件事真讓我震驚，我有一段時間都不想再想起它。
examples.english_sentence: That incident really shocked me; I didn't want to think about it for a while.

mandarin_meaning: 脂 (zhī)：脂肪、油脂
english_meaning: fat; grease; lipid
explanation_mandarin: 表示油脂或脂肪的概念，常出現在複合詞中，如「油脂」「脂肪」「脂質」。
explanation_english: Denotes fat, grease, or lipid. Commonly appears in compounds such as "oil/grease" and "fat".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條魚有好多油脂，唔啱炸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 jyu4 jau5 hou2 do1 jau4 zi1, m4 ngam1 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條魚有很多油脂，不適合炸。
examples.english_sentence: This fish has a lot of oil/fat; it's not suitable for deep-frying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要減低體內脂肪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 gaam2 dai1 tai2 noi6 zi1 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說要降低體內脂肪。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said to reduce body fat.

mandarin_meaning: 脂粉；化妝品；泛指女子的妝扮或女性（有時帶輕微貶義）
english_meaning: cosmetics; makeup; also feminine adornment or, figuratively, women (sometimes slightly pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 指用於臉部的粉類與其他美容用品（如胭脂、粉底等）；也可泛指女性的打扮或女性本人，文語或口語皆可使用。
explanation_english: Refers to face powders and other cosmetic products (rouge, foundation, etc.); can also refer more generally to a woman's adornment or to women themselves. Used in both literary and colloquial contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢抽屜入面放住好多脂粉同化妝品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cau1 toi3 jap6 min6 fong3 zyu6 hou2 do1 zi1 fan2 tung4 faa3 zong1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她抽屉里面放着很多脂粉和化妆品。
examples.english_sentence: She keeps a lot of cosmetics and makeup in her drawer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲電影入面啲女角好有脂粉氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 din6 jing2 jap6 min6 di1 neoi5 gok3 hou2 jau5 zi1 fan2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些電影裡的女角很有脂粉氣。
examples.english_sentence: The female characters in those films are very feminine/affected.

mandarin_meaning: 爱化妆、爱打扮或过于注重外表的人（常含贬义）
english_meaning: a person who is fond of cosmetics and dressing up; a vain/fastidious person
explanation_mandarin: “脂粉客”字面指涂脂抹粉的人，常用来形容喜爱打扮、注重外表或有些虚荣的人，语气可带贬义或戏谑。
explanation_english: Literally 'makeup person' — used to describe someone who loves to wear makeup and dress up. Often implies vanity or superficiality; can be pejorative or teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日好注重打扮，真係個脂粉客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hou2 zyu3 zung6 daa2 baan6, zan1 hai6 go3 zi1 fan2 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她总是很注重打扮，真是个脂粉客。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is always very particular about dressing up — truly a cosmetics-lover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係做個脂粉客，要注重內在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 zou6 go3 zi1 fan2 haak3, jiu3 zyu3 zung6 noi6 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只做一个脂粉客，要注重内在。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just be someone who focuses on cosmetics; pay attention to the inner self.

mandarin_meaning: 脂肪（動物或人體內儲存能量的組織或物質）
english_meaning: fat; adipose tissue (the substance/tissue in animals/humans that stores energy)
explanation_mandarin: 儲存在動物或人體內的脂質，主要存在於脂肪組織中，能儲存能量、保溫並保護器官，但過多會導致肥胖和相關健康問題。
explanation_english: A lipid substance stored in animals or humans, mainly in adipose tissue. It stores energy, provides insulation and protects organs; excess fat can lead to obesity and related health issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做運動可以幫助燃燒脂肪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 bong1 zo6 jin4 siu1 zi1 fong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做运动可以帮助燃烧脂肪。
examples.english_sentence: Exercising can help burn fat.

mandarin_meaning: 脂肪瘤（zhīfángliú），由脂肪組織構成的良性腫瘤
english_meaning: lipoma — a benign tumor made of adipose (fat) tissue
explanation_mandarin: 脂肪瘤是一種良性腫瘤，由成熟的脂肪細胞組成，通常出現在皮下，質地柔軟、可推動，常無痛，但若壓迫神經或生長較大可能需處理。
explanation_english: A lipoma is a benign tumor composed of mature fat cells. It typically appears under the skin as a soft, movable, usually painless lump. Treatment may be considered if it grows large or causes symptoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我頸上有個脂肪瘤，要唔要切除？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 geng2 soeng6 jau5 go3 zi1 fong4 lau4, jiu3 m4 jiu3 cit3 ceoi4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我脖子上有一个脂肪瘤，要不要切除？
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I have a lipoma on my neck. Should it be removed?

mandarin_meaning: 脂肪酸 (zhīfángsuān)
english_meaning: fatty acid
explanation_mandarin: 脂肪酸是由碳氢链和羧基（-COOH）组成的有机酸，是脂类（如甘油三酯、磷脂等）的组成部分，可分为饱和脂肪酸和不饱和脂肪酸，参与能量代谢与细胞结构构成。
explanation_english: Fatty acids are organic acids made of a hydrocarbon chain and a carboxyl group (-COOH). They are components of lipids (e.g. triglycerides, phospholipids) and can be classified as saturated or unsaturated. They play roles in energy metabolism and cell structure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 深海魚含有豐富嘅不飽和脂肪酸，對心臟健康有好處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sam1 hoi2 jyu4 ham4 jau5 fung1 fu3 ge3 bat1 baau2 wo4 zi1 fong4 syun1, deoi3 sam1 zong6 gin6 hong1 jau5 hou2 cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 深海鱼含有丰富的不饱和脂肪酸，对心脏健康有好处。
examples.english_sentence: Fatty fish contain abundant unsaturated fatty acids, which are beneficial for heart health.

mandarin_meaning: 威脅；脅迫；（解剖）側腹、兩側
english_meaning: to threaten; to coerce; (anatomy) flank, side
explanation_mandarin: 「脅」主要作動詞使用，表示以威脅或脅迫的方式迫使他人服從；也可作名詞，指身體的側面或側腹。常見於複合詞如「威脅」、「脅迫」、「脅持」。
explanation_english: The character 脅 is primarily used as a verb meaning to threaten or coerce; it can also be a noun referring to the flank or side of the body. Commonly found in compounds like 威脅 (threaten), 脅迫 (coerce), and 脅持 (hold hostage).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個人威脅我，話如果我報警就會出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 jan4 wai1 hip3 ngo5, waa6 joeng4 gwo2 ngo5 bou3 ging2 zau6 wui5 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個人威脅我，說如果我報警就會出事。
examples.english_sentence: That person threatened me, saying that if I called the police something would happen.

mandarin_meaning: 胁持；以威胁或武力控制、拘禁他人（常指劫持人质）
english_meaning: to take/hold (someone) hostage; to coerce or detain by threat or force
explanation_mandarin: 指以威脅、武力或其他強制手段控制、拘禁或迫使他人，常用於描述劫持人質或脅迫他人從事某行為。
explanation_english: Refers to using threats, force, or other coercive means to control, detain, or compel someone; often used to describe taking hostages or forcing compliance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歹徒脅持咗幾個人作為人質，警方而家正同歹徒談判。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai2 tou4 hip3 ci4 zo2 gei2 go3 jan4 zok3 wai4 jan4 zat1, ging2 fong1 ji4 gaa1 zing3 tung4 daai2 tou4 taam4 pun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 歹徒劫持了幾個人作為人質，警方正在與歹徒談判。
examples.english_sentence: The assailants took several people hostage; the police are currently negotiating with them.

mandarin_meaning: 胁迫 (用威胁或强制手段逼迫他人)
english_meaning: to coerce; to force or compel someone by threats or intimidation
explanation_mandarin: 用威脅、恐嚇或其他強制性手段逼使他人做某事。
explanation_english: To force or compel someone to do something by means of threats, intimidation, or other coercive methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢脅迫我簽咗份合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hip3 bik1 ngo5 cim1 zo2 fan6 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他胁迫我签了那份合同。
examples.english_sentence: He coerced me into signing that contract.

mandarin_meaning: 胁迫 / 脅迫（以威脅或強制手段迫使他人）
english_meaning: to coerce; to threaten and force someone to do something
explanation_mandarin: 以威脅、恐嚇或其他強制手段迫使他人做某事，含有強制性和不自願的意味。
explanation_english: To compel someone to act against their will by means of threats, intimidation, or other coercive tactics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆用脅逼手段，強迫員工加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 jung6 hip3 bik1 sau2 dyun6, koeng4 bik1 jyun4 gung1 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板用胁迫的手段，强迫员工加班。
examples.english_sentence: The boss used coercive methods to force employees to work overtime.

mandarin_meaning: 脆（cuì）——（食物）酥脆、鬆脆；（物體）易碎；（人或事）脆弱、易受影響（引申）
english_meaning: crisp; crunchy; brittle; fragile (literal); fragile or easily affected (figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 表示食物的口感酥脆或物體容易碎裂；在引申用法中可表示情感或狀態上容易受傷、脆弱。
explanation_english: Describes a crisp or crunchy texture for food, or something brittle and easily broken; figuratively it can mean emotionally or structurally fragile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲炸雞皮好脆，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zaa3 gai1 pei4 hou2 ceoi3, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些炸鸡皮很脆，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: These fried chicken skins are very crispy and delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個餅乾好脆，啱晒做下午茶小食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 beng2 gon1 hou2 ceoi3, aam1 saai3 zou6 haa6 ng5 caa4 siu2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个饼干很脆，适合做下午茶小点心。
examples.english_sentence: This biscuit is very crunchy, perfect as an afternoon tea snack.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個玻璃杯好脆，小心啲唔好跌爛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 bo1 lei4 bui1 hou2 ceoi3, siu2 sam1 di1 m4 hou2 dit3 laan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个玻璃杯很脆，小心别摔坏了。
examples.english_sentence: This glass cup is fragile; be careful not to break it.

mandarin_meaning: 脆脆的；酥脆
english_meaning: crispy; crunchy (onomatopoeic)
explanation_mandarin: 「脆卜卜」是廣東話的擬聲詞/形容詞，用來形容食物或物件具有酥脆、會發出脆響的口感或質感，屬於口語用法。
explanation_english: “脆卜卜” is a Cantonese onomatopoeic adjective describing a crisp, crunchy texture (often for food) that makes a crisp sound. It is colloquial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包薯片脆卜卜，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baau1 syu4 pin3 ceoi3 buk1 buk1, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這包薯片脆脆的，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: These potato chips are crunchy and very tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 脆弱（情感或狀態上容易受傷、缺乏堅強）
english_meaning: fragile; vulnerable; easily hurt or lacking resilience
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述一個人在情感、心理或物理上容易受傷、難以承受壓力或缺乏堅強的特質。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is easily hurt or damaged emotionally, psychologically, or physically; lacking resilience or strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個心靈好脆弱，成日容易受傷害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 sam1 ling4 hou2 ceoi3 joek6, seng4 jat6 jung4 ji6 sau6 soeng1 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的心靈很脆弱，經常容易受傷。
examples.english_sentence: His emotions are very fragile; he often gets hurt easily.

mandarin_meaning: 脆柿（脆柿子）
english_meaning: crisp persimmon; crunchy persimmon
explanation_mandarin: 指口感較脆、類似蘋果般爽脆的柿子品種（例如日本的富有柿），通常可生吃，咬下去既脆又甜。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of persimmon with a crisp, apple-like texture (e.g., Fuyu persimmon). Usually eaten fresh; crunchy and sweet rather than soft and pulpy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係脆柿，啱啱摘落嚟，咬落好脆又甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 ceoi3 si6, aam1 aam1 zaak6 lok6 lei4, ngaau5 lok6 hou2 ceoi3 jau6 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些是脆柿，剛摘下來，咬起來又脆又甜。
examples.english_sentence: These are crisp persimmons; freshly picked, they're crunchy and sweet when you bite them.

mandarin_meaning: 脆片 / 脆的薄片（如玉米脆片、巧克力脆片、薯片等）
english_meaning: crisps / crispy flakes (thin, crunchy slices used as snacks or toppings)
explanation_mandarin: 指質地酥脆的薄片狀食品或配料，常見例子包括玉米脆片（早餐麥片）、巧克力脆片或薯片等。有時也可泛指任何脆的薄片。
explanation_english: Refers to thin, crunchy flake-like foods or toppings, such as corn flakes (breakfast cereal), chocolate crisps, or potato chips. It can also broadly mean any crispy thin pieces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食脆片做零食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 ceoi3 pin3 zou6 ling4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢把脆片当零食吃。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat crisps as a snack.

mandarin_meaning: 脆皮（外皮酥脆）
english_meaning: crispy skin; crunchy coating; crunchy crust
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容食物外層酥脆的質地，常見於燒肉、燒鴨、炸物等。也可作為複合詞（如「脆皮燒肉」）。
explanation_english: Describes a crispy or crunchy outer layer of food, commonly used for roast pork, roast duck, fried items, etc. Can also appear in compound terms like "crispy roast pork."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嗰間茶餐廳嘅脆皮燒肉好出名，個皮烤得好脆，肉又嫩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go2 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 ceoi3 pei4 siu1 juk6 hou2 ceot1 ming4, go3 pei4 haau1 dak1 hou2 ceoi3, juk6 jau6 nan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們那家茶餐廳的脆皮燒肉很出名，皮烤得很酥脆，肉又嫩。
examples.english_sentence: Their cha chaan teng's crispy roast pork is very famous; the skin is roasted until crunchy and the meat is tender.

mandarin_meaning: 炸得外皮酥脆的腸類小吃（如炸豬腸或脆皮香腸）
english_meaning: crispy fried intestine/sausage (a snack of intestines or sausages with a crunchy exterior)
explanation_mandarin: 指外層炸至酥脆的腸類食物，常見於粵式小吃或街頭小吃，材料可為豬腸或香腸，口感以酥脆為特徵。
explanation_english: Refers to intestines or sausages fried until the exterior is crispy. Common in Cantonese cuisine and street food; typically made from pork intestines or sausages and characterized by a crunchy outer texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食脆皮腸，佢啲外皮好香同好脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 ceoi3 pei4 coeng4, keoi5 di1 ngoi6 pei4 hou2 hoeng1 tung4 hou2 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜歡吃脆皮腸，它的外皮又香又脆。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating crispy fried intestines/sausage; its casing is fragrant and crunchy.

mandarin_meaning: 脆皮鸡 (cuì pí jī)
english_meaning: crispy-skinned chicken; roast chicken with a crisp, crackling skin
explanation_mandarin: 指外皮烤得或炸得很脆的雞，常見於廣東/香港的燒臘店或酒樓，皮脆肉嫩，是一道常見的菜品或小食。
explanation_english: Refers to chicken whose skin is cooked until very crispy (by roasting or frying), commonly served in Cantonese roast shops or restaurants. The skin is crisp while the meat remains tender.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚買咗一隻脆皮雞，啲皮好脆，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 jat1 zek3 ceoi3 pei4 gai1, di1 pei4 hou2 ceoi3, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚买了一只脆皮鸡，皮很脆，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a crispy-skinned chicken tonight; the skin is very crispy and it's delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 一种淡水鯇魚，肉質脆嫩，常見於中國南方市場，常用於烹調（如清蒸或煮湯）。
english_meaning: a freshwater carp (literally "crisp-fleshed carp") known for its tender, slightly crisp flesh; commonly sold in southern China and used in cooking.
explanation_mandarin: 「脆肉鯇」為一種淡水魚的俗名，因為魚肉較為細嫩且口感稍脆而得名。市場上常見於粵菜或廣東地區的海鮮檔，常用清蒸、煲湯或紅燒等烹調方法。
explanation_english: "脆肉鯇" is a common name for a freshwater carp valued for its tender, slightly crisp flesh. It is commonly found in markets in southern China and is typically prepared by steaming, stewing, or braising in regional cuisines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚買咗條脆肉鯇，打算蒸嚟食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 maai5 zo2 tiu4 ceoi3 juk6 gwaan1, daa2 syun3 zing1 lai4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚买了条脆肉鯇，打算清蒸来吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a脆肉鯇 tonight and plan to steam it.

mandarin_meaning: （有點）脆脆的/有點酥脆
english_meaning: slightly crispy / a bit crunchy (colloquial)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞 / 副詞（口語用法）
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，形容食物或口感有點脆，常用重疊詞加上結尾的“地/哋”來表示程度較輕或口語化的描述。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression using reduplication plus the particle 哋 to indicate a light degree of crispiness — used to describe food texture or to modify verbs/adjectives in a casual way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包薯片脆脆哋，好啱我鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou1 syu4 pin3 ceoi3 ceoi3 dei6, hou2 aam1 ngo5 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這包洋芋片有點脆，很合我的口味。
examples.english_sentence: These chips are a bit crispy — just how I like them.

mandarin_meaning: （副詞）脆脆地，酥脆地
english_meaning: crisply; in a crisp/crunchy manner
explanation_mandarin: 用來描述食物或物體的口感或聲音等呈現鬆脆、酥脆的狀態，通常作副詞使用（為粵語習慣的疊詞加地）。
explanation_english: Used to describe a crisp or crunchy texture or sound of food or objects; typically an adverb formed by reduplication plus the particle '地' in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊餅脆脆地，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 beng2 ceoi3 ceoi3 dei6, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块饼脆脆的，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: This cookie is crispy and very tasty.

mandarin_meaning: 脆角（炸成三角形的酥脆点心或油炸小吃）
english_meaning: crispy triangular fried pastry/snack (a deep-fried triangular crisp)
explanation_mandarin: 脆角指一種油炸成三角形、外皮酥脆的小吃或點心，常見於粵式茶樓或地區小吃，有時與「油角」「炸角」互通使用，但製法與餡料可有差異。
explanation_english: A deep-fried triangular snack or dim-sum pastry with a crispy exterior. Common in Cantonese tea houses and local eateries. It is sometimes used interchangeably with terms like 'yau gok' or 'fried triangle,' though fillings and preparation can vary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺茶樓叫咗份脆角，啲皮好脆，好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 caa4 lau4 giu3 zo2 fan6 ceoi3 gok3, di1 pei4 hou2 ceoi3, hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在茶楼点了一份脆角，皮很脆，很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I ordered a serving of crispy triangles at the tea house; the pastry was very crispy and delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 酥脆；脆脆作響（擬聲詞／俚語）
english_meaning: crispy; crunchy; (onomatopoeic) making a crisp/crackling sound
explanation_mandarin: 「脆輯輯」為粵語口語/擬聲詞，用來形容食物或物件非常酥脆、發出脆裂的聲音。有時帶有口語色彩，多見於香港粵語日常用語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/onomatopoeic expression used to describe something that is very crispy or makes a crisp/crackling sound. It's informal and commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢包薯片脆輯輯，食到停唔到口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baau1 syu4 pin3 ceoi3 zik1 zik1, sik6 dou3 ting4 m4 dou3 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這包薯片酥脆，吃得停不下來。
examples.english_sentence: These potato chips are crunchy — I can't stop eating them.

mandarin_meaning: 腋下；側面、側肋（拼音：xié）
english_meaning: Flank; side of the body; armpit
explanation_mandarin: 「脇」為較書面或文言用字，常指人體的側面或腋下部位，也可泛指事物的側邊或側側肋處。
explanation_english: A literary or technical term referring to the side or flank of the body, including the armpit; can also denote the side or lateral part of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢摸住自己嘅脇位，話畀我聽有蚊咬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mo1 zyu6 zi6 gei2 ge3 hip3 wai6, waa6 bei2 ngo5 teng1 jau5 man1 ngaau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摸著自己的腋下，跟我說被蚊子叮了。
examples.english_sentence: He touched his armpit and told me he'd been bitten by a mosquito.

mandarin_meaning: 脈；脈搏；（引申）脈絡、線索
english_meaning: pulse; vein; (figurative) the thread or context of something
explanation_mandarin: 通常指人體的脈搏或血管中的脈，也可引申為事物的脈絡、關聯或發展脈動。
explanation_english: Usually refers to the body's pulse or a blood vessel; can also be used figuratively to mean the thread, context, or trend of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生替佢捉脈，話心跳正常。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 tai3 keoi5 zuk1 mak6, waa6 sam1 tiu3 zing3 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生替他把脉，说心跳正常。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor took his pulse and said his heartbeat was normal.

mandarin_meaning: 脉搏 (màibó)
english_meaning: pulse; the rhythmic beating of blood in the arteries
explanation_mandarin: 指血液在動脈中搏動所產生的規律跳動，常用於醫學檢查以判斷心率和血液循環狀況。
explanation_english: The rhythmic beating of blood through the arteries (the pulse); commonly used in medical contexts to assess heart rate and circulation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生替佢量緊脈搏，發覺心跳好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 tai3 keoi5 loeng4 gan2 mak6 bok3, faat3 gok3 sam1 tiu3 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生正在给他测脉搏，发觉心跳很快。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor is measuring his pulse and noticed his heartbeat is very fast.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你摸到佢嘅脈搏未？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mo2 dou2 keoi5 ge3 mak6 bok3 mei6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你摸到他的脉搏了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can you feel his pulse?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做完運動之後我嘅脈搏加快，要休息一陣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyun4 wan6 dung6 zi1 hau6 ngo5 ge3 mak6 bok3 gaa1 faai3, jiu3 jau1 sik1 jat1 zan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 运动后我的脉搏加快，需要休息一会儿。
examples.english_sentence: After exercising my pulse quickened and I need to rest for a while.

mandarin_meaning: 脈絡 (màiluò)：1. 事物之間的來龍去脈、關聯、脈絡線索；2. （解剖）血管或組織的網絡（如脈絡叢）
english_meaning: 脈絡: the thread or context connecting events or elements (the sequence/line of development); also, in anatomy, a network of vessels/tissues (e.g., choroid plexus).
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示事情的前因後果、內在關聯或線索，也可指生理上的血管／組織網絡（如脈絡叢）。
explanation_english: Used to indicate the causal chain, internal connections or thread of a matter; can also refer to a physiological network of vessels/tissues (e.g., choroid plexus).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要理清個故事嘅脈絡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lei5 cing1 go3 gu3 si6 ge3 mak6 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要理清这个故事的脉络。
examples.english_sentence: We need to clarify the thread/sequence of this story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告冇交代清楚資料之間嘅脈絡，令決策好困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 mou5 gaau1 doi6 cing1 co2 zi1 liu2 zi1 gaan1 ge3 mak6 lok3, ling6 kyut3 caak3 hou2 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那份报告没有交代清楚资料之间的脉络，令决策很困难。
examples.english_sentence: The report didn't explain the connections between the data clearly, making decision-making difficult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺病理報告入面提到脈絡叢有異常。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 beng6 lei5 bou3 gou3 jap6 min6 tai4 dou3 mak6 lok3 cung4 jau5 ji6 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在病理报告中提到脉络丛有异常。
examples.english_sentence: The pathology report mentioned abnormalities in the choroid plexus (脈絡叢).

mandarin_meaning: 脉冲
english_meaning: pulse; impulse (e.g., electrical or physical pulse)
explanation_mandarin: 指在短時間內能量、電流或信號的突發變化，常用於電子學、物理學，也可用來描述心臟或血管的脈搏波動。
explanation_english: A short, sudden change or surge in energy, current, or signal; commonly used in electronics and physics. Can also refer to a heartbeat or pulse wave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個儀器會發出短促嘅脈衝信號。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ji4 hei3 wui5 faat3 ceot1 dyun2 cuk1 ge3 mak6 cung1 seon3 hou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个仪器会发出短促的脉冲信号。
examples.english_sentence: This instrument emits short pulse signals.

mandarin_meaning: 中醫診脈時所見的脈的形態或特徵，用以判斷病情
english_meaning: Pulse condition; the characteristics of the pulse observed in traditional Chinese medicine used to assess a patient's condition
explanation_mandarin: 脈象是中醫透過按脈、觀察脈的強弱、快慢、浮沉、滑澀等特徵來判斷臟腑狀態和病機的一組表現。
explanation_english: In traditional Chinese medicine, '脈象' refers to the observed qualities of the pulse (strength, rate, depth, smoothness, etc.) used to infer organ conditions and disease patterns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫睇症會睇脈象，從脈象可以了解身體嘅虛實、寒熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 tai2 zing3 wui5 tai2 mak6 zoeng6, cung4 mak6 zoeng6 ho2 ji5 liu5 gaai2 san1 tai2 ge3 heoi1 sat6, hon4 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中医看病时会观察脉象，从脉象可以了解身体的虚实、寒热。
examples.english_sentence: When a TCM practitioner diagnoses a patient, they observe the pulse; from the pulse condition they can learn about the body's deficiency/excess and cold/heat patterns.

mandarin_meaning: 脉门；门路；诀窍；头绪
english_meaning: key point; clue; knack; the way in to solving something
explanation_mandarin: 指事情的關鍵、頭緒或辦法，常用於口語，表示找到了解決問題的方法或線索。
explanation_english: Refers to the key point, clue, or knack for handling something. Often used colloquially to indicate finding the way to solve a problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我終於搵到件事嘅脈門，可以開始解決佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 wan2 dou3 gin6 si6 ge3 mak6 mun4, ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 gaai2 kyut3 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我終於找到了事情的脈門，可以開始解決它了。
examples.english_sentence: I finally found the key clue to the matter, so I can start solving it.

mandarin_meaning: 脊、脊椎、脊背（脊柱）
english_meaning: spine; backbone; ridge (of body); (figuratively) backbone/strength
explanation_mandarin: 指人體的脊柱或脊背，常見於背脊、脊椎、脊骨等詞彙。在口語中，與「冇脊骨」等說法合用，表示沒有骨氣或沒有鬥志。
explanation_english: Refers to the spine or backbone of the body; appears in compounds such as 背脊 (back), 脊椎 (spine), 脊骨 (vertebrae). Colloquially used in expressions like "冇脊骨" meaning "spineless".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我背脊痛，可能係坐得太耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bui3 zek3 tung3, ho2 nang4 hai6 co5 dak1 taai3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我背脊痛，可能是坐得太久。
examples.english_sentence: My back hurts; maybe I sat for too long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢脊椎受傷，要做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 zek3 zeoi1 sau6 soeng1, jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他的脊椎受伤，需要做手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his spine was injured and he needs surgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢冇脊骨，乜嘢都肯做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 zek3 gwat1, mat1 je5 dou1 hang2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他沒有骨氣，什麼都肯做。
examples.english_sentence: He has no backbone; he'll do anything.

mandarin_meaning: 脊柱
english_meaning: spine; vertebral column
explanation_mandarin: 人體背部中間由多塊椎骨連成的柱狀結構，保護脊髓並支撐軀幹。
explanation_english: The column of vertebrae in the back that protects the spinal cord and supports the torso.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌親，脊柱受傷，宜家要做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 can1, zek3 zyu6 sau6 soeng1, ji4 gaa1 jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔傷了，脊柱受傷，現在要做手術。
examples.english_sentence: He fell and injured his spine; now he needs surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 脊椎；由多節椎骨組成的脊柱
english_meaning: spine; vertebral column; backbone
explanation_mandarin: 指由多塊椎骨構成，支撐人體軀幹並保護脊髓的骨性結構，也可泛指後背的中軸部分。
explanation_english: The bony column made up of vertebrae that supports the trunk and protects the spinal cord; commonly referred to as the backbone or spine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我脊椎有少少移位，要做物理治療。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 zek3 zeoi1 jau5 siu2 siu2 ji4 wai6, jiu3 zou6 mat6 lei5 zi6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我的脊椎有点移位，需要做物理治疗。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said my spine is slightly misaligned and I need physiotherapy.

mandarin_meaning: 脊椎动物（jǐzhuī dòngwù）——指具有脊柱（脊椎）的动物，包括哺乳类、鸟类、爬行动物、两栖类和鱼类。
english_meaning: Vertebrate — an animal that has a backbone or spinal column (includes mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians and most fish).
explanation_mandarin: 脊椎動物是指具有脊柱（由一節節的椎骨組成）的動物類群，通常包括哺乳類、鳥類、爬蟲類、兩棲類和魚類，與無脊椎動物相對。
explanation_english: A vertebrate is an animal with a backbone (a series of vertebrae). Vertebrates include mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians and most fish, as opposed to invertebrates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 所有哺乳類、鳥類、爬蟲類、兩棲類同大部分魚類都係脊椎動物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: so2 jau5 bou3 juk6 leoi6, niu5 leoi6, paa4 cung4 leoi6, loeng5 cai1 leoi6 tung4 daai6 bou6 fan6 jyu4 leoi6 dou1 hai6 zek3 zeoi1 dung6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 所有哺乳類、鳥類、爬蟲類、兩棲類和大部分魚類都是脊椎動物。
examples.english_sentence: All mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians and most fish are vertebrates.

mandarin_meaning: 脊椎按摩師 / 整脊醫生
english_meaning: chiropractor (spine specialist)
explanation_mandarin: 專門治療脊椎或脊柱相關問題的治療師或醫生，常以手法矯正、按摩或物理治療為主。
explanation_english: A practitioner or clinician who treats spine-related problems, typically using manual adjustments, massage, or physical therapies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近背痛，想搵脊醫睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 bui3 tung3, soeng2 wan2 zek3 ji1 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近背痛，想找脊椎按摩師看看。
examples.english_sentence: I've had back pain recently and want to see a chiropractor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位有牌照嘅脊醫，專門做脊椎矯正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 jau5 paai4 ziu3 ge3 zek3 ji1, zyun1 mun4 zou6 zek3 zeoi1 giu2 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位有牌照的脊椎按摩師，專門做脊椎矯正。
examples.english_sentence: He is a licensed chiropractor who specializes in spinal adjustments.

mandarin_meaning: 脊饰（背部的装饰性结构或突起）
english_meaning: dorsal ornamentation; decorative or structural features on the back (e.g., crests, bony plates, spines)
explanation_mandarin: 指動物或模型背部的裝飾性結構或突起，如冠、骨板、棘等；常用於動物形態學、古生物或生物學描述中。
explanation_english: Refers to decorative or structural features on an animal's back (dorsal side), such as crests, bony plates, or spines; commonly used in morphology, zoology, or paleontology descriptions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻恐龍模型有好明顯嘅脊飾，背脊上有一列骨板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 hung2 lung4 mou4 jing4 jau5 hou2 ming4 hin2 ge3 zek3 sik1, bui3 zek3 soeng6 jau5 jat1 lit6 gwat1 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個恐龍模型有很明顯的脊飾，背脊上有一列骨板。
examples.english_sentence: This dinosaur model has very prominent dorsal ornamentation; there is a row of bony plates along its back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 生物學家研究魚類嘅脊飾同佢哋游水姿勢嘅關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: saang1 mat6 hok6 gaa1 jin4 gau3 jyu4 leoi6 ge3 zek3 sik1 tung4 keoi5 dei6 jau4 seoi2 zi1 sik1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 生物學家研究魚類的脊飾與牠們游泳姿勢的關係。
examples.english_sentence: Biologists study the relationship between fish dorsal ornamentation and their swimming posture.

mandarin_meaning: 脊柱；脊椎骨；比喻骨氣或支柱
english_meaning: spine; backbone; (figuratively) backbone, courage, or main support
explanation_mandarin: 指人體由一連串椎骨組成的脊柱或單個脊椎骨。在口語或書面語中也常用來比喻一個人或事物的骨氣、骨幹或支柱地位。
explanation_english: Refers to the spine composed of vertebrae or an individual vertebra. It is also used figuratively to mean someone's backbone, moral courage, or the main support of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條脊骨斷咗，要睇醫生同做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 zik6 gwat1 dyun3 zo2, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1 tung4 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的脊骨断了，需要看医生并做手术。
examples.english_sentence: His spine is broken; he needs to see a doctor and have surgery.

mandarin_meaning: 脊髓（中枢神经系统的一部分，位于脊椎管内）
english_meaning: spinal cord
explanation_mandarin: 脊髓是中枢神经系统的一部分，位于脊椎管內，负责在大脑与身体各部分之间传递神经信号，并控制许多反射活动。
explanation_english: The spinal cord is part of the central nervous system located within the vertebral column, responsible for transmitting neural signals between the brain and the rest of the body and mediating many reflexes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺車禍入面傷咗脊髓，依家下半身冇乜感覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ce1 fo3 jap6 min6 soeng1 zo2 zek3 seoi2, ji4 gaa1 haa6 bun3 san1 mou5 mat1 gam2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在车祸中伤到脊髓，现在下半身没有感觉。
examples.english_sentence: He injured his spinal cord in the car accident and now has no feeling in his lower body.

mandarin_meaning: 扎；刺；戳（用尖物刺入或戳的動作，書面少見，方言或口語中可見）
english_meaning: to prick / to stab / to poke (an action of stabbing or poking with a pointed object; rare/colloquial character)
explanation_mandarin: 「脌」是較罕見的字，粵語中可用來表示用尖銳物件刺、扎或戳的動作。此字在現代書面語中不常見，更多出現在方言、口語或古籍裡。意思與「扎」「刺」「戳」相近。
explanation_english: The character "脌" is a rare/archaic form used in Cantonese to indicate the action of pricking, stabbing, or poking with a pointed object. It is uncommon in modern standard writing and appears more in dialectal or colloquial contexts. Its meaning is similar to "to prick/ poke/ stab."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用枝針脌咗我一下，做我驚一驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zek3 zam1 zat6 zo2 ngo5 jat1 haa6, zou6 ngo5 ging1 jat1 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用针扎了我一下，讓我嚇了一跳。
examples.english_sentence: He pricked me once with a needle, which startled me.

mandarin_meaning: 后脑勺
english_meaning: back of the head (nape)
explanation_mandarin: 口語中指人的後腦位置，即後腦勺，通常用於描述被打或碰到後腦的位置。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term for the back of the head (nape). Commonly used when describing being hit or bumped on the back of the head.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一巴打咗我脌頭，我即刻暈咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 baa1 daa2 zo2 ngo5 gwat1 tau4, ngo5 zik1 haak1 wan4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打了我的后脑勺，我立刻头晕了。
examples.english_sentence: He hit the back of my head; I immediately felt dizzy.

mandarin_meaning: 脖子 (bózi)，指頸部
english_meaning: neck (the part between the head and shoulders); nape
explanation_mandarin: 「脖」常見於合成詞如「脖子」，表示頸部，即連接頭部與軀幹的部位。在粵語口語中通常與「子」或「頸」搭配使用。
explanation_english: The character refers to the neck. It usually appears in compounds such as "脖子" and denotes the area connecting the head and the torso. In Cantonese it is commonly used together with particles like "子" or alongside "頸".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢脖子痛，要睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bok3 zi2 tung3, jiu3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的脖子痛，要看医生。
examples.english_sentence: His neck hurts; he needs to see a doctor.

mandarin_meaning: 脖子（指連接頭部和軀幹的部位）
english_meaning: neck (the part of the body connecting the head and torso)
explanation_mandarin: 指連接頭部和軀幹的部位，俗稱頸；可指解剖位置或描述不適、受傷等情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the part of the body that connects the head and the torso (commonly called the neck); used for anatomical reference or to describe discomfort or injury.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你脖子痛唔痛？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bok6 zi2 tung3 m4 tung3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你脖子痛不痛？
examples.english_sentence: Does your neck hurt?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 外套太緊，脖子好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngoi6 tou3 taai3 gan2, bok6 zi2 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外套太緊，脖子很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The coat is too tight; my neck feels very uncomfortable.

mandarin_meaning: 吻（古字或異體字），意為親吻或嘴唇部位
english_meaning: A variant of '吻' meaning a kiss; also refers to the mouth/lips; can be noun or verb (to kiss)
explanation_mandarin: 「脗」為較少使用或古書中的字，常與「吻」通用。可作名詞表示一次親吻或嘴唇部位，也可作動詞表示親吻。
explanation_english: A less common or archaic character often used interchangeably with '吻'. It can be a noun meaning a kiss (or the lip/mouth area) or a verb meaning to kiss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀咗我一個脗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 go3 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他给了我一个吻。
examples.english_sentence: He gave me a kiss.

mandarin_meaning: 脚（jiǎo）：足；腿的部位，用於行走或站立。
english_meaning: foot (or sometimes leg) — the body part used for standing and walking.
explanation_mandarin: 指人的腳或動物的足部，為行走、支撐身體的重要部位。亦常出現在各種詞語和口語表達中。
explanation_english: Refers to the foot (or the lower extremity) — the body part used for walking and supporting the body. Commonly appears in compounds and colloquial expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻腳好痕，可能畀蚊咬咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 goek3 hou2 hon4, ho2 nang4 bei2 man1 ngaau5 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的脚很痒，可能被蚊子咬了。
examples.english_sentence: My foot is very itchy; it might have been bitten by a mosquito.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我跑步之後，雙腳好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 paau2 bou6 zi1 hau6, soeng1 goek3 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑步之后，我的双脚很累。
examples.english_sentence: After running, my feet are very tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心啲，樓梯濕，你會跌親腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 di1, lau4 tai1 sap1, nei5 wui5 dit3 can1 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心点，楼梯很湿，你会摔伤脚。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful, the stairs are wet — you could injure your foot.

mandarin_meaning: 胫（小腿前部，介于膝盖与脚踝之间）
english_meaning: shin (the front part of the lower leg between the knee and the ankle)
explanation_mandarin: 指小腿前方靠近膝蓋與踝之間的部位，常用來描述身體部位或該處受傷的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to the shin — the front area of the lower leg between the knee and ankle. Commonly used to describe that body part or injuries to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢踢波踢到脛痛，行路都唔方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tek3 bo1 tek3 dou3 geng3 tung3, haang4 lou6 dou1 m4 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他踢足球把胫踢痛了，走路都不方便。
examples.english_sentence: He hurt his shin playing football, so it's difficult for him to walk.

mandarin_meaning: 罕用字，無固定現代普通話詞義；偶見於古籍或作人名用字
english_meaning: A rare/archaic character with no established modern Mandarin meaning; occasionally seen in classical texts or used in personal names
explanation_mandarin: 「脢」為罕見漢字，現代漢語中少見，沒有固定的通用讀音或常用義，常在古籍或人名中偶見。
explanation_english: The character "脢" is rare and archaic. It has no widely accepted modern reading or meaning in standard Mandarin and is mostly encountered in classical texts or occasionally as part of proper names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「脢」係一個好罕見嘅字，日常唔會用到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: 「脢」hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hon2 gin3 ge3 zi6, jat6 soeng4 m4 wui5 jung6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「脢」是一个非常罕见的字，日常不会使用。
examples.english_sentence: "脢" is a very rare character and is not used in everyday language.

mandarin_meaning: 舌头肉（例如牛舌或猪舌），指动物舌部可食用的肉。
english_meaning: Tongue (meat) — the edible meat from an animal's tongue (e.g. beef tongue, pork tongue).
explanation_mandarin: 「脢肉」在廣東話中常指可食用的動物舌部肉，烹調方式包括滷、燒、紅燒或燉等。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "脢肉" commonly refers to edible tongue meat from animals. Common preparations include braising, roasting, stewing, or marinating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街市有賣新鮮脢肉，可以用嚟滷或者燒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 si5 jau5 maai6 san1 sin1 lei6 juk6, ho2 ji5 jung6 lai4 lou5 waak6 ze2 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 菜市場有賣新鮮的舌頭肉，可以用來滷或燒。
examples.english_sentence: The wet market sells fresh tongue meat; it can be braised or roasted.

mandarin_meaning: 小塊肉；肉片
english_meaning: a small piece or chunk of meat
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語，用以指較細的肉塊或在煮食、煲湯時加入的肉粒。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for a small piece or chunk of meat, often mentioned when cooking or making soup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煲湯記得加啲脢頭，咁會更香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou1 tong1 gei3 dak1 gaa1 di1 mai5 tau4, gam2 wui5 gang1 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 煲湯記得加一些小塊肉，這樣會更香。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to add some small pieces of meat to the soup; it will taste better.

mandarin_meaning: 唇；嘴唇
english_meaning: lip; lips
explanation_mandarin: 指人的嘴唇，位於口部外側的肉質部分，與說話、進食和表情有關。
explanation_english: Refers to the lips, the fleshy parts at the mouth's edge involved in speaking, eating, and facial expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冬天我啲脣好易乾裂，要搽潤脣膏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung1 tin1 ngo5 di1 seon4 hou2 ji6 gon1 lit3, jiu3 caat3 jeon6 seon4 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 冬天我的嘴唇很容易乾裂，要擦護唇膏。
examples.english_sentence: In winter my lips easily chap; I need to apply lip balm.

mandarin_meaning: 唇亡齒寒（比喻彼此依存，一方受損另一方也會遭殃）
english_meaning: Literally 'when the lips are gone, the teeth will be cold' — an idiom meaning mutual dependence: if one party is harmed, the other suffers as well.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻彼此依存、利害相關，常用以說明一方受損會牽連到另一方的情況。
explanation_english: An idiom describing mutual dependence or closely linked interests; harm to one side will adversely affect the other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司準備削減質檢部嘅預算，有同事話脣亡齒寒，其他部門都會跟住受影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeon2 bei6 sik1 gim2 zat1 gim2 bou6 ge3 jyu6 syun3 jau5 tung4 si6 waa6 seon4 mong4 ci2 hon4 kei4 taa1 bou6 mun4 dou1 wui5 gan1 zyu6 sau6 jing2 hoeng2
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司准备削减质检部的预算，有同事说：唇亡齿寒，其他部门也会受到影响。
examples.english_sentence: The company plans to cut the quality-control department's budget; some coworkers say, 'When the lips are gone the teeth will be cold' — other departments will also be affected.

mandarin_meaning: 甜言蜜語；奉承話
english_meaning: sweet talk; flattering words (glib flattery)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，指用甜言蜜語或奉承性的話去討好、哄騙或操控別人。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term for flattering or sweet talk used to please, coax, or deceive others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用脣筆哄人，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 seon4 bat1 hung3 jan4, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用甜言蜜語哄人，不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He uses sweet talk to coax people; don't trust him.

mandarin_meaning: 唇膏（口紅或潤唇膏）
english_meaning: lipstick / lip balm
explanation_mandarin: 塗抹在嘴唇上的化妝品，用於著色或保濕；在不同語境下可指口紅或潤唇膏。
explanation_english: A cosmetic applied to the lips to add color or provide moisture; depending on context it may mean lipstick or lip balm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱塗咗一支紅色嘅脣膏，好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aam1 aam1 tou4 zo2 jat1 zi1 hung4 sik1 ge3 seon4 gou1, hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她剛剛擦了一支紅色的唇膏，很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She just put on a red lipstick; it looks very pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見或古字，現代漢語中無常用意義（多作罕見字或人名、古籍用字）
english_meaning: a rare/obsolete character with no common modern usage (appears mainly in names or classical texts)
explanation_mandarin: 「脤」屬於罕見或古字，現代粵語和普通話中無固定、常用的讀音或義項。通常只在古籍、姓名或字典的異體字條目中出現，故難以找到一致的讀法或具體意義。
explanation_english: The character 脤 is a rare/obsolete hanzi with no established modern Cantonese or Mandarin pronunciation or common meaning. It mainly appears in classical texts, personal names, or as a variant form in specialized dictionaries, so consistent readings and definitions are generally not available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個字「脤」好罕見，唔知道有冇讀音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zi6 '脤' hou2 hon2 gin3, m4 zi1 dou3 jau5 mou5 duk6 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个字「脤」很罕见，不知道有没有读音。
examples.english_sentence: The character '脤' is very rare; I don't know if it has a pronunciation.

mandarin_meaning: 撩人；挑逗、吸引別人（多指打情罵俏或故意逗弄）
english_meaning: to flirt with someone; to tease or lead someone on
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俚語，通常指用言語或行為故意吸引或挑逗別人，常含調情或戲弄的意味。可用於社交場合或網絡互動中。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang verb meaning to deliberately attract, tease, or flirt with someone—often used for playful or flirtatious behaviour online or in social settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺社交平台脤人，唔係真係鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 se5 gaau1 ping4 toi4 liu1 jan4, m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常在社交平台撩人，不是因為真的喜歡對方。
examples.english_sentence: They often flirt with people on social media; it's not because they genuinely like them.

mandarin_meaning: 罕用字，無固定讀音或明確意義（多見於古文或字書註）
english_meaning: a rare/archaic character with no established pronunciation or clear meaning in modern Cantonese
explanation_mandarin: 「脧」為罕見漢字，現代漢語（包括廣東話）中通常沒有固定讀音或通行意義，常見於古籍或字典條目中註明為罕用字或異體字。
explanation_english: The character "脧" is a rare or archaic han character. In modern usage, including Cantonese, it typically has no established pronunciation or common meaning and is mainly encountered in classical texts or dictionary entries as a rare/variant character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 字典話「脧」係罕用字，喺現代廣東話冇固定讀音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 din2 waa6 '脧' hai6 hon2 jung6 zi6, hai6 jin6doi6 gwong2dung1waa2 mou5 gu3ding6 duk6jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 字典說「脧」是罕用字，在現代粵語沒有固定讀音。
examples.english_sentence: Dictionaries note that "脧" is a rare character and has no fixed pronunciation in modern Cantonese.

mandarin_meaning: 罕見或未被記錄的字/詞，粵語口語中無明確記錄或標準讀音
english_meaning: A rare or unrecorded character/term; not attested in common Cantonese usage and has no established pronunciation
explanation_mandarin: 「脧脧」在常見的粵語詞彙與辭典中缺乏明確記錄，沒有標準發音或固定詞義。它可能是罕見字、古字、誤寫或地方性用法，但在現代粵語口語中並不常見。若需確定，可查閱古籍、專門字典或地方語料。
explanation_english: “脧脧” is not clearly recorded in common Cantonese dictionaries or corpora and lacks an established pronunciation or fixed meaning. It may be a rare/archaic character, a misspelling, or a local usage, but it is not used in everyday modern Cantonese. For verification consult classical dictionaries or specialized Cantonese resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「脧脧」呢個字好罕見，平時唔會用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: 「脧脧」ne1 go3 zi6 hou2 hon2 gin3, ping4 si4 m4 wui5 jung6。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 「脧脧」這個字很罕見，平時不會使用。
examples.english_sentence: "脧脧" is a very rare character and is not used in everyday speech.

mandarin_meaning: 脱 (tuō)：脱下、摆脱、脱落等
english_meaning: to take off (clothing); to shed; to escape/get free from; to fall off
explanation_mandarin: 表示脫下、擺脫、脫離或掉落等動作或狀態，常用作動詞，亦可出現在複合詞中（如脫落、脫身）。
explanation_english: Indicates actions such as taking off (clothes), shedding, getting free/escaping, or falling off; commonly used as a verb and appears in compounds (e.g. 脫落, 脫身).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣咁熱，快啲脫件外套啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 gam2 jit6, faai3 di1 tyut3 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气这么热，快点把外套脱下来吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's so hot; take off your coat quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於脫身，冇畀人捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 tyut3 san1, mou5 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于脱身了，没有被人抓到。
examples.english_sentence: He finally escaped and wasn't caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對耳環好鬆，會脫落㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 ji5 waan4 hou2 sung1, wui5 tyut3 lok6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这对耳环很松，会脱落的。
examples.english_sentence: These earrings are loose and might fall off.

mandarin_meaning: 脱（表示脱掉、摆脱、逃脱等）
english_meaning: to take off; to shed; to get free/escape (used as a verb root in various compounds)
explanation_mandarin: 「脫」(tyut3) 是粤语常用动词，基本含义为脱掉（衣物等）、脱落、摆脱或逃脱。写作「脫*」时星号表示该字可与不同字组成短语或复合词（如脫衫、脫身、脫得），用法广泛。
explanation_english: “脫” (tyut3) is a common Cantonese verb meaning to take off (clothes), to shed, to get free or to escape. Writing it as “脫*” indicates a root that combines with other characters to form compounds (e.g. 脫衫, 脫身, 脫得).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢脫咗件衫喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tyut3 zo2 gin6 saam1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经脱了件衣服。
examples.english_sentence: He has taken off his shirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢脫得好快，追唔到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tyut3 dak1 hou2 faai3, zeoi1 m4 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他逃得很快，追不到他。
examples.english_sentence: He got away very quickly; we couldn't catch him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想搵方法脫身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 wan2 fong1 faat3 tyut3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想找办法脱身。
examples.english_sentence: I want to find a way to get out of this situation.

mandarin_meaning: 脫離世俗、不同凡俗；不庸俗、清新脫俗
english_meaning: unconventional; not ordinary or vulgar; refined and refreshing
explanation_mandarin: 形容不落入俗套、與眾不同或不庸俗，常用來形容風格、氣質或作品具有獨特且清新的特質。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that stands out from the ordinary or vulgar; refined, distinctive, and refreshing in style, temperament, or creation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅風格好脫俗，令人耳目一新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 fung1 gaak3 hou2 tyut3 zuk6, ling6 jan4 ji5 muk6 jat1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的風格很脫俗，令人耳目一新。
examples.english_sentence: His/her style is very unconventional and refreshing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件設計唔追潮流，反而顯得脫俗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 cit3 gai3 m4 zeoi1 ciu4 lau4, faan2 ji4 hin2 dak1 tyut3 zuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件設計不追潮流，反而顯得脫俗。
examples.english_sentence: This design doesn't follow trends and instead appears distinctive.

mandarin_meaning: 脱俗（不落俗套；高雅、與眾不同）
english_meaning: unconventional; not vulgar; refined; standing out from the ordinary
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或事物不落俗套、顯得高雅或與一般常態不同，帶有脫離庸俗的意思。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is not ordinary or vulgar; refined, elegant, or distinctive compared with the common or clichéd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅氣質好脫俗，行入房間即刻令人注目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hei3zat1 hou2 tyut3 zuk6, haang4 jap6 fong4gaan1 zik1hak1 ling6 jan4 zyu3 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的气质很脱俗，走进房间就让人注目。
examples.english_sentence: Her/his temperament is very refined; when they enter a room they immediately attract attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫風格脫俗，唔似市面上嗰啲俗套作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 fung1gok3 tyut3 zuk6, m4 ci5 si5min6 soeng6 go2 di1 zuk6tou3 zok3ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画风格脱俗，不像市面上那些俗套的作品。
examples.english_sentence: This painting has an unconventional style; it's not like the banal works on the market.

mandarin_meaning: 脱光（脱掉所有衣服）
english_meaning: to strip naked; to take off all one's clothes
explanation_mandarin: 口语用法，表示把全身的衣服全部脱掉。有时也可夸张地用于表示将某物完全去除或露出。
explanation_english: A colloquial expression meaning to remove all of one's clothes (to be naked). Can also be used figuratively to mean removing something entirely or exposing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺海灘脫光晒游水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hoi2 taan1 tyut3 gwong1 saai3 jau4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她在海滩上脱光了游泳。
examples.english_sentence: He/She stripped naked and swam at the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以喺公司脫光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 hai2 gung1 si1 tyut3 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能在公司脱光。
examples.english_sentence: You can't take off all your clothes at the office.

mandarin_meaning: 脫鉤；脫離、抽身／切斷關係
english_meaning: to unhook / to decouple; to withdraw from or cut ties with someone or something
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用詞，表示與某人或某事物脫離關係、退出或不再負責／不再牽涉，亦可用作描述在經濟或合作上的「脫鉤」現象。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial verb meaning to withdraw from, abandon, or cut ties with a person, project, or obligation. It can also describe 'decoupling' in economic or cooperative contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一有事就脫勾，成日都係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jau5 si6 zau6 tyut3 gau1, sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一有事就脫鉤，經常是這樣。
examples.english_sentence: Whenever there's trouble, he bails out — he's always like that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定與有爭議嘅項目脫勾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 jyu5 jau5 zang1 ji4 ge3 hong6 muk6 tyut3 gau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司決定與有爭議的項目脫鉤。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to sever ties with the controversial project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年嚟有人講緊兩國經濟開始脫勾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan6 nin4 lai4 jau5 di1 jan4 gong2 gan2 loeng5 gwok3 ging1 zai3 hoi1 ci2 tyut3 gau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年來有人說兩國經濟開始脫鉤。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years people have said the two countries' economies are beginning to decouple.

mandarin_meaning: 脱钩/脱勾（取消挂钩、解除联系；在经济或社交媒体语境可指脱离依赖或取关）
english_meaning: to decouple / to unhook / to sever a link or connection; (colloquially) to unfollow or unlink
explanation_mandarin: 非正式或口語用法，指解除兩者之間的掛鉤或關係。可用於政策或經濟語境（脫鉤），也可在社交媒體上指取關或取消連繫。
explanation_english: An informal/colloquial term meaning to remove a link or connection between two parties or systems. Used in policy/economic contexts for 'decoupling' and colloquially for unfollowing or unlinking on social media.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府喺諗緊要唔要同外國脫勾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hai2 lam2 gan2 jiu3 m4 jiu3 tung4 ngoi6 gwok3 tyut3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府在考虑是否要与外国脱钩。
examples.english_sentence: The government is considering whether to decouple from foreign countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺IG將我脫勾咗，唔知點解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 IG zoeng1 ngo5 tyut3 gou1 zo2, m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在IG上把我脱钩了，不知道為什麼。
examples.english_sentence: He unfollowed/unlinked me on Instagram; I don't know why.

mandarin_meaning: （常見於“脫口而出”）不經思考就說出話來，說漏了話
english_meaning: to blurt out; to say something without thinking; to let something slip out
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞（常用於片語“脫口而出”）
explanation_mandarin: 指說話時未經深思、控制不住而說出來的話，常用於“脫口而出”。可表示不小心或情緒化地說出某句話。
explanation_english: Refers to saying something without thinking or control, often used in the phrase "脫口而出". It describes an unintentional or impulsive utterance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心脫口講咗啲唔應該講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 tyut3 hau2 gong2 zo2 di1 m4 jing1 goi1 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心脫口說出了不該說的話。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally blurted out something I shouldn't have.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時激動，脫口而出話佢唔想再見佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 gik1 dung6, tyut3 hau2 ji4 ceot1 waa6 keoi5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 gin3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一時激動，脫口而出說他不想再見她。
examples.english_sentence: He got emotional and blurted out that he didn't want to see her again.

mandarin_meaning: 脱口而出；不经思考就说出
english_meaning: to blurt out; to say something without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 指在未經深思的情況下突然說出話來，常帶有無意或失言的含義。常見用法為「脫口而出」。
explanation_english: Refers to suddenly saying something without thinking, often unintentionally or as a slip of the tongue. Commonly used in the form "脫口而出" (to blurt out).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心脫口講咗佢嘅秘密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 tyut3 hau2 gong2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 bei3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心脱口说出他的秘密。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally blurted out his secret.

mandarin_meaning: 脱口而出；不经思考就说出来
english_meaning: to blurt out; to say something suddenly without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 形容话语未经思考、突然说出来，常带有不经意或失言的意思。
explanation_english: Describes saying something suddenly and without thinking, often unintentionally or resulting in a gaffe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心脫口而出，結果得罪咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 tyut3 hau2 ji4 ceot1, git3 gwo2 dak1 zeoi6 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心脱口而出，结果得罪了他。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally blurted it out and ended up offending him.

mandarin_meaning: 脱口而出；不假思索地说出
english_meaning: to blurt out; to say something impulsively or without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 指沒經過深思熟慮就把話說出來，常用於一時衝動、失言或不小心說漏了秘密的情況。
explanation_english: Refers to saying something without careful thought; often used when someone blurts out something in a moment of impulse, makes a slip of the tongue, or accidentally reveals a secret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一時嬲，脫口而出咗幾句傷人嘅說話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 si4 nau1, tyut3 hau2 ji4 ceot1 zo2 gei2 geoi3 soeng1 jan4 ge3 syut3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一时生气，脱口而出几句伤人的话。
examples.english_sentence: I was briefly angry and blurted out a few hurtful things.

mandarin_meaning: （口）非常好笑；笑得停不下来（相当于「笑死」）
english_meaning: hilarious; extremely funny (slang) — laugh one's head off
explanation_mandarin: 「脫市」是香港粵語俚語，常用來形容某事非常好笑，會讓人笑到停不下來或笑到難受。常出現在口語或網絡語境中（例如「笑到脫市」）。
explanation_english: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used to describe something extremely funny or uproarious (literally 'drop out of the market'). Often used in colloquial speech or online (e.g., 'laugh until you drop').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰個笑話真係脫市，我笑到肚痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 go3 siu3waa6 zan1 hai6 tyut3 si5, ngo5 siu3 dou3 tou5 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你讲的那个笑话真是太好笑了，我笑得肚子都痛了。
examples.english_sentence: That joke you told is hilarious — I laughed until my stomach hurt.

mandarin_meaning: 出戲；失去沉浸感，打破情境或脫離主題
english_meaning: to break character / to break the immersion; to spoil the mood or go off-topic
explanation_mandarin: 指在觀賞、表演或談話時，因某人或某事出現而打破情境或失去沉浸感；演員亦可指在表演中脫離角色狀態（跑戲）。在非表演語境也可指離題或破壞氣氛。
explanation_english: Refers to breaking the immersive atmosphere in a performance, conversation, or situation—e.g., an actor losing character, or someone saying something that spoils the mood. Can also mean going off-topic or disrupting the flow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰場戲本來好感人，但有個演員講錯台詞，全場都脫戲咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 coeng4 hei3 bun2 loi4 hou2 gam2 jan4, daan6 jau5 go3 jin2 jyun4 gong2 co3 toi4 ci4, cyun4 coeng4 dou1 tyut3 hei3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那場戲本來很感人，但有個演員念錯臺詞，全場都出戲了。
examples.english_sentence: That show was supposed to be moving, but one actor flubbed his lines and the whole audience lost immersion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘢咁離題，完全脫戲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 je5 gam2 lei4 tai4, jyun4 cyun4 tyut3 hei3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說話這麼離題，完全脫戲了。
examples.english_sentence: You're being so off-topic — you've completely broken the mood.

mandarin_meaning: 脱手（放手、脱手而出；把物品卖掉或处理掉；从手中滑落）
english_meaning: to let go; to slip out of one's hand; to sell or dispose of (an item)
explanation_mandarin: 「脫手」可指物品從手中滑落或被放開，也可指把某物賣掉或處理掉（脫手掉）。在廣東話中常用於描述賣出或擺脫某物。
explanation_english: “脫手” can mean an object slipping out of one's hand or being released, and colloquially it also means to sell or get rid of something. Commonly used to describe selling or disposing of items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張梳化好快就脫手喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 so1 faa3 hou2 faai3 zau6 tyut3 sau2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這張沙發很快就賣掉了。
examples.english_sentence: This sofa will be sold quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我手一滑，杯仔脫手跌咗落地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sau2 jat1 waa6, bui1 zai2 tyut3 sau2 dit3 zo2 lok6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我手一滑，杯子脫手掉到地上了。
examples.english_sentence: My hand slipped and the cup slipped out of my hand onto the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司想脫手嗰個舊倉庫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 soeng2 tyut3 sau2 go2 go3 gau6 cong1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司想把那個舊倉庫出售/脫手。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to sell off that old warehouse.

mandarin_meaning: 脱手（将东西从手上掉落或把物品卖掉/处理掉）
english_meaning: to slip out of one's hand; to get rid of or sell something
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中“脫手”常有两层意思：一是指物品从手中脱落（滑落、掉落）；二是指将物品卖掉或处理掉（脱手出售）。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '脫手' commonly has two senses: (1) something slips out of one's hand (falls or is released), and (2) to get rid of or sell an item (dispose of it).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想再留住嗰件衫，想快啲脫手佢。
