examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoi6 lau4 zyu6 go2 gin6 saam1, soeng2 faai3 di1 tyut3 sau2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想再留那件衣服，想盡快脫手它。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to keep that shirt anymore; I want to get rid of it quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貨滯銷，最後都脫手咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 fo3 zai6 siu1, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 tyut3 sau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 貨物滯銷，最後都賣掉了。
examples.english_sentence: The goods were hard to sell, but in the end they were sold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個唔穩，杯就脫手跌爛咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 m4 wan2, bui1 zau6 tyut3 sau2 dit3 laan6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一個不穩，杯子就脫手摔碎了。
examples.english_sentence: He was unsteady and the cup slipped out of his hand and shattered.

mandarin_meaning: 被取消（演出/明星身份）；從名單或劇組中剔除
english_meaning: to be removed/dropped (from a cast or roster); to lose one's 'star' status (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語/俚語，常用於娛樂圈或群體中，指某人被從演出名單、劇組或明星行列中剔除，失去出演或“星”身份。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang verb used especially in entertainment contexts to say someone has been removed or dropped from a cast, roster, or lost their status as a 'star'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢喺套新劇度被脫星，唔使上鏡啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 gong2 keoi5 hai6 tou3 san1 kek6 dou6 bei6 tyut3 sing1, m4 sai2 soeng5 geng2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他在那部新剧里被除名/取消出演，不用再上镜了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he was removed from that new drama and won't have to appear on camera anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 失去明星地位；人氣下跌
english_meaning: to lose star status; to fall out of favor or popularity
explanation_mandarin: 口語俚語，常用於香港粵語，指一個人（通常指名人或藝人）由受歡迎或有名氣變得不再受注目或人氣下降。
explanation_english: Colloquial Cantonese slang, commonly used in Hong Kong, meaning that someone (usually a celebrity or public figure) loses popularity or is no longer in the spotlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個歌手出事之後，慢慢脫星，冇人再理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 go1 sau2 ceot1 si6 zi1 hau6, maan6 maan6 tyut3 sing1, mou5 jan4 zoi3 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個歌手出事之後，慢慢就不再是明星了，沒人再理他。
examples.english_sentence: That singer, after the incident, gradually lost star status and nobody paid attention to him anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 脫掉喪服；結束服喪；（也可）脫去衣服
english_meaning: to end a period of mourning / to remove mourning garments; (also) to take off clothes
explanation_mandarin: 指結束服喪期、脫掉喪服。在某些語境下也可泛指脫去衣物。通常用於較正式或禮節性的情境。
explanation_english: Refers to ending a mourning period by removing mourning garments. In some contexts it can also mean to take off clothes. Typically used in formal or ritual contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿媽啱啱脫服，屋企可以開始擺喜宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 maa1 ngaam1 ngaam1 tyut3 fuk6, uk1 kei2 ho2 ji5 hoi1 ci2 baai2 hei2 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他媽媽剛脫服，家裡可以開始擺喜宴。
examples.english_sentence: His mother has just come out of mourning; the family can start holding the wedding banquet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太熱，忍唔住脫服換衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 jit6, jan2 m4 zyu6 tyut3 fuk6 wun6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太熱，忍不住脫掉衣服換衫。
examples.english_sentence: He was so hot he couldn't help taking off his clothes to change.

mandarin_meaning: 戒毒 / 排毒
english_meaning: to detox; to quit drugs; to cleanse toxins
explanation_mandarin: 口語／俗語，表示戒除毒品或清除體內毒素的行為。常用於指戒毒治療或做排毒療程，也可泛指擺脫上癮行為。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang verb meaning to detox — to stop using drugs or to eliminate toxins from the body. Commonly used for drug rehabilitation or detox programs, and can also refer generally to breaking an addiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於成功脫毒，依家已經冇再碰過毒品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 tyut3 duk6, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 mou5 zoi3 pung3 gwo3 duk6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於成功戒毒，現在已經沒有再接觸毒品。
examples.english_sentence: He finally succeeded in detoxing; he hasn't touched drugs since.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺醫院有個脫毒課程，幫助吸毒者戒斷毒癮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 ji1 jyun2 jau5 go3 tyut3 duk6 fo3 cing4, bong1 zo6 kap1 duk6 ze2 gaai3 dyun6 duk6 jan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們在醫院有一個脫毒課程，幫助吸毒者戒斷毒癮。
examples.english_sentence: They have a detox program at the hospital to help drug users break their addiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近去做脫毒療程，想清理體內嘅毒素，改善氣色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 heoi3 zou6 tyut3 duk6 liu4 cing4, soeng2 ceng1 lei5 tai2 noi6 ge3 duk6 sou3, goi2 sin3 hei3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近去做脫毒療程，想清理體內的毒素，改善氣色。
examples.english_sentence: I've been doing a detox program recently to cleanse toxins from my body and improve my complexion.

mandarin_meaning: 戒毒；擺脫毒癮（口語）
english_meaning: to detox; to quit drugs; to kick a drug habit (colloquial)
explanation_mandarin: 「脫毒」為廣東話口語，通常指戒除毒品，擺脫毒癮；在某些情況下也可泛指排除體內毒素或戒除成癮行為。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term meaning to quit drugs or kick a drug habit. It can also be used more broadly for detoxifying (removing toxins) or giving up addictive behaviors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於脫毒成功咗，依家生活穩定晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 tyut3 duk6 sing4 gung1 zo2, ji4 gaa1 saang1 wut6 wan2 ding6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於戒掉毒品了，現在生活很穩定。
examples.english_sentence: He finally kicked the drug habit and now his life is stable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間中心幫助吸毒者脫毒同重建生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zung1 sam1 bong1 zo6 kap1 duk6 ze2 tyut3 duk6 tung4 cung4 gin3 saang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間中心幫助吸毒者戒毒並重建生活。
examples.english_sentence: This center helps drug users detox and rebuild their lives.

mandarin_meaning: 脱毛；去除体毛；（动物）换毛、掉毛
english_meaning: to remove hair (e.g. waxing/laser); to shed hair or fur
explanation_mandarin: 「脫毛」在廣東話常用有兩個意思：一是指美容或醫療上去除體毛（如蠟脫、雷射脫毛）；二是指人或動物毛髮脫落、掉毛或換毛。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "脫毛" commonly means either hair removal (beauty/medical procedures such as waxing or laser) or the shedding of hair/fur by people or animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜去美容院脫毛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 mei5 jung4 jyun2 tyut3 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个礼拜去美容院脱毛。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to the beauty salon next week to get hair removal.

mandarin_meaning: 脫水（醫學或物理上失去水分）；也可作比喻或廣東話俚語，指精力耗盡或內容被刪減（脫去細節）
english_meaning: dehydration (loss of water physically or medically); to dehydrate; colloquially, to be drained/exhausted or to have content stripped/abridged
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指身體或物體失去水分（如因嘔吐、腹瀉或乾燥處理）。2) 口語上可指人精力耗盡（被形容為“脫水”）。3) 在某些情況下也用作“刪減、去掉細節或水分”（如內容被編輯得較簡略）。
explanation_english: 1) Refers to loss of water in the body or an object (e.g., from vomiting, diarrhea, or dehydration processes). 2) Colloquially used to say someone is drained or exhausted. 3) Sometimes used to mean that content has been stripped down or abridged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗，成日嘔同拉肚，醫生話佢有啲脫水，要打點滴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2, sing4jat6 ngau2 tung4 laai1tou5, ji1sang1 waa6 keoi5 jau5 di1 tyut3 seoi2, jiu3 daa2 dim2 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了，經常嘔吐和腹瀉，醫生說他有些脫水，需要打點滴。
examples.english_sentence: He got sick, kept vomiting and having diarrhea; the doctor said he was a bit dehydrated and needed an IV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個禮拜加班加到我脫水，返到屋企成個人冇晒力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lai5baai3 gaa1baan1 gaa1 dou3 ngo5 tyut3 seoi2, faan1 dou3 uk1kei5 sing4 go3 jan4 mou5 saai3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這星期加班到把我累得精疲力盡。
examples.english_sentence: I've worked so much overtime this week that I'm totally drained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房用脫水機去脫水蔬果，做成乾貨保存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyu4fong4 jung6 tyut3 seoi2 gei1 heoi3 tyut3 seoi2 so1gwo2, zou6 sing4 gon1 fo3 bou2cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 廚房用脫水機把蔬果脫水，製成乾貨保存。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen uses a dehydrator to remove water from fruits and vegetables to make dried goods for storage.

mandarin_meaning: （廣東話俚語）失去節制、表現誇張或即興搞笑
english_meaning: Cantonese slang meaning to lose restraint or go over-the-top (often jokingly); to act wildly or do something hilariously unrestrained
explanation_mandarin: 「脫片」是香港廣東話的俗語／俚語，通常用來形容人在公開場合或表演時突然表現得很瘋狂、誇張或即興搞笑，令周圍人爆笑。亦可指脫離原定劇本、做出出乎意料的表現。
explanation_english: “脫片” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang used to describe someone suddenly acting wildly, exaggeratedly, or doing impromptu comedy in public or on stage — often causing others to laugh. It can also mean breaking away from the script to perform unexpectedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上次喺舞台上真係脫片，成場觀眾笑到停唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 ci3 hai2 mou5 toi4 soeng6 zan1 hai6 tyut3 pin3, sing4 coeng4 gun1 zung3 siu3 dou3 ting4 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上次在舞台上真的是脫片，整場觀眾笑個不停。
examples.english_sentence: He really went wild on stage last time — the whole audience couldn't stop laughing.

mandarin_meaning: 脱皮；（口語）被宰、被坑
english_meaning: to shed/peel (skin); (slang) to be ripped off / to get cheated
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指皮膚脫落、脫屑，例如曬傷後皮膚脫皮；口語上在廣東話中可指被人宰或被坑（付出過多金錢）。
explanation_english: Literally, to shed or peel skin (e.g. after sunburn). Colloquially in Cantonese it can mean to be ripped off or cheated (paying too much).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我曬咗太陽，依家開始脫皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 saai3 zo2 taai3 joeng4, ji4 gaa1 hoi1 ci2 tyut3 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我晒了太阳，现在开始脱皮。
examples.english_sentence: I got sunburned and my skin is peeling now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗部電話，俾人脫哂皮，貴到離譜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bou6 din6 waa6, bei2 jan4 tyut3 saai3 pei4, gwai3 dou3 lei4 pou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了部手机，被人宰得很厉害，贵得离谱。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a phone and got totally ripped off — it was ridiculously expensive.

mandarin_meaning: 脱稿（不按稿子即兴发挥）
english_meaning: to go off-script; to improvise (speak or perform without following a prepared script)
explanation_mandarin: 指在演讲或表演时不按稿子，而是在现场即兴发挥或脱离原有稿件。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking or performing without following a prepared script; to ad-lib or improvise during a speech or performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次嘅演講完全脫稿，唔使睇稿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 ge3 jin2 gong2 jyun4 cyun4 tyut3 gou2, m4 sai2 tai2 gou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次的演讲完全脱稿，不用看稿子。
examples.english_sentence: His speech this time was completely off-script; he didn't need to read from notes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 節目主持人唔記得帶稿子，只好即興脫稿，結果都幾順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zit3 muk6 zyu2 ci4 jan4 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 gou2 zi2, zi2 hou2 zik1 hing3 tyut3 gou2, git3 gwo2 dou1 gei2 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 节目主持人忘记带稿子，只好即兴脱稿，结果还挺顺利的。
examples.english_sentence: The show's host forgot to bring the script, so had to improvise off the cuff, and it turned out quite smoothly.

mandarin_meaning: 脱稿（即兴、不按稿子）
english_meaning: to go off-script; to ad-lib; to improvise (speak or perform without a prepared script)
explanation_mandarin: 指在沒有稿本或不按照稿本內容而即興發言或表演，即臨場脫離原定稿子，常用於演講、節目或訪問中。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking or performing without following a prepared script — to ad-lib or improvise. Commonly used for speeches, broadcasts, or interviews when someone departs from the planned text.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上突然脫稿，講得好流利，觀眾賞識佢嘅即興反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng5 dat6 jin4 tyut3 gou2, gong2 dak1 hou2 lau4 lei6, gun1 zung3 soeng2 sik1 keoi5 ge3 zik1 hing3 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上突然脱稿，讲得很流利，觀眾欣賞他的即興反應。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly went off-script on stage and spoke fluently; the audience appreciated his improvisational responses.

mandarin_meaning: 脱颖而出（tuō yǐng ér chū）：在众人中显露才能、表现突出
english_meaning: to reveal one's talent; to stand out; to emerge prominently from a group
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人在眾多人或競爭中顯露出才能或優勢，表現突出，超過其他人。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who reveals their talent or advantages and stands out from others in a competition or group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺今次嘅比賽入面，佢嘅表現好突出，真係脫穎而出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam1 ci3 ge3 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6, keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin6 hou2 dat6 ceot1, zan1 hai6 tyut3 wing5 ji4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这次的比赛中，他的表现很突出，真的是脱颖而出。
examples.english_sentence: In this competition, his performance was outstanding; he truly stood out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新入職嗰幾位同事經過培訓後終於脫穎而出，得到升職機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jap6 zik1 go2 gei2 wai2 tung4 si6 ging1 gwo3 pui4 fan3 hau6 zung1 jyu1 tyut3 wing5 ji4 ceot1, dak1 dou3 sing1 zik1 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新入职的几位同事经过培训后终于脱颖而出，得到了升职的机会。
examples.english_sentence: After training, the new colleagues finally stood out and received promotion opportunities.

mandarin_meaning: 脱颖而出
english_meaning: to stand out; to emerge as outstanding among peers
explanation_mandarin: 表示在眾人之中顯露才能或表現突出，從而被認可或受到注意。
explanation_english: Indicates someone showing exceptional talent or performance and standing out from the crowd.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新來嘅工程師喺個項目入面表現出色，終於喺公司脫穎而出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 loi4 ge3 gung1 cing4 si1 hai2 go3 hong6 muk6 jap6 min6 biu2 jin6 ceot1 sik1, zung1 jyu1 hai2 gung1 si1 tyut3 wing5 ji4 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新来的工程师在项目中表现出色，终于在公司脱颖而出。
examples.english_sentence: The new engineer performed so well on the project that he finally stood out in the company.

mandarin_meaning: （与……）脱节；不连贯、不相衔接
english_meaning: to be out of touch / disconnected; not in sync; a break in continuity
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或某些方面彼此之間缺乏聯繫或不協調，導致不能順暢銜接或理解，例如想法、溝通或制度與現實脫節。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of connection or coordination between things, causing a break in continuity or failure to align—e.g., ideas, communication, or systems being out of touch with reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學校教育同社會脫節，學生未準備好入職場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 haau6 gaau3 juk6 tung4 se5 wui6 tyut3 zit3, hok6 saang1 mei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 jap6 zik1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 學校教育與社會脫節，學生未準備好進入職場。
examples.english_sentence: School education is out of touch with society; students aren't prepared to enter the workforce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅講法好脫節，聽唔到重點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gong2 faat3 hou2 tyut3 zit3, teng1 m4 dou2 zung6 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的說法很脫節，聽不出重點。
examples.english_sentence: His way of speaking is disjointed and you can't get the main point.

mandarin_meaning: 脱罪（免除罪责、被宣判无罪）
english_meaning: to be exonerated; to be acquitted; to escape guilt or criminal liability
explanation_mandarin: 表示免除刑事責任或被裁定無罪，常用於法律或社會語境。
explanation_english: Means to be cleared of criminal responsibility or declared not guilty; commonly used in legal or social contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搵律師幫手，最後成功脫罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan2 leot6 si1 bong1 sau2, zeoi3 hau6 sing4 gung1 tyut3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他請律師幫忙，最後成功脫罪。
examples.english_sentence: He hired a lawyer to help and was ultimately acquitted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 證據不足，佢被法官判無罪，等於脫罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 geoi3 bat1 zuk1, keoi5 bei6 faat3 gun1 pun3 mou4 zeoi6, dang2 jyu1 tyut3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 證據不足，他被法官判無罪，等於脫罪。
examples.english_sentence: With insufficient evidence, he was found not guilty by the judge — effectively exonerated.

mandarin_meaning: 脱罪；洗脱罪名，免除罪责
english_meaning: to clear (someone) of guilt; to be exonerated; to escape blame
explanation_mandarin: 表示摆脱或免除罪责，使自己或他人不被判定有罪或洗清罪名，常用于法律或口語語境。
explanation_english: Means to rid oneself or someone else of criminal responsibility or blame — to be acquitted or to have charges dropped; used in legal and colloquial contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話自己冇做嗰件事，點都想脫罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 zou6 go2 gin6 si6, dim2 dou1 soeng2 tyut3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说自己没做那件事，无论如何都想脱罪。
examples.english_sentence: He says he didn't do that thing and is trying by all means to clear his name.

mandarin_meaning: 脫胎換骨 (tuō tāi huàn gǔ)：經歷重大改變、徹底改觀，常指由內而外的轉變或重生。
english_meaning: To undergo a complete transformation; to be reborn; to experience a radical change (often for the better).
explanation_mandarin: 原指像重生一樣改變身體或本質，現多用來形容經過重大改變後，外觀、狀況或性格等徹底改觀。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a rebirth-like change of body or essence, it is now commonly used to describe a thorough change in appearance, condition, or character—often implying significant improvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次整容之後，佢真係脫胎換骨，樣子完全唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 zing2 jung4 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zan1 hai6 tyut3 toi1 wun6 gwat1, joeng6 zi2 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次整容之后，他真的脱胎换骨，样子完全不同。
examples.english_sentence: After the plastic surgery, he was completely transformed—his appearance is totally different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新管理層上任後，公司脫胎換骨，業績大幅提升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 gun2 lei5 cang4 soeng5 jam6 hau6, gung1 si1 tyut3 toi1 wun6 gwat1, jip6 zik1 daai6 fuk1 tai4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新管理层上任后，公司脱胎换骨，业绩大幅提升。
examples.english_sentence: After the new management took office, the company was transformed and its performance improved dramatically.

mandarin_meaning: 脱胎换骨
english_meaning: to be completely transformed; to undergo a complete rebirth or makeover
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物經歷重大變化，外貌、性格或情況發生根本性改變，像重獲新生一樣。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that has undergone a profound change in appearance, character, or condition — as if reborn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢做咗嗰次手術之後，佢真係脫胎換骨，整個人完全唔同咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 zou6 zo2 go2 ci3 sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zan1 hai6 tyut3 toi1 wun6 gwat1, zing2 go3 jan4 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自從他做了那次手術之後，他真是脫胎換骨，整個人完全不一樣了。
examples.english_sentence: Since he had that surgery, he has truly been reborn — his whole self is completely different.

mandarin_meaning: 脱脂
english_meaning: to remove fat; fat-free / low-fat; degrease / defat
explanation_mandarin: 指去掉脂肪或油脂。常用于食品（如脱脂奶）表示低脂或无脂，也用于工业上的去油处理（如对金属或材料进行脱脂）。
explanation_english: Refers to removing fat or oil. Used for foods (e.g., skimmed/low‑fat milk) to indicate low- or no-fat, and as a verb for industrial degreasing or defatting processes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想減肥就飲脫脂奶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 gaam2 fei4 zau6 jam2 tyut3 zi1 naai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想减肥就喝脱脂奶。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to lose weight, drink skimmed (fat-free) milk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做蛋糕我唔用脫脂奶，因為口感唔夠滑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 daan6 gou1 ngo5 m4 jung6 tyut3 zi1 naai5, jan1 wai6 hau2 gam2 m4 gau3 waat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做蛋糕我不用脱脂奶，因为口感不够顺滑。
examples.english_sentence: I don't use skimmed milk when baking cakes because the texture isn't smooth enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鋼材要脫脂先可以電鍍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong1 coi4 jiu3 tyut3 zi1 sin1 ho2 ji5 din6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钢材要脱脂才能电镀。
examples.english_sentence: The steel must be degreased before electroplating.

mandarin_meaning: （1）褪色；（2）（口）臉色沒了、丟臉（比喻）
english_meaning: (1) to fade (in color); (2) colloquial: to lose color/face — to go pale or be embarrassed/lose face
explanation_mandarin: 1) 指顏色因洗滌、日曬等而變淡、褪去。2) 口語用法，指因尷尬或被揭發而臉色變了或丟臉。
explanation_english: 1) Refers to colors fading (e.g., clothing losing dye after washing or sun exposure). 2) Colloquial use: to lose one's color/face — to go pale, feel embarrassed, or lose face when exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫洗咗幾次已經開始脫色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 sai2 zo2 gei2 ci3 ji5 ging1 hoi1 ci2 tyut3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服洗了几次已经开始褪色。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt has started to fade after being washed a few times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆當眾揭發佢嘅錯，佢即刻面都脫晒色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 dong3 zung3 kit3 faat3 keoi5 ge3 co3, keoi5 zik1 hak1 min6 dou1 tyut3 saai3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板当众揭发他的错误时，他立刻脸都没了颜色（很尴尬）。
examples.english_sentence: When the boss exposed his mistake in public, he immediately went pale with embarrassment.

mandarin_meaning: 褪色；掉色（衣物或物體顏色變淡或脫落）
english_meaning: to fade (in color); to discolor; color to come off
explanation_mandarin: 常用於描述衣物、染料或物體顏色因洗滌、日曬或磨損而變淡或脫落。偶爾也可比喻事物失去光彩或吸引力。
explanation_english: Commonly used to describe clothing, dyes, or surfaces losing or shedding color due to washing, sunlight, or wear. Can also be used figuratively to mean losing appeal or luster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫唔好用熱水洗，會脫色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 m4 hou2 jung6 jit6 seoi2 sai2, wui5 tyut3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服不要用热水洗，会褪色。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wash this garment with hot water; it will fade.

mandarin_meaning: 脱落 (tuōluò)
english_meaning: to fall off; to come off; to shed; to detach
explanation_mandarin: 表示從某物上或身體上脫離、掉落或剝離，例如頭髮、葉子、塗層等脫落。
explanation_english: Indicates something coming off or falling off from a surface or body part (e.g., hair, leaves, paint); to shed or detach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近成日頭髮脫落，好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 seng4 jat6 tau4 faat3 tyut3 lok6, hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近頭髮一直脫落，很擔心。
examples.english_sentence: My hair has been falling out a lot recently; I'm really worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牆上嘅油漆脫落咗好多，要請工人嚟整修。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 soeng6 ge3 jau4 caak3 tyut3 lok6 zo2 hou2 do1, jiu3 ceng2 gung1 jan4 lai4 zing2 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牆上的油漆脫落了很多，需要請工人來修整。
examples.english_sentence: The paint on the wall has peeled off a lot; we need to hire workers to repair it.

mandarin_meaning: 脱落
english_meaning: to fall off; to come off; to shed; to drop out; to be omitted
explanation_mandarin: 表示從物體表面或位置上掉下來或脫離的狀態，可用於頭髮、牙齒、貼紙、油漆等脫落，也可指文字或內容被省略或遺漏。
explanation_english: Indicates something falling off or coming loose from a surface or position. Can describe shedding (hair, teeth), peeling (stickers, paint), or omission/being left out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲貼紙慢慢開始脫落喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 tip3 zi2 maan6 maan6 hoi1 ci2 tyut3 lok6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些贴纸慢慢开始脱落了。
examples.english_sentence: These stickers are starting to peel off.

mandarin_meaning: 脱衣舞；脫衣表演
english_meaning: striptease; a dance in which the performer gradually removes clothing
explanation_mandarin: 指表演者透過舞蹈逐漸脫去衣服，通常是為娛樂或商業表演的一種形式。
explanation_english: A performance in which a dancer gradually removes clothing as part of the act, usually for entertainment or commercial purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒吧今晚有脫衣舞表演。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 baa1 gam1 maan5 jau5 tyut3 ji1 mou5 biu2 jin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间酒吧今晚有脱衣舞表演。
examples.english_sentence: This bar has a striptease performance tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢唔鍾意睇脫衣舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 tai2 tyut3 ji1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他不喜欢看脱衣舞。
examples.english_sentence: He said he doesn't like watching striptease.

mandarin_meaning: 脱衣舞
english_meaning: striptease (dance); strip show
explanation_mandarin: 指以脱去衣物为主要内容的舞蹈表演，通常带有情色或挑逗性质，常见於夜店或成人娱乐场所。
explanation_english: A dance performance in which the performer gradually removes clothing (a striptease); typically erotic and found in nightclubs or adult entertainment venues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚去嗰間夜店有脫衣舞表演，你想唔想去睇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 go2 gaan1 je6 dim3 jau5 tyut3 ji1 mou5 biu2 jin2, nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 heoi3 tai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚去那家夜店有脱衣舞表演，你想不想去看？
examples.english_sentence: There's a striptease performance at that nightclub tonight — do you want to go see it?

mandarin_meaning: 脱贫（摆脱贫困）
english_meaning: to get out of poverty; to be lifted out of poverty
explanation_mandarin: 指擺脫貧困或貧窮狀態，通常指收入或生活條件改善，以致不再貧窮。
explanation_english: Refers to escaping a state of poverty; typically means income or living conditions have improved so that one is no longer poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府推出嘅扶貧計劃幫助好多家庭，令佢哋脫貧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 teoi1 ceot1 ge3 fu4 pan4 gai3 waak6 bong1 zo6 hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4, ling6 keoi5 dei6 tyut3 pan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府推出的扶贫计划帮助了很多家庭，使他们脱贫。
examples.english_sentence: The government's poverty alleviation program helped many families escape poverty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做咗幾年生意，終於脫貧，生活好返啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 zo2 gei2 nin4 saang1 ji3, zung1 jyu1 tyut3 pan4, saang1 wut6 hou2 faan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做了几年生意，终于脱贫，生活好了些。
examples.english_sentence: He ran a business for several years and finally got out of poverty; his life has improved a bit.

mandarin_meaning: 脱贫（摆脱贫困）
english_meaning: to escape poverty; to be lifted out of poverty
explanation_mandarin: 指摆脱贫困、离开贫困状态，常用于描述个人、家庭或地区的经济状况得到改善或被帮助脱离贫困。
explanation_english: Refers to getting out of poverty or leaving a state of poverty. Commonly used to describe individuals, households, or regions whose economic situation has improved or been assisted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個扶貧項目幫咗唔少家庭脫貧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fu4 pan4 hong6 muk6 bong1 zo2 m4 siu2 gaa1 ting4 tyut3 pan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个扶贫项目帮助了不少家庭脱贫。
examples.english_sentence: This poverty-alleviation program has helped many families escape poverty.

mandarin_meaning: 脫身（tuōshēn）：擺脫困境、責任或逃脫被追捕
english_meaning: to get away; to free oneself from a situation, obligation, or pursuit; to escape
explanation_mandarin: 表示設法離開某種困境、責任或被追捕的情況，也可用於日常口語表示擺脫某事或某人。
explanation_english: Indicates managing to leave or escape a predicament, responsibility, or pursuit. Commonly used colloquially to mean getting out of or disentangling oneself from something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成功脫身，冇畀警方捉到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 gung1 tyut3 san1, mou5 bei2 ging2 fong1 zuk1 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成功脫身，沒被警方抓到。
examples.english_sentence: He managed to get away and wasn't caught by the police.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我幫唔到你脫身，今次你要自己承擔後果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bong1 m4 dou3 nei5 tyut3 san1, gam1 ci3 nei5 jiu3 zi6 gei2 sing4 daam1 hau6 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我幫不了你脫身，這次你要自己承擔後果。
examples.english_sentence: I can't get you out of this; this time you'll have to bear the consequences yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 趁佢唔留神，我偷偷脫身離開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: can3 keoi5 m4 lau4 san1, ngo5 tau1 tau1 tyut3 san1 lei4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 趁他不留神，我偷偷脫身離開。
examples.english_sentence: Taking advantage of him being distracted, I slipped away quietly.

mandarin_meaning: 脱身；摆脱（责任、困境或不想参与的场合）
english_meaning: to get away; to free oneself; to extricate oneself from an obligation, trouble, or unwanted situation
explanation_mandarin: 「脫身」表示從某個困境、聯繫或責任中抽身、逃脫或擺脫，不再受牽連或不參與該事。
explanation_english: ‘脫身’ means to free oneself or escape from a predicament, obligation, or unwanted involvement — to get away or extricate oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嗰個聚會好悶，我想搵個藉口脫身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 go2 go3 zeoi6 wui6 hou2 mun6, ngo5 soeng2 wan2 go3 zek3 hau2 tyut3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的聚會很无聊，我想找个借口脱身。
examples.english_sentence: The party tonight is boring; I want to find an excuse to get away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成功脫身，跳窗走咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 gung1 tyut3 san1, tiu3 coeng1 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成功脱身，跳窗逃走了。
examples.english_sentence: He managed to get away, jumping out the window.

mandarin_meaning: 脱轨（字面指列车等脱离轨道；比喻指偏离正轨或规范）
english_meaning: derail; go off the rails; deviate from the proper course (literal and figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 原指列車等從軌道上脫離（出軌），現也常用作比喻，表示計劃、行為或人生等偏離正軌或規範。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a train leaving its tracks (derailing). Also used figuratively to describe plans, behavior, or life deviating from the proper course or norms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班火車喺早上喺郊區脫軌，乘客要改坐其他班次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 fo2 ce1 hai2 zou2 soeng6 hai2 gaau1 keoi1 tyut3 gwai2, sing4 haak3 jiu3 goi2 co5 kei4 taa1 baan1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上有班火車在郊區脫軌，乘客需要改乘其他班次。
examples.english_sentence: A train derailed in the suburbs this morning, and passengers had to take other services.

mandarin_meaning: 脱轨（脫軌）
english_meaning: to derail; to go off the rails; to deviate from the normal course; (informally) to have an affair
explanation_mandarin: 原指火車等脫離軌道，後用作比喻，表示行為或發展偏離正常軌道，也常用於指婚姻或感情關係出軌。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a train leaving its tracks; figuratively used to mean going off the rails or deviating from the normal course. It can also refer to infidelity in a relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 列車喺郊外脫軌，線路暫時封閉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lit6 ce1 hai2 gaau1 ngoi6 tyut3 gwai2, sin3 lou6 zaam6 si4 fung1 bai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 列车在郊外脱轨，线路暂时封闭。
examples.english_sentence: The train derailed in the suburbs; the line is temporarily closed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為開始脫軌，老闆好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai6 hoi1 ci2 tyut3 gwai2, lou5 baan2 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为开始脱轨，老板很担心。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior has started to go off the rails; the boss is worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被揭發有婚外情，被人話佢脫軌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 gaai1 faat3 jau5 fan1 ngoi6 cing4, bei6 jan4 waa6 keoi5 tyut3 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被揭发有婚外情，被人说他脱轨。
examples.english_sentence: He was exposed for having an extramarital affair; people say he cheated.

mandarin_meaning: 脱钩；脱离（协议、合作、关系等）
english_meaning: to unhook; to withdraw/decouple from an agreement, relationship, or commitment; to back out
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是把鉤子脫開，口語上用來表示退出、脫離或中途解除與某事物或某人的聯繫（例如合作、協議或承諾）。
explanation_english: Literally 'to unhook.' Colloquially used to mean withdrawing from, decoupling, or disengaging from an agreement, cooperation, relationship, or commitment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺合作項目中途脫鈎，個團隊好頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 hai2 hop6 zok3 hong6 muk6 zung1 tou4 tyut3 gau1, go3 tyun4 deoi2 hou2 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在合作項目中途脱钩，團隊很頭痛。
examples.english_sentence: He pulled out of the joint project halfway, which was a headache for the team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以咁樣突然脫鈎，事前要講清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng6 dat6 jin4 tyut3 gau1, si6 cin4 jiu3 gong2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能这样突然脱钩，事先要说明清楚。
examples.english_sentence: You can't suddenly back out like that — you should make it clear in advance.

mandarin_meaning: 脱钩
english_meaning: to decouple; to disengage/unhook (from a linkage or dependency)
explanation_mandarin: 表示解除掛鉤或脫離原本的聯繫或依賴，常用於經濟、政策、供應鏈或政治關係等語境，有時帶有政治或戰略意涵。
explanation_english: Indicates removing or disengaging a linkage or dependency. Commonly used in contexts such as economics, policy, supply chains, or political relations; can carry political or strategic implications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府話唔會同內地嘅經濟完全脫鉤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waa6 m4 wui5 tung4 noi6 dei6 ge3 ging1 zai3 jyun4 cyun4 tyut3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府說不會與內地的經濟完全脫鉤。
examples.english_sentence: The government says it will not completely decouple from the mainland's economy.

mandarin_meaning: 脱险 (tuō xiǎn) — 脱离危险、脱离险境
english_meaning: to get out of danger; to escape a dangerous situation; to be out of danger
explanation_mandarin: 表示從危險或險境中脫離、獲得安全，常用於描述人或事物在經歷危急情況後恢復安全。
explanation_english: Indicates escaping or being freed from a dangerous or critical situation; commonly used to describe a person or thing becoming safe after a perilous event.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經歷嚴重手術之後，佢終於脫險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lik6 jim4 zung6 sau2 seot6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 tyut3 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经历严重手术之后，他终于脱险。
examples.english_sentence: After undergoing major surgery, he finally got out of danger.

mandarin_meaning: 脱险 (tuō xiǎn)
english_meaning: to escape danger; to be out of danger; to get out of a perilous situation
explanation_mandarin: 指從危險或險境中擺脫出來，免於受傷或喪命，表示已經脫離危險狀態。
explanation_english: To get out of a dangerous or perilous situation; to be saved from harm or death and no longer be in danger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幸好醫生搶救及時，佢總算脫險啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hang6 hou2 ji1 sang1 coeng2 gau3 kap6 si4, keoi5 zung2 syun3 tyut3 him2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幸好医生抢救及时，他总算脱险了。
examples.english_sentence: Fortunately the doctors rescued him in time; he finally got out of danger.

mandarin_meaning: 脱离
english_meaning: to separate from; to break away from; to be detached from
explanation_mandarin: 表示从某种状态、环境、关系或影响中分开、摆脱或不再受制于某事物。
explanation_english: Indicates separating from a state, environment, relationship, or influence; to break away or be freed from something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想脫離依家呢份工作，搵啲更有前途嘅機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 tyut3 lei4 ji1 gaa1 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3, wan2 di1 gang3 jau5 cin4 tou4 ge3 gei1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想脱离现在这份工作，找些更有前途的机会。
examples.english_sentence: I want to leave my current job and find opportunities with better prospects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘗試脫離屋企人嘅管束，開始自己做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng4 si3 tyut3 lei4 uk1 kei5 jan4 ge3 gun2 suk1, hoi1 ci2 zi6 gei2 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他尝试脱离家人的管束，开始自己做决定。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to break away from his family's control and start making his own decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅幻想有啲脫離現實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 waan6 soeng2 jau5 di1 tyut3 lei4 jin6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的幻想有点脱离现实。
examples.english_sentence: His fantasies are somewhat detached from reality.

mandarin_meaning: 脫離 (tuōlí)：擺脫、離開或與某種關係、狀態分開
english_meaning: to break away from; to detach from; to get free from a relation, influence, or condition
explanation_mandarin: 表示與某人或某事物分開、擺脫或脫節某種關係、影響或狀態，例如脫離現實、脫離控制、脫離危險等。
explanation_english: Indicates separating or breaking away from someone or something, escaping an influence or condition (e.g., breaking away from reality, getting out of control, escaping danger).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於脫離咗毒品嘅控制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 tyut3 lei4 zo2 duk6 ban2 ge3 hung3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於脫離了毒品的控制。
examples.english_sentence: He finally broke free from the control of drugs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果脫離現實，後果可能會好嚴重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 tyut3 lei4 jin6 sat6, hau6 gwo2 ho2 nang4 wui5 hou2 jim4 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果脫離現實，後果可能會很嚴重。
examples.english_sentence: If one becomes detached from reality, the consequences can be serious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司想脫離母公司嘅控制，成為獨立運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 soeng2 tyut3 lei4 mou5 gung1 si1 ge3 hung3 zai3, sing4 wai4 duk6 lap6 wan6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司想脫離母公司的控制，成為獨立運作。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to break away from the parent company's control and operate independently.

mandarin_meaning: 脱发 (tuōfà)
english_meaning: hair loss; losing hair
explanation_mandarin: 指頭髮逐漸脫落或稀疏的現象，常由遺傳、壓力、荷爾蒙失調、營養不良或疾病等原因引起。
explanation_english: Refers to the condition of hair gradually falling out or becoming thin; commonly caused by genetics, stress, hormonal imbalance, poor nutrition, or illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近壓力好大，開始脫髮，髮線都有啲後移。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6 hoi1 ci2 tyut3 faat3, faat3 sin3 dou1 jau5 di1 hau6 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近壓力很大，開始脫髮，髮際線有些後移。
examples.english_sentence: I've been under a lot of stress lately and have started losing hair; my hairline is receding a bit.

mandarin_meaning: （pú）指風乾、醃製或蜜製而成的肉類或果實，如肉脯、果脯（蜜餞）。
english_meaning: dried or preserved meat or fruit (e.g., jerky, candied/dried fruit).
explanation_mandarin: 「脯」常見於複合詞如「果脯」「肉脯」，表示經過風乾、醃製或蜜製處理以保存的果實或肉類，口感較乾、有保存味道或甜味。
explanation_english: Commonly found in compounds like '果脯' or '肉脯', meaning fruit or meat that has been dried, salted, candied, or otherwise preserved; typically has a chewy or sweet-preserved taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲果脯係喺香港買嘅，好香又唔太甜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gwo2 pou2 hai6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 maai5 ge3, hou2 hoeng1 jau6 m4 taai3 tim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些果脯是在香港买的，又香又不太甜。
examples.english_sentence: These candied fruits were bought in Hong Kong; they're fragrant and not too sweet.

mandarin_meaning: 脱 (tuō) — 脱下、摆脱、脱离、脱口而出等意思
english_meaning: to take off; to remove; to get free/escape; to blurt out
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“脱”(tyut3)作动词使用，常表示脱下（衣物）、摆脱或脱离某种状态，也可用于“脱口而出”表示不经意说出话来。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, '脱' (tyut3) is a verb meaning to take off (clothes), to remove or free oneself from something, or to blurt out. It can refer to removing garments, escaping/loosening from a situation, or speaking unintentionally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我返到屋企即刻脫咗件外套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 zik1 haak1 tyut3 zo2 gin6 ngoi6 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我回到家立刻脱了外套。
examples.english_sentence: I took off my coat as soon as I got home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於可以脫身去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 tyut3 san1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于可以脱身去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He can finally free himself to go travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心脫口而出講咗真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 tyut3 hau2 ji4 ceot1 gong2 zo2 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心脱口而出说了真相。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally blurted out the truth.

mandarin_meaning: 脱俗：不落俗套、不庸俗，与众不同，有品味。
english_meaning: Not vulgar or commonplace; refined, unconventional, refreshingly different.
explanation_mandarin: 形容不庸俗、与众不同、有品位或脱离凡俗的状态，常用于评价人、作品或风格。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that stands out from common or vulgar taste — refined, unconventional, or refreshingly different; often used to praise people, works, or styles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅着衫風格好脫俗，唔似一般潮流嗰啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zoek3 saam1 fung1 gaak3 hou2 tyut3 zuk6, m4 ci5 jat1 bun1 ciu4 lau4 go2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的着装风格很脱俗，不像一般潮流那样。
examples.english_sentence: His dressing style is refreshingly unconventional, not like ordinary trends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫有種脫俗嘅氣質，好有藝術感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa6 jau5 zung2 tyut3 zuk6 ge3 hei3 zat1, hou2 jau5 ngai6 seot6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画有种脱俗的气质，很有艺术感。
examples.english_sentence: This painting has a refined, unconventional quality; it's very artistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅諗法好脫俗，成日有新奇嘅見解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3 hou2 tyut3 zuk6, sing4 jat6 jau5 san1 kei4 ge3 gin3 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法很脱俗，经常有新奇的见解。
examples.english_sentence: His way of thinking is unconventional; he often has novel insights.

mandarin_meaning: 脱光（衣服），完全赤身裸体
english_meaning: to strip naked; to take off all one's clothes
explanation_mandarin: 表示把衣服全部脱掉，变成赤裸状态。常用于口语或粗俗语境，也可描述在公共场合脱光衣服的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to removing all clothing and becoming completely naked. Commonly used in colloquial or slang contexts; can describe stripping completely, sometimes in public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺街度脫光啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 gaai1 dou6 tyut3 gwong1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在街上脱光！
examples.english_sentence: Don't strip naked on the street!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺更衣室入面可以脫光換衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gang1 ji1 sat1 jap6 min6 ho2 ji5 tyut3 gwong1 wun6 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在更衣室里面可以脱光换衣服。
examples.english_sentence: You can take off all your clothes to change in the dressing room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺派對上脫光做表演，嚇親晒大家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 paai3 deoi3 soeng6 tyut3 gwong1 zou6 biu2 jin2, haak3 can1 saai3 daai6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在派对上脱光表演，把大家吓坏了。
examples.english_sentence: He stripped naked at the party to perform and frightened everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 脱钩 / 退出、抽身
english_meaning: to withdraw from a commitment; to disengage or decouple
explanation_mandarin: （口語）表示退出原先的承諾或關係、解除牽連或不再參與；也可用於描述在合作或政策上的脫鈎（decouple）。
explanation_english: A colloquial verb meaning to back out of a promise or commitment, to withdraw or disengage from a relationship or involvement; can also mean to decouple (e.g., in cooperation or policy).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢臨時脱勾，話唔嚟開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam4 si4 tyut3 gau1, waa6 m4 lai4 hoi1 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他臨時脱钩，說不來開會。
examples.english_sentence: He bailed at the last minute and said he wouldn't come to the meeting.

mandarin_meaning: 脱口而出（不假思索地说出）
english_meaning: to blurt out; to say something impulsively without thinking
explanation_mandarin: 表示不經過深思熟慮，突然說出某句話或秘密，常帶有意外或失言的含義。
explanation_english: Indicates saying something suddenly or unintentionally without careful thought — often used for blurting out remarks or secrets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔小心脫口講咗佢嘅秘密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 tyut3 hau2 gong2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 bei3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不小心脱口说出了他的秘密。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally blurted out his secret.

mandarin_meaning: 脱手（失手、脱落、卖掉或脱离自己控制）
english_meaning: to let slip/from one's hand; to lose control of a situation; to sell off/hand over
explanation_mandarin: 「脱手」在廣東話可指物件從手中滑落或脱落，也可指把東西賣掉、甩手，以及事情失去自己控制的狀態。根據語境可作不同解釋。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "脫手/脱手" can mean an object slipping from one's hand, selling something off/handing it over, or a situation getting out of one's control. The exact sense depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 杯奶茶突然脫手，灑晒喺地下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bui1 naai5 caa4 dat6 jin4 tyut3 sau2, saa2 saai3 hai2 dei6 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶茶突然从手里滑脱，洒满了地。
examples.english_sentence: The milk tea suddenly slipped from my hand and spilled all over the floor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次啲貨好快就脫手晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 di1 fo3 hou2 faai3 zau6 tyut3 sau2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的货很快就卖掉了。
examples.english_sentence: This batch of goods sold out quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 情況已經脫手，好難挽回。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing4 fong3 ji5 ging1 tyut3 sau2, hou2 naan4 waan5 wui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 情况已经失去控制，很难挽回。
examples.english_sentence: The situation has gotten out of hand and it's hard to recover.

mandarin_meaning: 掉星 / 失去星級（常指遊戲或評級系統中掉等級/失去星）
english_meaning: to lose a star (drop a rank or rating, often in games or rating systems)
explanation_mandarin: 「脱星」是廣東話俚語，用來表示在有星級或星數評級的系統中失去星（例如競技遊戲的段位星數減少），也可泛指評分降低或被降級。
explanation_english: 脱星 is Cantonese slang meaning to lose a star in a star-based rating/ranking system (for example dropping stars in competitive games). It can also broadly mean a rating has decreased or being demoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場打輸咗，我脫咗兩個星，心情好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 daa2 syu1 zo2, ngo5 tyut3 zo2 loeng5 go3 sing1, sam1 cing4 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這場比賽輸了，我掉了兩顆星，心情很差。
examples.english_sentence: I lost that match and dropped two stars; I'm feeling really bad.

mandarin_meaning: 戒毒；排除體內毒素；擺脫毒癮
english_meaning: to detox; to quit drugs; to break an addiction; to purge toxins
explanation_mandarin: 指擺脫對毒品的依賴（戒除毒癮），或在保健語境中指排除體內毒素。也可比喻擺脫某種不良嗜好或成癮行為。
explanation_english: Refers to getting rid of dependence on drugs (quitting addiction), or in health contexts to removing toxins from the body. Can also be used metaphorically for breaking a bad habit or addiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗康復中心脫毒，家人好支持佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 hong1 fuk6 zung1 sam1 tyut3 duk6, gaa1 jan4 hou2 zi1 ci4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去康復中心戒毒，家人很支持他。
examples.english_sentence: He went to a rehab center to detox; his family is very supportive of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決心要脫毒，唔想再畀毒癮控制。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 sam1 jiu3 tyut3 duk6, m4 soeng2 zoi3 bei2 duk6 jan3 hung3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下定決心要戒毒，不想再被毒癮控制。
examples.english_sentence: He is determined to quit drugs; he doesn't want to be controlled by his addiction anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個App可以幫你脫離網絡成癮，等於一種數碼脫毒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 App ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 tyut3 lei4 mong5 lok6 sing4 jan3, dang2 jyu4 jat1 zung2 sou3 maa5 tyut3 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個App可以幫你脫離網路成癮，相當於一種數位脫毒。
examples.english_sentence: This app can help you break internet addiction — like a kind of digital detox.

mandarin_meaning: 脱毛 / 去除体毛
english_meaning: hair removal; depilation
explanation_mandarin: 指通过刮除、拔除、蜡脱、激光等方式去除皮肤表面的毛发。可作动词（去脱毛）或名词（脱毛服务）。
explanation_english: Refers to removing body hair by methods such as shaving, waxing, plucking, or laser. Can be used as a verb (to remove hair) or a noun (hair-removal service).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我打算去美容院脫毛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2syun3 heoi3 mei5jung4jyun2 tyut3 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算去美容院脱毛。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to go to the beauty salon for hair removal.

mandarin_meaning: 脱水（身体或物质失去水分）；（口语）感到精力枯竭、疲惫
english_meaning: dehydrate / desiccate; (colloquial) feel drained or exhausted
explanation_mandarin: “脱水”字面意思是失去水分，用于医学或烹饪上表示身体或食材失水、干燥。在粤语口语中，有时也用来形容人感到非常疲倦、精力被耗尽（非正式用法）。
explanation_english: Literally means losing water — used medically or for food to indicate dehydration or desiccation. In Cantonese colloquial speech it can also be used informally to describe feeling very drained or exhausted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行山行到口渴又頭暈，可能係脫水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 saan1 haang4 dou3 hau2 hot3 jau6 tau4 wan4, ho2 nang4 hai6 tyut3 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爬山爬到又口渴又头晕，可能是脱水。
examples.english_sentence: He/she hiked until thirsty and dizzy — he/she might be dehydrated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將菜脫水先再煮，會更易入味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 coi3 tyut3 seoi2 sin1 zoi6 zyu2, wui5 gang3 ji6 jap6 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把菜先脱水再煮，会更容易入味。
examples.english_sentence: Dry/drain the vegetables first before cooking — they'll absorb the flavors more easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幾日加班加到好脫水，成日覺得好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gei2 jat6 gaa1 baan1 gaa1 dou3 hou2 tyut3 seoi2, sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这几天加班加得很累，整天觉得精力被耗尽。
examples.english_sentence: I've been working overtime these days and feel totally drained and exhausted.

mandarin_meaning: 脱皮 (tuōpí)：指動物或人的皮膚脫落、剝落；引申可指經歷改變、蛻變。
english_meaning: to shed skin; to peel (skin coming off); figuratively, to undergo a transformation or molt.
explanation_mandarin: 通常指皮膚因為曬傷、炎症或動物換皮而脫落；在口語或比喻用法中，也可以形容一個人經歷變化、像換掉舊有的一層再成長。
explanation_english: Usually refers to skin coming off due to sunburn, inflammation, or animals shedding their skin; figuratively it can describe a person undergoing change, like shedding an old layer and growing anew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我隻手因為曬傷開始脫皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zek3 sau2 jan1 wai6 saai3 soeng1 hoi1 ci2 tyut3 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的手因為曬傷開始脫皮。
examples.english_sentence: My hand started to peel because of sunburn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 蜥蜴到夏天會脫皮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik1 jik6 dou3 haa6 tin1 wui5 tyut3 pei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 蜥蜴到了夏天會脫皮。
examples.english_sentence: Lizards shed their skin in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經歷咗啲事後，佢好似脫皮咁，變得成熟咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 lik6 zo2 di1 si6 hau6, keoi5 hou2 ci5 tyut3 pei4 gam2, bin3 dak1 sing4 suk6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經歷了那些事情後，他好像脫皮一樣，變得成熟了。
examples.english_sentence: After going through those experiences, he seemed to have shed his old skin and become more mature.

mandarin_meaning: 脱稿 (tuōgǎo)：不看稿子即兴表演或讲话；也可指稿子已完成并交出
english_meaning: to speak or perform without using a script (to go off‑script, improvise); can also mean a draft/manuscript has been completed/submitted
explanation_mandarin: 指在演講、節目或表演時不看稿子即興發揮；在某些情況下也用來表示稿件已完成並提交。
explanation_english: Refers to delivering a speech or performance without reading from a script (improvising). In some contexts it also means a manuscript/draft has been finished and handed in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今晚嘅演講完全脫稿，講得好自然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 maan5 ge3 jin2 gong2 jyun4 cyun4 tyut3 gou2, gong2 dak1 hou2 zi6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今晚的演讲完全脱稿，讲得很自然。
examples.english_sentence: His speech tonight was completely off‑script; he spoke very naturally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次電視節目主持人突然脫稿，改同觀眾互動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 din6 si6 zit3 muk6 zyu2 ci4 jan4 dat6 jin4 tyut3 gou2, goi2 tung4 gun1 zung3 wu6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次电视节目的主持人突然脱稿，改和观众互动。
examples.english_sentence: The TV show's host suddenly went off‑script and switched to interacting with the audience.

mandarin_meaning: 脱颖而出
english_meaning: to stand out; to emerge prominently; to show one's talent and outshine others
explanation_mandarin: 表示在眾人中顯露才能或表現突出，脫穎而出，常用作動詞性短語。
explanation_english: Indicates someone displays outstanding ability or performance among others and thus stands out; used as a verb phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個新人喺公司面試時脱穎而出，攞咗份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 san1 jan4 hai2 gung1 si1 min6 si3 si4 tyut3 wing5 ji4 ceot1 lo2 zo2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這位新人在公司面試時脫穎而出，得到了這份工作。
examples.english_sentence: The new employee stood out in the company interview and got the job.

mandarin_meaning: 脱节（与…不相连或不相符；脱离实际、断裂）
english_meaning: to be disconnected or out of sync; a disconnect or lack of coordination; out of touch with reality
explanation_mandarin: 表示事物之间缺乏联系或协调，或思想、行為與現實、情況不相符合，導致衝突或效率下降。
explanation_english: Indicates a lack of connection or coordination between things, or that ideas/behaviour are out of touch with reality or circumstances, causing conflict or reduced efficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃同市場需求有啲脫節，可能要調整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 tung4 si5 coeng4 seoi1 kau4 jau5 di1 tyut3 zit3, ho2 nang4 jiu3 tiu4 zeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划与市场需求有些脱节，可能需要调整。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is somewhat disconnected from market demand and may need adjustment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋之間嘅溝通有脫節，導致工作重複。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 gou1 tung1 jau5 tyut3 zit3, dou6 zi3 gung1 zok3 cung4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们之间的沟通有脱节，导致工作重复。
examples.english_sentence: There's a disconnect in their communication, causing duplicated work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲諗法同現實有啲脫節，好難溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 lam2 faat3 tung4 jin6 sat6 jau5 di1 tyut3 zit3, hou2 naan4 gou1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法与现实有些脱节，很难沟通。
examples.english_sentence: His thinking is a bit out of touch with reality, making him hard to communicate with.

mandarin_meaning: 脫罪；免除指控或責任
english_meaning: to be exonerated; to be cleared of blame or criminal charges; to escape conviction
explanation_mandarin: 表示免除（或擺脫）對某人的指控或責任，使其不再被視為有罪；有時可指透過法律程序或其他手段使人逃避責任。
explanation_english: Means to be cleared of accusations or responsibility, so that a person is no longer regarded as guilty. It can refer to being legally exonerated or to escaping liability by other means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最後成功脫罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 zeoi3 hau6 sing4 gung1 tyut3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最後成功脫罪。
examples.english_sentence: He was finally exonerated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 律師提出新證據，幫當事人脫罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Leot6 si1 tai4 ceot1 san1 zing3 geoi3, bong1 dong1 si6 jan4 tyut3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 律師提出新證據，幫當事人脫罪。
examples.english_sentence: The lawyer presented new evidence that helped exonerate the defendant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人試圖用關係嚟幫佢脫罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Jau5 di1 jan4 si3 tou4 jung6 gwaan1 hai6 lai4 bong1 keoi5 tyut3 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人試圖用關係幫他脫罪。
examples.english_sentence: Some people tried to use connections to get him off the hook.

mandarin_meaning: 脱胎换骨（tuō tāi huàn gǔ）：彻底改头换面、脱胎换骨，指经过重大变化或改造后获得全新的面貌或能力。
english_meaning: To undergo a complete transformation or renewal; to be completely changed or reborn (often used metaphorically for dramatic improvement).
explanation_mandarin: 原指佛道教中重生或轉世的意象，現常用來形容人、事物或技能經歷重大改變後產生根本性、煥然一新的狀態或質變。
explanation_english: Originally referring to spiritual rebirth, now commonly used to describe a fundamental, dramatic change in a person, thing, or skill that results in a renewed or completely different state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢減咗好多磅，成個人真係脫胎換骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaam2 zo2 hou2 do1 bong6, seng4 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 tyut3 toi1 wun6 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他減掉很多磅，整個人真的脫胎換骨。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a lot of weight and was completely transformed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過呢個培訓班，我嘅寫作技巧真係脫胎換骨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 ni1 go3 pui4 fan3 baan1, ngo5 ge3 se2 zok3 gei6 haau6 zan1 hai6 tyut3 toi1 wun6 gwat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經過這個培訓班，我的寫作技巧真的脫胎換骨。
examples.english_sentence: After this training course, my writing skills were radically transformed.

mandarin_meaning: 去除脂肪；指去掉食品或物質中的脂肪（如脫脂牛奶）
english_meaning: to remove fat; (of food) fat-free / skimmed (e.g., skimmed milk)
explanation_mandarin: 指把食品或其他物質中的脂肪去掉。常見於食品標示（例如脫脂牛奶、脫脂乳製品）或烹調處理（去掉肉類表面或多餘脂肪）。
explanation_english: Refers to removing fat from food or other substances. Commonly used on food labels (e.g., skimmed milk) or in cooking when trimming excess fat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢罐係脫脂牛奶，脂肪含量好低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gun3 hai6 tyut3 zi1 ngau4 naai5, zi1 fong4 ham4 loeng6 hou2 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這罐是脫脂牛奶，脂肪含量很低。
examples.english_sentence: This can is skimmed milk; the fat content is very low.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 煮嘢食之前最好先將肉類脫脂，咁樣比較健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zyu2 je5 sik6 zi1 cin4 zeoi3 hou2 sin1 zoeng1 juk6 leoi6 tyut3 zi1, gam2 joeng6 bik1 gaau3 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做菜前最好先把肉類脫脂，這樣比較健康。
examples.english_sentence: Before cooking, it's best to trim the fat from meat; that way it's healthier.

mandarin_meaning: 褪色 / 掉色（顏色變淡或脫落）
english_meaning: to fade (in color); to lose color; discoloration
explanation_mandarin: 指顏色變淡或脫落，常用於衣物、布料或其他有顏色的物品上，也可指顏色失去鮮艷度或被漂白。
explanation_english: Refers to colors becoming lighter or coming off, commonly used for clothes, fabrics, or other colored items; can also mean colors losing vibrancy or being bleached.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫洗咗幾次就脱色咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 sai2 zo2 gei2 ci3 zau6 tyut3 sik1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服洗了几次就褪色了。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt faded after a few washes.

mandarin_meaning: 脱落 (tuōluò)：掉下、脱落；也可指遗漏或被省略
english_meaning: to fall off; to drop off; to shed (e.g. hair, teeth); to be omitted
explanation_mandarin: 表示某部分从整体上掉下来（例如頭髮、牙齒、衣物上的鈕扣），也可引申為漏掉或被省略。
explanation_english: Indicates a part falling off from a whole (e.g. hair, teeth, buttons), or figuratively that something is omitted or left out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件衫個鈕扣脫落咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 go3 nau2 kau3 tyut3 lok6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服的鈕扣脫落了。
examples.english_sentence: The button on the shirt fell off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牙齒脫落要睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaa4 ci2 tyut3 lok6 jiu3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙齒脫落要看牙醫。
examples.english_sentence: If a tooth falls out, you should see a dentist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為壓力大，頭髮開始脫落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 aat3 lik6 daai6, tau4 faat3 hoi1 ci2 tyut3 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為壓力大，頭髮開始脫落。
examples.english_sentence: Because of high stress, his hair has started to fall out.

mandarin_meaning: 脱衣舞 (指以脱去衣物为主要内容的舞蹈或表演，常见于夜场、酒吧等场所)
english_meaning: striptease; strip show (a dance or performance in which the performer removes clothing)
explanation_mandarin: 指以脱去衣物为主要表演内容的舞蹈或表演，通常在夜总会、酒吧或专门的俱乐部中出现，也称为脱衣秀或脱衣表演。
explanation_english: Refers to a dance or performance where removing clothing is the main feature. Commonly seen in nightclubs, bars, or specialized clubs; also called a strip show or striptease.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚嗰間酒吧有脫衣舞表演，我哋去唔去？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 go2 gaan1 zau2 baa1 jau5 tyut3 ji1 mou5 biu2 jin2, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 m4 heoi3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚那間酒吧有脱衣舞表演，我們要不要去？
examples.english_sentence: That bar is having a striptease show tonight—shall we go?

mandarin_meaning: 脱贫
english_meaning: to be lifted out of poverty; to escape poverty
explanation_mandarin: 脱貧指摆脱贫困状态，通常用于描述个人、家庭或地区在收入、生活条件等方面改善，不再处于贫困线以下。
explanation_english: To escape poverty or be lifted out of poverty. Used to describe individuals, families, or regions whose income or living conditions have improved so they are no longer below the poverty line.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多地方已經脱貧，生活明顯改善咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 ji5 ging1 tyut3 pan4 , sang1 wut6 ming4 hin2 goi2 sin6 zo2 .
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多地方已经脱贫，生活明显改善了。
examples.english_sentence: Many places have now been lifted out of poverty and living conditions have clearly improved.

mandarin_meaning: 摆脱、脱离、逃脱（从某种责任、场合或困境中脱身）
english_meaning: to free oneself; to get away or escape from an obligation, commitment, place, or awkward situation
explanation_mandarin: 表示從某種困境、責任或場合中擺脫或離開，常用於口語，既可指實際離開現場，也可指脫離義務或約束。
explanation_english: Used to indicate removing oneself from a difficult situation, obligation, or location. Commonly used in speech; can mean physically leaving a place or freeing oneself from responsibilities or commitments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚老細叫我加班，我唔知點樣先可以脱身返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 lou5 sai3 giu3 ngo5 gaa1 baan1, ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 joeng6 sin1 ho2 ji5 tyut3 san1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚老板叫我加班，我不知道怎麼才能脫身回家。
examples.english_sentence: My boss asked me to work overtime tonight; I don't know how I can get away and go home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見佢態度咁差，我想快啲脱身，唔想再拖落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 keoi5 taai3 dou6 gam2 caa1, ngo5 soeng2 faai3 di1 tyut3 san1, m4 soeng2 zoi3 to1 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他態度這麼差，我想快點脫身，不想再拖下去。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing his attitude is so bad, I want to get away quickly; I don't want to let this drag on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢約我幫手做項目，但係我抽唔到身，未能脱身幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joek3 ngo5 bong1 sau2 zou6 hong6 muk6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 cau1 m4 dou2 san1, mei6 nang4 tyut3 san1 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他約我幫忙做項目，但我抽不出身，沒辦法脫身幫忙。
examples.english_sentence: He asked me to help with a project, but I can't free myself; I can't manage to get away to help.

mandarin_meaning: 脱轨（列车脱离铁轨）；引申为行为或计划偏离常规、失控
english_meaning: to derail (literally, as a train); figuratively, to go off the rails, deviate from a plan or become out of control
explanation_mandarin: 原指列車等脫離鐵軌造成故障或事故；比喻用法表示行為、計劃、情況等脫離正軌、失去控制或不合常規。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a train or vehicle leaving its rails (a derailment). Figuratively it describes behavior, plans, or situations that deviate from the proper course, become uncontrolled, or go astray.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 列車脱軌，大家要冷靜，並聽從指示。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lit6 ce1 tyut3 gwai2, daai6 gaa1 jiu3 laang5 zing6, bing6 teng1 cung4 zi2 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 列车脱轨，大家要保持冷静，并听从指示。
examples.english_sentence: The train derailed; everyone should stay calm and follow instructions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅生活開始脱軌，唔再按計劃行事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sang1 wut6 hoi1 ci2 tyut3 gwai2, m4 zoi6 on3 gai3 waak6 haang4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的生活开始脱轨，不再按计划行事。
examples.english_sentence: His life started to go off the rails; he no longer follows the plan.

mandarin_meaning: 脱钩；退出、抽身，不再参与或不再支持某事
english_meaning: to unhook; to back out/withdraw; to disengage or stop supporting something
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，字面意思為「脫開鉤子」，引申為從約定、計劃或關係中抽身、退出或不再提供支持。常見於香港粵語口語表達。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression literally meaning 'to unhook'. Figuratively it means to withdraw, back out, disengage, or stop supporting something. Commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢突然話想脫鈎，唔再支持呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dat6 jin4 waa6 soeng2 tyut3 gou1, m4 zoi6 zi1 ci4 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他突然說要脫鉤，不再支持這個計畫。
examples.english_sentence: He suddenly said he wanted to back out and won't support this project anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 脱钩（脱离原有联系或关联）
english_meaning: to decouple; to delink; to disengage a connection or dependency
explanation_mandarin: “脱钩”指脱离原有的联系或关联，解除耦合。常用于经济、技术或政治语境，表示不再相互依赖或停止关联。
explanation_english: Refers to breaking off or detaching a connection — decoupling systems, chains, or relationships. Commonly used in economic, technical, or political contexts to indicate ending mutual dependence or association.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司決定同舊供應鏈脫鉤，搵新嘅供應商。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 tung4 gau6 gung1 jing3 lin4 tyut3 gau1, wan2 san1 ge3 gung1 jing3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司决定与旧供应链脱钩，寻找新的供应商。
examples.english_sentence: The company decided to decouple from the old supply chain and look for new suppliers.

mandarin_meaning: 脱险 (tuō xiǎn)：脱离危险、摆脱险境
english_meaning: to get out of danger; to escape a dangerous situation
explanation_mandarin: 表示從危險情況中脫離，免於受到傷害或更嚴重的後果。常用於描述事故、火災或病情等情況後已脫離險境。
explanation_english: Indicates escaping or being rescued from a dangerous situation, avoiding injury or worse consequences. Commonly used after accidents, fires, surgeries, or other emergencies to say someone has gotten out of danger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 火場嗰啲人經過消防員搶救，終於全部脫險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo2 coeng4 go2 di1 jan4 ging1gwo3 siu1fong4jyun4 coeng2gau3, zung1jyu1 cyun4bou6 tyut3 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 經過消防員搶救，火場裡那些人終於全部脫險。
examples.english_sentence: After the firefighters' rescue, the people in the fire finally all escaped danger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢開刀之後狀況穩定，已經算係脫險喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoi1 dou1 zi1 hau6 zong6fong3 wan2ding6, ji5ging1 syun3 hai6 tyut3 him2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他開刀之後情況穩定，已經算是脫險了。
examples.english_sentence: After the operation his condition stabilized; he's considered out of danger now.

mandarin_meaning: 脱离；与……分开、摆脱（联系、束缚或影响）
english_meaning: to break away from; to be separated from; to detach from; to escape from influence or control
explanation_mandarin: 表示与某物或某种情形分开、不再受其约束或影响，可用于具体或抽象的关系（例如脱离组织、脱离现实）。
explanation_english: Indicates separating from something or no longer being under its influence or constraint; can be used for concrete or abstract relationships (e.g., leaving an organization, being out of touch with reality).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經脱離咗公司，開始自己做生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 tyut3 lei4 zo2 gung1 si1, hoi1 ci2 zi6 gei2 zou6 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经脱离公司，开始自己做生意。
examples.english_sentence: He has left the company and started his own business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅計劃太脱離現實，做唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 gai3 waak6 taai3 tyut3 lei4 jin6 sat6, zou6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的计划太脱离现实，做不到。
examples.english_sentence: His plan is too unrealistic; it won't work.

mandarin_meaning: 脱发（tuōfà）：头发脱落、掉发
english_meaning: hair loss; to lose or shed hair
explanation_mandarin: 指頭髮脫落或掉落的現象，可能由遺傳、壓力、荷爾蒙失調、營養不良、疾病或藥物副作用等引起。可作動詞（脫髮）或名詞（脫髮問題）。
explanation_english: Refers to the shedding or loss of hair, which can result from genetics, stress, hormonal imbalance, poor nutrition, illness, or medication side effects. Can be used as a verb (to lose hair) or a noun (hair loss).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我成日甩頭髮，驚會開始脫髮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 sing4 jat6 lat1 tau4 faat3, geng1 wui5 hoi1 ci2 tyut3 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我一直掉頭髮，擔心會開始脫發。
examples.english_sentence: Lately I've been losing a lot of hair; I'm worried I might start experiencing hair loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話壓力同飲食都可能會引致脫髮，要改善生活習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngaat3 lik6 tung4 jam2 sik6 dou1 ho2 nang4 wui5 jan5 zi3 tyut3 faat3, jiu3 goi2 sin6 sang1 wut6 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說壓力和飲食都可能造成脫髮，需要改善生活習慣。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said stress and diet can cause hair loss; you need to improve your lifestyle habits.

mandarin_meaning: 舌頭
english_meaning: tongue (the anatomical organ)
explanation_mandarin: 口腔內的肌肉器官，用於味覺、發音與吞嚥。粵語中「脷」即指舌頭，常見於口語與俗語中。
explanation_english: The muscular organ in the mouth used for taste, speech, and swallowing. In Cantonese, '脷' refers to the tongue and appears in colloquial expressions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲脷好痛，可能食太辣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 lei6 hou2 tung3, ho2 nang4 sik6 taai3 laat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的舌頭很痛，可能吃太辣了。
examples.english_sentence: My tongue hurts; maybe I ate something too spicy.

mandarin_meaning: （形容）使舌頭感到刺痛或被刮擦的刺激感
english_meaning: describing a sharp, scratching or irritating sensation on the tongue (often from spicy/strong-tasting food)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，用來形容食物或物質令舌頭感到刺痛、發癢或像被刮擦般不舒服的感覺。常用於描述芥末、芥辣、超辣湯等強烈刺激性食物的口感。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe when food or a substance produces a sharp, irritating, or 'scratching' sensation on the tongue. Commonly used for wasabi, very spicy condiments, strong horseradish, or similar pungent tastes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲芥末真係好脷刮，食咗一啖已經刺激到成個脷痕痕地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 gaai3 mat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 lei6-gwaat3 sik6 zo2 jat1 daam6 ji5 ging1 ci3 gik1 dou3 sing4 go3 lei6 han4 han4 dei6
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些芥末真的是很脷刮，吃了一口就刺激得整個舌頭發癢。
examples.english_sentence: That wasabi is really tongue-scratchy — after one bite my whole tongue felt irritated.

mandarin_meaning: 舌下含服的藥丸或含片（含在舌下讓藥物吸收）
english_meaning: a sublingual tablet/lozenge placed under the tongue to dissolve and be absorbed
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是放在舌底的丸劑。常用來指需含在舌下讓藥物或含片溶解、藥效快速吸收的藥丸或含片。有時也泛指含在口中慢慢化的糖果或含片。
explanation_english: Literally 'pill under the tongue.' Refers to a tablet or lozenge placed beneath the tongue to dissolve so the medicine is absorbed quickly (sublingual). Can also be used loosely for lozenges or candies held in the mouth to dissolve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話要我喺脷底含一粒脷底丸，等藥快啲吸收。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 jiu3 ngo5 hai2 lei6 dai2 ham4 jat1 lap1 lei6 dai2 jyun4, dang2 joek6 faai3 di1 kap1 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說要我把一粒脷底丸含在舌下，讓藥快點吸收。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told me to hold a sublingual tablet under my tongue so the medicine would be absorbed faster.

mandarin_meaning: 舌根
english_meaning: base of the tongue
explanation_mandarin: 指舌頭靠近喉嚨的部分，即舌根部位，常用於描述疼痛或腫脹等狀況。
explanation_english: Refers to the part of the tongue close to the throat — the base of the tongue. Commonly used when describing pain, swelling, or other sensations there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我脷根痛，食嘢同飲嘢都唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lei6 gan1 tung3, sik6 je5 tung4 jam2 je5 dou1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我舌根痛，吃東西和喝東西都不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: My base of tongue hurts; eating and drinking are uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢脷根有少少腫，要再檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 lei6 gan1 jau5 siu2 siu2 zung2, jiu3 zoi3 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說他舌根有點腫，需要再檢查。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his base of the tongue is a little swollen and needs further examination.

mandarin_meaning: 舌苔（覆蓋在舌面上的薄膜或沉積物，常作為健康、消化狀況的指標）
english_meaning: tongue coating (the film or coating on the surface of the tongue, often used as an indicator of health or digestive condition)
explanation_mandarin: 指覆蓋在舌面上的白色、黃色或其他顏色的薄膜或沉積物。中醫常以舌苔的顏色和厚薄判斷體內狀況，日常也與口氣或口腔衛生有關。
explanation_english: Refers to the white, yellow, or other-colored film or deposits that cover the tongue surface. Traditional Chinese medicine often uses the color and thickness of the tongue coating to assess internal conditions; it is also related to breath and oral hygiene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今朝起身見到自己脷苔好厚，有啲擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 hei2 san1 gin3 dou2 zi6 gei2 lei6 toi4 hou2 hau5, jau5 di1 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天早上起床看到自己的舌苔很厚，有點擔心。
examples.english_sentence: I noticed this morning that my tongue coating was thick; I'm a bit worried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫話脷苔顏色可以反映身體狀況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 waa6 lei6 toi4 ngaan4 sik1 ho2 ji5 faan2 jing2 san1 tai2 zong6 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中醫說舌苔的顏色可以反映身體狀況。
examples.english_sentence: TCM says the color of the tongue coating can reflect the body's condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生建議用刮舌器清潔脷苔，幫助改善口氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 gin3 ji5 jung6 gwaat3 sit3 hei3 cing1 git3 lei6 toi4, bong1 zo6 goi2 sin3 hau2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生建議用刮舌器清潔舌苔，有助改善口氣。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor suggested using a tongue scraper to clean the tongue coating; it helps improve bad breath.

mandarin_meaning: 擬聲詞，模仿舌頭拍擊或咂嘴的聲音，表示舔嘴或嘴巴發出聲響
english_meaning: An onomatopoeic slang imitating the sound of the tongue/lips smacking; used to describe lip-smacking, licking lips, or a mouthmaking noise
explanation_mandarin: 「脷𦧲𦧲」是廣東話的擬聲用法，取自「脷」（舌頭）加上重疊的罕用字𦧲，模仿咂嘴、舔嘴或舌頭拍擊口腔發出的聲音。因𦧲為罕見字，讀音有一定不確定性，這裡給出的是常見的近似粵拼。常用來形容看到好吃的東西而不停咂嘴或貪吃的樣子。
explanation_english: “脷𦧲𦧲” is a Cantonese onomatopoeic slang formed from 脷 (tongue) plus a repeated rare character 𦧲 to imitate the sound of tongue/lip-smacking. It describes lip-smacking, licking of the lips, or similar mouth noises. Because 𦧲 is an uncommon glyph, the exact pronunciation is not firmly standardized; the provided Jyutping is an approximate common reading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日脷𦧲𦧲，好似好想食咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lei6 laap3 laap3, hou2 ci5 hou2 soeng2 sik6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成天脷𦧲𦧲，好像很想吃東西。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps smacking his lips, as if he really wants to eat.

mandarin_meaning: （zhàng）膨脹、腫脹；（價格等）上漲
english_meaning: to swell or become distended (due to gas/liquid); to inflate; to rise (e.g., prices)
explanation_mandarin: 表示因內部積氣或液體而膨脹、腫起來，也可用於比喻或描述價格等上漲（如脹價）。常見於描述腹脹、腫脹或物價上升。
explanation_english: Indicates swelling or becoming distended because of internal gas or fluid; can also be used for increases such as prices rising (e.g., 'prices inflate'). Commonly used for bloated stomachs, swelling, or price increases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個肚好脹，可能食太多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 tou5 hou2 zoeng3, ho2 nang4 sik6 taai3 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我肚子很脹，可能吃太多東西。
examples.english_sentence: My stomach feels very bloated; maybe I ate too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近物價脹咗好多，買餸貴返唔少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 mat6 gaa3 zoeng3 zo2 hou2 do1, maai5 sung3 gwai3 faan1 m4 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近物價漲了很多，買菜貴了不少。
examples.english_sentence: Recently prices have risen a lot; buying groceries got considerably more expensive.

mandarin_meaning: 鼓鼓的／胀得鼓鼓的
english_meaning: puffed up; swollen; bulging; round and plump
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容某物或身體部位鼓起、腫脹或圓鼓鼓的樣子，常用來形容肚子、臉頰或包裹鼓起來的情況，帶有口語或稍微俏皮的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese term describing something that is puffed up, swollen, or round and bulging. Often used for a bloated stomach, chubby cheeks, or anything that has puffed out; carries an informal or mildly playful tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗咁多嘢，我依家肚仔脹卜卜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 gam2 do1 je5, ngo5 ji1 gaa1 tou5 zai2 zoeng3 buk1 buk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了这么多东西，我现在肚子鼓鼓的。
examples.english_sentence: I ate so much; my tummy is all bloated now.

mandarin_meaning: （物理）肿大、膨胀；（口语）夸大、渲染
english_meaning: to swell or expand (physically); colloquially, to exaggerate or blow something up
explanation_mandarin: 指體積或尺寸變大、腫脹或膨脹；在口語中也可指將事情或細節誇大、渲染，使看起來比實際更嚴重或更重要。
explanation_english: Refers to a physical increase in size (swelling or expansion). Colloquially, it can mean to exaggerate or blow something out of proportion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行多咗陣，隻腳脹大晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 do1 zo2 zan6, zek3 goek3 zoeng3 daai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走久了，脚肿起来了。
examples.english_sentence: After walking for a while, my foot swelled up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日將件事脹大，唔係好可信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoeng1 gin6 si6 zoeng3 daai6, m4 hai6 hou2 ho2 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常把事情夸大，不太可信。
examples.english_sentence: He often blows things out of proportion; not very believable.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）肚子或身體某處鼓脹、脹大的狀態
english_meaning: colloquial: bloated; puffed up; swollen (usually the stomach or a body part)
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容因脹氣、吃太多或腫脹而導致肚子或身體某處鼓起來的狀態，帶有口語或俚語色彩。
explanation_english: Used to describe a state where the stomach or a body part is puffed up or swollen due to bloating, overeating, etc. It is colloquial/slang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚食咗太多，依家成個肚脹泵泵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 sik6 zo2 taai3 do1, ji1 gaa1 seng4 go3 tou5 zoeng3 bam1 bam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚吃太多，現在整個肚子脹得鼓鼓的。
examples.english_sentence: I ate too much tonight; my whole stomach is all bloated.

mandarin_meaning: 脾（器官）；（口語）脾气、性情
english_meaning: spleen (organ); (colloquial) temper, disposition
explanation_mandarin: 「脾」可指人體內的器官（脾臟），在中醫語境中也常與「脾虛」等病理概念相連。另外口語中常見於複合詞如「脾氣」，表示性情或脾性。
explanation_english: “脾” can refer to the bodily organ (spleen). In traditional Chinese medicine it is used in diagnostic terms (e.g. spleen deficiency). In colloquial usage it appears in words like "脾氣" to mean temper or disposition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近去睇醫生，醫生話佢脾有問題，要做檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1, ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 pei4 jau5 man6 tai4, jiu3 zou6 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近去看医生，医生说他的脾有问题，需要做检查。
examples.english_sentence: He recently went to see a doctor; the doctor said his spleen has a problem and he needs tests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢脾氣好大，成日發脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pei4 hei3 hou2 daai6, sing4 jat6 faat3 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他脾气很大，总是发脾气。
examples.english_sentence: He has a big temper and is always losing his temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫話脾虛係常見嘅情況，通常要靠飲食調理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 waa6 pei4 heoi1 hai6 soeng4 gin3 ge3 cing4 fong3, tung1 soeng4 jiu3 kaau3 jam2 sik6 tiu4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中医说脾虚是常见的情况，通常需要靠饮食调理。
examples.english_sentence: Traditional Chinese medicine says spleen deficiency is common and usually needs dietary treatment.

mandarin_meaning: 脾氣、性情；一個人的性格或情緒傾向
english_meaning: temper; disposition; a person's nature or temperament (often refers to tendency to get angry or be stubborn)
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人的脾氣或性情，通常用來描述容易發怒、固執或情緒化的性格傾向。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's temper or disposition, often used to describe tendencies to get angry, be stubborn, or emotional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個脾性好火爆，一啲小事都會嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 pei4 sing3 hou2 fo2 baau3, jat1 di1 siu2 si6 dou1 wui5 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的脾性很火爆，常為小事生氣。
examples.english_sentence: His temper is explosive; he often gets angry over small things.

mandarin_meaning: 脾气（性情、脾性或容易发怒的倾向）
english_meaning: temper; temperament; mood; tendency to get angry
explanation_mandarin: 指一個人的性情或情緒傾向，尤其指容易發怒或不耐煩的性格或暫時的情緒狀態。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's temperament or emotional tendency, especially their tendency to get angry or be irritable; can mean stable temperament or a temporary mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個脾氣好差，成日發脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 pei4 hei3 hou2 caa1, sing4 jat6 faat3 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的脾气很差，经常发脾气。
examples.english_sentence: He has a bad temper and often loses his temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲脾氣一嚟，乜都唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 pei4 hei3 jat1 lei4, mat1 dou1 m4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一发脾气，什么都不管。
examples.english_sentence: When he gets angry, he ignores everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要識得控制自己嘅脾氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sik1 dak1 hung3 zai3 zi6 gei2 ge3 pei4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要学会控制自己的脾气。
examples.english_sentence: We should learn to control our temper.

mandarin_meaning: 脾气（耍脾气、发脾气）
english_meaning: temper; sulk; a fit of bad temper (Cantonese slang)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，指脾氣、耍脾氣或突然發脾氣的情況，常用來形容人容易生氣或耍性子。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial term for temper or sulking — describing someone getting upset, throwing a tantrum, or being moody.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日成日有脾罅，唔想理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1jat6 seng4jat6 jau5 pei4 haa6, m4 soeng2 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天一直在耍脾气，我不想理他。
examples.english_sentence: He's been sulking all day; I don't want to deal with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友一啲小事就有脾罅，真係幾煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 jat1 di1 siu2 si6 zau6 jau5 pei4 haa6, zan1 hai6 gei2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子一點小事就發脾氣，真的挺煩的。
examples.english_sentence: Kids get upset over the tiniest things; it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣講會惹到佢脾罅㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 gong2 wui5 je5 dou3 keoi5 pei4 haa6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣說會惹他生氣。
examples.english_sentence: Saying that will make him get upset.

mandarin_meaning: 脾胃（pí wèi）：指脾和胃，常用以表示消化功能或胃口、食欲，在中醫語境中亦指脾胃功能的強弱。
english_meaning: spleen and stomach; (figuratively) appetite or digestive system/function
explanation_mandarin: 「脾胃」原指脾與胃兩個器官，常用來描述消化系統的功能或一個人的胃口。在中醫語境中，脾胃虛或脾胃強弱用來說明消化吸收能力與整體狀況。
explanation_english: Literally 'spleen and stomach.' Used to refer to the digestive system or a person's appetite. In traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) it describes the strength or deficiency of digestive functions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近我脾胃唔好，成日冇胃口，食唔落嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 pei4 wai6 m4 hou2, sing4 jat6 mou5 wai6 hau2, sik6 m4 lok6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近我脾胃不好，常常沒胃口，吃不下東西。
examples.english_sentence: Lately my spleen/stomach (appetite) aren't good — I often have no appetite and can't eat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中醫話我脾胃虛，要補脾健脾，咁先可以改善消化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 ji1 waa6 ngo5 pei4 wai6 heoi1, jiu3 bou2 pei4 gin6 pei4, gam2 sin1 ho2 ji5 goi2 sin6 siu1 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中醫說我脾胃虛，需要補脾健脾，這樣才能改善消化。
examples.english_sentence: The TCM doctor said my spleen and stomach are deficient; I need to strengthen them to improve digestion.

mandarin_meaning: 脾臟 / 脾（器官）
english_meaning: spleen (organ)
explanation_mandarin: 人體內的一個淋巴器官，位於左上腹，參與免疫反應、血液過濾與儲存等功能。
explanation_english: An internal lymphoid organ located in the upper left abdomen involved in immune responses, filtering and storing blood cells.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我要檢查下脾臟有冇問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jiu3 gim2 caa4 haa6 pei4 zong6 jau5 mou5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 醫生說我要檢查一下脾臟有沒有問題。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said I need to have my spleen checked for any problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為脾臟破咗，要緊急開刀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 pei4 zong6 po3 zo2, jiu3 gan2 gap1 hoi1 dou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為脾臟破裂，需要緊急開刀。
examples.english_sentence: He needed emergency surgery because his spleen ruptured.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）靦腆、害羞；（在某些詞中）厚顏無恥；古義有突出、鼓起之意。
english_meaning: bashful, shy (colloquial); in some compounds 'thick-faced' or shameless; archaically 'to bulge' or 'protrude'.
explanation_mandarin: 在廣東話口語中，單字「腆」常用來表示害羞、靦腆（例如「佢好腆」）；在某些詞語（如「腆面」）中則表示厚臉皮、厚顏無恥。此字在古漢語中也有凸出、鼓起的含義。
explanation_english: In colloquial Cantonese, the character '腆' commonly means shy or bashful (e.g., '佢好腆'). In some compounds (such as '腆面') it conveys being thick-faced or shameless. Historically it could also mean to bulge or protrude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到生人就腆，唔敢講嘢。
