examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成功之後變得好自滿，唔再聽其他人意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 gung1 zi1 hau6 bin3 dak1 hou2 zi6 mun5, m4 zoi6 teng1 kei4 taa1 jan4 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成功之後變得很自滿，不再聽別人的意見。
examples.english_sentence: After his success he became very complacent and stopped listening to others' opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小心唔好自滿，仲有好多嘢要學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 zi6 mun5, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小心不要自滿，還有很多東西要學。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful not to be complacent; there's still a lot to learn.

mandarin_meaning: 自慰（自我性刺激）、手淫
english_meaning: masturbation; self-stimulation (sexual)
explanation_mandarin: 指個人以手或其他方式對自身性器官進行刺激，以獲得性快感或達到高潮。詞語在口語中可與「自慰」「手淫」互換；在文言或正式語境中亦可見到用法。
explanation_english: Refers to a person stimulating their own sexual organs (typically by hand) to obtain sexual pleasure or reach orgasm. In colloquial use it corresponds to terms like 'masturbate' or 'self-stimulate'; the term can appear in more formal or literary contexts as well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢瞓覺之前有時會自瀆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan3 gaau3 zi1 cin4 jau5 si4 wui5 zi6 duk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他睡覺前有時會自瀆。
examples.english_sentence: He sometimes masturbates before going to sleep.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）把自己弄到被解雇／自找麻煩；（字面）自己炒菜
english_meaning: In slang usage: to get oneself fired or to bring trouble on oneself; literally: to stir-fry by oneself
explanation_mandarin: 「自炒」在香港廣東話俚語中常用作動詞，指因個人行為或決定而導致被公司解僱或自我造成失業，也可引申為自找麻煩。字面上亦可表示自己炒（菜）。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong Cantonese slang, '自炒' (literally 'self-fry') is used as a verb meaning to get oneself fired (due to one's own actions) or more generally to bring trouble upon oneself. Literally it can also mean to stir-fry/cook for oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣對客人發脾氣，好易自炒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 deoi3 haak3jan4 faat3 pei4hei3, hou2 ji6 zi6 caau2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣對客戶發脾氣，很容易被公司開除。
examples.english_sentence: If you lose your temper with clients like that, you'll easily get yourself fired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽人勸，做錯咗幾單生意，結果自炒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 teng1 jan4 hyun3, zou6 co3 zo2 gei2 daan1 sang1ji3, git3gwo2 zi6 caau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不聽勸告，做錯了好幾單生意，結果被公司開除了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't listen to advice, messed up several deals, and ended up getting himself fired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚冇人幫手，我只好自炒一餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 mou5 jan4 bong1 sau2, ngo5 zi2 hou2 zi6 caau2 jat1 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚沒有人幫忙，我只好自己炒一頓飯。
examples.english_sentence: No one was around to help tonight, so I had to stir-fry dinner myself.

mandarin_meaning: 自焚（自焚、以火自殺或以火示威）
english_meaning: self-immolation (setting oneself on fire; an act of suicide or protest by burning oneself)
explanation_mandarin: 指以火燒自己，通常作為自殺或抗議的極端行為。
explanation_english: Refers to setting oneself on fire, usually as an extreme act of suicide or a form of protest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋絕望到有人選擇以自焚嚟抗議。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyut6 mong6 dou3 jau5 jan4 syun2 zaak6 ji5 zi6 fan4 lai4 kong3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他們絕望到有人選擇以自焚抗議。
examples.english_sentence: They were so desperate that some people chose self-immolation to protest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報道提到有數宗自焚事件，警方正調查原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 dou6 tai4 dou3 jau5 sou3 zung1 zi6 fan4 si6 gin6, ging2 fong1 zing3 diu6 caa4 jyun4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 報道提到有數起自焚事件，警方正在調查原因。
examples.english_sentence: Reports mentioned several cases of self-immolation, and the police are investigating the causes.

mandarin_meaning: 自然 (zìrán) — 自然；天然；自然而然
english_meaning: nature; natural; naturally
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 形容词 / 副词
explanation_mandarin: 表示大自然或事物不經修飾、天生的狀態；也可表示事情理所當然、自然而然發生。
explanation_english: Refers to nature or a state that is unmodified/innate; can also mean that something happens of course or naturally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意去山上行山，親近自然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 heoi3 saan1 soeng6 hang4 saan1, can1 gan6 zi6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢去山上爬山，亲近自然。
examples.english_sentence: I like hiking in the mountains to be close to nature.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好太擔心，畀啲時間，自然會有結果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 taai3 daam1 sam1, bei2 di1 si4 gaan3, zi6 jin4 wui5 jau5 git3 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要太担心，给点时间，自然会有结果。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry too much; give it some time and there will naturally be results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺鏡頭前面表現得好自然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 geng3 tau4 cin4 min6 biu2 jin2 dak1 hou2 zi6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在镜头前的表现很自然。
examples.english_sentence: He behaved very naturally in front of the camera.

mandarin_meaning: 自然反应；下意识或本能的反应
english_meaning: natural reaction; an instinctive or automatic response (reflex)
explanation_mandarin: 指人在没有经过深思熟虑时，自然而然产生的反应或举动，也可指生理上的本能反应。
explanation_english: Refers to an automatic or instinctive response that occurs without conscious thought; can also mean a physiological reflex.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 當聽到巨響時，我嘅自然反應係衝出房間逃走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dong1 teng1 dou3 geoi6 hoeng2 si4, ngo5 ge3 zi6 jin4 faan2 jing3 hai6 cung1 ceot1 fong4 gaan1 tou4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当听到巨响时，我的自然反应是冲出房间逃走。
examples.english_sentence: When I heard the loud bang, my natural reaction was to run out of the room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對突如其來嘅問題，佢嘅自然反應係保持冷靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 dat6 jyu4 kei4 loi4 ge3 man6 tai4, keoi5 ge3 zi6 jin4 faan2 jing3 hai6 bou2 ci4 laang5 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对突如其来的问题，他的自然反应是保持冷静。
examples.english_sentence: Facing the sudden problem, his natural reaction was to stay calm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嬰兒見到光線反射會眨眼，呢啲係本能嘅自然反應。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing1 ji4 gin3 dou3 gwong1 sin3 faan2 se6 wui5 zaa3 ngaan5, ni1 di1 hai6 bun2 nang4 ge3 zi6 jin4 faan2 jing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 婴儿看到强光会眨眼，这些是本能的自然反应。
examples.english_sentence: Babies blink when they see bright light; these are instinctive natural reactions.

mandarin_meaning: 自然数
english_meaning: natural number(s)
explanation_mandarin: 數學中指一類整數，通常是從0或從1開始的非負整數集合；是否包含0取決於所採用的定義。
explanation_english: In mathematics, the set of integers typically called natural numbers; conventionally taken as either the non-negative integers starting at 0 or the positive integers starting at 1, depending on definition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺數學課堂上，老師解釋咗自然數嘅定義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 sou3 hok6 fo3 tong4 seong6, lou5 si1 gaai2 sik1 zo2 zi6 jin4 sou3 ge3 ding6 ji6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在數學課堂上，老師解釋了自然數的定義。
examples.english_sentence: In the math class, the teacher explained the definition of natural numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 根據唔同嘅定義，自然數可以包括0。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 geoi3 m4 tung4 ge3 ding6 ji6, zi6 jin4 sou3 ho2 ji5 baau1 kut3 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 根據不同的定義，自然數可以包括0。
examples.english_sentence: Depending on the definition, natural numbers may include 0.

mandarin_meaning: 自然段（段落）
english_meaning: paragraph (a unit of writing focused on a single topic)
explanation_mandarin: 指文章中按內容劃分的段落單位，通常每個自然段集中討論一個子主題或一個完整的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to a section of text divided according to content; typically each natural paragraph concentrates on a single subtopic or complete idea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師教我哋點樣分自然段，話每段應該只講一個主題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 gaau3 ngo5 dei6 dim2 joeng6 fan1 zi6 jin4 dyun6, waa6 mui5 dyun6 jing1 goi1 zi2 gong2 jat1 go3 zyu2 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老师教我们怎样分自然段，说每段应该只讲一个主题。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher taught us how to divide natural paragraphs, saying each paragraph should cover only one topic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇報告嘅自然段太長，讀者可能會唔容易明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 bou3 gou3 ge3 zi6 jin4 dyun6 taai3 coeng4, duk6 ze2 ho2 nang4 wui5 m4 jung4 ji6 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇报告的自然段太长，读者可能不容易理解。
examples.english_sentence: The paragraphs in this report are too long; readers may find them hard to understand.

mandarin_meaning: 自然界 / 自然世界 (zìrán jiè) — 指大自然和生物環境
english_meaning: the natural world; nature; the realm of nature
explanation_mandarin: 指地球上非人造的自然事物和系統，包括動植物、氣候、地形、生態等整體，即『大自然』。
explanation_english: Refers to the natural world — non-human-made phenomena and systems such as plants, animals, climate, landforms and ecosystems; essentially 'nature'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺自然界入面，每一樣生物都有佢嘅角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zi6 jin4 gaai3 jap6 min6, mui5 jat1 joeng6 sang1 mat6 dou1 jau5 keoi5 ge3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在自然界里面，每一种生物都有它的角色。
examples.english_sentence: In the natural world, every organism has its role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自然界嘅平衡好容易畀人類活動破壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 jin4 gaai3 ge3 ping4 hang4 hou2 jung4 ji6 bei6 jan4 leoi6 wut6 dung6 po3 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自然界的平衡很容易被人类活动破坏。
examples.english_sentence: The balance of the natural world is easily damaged by human activities.

mandarin_meaning: 自然科学
english_meaning: natural science; the sciences that study natural phenomena
explanation_mandarin: 指研究自然界現象及其規律的科學總稱，通常包括物理、化學、生物、地理等分支。
explanation_english: Refers to the branch of science that studies natural phenomena and their laws; commonly includes fields such as physics, chemistry, biology, and geography.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺中學主修自然科學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 zung1 hok6 zyu2 sau1 zi6 jin4 fo1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在中学主修自然科学。
examples.english_sentence: I majored in natural sciences in secondary school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自然科學包括物理、化學、生物同地理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 jin4 fo1 hok6 baau1 kut3 mat6 lei5, fo3 hok6, saang1 mat6 tung4 dei6 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自然科学包括物理、化学、生物和地理。
examples.english_sentence: The natural sciences include physics, chemistry, biology, and geography.

mandarin_meaning: 自然而然（表示事情不經刻意安排或強迫，而是順其自然地發生或發展）
english_meaning: naturally; as a matter of course; without deliberate effort
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情不經刻意的安排或強迫，而是順其自然地發生或發展。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens or develops on its own, without deliberate intervention or force; it occurs naturally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋慢慢相處，自然而然就成為咗好朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 maan6 maan6 soeng1 cyu3, zi6 jin4 ji4 jin4 zau6 sing4 wai4 zo2 hou2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们慢慢相处，自然而然就成为了好朋友。
examples.english_sentence: They spent time together gradually and naturally became good friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使急，事情會自然而然解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gap1, si6 cing4 wui5 zi6 jin4 ji4 jin4 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用着急，事情会自然而然解决。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry; the matter will resolve itself naturally.

mandarin_meaning: 自爆 (zì bào)：1) 字面上指自我炸毀或自殺式攻擊；2) 口語/網絡用法指自己揭露或不小心透露不利於自己的資訊或秘密。
english_meaning: self-destruct / to blow oneself up; colloquially: to expose or reveal (often unintentionally) incriminating or embarrassing information about oneself
explanation_mandarin: 「自爆」有兩層常見用法：一是字面意思，指自行爆炸或自我犧牲式攻擊；二是口語或網絡用法，指自己揭露身份、秘密或不利訊息（可能是有意或無意）。
explanation_english: There are two common uses of "自爆": literally to blow oneself up or commit a self-destructive attack; colloquially (esp. online) to reveal or expose one’s own identity, secrets, or damaging information—either intentionally or accidentally.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺群組度自爆咗自己嘅秘密，依家大家都知啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 kwan4 zou2 dou6 zi6 baau3 zo2 zi6 ge3 bei3 mat6, ji1 gaa1 daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在群組裡自爆了自己的秘密，現在大家都知道了。
examples.english_sentence: He revealed his secret in the group chat; now everyone knows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺遊戲入面，佢自爆咗，反而幫咗敵隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6, keoi5 zi6 baau3 zo2, faan2 ji4 bong1 zo2 dik6 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在遊戲裡，他自爆了，反而幫了敵隊。
examples.english_sentence: In the game, he self-destructed and ended up helping the enemy team.

mandarin_meaning: 自甘堕落；甘心放弃进步或道德约束，沉溺于颓废或不良行为
english_meaning: to willingly degenerate; to resign oneself to decadence or moral decline
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人主动放弃自我要求或社会责任，甘心沉沦、沉迷于颓废或不良习惯。
explanation_english: Describes someone who willingly gives up standards or responsibilities and sinks into decadence or harmful behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自甘墮落，成日瞓晏覺，冇心機搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 zi6 gam1 do6 lok6, seng4 jat6 fan3 ngaan3 gaau3, mou5 sam1 gei1 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自甘堕落，整天睡懒觉，没心思找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He has willingly sunk into decline — sleeping in every day and not motivated to look for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日同唔好朋友周圍飲酒，簡直係自甘墮落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Keoi5 seng4 jat6 tung4 m4 hou2 pang4 jau5 zau1 wai4 jam2 zau2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 zi6 gam1 do6 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是和坏朋友到处喝酒，简直是在自甘堕落。
examples.english_sentence: He always drinks around with bad company; it's basically willingly sinking into ruin.

mandarin_meaning: 自生自灭
english_meaning: to be left to fend for oneself; left to live and die on its own; let something take its natural course without intervention
explanation_mandarin: 表示讓某人或某事自行發展或衰亡，不加干預或照顧，任其自然消長。
explanation_english: Indicates leaving a person or thing to develop or perish on its own without intervention or care; letting something take its natural course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔肯再投資，嗰個項目就自生自滅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 hang2 zoi3 tau4 zi1, go2 go3 hong6 muk6 zau6 zi6 saang1 zi6 mit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不肯再投资，那个项目就自生自灭。
examples.english_sentence: The company refused to invest further, so that project was left to fend for itself.

mandarin_meaning: 自用（zìyòng）：供個人使用，不對外出售或借出
english_meaning: for personal use; intended for one's own use (not for sale or lending)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物是留作個人使用，不打算出售或借給別人，常用於說明物品用途或狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates that an item is intended for personal use — kept for the owner's use and not meant to be sold or lent out; often used to describe an item's intended purpose or status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話係自用，唔會賣俾人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 hai6 zi6 jung6, m4 wui5 maai6 bei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部手機是自用的，不會賣給別人。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is for personal use; I won't sell it to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢箱酒係自用，唔係賣嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 soeng1 zau2 hai6 zi6 jung6, m4 hai6 maai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這箱酒是自用的，不是要賣的。
examples.english_sentence: This case of wine is for personal use, not for sale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買返嚟係自用，唔會借畀人用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 faan1 lai4 hai6 zi6 jung6, m4 wui5 ze3 bei2 jan4 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我買回來是自用的，不會借給別人用。
examples.english_sentence: I bought it for personal use; I won't lend it to others.

mandarin_meaning: 自由 (zìyóu)
english_meaning: freedom; liberty; free
explanation_mandarin: 指不受约束、可以自主行动或选择的状态，可作名词或形容词使用。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of being unrestrained or able to act/choose independently; can function as a noun or an adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想有多啲自由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jau5 do1 di1 zi6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想有更多自由。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have more freedom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 言論自由好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin4 leon6 zi6 jau4 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 言论自由很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Freedom of speech is very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以自由安排時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 zi6 jau4 on1 paai4 si4 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以自由安排时间。
examples.english_sentence: You can schedule your time freely.

mandarin_meaning: 自由世界 (zìyóu shìjiè)
english_meaning: the free world
explanation_mandarin: 指享有言論、結社等自由的國家或社會，常用於政治語境，與專制或封閉體制相對。
explanation_english: Refers to countries or societies that enjoy freedoms such as speech and association; commonly used in political contexts and contrasted with authoritarian or closed systems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺自由世界入面，新聞可以自由發表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zi6 jau4 sai3 gaai3 jap6 min6, san1 man4 ho2 ji5 zi6 jau4 faat3 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在自由世界裡，新聞可以自由發表。
examples.english_sentence: In the free world, the press can publish freely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情期間，香港同自由世界嘅交流變得困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing4 king4 kei4 gaan1, hoeng1 gong2 tung4 zi6 jau4 sai3 gaai3 ge3 gaau1 lau4 bin3 dak1 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 疫情期間，香港與自由世界的交流變得困難。
examples.english_sentence: During the pandemic, exchanges between Hong Kong and the free world became difficult.

mandarin_meaning: 自由市场 / 自由經濟下的市場（自由貿易、價格由供需決定）
english_meaning: free market (an economic system where prices and trade are determined by supply and demand with minimal government intervention)
explanation_mandarin: 指在市場機制下，商品與服務的價格和資源配置主要由供求關係決定，政府干預較少或有限的經濟體制或市場模式。
explanation_english: An economic concept/system in which goods and services prices and resource allocation are primarily determined by supply and demand with limited government intervention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該維持自由市場，減少干預。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 wai4 ci4 zi6 jau4 si5 coeng4, gaam2 siu2 gon1 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府應該維持自由市場，減少干預。
examples.english_sentence: The government should maintain a free market and reduce intervention.

mandarin_meaning: 自由式（指自由的風格或不受限制的表現方式；在體育項目中常指自由泳或自由式項目）
english_meaning: freestyle (a free/unrestricted style; in sports often refers to freestyle events such as freestyle swimming)
explanation_mandarin: 「自由式」可用來形容不受既定規則束縛、以自由風格表現的方式；在體育語境下，通常指自由泳或以自由式規則進行的項目。
explanation_english: “Freestyle” describes a free or unrestricted way of performing or expressing something. In sports contexts it commonly refers to freestyle events, for example freestyle swimming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺學校游泳隊做自由式選手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hok6 haau6 jau4 wing6 deoi6 zou6 zi6 jau4 sik1 syun2 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在學校游泳隊是自由式選手。
examples.english_sentence: He is a freestyle swimmer on the school's swim team.

mandarin_meaning: 自由心证（法律術語），指法官在審理案件時，根據證據自由形成的內心確信或判斷
english_meaning: Free evaluation of evidence; a legal concept where a judge forms a subjective conviction or judgment based on the evidence
explanation_mandarin: 在法律語境中，自由心證指法官依據庭上呈現的證據，按其心中形成的確信作出判斷。此概念強調證據評價的自由性，但亦常被批評為帶有主觀性。
explanation_english: In legal contexts, 'free evaluation of evidence' refers to a judge forming a conviction based on the evidence presented in court. It emphasizes the judge's freedom to assess evidence, but can be criticized for allowing subjectivity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法官喺審訊入面用自由心證，按證據作出裁決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 gwan1 hai2 sam2 seon3 jap6 min6 jung6 zi6 jau4 sam1 zing3, on3 zing3 geoi3 zok3 ceot1 coi4 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法官在审讯中采用自由心证，根据证据作出裁决。
examples.english_sentence: The judge used free evaluation of evidence during the trial and made a ruling based on the evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 辯方話法官唔可以淨係憑自由心證定罪，應該要有確實證據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bin6 fong1 waa6 faat3 gwan1 m4 ho2 ji5 zing6 hai6 ping4 zi6 jau4 sam1 zing3 ding6 zeoi6, jing1 goi1 jiu3 jau5 kok3 sat6 zing3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 辩方说法官不能仅凭自由心证定罪，应该要有确实证据。
examples.english_sentence: The defense argues the judge cannot convict solely on free evaluation of evidence; there should be concrete proof.

mandarin_meaning: 自由心證（指法官或裁判者對證據的自由評價與認定）
english_meaning: free evaluation of evidence; the judge's discretionary conviction based on their assessment of evidence
explanation_mandarin: 在法律審判中，指法官或事實認定者不受固定證據評價公式限制，根據自身對證據的自由評價形成認定或信念的一種原則或現象。此概念強調裁判者對證據可信度和證明力的主觀判斷空間。
explanation_english: In law, the principle that a judge or fact-finder forms conviction based on their free assessment of the evidence, not bound by strict evidentiary formulas. It emphasizes the trier's discretionary evaluation of credibility and probative value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺法庭上，法官會根據證據作出自由心證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 faat3 ting4 soeng6, faat3 gun1 wui5 gan1 geoi3 zing3 geoi3 zok3 ceot1 zi6 jau4 sam1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在法庭上，法官會根據證據作出自由心證。
examples.english_sentence: In court, the judge will form a free conviction based on the evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 自由意志（哲学术语，指个体做出选择和行动的自主能力）
english_meaning: free will (the capacity to make choices that are not wholly determined by external causes)
explanation_mandarin: 在哲學中指個人不完全受因果或外在因素決定，而能自主選擇行為和決定的能力或概念。
explanation_english: In philosophy, the concept that an individual has the capacity to make choices and decisions independently of deterministic external causes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢相信每個人都有自由意志，可以自己揀選自己嘅道路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng1 seon3 mui5 go3 jan4 dou1 jau5 zi6 jau4 ji3 zi3, ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 gaan2 syun2 zi6 gei2 ge3 dou6 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他相信每個人都有自由意志，可以自己選擇自己的人生道路。
examples.english_sentence: He believes everyone has free will and can choose their own path in life.

mandarin_meaning: 自由泳
english_meaning: freestyle (swimming); freestyle stroke (usually front crawl)
explanation_mandarin: 一种游泳项目或泳姿。“自由泳”在比赛规则上允许使用任意泳姿，但通常指的是爬泳（前爬）。
explanation_english: A swimming event or stroke. In competition 'freestyle' permits any stroke, but it commonly refers to the front crawl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意游自由泳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 jau4 zi6 jau4 wing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢游自由泳。
examples.english_sentence: I like swimming freestyle.

mandarin_meaning: 自由自在
english_meaning: free and at ease; carefree; unrestrained
explanation_mandarin: 表示沒有拘束、隨心所欲、悠閒自在的狀態。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being unrestrained, carefree, and at ease; able to act as one pleases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搬咗出嚟住之後，日子過得自由自在多咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bun1 zo2 ceot1 lai4 zyu6 zi1 hau6, jat6 zi2 gwo3 dak1 zi6 jau4 zi6 zoi6 do1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我搬出來住之後，日子過得自由自在多了。
examples.english_sentence: After I moved out, my life became much freer and more carefree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 小朋友喺公園跑嚟跑去，玩得好自由自在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 gung1 jyun4 paau2 lai4 paau2 heoi3, waan2 dak1 hou2 zi6 jau4 zi6 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小朋友在公園跑來跑去，玩得很自由自在。
examples.english_sentence: The kids running around in the park were playing very freely and carefree.

mandarin_meaning: 自由落体
english_meaning: free fall
explanation_mandarin: 指在重力作用下、忽略空氣阻力時，物體僅受重力影響而自由下落的運動。
explanation_english: The motion of an object falling under gravity alone, ignoring air resistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔計空氣阻力，物體會做自由落體運動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 gai3 hung1 hei3 zo2 lik6, mat6 tai2 wui5 zou6 zi6 jau4 lok6 tai2 wan6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不考慮空气阻力，物体将做自由落体运动。
examples.english_sentence: If air resistance is ignored, the object will undergo free-fall motion.

mandarin_meaning: 自由行（自行安排行程、不跟團的旅遊方式）
english_meaning: independent travel; self-guided tour
explanation_mandarin: 指旅客不參加旅行團，由自己安排行程、機票和住宿等的旅遊方式，常用於區別跟團遊。
explanation_english: Refers to traveling independently without joining an organized tour; travelers arrange their own itinerary, transport, and accommodation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋打算下個月去日本自由行，唔跟旅行團。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 zi6 jau4 haang4, m4 gan1 leoi5 hang4 tyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们打算下个月去日本自由行，不跟团。
examples.english_sentence: We're planning to travel to Japan independently next month, not joining a tour group.

mandarin_meaning: 自由贸易 (zìyóu màoyì)
english_meaning: free trade
explanation_mandarin: 指商品或服務在國家或地區之間自由流通、減少關稅和貿易壁壘的經濟政策或體制。
explanation_english: Refers to the economic policy or system where goods and services move freely between countries or regions with reduced tariffs and trade barriers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港一向支持自由貿易政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jat1 hoeng3 zi1 ci4 zi6 jau4 mau6 jik6 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港一向支持自由贸易政策。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has always supported free trade policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果簽咗自由貿易協定，關稅會減少，進出口就會方便啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 cim1 zo2 zi6 jau4 mau6 jik6 hip3 ding6, gwaan1 seoi2 wui5 gaam2 siu2, zeon3 ceot1 hau2 zau6 wui5 fong1 bin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果签署了自由贸易协定，关税会减少，进出口就会更方便。
examples.english_sentence: If a free trade agreement is signed, tariffs will be reduced and importing and exporting will become more convenient.

mandarin_meaning: 自由身／自由人（指不受約束、無固定工作或感情束縛的人）
english_meaning: free agent; unattached person — someone not bound by a contract, job, or relationship
explanation_mandarin: 「自由身」通常用來形容一個人沒有受僱約束或沒有感情上的牽絆，可以指自由職業者、未婚或剛脫離關係的人。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person who is not bound by an employment contract or relationship ties; can refer to a freelancer, someone single, or someone newly unattached.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家做自由身，想試吓唔同嘅 freelance 工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 zi6 jau4 san1, soeng2 si3 haa5 m4 tung4 ge3 freelance gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在做自由身，想嘗試不同的自由職業工作。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently a free agent and wants to try different freelance jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 分手之後佢變咗自由身，好快又有新對象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan1 sau2 zi1 hau6 keoi5 bin3 zo2 zi6 jau4 san1, hou2 faai3 jau6 jau5 san1 deoi3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 分手之後他就變成自由身，很快又有了新對象。
examples.english_sentence: After the breakup he became single again and soon had a new partner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔續約，佢下個月就會做自由身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 zuk6 joek3, keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 wui5 zou6 zi6 jau4 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不續約，他下個月就會變成自由身。
examples.english_sentence: The company didn't renew his contract, so he'll be a free agent next month.

mandarin_meaning: 字面為「自由+閪」，屬粗俗俚語，指為所欲為、不受約束或不負責任、自我中心的人（帶貶義）。
english_meaning: A vulgar slang term literally meaning 'free cunt'; an insulting label for someone who does whatever they want without regard for rules or others (pejorative).
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容行為自我、任性、常常不顧他人或不守規矩的人，語氣粗俗，多用作譏諷或罵人。
explanation_english: Used to describe a person who is self-centered, reckless or does as they please without consideration for others; coarse and derogatory, often used to insult or mock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日咁做，真係一個自由閪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gam2 zou6 je5, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 zi6 jau4 hai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是這樣做，真是個自由閪。
examples.english_sentence: He always does things like that — he's such a 'free cunt' (vulgar term for someone who does whatever they want).

mandarin_meaning: 自由骑士（zìyóu qíshì）：字面上是自由的騎乘者，常用來指追求騎行自由、行事隨性的人；在口語或新聞語境中也會帶有貶義，指無視交通規則的機車或自行車騎士。
english_meaning: “Free rider” or “free-spirited rider”: literally a rider who values freedom; often refers to motorcyclists/cyclists who ride freely and sometimes recklessly, occasionally used pejoratively.
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容喜歡追求騎行自由、行動隨性的人；在日常語境中可正面描述自由奔放，也可負面指不守交通規則的騎士。
explanation_english: Describes someone who values the freedom of riding and acts independently; can be positive (free-spirited rider) or negative (a rider who disregards traffic rules).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲自由騎士成日喺度無視交通規則，令到其他人好危險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zi6 jau4 kei4 si6 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 mou4 si6 gaau1 tung1 gwai1 zak1, ling6 dou3 kei4 taa1 jan4 hou2 ngai4 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些自由骑士经常无视交通规则，导致其他人很危险。
examples.english_sentence: Those 'free riders' often ignore traffic rules, making things very dangerous for others.

mandarin_meaning: 自由黨（香港）
english_meaning: Liberal Party (Hong Kong)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（專有名詞／政黨名稱）
explanation_mandarin: 香港的一個親商、相對保守的政黨，成立於1993年，主要代表工商界利益，通常被歸類為建制派。
explanation_english: A pro-business, relatively conservative political party in Hong Kong, founded in 1993, primarily representing commercial and business interests and generally considered part of the pro-establishment camp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自由黨喺香港係一個主要代表工商界嘅政黨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 jau4 dong2 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 zyu2 jiu3 doi6 biu2 gung1 soeng1 gaai3 ge3 zing3 dong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自由黨在香港是一個主要代表工商界的政黨。
examples.english_sentence: The Liberal Party is a political party in Hong Kong that primarily represents the business community.

mandarin_meaning: 自发 (zìfā) — 自行发生或主动进行的，不是被外力强迫的
english_meaning: spontaneous; voluntary; done of one's own initiative
explanation_mandarin: 表示主動、自行發起或進行某事，沒有外在強制或命令。例如：自發組織、自發幫忙。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something on one's own initiative or spontaneously, without external compulsion or orders. For example: spontaneously organizing, volunteering to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係自發嚟幫手整理教室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 zi6 faat3 lai4 bong1 sau2 zing2 lei5 gaau3 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是自发来帮忙整理教室。
examples.english_sentence: We came voluntarily to help tidy the classroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自發留低做多啲工作，冇人叫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 faat3 lau4 dai1 zou6 do1 di1 gung1 zok3, mou5 jan4 giu3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自发留下来多做一些工作，没人叫他。
examples.english_sentence: He voluntarily stayed to do more work; nobody asked him to.

mandarin_meaning: 自发粉丝 / 自发支持者
english_meaning: spontaneous/voluntary fans (not paid or organized); grassroots supporters
explanation_mandarin: 指那些不是受雇或受組織安排，而是主動自發出席或參與支持活動的粉絲，強調自發性，常用以區別於水軍或受邀的應援人員。
explanation_english: Refers to fans who attend or support voluntarily on their own initiative (not hired or organized). Emphasizes grassroots, spontaneous support and is often contrasted with paid fans or hired shills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋唔係請嚟嘅，係一班自發粉，自己嚟支持偶像。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 m4 hai6 ceng2 lai4 ge3, hai6 jat1 baan1 zi6faat3 fan2, zi6 gei2 lai4 zi1 ci4 ngau5 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们不是请来的，是一群自发粉，自己来支持偶像。
examples.english_sentence: They weren't hired; they're a group of spontaneous fans who came on their own to support the idol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司要分清楚自發粉同水軍，免得誤會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jiu3 fan1 cing1 co2 zi6faat3 fan2 tung4 seoi2 gwan1, min5 dak1 ng6 wui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要分清楚自发粉和水军，以免误会。
examples.english_sentence: The company must distinguish between spontaneous fans and paid shills to avoid misunderstandings.

mandarin_meaning: 自白（承認、坦白）
english_meaning: confession; to confess; to admit
explanation_mandarin: 表示自己承認某事或向他人交代內心想法，可作動詞（去自白、坦白）或名詞（一次自白、供述）。
explanation_english: To admit or confess something; can be used as a verb (to confess) or as a noun (a confession or admission).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於向我自白，話佢鍾意我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 hoeng3 ngo5 zi6 baak6, waa6 keoi5 zung1 ji3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於向我自白，說他喜歡我。
examples.english_sentence: He finally confessed to me that he likes me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方得到佢嘅自白，案件有突破。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 dak1 dou3 keoi5 ge3 zi6 baak6, on3 gin6 jau5 tou3 po3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方得到了他的自白，案件有了突破。
examples.english_sentence: The police obtained his confession, and the case made a breakthrough.

mandarin_meaning: 自盡 / 自殺
english_meaning: to kill oneself; to commit suicide
explanation_mandarin: 指自己結束生命，即自殺。
explanation_english: Refers to ending one's own life; to commit suicide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想自盡，幸好被朋友發現及時勸阻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zi6 zeon6, hang6 hou2 bei6 pang4 jau5 faat3 jin4 kap6 si4 kyun3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想自盡，幸好被朋友發現並及時勸阻。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to kill himself; fortunately a friend discovered it and persuaded him in time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報章報道指出，失業率上升令更多人有自盡念頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 zoeng1 bou3 dou6 zi2 ceot1, sat1 jip6 leot6 soeng5 sing1 ling6 gang1 do1 jan4 jau5 zi6 zeon6 nim6 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 報章報導指出，失業率上升使更多人產生自盡念頭。
examples.english_sentence: Newspapers reported that rising unemployment has led more people to have suicidal thoughts.

mandarin_meaning: 自相残杀 (zì xiāng cán shā)
english_meaning: to destroy/kill one another; to engage in mutual destruction or infighting within the same group
explanation_mandarin: 原意指互相殘殺，現多用於形容同一陣營或同類之間互相鬥爭、互相傷害，導致雙方受損或失敗。
explanation_english: Originally meant to kill one another; now commonly used to describe infighting within the same camp or group, where members harm each other and cause mutual loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嗰兩個部門為咗爭奪升職機會，成日自相殘殺，最後兩邊都輸咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 go2 loeng5 go3 bou6 mun4 wai6 zo2 zang1 dyut6 sing1 zik1 gei1 wui6, sing4 jat6 zi6 soeng1 caan4 saat3, zeoi6 hau6 loeng5 bin1 dou1 syu1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司那兩個部門為了爭奪升職機會，整天自相殘殺，最後雙方都吃虧了。
examples.english_sentence: The two departments at the company have been fighting each other over promotion opportunities, constantly infighting, and in the end both sides lost out.

mandarin_meaning: 自相矛盾（指自己说的话或做的事前后矛盾）
english_meaning: To contradict oneself; self-contradiction
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成语；可作动词或形容词
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人说的话或做的事相互冲突、前后不一致，互相矛盾。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone's statements or actions conflict with each other — a self-contradiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日咁講又咁做，真係自相矛盾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 gam2 gong2 jau6 gam2 zou6, zan1 hai6 zi6 soeng1 maau4 deon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是这样说又那样做，真是自相矛盾。
examples.english_sentence: You always say one thing and do another — it's really self-contradictory.

mandarin_meaning: 自知之明（知道自己的能力或局限，對自己有清醒的認識）
english_meaning: self-knowledge; a realistic awareness of one's own abilities and limitations
explanation_mandarin: 指對自己有清楚的認識，知道自己的長處和短處，不會高估或低估自己。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning having a clear and realistic understanding of one's own strengths and weaknesses; knowing one's limits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要有自知之明，唔好高估自己嘅能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 jau5 zi6 zi1 zi1 ming4, m4 hou2 gou1 gu2 zi6 gei2 ge3 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要有自知之明，不要高估自己的能力。
examples.english_sentence: One should have self-knowledge; don't overestimate your own abilities.

mandarin_meaning: 自私 (zìsī)，只顧自己利益，不顧他人
english_meaning: selfish; selfishness; self-centered
explanation_mandarin: 形容只顧自己利益或感受、不顧他人需要或權益的性格或行為。
explanation_english: Describes someone who only considers their own interests or feelings and disregards others' needs or rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做真係好自私。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zan1 hai6 hou2 zi6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這樣做真的是很自私。
examples.english_sentence: What he did is really selfish.

mandarin_meaning: 自私自利（指只顧自己利益、不顧他人）
english_meaning: selfish and self-serving; only concerned with one's own interests
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人只顧及自己利益，不顧他人感受或權益，帶有貶義。
explanation_english: Describes a person who only looks after their own interests and disregards others' feelings or rights; carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好自私自利，成日只顧自己，唔理人嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zi6 si1 zi6 lei6, sing4 jat6 zi2 gu3 zi6 gei2, m4 lei5 jan4 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很自私自利，總是只顧自己，不顧別人的感受。
examples.english_sentence: He is very selfish and self-serving, always looking out only for himself and ignoring others' feelings.

mandarin_meaning: 自称
english_meaning: to claim oneself to be; to call oneself; self-styled
explanation_mandarin: 表示聲稱自己是某種身份或具有某種能力，有時含有懷疑或未被證實的意味。
explanation_english: To claim that one is something or has a certain identity/ability; often implies the claim may be unverified or dubious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自稱係呢間公司嘅創辦人，但冇證據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cing1 hai6 ni1 gaan1 gung1si1 ge3 cong3 baan6 jan4, daan6 mou5 zing3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自称是这间公司的创办人，但没有证据。
examples.english_sentence: He claims to be the founder of this company, but there's no evidence.

mandarin_meaning: 自立 (zìlì)：靠自己生活或自主，不依賴他人
english_meaning: to be independent; self-reliant
explanation_mandarin: 指能夠靠自己生活、工作或做決定，不依靠他人。可用作動詞（自立）或形容詞（很自立）。
explanation_english: Refers to being able to support oneself, make one's own decisions, and not rely on others. Can be used as a verb (to be independent) or an adjective (self-reliant).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家搬出嚟住，學識自立喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 bun1 ceot1 lai4 zyu6, hok6 sik1 zi6 laap6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他現在搬出來住，學會自立了。
examples.english_sentence: He/She has moved out and learned to be independent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 父母應該教小朋友點樣自立，但唔好逼得太緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu6 mou5 jing1 goi1 gaau3 siu2 pang4 jau5 dim2 joeng6 zi6 laap6, daan6 m4 hou2 bik1 dak1 taai3 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 父母應該教小孩如何自立，但不要逼得太緊。
examples.english_sentence: Parents should teach children how to be independent, but shouldn't push them too hard.

mandarin_meaning: 自立门户（zì lì mén hù）：自己成立門戶、獨立發展，常指脫離原來的家庭、組織或公司，自行創業或另立門庭。
english_meaning: to establish one's own household/enterprise; to go independent; to strike out on one's own
explanation_mandarin: 表示自己獨立成立門戶或機構，通常指離開原有團體或公司，自行創業或另立勢力。
explanation_english: Refers to setting up an independent household, business, or faction—leaving an original group or employer to operate independently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想繼續喺公司度做，決定自立門戶，開間自己嘅設計工作室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 gai3 zuk6 hai2 gung1 si1 dou6 zou6, kyut3 ding6 zi6 lap6 mun4 wu6, hoi1 gaan1 zi6 gei2 ge3 cit3 gai3 gung1 zok3 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想继续在公司工作，决定自立门户，开一家自己的设计工作室。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to keep working at the company and decided to go independent, opening his own design studio.

mandarin_meaning: 自立门户
english_meaning: to set up one's own household/establish oneself independently; to break away and start one's own business or faction
explanation_mandarin: 原指家族分支自行成立戶第；引申為自己獨立成立家業、門戶或派系，不再依附於原來的組織或家庭，常用作動詞短語。
explanation_english: Originally referred to a family branch establishing its own household; by extension, it means to become independent and establish one's own household, business, or faction — to break away and set up on one's own. Commonly used as a verb phrase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想自立門戶，自己開公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zi6 lap6 mun4 wu6, zi6 gei2 hoi1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想自立门户，自己开公司。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to set up on his own and start his own company.

mandarin_meaning: 自立门户
english_meaning: to set up one's own household or business; to go independent; to strike out on one's own
explanation_mandarin: 指離開原來的家庭、團體或上級，自己成立獨立的家庭、事業或門戶，常用來表示獨立經營或另起爐灶。
explanation_english: To leave one's original family, group, or superior and establish an independent household, business, or branch; often used to mean becoming independent or starting one's own venture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做夠咗，就想自立門戶，開自己嘅公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gau3 zo2, zau6 soeng2 zi6 laap6 mun4 wu6, hoi1 zi6 gei2 ge3 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做夠了，就想自立门户，开自己的公司。
examples.english_sentence: He feels he's done enough and wants to set up his own company and be independent.

mandarin_meaning: 從小 / 自小 / 小時候
english_meaning: since childhood; from a young age
explanation_mandarin: 「自細」是廣東話常用表達，表示某件事或某種習慣從很小的時候就開始。相當於普通話的「從小」或「自小」，常用來描述性格、習慣或經歷的起始時間。
explanation_english: "自細" is a Cantonese expression meaning that something has been the case since early childhood. It is equivalent to Mandarin "從小" and is used as an adverb to describe when a habit, trait, or situation began.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我自細就鍾意唱歌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi6 sai3 zau6 zung1 ji3 coeng3 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我從小就喜歡唱歌。
examples.english_sentence: I've liked singing since I was a child.

mandarin_meaning: 自行組織；自己組成（團體、隊伍或小組）
english_meaning: to organize oneself; to form (a group/team) by oneself
explanation_mandarin: 「自組」指由自己發起或自行組成一個團體、隊伍或小組，通常用於描述不加入既有組織而自行成立的行動或活動。
explanation_english: “自組” means to form or organize a group/team by oneself—initiating and creating a group independently rather than joining an existing organization; commonly used for ad hoc teams or self-organized activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今次打算自組一隊去比賽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 ci3 daa2 syun3 zi6 zou2 jat1 deoi2 heoi3 bei2 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我們這次打算自行組成一隊去比賽。
examples.english_sentence: We plan to form our own team to go to the competition this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班人唔想跟大隊，寧願自組活動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 jan4 m4 soeng2 gan1 daai6 deoi2, ning4 jyun6 zi6 zou2 wut6 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這群人不想跟隨大隊，寧願自行組織活動。
examples.english_sentence: This group doesn't want to follow the main team; they'd rather organize their own activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你有興趣，可以自組工作小組討論計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jau5 hing3 ceoi3, ho2 ji5 zi6 zou2 gung1 zok3 siu2 zung2 tou2 leon6 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有興趣，可以自組工作小組討論計劃。
examples.english_sentence: If you're interested, you can form a working subgroup to discuss the plan.

mandarin_meaning: 自给自足
english_meaning: self-sufficiency; self-sufficient
explanation_mandarin: 表示自己生产或擁有足夠的资源或能力，不依赖外部供给。
explanation_english: Indicates producing or having enough resources or capacity for oneself, not relying on external supply.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋選擇自給自足，喺農地種菜同養雞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 syun2 zaak6 zi6 kap1 zi6 zuk1, hai2 nung4 dei6 zung2 coi3 tung4 joeng5 gai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们选择自给自足，在农地种菜和养鸡。
examples.english_sentence: They chose to be self-sufficient, growing vegetables and raising chickens on their farmland.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家想過自給自足嘅生活，自己種菜同自製日常用品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 soeng2 gwo3 zi6 kap1 zi6 zuk1 ge3 sang1 wut6, zi6 gei2 zung2 coi3 tung4 zi6 zai3 jat6 soeng4 jung6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在想过自给自足的生活，自己种菜并自制日常用品。
examples.english_sentence: He now wants to live a self-sufficient life, growing his own vegetables and making everyday items himself.

jyutping: zi6 pin1 zi6 dou6 zi6 jin2
mandarin_meaning: 自编自导自演（自己編寫、導演並出演，常指為博取注意或偽造戲碼）
english_meaning: To write, direct and act in something oneself; to stage or fabricate a scene oneself (often to attract attention or deceive).
explanation_mandarin: 指某人自己編排、導演並出演一齣戲或一個場面，通常含貶義，用來形容刻意製造戲劇性或虛假的情況以博取關注或掩飾真相。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who writes, directs and acts in a staged scene themselves. Often derogatory — used to describe deliberately creating drama or fabrications to gain attention or hide the truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日自編自導自演，淨係想吸引人注意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zi6 pin1 zi6 dou6 zi6 jin2, zing6 hai6 soeng2 kap1 jan5 jan4 zyu3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是自编自导自演，就是想吸引别人的注意。
examples.english_sentence: He is always staging things himself; he just wants to attract people's attention.

mandarin_meaning: 自縊（自殺的一種方式，指上吊或絞頸而死）
english_meaning: to hang oneself (to commit suicide by hanging)
explanation_mandarin: 「自縊」指自己以繩索等勒頸或上吊致死，屬於自殺的一種行為，語義嚴肅、正式或書面用語。
explanation_english: "自縊" means to hang oneself (to cause one's own death by suspension or strangulation with a cord); it is a serious term often used in formal or written contexts to describe a method of suicide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到消息後竟然自縊咗，大家都好震驚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teng1 dou3 siu1 sik1 hau6 ging2 jin4 zi6 wai6 zo2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 zan3 ging1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他聽到消息後竟然自縊了，大家都很震驚。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing the news, he unexpectedly hanged himself; everyone was very shocked.

mandarin_meaning: 自购；为自用而购买（常用于房产）
english_meaning: to buy/acquire for one's own use (often used of property)
explanation_mandarin: 表示自己购买或置办，通常用于表示购买房产作为自住用途，如“自置物业”。
explanation_english: Refers to purchasing or acquiring something for one's own use; commonly used about buying property to live in (e.g., 'to buy one's own home').

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋決定自置物業，唔再租樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zi6 zi3 mat6 jip6, m4 zoi3 zou1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们决定自置物业，不再租房。
examples.english_sentence: They decided to buy a property for themselves and stop renting.

mandarin_meaning: 為自己謀取私利；撈取不當好處（口語）
english_meaning: to enrich oneself; to grab perks or benefits for oneself (colloquial/slang), often unfairly or at others' expense
explanation_mandarin: 「自肥」是廣東話俗語，原意可指自己弄肥自己，引申為在集體或公務環境中，為自己分走好處或利益，帶有自利、不公平的負面含義。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang expression literally meaning "to fatten oneself". Idiomatically it means to secure benefits, perks, or profits for oneself (especially within an organization), usually implying self-serving or unfair behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲官員淨係識自肥，唔理市民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gun1 jyun4 zing6 hai6 sik1 zi6 fei4, m4 lei5 si5 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些官员只会自肥，不管市民。
examples.english_sentence: Those officials only know how to enrich themselves and don't care about the citizens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司年度分紅搞到好似自肥咁，管理層攞走最大份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 nin4 dou6 fan1 hung4 gaau2 dou3 hou2 ci5 zi6 fei4 gam2, gun2 lei5 cang4 lo2 zau2 zeoi3 daai6 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的年度分红弄得像是在自肥，管理层拿走最大的一份。
examples.english_sentence: The company's annual bonus distribution was like self-enrichment—the management took the biggest share.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好自肥啦，大家公平分配啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zi6 fei4 laa1, daai6 gaa1 gung1 ping4 fan1 pui3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別自肥了，大家公平分配吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't grab perks for yourself—let's distribute it fairly.

mandarin_meaning: 自然地；不做作、隨意
english_meaning: naturally; relaxed; unforced
explanation_mandarin: 「自自然」是粵語口語，源自「自自然然」，用來形容一個人或行為自然、不做作、放鬆。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression (from 自自然然) meaning to be natural, unforced, relaxed or casual in behaviour or manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋拍拖唔使太刻意，放鬆啲，自自然啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 paak3 to1 m4 sai2 taai3 hak1 ji3, fong3 sung1 di1, zi6 zi6 jin4 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你們拍拖不需要太刻意，放輕鬆，自然一點吧。
examples.english_sentence: When you're dating, you don't need to be too deliberate; relax and be more natural.

mandarin_meaning: 自然而然 / 很自然、不做作
english_meaning: naturally; in a natural, unforced way
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語短語，表示某種行為或表現很自然、順其自然或不刻意做作。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial adverbial phrase meaning to behave or appear naturally, unforced, or to let things take their course.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同人傾偈好自自然然，唔會好刻意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2 hou2 zi6 zi6 jin4 jin4, m4 wui5 hou2 hak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和人聊天很自然，不會很刻意。
examples.english_sentence: He chats with people in a very natural, unforced way; he doesn't act deliberately.

mandarin_meaning: 自荐（推荐自己）
english_meaning: to recommend oneself; to self-nominate; to volunteer for a task
explanation_mandarin: 表示自己推荐自己担任某职务或主动要求承担某项工作或责任。
explanation_english: To recommend oneself for a position or to volunteer to take on a task or responsibility; to self-nominate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想自薦做下一個項目嘅負責人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zi6 zin2 zou6 haa6 jat1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 fu6 zaak3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想自荐做下一个项目的负责人。
examples.english_sentence: I want to recommend myself to be the person in charge of the next project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇人應徵，你可以自薦嚟幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 mou5 jan4 jing3 cing1, nei5 ho2 ji5 zi6 zin2 lai4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没有人应征，你可以自荐来帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: If no one applies, you can volunteer yourself to help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔鍾意自薦，多數等人推舉佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 zung1 ji3 zi6 zin2, do1 sou3 dang2 jan4 teoi1 geoi2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不喜欢自荐，多数等别人推举他。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't like to self-nominate; he usually waits for others to recommend him.

mandarin_meaning: 自虐；自我施加痛苦或折磨自己的行為或傾向
english_meaning: masochism; to inflict suffering on oneself; self‑sabotaging or self‑punishing behavior
explanation_mandarin: 指個人有意或無意地令自己受苦、受傷或做令自己不快的事，可指生理或心理上的受虐傾向，也可比喻自找麻煩或折磨自己。
explanation_english: Refers to intentionally or unintentionally causing oneself pain or distress, either physically or psychologically. Can denote literal masochism or be used figuratively for self‑sabotaging or self‑punishing behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁自虐，做啲令自己唔開心嘅嘢有咩意思？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zi6 joek6, zou6 di1 ling6 zi6 gei2 m4 hoi1 sam1 ge3 je5 jau5 me1 ji3 si1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這麼自虐，做那些讓自己不開心的事有什麼意思？
examples.english_sentence: You're being so masochistic — what's the point of doing things that make you unhappy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 練跑過量係一種自虐，對身體冇益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin6 paau2 gwo3 loeng6 hai6 jat1 zung2 zi6 joek6, deoi3 san1 tai2 mou5 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 過度跑步是一種自虐，對身體沒有好處。
examples.english_sentence: Excessive running is a form of self‑abuse/masochism; it's not good for your health.

mandarin_meaning: 自处（學會與自己相處、處理自身事務或在困境中自我調適）
english_meaning: to be able to cope with oneself; to manage on one's own; to find a way to live with oneself or one's circumstances
explanation_mandarin: 表示能夠處理自己的生活或情緒，在孤獨或困難情況下保持自我調適和平衡。
explanation_english: Refers to being able to handle one's own affairs or emotions, maintaining self-adjustment and balance when alone or facing difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學識咗點樣自處，唔使成日依賴人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 sik1 zo2 dim2 joeng6 zi6-cyu3, m4 sai2 seng4 jat6 ji1-laai6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学会了如何自处，不需要总是依赖别人。
examples.english_sentence: He learned how to be okay on his own and doesn't need to rely on others all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺大城市生活，要學識自處先唔會咁孤單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 daai6-sing4-si5 sang1-wut6, jiu3 hok6 sik1 zi6-cyu3 sin1 m4 wui5 gam2 gu1-daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在大城市生活，要学会自处才不会那么孤单。
examples.english_sentence: Living in a big city, you have to learn to cope on your own so you won't feel so lonely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一個人旅行可以幫你學識點樣自處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 go3 jan4 leoi5-hang4 ho2-ji5 bong1 nei5 hok6 sik1 dim2 joeng6 zi6-cyu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一个人旅行可以帮助你学会如何自处。
examples.english_sentence: Traveling alone can help you learn how to be comfortable by yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 自己；自行（zìxíng）——由自己做、自己處理
english_meaning: by oneself; on one's own; of one's own accord; do something independently
explanation_mandarin: 表示由自己去做或自己處理，不依賴他人，也可表示自發或自動的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something oneself or handling something without others' help; can also mean acting of one's own accord or automatically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件嘢你可以自行處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 je5 nei5 ho2 ji5 zi6 haang4 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事你可以自行處理。
examples.english_sentence: You can handle this yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請大家自行排隊，唔好推擠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 daai6 gaa1 zi6 haang4 paai4 deoi6, m4 hou2 teoi1 zai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 請大家自行排隊，不要推擠。
examples.english_sentence: Please queue up on your own and don't push.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如有問題，請自行聯絡客服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 jau5 man6 tai4, ceng2 zi6 haang4 lyun4 lok3 haak3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如有問題，請自行聯絡客服。
examples.english_sentence: If there are any issues, please contact customer service yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 自行了断（自己解决或结束某事；有时委婉指自杀）
english_meaning: To settle or end something by oneself; sometimes used as a euphemism for committing suicide.
explanation_mandarin: 表示由自己處理並結束一件事或一段關係，強調不再依靠外人或繼續周旋；在某些語境下可作自殺的委婉說法。
explanation_english: Indicates resolving or terminating a matter by one's own action, emphasizing no further involvement from others; in some contexts it is used as a euphemism for suicide.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事佢會自行了斷，唔使我哋插手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 keoi5 wui5 zi6 hang4 liu5 dyun6, m4 sai2 ngo5 dei6 caap3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件事他會自行了斷，不需要我們插手。
examples.english_sentence: He will settle this matter himself; we don't need to intervene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢講想自行了斷，朋友趕快勸佢求助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: teng1 dou3 keoi5 gong2 soeng2 zi6 hang4 liu5 dyun6, pang4 jau5 gon2 faai3 wun6 keoi5 kau4 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聽到他說想自行了斷，朋友趕快勸他尋求幫助。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him say he wanted to 'settle things himself' (a euphemism), his friends quickly urged him to seek help.

mandarin_meaning: 自行车 (zìxíngchē)
english_meaning: bicycle; bike
explanation_mandarin: 以腳踏板驅動的兩輪車輛，常用作短途代步或運動。
explanation_english: A two-wheeled vehicle powered by pedals, commonly used for short-distance travel or exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日都騎自行車返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 kei4 zi6 hang4 ce1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天都骑自行车上班。
examples.english_sentence: I ride a bicycle to work every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢架自行車壞咗，要拎去修理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaa3 zi6 hang4 ce1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 ling1 heoi3 sau1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆自行车坏了，要拿去修理。
examples.english_sentence: This bicycle is broken; it needs to be taken for repair.

mandarin_meaning: 自卫；保护自己或进行防卫的行为
english_meaning: self-defense; to defend oneself; self-protection
explanation_mandarin: 指為了保護自己而採取的防衛行為，可以作動詞（自衛）或名詞（自衛）使用，亦可用於法律語境（如出於自衛的辯護）。
explanation_english: Refers to actions taken to protect or defend oneself. It can function as a verb (to defend oneself) or a noun (self-defense), and is also used in legal contexts (e.g., a claim of self-defense).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 街上遇到惡人衝你，最緊要識得自衛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaai1 soeng6 jyu6 dou3 ok3 jan4 cung1 nei5, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 sik1 dak1 zi6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在街上遇到壞人衝你，最重要的是要懂得自衛。
examples.english_sentence: If a bad person attacks you on the street, the most important thing is to know how to defend yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法庭接受佢出於自衛嘅辯護，認為佢係為保護自己而反擊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 ting4 zip3 sau6 keoi5 ceot1 jyu1 zi6 wai6 ge3 bin6 wu6, jing6 wai4 keoi5 hai6 wai4 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2 ji4 faan2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法庭接受他出於自衛的辯護，認為他是為了保護自己而反擊。
examples.english_sentence: The court accepted his claim of self-defense, finding that he retaliated to protect himself.

mandarin_meaning: 自卫（保護自己，抵禦攻擊或為了保護自己而採取的言行）
english_meaning: self-defense; to defend oneself; protecting oneself from harm (can refer to physical defense or actions/words to protect one's reputation)
explanation_mandarin: 指個體為了避免受到傷害或攻擊而採取的行動或言論，也可用於網絡語境下表示為了保護自己而作出的回應或說法。
explanation_english: Refers to actions or words taken to protect oneself from harm or attack. Can mean physical self-defense or defensive remarks/behaviour (including online) intended to protect one's interests or reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係為咗自衛先講咗啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 wai6 zo2 zi6 wai6 sin1 gong2 zo2 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是為了自衛才說那些話。
examples.english_sentence: He said those things to defend himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係自衛一下，唔係針對任何人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 zi6 wai6 jat1 haa6, m4 hai6 zam1 deoi3 jam6 ho4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是自衛一下，並非針對任何人。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just defending myself a bit, not targeting anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人攻擊你，記住要自衛或者求助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 gung1 gik1 nei5, gei3 zyu6 jiu3 zi6 wai6 waak6 ze2 kau4 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人攻擊你，記得要自衛或尋求幫助。
examples.english_sentence: If someone attacks you, remember to defend yourself or seek help.

mandarin_meaning: 自卫（保护自己）
english_meaning: self-defense; to defend oneself; being defensive
explanation_mandarin: 表示保護自己或為自己辯護／解釋。可以指實際的身體自我防衛行為，也可指言語或心理上的防衛反應（即“捍衛自己”或“自我辯解”）。
explanation_english: Refers to defending oneself or justifying/protecting oneself. It can mean physical self-defense or verbal/psychological defensiveness (self-preservation or self-justification).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係為咗自衞先出手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 wai6 zo2 zi6 wai6 sin1 ceot1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是為了自衛才出手。
examples.english_sentence: He only acted to defend himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要學啲自衞技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 hok6 di1 zi6 wai6 gei6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要學一些自衛技巧。
examples.english_sentence: You should learn some self-defense techniques.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好有自衞心態，成日都唔肯承認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 zi6 wai6 sam1 taai3, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 hang2 sing4 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他說話很有自衛心態，總是不肯承認錯誤。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks in a defensive way and never admits mistakes.

mandarin_meaning: 自殺
english_meaning: to commit suicide; to take one's own life
explanation_mandarin: 自裁指自行結束生命，即自殺。此詞語氣較書面或正式，有時用於報章、文學或正式說法中。
explanation_english: Refers to ending one's own life; to commit suicide. The term is relatively formal or literary and is often used in written or official contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為失業同負債，差啲想自裁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1wai6 sat1 jip6 tung4 fu6 zai3, caa1 di1 soeng2 zi6 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為失業和負債，差點想自殺。
examples.english_sentence: He almost wanted to kill himself because of unemployment and debt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你有諗住自裁，記住要搵可信嘅人傾訴或者打熱線求助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jau5 lam2 zyu6 zi6 coi4, gei3 zyu6 jiu3 wan2 ho2 seon3 ge3 jan4 king1 sou3 waak6 ze2 daa2 jit6 sin3 kau4 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你有打算自殺，一定要找可信的人傾訴或打熱線求助。
examples.english_sentence: If you're thinking about killing yourself, make sure to find someone trustworthy to talk to or call a suicide hotline.

mandarin_meaning: 自製 / 自制 (zìzhì)：自己製作，手工或非工業化生產（也可作「自我克制」之意，視語境而定）
english_meaning: homemade; self-made; made by oneself (contrasted with bought or mass-produced)
explanation_mandarin: 表示某物由自己製作，而非購買或由工廠大量生產；在不同語境下也可能表示「自我克制」的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates something made by oneself rather than bought or mass-produced; depending on context, can also mean self-control in Mandarin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個餅係我自製㗎，俾你試吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 beng2 hai6 ngo5 zi6 zai3 gaa3, bei2 nei5 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個餅是我自製的，給你試試看。
examples.english_sentence: This cake is homemade by me — try some.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企自製口罩，送俾鄰居。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei5 zi6 zai3 hau2 zaau3, sung3 bei2 leon4 geoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家自製口罩，送給鄰居。
examples.english_sentence: He made masks at home and gave them to the neighbors.

mandarin_meaning: 自视过高：对自己的能力或地位估计过高，认为自己比别人优越
english_meaning: To overestimate oneself; to have an excessively high opinion of one's own abilities or status; arrogant
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人對自己的能力、地位或價值估計過高，自以為比別人優越或不接受別人意見。
explanation_english: Describes someone who overestimates their abilities, status, or worth; considers themselves superior and often refuses to accept others' opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日自視過高，唔會聽人意見，搞到大家都好煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zi6 si6 gwo3 gou1, m4 wui5 teng1 jan4 ji3 gin3, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是自视过高，不听别人的意见，弄得大家很烦。
examples.english_sentence: He is always overestimating himself, doesn't listen to others' opinions, and it annoys everyone.

mandarin_meaning: 自覺 (有自我覺察或主動自發的行為)
english_meaning: self-aware; conscious; acting on one's own initiative; conscientious
explanation_mandarin: 表示對自己行為或狀態有覺察，或能主動自發去做某事（如自覺遵守規則、主動完成任務）。
explanation_english: Indicates awareness of oneself or acting voluntarily on one's own initiative; can describe being self-aware/conscientious or doing something proactively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好自覺，會提早完成功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zi6 gok3, wui5 tai4 zou2 jyun4 sing4 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很自覺，會提早完成功課。
examples.english_sentence: He's very conscientious and finishes his homework early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家應該自覺排隊，唔好插隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 jing1 goi1 zi6 gok3 paai4 deoi6, m4 hou2 caap3 deoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家應該自覺排隊，不要插隊。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone should voluntarily queue up and not cut in line.

mandarin_meaning: 自言自语 (zì yán zì yǔ)
english_meaning: to talk to oneself; to mutter to oneself; soliloquize
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人对自己说话，通常是在思考、回忆或练习，也可能是自我安慰或小声抱怨。
explanation_english: To speak aloud to oneself—muttering or soliloquizing—often while thinking, rehearsing, or comforting oneself; can also be an involuntary murmuring of one's thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺屋企一個人自言自語，好似喺諗緊嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei5 jat1 go3 jan4 zi6 jin4 zi6 jyu5, hou2 ci5 hai2 lam2 gan2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在家一个人自言自语，好像在思考问题。
examples.english_sentence: He often talks to himself at home, as if he's thinking.

mandarin_meaning: 自找麻煩；自討苦吃
english_meaning: to bring suffering upon oneself; to ask for trouble
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 動賓短語（動詞短語）
explanation_mandarin: 表示自己主動做某事而導致受苦或遭遇麻煩，相當於“自找麻煩”。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to cause oneself unnecessary hardship or trouble by one's own actions; to ask for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明知唔識但又去參加比賽，真係自討苦吃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 zi1 m4 sik1 daan6 jau6 heoi3 caam1 gaa1 bei2 coi3, zan1 hai6 zi6 tou2 fu2 hek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明不會，還去參加比賽，真是自找麻煩。
examples.english_sentence: He knew he wasn't capable but still entered the competition — he's really asking for trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔跟指示做，就係自討苦吃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 gan1 zi2 si6 zou6, zau6 hai6 zi6 tou2 fu2 hek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不按照指示做，就是自討苦吃。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't follow the instructions, you'll only be causing trouble for yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 自诩（自我夸耀、吹嘘自己）
english_meaning: to boast about oneself; to profess or claim (often arrogantly or exaggeratedly)
explanation_mandarin: 指自己誇耀或自我標榜，聲稱具有某種身分、能力或成就，常帶有自負或誇大的意味。
explanation_english: Describes the act of praising or boasting about oneself—claiming a status, ability, or achievement—often with arrogance or exaggeration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日自詡係最叻嘅工程師，其實做嘢好一般。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zi6 heoi2 hai6 zeoi3 lak6 ge3 gung1 cing4 si1, kei4 sat6 zou6 je5 hou2 jat1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他常常自诩是最厉害的工程师，其实工作很一般。
examples.english_sentence: He often boasts that he's the best engineer, but his work is actually mediocre.

mandarin_meaning: 自夸；自我吹耀
english_meaning: to boast; to brag about oneself
explanation_mandarin: 表示自己誇耀、吹噓自己的言行，帶有自我讚美或炫耀的意思。
explanation_english: To praise or boast about oneself; expressing self-praise or showing off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日自誇話自己做嘢最快，結果老闆發現問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zi6 kwaa1 waa6 zi6 gei2 zou6 je5 zeoi3 faai3, git3 gwo2 lou5 baan2 faat3 jin4 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是自誇自己做事最快，結果老闆發現問題。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps bragging that he finishes work the fastest, but the boss found problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺面前自誇，等大家自己嚟評價你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 min6 cin4 zi6 kwaa1, dang2 daai6 gaa1 zi6 gei2 lai4 ping4 gaa3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要當著別人面前自誇，讓大家自己來評價你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't boast in front of others; let people judge you for themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老師提醒我哋唔好自誇，要以謙虛態度學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 si1 tai4 jing4 ngo5 dei6 m4 hou2 zi6 kwaa1, jiu3 ji5 him1 heoi1 taai3 dou6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老師提醒我們不要自誇，要以謙虛的態度學習。
examples.english_sentence: The teacher reminded us not to boast and to learn with a humble attitude.

mandarin_meaning: 自認
english_meaning: to consider/admit oneself (to be); to acknowledge oneself as
explanation_mandarin: 表示自己承認或認為自己是某種人、具有某種性質或處於某種狀態。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone admits or regards themselves as a certain type of person, possessing a certain quality, or being in a certain state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自認係個好努力嘅人，唔肯認錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 jing6 hai6 go3 hou2 nou5 lik6 ge3 jan4, m4 hang2 jing6 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自認是個很努力的人，不肯認錯。
examples.english_sentence: He considers himself a very hardworking person and refuses to admit mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自認冇乜經驗，但都願意試吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 jing6 mou5 mat1 ging1 jim6, daan6 dou1 jyun6 ji3 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自認沒有太多經驗，但仍然願意試一試。
examples.english_sentence: He admits he doesn't have much experience, but is still willing to give it a try.

mandarin_meaning: 自說自話（自言自語或不顧他人意見地說話）
english_meaning: to talk to oneself; to speak unilaterally or monologue without regard for others
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人自己講自己話，或者不顧他人意見單方面說話，有時亦指自言自語。
explanation_english: Describes someone talking to themselves or speaking on their own without considering others' views; can mean monologuing or speaking arbitrarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日自說自話，唔理其他人嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zi6 syut3 zi6 waa6, m4 lei5 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成日自說自話，不理其他人的意見。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks to himself and ignores other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好自說自話，先同我講清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zi6 syut3 zi6 waa6, sin1 tung4 ngo5 gong2 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要自說自話，先跟我把事情說清楚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak unilaterally—explain the situation to me clearly first.

mandarin_meaning: 自说自话；自己说自己的话，不顾别人意见或自顾自地说话
english_meaning: to talk to oneself; to speak on one's own without considering others; to keep up a monologue
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人自己说自己的话，常指不听或不顾别人的意见，独自喋喋不休或自言自语。
explanation_english: Describes someone speaking on their own—often ignoring others' input—either talking to themselves or continuing a monologue without regard for listeners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日自說自話，唔理人講乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zi6 syut3 zi6 waa6, m4 lei5 jan4 gong2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是自说自话，不理别人说什么。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks to himself and doesn't pay attention to what others say.

mandarin_meaning: 自說自話（自言自語；不顧他人，隨意說話）
english_meaning: to talk to oneself; to speak arbitrarily or ramble on without regard for others
explanation_mandarin: 表示一個人自顧自地說話，常指自言自語或不顧他人意見地隨意發表看法或說些不中肯的話。
explanation_english: Describes someone talking to themselves or speaking on their own, often implying rambling, speaking without considering others' views, or saying arbitrary things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日自說自話，冇理其他人嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zi6 syut3 zi6 waa6, mou5 lei5 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是自說自話，沒顧及別人的感受。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks to himself and doesn't care about other people's feelings.

mandarin_meaning: 自谦；表示谦虚、淡化自己的能力或成就
english_meaning: to be modest; to downplay one's abilities or achievements
explanation_mandarin: 表示以谦虚的方式描述自己，轻描淡写自己的能力或成就，常用於礼貌或谦逊的场合。
explanation_english: To express modesty about oneself, deliberately understating one's abilities or achievements; commonly used as a polite or humble expression.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好自謙，你做得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zi6 him1, nei5 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别自谦，你做得很好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be modest; you did very well.

mandarin_meaning: 主動讓步；自願退讓
english_meaning: to yield voluntarily; to concede; to give way
explanation_mandarin: 表示主動退讓或讓步，將權利、位置或意見退讓給他人，常用於維持和諧或避免爭執。
explanation_english: Indicates voluntarily yielding or conceding, giving up a right, position, or opinion to someone else—often to preserve harmony or avoid conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗維持和諧，佢決定自讓一步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 wai4 ci4 wo4 haai4, keoi5 kyut3 ding6 zi6 joeng6 jat1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為了維持和諧，他決定主動讓步。
examples.english_sentence: To preserve harmony, he decided to yield/concede.

mandarin_meaning: 自豪（表示因自己的成就或所屬團體而感到驕傲或光榮）
english_meaning: proud; feeling proud or honored
explanation_mandarin: 表示因個人或集體的成就、表現等而感到驕傲、光榮，是一種正面的自我肯定情感。
explanation_english: Indicates feeling proud or honored because of one's or one's group's achievements or performance; a positive sentiment of self-respect or pride.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我為自己嘅成績感到自豪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai4 zi6 gei2 ge3 sing4 zik1 gam2 dou3 zi6 hou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我为自己的成绩感到自豪。
examples.english_sentence: I feel proud of my achievements.

mandarin_meaning: 自豪感（对自己或所属群体的成就、身份等产生的自尊与自豪的感觉）
english_meaning: a sense of pride (feeling proud of oneself or one’s group, achievements, or identity)
explanation_mandarin: 指個人因為自己的成就、所屬團體、身份或表現等，而產生的一種自尊或驕傲的情感或感覺。
explanation_english: Refers to the feeling of pride or self-respect someone experiences because of their achievements, group membership, status, or performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對自己嘅成就有一種好強烈嘅自豪感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 ge3 sing4 zau6 jau5 jat1 zung2 hou2 koeng4 lit6 ge3 zi6 hou4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我對自己的成就有一種很強烈的自豪感。
examples.english_sentence: I feel a strong sense of pride about my achievements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到啲學生考得咁好，老師覺得好有自豪感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 di1 hok6 saang1 haau2 dak1 gam2 hou2, lou5 si1 gok3 dak1 hou2 jau5 zi6 hou4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到學生考得這麼好，老師覺得很有自豪感。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing the students do so well on the exams, the teacher felt very proud.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為屋企贏咗獎，我哋全家都有一份自豪感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 uk1 kei5 jing4 zo2 zoeng2, ngo5 dei6 cyun4 gaa1 dou1 jau5 jat1 fan6 zi6 hou4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 為家裡贏得獎項，我們全家都有一份自豪感。
examples.english_sentence: Because the family won an award, our whole family felt a sense of pride.

mandarin_meaning: 自负 (zìfù)：自以为有才能或很了不起；过分自信；也可指承担（费用、责任）。
english_meaning: conceited; arrogant; overconfident; (formal) to bear/assume (costs, responsibility).
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（主要）；亦可作動詞（書面語，用於“承擔”）
explanation_mandarin: 表示對自己的能力、才幹或成就有過高評價，帶有驕傲、自負的態度；在正式用法中也可表示承擔費用或責任。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has an excessively high opinion of their abilities or achievements (arrogant/overconfident). In formal contexts it can also mean to bear or assume costs/responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好自負，唔會聽人意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zi6 fu6, m4 wui5 teng1 jan4 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很自負，不會聽別人的意見。
examples.english_sentence: He's very conceited and won't listen to others' opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好太自負，呢次比賽好多人都好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 taai3 zi6 fu6, ni1 ci3 bei2 coi3 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要太自負，這次比賽很多人都很厲害。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be overconfident — many competitors are very strong this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲費用要由公司自負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fai3 jung6 jiu3 jau4 gung1 si1 zi6 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這些費用要由公司自負。
examples.english_sentence: These expenses must be borne by the company.

mandarin_meaning: 自负盈亏 (zì fù yíng kuī) — 对利润和亏损自行承担责任
english_meaning: to bear one's own profits and losses; to be responsible for one's own gains and losses
explanation_mandarin: 表示對經濟上的盈虧自行承擔責任，常用於公司、部門或個人承擔財務風險的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates taking responsibility for financial gains and losses oneself; commonly used when a company, department or individual assumes financial risk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司要求每個部門自負盈虧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 mui5 go3 bou6 mun4 zi6 fu6 jing4 kwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间公司要求每个部门自负盈亏。
examples.english_sentence: The company requires each department to be responsible for its own profits and losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做生意有風險，老闆要自負盈虧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 saang1 ji3 jau5 fung1 him2, lou5 baan2 jiu3 zi6 fu6 jing4 kwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做生意有风险，老板要自负盈亏。
examples.english_sentence: Doing business carries risks; the owner must bear the profits and losses.

mandarin_meaning: 自責 (對自己進行責備或譴責)
english_meaning: to blame oneself; to reproach oneself; to feel guilty
explanation_mandarin: 對自己的行為或過失感到負責或內疚，並責備自己。
explanation_english: To criticize or blame oneself for a mistake or fault, often accompanied by feelings of guilt or remorse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好自責，呢件事唔係你一個人嘅錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zi6 zaak3, ni1 gin6 si6 m4 hai6 nei5 jat1 go3 jan4 ge3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要自責，這件事不是你一個人的錯。
examples.english_sentence: Don't blame yourself; this isn't solely your fault.

mandarin_meaning: 自贬身价
english_meaning: to belittle oneself; to lower one's own status or worth
explanation_mandarin: 指自己降低身份或價值，貶低自己，常用來形容為了討好他人或過度謙遜而自我貶低的行為（含負面意味）。
explanation_english: To devalue oneself or lower one's own status/worth. Often used to describe self-degrading behavior to please others or excessive humility (usually has a negative connotation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係為咗討好人而自貶身價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 wai6 zo2 tou2 hou2 jan4 ji4 zi6 bin2 san1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別總是為了討好別人而自貶身價。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always belittle yourself to please others.

mandarin_meaning: 自费
english_meaning: at one's own expense; self-funded; pay out of one's own pocket
explanation_mandarin: 表示自己支付费用，不由他人或单位承担。常用于医疗、教育、旅行等场合。
explanation_english: Indicates paying expenses oneself rather than being covered by others or an organization. Commonly used for medical, education, travel, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個醫療檢查要自費，保險唔包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ji1liu4 gim2caa4 jiu3 zi6 fai3, bou2him2 m4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个医疗检查要自费，保险不报销。
examples.english_sentence: This medical check is at your own expense; insurance doesn't cover it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果要參加海外交換，學校只資助部分，其他要自費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 jiu3 caam1 gaa1 hoi2 ngoi6 gaau1 wun6, hok6 haau6 zi2 zi1 zo6 bou6 fan6, kei4 taa1 jiu3 zi6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果要参加海外交换，学校只资助部分，其他要自费。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to join the overseas exchange, the school only subsidizes part of it; the rest you must pay yourself.

mandarin_meaning: 自费（自行筹资、自己负担费用）
english_meaning: self-funded; self-financed (paid for by oneself)
explanation_mandarin: 表示由個人或單位自行出資、負擔費用，常用於教育或項目上（如「自資學生」、「自資項目」）。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is funded or paid for by oneself or one's own organization; commonly used for education (e.g., 'self-funded student') or projects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係自資學生，要自己畀學費。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zi6 zi1 hok6 saang1, jiu3 zi6 gei2 bei2 hok6 fai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是自费学生，需要自己付学费。
examples.english_sentence: He is a self-funded student and has to pay the tuition himself.

mandarin_meaning: （俚語）指喜歡單獨行事、言行魯莽或不受控制、容易惹事的人；相當於「loose cannon」（不受控制的人、獨斷者）。
english_meaning: Slang for a "loose cannon" — someone who acts or speaks independently and recklessly, often causing trouble or embarrassment.
explanation_mandarin: 原指自走式火炮，借指行為像「自走」般不受控制、常常自行其是或出格發言的人或行為。常用於形容政治人物、同事或朋友在未經授權或不顧後果下的言行。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a self-propelled gun, it metaphorically describes a person or action that is uncontrolled or goes off on their own — someone who frequently speaks or acts without authorization and causes problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日自走炮，成日唔經過上司就亂講嘢，搞到公司好頭痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zi6 zau2 paau3, sing4 jat6 m4 ging1 gwo3 soeng6 si1 zau6 lyun6 gong2 je5, gaau2 dou3 gung1 si1 hou2 tau4 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他經常自作主張，總是不經上司就亂說話，弄得公司很頭疼。
examples.english_sentence: He often acts like a loose cannon, speaking without clearing it with his superiors and causing headaches for the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰位議員好自走炮，成日單獨出聲，搞到黨內好亂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 wai6 ji5 jyun4 hou2 zi6 zau2 paau3, sing4 jat6 daan1 duk6 ceot1 sing1, gaau2 dou3 dong2 noi6 hou2 lyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位議員很愛自作主張，經常單獨發聲，讓黨內很混亂。
examples.english_sentence: That legislator is a loose cannon; he frequently speaks independently and causes disorder within the party.

mandarin_meaning: 自走炮（zì zǒu pào）：字面為自行火炮；俚語中指在團隊遊戲或協作情況下獨自衝前、不配合隊友的玩家（即獨行俠、單獨衝鋒者）。
english_meaning: Literal: self-propelled gun (military vehicle). Slang: a player who rushes ahead alone or acts independently in team-based games — a 'lone wolf' or solo rusher, often causing problems for the team.
explanation_mandarin: 原為軍事用語「自行火炮」，在香港遊戲和網絡語境中被引申為形容那些不與隊友配合、常常獨自衝鋒或追求單人表現的玩家，可帶有批評意味。
explanation_english: Originally a military term for a self-propelled artillery vehicle. In Hong Kong gaming and online slang it describes a player who doesn't cooperate with teammates and repeatedly rushes solo — often used critically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場打機有個人成日自走砲，搞到我哋好難贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 daa2 gei1 jau5 go3 jan4 seng4 jat6 zi6 zau2 paau3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 hou2 naan4 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這局玩遊戲有人老是自走炮，弄得我們很難贏。
examples.english_sentence: In this match someone kept playing as a lone rusher (self-propelled gun), making it hard for us to win.

mandarin_meaning: 自給自足；知足、對自身狀態或生活感到滿足
english_meaning: self-sufficient; content with oneself; not relying on others
explanation_mandarin: 形容一個人或狀態能夠自給自足、不依賴他人，或對現狀感到滿足。
explanation_english: Describes a person or state that is self-sufficient, not dependent on others, or content with one's situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好自足，唔鍾意同人借嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zi6 zuk1, m4 zung1 ji3 tung4 jan4 ze3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很自足，不喜歡向別人借東西。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is very self-sufficient and doesn't like borrowing things from others.

mandarin_meaning: 自己、本身
english_meaning: oneself; oneself's own; itself; itself as a body/person
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某物本身、自己本体，常用來強調主體自身的狀態或責任。
explanation_english: Refers to the person or thing itself; used to emphasize the subject's own body, condition, or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢要為自身嘅健康負責。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jiu3 wai6 zi6 san1 ge3 gin6 hong1 fu6 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他要為自身的健康負責。
examples.english_sentence: He needs to take responsibility for his own health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要提高自身嘅能力先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 tai4 gou1 zi6 san1 ge3 nang4 lik6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要提高自身的能力才行。
examples.english_sentence: You need to improve your own abilities first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機器自身有問題，唔係操作嘅原因。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 hei3 zi6 san1 jau5 man6 tai4, m4 hai6 cou1 zok3 ge3 jyun4 jan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這部機器本身有問題，不是操作的原因。
examples.english_sentence: The machine itself has a problem; it's not due to the operation.

mandarin_meaning: 自己都保不住，難以保全自己（無能力幫助他人）
english_meaning: unable to protect oneself; in no position to help others; can't even take care of oneself
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 成語 / 形容詞性短語
explanation_mandarin: 表示連自己都無法保全或照顧，無力幫助別人或應對外在困難。
explanation_english: Indicates that one cannot even look after or protect oneself, and therefore is incapable of helping others or coping with external difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司蝕咁多，老闆自身難保，點會幫其他部門？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 sik1 gam2 do1, lou5baan2 zi6san1 naan4bou2, dim2 wui5 bong1 dou3 kei4taa1 bou6mun4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司虧損這麼多，老闆自身難保，哪會幫助其他部門？
