examples.english_sentence: The company is losing so much money; the boss can't even protect himself—how could he help other departments?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家連房租都交唔起，自身難保，暫時唔好答應幫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4gaa1 lin4 fong4zu1 dou1 gaau1 m4 hei2, zi6san1 naan4bou2, zaam6si4 m4 hou2 daap3 jing3 bong1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你現在連房租都付不起，自身難保，暫時不要答應幫他。
examples.english_sentence: You can't even afford the rent now; you can't take care of yourself—don't promise to help him for the time being.

mandarin_meaning: 自己單方面行動／自說自話、擅自決定
english_meaning: to act on one's own; to go off on one's own; to monologue/ramble; to make unilateral decisions (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「自轉」是香港粵語口語/俚語，通常指一個人不顧他人意見而自行行動或自說自話，亦可指在群體中單方面帶偏話題或擅自作決定。有時帶貶義，表示不合群或自我中心。
explanation_english: “自轉” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang meaning to act unilaterally or to talk/ramble to oneself. It can describe someone who goes off on their own, derails a conversation, or makes decisions without group agreement. It often carries a mildly negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好自己自轉，大家一齊決定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zi6 gei2 zi6 zyun2, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 kyut3 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要自己自作主張，我們一起決定吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make decisions on your own; let's decide together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺群組入面一路自轉，冇人回應佢都繼續講下去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 kwan4 zou2 jap6 min6 jat1 lou6 zi6 zyun2, mou5 jan4 wui4 jing3 keoi5 dou1 gai3 zuk6 gong2 haa6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在群組裡一直自說自話，沒有人回應他也繼續說下去。
examples.english_sentence: He kept rambling in the group chat; even without anyone responding he continued talking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 會議上唔好畀人自轉，大家有意見就一齊講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wui6 ji5 soeng6 m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 zi6 zyun2, daai6 gaa1 jau5 ji3 gin3 zau6 jat1 cai4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 會議上不要讓人擅自決定，大家有意見就一起說。
examples.english_sentence: In the meeting, don't let someone make unilateral decisions; if anyone has opinions, speak up together.

mandarin_meaning: 自辯 / 自我辯護（為自己辯解、說明以澄清或抵抗指控）
english_meaning: to defend oneself; to offer a defense or explanation; to justify oneself
explanation_mandarin: 表示為自己澄清、辯解或回應指控，通常用語言說明以減少誤解或責難。
explanation_english: To respond to accusations or criticism by explaining or defending oneself verbally, aiming to clarify misunderstandings or counter blame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出嚟自辯話自己冇做過嗰件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceot1 lai4 zi6 bin6 waa6 zi6 gei2 mou5 zou6 gwo3 go2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出來自辯說自己沒有做過那件事。
examples.english_sentence: He came forward to defend himself, saying he didn't do that.

mandarin_meaning: 自述（自我陈述、叙述自己的经历或感受）
english_meaning: to narrate or recount one's own experiences; a self-narrative or personal statement
explanation_mandarin: 指個人敘述自己經歷、感受或觀點，可用作自我介紹、陳述或自傳的一部分，亦可指書面或口頭的自我陳述。
explanation_english: Refers to a person recounting their own experiences, feelings, or perspectives; can be a spoken or written personal statement, self-report, or part of an autobiography.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢寫咗一篇自述，講述佢嘅成長經歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 se2 zo2 jat1 pin1 zi6 seot6, gong2 seot6 keoi5 ge3 sing4 zoeng2 ging1 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他写了一篇自述，讲述他的成长经历。
examples.english_sentence: He wrote a self-narrative describing his growth experiences.

mandarin_meaning: 自选（自行选择、可自由挑选）
english_meaning: self-selected; to choose oneself; optional
explanation_mandarin: 表示由自己選擇或挑選，常用於餐飲（自選配料）、商品（可自選單件）或投資（自選股）等情況，可作動詞或形容詞使用。
explanation_english: Indicates choosing by oneself or an option that can be selected freely. Commonly used for build-your-own food options, selectable items, or watchlists in finance. Functions as a verb or adjective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳有自選配料，你可以自己揀你鍾意嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 zi6 syun2 pui3 liu6, nei5 ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 gaan2 nei5 zung1 ji3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這間餐廳有自選配料，你可以自己選擇你喜歡的。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has build-your-own toppings; you can choose what you like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔想買成套，可以自選單件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 soeng2 maai5 sing4 tou3, ho2 ji5 zi6 syun2 daan1 gin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不想買成套，可以自選單件。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to buy the set, you can pick individual items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺證券App入面加咗幾隻股票入自選股。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 zing3 hyun3 aap1 jap6 min6 gaa1 zo2 gei2 zek3 gu2 piu3 jap6 zi6 syun2 gu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在證券App裡把幾支股票加入自選股。
examples.english_sentence: I added several stocks to my watchlist in the brokerage app.

mandarin_meaning: 有自尊；注意自己的言行
english_meaning: have self-respect; mind one's behavior; behave oneself
explanation_mandarin: 用來勸告或責備別人要有自尊、注意言行，不要失禮或放肆。
explanation_english: Used to admonish or tell someone to have self-respect and mind their behavior; to refrain from rude or inappropriate actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都幾大個人，請自重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gei2 daai6 go3 jan4, ceng2 zi6 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都長大了，請自重。
examples.english_sentence: You're already grown up; please behave yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺網上亂放嘢，要叫佢自重。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 lyun6 fong3 je5, jiu3 giu3 keoi5 zi6 zung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是在網上亂發東西，應該提醒他要自重。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps posting nonsense online; someone should tell him to mind his behavior.

mandarin_meaning: 自闭（口語：封閉自己、退縮；醫學上則與自閉症相關）
english_meaning: to shut oneself off; to withdraw socially; (colloquial) to feel embarrassed/awkward and shut down
explanation_mandarin: 在香港口語中，「自閉」常用來形容一個人封閉自己、不想與人接觸或在尷尬情況下退縮、無所適從。需注意醫學上「自閉症」是另一專業名詞，日常用法與醫學診斷不同。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong colloquial Cantonese, "自閉" describes someone who shuts themselves off, withdraws from social contact, or freezes up from embarrassment or awkwardness. Note that medically "autism" (autistic disorder) is a distinct term (self-closing in everyday speech is different from a clinical diagnosis).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近成日自閉，唔想出街見人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 zi6 bei3, m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1 gin3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近老是自闭，不想出门见人。
examples.english_sentence: He's been shutting himself off a lot recently; he doesn't want to go out or see people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面試嗰陣我答唔到問題，差啲自閉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 si5 go2 zan6 ngo5 daap3 m4 dou2 man6 tai4, caa1 di1 zi6 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面试的时候我答不出问题，差点就自闭了。
examples.english_sentence: During the interview I couldn't answer the questions; I almost shut down.

mandarin_meaning: 自閉症（自閉症譜系障礙）
english_meaning: Autism (autism spectrum disorder)
explanation_mandarin: 自閉症是一種神經發展障礙，特徵包括社交溝通困難、重複或限制性行為與興趣，症狀與嚴重程度因人而異。
explanation_english: Autism (autism spectrum disorder) is a neurodevelopmental condition characterized by difficulties in social communication and interaction, and by restricted or repetitive behaviors and interests; severity varies between individuals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細佬有自閉症，平時溝通會有啲困難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 lou2 jau5 zi6 bai3 zing3, ping4 si4 gau1 tung1 wui5 jau5 di1 kwan3 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的弟弟有自閉症，平時溝通會有些困難。
examples.english_sentence: His younger brother has autism; he often has some difficulty communicating.

mandarin_meaning: 己方队伍 / 我方队伍
english_meaning: one's own team; allied team; teammates
explanation_mandarin: 口語或網絡用語，常用於比賽或線上遊戲中，指“己方隊伍”或“我方”的成員，用以區分對手（敵隊）。
explanation_english: A colloquial or online term used in sports or multiplayer games to refer to one's own team or allies, distinguishing them from the opposing team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今場比賽我哋自隊表現唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 coeng4 bei2coi3 ngo5 dei6 zi6 deoi2 biu2 jin6 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场比赛我们己方队伍表现不错。
examples.english_sentence: In this match our team performed well.

mandarin_meaning: 自愿（愿意、不被强迫）
english_meaning: voluntary; willing; of one's own free will
explanation_mandarin: 表示出于个人意愿、主动愿意做某事，而非被强迫或命令。
explanation_english: Indicates acting out of one's own will or willingness to do something, not under coercion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係自願加班，唔係老闆逼我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 zi6 jyun6 gaa1 baan1, m4 hai6 lou5 baan2 bik1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是自愿加班，不是老板逼我。
examples.english_sentence: I volunteered to work overtime; my boss didn't force me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你自願幫手，我會好感激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zi6 jyun6 bong1 sau2, ngo5 wui5 hou2 gam2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你自愿帮忙，我会很感激。
examples.english_sentence: If you volunteer to help, I'll be very grateful.

mandarin_meaning: 顧不上自己或別人的事；忙得無暇顧及其他事情（成語）
english_meaning: Too busy to look after oneself or others; overwhelmingly occupied (idiom).
explanation_mandarin: 形容忙到連照顧自己或處理其他事情的時間或精力都沒有。
explanation_english: Describes being so busy or overwhelmed that one has no time or energy to take care of oneself or handle other matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司咁忙，經理都自顧不暇，冇時間照顧員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1si1 gam2 mong4, ging1lei5 dou1 zi6 gu3 bat1 haa4, mou5 si4gaan3 ziu3gu3 jyun4gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司這麼忙，經理都忙得顧不上自己，沒有時間照顧員工。
examples.english_sentence: The company is so busy that even the manager is too swamped to look after himself and has no time to take care of the staff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 媽咪要同時照顧兩個細路，仲要返工，真係自顧不暇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4mi4 jiu3 tung4si4 ziu3gu3 loeng5 go3 sai3lou6, zung6 jiu3 faan1gung1, zan1 hai6 zi6 gu3 bat1 haa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 媽媽要同時照顧兩個小孩，還要上班，真是顧不上自己。
examples.english_sentence: Mom has to care for two kids and work at the same time — she's really too busy to look after herself.

mandarin_meaning: 自食其力
english_meaning: to support oneself; to earn one's own living; be self-reliant
explanation_mandarin: 指靠自己的勞動或能力謀生，不依賴他人。
explanation_english: Refers to earning a living through one's own labor or ability; being self-reliant and not dependent on others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大學畢業之後就返工，想自食其力，唔想再靠父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 hok6 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 zau6 faan1 gung1, soeng2 zi6 sik6 kei4 lik6, m4 soeng2 zoi3 kaau3 fu6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他大學畢業後就去工作，想自食其力，不想再靠父母。
examples.english_sentence: After graduating from university he went to work; he wants to support himself and not rely on his parents anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 自作自受 / 承担自己行为造成的不良后果
english_meaning: to reap what one sows; to suffer the consequences of one's own actions
explanation_mandarin: 表示因自己的行为或决定导致不好的后果，必须自己承担。相当于“自作自受”或“咎由自取”。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone must bear the bad consequences brought about by their own actions or decisions; equivalent to 'to reap what one sows' or 'to bring it upon oneself.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日違反公司規矩，結果俾人炒，真係自食其果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 wai4 faan6 gung1 si1 kwai1 geoi2, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 caau2, zan1 hai6 zi6 sik6 kei4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是違反公司的規矩，結果被解僱，真是自食其果。
examples.english_sentence: He kept breaking company rules and was fired as a result — he really reaped what he sowed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔肯溫書，考試唔及格，唯有自食其果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hang2 wan1 syu1, haau2 si3 m4 kap6 gaak3, wai4 jau5 zi6 sik6 kei4 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不肯溫習，考試不及格，只好自食其果。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't study and failed the exam; he had to suffer the consequences of his own actions.

mandarin_meaning: 自首 (zìshǒu)：向警方或有關當局承認犯罪，主動投案。
english_meaning: to turn oneself in; to voluntarily surrender to the police/authorities and admit wrongdoing
explanation_mandarin: 向警方或有關當局承認罪行，主動投案接受調查和處罰。
explanation_english: To voluntarily surrender to the police or relevant authorities, admitting an offense and submitting to investigation and legal consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於決定去自首。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 kyut3 ding6 heoi3 zi6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他終於決定去自首。
examples.english_sentence: He finally decided to turn himself in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你做錯嘢，最好主動自首。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zou6 co3 je5, zeoi3 hou2 zyu2 dung6 zi6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你做錯事，最好主動自首。
examples.english_sentence: If you did something wrong, it's best to proactively turn yourself in.

mandarin_meaning: 自驾游 (指自己开车进行的旅行)
english_meaning: self-drive trip; self-driving tour; road trip by one's own car
explanation_mandarin: 指以自己駕車為主要交通方式的旅行或度假方式，通常強調自行開車、自由安排行程與停靠點。
explanation_english: A trip taken by driving one's own car — a self-driving tour or road trip where travelers drive themselves and arrange routes and stops freely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月去內地自駕遊，打算由廣州一路開車去桂林。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 noi6 dei6 zi6 gaa3 jau4, daa2 syun3 jau4 gwong2 zau1 jat1 lou6 hoi1 ce1 heoi3 gwai3 lam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月去内地自驾游，打算由广州一路开车去桂林。
examples.english_sentence: We're going on a self-drive trip to the mainland next month; planning to drive from Guangzhou all the way to Guilin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果冇人陪，我都鍾意自己一個人自駕遊，可以自由決定行程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 mou5 jan4 pui4, ngo5 dou1 zung1 ji3 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 jan4 zi6 gaa3 jau4, ho2 ji5 zi6 jau4 kyut3 ding6 hang4 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果没人陪，我也喜欢一个人自驾游，可以自由决定行程。
examples.english_sentence: If nobody comes along, I also like going on self-drive trips alone; you can decide the itinerary freely.

mandarin_meaning: 自毒自害；自招毀滅（古語用法，指以毒害自己或採取會導致自身滅亡的辦法）
english_meaning: to poison oneself; to bring about one's own ruin; self-destructive action
explanation_mandarin: 「鴆」為古代用以害人的毒物，引申為自害或自我毀滅。『自鴆』多用於書面或文言語境，表示採取會導致自己受害或滅亡的行為。
explanation_english: Literary term: originally referring to the poisonous agent 'zhen'. 'Self-zhen' (自鴆) means to poison oneself or to take actions that lead to one's own downfall — a self-destructive choice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣做只係自鴆，自討苦吃啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng6 zou6 zi2 hai6 zi6 zam2, zi6 tou2 fu2 hek3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這樣做只是自鴆，自討苦吃而已。
examples.english_sentence: Doing this is self-destructive; you're just asking for trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 臭（chòu）：有難聞的氣味；引申為討厭、不好的意思，也可作貶稱
english_meaning: smelly, stinky; foul-smelling; figuratively: nasty, lousy, or used as an insult
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容詞（也可作動詞或俗稱性質詞）
partOfSpeech_english: adjective (can be used informally as a verb or pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 「臭」主要指發出難聞的氣味。引申義包括討厭、不好或作為貶稱（如「臭小子」）。在口語中可當形容詞或用作動詞性表達（表示發臭）。
explanation_english: Primarily denotes a bad or foul smell. Figuratively it can mean unpleasant, lousy, or be used as a pejorative (e.g. "臭小子" = "you brat"). In spoken usage it functions mainly as an adjective and sometimes as a verb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條魚好臭，要拋咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 jyu4 hou2 cau3, jiu3 pou1 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這條魚很臭，要丟掉它。
examples.english_sentence: This fish smells really bad; we should throw it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個臭小子又遲到，真係唔可靠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 cau3 siu2 zi2 jau6 ci4 dou3, zan1 hai6 m4 ho2 kaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個臭小子又遲到了，真不可靠。
examples.english_sentence: That little brat is late again; really unreliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫有陣臭味，要洗乾淨先好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 zan6 cau3 mei6, jiu3 sai2 gon1 zeng6 sin1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服有一股臭味，要先洗乾淨才行。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt has a bad smell; it needs to be washed first.

mandarin_meaning: 臭小子；討人厭的小混蛋（粵語俚語、罵人或戲稱用）
english_meaning: little rascal; stinker (Cantonese slang, a mild insult or teasing term)
explanation_mandarin: 「臭串」是粵語口語俚語，常用來罵人或開玩笑，指討人厭、調皮或惹人生氣的人。語氣可視語境由戲謔到輕微侮辱不等。
explanation_english: “Chau cyun” is Cantonese colloquial slang used as a mild insult or teasing term for someone who is annoying, naughty, or a rascal. Tone can range from playful to mildly offensive depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你條臭串，做咩又遲到呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tiu4 cau3 cyun3, zou6 me1 jau6 ci4 dou3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個臭小子，幹嘛又遲到？
examples.english_sentence: You little rascal, why are you late again?

mandarin_meaning: 臭小子；小壞蛋（口語、戲稱）
english_meaning: little stinker; little rascal (informal, teasing insult/affectionate)
explanation_mandarin: 「臭丸」是廣東話口語俚語，常用來戲稱或輕微罵人，通常對小孩子或熟人用，語氣可親熱也可帶有不滿，意指「小屁孩」、「臭小子」或「小壞蛋」。
explanation_english: “臭丸” is Cantonese colloquial slang used to teasingly address someone as a little rascal or “little stinker.” It’s often used for children or familiar people; tone can be affectionate or mildly reproachful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個臭丸，唔好成日偷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 cau3 jyun4, m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 tau1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個臭小子，不要成天偷東西。
examples.english_sentence: You little stinker, stop stealing things all the time.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）很臭、臭烘烘
english_meaning: colloquial for very smelly; stinky
explanation_mandarin: 口語粵語俚語，用來形容人或物有強烈的臭味，常帶有戲謔或貶義的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese slang term used to describe a person or thing as having a strong unpleasant smell; often used jokingly or pejoratively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好臭亨亨，我唔想著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 cau3 hang1 hang1, ngo5 m4 soeng2 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服很臭，我不想穿。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is really stinky; I don't want to wear it.

mandarin_meaning: （在背後或當面）說別人的壞話；說人壞話、誹謗、嘲笑。
english_meaning: To badmouth someone; to speak ill of someone (behind their back or to their face); to gossip or slander.
explanation_mandarin: 口語用語，指對別人說壞話、講閒話或嘲笑別人的行為，常含有貶低或造謠的意味。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning to speak badly of someone, gossip about them, or mock them. It often implies disparagement or slander.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺背後臭口人，搞到大家都唔想靠近佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 bui3 hau6 cau3 hau2 jan4, gaau2 dou3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 soeng2 kaau3 gan6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他總是在背後說別人壞話，讓大家都不想接近他。
examples.english_sentence: He always badmouths people behind their backs, making everyone not want to get close to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺佢面前臭口，佢會唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 keoi5 min6 cin4 cau3 hau2, keoi5 wui5 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別在他面前說他的壞話，他會不高興。
examples.english_sentence: Don't badmouth him in front of him — he'll get upset.

mandarin_meaning: 因聲譽不好而廣為人知；臭名昭著
english_meaning: to be notorious; to have a widely spread bad reputation
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容某人或某事因不良行為、醜聞或壞名聲而被廣泛傳播與知曉，通常帶有負面評價。
explanation_english: An idiom used to describe someone or something that has become widely known for negative reasons (scandals, bad behavior), implying notoriety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為嗰宗醜聞而臭名遠播，冇人肯再信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 go2 zung1 cau2 man4 ji4 cau3 ming4 jyun5 bo3, mou5 jan4 hang2 zoi3 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因為那起醜聞而臭名遠播，沒人肯再相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He became notorious because of that scandal; no one is willing to trust him again.

mandarin_meaning: 臭味（指令人不舒服的惡臭或異味）
english_meaning: bad smell; stench; unpleasant odor
explanation_mandarin: 指令人不舒服或令人皺鼻子的氣味，可指短暫的一陣臭味或長期存在的臭味，常用於描述垃圾、腐敗物或人體不潔等發出的異味。
explanation_english: Refers to an unpleasant or offensive smell; can denote a transient whiff or a persistent foul odor. Commonly used to describe smells from trash, decay, or poor personal hygiene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房有陣臭味，好似係垃圾冇倒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong4 jau5 zan6 cau3 mei6, hou2 ci5 hai6 laap6 saap3 mou5 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房間有股臭味，好像是垃圾還沒倒。
examples.english_sentence: The room has a bad smell; it seems like the trash hasn't been taken out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身上有陣臭味，可能冇沖涼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 soeng6 jau5 zan6 cau3 mei6, ho2 nang4 mou5 cung1 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他身上有股臭味，可能沒有洗澡。
examples.english_sentence: He smells bad; maybe he hasn't showered.

mandarin_meaning: 彼此性格、愛好或惡習相近而互相吸引；物以類聚
english_meaning: To be kindred spirits or 'birds of a feather' — people who get along because they share similar tastes, characters, or bad habits
explanation_mandarin: 指性格、興趣或習性相似的人互相吸引或容易合得來，常可含貶義（如共同的壞習慣）。
explanation_english: Refers to people whose personalities, interests, or habits are similar, so they are attracted to one another or get along easily; can carry a negative connotation when referring to shared bad habits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日一齊做啲壞事，真係臭味相投。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 zou6 di1 waai6 si6, zan1 hai6 cau3 mei6 soeng1 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个经常一起做坏事，真是臭味相投。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are always doing bad things together; they're truly birds of a feather.

mandarin_meaning: （粤语粗口）笨蛋、傻瓜；用作骂人或形容讨厌/荒唐的人或行为
english_meaning: Cantonese slang insult meaning 'idiot' or 'dumbass'; used to call someone stupid, obnoxious, or acting ridiculous (vulgar, informal)
explanation_mandarin: 「臭四」是粤语粗口，用来骂人或开玩笑，表示某人很愚蠢、讨厌或行为荒唐。语气通常粗俗或带有轻蔑/调侃意味，视语境可为玩笑或冒犯。
explanation_english: “Chau3 sei3” is Cantonese vulgar slang used as an insult or teasing remark to call someone an idiot or describe someone as obnoxious or ridiculous. It is informal and can be offensive depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你臭四喎，做咩咁蠢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 cau3 sei3 wo3, zou6 me1 gam2 ceon2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是个笨蛋，为什么这么蠢？
examples.english_sentence: You're such an idiot — why are you so stupid?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做臭四，大家都唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 cau3 sei3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做白痴，大家都不开心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be an idiot; everyone's unhappy.

mandarin_meaning: 臭坑出臭草（粵語俗語），比喻惡劣的出身、環境或風氣會造就不良的人或結果。
english_meaning: Literally 'a stinky pit produces stinky grass' — an idiom meaning a bad environment, upbringing, or culture breeds bad people or bad outcomes.
explanation_mandarin: 此粵語俗語字面指『臭坑會長出臭草』，用來形容某個地方或環境很糟糕，因而培養出品行不好或行為有問題的人、事或後果。
explanation_english: A Cantonese saying literally meaning 'a stinky pit produces stinky grass.' It describes how a bad environment, upbringing, or institutional culture tends to produce undesirable people or results.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間公司管理咁差，出嚟嘅員工都冇乜正直，真係臭坑出臭草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 gung1 si1 gun2 lei5 gam2 caa1, ceot1 loi4 ge3 jyun4 gung1 dou1 mou5 mat1 zing3 zik6, zan1 hai6 cau3 haang1 ceot1 cau3 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司管理這麼差，出來的員工都沒有什麼正直，真是臭坑出臭草。
examples.english_sentence: That company is so badly managed that the employees it produces aren't very upright — truly, a bad environment breeds bad people.

mandarin_meaning: 臭小子；討厭的混蛋（罵人的粗俗用語）
english_meaning: A vulgar Cantonese insult meaning "stinking brat" or "stinking bastard", used to disparage someone.
explanation_mandarin: 「臭尿𡃴」是廣東話的粗俗罵人用語，帶有輕蔑和侮辱意味，通常用來指責對方可惡、無用或討厭。
explanation_english: “臭尿𡃴” is a vulgar Cantonese insult expressing contempt. It’s used to call someone a nasty or worthless person — similar to “stinking brat” or “stinking bastard.”

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個臭尿𡃴，做嘢做得咁差，收聲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 cau3 niu6 gai1, zou6 je5 zou6 dak1 gam2 caa1, sau1 seng1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個臭小子，做事做得這麼差，閉嘴吧！
examples.english_sentence: You stinking brat — you did such a lousy job, shut up!

mandarin_meaning: 自以為是／得意忘形（口語、俚語）
english_meaning: to be smug/arrogant; acting conceited (colloquial slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「臭屁勒」是香港粵語口語俚語，用來形容某人自大、得意、愛炫耀，語氣常帶責備或嘲諷。結尾的「勒」為書寫變體的語氣助詞，實際口語發音與「喇」相同。
explanation_english: “臭屁勒” is Hong Kong Cantonese slang used to describe someone who is smug, conceited, or showing off. It often carries a reproachful or mocking tone. The final character 「勒」 here is a written variant used as a sentence particle and is pronounced like the particle "laa3".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁臭屁勒，冇人理你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 cau3 pei3 laa3, mou5 jan4 lei5 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你別這麼自以為是，沒有人理你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so smug; nobody cares about you.

mandarin_meaning: 自以為是；愛出風頭、很自大的樣子
english_meaning: cocky; full of oneself; arrogantly showy
explanation_mandarin: 「臭屁瘌」是粵語俗語，用來形容一個人自大、愛炫耀或擺架子，帶有貶義，常用於口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term describing someone who is arrogant, boastful, or full of themselves. It's informal and usually derogatory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日臭屁瘌，講嘢又自大，真討厭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 cau3 pei3 laak3, gong2 je5 jau6 zi6 daai6, zan1 tou2 jim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老是臭屁瘌，說話又自大，真討厭。
examples.english_sentence: He's always being cocky and full of himself — so annoying.

mandarin_meaning: 愛裝腔作勢、顯得很自負、驕傲
english_meaning: to be cocky or smug; to show off; full of oneself
explanation_mandarin: 「臭屁𤷫」是廣東話的口語／俚語，用來形容一個人自以為了不起、誇耀自己或擺出一副驕傲的樣子。當中「𤷫」字在俗寫中常作強調或裝飾用，整體讀音與「臭屁」相同。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to describe someone who is arrogant, smug, or boastful. The extra character 𤷫 is often a decorative/emphatic addition in colloquial writing; the phrase is pronounced like 臭屁 (cau3 pei3).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁臭屁𤷫啦，啲人都睇唔起你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 cau3 pei3 laa1, di1 jan4 dou1 tai2 m4 hei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那麼臭屁啦，別人都看不起你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so full of yourself; people will look down on you.

mandarin_meaning: 粗俗髒話，用來詛罵或發洩憤怒，相當於「他媽的／該死」等語氣詞
english_meaning: A vulgar Cantonese expletive used to curse or vent anger; roughly equivalent to 'fuck', 'goddamn', or 'damn it'.
explanation_mandarin: 由多個粗口字組成的罵人用語，語氣極粗俗，常見於非正式場合或口語怒罵中，用以表達強烈不滿或憤怒。
explanation_english: A compound obscene swear in Cantonese formed from several vulgar morphemes. Extremely coarse and used in informal speech to express strong anger, frustration, or to insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 臭屎密冚！啲嘢又壞咗！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau3 si2 mat6 ham2! di1 je5 jau6 waai6 zo2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他媽的！東西又壞了！
examples.english_sentence: Goddamn it! The thing's broken again!

mandarin_meaning: （口語、俚語）非常臭、臭兮兮
english_meaning: informal/slang: very stinky; reeking (used playfully or mildly insultingly)
explanation_mandarin: 「臭崩崩」是廣東話口語或俚語，用來強調某物或某人很臭、味道難聞；語氣常帶戲謔或輕微的貶義，多見於香港口語。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang term used to emphasize that something or someone smells very bad. The tone is often playful or mildly insulting; commonly used in Hong Kong Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你件衫臭崩崩，快啲洗啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin6 saam1 cau3 beng1 beng1, faai3 di1 sai2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的衣服很臭，快洗吧！
examples.english_sentence: Your clothes are really stinky — wash them quickly!

mandarin_meaning: （口語）小壞蛋、調皮鬼，帶有逗弄或親暱的語氣
english_meaning: an affectionate/teasing term for a little rascal or brat
explanation_mandarin: 「臭朵」是廣東話的口語稱呼，用來逗弄或輕微責備某人（常指小孩或熟人），含有調侃或親暱的意味，語氣可愛或嘲弄，視語境而定。
explanation_english: “臭朵” is a Cantonese colloquial term used to tease or mildly scold someone (often a child or a familiar person). It conveys a playful, affectionate, or slightly reproachful tone depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個臭朵，成日食我啲零食唔講我一聲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 cau3 do2, seng4 jat6 sik6 ngo5 di1 ling4 sik6 m4 gong2 ngo5 jat1 seng1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個小壞蛋，總是吃我的零食不告訴我！
examples.english_sentence: You little rascal, you always eat my snacks without telling me!

mandarin_meaning: 臭家伙；讨厌的人（贬义、口语）
english_meaning: jerk; nasty/annoying person (slang, derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: “臭格”是香港口語俚語，帶有貶義，用來稱呼討厭或令人不爽的人。語氣可輕可重，視說話者語調和語境而定，有時在熟人間也可半開玩笑地使用。
explanation_english: “Chau gaak” is a Hong Kong Cantonese slang insult used to refer to an annoying or unpleasant person. It's derogatory but tone and context determine how strong it feels; among friends it can be used jokingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個臭格，成日遲到！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 cau3 gaak3, sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个臭家伙，总是迟到！
examples.english_sentence: You jerk, you're always late!

mandarin_meaning: （1）字面：有臭味的檔口、攤位；（2）口語（貶義）：形容某人或某事糟糕、討厭或沒用。
english_meaning: (1) Literal: a stall/booth that smells bad; (2) Colloquial/pejorative: a lousy or annoying person/thing, a 'stinker' or 'trash'.
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞（口語，貶義；也可作實物名詞）
explanation_mandarin: 由「臭」（有難聞氣味/討厭）和「檔」（檔口、攤位）組成。字面上可指散發臭味的檔口；在香港口語中也常做貶義用，形容人或事物很差、令人討厭或沒用。
explanation_english: Formed from '臭' (stinky/annoying) + '檔' (stall/booth). Literally it can refer to a stall that smells bad; colloquially in Hong Kong it is used pejoratively to describe a person or thing that is lousy, annoying, or worthless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市場入面有一個臭檔，成日散發怪味，我唔敢行近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 coeng4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 go3 cau3 dong3, sing4 jat6 saan3 faat3 gwaai3 mei6, ngo5 m4 gam2 haang4 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市場裡有一個很臭的檔口，經常散發難聞的味道，我不敢靠近。
examples.english_sentence: There's a stinky stall in the market that always gives off a bad smell; I don't dare go near it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做事好差，老闆話佢係個臭檔，要走人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 si6 hou2 caa1, lou5 baan2 waa6 keoi5 hai6 go3 cau3 dong3, jiu3 zau2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很差，老闆說他是個臭檔，要把他炒魷魚（解僱）。
examples.english_sentence: He does his job very poorly; the boss called him a lousy person and is going to fire him.

mandarin_meaning: 臭气熏天
english_meaning: to reek to high heaven; extremely foul-smelling; (figuratively) an atmosphere of corruption or extreme unpleasantness
explanation_mandarin: 形容气味非常难闻，臭到弥漫整个空间；也可比喻风气败坏或气氛极其不好。
explanation_english: Describes a very strong, unpleasant smell that fills the air; can also be used figuratively to describe a corrupt or highly unpleasant atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋入面臭氣熏天，快啲開窗通風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 jap6 min6 cau3 hei3 fan1 tin1, faai3 di1 hoi1 coeng1 tung1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间里臭气熏天，快点开窗通风。
examples.english_sentence: The room reeks; open the windows to ventilate.

mandarin_meaning: 臭氧 (化学名：O3)
english_meaning: ozone (chemical molecule O3)
explanation_mandarin: 由三個氧原子組成的氣體分子，存在於大氣中。高空的臭氧層能吸收紫外線，地面附近的臭氧則可能對健康有害。
explanation_english: A gaseous molecule made of three oxygen atoms (O3). Stratospheric ozone forms the ozone layer that absorbs UV radiation, while ground-level ozone can be a harmful pollutant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學家擔心臭氧層被破壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 gaa1 daam1 sam1 cau3 joeng5 cang4 bei6 po3 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科學家擔心臭氧層被破壞。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists are worried that the ozone layer is being damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院有時會用臭氧來消毒某啲器材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 jau5 si4 wui5 jung6 cau3 joeng5 loi4 siu1 duk6 mau5 di1 hei3 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院有時會用臭氧來消毒某些器材。
examples.english_sentence: Hospitals sometimes use ozone to disinfect certain equipment.

mandarin_meaning: 臭氧层 (chòuyǎngcéng)
english_meaning: ozone layer
explanation_mandarin: 指地球平流層中的臭氧分子層，能吸收大部分紫外線，保護生物免受紫外線傷害；亦會因氟氯碳化物（CFCs）等造成耗損或空洞。
explanation_english: The layer of ozone molecules in the Earth's stratosphere that absorbs most ultraviolet (UV) radiation, protecting living organisms; it can be depleted by substances like CFCs, causing thinning or holes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 臭氧層可以保護我哋免受紫外線傷害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau3 joeng6 cang4 ho2 ji5 bou2 wu6 ngo5 dei6 min5 sau6 zi2 ngoi6 sin3 soeng1 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 臭氧层可以保护我们免受紫外线伤害。
examples.english_sentence: The ozone layer can protect us from ultraviolet radiation.

mandarin_meaning: 臭水；發臭的污水、下水道水或滯留腐敗的水
english_meaning: foul-smelling water; sewage, stagnant or polluted water
explanation_mandarin: 指有難聞氣味的水，通常指下水道、污水或滯留發臭的水。在口語粵語中常用作名詞描述臭味來源或污水情況。
explanation_english: Refers to water that smells bad, typically sewage, drain water, or stagnant polluted water. Used colloquially as a noun to describe the source of a bad smell or dirty water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落雨之後，街邊有陣臭水味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyu5 zi1 hau6, gaai1 bin1 jau5 zan6 cau3 seoi2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨之後，街邊有一股臭水味。
examples.english_sentence: After the rain, there was a smell of sewage on the street.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋隔離條渠爆咗，臭水淹到入屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 gaak3 lei4 tiu4 keoi4 baau3 zo2, cau3 seoi2 jim1 dou3 jap6 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隔壁的排水渠爆了，臭水淹進了屋裡。
examples.english_sentence: The drain next door burst and sewage flooded into the house.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗）討厭、卑鄙或沒用的人；粗俗的罵人用語（類似「混蛋」、「沒用的懶漢」）
english_meaning: A coarse Cantonese insult for an unpleasant, despicable, or useless person (like 'jerk', 'bum', or 'scoundrel').
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名詞 / 形容詞（口語、貶義）
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話粗俗俚語，用來形容一個人行為不檢點、卑鄙或沒用。語氣強烈、貶義，多用於口語或罵人時，屬於非正式或粗魯用語。
explanation_english: A coarse Cantonese slang term used to describe someone whose behavior is indecent, despicable, or useless. Strongly derogatory and informal; typically used in spoken language to insult someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係臭油膉，成日唔做嘢淨係飲酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 cau3 jau4 gut3, seng4 jat6 m4 zou6 je5 zing6 hai6 jam2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是個臭油膉，整天不做事只會喝酒。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a useless jerk — always drinking and never working.

mandarin_meaning: 狡猾或好色的人（俚語、貶義）
english_meaning: a sly or lecherous person (slang, pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 「臭狐」為廣東話俚語，常用來形容行事狡猾、滑頭或愛調情、好色的人，語氣可帶戲謔或貶義，視語境而定。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to describe someone who is sly, sneaky, or lecherous/constantly flirting. It is typically pejorative or teasing depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個人真係臭狐，成日呃人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 cau3 wu4, sing4 jat6 aak1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個人真是個臭狐，總是騙人。
examples.english_sentence: That person is such a sly fox — he’s always cheating people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個臭狐，成日周圍撩女仔，女仔要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 cau3 wu4, sing4 jat6 zau1 wai4 liu2 neoi5 zai2, neoi5 zai2 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個臭狐，總是在外面撩女生，女生要小心。
examples.english_sentence: He’s a lecherous sly fox — always flirting with girls; girls should be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 討厭的男人／壞男人（口語、貶義）
english_meaning: a rotten man; a jerk/loser (pejorative slang for a man who behaves badly, e.g. cheating or irresponsible)
explanation_mandarin: 「臭男人」是口語貶義詞，用來形容行為差、對人不負責任、欺騙或對伴侶不好等的男人。常帶有憤怒或戲謔的語氣。
explanation_english: A colloquial, pejorative term used to describe a man who behaves badly—e.g. unfaithful, irresponsible, or deceitful. Often used with anger or teasing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢偷食咗，你仲同佢一齊？臭男人！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 sik6 zo2, nei5 zung6 tung4 keoi5 jat1 cai4? cau3 naam4 jan4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出軌了，你還和他在一起？臭男人！
examples.english_sentence: He cheated — you're still with him? What a jerk!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再俾嗰個臭男人呃你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 bei2 go2 go3 cau3 naam4 jan4 aak1 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別再讓那個壞男人欺騙你了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let that rotten man fool you anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 臭缸出臭草（比喻壞的家庭或環境會出現行為不良的後代）
english_meaning: A bad jar produces bad grass — i.e. bad origins or upbringing produce bad results; 'like father, like son' / 'a rotten tree yields rotten fruit'.
explanation_mandarin: 這句粵語俗語用比喻說明壞的家庭、環境或榜樣會造就行為不良的後代或帶來不良後果，相當於「有其父必有其子」或「壞樹出壞果」。
explanation_english: This Cantonese proverb metaphorically says that a bad family, environment, or example produces bad offspring or results — similar to 'like father, like son' or 'a rotten tree bears rotten fruit.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爸成日做壞事，佢個仔都係，真係臭罌出臭草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 baa4 sing4 jat6 zou6 waai6 si6, keoi5 go3 zai2 dou1 hai6, zan1 hai6 cau3 joeng1 ceot1 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸經常做壞事，他兒子也一樣，真是臭缸出臭草。
examples.english_sentence: His father is always up to no good, and his son is the same — truly, like father, like son.

mandarin_meaning: 臭罈出臭醋（諺語）：壞的出身或環境會產生壞的結果；物以類聚、惡性循環。
english_meaning: Literally 'a rotten jar produces rotten vinegar' — an expression meaning bad origins, character, or environment produce bad outcomes; like begets like.
explanation_mandarin: 一句廣東話俗語，字面意思是臭罐子會出臭醋，比喻出身、性格或所處環境不好的人或事，往往會導致相應的壞結果或繼續出現類似的不良行為。
explanation_english: A Cantonese proverb literally meaning 'a rotten jar produces rotten vinegar.' It implies that bad origins, character, or environment tend to produce bad outcomes or further similar bad behavior — similar to 'like attracts like.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲朋友都係一班做壞事嘅人，臭罌出臭醋，佢都唔會變好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 pang4 jau5 dou1 hai6 jat1 baan1 zou6 waai6 si6 ge3 jan4, cau3 aang1 ceot1 cau3 cou3, keoi5 dou1 m4 wui5 bin3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那些朋友都是做壞事的人，臭罌出臭醋，他也不會變好。
examples.english_sentence: His friends are all bad people — a rotten jar produces rotten vinegar; he won't get any better.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）严厉地责骂、痛骂或恶语相向
english_meaning: to scold or berate someone harshly; to give someone a tongue-lashing
explanation_mandarin: 「臭罵」是廣東話口語，表示以惡劣或激烈的語氣嚴厲責罵某人，常含有很不客氣或侮辱性的講法。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese verb meaning to verbally abuse or scold someone severely, often with rude or insulting language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遲到咗成個鐘，結果畀老師臭罵一頓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 dou6 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1, git3 gwo2 bei2 lou5 si1 cau3 maa6 jat1 deon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他迟到了整整一个小时，结果被老师臭骂了一顿。
examples.english_sentence: He was an hour late and ended up getting severely scolded by the teacher.

mandarin_meaning: 脾气不好／坏脾气
english_meaning: bad temper; ill temper; easily irritable
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語，形容一個人很容易發脾氣、脾氣不好或容易惹人生氣。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial expression describing someone with a bad or ill temper who gets angry easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日有臭脾氣，啲細事都會嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 jau5 cau3 pei4 hei3, di1 sai3 si6 dou1 wui5 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她总是脾气很坏，小事也会生气。
examples.english_sentence: He/She always has a bad temper and gets angry even over small things.

mandarin_meaning: 該死（感嘆詞，用來表示驚訝、不滿或惱怒）
english_meaning: an expletive/exclamation expressing annoyance, frustration, or surprise (literal: 'stinky grass') — roughly 'damn' or 'shit'
explanation_mandarin: 「臭草」是廣東話俗語/罵人用的感嘆詞，常用來表達驚訝、不滿或懊惱，語氣可從略帶抱怨到粗口程度不等，字面是「臭的草」。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang exclamation used to express surprise, annoyance, frustration, or disgust. Literally 'stinky grass', it functions like 'damn' or 'shit' in English and can range from mild to vulgar depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 臭草！我又遲到喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau3 cou2! ngo5 jau6 ci4 dou3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 該死！我又遲到了。
examples.english_sentence: Damn! I'm late again.

mandarin_meaning: 臭虫 (床虱)
english_meaning: bedbug; (colloquially) a pest/annoying person
explanation_mandarin: 指會叮咬人的寄生昆蟲（即床虱、臭蟲）。在口語中也可用作罵人或稱呼惹人厭、討厭的人，表示貶義。
explanation_english: Refers to the parasitic insect (bedbug). Colloquially it can be used as an insult to call someone a pest or an annoying person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺旅館俾臭蟲咬到一身紅印。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 leoi5 gun2 bei6 cau3 cung4 ngaau5 dou3 jat1 san1 hung4 jan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在旅馆被臭虫咬得全身都是红印。
examples.english_sentence: I was bitten all over by bedbugs at the hostel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個臭蟲，唔好再煩我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 cau3 cung4, m4 hou2 zoi3 faan4 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个臭虫，别再烦我了。
examples.english_sentence: You little pest, don't bother me again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企有臭蟲，要搵滅蟲公司嚟搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jau5 cau3 cung4, jiu3 wan2 mit6 cung4 gung1 si1 lai4 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里有臭虫，要找灭虫公司来处理。
examples.english_sentence: There are bedbugs at home; we need to hire pest control.

mandarin_meaning: 臭小子；混蛋（口語、貶義）
english_meaning: a derogatory slang term meaning 'brat', 'jerk' or 'bastard' (informal, insulting)
explanation_mandarin: 粵語俗語/俚語，用作對人的侮辱性稱呼，表示厭惡、輕蔑或責怪，類似「臭小子」或「混蛋」。屬於口語及粗俗用語，使用時需注意場合。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang insult used to address or refer to someone with contempt — similar to 'brat', 'jerk', or 'bastard'. It's informal and vulgar, so be careful with context and audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個臭西，成日遲到仲唔覺得錯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 cau3 sai1, sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3 zung6 m4 gok3 dak1 co3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個臭小子，老是遲到還不覺得錯！
examples.english_sentence: You little brat — you're always late and don't think it's wrong!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個臭西，成日借錢唔還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 cau3 sai1, sing4 jat6 zek3 cin2 m4 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是個臭小子，老是借錢不還。
examples.english_sentence: He's a jerk who always borrows money and never pays it back.

mandarin_meaning: 臭豆腐 (chòu dòu fu) — 一種經過發酵、氣味較重的豆製小吃，常見於臺灣、中國大陸與香港等地的街頭夜市。
english_meaning: stinky tofu — a fermented tofu snack with a strong odor, popular as a street food in Taiwan, Mainland China, and Hong Kong.
explanation_mandarin: 臭豆腐是把豆腐經過發酵製成的食品，因發酵過程產生特殊強烈氣味而得名。可油炸、蒸或燒烤，常作為小吃。 在口語中偶爾也會比喻用來形容人或物很臭（貶義）。
explanation_english: Stinky tofu is tofu produced by fermentation, which gives it a distinctive strong smell. It can be deep-fried, steamed, or grilled and is commonly eaten as a snack. Colloquially it can also be used metaphorically to describe something or someone as smelly (pejorative).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜市嗰間檔口嘅臭豆腐好好味，我每次去都會買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 si5 go2 gaan1 dong3 hau2 ge3 cau3 dau6 fu6 hou2 hou2 mei6, ngo5 mui5 ci3 heoi3 dou1 wui5 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夜市那家攤位賣的臭豆腐很好吃，我每次去都會買。
examples.english_sentence: The stinky tofu from that stall at the night market is delicious; I buy it every time I go.

jyutping: cau3 zyu1 tau4 jau5 mang4 bei6 pou4 saat3
mandarin_meaning: 罵人俚語，用來形容某人又笨又虛偽／偽善或自以為是（字面把人比作「臭豬頭」，又帶諷刺性的「菩薩」）。
english_meaning: A Cantonese slang insult meaning someone is stupid and hypocritical or pretentious; literally compares the person to a 'stinky pig head' with a mocking 'bodhisattva' label.
explanation_mandarin: 這是一句香港粵語的粗俗俚語或諷刺用語，通常用來罵人或嘲諷別人愚蠢、虛偽或裝腔作勢。字面上把對方稱為「臭豬頭」，同時滑稽地加上「菩薩」以示諷刺，語氣帶貶義且不禮貌。
explanation_english: This is a coarse Hong Kong Cantonese slang expression used to insult or mock someone as foolish and hypocritical or pretentious. Literally it calls someone a 'stinky pig head' and facetiously adds 'bodhisattva' to heighten the sarcasm; the tone is derogatory and impolite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係臭豬頭有盟鼻菩薩，乜都唔識就裝識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 cau3 zyu1 tau4 jau5 mang4 bei6 pou4 saat3, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 zau6 zong1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是又臭又笨又偽善，什麼都不懂還裝懂。
examples.english_sentence: You're really a stinky, stupid, hypocrite — you don't know anything but pretend you do.

mandarin_meaning: 討厭的傢伙；壞人、卑劣或不誠實的人（俚語、貶義）
english_meaning: a jerk / scoundrel / rotten person (slang, derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話俚語，用來罵或形容令人討厭、卑劣或不誠實的人。語氣通常帶貶義，視語境可作玩笑或嚴厲斥責。
explanation_english: A Cantonese slang term used to insult or describe someone who is disliked, nasty, or dishonest. It is derogatory and can be used jokingly or harshly depending on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係臭貨，成日呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 cau3 fo3, sing4 jat6 aak1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是個臭貨，老是騙人錢。
examples.english_sentence: He's such a scoundrel; he always cheats people out of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做臭貨啦，知錯就改啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 cau3 fo3 laa1, zi1 co3 zau6 goi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要當個臭貨，知錯就改吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a jerk—admit your mistake and change.

mandarin_meaning: 比屎坑還臭；非常難聞或令人厭惡
english_meaning: stinks worse than a cesspit; extremely foul-smelling or obnoxious
explanation_mandarin: 用來形容人或物極其難聞或極其討厭，帶貶義，通常在口語或粗俗語境使用。
explanation_english: A colloquial/slang expression to describe a person or thing as extremely foul-smelling or extremely unpleasant/obnoxious; derogatory and informal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人臭過屎坑，冇人鍾意理佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 cau3 gwo3 si2 haang1, mou5 jan4 zung1 ji3 lei5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這人臭得像屎坑，沒人想理他。
examples.english_sentence: He's so obnoxious he 'stinks worse than a cesspit' — nobody wants to deal with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間房臭過屎坑，要開窗通風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 fong4 cau3 gwo3 si2 haang1, jiu3 hoi1 coeng1 tung1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個房間臭得像屎坑，要開窗通風。
examples.english_sentence: This room stinks worse than a cesspit; we need to open the windows.

mandarin_meaning: 粗俗侮辱性詞語（相當於「臭逼」/侮辱性的『婊子』等）
english_meaning: A very vulgar Cantonese insult (roughly 'fucking bitch' / 'stinking cunt'); highly offensive
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 粗俗侮辱性詞語（名詞／感歎詞）
explanation_mandarin: 「臭閪」是廣東話極為粗俗、侮辱性的罵人用語，原指女性生殖器，但常用作針對人（男女皆可）的惡辱性稱呼。屬於粗口，應避免在禮貌或正式場合使用。
explanation_english: “臭閪” is an extremely vulgar Cantonese profanity; literally referencing female genitals but used as a harsh insult directed at a person (can be used for any gender). It is highly offensive and inappropriate in polite or formal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做，真係臭閪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng6 zou6, zan1 hai6 cau3 hai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他這樣做，真是個臭逼。
examples.english_sentence: Doing that, he's such a fucking bitch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 臭閪！你又遲到啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cau3 hai1! nei5 jau6 ci4 dou3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 臭逼！你又迟到了！
examples.english_sentence: You fucking bitch! You're late again!

mandarin_meaning: （香港俚語、貶義）指沒用、令人討厭或可鄙的人；也可用來罵膽小或懦弱的人
english_meaning: Hong Kong Cantonese slang (pejorative) for a worthless, annoying, or contemptible person; can also imply a coward or someone pathetic
explanation_mandarin: 「臭雞」是香港粵語的粗俗用語，常用來罵人，意味對方沒用、令人厭惡或可鄙；視語境也可指膽小、懦弱的人。屬口語、貶義表達。
explanation_english: “臭雞” is a coarse Hong Kong Cantonese slang term used to insult someone as useless, disgusting, or contemptible; depending on context it can also mean a coward. It is informal and pejorative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個臭雞，成日遲到！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 cau3 gai1, sing4 jat6 ci4 dou3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這個臭雞，老是遲到！
examples.english_sentence: You stinky loser, always late!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做臭雞，試下向佢講明你嘅意見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 cau3 gai1, si3 haa5 hoeng3 keoi5 gong2 ming4 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別當個臭雞，試著向他說出你的意見。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a coward/loser — try telling him your opinion.

mandarin_meaning: （香港粵語俚語）指無禮、討人厭或愛頂嘴的年輕人或小孩；類似「臭小子」「頑童」。
english_meaning: A Hong Kong Cantonese slang term for a rude, annoying, or impertinent young person; similar to 'brat'.
explanation_mandarin: 「臭青」是廣東話俗語，帶貶義，多用來形容行為無禮、討厭或愛頂嘴的年輕人或小孩。常見於口語和非正式場合。
explanation_english: “臭青” is an informal Cantonese slang term with a negative connotation, used to describe a young person or child who is rude, annoying, or cheeky. It's used in spoken, informal contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做臭青啦，講嘢要有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 cau3 ceng1 laa1, gong2 je5 jiu3 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 別做臭青，說話要有禮貌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a 'chou ceng' (brat); speak politely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個臭青成日喺度頂嘴，真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 cau3 ceng1 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 deng2 zeoi2, zan1 hai6 deng2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那個臭青總是在那裡頂嘴，真讓人受不了。
examples.english_sentence: That brat is always talking back; it's really unbearable.

mandarin_meaning: 討人厭的人／討厭的小子（粗俗貶義）
english_meaning: an annoying person / a 'stinker' (informal derogatory slang)
explanation_mandarin: 「臭飛」是廣東話的粗俗俚語，用來罵人或形容某人討人厭、無禮或愛惹事。語氣偏負面、口語化，多用於熟人之間或罵人時。
explanation_english: “臭飛” is Cantonese slang and a mildly vulgar insult used to describe someone annoying, rude, or troublesome. It is informal, derogatory, and typically used in spoken contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係臭飛，成日唔聽人講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 cau3 fei1, seng4 jat6 m4 teng1 jan4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是個臭飛，總是不聽別人說話。
examples.english_sentence: You're such a stinker—you never listen to anyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日又扮晒嘢，真係臭飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 jau6 baan6 saai3 je5, zan1 hai6 cau3 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天又擺架子，真是個討人厭的人。
examples.english_sentence: He was showing off again today—what an annoying guy.

mandarin_meaning: 混蛋；讨厌的人（粗俗侮辱用语）
english_meaning: vulgar insult meaning 'bastard' / 'jerk' / 'asshole'
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 / 感叹词（粗口、侮辱性用语）
explanation_mandarin: 「臭餲」是廣東話的粗口，用來罵人、表達極度輕蔑或憤怒。語氣粗俗，通常用作指責或辱罵對方。
explanation_english: A Cantonese vulgar insult used to express strong contempt or anger toward someone. Extremely coarse — used to berate or demean a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係臭餲，做嘢成日遲到又唔負責！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 cau3 gau2, zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 jau6 m4 fu6 zaak3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是个混蛋，做事总是迟到又不负责任！
examples.english_sentence: You're such a bastard — you always show up late and never take responsibility!

mandarin_meaning: 痛骂；狠狠斥责
english_meaning: to scold someone harshly; to berate or curse out
explanation_mandarin: “臭駡”是廣東話口語，帶有強烈的貶義或粗魯語氣，表示對某人進行嚴厲或激烈的責罵。
explanation_english: “Chau maa” is Cantonese colloquial slang used to indicate harsh, often rude scolding or berating of someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被老細臭駡咗一頓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 lou5 sai3 cau3 maa6 zo2 jat1 deon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板臭骂了一顿。
examples.english_sentence: He was harshly scolded by the boss.

mandarin_meaning: （粗俗）罵人的詞，指妓女或用來侮辱女性／人
english_meaning: a vulgar insult meaning 'stinking whore' or a derogatory term for a person (usually a woman); offensive
explanation_mandarin: 「臭鷄」是廣東話的粗俗辱罵詞，字面上為「臭雞」，常用來稱呼妓女或貶低、侮辱他人（多指女性）。屬攻擊性語言，使用時會冒犯他人，主要出現在香港口語或粗俗對話中。
explanation_english: “臭鷄” (cau3 gai1) is a vulgar Cantonese insult literally meaning 'stinky chicken' but used to call someone a 'whore' or to demean a person (often a woman). It is offensive slang commonly heard in informal or coarse speech in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，真係臭鷄，唔好再嚟煩我！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6, zan1 hai6 cau3 gai1, m4 hou2 zoi3 lai4 faan4 ngo5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你這樣做，真是臭婊子，別再來煩我！
examples.english_sentence: You're acting like a damn whore — don't bother me again!

mandarin_meaning: 臭鼬（北美一种会喷出臭液的小型哺乳动物，英语：skunk）
english_meaning: skunk (a small black-and-white mammal that can spray a foul-smelling liquid as a defense)
explanation_mandarin: 臭鼬是一種小型哺乳動物，通常為黑白相間，遇到危險時會從肛腺噴出帶強烈臭味的液體以自衛。在日常語境中也可直接指代這種動物本身。
explanation_english: A skunk is a small mammal, typically black and white, that defends itself by spraying a strong-smelling liquid from glands near its tail. The term refers to the animal itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果喺郊外見到臭鼬，唔好靠近，佢會噴出臭液。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 hai6 gaau1 ngoi6 gin3 dou2 cau3 jau6, m4 hou2 kaau3 gan6, keoi5 wui5 pan3 ceot1 cau3 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果在郊外看到臭鼬，不要靠近，它可能會噴出臭液。
examples.english_sentence: If you see a skunk in the countryside, don't get close; it may spray foul-smelling liquid.

mandarin_meaning: 到；直到；甚至；表示程度達到
english_meaning: to; until; up to; as far as; even; (indicates reaching a point in time, place, or degree)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介詞 / 動詞 / 副詞
explanation_mandarin: 表示到達某個時間、地點或程度；也可用作強調，表示「甚至」或最高程度。常見於「直至」、「甚至」等詞語中。
explanation_english: Indicates reaching a point in time, place, or degree; can mean 'to', 'until', 'up to', or function as emphasis meaning 'even' or a superlative. Common in compounds like '直至' (until) and '甚至' (even).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 營業時間由早上九點至晚上九點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jing4 jip6 si4 gaan3 jau4 zou2 soeng6 gau2 dim2 zi3 maan5 soeng6 gau2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 營業時間由早上九點至晚上九點。
examples.english_sentence: The opening hours are from 9 AM to 9 PM.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 直至你講清楚，我先明白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zik6 zi3 nei5 gong2 cing1 co2, ngo5 sin1 ming4 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 直到你說清楚，我才明白。
examples.english_sentence: I won't understand until you explain it clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢忙到甚至連飯都冇時間食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mong4 dou3 si6 zan3 lin4 faan6 dou1 mou5 si4 gaan3 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忙到甚至連飯都沒時間吃。
examples.english_sentence: He was so busy that he didn't even have time to eat.

mandarin_meaning: 至高、最重要（置於一切之上）
english_meaning: supreme; paramount; above all
explanation_mandarin: 表示某事物位於最高地位或最重要，常用來強調優先或至高無上的地位，也常出現在複合詞如「至上主義」。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is of the highest status or most important, often used to emphasize priority or supremacy; frequently appears in compounds such as "-supremacy" or "-ism."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 安全至上，我哋唔可以貪快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: on1 cyun4 zi3 soeng6, ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 taam1 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 安全至上，我們不能匆忙行事。
examples.english_sentence: Safety comes first; we can't rush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對佢嚟講，成就至上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 keoi5 lai4 gong2, sing4 zau6 zi3 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 對他來說，成就至上。
examples.english_sentence: For him, achievement is paramount.

mandarin_meaning: 至今 / 到現在
english_meaning: up to now; until now; to this day
explanation_mandarin: 表示從過去某一時間點到現在為止的狀態或情況，常用於書面和口語中作副詞使用。
explanation_english: Expresses that a situation or state continues from some past time up to the present; commonly used as an adverb in both written and spoken language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我至今都未收到佢嘅回覆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi3 gam1 dou1 mei6 sau1 dou3 keoi5 ge3 wui4 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我至今都未收到他的回覆。
examples.english_sentence: I still haven't received his reply up to now.

mandarin_meaning: 直到 / 以至 / 甚至（口語用法，相當於普通話的「直到/以致/甚至」）
english_meaning: Colloquial Cantonese expression meaning "until" or "to the point that / so... that" (used to indicate a time limit or the extent/result)
explanation_mandarin: 「至到」為廣東話口語用法，用來表示某個動作或狀態持續到某一時點（相當於「直到」），或表示程度達到某一結果（相當於「以至/甚至」）。用法視上下文可表示時間或結果。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese construction used to indicate that an action or state continues up to a certain point (similar to "until") or that the degree reaches a certain result (similar to "to the point that" or "even"). Usage depends on context (time or result).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我等到天黑，至到佢都未嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dang2 dou3 tin1 haak1, zi3 dou3 keoi5 dou1 mei6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等到天黑，直到他都還沒來。
examples.english_sentence: I waited until it was dark, and he still hadn't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢忙到連飯都冇得食，至到身體都出問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mong4 dou3 lin4 faan6 dou1 mou5 dak1 sik6, zi3 dou3 san1 tai2 dou1 ceot1 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他忙到連飯都沒時間吃，以至身體也出問題。
examples.english_sentence: He was so busy he didn't even have time to eat, to the point that his health suffered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢窮到至到要跟人借錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kung4 dou3 zi3 dou3 jiu3 gan1 jan4 ze3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他窮到甚至需要向人借錢。
examples.english_sentence: He was so poor that he even had to borrow money from others.

mandarin_meaning: 非常合適；正好；恰當
english_meaning: perfect; exactly right; just right
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語用法，表示某事物非常合適、恰當或正好符合需要或情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression meaning something is very suitable, exactly right, or perfectly fits the need or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫至啱你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 zi3 ngaam1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這件衣服非常適合你。
examples.english_sentence: This outfit suits you perfectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家好肚餓，一碗湯麵至啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 tou5 ngo6, jat1 wun2 tong1 min6 zi3 ngaam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我現在很餓，一碗湯麵最合適。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really hungry now; a bowl of noodle soup is just right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嗰個主意至啱我哋而家嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 go2 go3 zyu2 ji3 zi3 ngaam1 ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 ge3 cing4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你說的那個主意最適合我們現在的情況。
examples.english_sentence: That idea you suggested fits our current situation perfectly.

mandarin_meaning: （副词）至多，最多，不超过某个数量或范围
english_meaning: at most; no more than
explanation_mandarin: 表示某個數量或程度的上限，意指不會超過該數目或範圍。
explanation_english: Indicates the maximum limit of a quantity or degree; means something will not exceed the stated amount or range.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你至多要等十分鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi3 do1 jiu3 dang2 sap6 fan1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最多要等十分钟。
examples.english_sentence: You'll have to wait at most ten minutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每人至多可以帶兩件行李上機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mui5 jan4 zi3 do1 ho2 ji5 daai3 loeng5 gin6 hang4 lei5 soeng5 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每人至多可以带两件行李上飞机。
examples.english_sentence: Each person may bring at most two pieces of luggage on the plane.

mandarin_meaning: 頂多/至多也不是（用於否定或弱化某種推測）
english_meaning: literally 'at most not'; a colloquial expression used to deny or downplay a claim — indicating that at most something isn't the case
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，用來否定或弱化對某事的推測或指控，意思為「頂多也不是那樣」，常用於引出更可能的原因或澄清情況。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese phrase used to deny or downplay an assertion. Literally 'at most not', it signals that a proposed explanation or accusation is unlikely or overstated, often followed by a more plausible reason.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遲到，至多唔係因為懶，可能係塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 dou3, zi3 do1 m4 hai6 jan1 wai6 laan5, ho2 nang4 hai6 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他遲到，頂多不是因為懶，可能是塞車。
examples.english_sentence: He was late — at most it's not because he's lazy; it was probably traffic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢唔嚟，至多唔係唔想嚟，係有事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 m4 lai4, zi3 do1 m4 hai6 m4 soeng2 lai4, hai6 jau5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他不來，頂多不是不想來，而是有事。
examples.english_sentence: If he doesn't come, it's at most not that he doesn't want to — he must have something going on.

mandarin_meaning: 最好
english_meaning: best; (it's) best to...; you'd better...
explanation_mandarin: 口語廣東話表達，相當於普通話的「最好」，用於給建議或表示某事為最理想的選擇。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression equivalent to Mandarin '最好'. Used to give advice or indicate the optimal choice/situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你至好早啲返屋企，今晚會落大雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi3 hou2 zou2 di1 faan1 uk1 kei2, gam1 maan5 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好早點回家，今晚會下大雨。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better go home early; there's going to be heavy rain tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔舒服，至好去睇醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 syu1 fuk6, zi3 hou2 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不舒服，最好去看醫生。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't feel well, it's best to see a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係至好嘅選擇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 zi3 hou2 ge3 syun2 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個是最好的選擇。
examples.english_sentence: This is the best choice.

mandarin_meaning: 最好不是 / 最好不要
english_meaning: It would be best if (something) weren't the case; better not...
explanation_mandarin: 粵語口語表達，用來表示最好不要發生某事或最好不是某種情況，通常用來提出建議或勸阻。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to say it would be best if something did not happen or if something/someone were not the case; used to give advice or discourage an action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你至好唔係親身去，派個代表就得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi3 hou2 m4 hai6 can1 san1 heoi3, paai3 go3 doi6 biu2 zau6 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好不要親自去，派個代表就行了。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better not go in person; send a representative instead.

mandarin_meaning: 至高无上；最尊贵
english_meaning: supreme; highest; most honorable
explanation_mandarin: 表示地位、等级或价值最高，至高无上、最尊贵。可作形容词修饰事物，亦可作名词或称号使用。
explanation_english: Denotes the highest status, rank, or value; supreme and most honorable. Can be used as an adjective to describe something or as a noun/title.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店嘅至尊套房，價錢貴，但設備好豪華。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 zi3 zyun1 tou3 fong2, gaa3 cin2 gwai3, daan6 cit3 bei6 hou2 hou4 waa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的至尊套房，价钱贵，但设施很豪华。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel's supreme suite is expensive, but the facilities are very luxurious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個漢堡加咗晒所有配料，叫做「至尊漢堡」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hon3 bou2 gaa1 zo2 saai3 so2 jau5 pui3 liu6, giu3 zou6 "zi3 zyun1 hon3 bou2".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个汉堡加了所有配料，叫做“至尊汉堡”。
examples.english_sentence: This burger has all the toppings and is called the 'Supreme Burger'.

mandarin_meaning: 至少
english_meaning: at least
explanation_mandarin: 表示最低限度，不低于某个数量或程度，用来强调至少的情况或要求。
explanation_english: Indicates a minimum amount or degree; used to emphasize that something is not less than the stated quantity or condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我至少有十分鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi3 siu2 jau5 sap6 fan1 zung1
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我至少有十分钟。
examples.english_sentence: I have at least ten minutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你至少要交英文功課啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi3 siu2 jiu3 gaau1 jing1 man4 gung1 fo3 laa3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你至少要交英文作业了。
examples.english_sentence: You should at least hand in the English homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 至少有一樣嘢係啱嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi3 siu2 jau5 jat1 joeng6 je5 hai6 aam1 ge3
examples.mandarin_sentence: 至少有一样东西是对的。
examples.english_sentence: At least one thing is correct.

mandarin_meaning: 很可以；非常好；很讚
english_meaning: awesome; very good; totally acceptable/cool
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 感嘆詞 / 形容詞（俚語）
explanation_mandarin: 廣東話口語俚語，用來表示對人或事物的讚賞或認同，意思接近「很可以」「很棒」「很合適」。多見於香港年輕人口語，語氣較隨意。
explanation_english: A Cantonese colloquial/slang expression used to praise or approve someone or something — similar to 'very good', 'awesome', or 'totally acceptable'. Common in Hong Kong informal speech.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇吓呢件衫，至得喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 ni1 gin6 saam1, zi3 dak1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看看这件衣服，很酷／很合适。
examples.english_sentence: Look at this shirt — it's awesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個提議至得，我哋就跟住做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 tai4 ji5 zi3 dak1, ngo5 dei6 zau6 gan1 zyu6 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的提议很不錯，我們就照做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Your proposal is great — let's go ahead with it.

mandarin_meaning: 至爱 (zhì'ài)：最喜愛的人或物
english_meaning: favorite; beloved
explanation_mandarin: 表示最喜歡或最珍視的人或物，常用來形容心愛的事物或人。
explanation_english: Indicates the person or thing one likes most or cherishes; used to describe a favorite or beloved item/person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書係我嘅至愛，成日翻睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zi3 oi3, sing4 jat6 faan1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這本書是我的至愛，經常重看。
examples.english_sentence: This book is my favorite; I often reread it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅至愛，冇佢唔得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zi3 oi3, mou5 keoi5 m4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他／她是我的至愛，沒有他／她不行。
examples.english_sentence: He/she is my beloved; I can't do without them.

mandarin_meaning: 至于（關於；至於…則）
english_meaning: as for; as to; regarding; with regard to
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 介詞 / 連詞（語篇連接詞）
explanation_mandarin: 用來引出談話中另一個主題或就某一方面作說明，相當於「至於…」、「關於…」。
explanation_english: Used to introduce another topic or to comment on a particular aspect; functions like 'as for' or 'regarding'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 至於嗰件事，我覺得冇必要再講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi3 jyu1 go2 gin6 si6, ngo5 gok3 dak1 mou5 bit1 jiu3 zoi3 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 至于那件事，我覺得沒有必要再說。
examples.english_sentence: As for that matter, I think there's no need to talk about it anymore.

mandarin_meaning: 至极（表示程度非常高）
english_meaning: extremely; to the utmost; exceedingly
explanation_mandarin: 用來表示程度非常高、極其，常見於書面或較正式的語境，相當於「非常」「極其」。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a very high degree; equivalent to 'extremely' or 'utterly'. Often found in more formal or literary contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅體驗真係至極難忘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 tai2 jim6 zan1 hai6 zi3 gik6 naan4 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的体验真是至极难忘。
examples.english_sentence: This experience was truly extremely unforgettable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我煩厭至極，想離開呢個地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 faan4 jim3 zi3 gik6, soeng2 lei4 hoi1 ni1 go3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我厌烦至极，想离开这个地方。
examples.english_sentence: I'm extremely fed up and want to leave this place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅表現差勁，令我失望至極。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 biu2 jin2 caa1 ging6, ling6 ngo5 sat1 mong6 zi3 gik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的表现很差，让我失望至极。
examples.english_sentence: His performance was terrible, making me extremely disappointed.

mandarin_meaning: 至死方休 / 誓死不休
english_meaning: to persist until death; will not stop until one dies; to be relentless (often used for vengeful or stubborn conduct)
explanation_mandarin: 表示堅持某種行為或態度直到死亡才會停止，語氣激烈，常用於報復、記仇或不肯放手的情況。
explanation_english: Indicates persisting in an action or attitude until death; not giving up until one dies. Often conveys a fierce or vindictive determination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗報仇，至死方休，唔肯放過對方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bou3 cau4, zi3 sei2 fong1 jau1, m4 hang2 fong3 gwo3 deoi3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他為了報仇，至死方休，不肯放過對方。
examples.english_sentence: He is determined to get revenge and won't stop until he dies; he refuses to let the other person off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好記仇，至死方休，大家都盡量閃佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gei3 cau4, zi3 sei2 fong1 jau1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zeon6 loeng6 sim2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很記仇，至死方休，大家都盡量躲開他。
examples.english_sentence: He holds grudges and won't let them go until death; everyone tries to avoid him.

mandarin_meaning: 甚至沒有 / 完全沒有
english_meaning: not even; absolutely no / not at all
explanation_mandarin: 表示極端的否定，用於強調某事完全不存在或根本沒發生，可理解為「甚至沒有」或「連……都沒有」。
explanation_english: Expresses extreme negation, used to emphasize that something does not exist or did not happen at all; equivalent to 'not even' or 'absolutely no'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我至無諗過佢會咁樣做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi3 mou4 nam2 gwo3 keoi5 wui5 gam2 joeng6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我甚至沒有想到他會這樣做。
examples.english_sentence: I never even thought he would do that.

mandarin_meaning: 至理名言 (zhì lǐ míng yán)
english_meaning: A maxim/aphorism expressing a fundamental truth or wise saying
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常有智慧或具普遍真理的一句話，常用來形容簡短而精闢的格言或忠告。
explanation_english: A concise, insightful saying that expresses a universal truth or wise advice; used to refer to pithy maxims or aphorisms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢句至理名言，人人都應該記住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 geoi3 zi3 lei5 ming4 jin4, jan4 jan4 dou1 jing1 goi1 gei3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这句至理名言，人人都应该记住。
examples.english_sentence: This maxim is something everyone should remember.

mandarin_meaning: 至亲；最亲近的家人或亲属
english_meaning: closest relatives; immediate family; closest kin
explanation_mandarin: 表示與自己關係最親近的人，通常指家人或血親，也可作形容詞表示非常親近。
explanation_english: Refers to the people who are the closest to you, usually family or blood relatives. Can be used as a noun or adjective to indicate very close kinship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我至親，無人可以取代。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 zi3 can1, mou4 jan4 ho2 ji5 ceoi2 doi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我至亲，没人可以取代。
examples.english_sentence: He is my closest relative; no one can replace him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋都係我嘅至親家人，逢年過節都會一齊返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 dou1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zi3 can1 gaa1 jan4, fung4 nin4 gwo3 zit3 dou1 wui5 jat1 cai4 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们都是我的至亲家人，逢年过节都会一起回家。
examples.english_sentence: They are all my closest family members; we always return home together for festivals.

mandarin_meaning: （口語）甚至（說）
english_meaning: even (to say); to even go so far as to say
explanation_mandarin: 口語用法，用來引出一個更極端或令人驚訝的例子或說法，相當於普通話的「甚至（說）」。
explanation_english: A colloquial Cantonese expression used to introduce a surprising or extreme example or statement, equivalent to Mandarin "甚至(說)" ("even, to even say").

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢竟然至話唔識返屋企路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging2 jin4 zi3 waa6 m4 sik1 faan1 uk1 kei2 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他甚至說不認得回家的路。
examples.english_sentence: He even said he didn't know the way home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人話條片係假，佢仲至話係陰謀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 waa6 tiu4 pin2 hai6 gaa2, keoi5 zung6 zi3 waa6 hai6 jam1 mou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人說那段影片是假的，他甚至說是陰謀。
examples.english_sentence: People say the clip is fake; he even said it's a conspiracy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明做錯事，至話係別人勸佢咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zok3 co3 si6, zi3 waa6 hai6 bit6 jan4 hyun3 keoi5 gam2 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明做錯事，卻甚至說是別人勸他那樣做。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly did something wrong, but even claimed others urged him to do it.

mandarin_meaning: 至诚（極度的誠懇、真誠）
english_meaning: utmost sincerity; wholehearted honesty
explanation_mandarin: 表示極度誠懇或真誠的態度，常用於書面或正式語境，形容人對待他人或事物非常誠恳。
explanation_english: Expresses extreme sincerity or wholehearted honesty; commonly used in formal or written contexts to describe a person's very sincere attitude toward others or matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對人至誠，所以獲得大家嘅信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 jan4 zi3 sing4, so2 ji5 wok6 dak1 daai6 gaa1 ge3 seon3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他對人至誠，所以獲得大家的信任。
examples.english_sentence: He treats people with utmost sincerity, so he has earned everyone's trust.

mandarin_meaning: 至高无上（zhì gāo wú shàng）——最高、無可超越
english_meaning: supreme; paramount; of the highest rank or importance; unsurpassable
explanation_mandarin: 表示地位、程度或名望達到最高，無可超越或超越一切其他者。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone or something's status, degree, or reputation is the highest and cannot be surpassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺樂隊入面享有至高無上的地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngok6 deoi6 jap6 min6 hoeng2 jau5 zi3 gou1 mou4 soeng6 dik1 dei6 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在乐队里享有至高无上的地位。
examples.english_sentence: He enjoys a supreme position in the band.

mandarin_meaning: （書面語）送、致使、致力（如「致電」「致力」「致命」）
english_meaning: to send; to cause; to devote (formal/written); deadly/fatal (in compounds)
partOfSpeech_english: verb (formal/written); adjective (in compounds like '致命' = fatal)
explanation_mandarin: 「致」常用於書面或正式場合，表示送達、使發生或投入精力（如「致電」「致力」），在某些複合詞中表示「致命、致使」等含義。
explanation_english: A formal/written character meaning to send, to cause, or to devote effort (e.g. 致電, 致力). In compounds it can also mean fatal or causative (e.g. 致命, 導致).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢致電本公司查詢資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi3 din6 bun2 gung1 si1 caa4 seon1 zi1 liu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他致電本公司查詢資料。
examples.english_sentence: He called our company to inquire about the information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直致力於社區服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 zi3 lik6 jyu1 se5 keoi1 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直致力於社區服務。
examples.english_sentence: He has been dedicated to community service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰次車禍致命，造成兩個人死亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 ci3 ce1 fo2 zi3 ming6, zou6 sing4 loeng5 go3 jan4 sei2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那次車禍致命，造成兩人死亡。
examples.english_sentence: That car crash was fatal, causing two deaths.

mandarin_meaning: 导致
english_meaning: to cause; to bring about; to result in
explanation_mandarin: 表示造成某种结果，常用于书面语，相当于“导致”或“致令”。
explanation_english: Indicates causing a particular result; often used in formal or written contexts; equivalent to 'lead to' or 'cause'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 連日大雨致使河水暴漲，村莊需要撤離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lin4 jat6 daai6 jyu5 zi3 si2 ho4 seoi2 bou6 zoeng3, cyun1 zong1 seoi1 jiu3 cit3 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 连日大雨致使河水暴涨，村庄需要撤离。
examples.english_sentence: Continuous heavy rain caused the river to flood, forcing the villagers to evacuate.

mandarin_meaning: 致力（投入力量或努力去做某事）
english_meaning: to devote oneself to; to strive; to make efforts
explanation_mandarin: 表示投入力量或努力去做某件事情，常用於表達為某目標而努力或投入資源。
explanation_english: Indicates devoting effort or resources to accomplish something; used to express striving or committed effort toward a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會致力改善社區環境，令街坊有更好嘅生活空間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 zi3 lik6 goi2 sin6 se5 keoi1 waan4 ging2, ling6 gaai1 fong1 jau5 gang3 hou2 ge3 sang1 wut6 hung1 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会致力改善社区环境，让街坊有更好的生活空间。
examples.english_sentence: We will strive to improve the community environment so residents have better living space.

mandarin_meaning: 致勝 (zhìshèng)：確保勝利、決定勝負的
english_meaning: to secure victory; decisive (factor or method)
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 動詞/形容詞（視語境而定）
explanation_mandarin: 表示能夠帶來勝利或決定比賽、競爭結果的因素或方法。可用作動詞（使取得勝利）或形容詞（具有致勝效果）。
explanation_english: Indicates something that can bring about victory or decide the outcome of a contest. Can be used as a verb (to secure victory) or as an adjective (having a winning/decisive effect).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個戰術係致勝關鍵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zin3 seot6 hai6 zi3 sing3 gwaan1 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個戰術是致勝的關鍵。
examples.english_sentence: This tactic is the key to victory.

mandarin_meaning: 致命（导致死亡、具有致死性；亦可引申为造成严重后果或在口语中指极具吸引力）
english_meaning: fatal; deadly; lethal. (Also used figuratively/slang for 'irresistible' or 'killer')
explanation_mandarin: 「致命」本義指能導致死亡或具有致死性，用於描述傷害、疾病或危險情況；引申義可指造成致命性後果的關鍵一擊或在口語中形容某人或某事物極具吸引力、難以抗拒。
explanation_english: Originally means causing death or having lethal effect, used for injuries, illnesses or dangerous situations. Figuratively it can mean a decisive/fatal blow, or colloquially describe something/someone as extremely attractive or irresistible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個傷勢好嚴重，可能致命，要即刻送院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 soeng1sai3 hou2 jim4zung6, ho2nang4 zi3ming6, jiu3 zik1haak1 sung3 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個傷勢很嚴重，可能致命，要立刻送醫。
examples.english_sentence: The injury is very serious and could be fatal — get them to the hospital immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個笑容真係致命，令人無得頂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 siu3jung4 zan1hai6 zi3ming6, ling6jan4 mou4 dak1 deng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她的笑容真是致命，讓人招架不住。
examples.english_sentence: His/her smile is killer — completely irresistible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢招係致命一擊，對手即刻投降。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ziu1 hai6 zi3ming6 jat1 gik1, deoi3sau2 zik1haak1 tau4hoeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這一招是致命一擊，對手立刻投降。
examples.english_sentence: This move is a fatal blow; the opponent surrendered immediately.

mandarin_meaning: 致命伤
english_meaning: fatal wound; critical fatal flaw
explanation_mandarin: 指能導致死亡的嚴重傷害；引申為使計劃、事業或競爭等徹底失敗的關鍵性缺陷或弱點。
explanation_english: Refers to a wound that can cause death; figuratively, a decisive weakness or flaw that causes a plan, project, or effort to fail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢胸口中咗一個致命傷，已經救唔返喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hung1 hau2 zung1 zo2 jat1 go3 zi3 ming6 soeng1, ji5 ging1 gau3 m4 faan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的胸口中了一个致命伤，已经救不回来了。
examples.english_sentence: He suffered a fatal wound to the chest; he couldn't be saved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃最大嘅致命傷係預算唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 zi3 ming6 soeng1 hai6 jyu6 syun3 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 這個計劃最大的致命傷是預算不足。
examples.english_sentence: The biggest fatal flaw of this project is an insufficient budget.

mandarin_meaning: 向死者或其家屬表達哀悼、慰問（zhì āi）
english_meaning: to offer condolences; to express mourning or sympathy for the deceased
explanation_mandarin: 表示對逝者或其家屬表示哀悼和慰問，多用於正式或書面語境，如追悼會、悼念活動中。
explanation_english: A formal phrase meaning to express sorrow or offer condolences to the deceased or their family; commonly used in memorials and official contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府派代表去向家屬致哀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 paai3 doi6 biu2 heoi3 hoeng3 gaa1 suk6 zi3 oi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府派代表去向家属致哀。
examples.english_sentence: The government sent representatives to offer condolences to the family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺追悼會上向遇難者致哀，默哀三分鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 zeoi1 dou6 wui6 soeng6 hoeng3 jyu6 naan6 ze2 zi3 oi1, mak6 oi1 saam1 fan1 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在追悼会上向遇难者致哀，默哀三分钟。
examples.english_sentence: At the memorial service we offered condolences for the victims and observed three minutes of silence.

mandarin_meaning: 致富（zhì fù），變得富有或獲得財富
english_meaning: to become wealthy; to acquire wealth
explanation_mandarin: 指通過努力、投資或其他手段而獲得財富、變得富有。
explanation_english: Refers to becoming wealthy or obtaining wealth through effort, investment, or other means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想致富，就要慳錢同投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 zi3 fu3, zau6 jiu3 haan1 cin2 tung4 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想致富，就要省錢和投資。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to become wealthy, you need to save money and invest.

mandarin_meaning: 向某人表示問候或敬意
english_meaning: to convey one's regards or to express respect/greetings
explanation_mandarin: 表示向某人傳達問候或敬意，常用於正式或書面語境。
explanation_english: To send or convey greetings, regards, or respect to someone; often used in formal or written contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 麻煩你替我向阿姨致意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 faan4 nei5 tai3 ngo5 hoeng3 aa3 ji4 zi3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你替我向阿姨致意。
examples.english_sentence: Could you please convey my regards to my aunt?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 開會開始前，主席向來賓致意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoi1 wui6 hoi1 ci2 cin4, zyu2 zik6 hoeng3 loi4 ban1 zi3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 会议开始前，主席向来宾致意。
examples.english_sentence: Before the meeting began, the chairperson extended greetings to the guests.

mandarin_meaning: 过敏原（引起过敏反应的物质）
english_meaning: allergen; a substance that causes an allergic reaction
explanation_mandarin: 引起机体免疫反应并导致过敏症状的物质，例如花粉、塵蟎、动物皮屑或某些食物蛋白等。
explanation_english: A substance that triggers an immune response causing allergic symptoms, for example pollen, dust mites, animal dander, or certain food proteins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話呢樣嘢係你嘅致敏原，記住要避免接觸同埋食用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ni1 joeng6 je5 hai6 nei5 ge3 zi3 man5 jyun4, gei3 zyu6 jiu3 bei6 min5 zip3 zuk1 tung4 maai4 sik6 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说这个东西是你的致敏原，记得要避免接触和食用。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said this substance is your allergen; remember to avoid contact and consumption.

mandarin_meaning: 向某人或某事表示尊敬、敬意或致意（致敬）
english_meaning: to pay tribute to; to show respect or salute
explanation_mandarin: 表示向某人或某事表達尊敬、敬意或敬禮，常用於正式或莊重的場合，例如向英勇者或傑出人士致敬。
explanation_english: To express respect, admiration, or to salute someone or something. Commonly used in formal or solemn contexts, e.g., paying tribute to heroes or notable figures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要向為抗疫辛勞嘅前線醫護人員致敬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hoeng3 wai6 jik6 cing4 san1 lou4 ge3 cin4 sin3 ji1 wu6 jan4 jyun4 zi3 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要向为抗疫辛劳的前线医护人员致敬。
examples.english_sentence: We should pay tribute to the frontline medical staff who worked hard during the epidemic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌係向傳奇歌手致敬嘅作品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 hai6 hoeng3 cyun4 kei4 go1 sau2 zi3 ging3 ge3 zok3 ban2.
